hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This is not our first stay at the Hampton Inn in downtown Brickell and like the many other stays it did not disappoint. The value far exceeds the price and the location is great with so many restaurants within walking distance. We are always greeted by friendly staff doing their best to make our stay perfect. The atmosphere is great. Nice music and scent throughout the common areas. The rooms are quiet, decorated nicely, clean and the beds are very comfortable. The complimentary breakfast in the morning has a variety of food offerings for a great way to start your day. The gym has everything you need to get a workout in and the pool is a great spot to relax. This is always our hotel of choice when we come to visit and highly recommend it.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great hotel, location and staff. This was our second time staying here and it did not disappoint. The rooms are modern and clean. The breakfast has a large variety of items to choose from. The hotel is walking distance to lots of great restaurants, short ride from the airport, cruise port or Miami. The metro is also right by the hotel for easy access to Miami. Will definitely choose this hotel again when staying in Miami.

review_text: I stayed in this Hilton hotel for access to the FIFA fan-zone in Miami and it was a great hotel , with a wonderful location and service. hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Ernest, the manager, provided us with outstanding and high-quality service throughout our stay. The entire staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, comfortable, and valued from the moment we arrived. This hotel offers a truly high-standard experience in every aspect, from the service to the facilities and overall atmosphere. We sincerely appreciate the dedication and professionalism of the team and would like to thank everyone for making our stay such an enjoyable one.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I do not usually write many reviews and I should have written this back in March after our stay at the Hampton Inn & Suites, I have made a conscious effort to battle with my prehistoric login details and make a point of writing a review for this hotel. I stayed in March 2026 with my husband and 6 year old son - we are from the UK and this was a pre-cruise stay leaving from Miami port. The hotel is in a great location, just by Brickell Station so we were able to get the Miami Mover train at the airport to the station and 15 mins later at Brickell - for something like $5 for us all! Hotel is lovely, reception staff were attentive and welcoming. Our room was clean with excellent facilities. I has signed up to Hilton rewards and received a welcome gift with water/snack which was very appreciated after a long day of travelling across the pond! BREAKFAST - was soo soo good! My son enjoyed making the waffles himself and there was a great selection of hot and cold foods. Enough to set you up for a busy day in Miami and this saved us a lot of money!! We went to the pool which was nice - never too busy and views of skyscrapers really set the scene that we were in Miami. We had free drink vouchers given to us at check in which we used in the hotel bar. This was a large clean area - same as used for breakfast - which was a nice place to chill out. PLOT TWIST - we enjoyed this hotel so so much, that we actually pushed our flights back after our cruise and stayed a further two nights to finish exploring Miami. That is how much I would recommend it! I did see a transfer bus to the port for cruises which looked well organised. We used an Uber which was easy and took around 40 mins with traffic. I noticed lots of guests were cruisers, some co-corporate and many with children. There is a fantasic gastropub located next to the hotel - same building - called Batch. We ate here each evening and it was the perfect american experience. I will review independently but I would strongly recommend it if you are staying.

review_text: Me encantó hospedarme aquí. Todo estuvo excelente: el personal súper amable, la habitación muy cómoda y limpia. El desayuno también estuvo muy bueno. La ubicación es inmejorable, en el corazón de Brickell, cerca de todo: restaurantes, tiendas y lugares de interés. Sin duda, recomendaría este hotel al 100%. They RE-CHARGED us for a breakfast buffet WE DIDN’T HAVE. We flew into Miami on 7/11/26 for a World Cup match and checked out the next morning. We had no complaints about the stay until checkout. The checkout agent said we had a breakfast buffet charge that day, which we did not eat. I assured her all the other charges were correct but neither my wife nor I had breakfast. In fact, we had brunch reservations at Joe’s Stone Crab right after we checked out (so why would we eat a buffet before?). The agent took off the breakfast charge but did remark in a very suspicious and snarky manner, “oh, that is interesting…” which was offensive but I didn’t say anything in reply. I’ve spent a significant chunk of my life in hotels but never had that kind of suspicion directed at me. The real problem started when I found out a couple of days later that the hotel had RE-CHARGED us for the breakfast we never had, the day after we checked out. Of course, I contacted IHG support and disputed the charge again. The management of the hotel replied and said the charge was for the breakfast buffett and that was all. Basically, the hotel is calling us liars/criminals. I contacted IHG again and asked to have them check the security camera footage. We never even went to the buffet restaurant during our one-night stay. Also, I offered to show them the credit card receipt for brunch at Joe’s Stone Crab which we had immediately after checkout. They said they would respond in 24 hours but never been. My wife once had a similar experience at a Marriott where someone accidentally / intentionally charged her room for a breakfast she never had. After a quick investigation, they took off the charge, simple as that. I had been a Hyatt Globalist for a while and have stayed at many hotels in my life and this is the only time I’ve been accused of lying. Their lack of process or controls to ensure that innocent guests don’t get incorrectly charged for food/service they never had is very unsettling. I certainly will not stay at this property again and will have serious reservations about staying at any IHG property in the future.

My mom and I stayed at the InterContinental Miami to celebrate my mom’s birthday, and what we experienced was so much more than a hotel stay, it became a memory we will cherish for the rest of our lives. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with genuine warmth and kindness. The room was beautifully decorated with balloons, flowers, and thoughtful details that immediately made my mom feel celebrated. She was completely overwhelmed with emotion and actually cried after she walked into the room. Seeing her so happy was priceless and it is a moment our family will never forget. The biggest reason this stay was so extraordinary was Mariana from Room Fairies along side Eduardo Rosello and Mauricio Botero. Mariana poured her heart into every detail. She took the time to learn about my mom, carefully selected beautiful purple flowers and sunflowers, and even left us one of her mother’s poetry books because Puerto Rico held such a special place in her mother’s heart. That incredibly personal and heartfelt gesture touched us beyond words. It wasn’t just customer service it truly was genuine human kindness. Mr Rosello and Mr Mauricio were equally wonderful, helping make everything seamless and making us feel truly cared for throughout our stay. Together, they transformed what could have been a nice birthday into one of the most meaningful celebrations my mom has ever had. Beyond the incredible hospitality, the hotel itself is fantastic. The location is unbeatable, we were able to easily walk to the FIFA Fan Festival for the World Cup festivities, which made the experience even more exciting. Watching the games surrounded by fans from all over the world was unforgettable. The Fourth of July rooftop celebration was another highlight. The views over Biscayne Bay and the fireworks and the drone show were spectacular, the atmosphere was festive, and it was the perfect way to end such a special trip. Everything about the hotel, from the beautiful property, comfortable rooms, cleanliness, and excellent service, was outstanding. But what truly sets the InterContinental Miami apart are the people who work there. They made us feel like family from the moment they open the door for you. We travel often, but very few places leave a lasting imprint on your heart. This one did. If we return to Miami, it will be because of Mariana, Mauricio and Rosello. They reminded us that hospitality isn’t just about a beautiful hotel, it’s about making people feel seen, loved, and cared for. Thank you InterContinental Miami for giving my mom a birthday she’ll remember forever. And from the bottom of our hearts, thank you, Mariana, Eduardo Rosello and Mauricio Botero. You truly made magic happen, and we will never forget your kindness. ❤️🎈🌻💜

I am extremely disappointed with our experience at the InterContinental Miami. We specifically called ahead before our stay and made two requests: (1) a room with a view facing the 4th of July fireworks, and (2) reservations for two people for the hotel’s 4th of July pool deck celebration. We were assured over the phone that both requests would be taken care of. When we arrived, we discovered that neither promise had been honored. Our room did not face the fireworks as promised, and the front desk informed us that the 4th of July celebration had already sold out and that no reservations had been made for us. If the hotel could not accommodate these requests, we would have appreciated honesty from the beginning instead of being told everything was confirmed. We planned our holiday around these promises, only to arrive and find out they were never fulfilled. It completely changed our experience and was a huge disappointment. For a hotel that markets itself as providing exceptional service, this level of miscommunication and lack of follow-through is unacceptable. We expected much better, especially for a special holiday stay. Unfortunately, based on this experience, we cannot recommend this hotel and will not be staying here again in the future.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: My best friend and I had an absolutely phenomenal stay at this hotel, and we genuinely cannot stop talking about how incredible the experience was from start to finish. The location alone deserves five stars — perfectly situated in the heart of the city with easy access to public transportation, amazing restaurants, shopping, and so many of Miami’s must-see attractions. Everything felt effortlessly convenient, which made our trip even more enjoyable. What truly stood out was the atmosphere of the hotel. It had this perfect balance of lively Miami energy and refined professionalism. The space felt vibrant and exciting without ever feeling chaotic or overwhelming. From the moment we walked in, the hotel gave off an upscale, welcoming vibe that immediately made us feel comfortable and excited for our stay. Our room met or exceeded expectations in every way. It was beautiful, spacious, spotless, and thoughtfully designed. Every detail felt intentional and polished, and the level of cleanliness was honestly impressive. Housekeeping clearly takes great pride in maintaining the property because everything felt immaculate throughout our entire visit. One of the most surprising aspects was how quiet the hotel was, especially considering its downtown location. We expected at least some city noise, but our room was peaceful and relaxing at all hours. We both slept incredibly well every night, which says a lot in a busy city like Miami. The service was truly exceptional and easily comparable to what you’d expect at a luxury hotel. Every staff member we encountered was professional, warm, accommodating, and genuinely kind. The front desk team made us feel welcomed from the second we arrived, and they consistently went above and beyond throughout our stay. A very special thank you to Adrian at the bar, who made our experience even more memorable with his friendliness, professionalism, and generosity. He was outstanding and absolutely deserves recognition. The amenities were another highlight of the stay. Everything felt thoughtful, hospitable, and designed to make guests feel taken care of. We genuinely felt valued and cared for throughout the entire experience, which made the trip feel extra special. Overall, this hotel delivered an unbelievable value for everything it offers — prime location, beautiful accommodations, exceptional service, incredible cleanliness, and a truly elevated experience from beginning to end. We would return in a heartbeat and recommend it to anyone visiting Miami without hesitation. Five stars across the board!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Absolutely amazing hotel stay before my cruise. This hotel is clean, convenient to shopping and plenty of restaurants/bars. Walking distance to a Publix, the mall, bakery, etc. The hotel checkin is on the 6th floor, the first floor is mainly a seating area and concierge. They offer free hot breakfast, mini fridge and microwave in the room, cruise shuttle at time of this review is priced at $12 with pick up times at 10a, 11a, and 12p. If you miss breakfast, they had breakfast bags with fruit and other grab and go items. You will need your room key to access the laundry room and guest floors. There is no carpet in the room I was in (basic king- not the elite level) and pets are not allowed. Service animals only. The hotel has a lobby bar, three restaurants are located right next door (Sproutz, Batch Gastropub, and Shahs of Kabob). I dined at Sproutz and Shahas of Kabob and both are good, but they are not affiliated with the hotel. I stayed 3 nights prior to my cruise and I really enjoyed my stay. The air conditioner worked with no issues, pillows are very soft, bed was firm, but not uncomfortable and I slept better in that bed, than my own. There is a master light switch to control the overhead light in the entry and bathroom. You can operate them separately (it just takes some flipping of lights to figure it out). Decent water pressure and nice, hot water at night. Morning time I suggest getting your shower in early. Hot water is still present but not as hot as it was the night before. Tip- I took my shower at 5/6am the morning of checkout and the water was hot and perfect for a nice shower before leaving for cruise. Staff was always smiling, friendly and willing to assist. Carlos at the concerige desk is very helpful, ask for his recommendations and he is more than happy to assist. The 7th floor has the laundry facility, but many machines were out of order. This is going on my pre cruise hotel list because it was the perfect hotel and the perfect location. It was about a 15min ride to the cruise port and airport. The cruise port ride was booked for 8am, so I beat the 9am bumper car cruise port traffic.

review_text: Walter at reception made our day and our stay! He solved every issue we had. Another ice machine would be a nice addition, and a jacuzzi would complement the pool area very well for the colder days.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Jorge was a wonderful driver! Very friendly and helpful!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Skip the Uber take the shuttle which is free to the Hilton hotels. Jorge was very nice

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Gorge was awesome. He was very friendly and made sure our ride to the airport was seamless. Thanks Gorge. Hilton must be lucky to have you.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Staff members courteous and professional. Airport shuttle efficient; ask for Yuri. He is extremely pleasant and helpful!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Me and my husband, mother in law and father in law step son and friend stayed in the 2 bedroom suite. It was a lovely reporting. The 2 bedroom is extremely spacious and convenient and the view of the water was beautiful. The shuttle to and from airport is super helpful and also they have a port to the port of Miami for cruise for a very reasonable price. I would definitely recommend this location for a pre cruise trip.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: The driver, Yuri was great. They were working on one of the elevators, which has been the case the last 3 times we have stayed there.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Excellent stay, shuttle to airport was very pleasant. Kudos to the shuttle driver who was very kind.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Very comfortable 2-bedroom suite. Free breakfast. Quiet, safe location. Very clean room. Shuttle was arranged by hotel and got us to the cruise port in about 30 minutes. Take the earliest shuttle you can… after 9:30 traffic becomes heavy. Construction at tunnel/bridge can get backed up for over an hour and a lot of Uber and Lyft drivers don’t want to sit in traffic.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Stayed in April before a cruise and this hotel was great! Stayed in a 2 bedroom with family and rooms were large and comfortable. Room had 2 kinds with separate bathrooms full kitchen and living space. Staff helped with booking the best shuttle to the port! Everything was simple and well planned by the hotel. Free breakfast was great also and a nice add since we had to leave early. My only recommendation would be to repair elevators. They had 1 down and the other was extremely slow.
George was super Helpful. Midtown is awesome!
The property and amenities are first class and beautiful! The level of guest services and accommodations from George was impeccable! Enjoy this Modern property in the Heart of Midtown!

We stayed at The Hyde for the Memorial weekend! It is very central close to the mix, South Beach, Brickell and Wynwood are all within 15 minutes by car. The receptionists Carol and George are very friendly and helpful! Check-in was seamless and we also asked for a late checkout. The hotel itself is surrounded by restaurants, breakfast spots and shops. Very convenient to walk to. The rooms were clean, however I wish toiletries like shower cap, cotton rounds etc were available as a complimentary option. But there’s a Target in the area to get those too. Atmosphere was amazing! Even though Midtown is pretty busy, we got to relax. Thank you again Hyde Midtown for having us!
Great experience. Quiet Neighborhood and centrally located with good restaurant option nearby

If I could give zero stars I would. 1 star is simply too much. My boyfriend and I have stayed at this hotel several times because of the convenience in location and walkable area, but this visit was extremely unacceptable and incredibly disappointing. We booked through a third-party site at a confirmed promotional rate, and the hotel employee refused to honor it and overcharged us. While we understand mistakes happen, the front desk employee, by the name of Ken, would not correct the mistake or offer any resolution, despite the price on the website and their received confirmation that we booked through that website. Our proof was rudely dismissed. It all felt like a SCAM. No supervisor was on site or on call to correct the problem. This level of service is extremely disappointing and unprofessional. We will not be staying here EVER again! Would not recommend anyone else to stay either!!
Very comfortable room, quiet, excellent bed and shower. Lots of dining alternatives on the same street and within a block of the hotel. Friendly staff.
Great service from the front desk team, including George, at the Hyde hotel in Midtown Miami. The team was extremely kind and very accommodating, will definitely stay again.

I stayed at the Hyde Midtown for a business trip and really enjoyed it. The room was spacious and spotless; the pool and gym were both lovely. Easy to walk to different places thought Midtown, Wynwood, and the Design District. Jessa and George at the front desk were super nice and friendly, and Jessa really went out of her way to make me feel welcome. Overall a very pleasant stay!

Extremely central location in a lovely neighborhood, 5 minutes from the Design District, rooms are spacious and clean, and the staff are very attentive and helpful. We would especially like to thank Jessa at reception for her attentiveness and friendly demeanor. This will definitely be a hotel I'll stay at the next time I come to Miami!
I had a wonderful stay with Hyde and Jessa is super helpful and friendly. I will come back to stay for sure.
Great location, modern room decor.
Amazing experience as always! George was very polite both in the check in and check out.

Hydr Midtown was great stay all around! Guest services helped decorate my room for a birthday surprise, the valet service was seamless, and the amenities beneficial bonuses on top of my stay. The WhatsApp communication was also superb! 10/10 stay!!

The hotel is very modern and hip. The suite was absolutely perfect and finally a bathroom that had lighting that actually works for applying makeup. I usually have to sit on the floor with a small mirror on window sill to get ready because other hotels bathrooms are lit like a cave. The location in Midtown is awesome. It’s an up and coming area in Miami and has an easy vibe with many great restaurants within walking distance of hotel. It also feels safe. Price was surprisingly low. Especially still being at the end of our season in Florida

We got a free upgrade so that was nice! The rooms could have been cleaner. We found a previous guest's lingerie stuffed inside one of the drawers. But overall it was a great stay and I would definitely recommend it.
Location, neighbor and vale service 5/5 Crew 4/5 Housekeeping 1/5 (sometimes they skip room cleaning and when they do it's not completely done)

This was an excellent hotel in a great location. Front desk staff George & Billy were so helpful and great to recommend places to eat, etc. Beautiful room and great amenities. Very close to the cruise port and that was great for the morning we checked out. We will definitely book this hotel again if we are in Miami.
Clean room, great location Talk to George. He'll be happy to help you.

I stayed at the beautiful Hyde Hotel in Midtown. There was an issue with my towels. I left makeup on them. The hotel thought it was something else. I spoke with George and he provided me with a credit after speaking with him. He understood it was make up. The hotel is amazing with beautiful views and location is in walking distance to all restaurants and shopping. I would definitely stay at this hotel again. I will bring my own makeup towel next time.

I would highly recommend this hotel. I am basing this especially on the service of the staff especially Jesse, she went out of way to ensure our needs were met. The room was especially clean and had everything we needed. The location was amazing, right next to a Starbucks. Thanks for a great stay!

My sister and I took a girls trip to Miami and my sister found this hotel. From the time we walked into the door we knew this was our vibe. Rooms were very nice and clean. The fortune cookies and card on the beds was such a nice touch. I absolutely love details like this. The hotel itself was so nice and the esthetic screamed modern, chic, but also warm and welcoming. Customer service excellent. Aisha was amazing! She was so helpful, resourceful, patient and just had the sweetest spirit. We loved everything about this hotel and will definitely be back!

Arlo Wynwood was the perfect location for our Miami visit—new, upscale design and amenities; beautiful room and bath with a fantastic shower in the heart in the heart of the arts district. Staff was available throughout the stay and seemed eager to assist as needed. We highly recommend this hotel.
The hotel is nicely located walking distance to everything. Staff very friendly and attentive.

Nuestra estancia en Arlo hotel fue perfecta . Lo mejor de todo fue el personal , Andrés en recepción fue muy amable y resolvió todas nuestras dudas al momento . En el restaurante Víctor nos atendió de maravilla súper atento y profesional ambos hicieron que nuestras vacaciones fueran aún mejores ! Recomendado al 100% Gracias Andrés y Víctor Las españolas y el cubano un
I stayed at the hotel for two days. My respects go to the young woman from Nicaragua who cleans in the early hours of the morning, keeping the lobby impeccable.

Alro is the top choice for staying in Miami. Ernesto operates the best valet service. I only trust him with my car. Oscar at the front desk sent over a bottle of champagne for our anniversary, top notch service. 10/10 with the Arlo

Very unprofessional and not worth the money they charge in my opinion… Ressort fee will be additionally charged per day for WiFi, water and pool. Water is not in the room in the promised amount and also not restocked. Coffee capsules same… you have to call them for every single thing - even if you want your towels changed
Oscar at the front desk was seriously the best!! So welcoming, so nice, and just made everything feel easy from the second I walked in.

We had a fantastic stay at the Arlo, the rooms were spotless, the facilities modern and easily accessible. The staff were particularly helpful and I want to commend both Oscar and Wanda at the front desk for their hospitality - they made our stay memorable and I truly appreciated their attitude to service.

Excellent service! I attended a party on the 3rd floor and had an emergency in the restrooms; Mariela, the overnight cleaning staff member, helped me every step of the way. She is a very generous young woman.

Where do I begin — our stay at the Arlo Wynwood was a 10/10. The majority of that rating is due to the amazing front desk team. Specifically Oscar, Fabiola and Savory. Check in was a breeze and they went above and beyond to help us in any capacity. We will only stay at the Arlo when we are in Miami, I recommend you do the same!

I had an amazing time staying at the Arlo Wynwood. The staff were amazing with a special shout out to Julian for his excellent hospitality. The rooftop pool was very nice and the food and drinks were excellent
Great hotel with great staff. Love the vibe of the neighborhood!!! Will be back

I recently stayed at Arlo Hotel Wynwood with my husband and kids and the experience was extremely disappointing. There were very loud events happening at the hotel and the noise level was completely out of control. People were screaming and the music was so loud that it was impossible to relax in our room. When you stay at a hotel with your family you expect at least a basic level of comfort and quiet, but that was not the case here. For the price they charge, the experience simply does not match the cost. The service was also disappointing and the staff did not seem concerned about the situation or the impact on guests who were trying to rest. Overall it felt like a waste of both time and money. If you are looking for a peaceful stay, especially with family, I would not recommend this hotel. Unfortunately this was one of the worst hotel experiences we’ve had.

Vancances at the arlo hotel with my husband we had was captivated by the decoration of a very great elegance and even has very modern time. The bar the restaurant are as much a treat of the eyes and taste buds the staff of great kindness smiling at the listen and even if we do not speak English they all do to help us. The pool heat on you with the bar. The music on top 😊 thank you on c is feasted. Geraldine and Stephan

We had the most amazing experience at Arlo Wynwood! I stayed here with my mom to celebrate her birthday, and everything exceeded our expectations. The hotel itself is beautiful. very modern, stylish, and clean. However what truly made our stay special, was the incredible staff. A huge shoutout to Savery and Iaisha at check-in who were so kind, warm, and genuinely helpful. They made my mom feel celebrated and made the entire arrival process smooth and enjoyable. We felt taken care of the entire time, and it made my mom’s birthday trip that much more memorable. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a chic, clean, and welcoming place to stay in Miami. 💛

I had an amazing experience loved the hotel I want to give a special shout out to Nicholas at the valet, stand for all the extra help and hospitality, he is a very respectful and professional young man! 10/10 service

Had the pleasure of staying at Arlo Wynwood for one evening Friday February 20th prior to boarding our NCL cruise ship. All staff at check in were friendly upon arrival. The King size bed room was very clean and bed was comfortable. The rooftop pool is AMAZING. Food and drinks on the pool deck were delicious as well . Shout out to the female bartender there. she was very pleasant.:) a huge shout out to Shatoya in Security! I left my favorite hoodie in the lobby during check in. She helped me to co-ordinate a shipper to get it sent back to me in Canada :) We definitely will be staying in this hotel next February before we board next years cruise. I highly RECOMMEND Arlo Wynwood!!!!!
I was here for a business trip. Aisha was phenomenal! Her hospitality and charisma made me feel comfortable during my stay. She also has a genuine smile when you enter the hotel.
Oscar at the front desk was very helpful when we had questions. He was able to answer them all and accommodate us very nicely. Hotel environment and staff were phenomenal! Highly recommended!

Hotel overbooked! We flew in from Europe to the U.S. and had a booking at EPIC in Miami. We had booked a room well in advance through the hotel’s website and received a confirmation, but when we arrived after a 10-hour flight, we were told that the hotel was overbooked and that we couldn’t get our room. After a long discussion, we finally got the room we had booked. I will never book a room at EPIC again. So dissapointed.
David went above and beyond with the baggage service.

We came to thia hotel and we were greeted by Jhonathan. He has been a positive light during our entire stay (we stayed 2 overnights in May and then came back for 2 more over nights in June). He gave great recommendations to try different places in the area and made sure we got our needs met (grabbing waters, gett coffee after coffee hours, and explaining wine hour and such)! Even when we left the hotel, he was there to help with our bags till the very end. We will definitely come back because of him! Also some shout outs to Juan one of the servers at Area 31 and Victoria at the spa for massage and facial. The whole experience was relaxing, stress-free, and positive.
We had the best time! David was amazing with our luggage after checkout! Excited to come back!

Always a pleasure to stay at the Kimpton Epic Hotel. Jhonathan is such a kind person. He assisted my husband and I with early check in, made sure we had water, and handle our bags with great care. We always looking forward to seeing him when we stay here.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ After a very disappointing experience at another hotel, I was honestly considering driving the nine hours back home and canceling my birthday trip altogether. Thankfully, Sophia and bellhop Idael at the Kimpton EPIC completely changed that. Because of what had happened at the previous property, I was hesitant to book another hotel without seeing the room first. Sophia took the time to listen to my concerns and graciously allowed me to view the room before booking. Idael personally escorted me to the room, answered my questions, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. After viewing the room, I briefly visited another nearby hotel to compare options. The experience there was cold and unwelcoming, which only made me appreciate the genuine kindness and professionalism I had received at the Kimpton EPIC even more. I immediately returned and booked my stay. What stood out most was that Sophia and Idael genuinely cared. This wasn't just another reservation to them. I was celebrating my birthday with my daughter, two military veterans, and our dog, and they understood how important this trip was. At a time when I was stressed, disappointed, and ready to give up on the entire trip, they made us feel welcomed, respected, and valued. They didn't just provide excellent customer service—they helped save my birthday celebration. Their kindness, patience, and willingness to go above and beyond turned what could have been a terrible experience into a wonderful memory. While my experience with the spa was disappointing, the hospitality provided by Sophia and Idael was exceptional. They are the reason I chose the Kimpton EPIC, and they are the reason I would absolutely return. Thank you, Sophia and Idael, for your outstanding service, compassion, and professionalism. You made all the difference, and Kimpton EPIC is fortunate to have you both.
Excelente atención y servicio del señor Ramón Chavez. Atiende con naturalidad. Es sincero con el servicio Se nota que valora mucho su trabajo
Jean Baptiste was so kind and welcoming. He was a breath of fresh air in the morning.

I had a serious accident in the shower during my stay due to what I believe is a safety hazard in the bathroom. After the incident, I sent multiple emails over the course of nearly two months trying to contact management. Not once did anyone respond, follow up, or even check on my well-being. (There’s a big step when you’re going in the shower) What is most disappointing is not only the lack of concern after a guest was injured, but the complete absence of communication. If you stay here, please be extremely careful in the shower area, as it may pose a safety risk. I expected at least a response or acknowledgment, but received nothing. Customer service and guest safety should be taken much more seriously.
I had a great experience at the hotel. The staff were very helpful & friendly, especially Jean Baptiste! I would highly recommend.
Hotel has beautiful views, walking distance to everything and very helpful, polite and hard working staff. Room was clean and pleasant but I was expecting to be a bit more wowed by the esthetics.
Excellent service and excellent accommodations. Definitely will be back! Thank you Jean B. for your help with our car!

Left my cruise and was able to check into my room early. Plus the staff was nice ( something not too present here in MIA). Special shout out to my bellsman Jhonathan. Thanks for looking out for me for my BDay 🫡

I had an epic experience at the Kimpton epic hotel. It is definitely my go to when I’m in Miami. The service and location was absolutely perfect and accessible to everything. You’re close to everything yet far enough away from some of the nuances that Miami’s nightlife can entail. Service at area 31 is incredible. I’d recommend the shrimp and lobster wraps. Rudy’s service element was exceptional. He made sure my breakfast was executed correctly. Most importantly, My experience was highlighted by David Gil, the gentleman who helped me with my baggage and was very knowledgeable about advising me of nearby gyms and places that I can enjoy. I highly recommend this hotel and their impeccable staff!
Jean Bapt was a great help when I was coming in and leaving, the pace was really beautiful.
Overall the stay was amazing with a great view, breakfast was great the server was Coronado, and valet at checking out was above and beyond by Jean Baptiste.
Incredible stay. Upgraded room. Crib waiting for us upon arrival. Front desk staff always available and helpful. Jhonathan was very helpful with bags and advice. Breakfast excellent. Pool was nice.

Very good vibes from start to finish, the hotel is luxury in itself. The location is central and has a lot of nightlife in the area, with many eateries and entertainment within walking distance. Driving in Downtown Miami can get stressful and full of people so I'm glad for the valet services that are offered. Ramon Chavez from valet was especially very quick with service and attentive, making that experience much appreciated. Everything was better than expected.
David was great at helping us. 5 stars to him
Everyone at the hotel was beyond helpful. Made our experience great ! Would love to be back
Atmosphere and food is top tier, Dani was so nice and always looking out for the table.
Excellent service! Daniela was spectacular. She had so much knowledge about the food and drinks. Will definitely come back to this place. Well worth the price and the ambiance was magnificent.
Amazing food and great atmosphere! Dani is the best server there, she super nice and attentive
Fantastic time. Great food! Nice people!

The one thing better than the food is the service and the view. And that’s hard to say because everything is beyond amazing. Daniela made us feel so special, suggested the best options for our experience and was on top of every little detail. She told us about brunch and we can’t wait to try it

Encantada de todo el servicio, fui de visita desde España, en el valet parking de la noche me atendió un chico llamado Alejandro Rivas, encantada con la atención que nos brindo a mi y a mí hermana, muy amable el chico, el servicio 5 estrellas.
Had a great time, service was top notch. Thank you valet Alejandro for being so attentive.

I regret not coming sooner! We are so impressed with the friendly staff, beautiful decor, delicious food and drinks, and relaxing but fun atmosphere. The rooftop pool and bar/restaurant is such a lovely experience. It’s also a wonderful location in Coconut Grove. Close to everything! We will absolutely return the Mayfair in the future!

This is a beautiful hotel in a great area. For what we paid, their failure to better communicate + other things, was inexcusable. A lot of little things that added up. The joke, as I will explain, was that during our stay they texted and asked how things were going. I replied not so good and they asked why. I said happy to chat when back to hotel and then let them know I was back but no followup. I even showed the front desk person the texts. He could have cared less. When we checked in we were told because of how we booked, we got comp bf and also 2 drinks plus a $100 hotel credit. We had arrived late after a long day of travel. We were hungry and while we dont usually munch from the mini-bar, we were ready for a snack. Unfortunately, of the 10 or so food items there were supposed to be there, there was only 1. So no snack. We then went up to the roof top bar and sat down at 850. We looked at the food menu and first tried to order a couple beers with our drink coupons. They were out of about half the beers. People were eating around us. At 910, we told the bartender we wanted to order some food. He aid sorry, kitchen closed at 900. WHY COULDNT HE HAVE TOLD US THAT WHEN WE SAT DOWN! He said their main restaurant was open to 945. We decided to get room service. I tried to call couple times from the bar and just got vm. Frustrating. We were forced to go down to the restaurant and order directly from them. Had similar issue calling valet. Just rang and rang and rang. Finally front desk answered.Also, forgot to mention that in the room the toilet seat was loose. Annoying, especially when using it during the night. The room has a double sink (nice) but no dedicated soap dispenser. We had to move the soap dispenser from the shower to the sink and back. They had hand lotion but had to be 100 yers old. Came out in solid chunks. Disgusting. We crashed around mid-night. Poor sleep for 2 reasons. The hotel has an open atrium and we heard noises (loud) well after midnight- yelling, laughing. I was too tired to get out of bed and call but cant believe the hotel didn’t hear. Plus, the hallways are tiled, meaning you hear anything that is being wheeled over it. WE woke up around 900. I noticed on a flyer that they were serving brunch till 200 so figured we could shower and then head down for bf. We got to the restaurant about 1015 and were told sorry, bf ends at 1000. Nothing they could or would do other than get us 2 coffees (no machines in the rooms). Again, at check-in we should have been told this. We needed ice and called and they said would be right up. To me that means 5 minutes, maybe 10 if you tell someone “right up.” 15 minutes nothing. We were tired of waiting and called back and said to just leave it in the room since we were on our way out. Don’t promise something if cant deliver. Finally, as noted above, if you actually cared about how our stay was going, they would have responded to the text they sent me or the guy at reception would actually care we weren’t happy. Im happy to share with hotel the name of the person who texted us asking how the stay was going

I love the staff at this hotel! We had a little hiccup with our room when we arrived and Ozzy was above and beyond with kindness and help for us. What a wonderful individual! During our stay, David helped me more than once and he was just an incredible human being. Love the atrium and the style of our room! Great location to shops, restaurants, even the movie theater! We felt very safe here and were actually attending my favorite cousin’s wedding reception and activities for the weekend. We had so much fun on the rooftop relaxing after the hectic plans all weekend! Thank you again for a perfect stay.

Room was amazing and everything about a 2-3night stay was amazing. However, the wedding guests were terribly loud and rowdy until after 4am. Im surprised that type of disruption was allowed on property so late. The previous night was okay, no issues. Close to some major spots and hotel amenities are great. Stayed in a suite!

Worked with the staff to make a surprise for my brother and his fiancee and they went above and beyond! So grateful to them for their true hospitality and help. Quick response, kindness, and efficiency. Shout out to Alejandro Ponce for stellar work

This COULD be a great hotel. The staff is truly nice, the rooms are relatively clean and the hotel property is stunning. But issues which are unfortunate make it impossible to give this hotel a better review. They include a serious issue with hot water. Every member of our party had the same in their room every day we stayed and ended up taking cold showers. Clearly a pervasive issue and so unacceptable. The rooms are also too dark with inadequate overall lighting. The bathroom also needed an illuminating mirror. Finally, the elevators are too complex and you end up waiting constantly and need an engineering degree to use them. Could be a much better hotel. But someone needs to dial into the details!

We stayed at this hotel for three weeks in February. It was our second longer term stay at the hotel, and we enjoyed it once again. The hotel rooms surround a beautiful courtyard filled with palm trees, plants and fountains. This space establishes the vibe for the hotel. The hotel is older with a lot of character and the rooms are comfortable. The construction of the building doesn't allow for a lot of natural light in the rooms, but we enjoyed the spacious balcony. The hotel is located steps away from the restaurants and commercial area of Coconut Grove. We also found it very easy to explore other Miami environs from this location including Little Havana, Wynwood, Coral Gables, Key Biscayne, South Beach and the Everglades. The breakfast included with the stay was very good and the staff attentive. Specifically, we'd like to recognize Emily, Lorenzo, Kaylan, and Marlene for their great service. We also got to know the valet staff well! Miguel, William, Carlos, Fabrizio, and Lazaro were all very professional and helpful. They were always very prompt in getting our car to us when we needed it and offered helpful advice. The only area of the hotel that needs some improvement is housekeeping. The staff was very friendly but sometimes we needed to make multiple requests to receive what we asked for.

Beautiful looking hotel but when we checked in our room wasnt ready we were told we would be either messaged or called but no one contacted us at all.Room was lovely but the bed wasnt made properly the sheets were not tucked in at all. No Iron or board i had to ask for one and that did arrive the next morning. Valet parking did seem quick but it just felt like everyone was just after a huge tip !! Breakfast we waited 15 mins for a table once seated i asked could i just have 2 toast which was on the sides menu at a cost of $6 i was told it wasnt on the main menu so would be charged for it ,even though I didnt want the main costing $22 it just didnt make sense .Pool area was lovely but cocktails are very expensive .Overall nice hotel but I wouldnt go back .We did meet a lovely staff member called Michael but only once .Room cleaners came back on the 2nd day to clean but at 330pm we were resting before we went out for the evening .so told them no .I found it very frustrating staying at this hotel not relaxing at all !! We had previously tried to contact the hotel as this was a special trip for our 40th wedding anniversary they failed to contact us at all .Grwat shame !!

This hotel should be protected as an historic architectural gem. Loved the 80s design and detail. Service was great, rooms charming and clean. Ideal location. Pool nice. Loved the claw footed tub in the room. Everyday Yoga excellent and made the stay worth it! Coffee each morning much appreciated. It’s the small amenities that make a huge difference.

This beautiful hotel is perfectly located but service was uneven. From the hotel, it's an easy walk to scores of restaurants and shops, many directly across the street. As noted by others, valet is very quick and there are also several parking garages just a few steps away. While we noticed a number of weddings and celebrations during our stay, the hotel seemed to handle the traffic well and although one weekend evening had a band on the roof, we enjoyed it. The rooftop pool is small but lovely. The central garden is gorgeous and the second floor offers seating by the fountains. The rooms themselves are dark but we enjoyed the respite from the heat and from our 5th floor location, the balcony was sufficient when we wanted a bit more light. Breakfast and room service offerings are limited but adequate. In our five day stay, we found the service very uneven. We often made requests multiple times with different staff, particularly to get the room tidied and restocked and also in restaurants to get our full orders to the table. Everyone was very nice but seems a bit disorganized and for the price, we did expect a better experience. Common areas appeared spotless.
Fernando , Dakota , Simon and ariana made all the difference . Best service we’ve ever had .
Rooms very dark: lighting was terrible. No fan in interior bathroom. Electric (fuse) blew twice due to old wiring. But breakfast was very good. Rooftop pool and bar very nice.
Very comfortable Hotel with nice roof Top Bar and Pool. Hotel staff was very friendly. Close to Shops and. Restaurant at Coconut Grove.
Cori , she’s very good , she’s very sweet with me The hotel experience was incredible and the room

The rooftop is such a great spot! The views, the vibe, and the atmosphere make it a must visit. Raúl made the experience even better! He was incredibly friendly and provided spectacular service. He really stood out. If you stop by, definitely ask for Raúl!
Manuel was amazing, top notch employee🔥
The room was great. I was amazed the moment I walk in. Everything was clean and ready for us.
We loved the Elser! Amazing amenities especially during the World Cup. Manuel was excellent at assisting with our baggage. Very accommodating and personable. Thank you for the best service!

Fabian saved the day. He helped me voice my concern to the manager Frederick which completely changed everything around. I would’ve rated it higher but the woman at the front desk was not helpful at all. But Fabian and Frederick are heroes. The room is spectacular. Because of them I would return.

The wait time at the front desk was ridiculous. Then I was told they had an influx of check-ins. They knew they were coming and were still unprepared. One of the front desk employees was a girl in training and there was no supervisor or trainer to help her with a line of people waiting. I ended up checking in twice. Signed the same paperwork twice and finally got our room key. Oh and they told us we were getting a free upgrade to a 3 bedroom but it was not the bay view we paid for. For the price of their rooms I would expect exceptional service. Nothing impressive about anything in this hotel except the location.
Fabian was great, he was efficient and helpful and very positive, brilliant start to my holiday already.
Fabian was very helpful and nice
Manuel G was very helpful and directed us to parking and very helpful when we arrived!!!
Manuel was awesome!!! The room was amazing.
Amazing. Also thanks to Fabian for bag assistance.

I stayed at The Elser Miami to celebrate my birthday and unfortunately my experience fell far below expectations, especially considering the cost of the stay and the reputation of the property. Upon arrival, my room was not properly prepared. The microwave was dirty, the TV remote did not work, and I had to contact staff for assistance. Throughout my stay, housekeeping services were inconsistent. I made multiple requests for housekeeping and replenishment of items, but service was delayed and appeared rushed when it was finally completed. I also found expired items among the snacks and beverages provided in the room, which was concerning from both a quality control and guest safety standpoint. The most frustrating issue involved billing. After checkout, I noticed charges that I did not recognize and had to contact the hotel myself for an explanation. I was initially charged for minibar items that I did not consume. Although the charge was eventually removed, I was never provided with proof of what items I was supposedly accused of taking. As a guest, I should not have to dispute charges that were incorrectly applied in the first place. There was also significant confusion regarding credits, refunds, and charges. I was told one amount would be credited to my account, but later received different information from management. Even after multiple emails, I still do not feel that my questions regarding the charges and credits have been fully addressed. The worst part of my stay occurred on checkout day. The elevators were not functioning properly, creating major delays for guests trying to leave the property. My boyfriend and I were forced to carry our luggage down numerous flights of stairs in order to leave for the airport. Because of these delays, two Uber drivers canceled on us, and we were left scrambling to avoid missing our flight. What was most disappointing was the lack of assistance and concern shown to guests. A simple apology was offered, but no meaningful effort was made to address the inconvenience. When I later contacted management with a detailed explanation of the issues I experienced—including the room condition, housekeeping concerns, billing discrepancies, minibar accusations, elevator outage, transportation delays, and physical strain caused by carrying luggage down multiple floors—I received a response that addressed only a small portion of my concerns while ignoring many of the others. The hotel itself is beautiful and the location is convenient, but guest service, communication, billing transparency, and problem resolution need significant improvement. Based on my experience, I would not choose to stay here again, nor would I recommend it to others expecting a luxury hotel experience.
The hotel is very modern and clean, the location is very central. The staff is professional, very friendly and helpful!

My experience here was absolutely wonderful. I want to give a special shoutout to Corami, who goes above and beyond. It is so rare to see someone take their work as seriously and professionally as she does, and it made a huge difference in my visit. Humanity honestly needs more people who are as passionate and dedicated to what they do as she is. Highly recommend!
fabian who helped us transport our luggage to our room was really cool and friendly! def a good introduction to this hotel.
Good experience all around. Fabian was a great help, very good attitude, really made our stay better.
Manuel was a good bell man. I checked in early and left late even when I wasn’t checked in they made sure I didn’t have to walk around with my bags and they were secure.

Extremely disappointing experience at what is marketed as a premium property. We booked a One Bedroom Bay View apartment specifically because it included a washer and dryer, as we had just disembarked from a cruise and needed to do laundry before boarding another cruise the following day. Shortly after checking in, we discovered the dryer was not working. What followed was over two hours of frustration. We repeatedly contacted Concierge, Guest Services and Reception and were repeatedly told that someone from Engineering would arrive within 15 minutes. No one ever did. After nearly two hours, a manager finally informed us that the hotel was already aware the dryer was broken and that we would need to change rooms. In other words, the hotel was aware of the issue before our arrival, knowingly checked us into a room with a defective amenity, failed to disclose it, and then wasted more than two hours of our stay giving us false assurances that someone was coming to fix it. To make matters worse, the assistant manager we dealt with had a dismissive attitude throughout the interaction. I later emailed a formal complaint regarding the experience and never received any response. To make matters worse, we had already unpacked and started laundry. We were eventually moved to a studio, a downgrade from the one bedroom apartment we had booked and paid for. No assistance was offered with the move, and by the time everything was resolved, around two and a half hours of our one-night stay had been lost. The cleanliness was also below expectations, with visible dirt around the laundry area and hair left in the bathroom. The issue was never the broken dryer. Things break. The issue was the lack of transparency, poor communication, wasted time and the complete failure to take ownership of the situation. Having travelled extensively and stayed in hotels around the world, this was one of the most poorly handled service recoveries I have experienced. Unfortunately, I would not stay here again.
This is the second time I come to the hotel I just love it

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We had a one-night stay prior to a cruise. The hotel was clean, modern, and well maintained. The room was equipped with fridge, microwave, and a coffee machine that took some time to figure out. Check in on the sixth floor wasn’t a problem and elevator access any higher required a key card. Breakfast was included and the usual continental plus a few hot options. Staff was helpful storing our early arrival bags until our room was ready. There was an excellent restaurant right at the entrance and a bar in the front desk area. We were able to book a shuttle to our ship right on the ground floor for a reasonable price and that service was good. Our only disappointment was the pool being closed without explanation.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I visit family in Miami on a regular basis, and Hampton has become my go-to hotel. Conveniently located, always clean, and excellent service. The breakfast is a really useful perk as well. On this stay, I'd like to commend Rassoul who was particularly helpful after a stressful trip, due to train delays because of North Florida wildfires, and Rassoul was very understanding, concerned and attentive. Will be back soon!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I’m sorry we were only able to stay less than 24 hours. The hotel is conveniently located next to and walking distance from a lot of restaurants and shops and the metro. The room was a good size, comfortable and clean. The customer service was awesome. The breakfast was leagues ahead of any Hilton brand I have ever stayed at, and the person in charge kept the area very clean and stocked, and they have plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. Other locations please take note. It obviously can be done!! One additional perk that was perfect for us was the noon checkout instead of 11:00. We don’t usually travel to Miami, but I recommend this hotel to anyone needing a place to stay in the area.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Muy buen hotel. Es la segunda vez que nos alojamos aquí. Fuimos recibidos por Laicka excelente customer service . Nos explicó todo con detalles. Felicitaciones!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great location in Brickell—close to everything and just a block from the train, which made getting around really easy. Breakfast was simple, standard complimentary options, but did the job. What really stood out was the service, especially from Netch A. We arrived very early after a long trip and were exhausted—she went above and beyond to get us into a room as soon as possible. The room she selected was perfect and gave us exactly what we needed to rest and ease into our anniversary trip. It’s also conveniently close to the cruise port, and they offer shuttle service which was a big plus. We’d definitely stay here again and would recommend it to others.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: How much is a family room and the location and time to bake

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This hotel checked all our boxes: near public transportation, restaurants and shopping. Rooms were well thought out - and really appreciated the laundry facilities.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great facility, nice functional in downtown Miami brickell. Conveniently located to public transport that in Miami are convenient and free. Friendly and helpful staff. Good breakfast. Clean.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I’ve stayed at this location many times for business. They are always so warm and welcoming. I had an issue at check in recently and Rassoul went above and beyond to help me. His customer service is impeccable and I am forever a Hilton traveler because of people like Rassoul.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Exceeded my expectations! Location is amazing! Walking distance from best places in Downtown Miami! Breakfast was superior in quality : real cheese and charcuterie among the selections! Room was big with a jacuzzi! Everything went so well in my 2 nights stay! The cherry on the cake is Ernest, the manager! He is caring, attentive and courteous! I have one tiny complaint! I am a cheese lover who hate vegetables! Please, dont put cheese and broccoli in the same tray!( breakfast)!

The hotel is in a good location and has nice aesthetics. I enjoyed using the hot tub, and while it was too cold to use the pool during my stay, the pool area was beautiful. However, I don't believe this is a luxury hotel or that it's worth the price tag. There was no furniture on our balcony and certain items were not well stocked in our room (there was a kitchenette, but only two glasses and no way to wash them; no cutlery; only one coffee pod for the machine). There is a restaurant on site, but when we checked in we were told "there is no restaurant here" (it was closed for a private event the night we arrived). We were also told that we could request an upgrade (based on my credit card status) if we had an issue with the room; we were close to the elevators, so I decided to ask...only to be told we couldn't move. I'm usually not so picky with hotels and I tend to travel fairly frugally, and I do think it's a nice hotel. However, from my experience, the price does not match the amenities or service.

We used this hotel twice as we were on a Cunard cruise. We had rooms on the 6th floor both spacious well appointed, clean with a comfy bed and good Wi-Fi. Both rooms have small kitchens including a fridge but there is no cutlery or plates etc. There are two mugs for the coffee machine and glasses for water. There is sufficient storage space and a good safe. The bathrooms are large and security is good. You can't access the lift without your key card. Staff are very helpful, friendly and courteous. Our thanks to Jessa Robinson for upgrading us on our return visit and the female member of staff who assisted us with an Uber for the airport, much cheaper than a yellow cab. We also had late check outs and they have storage for your luggage in the lobby. The hotel is situated in the heart of midtown near a crossroads junction, road noise is noticeable. The hotel is also under the flight path of Miami airport and flights can be low. Fortunately flights are reduced in the evening and room insulation reduces exterior the noise. There are plenty of places within walking distance to eat both for breakfast and dinner. Our favourite for breakfast was Angelina's. There is also a good bakery round the corner from the hotel plus an Italian restaurant called Salumeria (advisable to book). We also tried a Mexican called Bakan and an Argentinian called Chimba. There is also a sports bar across from the hotel called Taps 42 with a good selection of drinks. Food is okay as well. The hotel is within walking distance of the Design district with lots of high end shops, cafe's and restaurants. It is also near the Wynwood area which has outdoors art, graffiti and also some good museums. If you get chance try and visit Cars & Guitars. Nice coffee bar, but the cars and guitars are the stars. There is also a hop on hop off bus stop near the hotel which will take you to the beach and Little Havana. So our thanks to Henry the general manager and the staff who made our time in Miami enjoyable. We would return should we visit Miami again.

Teníamos que elegir una ubicación que no estuviera muy distante del aeropuerto Internacional de Miami, y Midtown Miami resultó ser muy conveniente. El Hyde está súper bien ubicado. Es cómodo y el personal es muy amable. Tiene muchas tiendas alrededor y está a pocas cuadras del design District y de Wynwood!

Very beautiful hotel in a central location. Came to Miami to celebrate a birthday and could not have asked for a better place to stay. After comparing AirBnB options we decided to stay at Hyde Midtown instead since for the same price as the AirBnB options the hotel offered a higher quality room. The location was our favorite part since we were able to visit every part of Miami with a quick couple minutes drive. There is also everything you can need walking distance with all the surrounding stores and nightlife. Staff was very friendly and helpful the entire weekend. The room itself was clean, spacious, and offered a nice view of the open park outside. There was also a very large gym within the hotel that was bigger than most we've seen at other hotels with good array of equipment along with a nice rooftop pool. Overall, we will definitely be coming back any time we visit Miami.
Very nice boutique hotel situated in a great part of town surrounded by lots of great restaurants and great atmosphere.

Dear guys!!! The ADA platinum suite has been the perfect match for my 6 month experience as a wheelchair user the whole Hyde midtown hotel team has been great with me !!! A special thanks to Rob, Renata, ismael, claire, Kimberly, Billy, Samantha, Henry. All of them has always been available and accommodating. I will be missing them very much. Indeed, I have a very special feeling for them. I feel like I am part of The Hyde midtown hotel family forever after spending so long with all of them. I like them very much and I miss all of them very much. Take care my dear friends of the Hyde midtown hotel family Ben

I am pasting my Hotels.com review here as well. THERE WERE BEDBUGS!! We were bit!! It was so dirty!! Even though we put on the "Tidy Up My Room" sign noone came in to clean up the room. The hallways had left over trash on them for days. When we told the front desk about these, especially the bed bugs - they told us they would investigate and get back to us. For 3 days now no one reached out. Horrible stay, horrible hotel. Update: It has now been 5 days, and we still haven’t heard back.
Location is great and service good. However, I was looking forward to using the jacuzzi and it was jacuzzi closed for multiple days of my stay.
Location was excellent the room was clean and the staff friendly. I will definitely go again when traveling for business or personal.
Excellent, place to stay, great rooms, very responsive and attentive front desk. Claire was great. Only thing to consider is being more clear about the term "Kitchette" there is only a microwave.

Had an amazing stay. Hotel is well located mid town. Amenities are great and love the pool and fitness. The best of all is Claire at the front desk. She was able to recommend a great restaurant and a nice bar.

And the second time I stay in this hotel is always preserves the quality! This time I was surprised by the attention of all the receptionists and especially “Claire” who helped me with all the problems I had and giving me wonderful tips from Miami. Important to say of the tranquility that Claire receives and resolves the impasse giving us due safety and importance to its clients! Human experience is still above everything! Thank you, Claire!

My overall experience went well. It was a nice, clean hotel. The only thing I did not like was that the hotel did not offer room service, so it forced me to have to go out to eat all the time. There was spots within walking distance from the hotel that I could eat at, but it would've been better if I didn't have to leave the hotel at all.

Fantastic location in the very heart of Midtown Miami. Great room, great staff, from the Front Desk (Claire was awesome) to the Valets. You have so much shopping and local restaurants to choose from all within a few blocks plus the high end Fashion District is just about 4 blocks away. Everything is within easy walking distance. Very vibrant, hip area. Totally recommended as a must stay. We are returning soon. Also the Hyde Midtown and all the stores and restaurants we saw and visited are dog friendly. Literally everyone living there walk their dogs a be lot.
Beautiful space and superb guest relations, the location can’t be beat. Our group thoroughly enjoyed the rooftop bar and ambiance
Beautiful place, and Kimberly and Claire at the front desk helping me made the stay perfect. Returning soon. Can't wait.

Todo muy bien. No es un hotel de lujo porque por ejemplo no tiene desayunador, pero esta super bien ubicado como para caminar por el lugar. Tiene muchos lugares para desayunar( como Marie) donde también se pueden comer ricas cosas saladas, el restorán italiano Salumeria y otro italiano ,Pasta e basta y muchos más. También hay muchos lugares para hacer compras, baratos, medios y muy caros( para todos los gustos). Las habitaciones del hotel son muy cómodas, limpias y los servicios como piscina y demás están perfectos. En la recepción está CLAIRE que nos pareció un encanto. Muy atenta, educada y bien con el español ( es francesa).

We have just had a wonderful 5 night stay in this stylish hotel and whilst checking in we were upgraded to a suite. The hotel is situated in a classy residential area, with lovely bakery's, restaurants and shops all very close by. The reception staff were all really lovely and helpful, Renata especially who we spoke with quite a lot and she helped us with all our questions. There is a beautiful rooftop pool and hot tub which we used every day. We would highly recommend this hotel and would definitely stay there again should we return to Miami.

Excellent location, close to restaurants and District Design. Receptionist Claire is very attentive and helped us a lot. Comfortable suite. Ample bathroom. The kitchen lacked dishes and cutlery, but we ordered and brought. I'll be back.

Excelente ubicación en el corazón de Midtown que te hace sentir la vibrante atmósfera de Miami. Cafeterías, restaurantes y centros comerciales a unos pasos de distancia. El trato por parte del personal es increíble y te hacen sentir como en casa.

We had a great stay at the Vagabond and would absolutely stay again. It's been beautifully restored and the rooms are well kept with huge comfy beds. As previous reviewers have mentioned the staff are lovely. Very helpful and friendly. Special mention to Linda who looked after reception in the evenings. Housekeeping was to a very high standard and the AC was top notch. Essential in the Summer. The pool area was a real bonus and despite being on Biscayne Blvd, you could hardly hear the road. Same went for the rooms which were super quiet at night. We chose this part of town for better value and weren't disappointed. There are lots of places to eat within a 2-3 block walk which is a bonus for a city that is built for the car! It's a lovely low rise part of the city and it's clear that there has been investment in the neighbourhood. Alternatively North Beach is a 13 minute drive for a wider choice of bars and restaurants with nearby parking for $1 an hour.

The Vagabond Hotel is literally one of a kind. The decor, the history, the staff.. you have to see for yourself! It’s located in a great neighborhood in Miami and close to the conference I attended! My room was amazing, best sleep I’ve had in days and the pool and decor are incredible. Bring your selfie stick and take loads of pics to brag about your stay here! Also, incredibly clean! 🏆🏆🏆

Stayed for 2 nights at the Vagabond and was truly impressed The hotel is full on retro and done with amazing style. The room, pool and public areas are immaculately clean and have a great vibe The staff are super friendly and helpful The location is super handy for public transport and Uber and there are some great eateries nearby. The Caracas bakery and Doggis Venezuelan restaurant are within a 50 meter walk. Bayside park is 25 minutes away by public bus We’ll definitely stay here when next in Miami

We booked this hotel for one night during the FIFA WC match. It was great for the price point. The staff are very friendly and the pool area is really nice. Our only issue was the noise level. The walls are thin, so we could hear people at 2:15 am who were outside by the pool (even though we were at the very end of the hall). We heard very loud music again at 8:30am, so we didn't get a lot of sleep. Overall everything was clean and accommodating. If we stayed again, we would request a quieter area.
stayed for one night before our cruise. great staff, clean rooms and very nice pool. don't hesitate to book. we received excellent restaurant recommendations from the staff

What a find this hotel was. We had a car but didn’t want to use in Miami and this hotel was perfect for that. Free parking, a beautiful pool area and modern clean and spacious rooms. Downtown Miami is a short bus ride from just outside the hotel and South Beach is also manageable by public transport or approx $25 Uber. Lovely area to stay in with lots of restaurants and amenities nearby .

This was probably the 10th time we've stayed at The Vagabond, so time to update first review. My son's family lives a few blocks from the Vagabond, so it's very convenient for us when we visit. We love the hotel. All the essentials...clean, friendly staff, nice updated rooms, big sparkling-clean pool. On top of that it's really cool, with lots of Rat-pack era nostalgia. Having this hotel available to us has really enhanced our family visits. Fancy high rises are great, and we often stay at them, but the Vagabond is a great change, and we really enjoy staying there.

the cutest kitschy hotel i've ever seen! i loved it! my room was clean, quiet and bed was comfy. the shower was big enough for two people! the pool area was lush and pretty and there is a mermaid mosaic at the bottom of it! super cute! the front office staff was polite and helped me find local dining. i'd definitely come back!

the staff was incredibly friendly and gracious, greeting us in the morning with coffee and hellos. the rooms were clan and rooms spacious with a very comfortable bed and pleasant art deco decor. the area offers a variety of food options in easy walking distance. reasonably priced and we will definitely stay there again.

Raul at the front desk was unbelievably accommodating in the midst of an unfortunate rooming mixup. I was out of a room where I was supposed to be staying due to overbooking and He was able to notify me of a vacancy when his location had a last minute cancellation. He went above and beyond to help out. I highly recommend the vagabond!

Second stay and still delighted by the beauty of the room and the kindness of the staff; one feels very comfortable here, and the hotel's location allows for quick access to both Downtown and Miami Beach. I recommend it without hesitation.
I love the Vagabond Hotel. The staff is super nice and helpful, the rooms are clean, and the vibe is excellent :)
What a lovely surprise! When you see this “motel” you ate skeptical but don’t be fooled. It is modern and has everything you need, even a swim at the pool when you get home at night! Perfect.

Lo que más me gusto es la ubicación, emplazado en el Boulevard Biscayne, es un buen punto para salir hacia distintas lugares de Miami y además, esta cerca del aeropuerto. Mucha tranquilidad, limpieza impecable, la habitación es amplia, la cama muy cómoda. Tiene parking en sus instalaciones, no se pagan tasas adicionales. Este hotel es una opción muy recomendable. Hay muy cerca del hotel, lugares para desayunar, almorzar y cenar muy recomendables, incluso lugares en que trabajan varios argentinos y que también son opciones muy buenas.
We loved this boutique hotel! SO clean and conveniently located to the Miami cruise port. Mae & her staff were very friendly and helpful. We are already looking-forward to our next stay!
The hotel is super clean, all the staff really and the pool is amazing
Very kind staff The hotel was nice Great experience
Fabulous boutique hotel with beautiful pool area and nicely updated rooms. Well equipped, clean rooms.

Beautiful - Comfortable - Quiet - VERY Clean! My mom, sister and I were there last weekend for one night. We were beyond pleased with The Vagabond. We will definitely return. The staff was very friendly and helpful. And location - excellent restaurants and bakery just next door. It's like an oasis in the middle of Mi-Mo. The pool area is nicely appointed with areas to either sit in the sun or shade. We shared a bottle of wine poolside (the small party store next door has a great selection). The rooms are nicely appointed and comfortable.

Great stay and very convenient location to our family and friends in downtown Miami and Miami Shores. Super friendly staff - shout out to Linda for the laughs. Room was comfortable and clean, and we appreciated the complimentary coffee in the lobby. Pro Tip: Until they open the restaurant, walk next door to the Caracas Bakery for fantastic pastries, breakfast toasts and lattes. Bring them back and enjoy poolside!

Our stay at the InterContinental Miami was unforgettable, thanks to Concierge Rhiannon Aguilar. We traveled to Miami for our intimate wedding during the FIFA festivities, and she went above and beyond in every way. She upgraded us to a beautiful suite, officiated our ceremony, created my bridal bouquet, connected us with a wonderful photographer, and made us feel like family from the moment we arrived. Her kindness, creativity, and genuine care turned what could have been a stressful experience into one of the most meaningful days of our lives. Rhiannon is the definition of exceptional hospitality, and the InterContinental is fortunate to have her. We will never forget her.
Excellent and friendly service provided by Jacqueline and Sorayda. Great food options and drinks. Thank you very much!

Jacqueline did an excellent job with top tier service and her friendly and kind demeanor. This was my friend and I’s first time enjoying the club lounge and experiencing our stay at the intercontinental. We appreciate her diligence and speaking with her and will be back!

This was an amazing family trip. The associates were a delight to speak to. Everyone was eager to help you and offer assistance when approached. Our room was super and clean. Everything was well thought off ahead of time and the amenities were top notch. Our club experience was amazing. The team there remember you and welcome you every time you stop by. A special thank you to the Chief Concierge Rosello for always being hospitable and giving the best tips especially with FIFA World Cup going on and for ensuring our stay is going as expected. A big thank you to Mauricio for his help. Thank you and see you soon.
Great location to cruise port and Miami Beach by short Ubers. Staff is awesome. Rooms are very clean. Beautiful views.
Alberto Ferrer was amazing, a very kind person highly recommended.

The Club Lounge at the InterContinental Miami is one of the standout parts of the hotel experience. The space itself offers fantastic views over Biscayne Bay, a calm and comfortable atmosphere, and an excellent food and drinks selection throughout the day. What really makes it exceptional, though, is the service. It is truly spectacular — warm, attentive, and highly professional. The team strikes the perfect balance of being present when you need them while giving you space to relax. They remember the small details, make every interaction feel personal, and elevate the lounge from a simple hotel perk into a genuine highlight of the stay. Special thanks to our server Jacqueline Flores!
Buena atención, todo el ambiente bonito acogedor en especial Jacqueline Flores, muy atenta, cariñosa súper especial
Beautiful hotel in the heart of the FIFA 26 celebration in Miami.
The hotel was gorgeous and our bell boy Hernan was phenomenal. He helped us with everything we needed help with from beginning to end of the trip.
Hernan was amazing!!! As the moment we’ve arrived he took care of us. He’s personality was great, great vibes. Definitely will ask him again. Don’t lose him
Hernan was amazing. Great service.
The hotel is amazing and very dog-friendly. David Gil was especially kind, helpful, and friendly throughout our stay and really made the experience even better.
