Dimenica was very nice and helped out big time.

My daughter and I had a 3-day visit and we loved every minute of our stay here! From the moment we pulled up and the valet greeted us, to our wonderful front desk lady (Cindy) and the staff at the pool, they all were phenomenal. A special shout to Cindy who took care of us from the moment we walked in! She was so personable and helpful. We really adored her!

We spent this past Sunday and Monday nights at the Kimpton Epic Hotel by IHG in Miami. It was an outstanding stay in every way possible…We were celebrating my husband’s birthday. The staff was welcoming, professional and engaging. The suite was beyond exquisite with Panaramic views of the city as well as the water. Walls of floor to ceiling glass enhanced our stay. The balcony was huge and wrapped around the entire suite. Patricio greeted us immediately upon arrival. We instantly bonded~ he made us feell like family. A true gentleman. Pedro was our server for our lunch and two breakfasts. He was absolutely wonderful and caring and treated each person in the restaurant with kindness and respect. The housekeepers did an amazing job. Our rooms were kept immaculate. Thank-you to Calvin (manager) for our suite assignment. It was beyond awesome !!! Jhanathan carried our luggage out to our car and gave us our final good-bye leaving a lasting happy impression. We highly recommend this Kimpton and really look forward to a return visit 😎😎😎

We love this hotel. This is our second stay as a family. We do find this area fantastic with access to Bayside and Brickell within a short walk. We did Lyft to the beach $21. We also visited the Nu Stadium and this was $38 one way. Whole foods on the next block. The hotel facilities are excellent, pool area on the 16th floor is excellent, pools warm, lovely view and Area 31 was great. Towels provided and also suncream. The gym is fab and all you need. Parking and valet parking both excellent. We had a room on the 26th floor facing into the city, the view was excellent but there was some street noice, but very little when doors closed. We requested a pet free room as my husband has allergies, this was accommodated. We did notice several dogs around. We loved sitting on the balcony watching the yachts go up and down the river. All staff we encountered were incredible, really went the extra mile. We can’t wait to return.
Very good hotel. I like it I'll be back soon
Great experience. David Gil was very helpful on my entire trip! Will return soon for my next vacay!

We had some issues with our room and the Manager, Andrew, and our bellboy, Fabian, were extremely helpful and made a difficult situation very smooth and pleasant. The rooms are very nice too with amazing views.
Fabian was very helpful and professional, gave us great recommendations for activities nearby and made sure we got settled in comfortably.
Manuel what a bell man amazing guy very friendly really made me feel at home

I recently vacationed in Miami and stayed at The Elser and, unfortunately, my experience was overshadowed by a dispute regarding charges for minibar items that were never consumed. The prices of the items in the room were extraordinarily high, and we intentionally did not touch any of them. Despite this, charges appeared on my account. What was most frustrating was the lack of confidence this situation created in the hotel's internal processes and their staff's accountability. Dealing with unexpected charges and account discrepancies is not something any guest should have to worry about while on vacation, particularly at a property that positions itself as a premium hotel experience. For a property that presents itself as a premium hotel, I expected much better controls and customer service when addressing concerns of this nature. Instead, the experience left me feeling disappointed and questioning how such charges could occur after my checkout. While the location and facilities may appeal to some travelers, trust is an essential part of any hotel stay. Unfortunately, this experience has left me unable to recommend this property, and I would not choose to stay here again.

Great location, for a complimentary upgrade and Kori was great at the front desk, very helpful. Only downside if you have parties on different floors, you can't go to the rooms on different floors. But very safe
We had a wonderful stay. Everything was perfect! And also cori
Excellent Services!! Highly recommend this hotel. The room are great and the service is fast.
Yes. Very good. Yes, yes. Excellent service.

I gave The Elser a second chance and regretted it. I had experienced issues during a previous stay and originally told myself I would not return. However, I decided to give the hotel another opportunity. Unfortunately, the second experience was even more frustrating than the first. The problems began before I arrived. I experienced multiple booking issues and had to cancel and rebook my reservation. Before making the long drive to Miami, I specifically called to confirm that the room I wanted was available. After driving approximately nine hours, I called again about 15 minutes before arrival and was once again assured that the room was available. When I arrived, I was assigned a completely different room. The room I was shown did not meet expectations and had cleanliness and condition issues. At that point, I decided not to stay. What should have been a simple resolution turned into more than a week of follow-up regarding charges, billing questions, and conflicting explanations. The most disappointing part was the lack of transparency and communication. I spent days trying to obtain clear answers while also involving American Express. Different explanations were provided at different times, making a frustrating situation even worse. Mistakes happen in hospitality. Rooms can become unavailable and misunderstandings occur. What separates a great hotel from a poor one is how those situations are handled. Unfortunately, I found the communication, accountability, and guest service after the problem occurred to be far below expectations. There are many excellent hotels in Miami. Based on my experiences, I would encourage travelers to carefully consider their options before booking at The Elser.
Smooth check-in. Excellent service from Manuel!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great location, clean rooms, pool was huge, and the service was top tier. Ezgi at the fusion lounge was phenomenal and I highly recommend her smoked old fashioned!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Had an amazing stay at the Holiday Inn International Dr.-ICON. The location was perfect — close to everything we needed, with easy access to restaurants, shopping, and local attractions. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and the service truly stood out. A special thank you to Avi at the front desk for providing exceptional customer service from check-in to check-out. Avi was friendly, professional, welcoming, and always ready to help with a smile. It’s employees like Avi who make guests feel valued and at home. Highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a great location and outstanding hospitality. We will definitely be back! Judith Delgado

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: We had a fabulous visit. Housekeeping was amazing! Thank you!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I have been coming here for a while now and I absolutely love the location and the vibe of this hotel. I also have to give a big shoutout to my very good friend Salima who is always so sweet to me and my family. She always is so helpful and always has a smile on her face every time I come and get coffee. I always look forward to seeing her every time I come here. Love her !!!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: We had a great stay! The hotel is in a great location, and the atmosphere was relaxing and welcoming. The room was spacious, clean, and comfortable. We felt it was a great value for the price. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and always helpful. We really enjoyed our time here.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Excellent hotel with massive rooms. Anaya on reception was especially helpful, checking us in early at 2pm. Very helpful, we had a great stay and the darts in the bar was great fun. Great location next to Icon park, which has many dining and dining options.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: My recent stay at this Holiday Inn (June 23 – June 27) was a wonderful experience from start to finish. We were in town for a volleyball tournament and booked multiple rooms, and we were thoroughly impressed with the accommodations. The rooms were very nice, clean, and offered great value for the price. ​The location is incredibly convenient, situated just off International Drive with easy access to a wide variety of restaurants and attractions. It made our trip much smoother having so many dining options within walking distance or a very short drive. ​Beyond the facilities, I was consistently impressed by the level of service and the genuine friendliness of the entire staff. I interacted with the folks at the front desk a couple of times, and both times, they were exceptionally helpful and efficient. ​I would highly recommend this location to anyone visiting Orlando, whether for a tournament or a vacation.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Araya made my check in super easy and fast!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Shawn was wonderful. Stayed here many times. Wonderful hotel.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Everything amazing and the breakfast has been the best of the hotels I stayed before.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The front desk staff were very friendly at check-in and even took my number to let me know when our room would be ready.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Our experience at the holiday inn Orlando International dr-Icon was amazing! The staff are very friendly. Rooms are super clean and provided with fresh linens and coffee daily.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great hotel, staff were really attentive and helpful, especially Destiny at the front desk.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Shaun was very friendly and helpful!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great location near ICON Park and not far from Orange County Convention Center. Big rooms, swimming pool available. Good breakfast, kind Staff. Kate was very helpful and also an interesting small talk interlocutor.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great lobby and super friendly staff. Love how the big hotel feels small with all the nice meeting areas around the building. Near tons of restaurants and the ferris wheel.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Amazing hotel in good location!! Rooms are huge with baths! Every single staff member was lovely and knew us by name. Loads restaurants close by and loads of bars! Avi is amazing and helped us right out, perfect member of staff! Will defo be back. Thanks guys

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Destiny helped us while checking in!! She was super fast and efficient and really helped us out. She made the check in process a breeze. :)

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great location. Friendly staff room was great. Clean , comfy bed perfect Location Is great

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Very pleasant, very well looked after by Shaun at the front desk.

The staff were wonderful, and the architecture is world-class. Unfortunately, the suite we were in felt very neglected. The windows needed serious cleaning, and the upholstery was faded, torn, and/or stained. It was also fairly noisy at night, due to loud partying in the neighborhood on the weekend nights, and general traffic noise other times. With some TLC, this could be a world-class hotel, but it definitely wasn't worth the price, and did not feel like a luxury hotel like it probably used to be.
5+ The service is excellent. Nikole is a fabulous yoga teacher. Breakfast has been perfect. Gym has everything needed. Spectacular little oasis.
Phenomenal stay. A great mix of luxury and home feeling. Staff, especially Fernando, personally went above and beyond.

We landed in Miami because we could not get back to the West Coast due to the many airline cancellations. The greeters were very nice and helpful. They also made some great restaurant recommendations. The neighborhood is wonderful, family-friendly, and feels very safe. The hotel's vibe and architecture are iconic — really a work of art. The rooftop pool and bar offered a serene, yet fun, escape. Really, a wonderful experience, and I was happy to get to see this slice of Miami life. I would love to come back. The only negative was that we asked for a late checkout and were denied. Its' OK to be denied because of staffing arrangements. However, we were told that the hotel was "fully booked". It was not even close to being booked and/or busy on a Tuesday. Management, please don't tell your employees to lie, have them say "unfortunately we cannot accommodate your request, but we have these options...." Lying has become too commonplace these days; let's all do better. (As a side, we met people at the pool, who just didn't ask and brought their suitcases up to the pool, stayed the afternoon, and changed in the changing rooms. And no, they did not ask permission.)

No doubt, the location is great if you want to be in the heart of Coconut Grove. However, be prepared for dark, dated rooms with no view. It was so dim in the room, it made me think it wasn’t clean. Our room was not cleaned the next day, even when we were asked what time we wanted the room to be cleaned. The music from the wedding downstairs kept us up. I understand that there are lots of weddings at this location and they are allowed to play music until 11:00 pm. Many of our invoices were incorrect and we are still trying to sort it out. Fernando (at check-in) was very nice but ultimately had to “punt” issues up to management to follow up on.
We stayed almost a whole week and loved the Mayfair as our base to explore Miami!

I wanted to wait a week since returning from my trip to this hotel in order to render a fair assessment, not one based on immediate feelings. To be fair, this place merits a very average rating, by no means terrible, but a place in need of fixing. Let me elaborate. To start with, the front desk. There isn’t any! It’s just a circular table manned by one or two workers, though it could be mistaken for a work area for the guests. There is nothing inviting about it. Very odd. So now we move onto the room itself in which there is a very dangerous situation: the shower. It is not a walk-in shower, but rather an old fashioned bathtub. And an extremely high one at that. It was not easy to get in by any stretch. Once in, it was quite slippery with nary a grab bar in site. I’m in my early 60s, in excellent health and I really don’t see how an elderly person can use it. Finally, there is no door to the shower. The water was flying everywhere and piling up on the floor! Once again, very, very, odd. The rest of the room was situated nicely, but it was way too dark. It was really difficult to read anything without going right up to the light. We had to use our flashlights on our cells to see items in our bags. Beyond odd. There were good points: The hotel itself is picturesque with greenery everywhere. (Though since it is open air, it gets cool at times.) The pool was nicely heated, the staff attentive. The balcony or outdoor area was the highlight. The hotel itself is centrally located. But in end, I cannot get past the above-mentioned issues and thus cannot recommend this place.

I very rarely write reviews, but our stay at the Mayfair was flawless. It is such a beautiful building and our room was absolutely gorgeous. As mentioned in other places, people like Fernando made it a truly special experience. The room was quiet, the bed was comfortable and the balcony was so cozy and private. Cannot wait to go back!
David was amazing. Kind, efficient, professional. Everything! We arrived early, had all sorts of naive questions. He was patient and everything worked out. Fantastic!

The hotel is beautiful and the front desk staff are a pleasure to deal with. The room is amazing and clean. The hotel restaurant has delicious food as well and complimentary breakfast every morning! The only bad part is paying $600 for the room and not being able to use the additional benefits through AMEX hotel collection. Would not offer a room upgrade after asking every day of the stay. Got strung along with the response of "check back tomorrow we show availability"

I always stay a the Hyde , the hotel has great bed soft and firm, nice big pillows, great customer service at the front desk along with one of the best locations in Midtown Miami. I recommend the Hyde to anyone traveling fir business or for pleasure

I had an excellent stay at Hyde Midtown Miami. The room was spacious, comfortable, and beautifully designed—perfect for relaxing after a day in the city. A special shoutout to Renata, who was incredibly nice and helpful throughout my visit. Highly recommend!

Staff is excellent! I met Billy at the front desk and he was very helpful and very accommodating. Housekeeping did a great job during my stay. The hotel is next to the design district and just 5 minute walking distance from wynwood, lot of restaurants and shops around. We will be back, thanks Billy for everything,

Wonderful, attentive staff. The room was large, modern, spacious, and clean. The room was as quiet as you can expect from a hotel in Miami--there was some noise from cars on the street and music from the clubs, but the hotel itself was quiet. The location was wonderful, within walking distance of everything the design district has to offer. Close to restaurants, clubs, target, anything you need. Would stay here again.

Room was nice, the shower was great, but street noise and noise from the elevator and people in the hall were a constant disruption until well after midnight both nights. SImple horns in the street echoes in the room and normal hallway conversation was clearly audible. You need better soundproofing.

I enjoyed the ADA upgrade to a suite room. It felt like the planning of the space was well thought out. As a designer, these are things that I pay close attention to. Since I'm an early riser, I wanted to take advantage of the empty pool but I was disappointed that there weren't any towels for me to dry off. The location was perfect for the price and I think there was missing patio furniture. Which didn't make a ton of sense. I liked the art work in the lobby as they were from local artist. Some of which I know personally. I do wish they had regular complimentary water in my room.

What a guest experience! From the first meeting at reception to departure to the airport. Excellent recommendations for breakfast, at the French bakery Marie’s and dinner at the unbeatable Tap 42. It serves the world's best IPA, Jai Alai from Cigar City Brewing in Tampa. The rooms were amazing.

The hotel was clean, well decorated, and the staff were amazing. Will definitely book again when in Miami. The local area was filled with shopping, restaurants, grocery stores, and general shopping. Not a far taxi ride to local beaches. Very happy with all amenities.

Great location for couples and if you want to get out and about to see things. Lots of restaurants etc on the doorstep. Pool was great and got lots of sun in the afternoon. The room wasn’t spotless on arrival but when we mentioned it they rectified straight away. Restaurant on the 7th floor was super and lovely 5-7 for sunset and drinks

The hotel is well located, close to Wynwood and Design District: within walking distance, a Target and many food outlets are nearby. The view is correct. The bedding and pillows are soft and comfortable. On arrival we had a booking problem (because of our agency), Claire - the receptionist - was very responsive and kind. Our problem was quickly resolved. The downside would be that the street is a little too noisy, quite early in the morning. Sensitive to noise, arm yourself with earplugs. We recommend this hotel anyway.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I would like to start out saying Victoria, you were absolutely amazing… and Gladys went above and beyond for us on our vacation. We had a really bad experience at a prior hotel. We came there and they just absolutely made the rest of our time in Miami Amazing. We appreciate you both so much thank you, The Stone family.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Very comfortable stay. Enjoyed its proximity to public transport and getting to the beach. The breakfast staff were on top of everything. Had a great room overlooking the sea. Stayed for 4 nights. Though the pool was cleaned daily, a better job of having additional pool towels were needed.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Best location , near to several restaurants, stores , target and design district, all walking distance! Great breakfast, simple but very good. Staff is amazing!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Rooms were nice. Good breakfast. Lobby furniture was worn and needs replacing.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: During an unexpected visit to the UM Hospital my husband and I need to book a last minute hotel room. Brandon at the front desk was very accommodating. He was able to check us into a room and he called to verify if everything was okay. We would definitely recommend this hotel.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Dear Management Team at Hampton Inn I am a statewide inspector for a fire alarm and life safety company, and I frequently travel throughout Florida and Georgia. I am writing to commend the exceptional service I received from Brandon and Kanika during my recent stay. Their hospitality and professionalism were truly impeccable, ranking among the best I have encountered in my many years of travel. Employees like Brandon and Kanika are the foundation of a great company. Because of their outstanding service, I am recommending to my management team that this Hampton Inn location be the exclusive choice for our team members traveling to the Miami area. Thank you for the amazing work.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Excellent location. Excellent service! Brandon at the front desk was able to accommodate a special request for mobility limited room. Would definitely stay here again!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Our stay at the Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District was absolutely fantastic and provided the perfect start to our vacation before our cruise. As we were celebrating our 10th wedding anniversary, the team went above and beyond to prepare an unforgettable surprise for us. The lovely flowers, beautiful room decorations, and thoughtful arrangements were truly remarkable and created a lasting memory. Our accommodations were excellent; the room was spacious, and the large floor-to-ceiling windows offered a wonderful view of the vibrant street below. Throughout our stay, the staff displayed incredible kindness, consistently checking in to see if we needed anything, offering great local recommendations, and seamlessly arranging our shuttle to the cruise port. Breakfast was also highly enjoyable, with a helpful team always ready to assist. Logistically, the location is unbeatable. The property is just a short walk from the area's famous artsy murals and galleries. Having a pharmacy and several great restaurants nearby was also incredibly convenient for tackling all of our last-minute pre-cruise needs. We would definitely return to this property if we find ourselves in Miami again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: First time in Miami, and did not like our first choice of hotel after arriving at 10:30pm. We quickly searched and found the Hampton Inn. I spoke to Brandon St Gerard and he was polite and professional as he explained our options, and had 2 rooms left for the length of our stay. We quickly booked the room and he greeted us upon arrival. His kindness and assistance reduced our stress level. Our room is pleasant and clean.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Very good stay — with big credit to Alberte and her excellent customer service skills. The hotel itself is very nice, the location is near the lively design district and I didn’t experience any rudeness. Hot water supply was excellent. The rooms themselves could use the work hence the four stars. A bit of carpet would brinf soke needed warmth. Ither thsn that, a surprisingly good experience. Thank you Alberte. Tammy feom Ohio.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Muy buen hotel, buen servicio, limpio y la ubicación excelente

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: On March 25, 2026, family stayed at Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District overnight departing for a cruise the next day. During our stay, we encountered Eric. Eric truly gave the best customer service we've ever experienced. Eric was very helpful, considerate, polite, accommodating and just down right nice. It was truly an honor to experience that level of kindness because in today's world, it's very hard to find. So, kudos to Eric and thank you for putting the "H" in hospitality. Truly Thankful, The Teague & Nunn Families

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Victoria was amazing! She was super accommodating with a last minute booking!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We had a fantastic stay at this hotel with our family of four. The location was perfect. Close to the cruise port, which made our travel day easy and stress-free. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was welcoming and relaxing, setting the tone for a great experience. The amenities were wonderful. Complementary breakfast. The pool area was beautiful and a great place to unwind. Our room was clean/well-maintained, and we were comfortable the entire stay. What truly made this stay exceptional, though, was the staff. Every single person we interacted with was friendly, accommodating, and genuinely welcoming. A very special shoutout to Eric at the front desk. He was hands down the kindest person we have ever met. He patiently answered every question we had and never once made us feel rushed. His warmth and helpfulness made such a lasting impression on us. Eric was truly the star of this place, and honestly, we would return just to see him again! We can’t recommend this hotel enough and are already looking forward to our next stay.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We had a horrible experience at a different hotel and ended up here at 9pm looking for vacancy. Brandon was so nice and on top of everything. The hotel smelled clean upon walk in and the room itself was clean and comfortable. We were so glad with the decision to leave our booked hotel and find this place. Brandon was friendly, professional and so helpful to not only me but the people who came in after us while I was there. I would highly recommend this hotel.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: My recent stay at this hotel was my fourth stay. As usual the front desk staff were very helpful and the room was comfortable and clean. A big special thanks to Enrique who changed the battery in my suitcase weighing scales for me.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I had an outstanding experience, thanks to both Brandon and Tori! Brandon did an excellent job recommending the hotel-his suggestion was absolutely perfect and exceeded my expectations in every way. You can tell he truly cares about making sure guests have the best possible experience. Tori was equally amazing during the check-in process. She was warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful, making everything smooth and stress-free. Her professionalism and friendly attitude made a great first impression and set the tone for a wonderful stay. Together, Brandon and Tori provided top-notch service that truly stood out. I'm very grateful for their help and would highly recommend this team to anyone!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Checked in and Torri at the front desk was great. She went out of her way to find me a phone charger and personally delivered it to my room. Thank you again Torri for your first class hospitality.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Front desk staff was awesome ! I arrived very early and Eric was able to accommodate me and provide a fantastic room . Super friendly and very helpful !

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Great location, clean, quiet, wonderfully kind and helpful staff...thanks Eric (front desk)

Interesting motel in MIMO district--15 minutes or so from Miami Beach and Miami downtown. Great service--free coffee and chips. Would have loved to have a mini refriderator in the room I realize that this is not "retro" but it helps with doggy bags and drinks.

Location/ Area has changed since my last visit, not hotels fault. Atmosphere - Employee was very accommodating at check-in. The room we got needs a refresher, with stains on the bed's headboard and sticky remote to name a few. For the price point we would've expected more. The atmosphere was okay, however leaves a lot room for improvement. Cleanliness room needs a deep clean, the small details add up. We weren't in the room long enough to report back about noise levels.
The hotel is in a very convenient location. Close to the airport and a short drive to the beach. Great pool!

Love the retro vibe. Room was well appointed and clean. Staff were all polite. Lots of spots to eat nearby, and front desk staff had great suggestions for things to do in the area. A little noise from the pool area but overall a quiet stay. This property feels like a private oasis.

The Original Historically Renowned Rat Pack Hangout in Miami! We've stayed at The Vagabond Motel pre-cruise the past 2 years. What a find this was! And, it's close to both the airport , cruise port, and many restaurants within walking distance. The rooms are fabulous, fun & very retro if you like that vibe! The pool is huge & the entire property is beautiful and immaculate. The property was originally a popular hangout for the Rat Pack (Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, and Sammy Davis Jr.) in the 50's & the remodel mirrors this era in a fun, relaxing, retro vibe. The Vagabond Motel was added to the National Register of Historical Places in 2014. A placard is prominently displayed near the front of the Motel with a brief history of its architectural style and relevancy in Miami's evolving deterioration and rebuilding of the MiMo area through community support. See more here: https://www.selectedbyrg.com/blog/vagabondmotel

I had a wonderful experience at the hotel. We arrived quite late due to traffic and we were very well received by the reception. There was coffee available, parking facilitated a lot and the room was extremely clean. The exterior area is a grace, very nice and gave us the desire to stay for more days to enjoy it. The staff was very kind, gave us tips and wanted to present us with mimos from Brazil :) We recommend closed eyes!

Fantastic place to stay in Miami! Lovely staff, great pool area and clean rooms Just got a nice feel to the place. Very helpful staff, especially Kris who went out of his way to be helpful. Will defo be back whenever in Miami

We have stayed many times at the Vagabond Motel over the years visiting our daughter and grandson in Miami. Many of our family have also had excellent stays at different times at the Vagabond. The pool is clean and lovely with comfortable lounge chairs around and beach towels provided. The rooms are quiet and airy, and the decor is beautiful. The staff are always very friendly and helpful; highly recommended. Excellent restaurants and a great bakery are just a few steps away.

We stayed at the Vagabond for 5 nights from Friday to Wednesday. The hotel is in the middle of the Miami Modern (Mimo) district in super close distance to amazing restaurants with many breakfast options (like Caracas Bakery) and Dinner options as well, and close enough to North Beach (12 minutes). The hotel has been fully renovated and it is extremely clean (spotless rooms and hotel in general). The rooms are spacious and we love the decor and furniture. A true boutique hotel. The pool is amazing and great to spend a full day since the water in the pool is warmth at all times! It has enough pool beds, chais, and tables for a great set up. There is no pool bar or restaurant, but you can bring your own beverages and snacks to the pool. The staff, from maintenance to room keepers to the reception desk, was exceptional and very helpful at all times with all request. They pay attention to all details and drive for best customer service with all our questions and requests. You also get 2 bottles of water everyday and also free parking in front of the property or around the property. We just LOVED IT and can’t wait to come back to the Vagabond Hotel soon!!!

This IS a funky little hotel...more like the motor inns of yesteryear. They have done a great job of creating a 60's vibe. The rooms are basic and clean with groovy wall art. Bathrooms are terrific, as is the shower. We also stayed pre cruise but with construction around it took a little longer getting to the port. Lots of restaurants around. The pool is great as is the outdoor sitting area. Bar was getting renovated so not open at the time...but my guess is that it would fit the atmosphere. Staff was very good too!

Really delightful small hotel, completely renovated. Clean, well-decorated; great pool and pool area with its little bar. Very friendly and helpful staff, from management to front desk to housekeeping. Some good restaurants within one block, easy walk. We stay before cruising, and only a very easy and short drive to the port. Note: be careful and book directly; the first sites that come up on search are not the Vagabond's site.

We had a fun, spacious room very clean too) for a great price. And parking was included too! Though it’s not in the center of sightseeing spots, there are a lot of good restaurants nearby (We We’s Bistro and the outstanding Nido Caffe for Italian) and a beautiful pool area.

The retro, mid-century vibe, both in the rooms and throughout the property, gave it so much personality, and my room was very comfortable and clean. Each morning, I’d head to the lobby for a cup of coffee, chat with people there, and then make my way to the charming pool area. In the evenings, my friend and I would relax on the loungers before calling it a night. The hotel team also had great recommendations, and transit was easy for getting to much of what I wanted to see in Miami. I’m already looking forward to coming back, especially once the restaurant is open, though there was still plenty within walking distance.

The Vagabond was awesome. Vibes were immaculate, the pool was incredible. Room was nicely decorated and had everything I needed. The staff was most exceptional. They really made me feel like a valued guest, took care of all my needs, and it was clear they enjoyed getting to know their guests. There are also several amazing restaurants within a block of the hotel. Would definitely recommend!

My wife and I are in our sixties. We arrived early afternoon and were offered a room on the second floor. When we asked for another room on the lower level we were told the hotel was booked up. The air conditioner could not cool the room. We requested service three times. The hotel employee would come to the room and play with the remote until the air came out cool. After they left the AC would stop working. It was an uncomfortable night.

Staff are extremely helpful and friendly. Offering a detailed explanation of all the best local spots for food and to explore. Rooms were spacious and the pool area was incredible but surprisingly quiet when we were there making for a very tranquil experience. Great value for money.

Very nice place with a lot of character. Rooms are modern, clean, original and the pool is definitely a highlight of this historic place. Very friendly staff. Just regret that the restaurant was under renovation, but the bakery / café next door is very good. I highly recommend the Vagabond Hotel.

Truly a great gem of a hotel in Miami. Reasonable rate for the room which was spacious and clean. The day beds around the pool were perfect for relaxing. I could have stayed here all week! The hotel was also able to accommodate our early arrival (9am). While we did have to pay half of the rate for the day, it was worth it after getting up incredibly early to travel. Lots of great restaurants within walking distance and the staff were super friendly. Highly recommend and we will definitely return.

The Vagabond's location was perfect and free parking was an added bonus. We loved the retro feel and hotel was very clean. Our room was spacious and very well appointed and it was very comfortable and the shower felt like a spa. We also enjoyed the pool area and swimming was delightful and just the right temperature with easy access from our room. It was very quiet and we would definitely stay here again. Staff was very accommodating. The restaurant was closed for renovations and the staff offered other great places to eat that were within walking distance.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: At the pool bar asked for a mojito and got a cup of mint and old lemon that was never even squeezed. The lemon was browned corners and it tasted like a sour lemonade. Went to bar and when I told her so she said lemonade that was not lemonade!!!! Then I asked to change it to a mud slide. It was so much crushed ice that I could not use a straw to drink it. Never seen such a thing. You thing for almost $26 per drink they would be apologetic but no just worried about tips.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This hotel gets better each time we come with our friends and family. We take an annual trip to spend time and La Luce is always a must go! We had a Cabana by the lazy river and the kids have an amazing time watching TV in the Cabana and swimming in the lazy river. The team and management is top notch and the service is 5 stars.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Fantastic stay. Great food, calm atmosphere, and a perfect location right on Disney property. Rooms were clean, and the value and amenities were awesome. Erica, our server, was outstanding and made our experience even better. Highly recommended.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Erica at Harvest Bistro was great!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Erica was very courteous, helpful and professional.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel

After a long day of travel, we couldn’t have asked for a warmer welcome than the one we received at the AC Hotel Wynwood. From the moment we walked in, Sameerah, the front desk manager, set the tone for our entire stay with her energy, warmth, and genuine hospitality. Sameerah greeted us with a full walkthrough of the hotel’s amenities and surprised us with a thoughtful welcome that included chocolate, bottled water, and a glass of rosé. She then went above and beyond to take care of everything we needed: helping us plan breakfast for the next morning and arranging a shuttle to the port the following day. She handled it all cheerfully and made sure our family left the front desk feeling completely taken care of. That kind of attentive, personal service is rare, and it gave us an incredible first impression of the property. Our fifth floor room was everything we hoped for after a tiring travel day: spacious, quiet, clean, and thoughtfully laid out. As a family of three, we had plenty of room to spread out and get comfortable. The efficient layout made the space feel even larger than it was. If you’re considering a stay at the AC Hotel Wynwood, do yourself a favor and book it. Between the beautiful accommodations and staff like Sameerah who truly go the extra mile, this hotel delivers an experience that is hard to top. We will absolutely be back!

The hotel was very nice and clean, with tasty breakfast and friendly staff. We’ve had an issue with a delayed check in due to room not being ready at 3pm and the TV not working in our room - however staff was very apologetic and offered free parking and breakfast. In my opinion, the hotel only gets 4 starts as it’s expensive and you get an additional „destination fee” added on arrival of $30, giving you a credit of $15 to use in the hotel and other benefits such as 3h bike rental. Benefits that you are unlikely to use. Also, parking charge is $35 per day, with $7.70 self parking tax fee.

On a recent trip to Miami, I decided to check out as many properties as possible and enjoyed a night in the Wynwood area of the city. The AC Miami Wynwood hotel is situated close to local bars and restaurants, together with plenty of shopping opportunities. The hotel is also particularly generous when it comes to Titanium/Platinum benefits. Although a $30 resort fee is added to the bill, $15 of this can be used towards food and beverages. I was staying with my two children and was given $10 credit per person meaning breakfast was essentially paid for. Breakfast was a buffet or a la carte. Children were charged half price. It meant that for my $45 bill the entirety was covered by the $30 Titanium breakfast credit and the $15 resort fee rebate. The rooms are cozy and modern. I love the hardwood floor that runs throughout all of the AC hotels I’ve stayed at. The shower too was also particularly powerful. The hotel also has a great rooftop area with a warm rooftop pool. There are deck chairs and daybeds aligning the pool area and there also looked to be a restaurant and bar in operation at the time I was there. For those who love to watch the arrivals into Miami International Airport, you’re in luck! The planes coming in to land from the east fly directly over the hotel. There is also a super view of the Miami Skyline from the very same rooftop. Car parking at the hotel is on the pricey side with a charge of around $50 to park overnight. However, next door to the hotel is a private car park where you can leave your vehicle for 24 hours for just $20. I would encourage anyone looking to park close to the hotel to simply do that rather than pay the extortionate fee the hotel wished to charge me. There is also street parking directly in front of the hotel but this can only be for a maximum of five hours so it would not be any good for those who sleep more than that in a single night! It was interesting for me to stay in this part of Miami having never visited in the past and I would definitely return in the future should the opportunity arise.

A very nice and modern hotel in Miami. From the airport it is about 20 minutes to drive. The rooms are very modern. The hotel itself has a restaurant, a roof top bar and a pool. Parking in the in-house underground car park is charged $25 per day.

Stayed at the AC Hotel Miami Wynwood for a quick trip and left feeling pretty neutral. The stay wasn’t terrible, but it also wasn’t memorable. The room was fine overall, though there were some noticeable stains on the door that should’ve been cleaned before check-in. I had requested a higher floor, but neither was accommodated, even though the hotel didn’t seem full. There’s no room service, which was my fault for not checking beforehand, but still a bit of a letdown. Service was polite but unremarkable, and the space itself feels more functional than welcoming. It’s not a place I’d warn anyone away from, but it’s also not one I’d choose again.
