I was invited by a friend to watch and celebrate the World Cup, and with Miami being so busy and hectic, I know it wasn't an easy day. Despite how incredibly crowded the restaurant was, you and your entire team went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable, well taken care of, and truly enjoyed our experience. Your kindness, professionalism, and genuine care did not go unnoticed. Thank you, Leandro, Sebastian, and the entire staff for working so hard and making our visit such a memorable one. We truly appreciate everything you did and can't wait to come back. Well done!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Mare restaurant is very luxurious and spacious, the lamps on each of the tables add a special touch that creates an even more inviting atmosphere. Leandro ( Manager) and Estefany ( Hostess) made our stay absolutely wonderful from start to finish, our dinner was not just good, but memorable, they went above and beyond to made sure everything was smooth and confortable and their positive attitude made a big difference. It’s rare to find such a great combination of efficiency and personal touch, they truly made us feel valued and well taken care of.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Everything was perfect,great quiet location on the luxury neighborhood,beautiful decoration, splendid views of Biscayne Bay,a very calm and relaxing atmosphere, plus and elegant, attractive, with strong empathy and chivalrous Italian Manager named Leandro.A wine list featuring a curated selection to suit every taste, as well as a menu that while not extensive includes dishes that go beyond just Mediterranean Cuisine. What else could you ask for ?

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: My husband and I went to dinner at Mare resturant,such a lovely place with an elegant desing and great views.I woud like to thank you to Mr Leandro for being very friendly,extremely courteous and always ready to assist with a smile. Leandro is a real asset to the hotel.He represents Luxury Collection in the best possible way.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Tables furnished to modern, without towels. The dishes are served directly at the table, you have nowhere to support the cutlery. A horror. Food well more or menas.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I organised and run an event here having visited the hotel back in February before it was a Marriott hotel. The transition from one brand to another happened after we had contracted our event and, to say the least, it was not smooth for us. So I will keep this review just about my experience as a guest over a 4-night stay. First of all, hats off to Mare Restaurant , excellent food especially at dinner and standout service with genuine warmth from Valentin. I’d also like to mention Nicole on the front desk who helped to overcome some of the transitional problems we experienced from brand to another. In general, this is a solid Brickell hotel with spacious and comfortable rooms and good facilities. It is also great for elevator geeks, if such a niche exists like aviation geeks or train geeks, for you spend a lot of time in elevators. It is up from the ground floor reception 25 floors to the Lounge where the great restaurant is located. Then down to your room in another elevator. Then if you want to use the pool it is up, down and up again in another elevator in a different building so an amazing 3 elevator rides. So if you love riding in elevators this is a truly outstanding hotel. All said, when next in Miami I would happily return.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Initially, the title of my review was different, however when I visited the Brickell Arch Hotel website and read a great number of reviews mentioning Leandro, I decided to change it. Evidently, I too, can now express my gratitude to him for such a memorable experience during dinner on Friday, May 8th. Leandro is not merely a manager, he is the kind of person who is truly focused on service, on pleasing guests and ensuring a complete sense of satisfaction. I echo the words of another reviewer who stated and I quote "this industry needs many more Leandros". Thank you, thank you, thank you, for all of this and so much more.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: When I visited the hotel, the concierges Carlos and David were very helful during breakfast and shopping. Staff and breakfast are the best features of this hotel. During breakfast everyone was magnificent even manager Leandro stopped by to chat, with warmth and kindness, making a big difference on all the experience with patience, dedication and attention to details were simply exceptional. His genuine hospitality and commiment to excellence perfectly embody what a true luxury hotel experience should be.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I like staying in Brickell when I visit Miami and this is the first time I stayed at this property. I will not stay here again. The elevator system requires guests to take 2 elevators to get to rooms. That is incredibly annoying and time consuming. That was enough to turn me off but, in addition, the staff did not seem to care about guests. As an example, I waited 15 minutes at the restaurant to get a coffee before finally giving up and going to a nearby coffee shop. Lastly, the fitness center is small with one of the two ellipticals not working. There are better places in Brickell.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: If you enjoy opening a window from the minute you step in, you know you are somewhere special. Manager(Leandro) ultra focused on service wonderful restaurant, calm, peaceful, gorgeous interiors, light music, if you have a table on the balcony terrace, you breathe the air of Biscayne Bay.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Mare Restaurant is situated on the 25th floor of what is now the Marriott Luxury Hotel, formerly the AKA Hotel. My husband and I are banking professionals based in the Brickell area, and we have dined at Mare for lunch on numerous occasions. It's certainly no coincidence that the Manager is actively involved in every detail from offering a warm welcome and crafting a delicious Aperol Spritz to cleaning plates from a table and preparing an exquisite Cuban Coffee, without a doubt, Leandro is a King, but without a crown. Many Leandro's are needed in the hospitality industry. We, the satisfied guests, placed the crown.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: From the very first moment, we were enveloped in a sense of comfort and refined hospitality. This remarkable experience was shaped not only by the gracious, attentive, and genuinely welcoming presence of the manager, Leandro, but also by the impeccable service throughout. The stunning bay views, exquisite cuisine, and serene, sophisticated ambiance come together seamlessly to create a truly unforgettable destination.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Overall, a fantastic experience with a Breakfast team, the service was absolutely excellent, especially Julianna and Jessica were very sweet and kind . Special mention to Leandro, who made a point of greeting us properly, no just a quick hello, but real eye contact, and often a short conversation, he made the whole experience feel personal rather transactional.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Last week, we had breakfast at Mare restaurant amidst a tense and difficult situation due to Micros system in the restaurant was not functioning, checks could not be printed or closed, but the breakfast Manager (Leandro) every moment reflected high professionalism and refined attention. He created such a positive reliable environment, he even used his Phone to take screenshots of the checks and showed them to those of us who were there, our kudos and deepest gratitude to him.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I can not believe how badly the property is managed now. I have a 2 week stay at the hotel for business and basically every other day there is some annoying issue: -TV remote is broken -No room service QR code or menu: I asked the front desk about it, they said they will bring a QR plaque for the menu, but nothing happened. I already asked 3 times at the front desk they always say they will put it into the room but after the 3rd time i just gave up -After using the Laundry service, they did not provide me with additional Laundry Bags or form. I asked at the front desk on my way to work if they could put some into the room... nothing there in the evening. Then i called the Front desk again, and they said they will immediately bring some. The bags did arrive but no forms for the laundry. -The glass shower door is falling apart and can not properly close. This is quite dangerous as it can shatter. I've told the front desk on multiple occasions that it's broken, on the 3rd day now. Maybe today is different. -Room cleaning staff left a bottle of their cleaner in the bathroom and took a bottle of my aftershave for some reason? -Once I called the room service number and they would just not pick up for several minutes until it reached some automated answering machine.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: When the sticker price for a basic queen room is $600 plus, why do you need to sneak “destination fees” onto to my bill? AKA does not tell you about the destination fees until you check out ($100 per day). Want to check in early? $100 fee (this was $75 fee last time we stayed here). The hotel was transitioning to Marriot brand on my last day so the breakfast service was extremely limited due to “system issue”. Only toast and fruit at the “Michelin chef” restaurant. Booked a massage for 9am. Got there at 8:50am and waited until 9:15am until I gave up. Eventually got a call at 9:30am w the spa manager acting as though she had been at the spa desk the whole time only to eventually admit she was caught in traffic. I did end up getting my “80 minute massage” but it was only 65 minutes of actual massage time. My shower was out of conditioner and body wash. I called down for a replacement and it never came. I travel to Miami often for work and will do my best to avoid AKA brickell or whatever it will be rebranded too under marriot ownership.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: From the moment I arrived, the experience was seamless. Corami made the check-in process smooth, efficient, and genuinely welcoming. After a long trip, that kind of energy makes all the difference. She was professional, attentive, and took the time to explain everything clearly without making it feel rushed. What truly stood out was how authentic the service felt. Oscar’s approach was natural and personable — not scripted, not forced. He was attentive without being intrusive and made the whole stay feel relaxed and comfortable. It’s rare to find that balance. Overall, the team created a first impression that set the tone for a great stay in Miami. I would definitely return.

The hotel is surrounded in a diverse location. Lots of restaurants and cafe's in walking distance. The 50's and 60's vibe is very unique. The rooms are updated, clean and spacious. I loved the oversized shower and large bathroom counter space. The pool was my favorite place to read my book and visit with family. We had pool towels in the room and bathrobes at the ready. The free coffee in the lobby was the best hotel coffee I have ever had by far. They pride themselves on the coffee. It has is minor drawbacks, like carrying luggage up the stairs, but then this just adds to the ambiance. Couldn't have been more please and would stay again.

The Vagabond Hotel was amazing! The room my friend and I shared was spacious and clean. The staff were incredibly welcoming and friendly. Although there is no restaurant on premise, we received an extensive list of restaurants within walking distance from the hotel. The Vagabond is situated in the MiMo section of Miami - which is the perfect place to retreat from the hustle and bustle of the downtown area. I highly recommend the Vagabond; it was fantastic.

Really nice motel Clean rooms perfectly equipped with bathrobe , spacious shower , very comfortable bedding Very friendly welcome The place is magical with a relaxing pool: chill music and really nice retro decor A little piece of paradise in the middle of Miami We highly recommend this small hotel for a break of one night or more All the staff is really charming Free parking on site

Cute clean rooms, great service, Beautiful pool area (with lively but chill music), fun neighborhood (but inconveniently located for hot spots). Pool bar was closed which was disappointing. If pool bar was open would five 5 stars. Hope it and restaurant bounce back because otherwise it’s a fabulous place!

My husband and I recently came back from the Vagabond and are already planning our trip back! This hotels vintage Miami vibe is everything!! Billie is amazing, and so knowledgeable! The beds were super comfy, and the rooms clean and bright!

This hidden gem is located in a great spot within walking distance to quite a few restaurants. The motel will surprise you with its special touches. Like robes, which you would not expect from a motel. Lovely staff, well maintained rooms and it is extremely clean. The pool area is serene with nice lounges and beautiful well maintained landscaping. Great place!
Great Boutique hotel. Built in the 50's and renovated very nice. Clean rooms, and hip. The pool area is like a tropical paradise. Office staff was great, check in and out was easy.

I've stayed at Vagabond Hotel multiple times, and it remains one of my favorite places in Miami. Recently stayed again and had another great experience. The room was clean, comfortable, and well designed. The location is very convenient, and the staff is consistently friendly, helpful, and welcoming. The grounds are beautiful, and the retro, mid-century vibe gives the hotel so much character and charm. It’s a relaxing, stylish place that always feels special. We’ve had nothing but positive experiences here and would absolutely stay again. Highly recommended.

The Vagabond is my secret go-to spot with 5-minute access to the beaches, fantastic, clean, renovated rooms, a quirky, retro vibe, and super friendly staff that treats me like family. The pool area is fantastic – well-maintained, great for cooling off after a beach day, and has that vintage Florida motel charm that’s impossible not to love. If you’re looking for authentic Miami vibes, great value, and a place that feels like a home away from home, book the Vagabond. Just… maybe don’t tell too many people. 😉​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Was recommended by a friend that had stayed there whose son lives nearby so they'd stayed there a lot. It's a classic 1960s motel, complete with retro signage. Rooms and property all updated and modern.

My experience with this hotel was very bad. I am a Bonvoy Platinum member and the treatment at the front desk was horrible. The 2 people, a guy and a girl, were very rude. I tried to speak to the manager Jorge and they wouldn't let me. It's incredible that this hotel is part of Bonvoy. Stay away from this hotel.

The pool staff is AMAZING! They took care of us. 10 out of 10 experience! Any time we needed help, they would not hesitate to come over and take care of us. The drinks and food were both great. They continued to check on us the entire time we visited the pool.

Cynthia at the rooftop restaurant was AMAZING! She was so nice, knowledgeable and made great drinks! Attentive to all our needs! My hubby had the surf and turf (beef and shrimp skewers) that Cynthia recommended. They were so delicious he said he could have eaten two orders!!! Thanks again Cynthia for the great conversation, suggestions and impeccable service!

Cynthia, the rooftop bartender was very attentive and amazing with my group of friends, helping with tasty drinks and overall great experience for our first time in miami. Definitely this hotel will be our go too as it’s close to everything.

I have stayed here multiple times and have worked with Daniela and her team to execute events. The hotel is great and Daniela and her team are wonderful and easy to work with. I highly recommend the AC Hotel Miami Wynwood! They take care of business!

EXCELLENT hotel. Boutique feel, very nice rooms and ambience inside and out, plus a really nice rooftop bar/pool. They even have food there, up top and a very nice restaurant on the first floor. Breakfast buffet (pretty basic) but we ordered food from the kitchen and both breakfasts were absolutely great. Staff was excellent, location so convenient to local dining and shopping. We would DEFINITELY stay there again!

The hotel is located at the beginning of the whynwood district, a bit decentralized 15 minutes by taxi to get to the coolest areas of downtown, but this also makes it very quiet to sleep at night, in the immediate vicinity 7/8 minutes walk there is a beautiful shopping center where you can find everything. The hotel is newly renovated very well run friendly and friendly staff. The rooms are very large and clean, very large bathroom with showers with huge cabin. On each floor there is a fresh water and ice dispenser. Absolutely recommended!!!

The hotel is very good. Rooms are big and spacious, but have little closet spaces, which really did not bothered me. The service all around the hotel is really excellent. Patricia, on the front desk, Carla, at the restaurant, and the housekeeping team always have a smile and kind words to deal with the guests.

I’ve returned to this establishment once more and felt compelled to write a review about my previous stay. I’ll be sure to add another review after my current trip. I had previously submitted a review, but it never got published. I’m not sure what happened, but I’m excited to share my positive feedback and experience about my stay now. There were so many moving parts and such an effortless group tandem that made my stay exceptional. Roneca, Shelly, and Alex were among the amazing crew members who welcomed me during my last stay. They made sure that all my accommodations and requests were met. They also provided expert advice, tips, and recommendations for good food and places to visit. I can’t thank them enough for making me feel welcome and appreciated. I definitely recommend this establishment and look forward to returning.

The woman who works in night shift, Sherly, has been the most helpful front desk person. I’ve been to many hotels but Sherly always provides the best customer service and the best service I have ever have. She has been so helpful throughout my stay

Love the customer service and front desk was very helpful s especially the front desk attendant Georgy ! Very knowledgeable and friendly, definitely will be coming back to this hotel again. The rooftop view was beautiful and the pina colda the bar made was delicious!

I visited your motel and stayed one day prior to going on a cruise to the Bahamas. The day that I stayed, I met one of your workers who is very sweet, polite and helpful even though I did not speak Spanish, she showed me how to translate told me her name was Mary and showed me the way to the pool Area. I asked her where she was from. She said Columbia and told me her last name was Luz that evening I seen her again in the elevator and immediately opened my translator when she spoke and she was asking how my state was and if there was anything that I needed . I rate my time at your facility. With the highest mark! All the staff was wonderful and helpful, and I will be visiting again in the future.

Great hotel, Solomon at the reception was very kind with us. He was very attentive to our requests and the check in was very smooth. He also offered us water which is very appreciative since it’s hot outside. 100% recommand this hotel and you can have your Marriott points, since it’s part of the Marriott program.

I like to stay in this area, and this time decided to try a new hotel… and was better than I expected! From cleaning to breakfast and all the staff, all great! They are always available to help us anytime and i would like to highlight the wonderful work of Jamina at front desk and Daniella at breakfast.

“My time at AC Hotel Miami Wynwood was truly unforgettable! The sleek, modern design and vibrant energy of the hotel perfectly captured the essence of Wynwood. A special shoutout to Jamila at the front desk, whose warm welcome and genuine hospitality set the tone for my entire stay—she made me feel right at home. And a big thank you to Dixon, the security officer, who was always friendly and attentive, ensuring guests felt safe and well cared for. From the stunning rooftop pool with its breathtaking Miami skyline views to the exceptional service from every staff member, every detail of my stay was perfect. I can’t wait to return!”

It is our five year anniversary and we were a little nervous to leave the kids at first. I have to say this has been the best anniversary staycation so far Freddy at the front desk and all the other staff at the front desk were so welcoming and thoughtful. They wished us well. Gave us complimentary drinks and we couldn’t be happier Felix at the bar mixed a wonderful drink had great stories to share and was incredibly attentive I loved the truffle fries The staff at the roof top bar always had a smile and were ready to serve Usually I find hotel rooms in Florida very warm and stuff The room was freezing cold! The bed was very comfortable and the shower had great hot water I also loved that there is a small fridge that kept our drinks very cold All in all would recommend

Our group booked the AC Hotel Wynwood and it couldn't have been more perfect. This was a corporate trip, and the hotel had everything we needed. Between the rooftop dinner party to the last-minute meeting rooms. All of our expectations were met and exceeded. Shoutout to Daniel & Emely for all their help during our stay.

My family and I are enjoying an amazing experience here in Miami. The staff at AC hotel are the best, Freddy at the front desk is absolutely outstanding and having been to a lot of Marriot Hotels as a Bonvoy member, he takes the time to listen, explain and finds the best value solution. He made our stay a 15 over 10.

Newly renovated, so the interior is in great condition. Rooms are small, ocean front doesn't have a balcony but city view does. That makes little sense. Front desk staff was mildly ok, felt like they would have rather been somewhere else. Staff recognized status on check-in but nightly upgrade award was denied by corp. Daily destination fee is a rip, provides little to no value. On site restaurant was fine but M club was disappointing. No real snacks or drinks other than soda, coffee and tea. Nothing really fun to do close by but its ok to use as a jumping point for a night for a cruise.

Recomendable para los amantes de la playa cerca,lejos del tumulto e ideal por la piscina en el ultimo piso con belleza para la vista mirando el mar caribeño,por eso esta opcion es muy valida para pasar un finde y varios dias mas o bien una semana romantica

The experience was great! Me and my family went for breakfast and Aurea made sure our juice glasses were full and was very kind and friendly! It was my mom’s birthday and she arranged for the kitchen to sing and gave her birthday waffles! 🥺

As a travel advisor, I have worked with this particular hotel a lot in setting up rooms pre-cruise for many of my clients, both with individual travelers and with large groups. I can say that the quality of customer service at this location, specifically by the hotel management and staff, is by far one of the top in the industry. They are responsive, helpful for specific client needs, and accommodating to special circumstances for each of my clients. This is hospitality at its finest! Specific shout outs to John Gunter, Rooms Operations Manager, Bertha Crucett, Director of Sales & Marketing, Lilian Lopez, Sales Executive, and Andrew Sirota, Sales Manager.
The food is amazing, also all the personal is really nice and gentle. The attention is great and my family and I had a great experience, cause our server made us feel as home

We had a very nice experience at the Biscayne Bay hotel. The breakfast buffet was great and Aurea, our server, was amazing. Very helpful, always looking if we need anything at the table and very friendly. The hotel and restaurant was great the staff are very friendly and the rooms are big and cozy. The location is ideal if you are taking a cruise.

What an incredible dining experience from start to finish! The churrasco was absolutely phenomenal, perfectly cooked, flavorful, and easily one of the best I’ve ever had. The atmosphere was vibrant, welcoming, and made the entire evening even more enjoyable. A special thank you to Carlos for the exceptional service and hospitality. He was attentive, friendly, and made us feel genuinely welcomed throughout our visit. It’s rare to find service that elevates an already amazing meal, but Carlos did exactly that. Everything about our visit exceeded expectations. Outstanding food, exceptional service, and an unforgettable atmosphere. We had an amazing time and will definitely be back. Highly recommend!
It was such a great experience!! Carlos and Frank were amazing serves. Can’t wait to be back! Loved having my birthday dinner here

I had an amazing experience! Carlos and Frank were my servers and they were phenomenal. I felt so hosted and welcomed. Constantly being checked on, I went to celebrate my friend’s birthday and we had an exceptional time. This was an amazing experience, I recommend you should go!

Our dining experience at the Marriott Miami Biscayne Bay Gold Coast restaurant was outstanding from start to finish.. The food was fresh, beautifully presented, and absolutely delicious, but what truly made our visit exceptional was our server, Aurea. Aurea provided warm, attentive, and genuinely outstanding service.She anticipated our needs, made excellent recommendations, and made us feel welcome throughout the entire meal. Her professionalism, kindness, and positive attitude turned a great dinner into a memorable experience. If you’re dining at the Marriott Miami Biscayne Bay Gold Coast restaurant I highly recommend asking for Aurea. She is a true asset to the restaurant
Very nice hotel, well located.
Aurea was a warm welcoming server and bent over backwards to help us feel at home. She was very understanding with my children when they ordered and made great recommendations.

During my stay, I received exceptional hospitality from the Marriott team. A special thank you to Frank at the restaurant (July 10, 2026) for his warm, attentive, and professional service. I would also like to recognize Miss Misha at the M Club for her outstanding hospitality throughout my stay. Their dedication to guest satisfaction truly enhanced my Marriott experience. Thank you both for making our visit so enjoyable. Your excellent customer service is greatly appreciated! — Tushar Bhansali

Bad service and terrible management. Final bill was not correct, was assured it would be corrected when we left but it was not. Tried to get them to correct it by contacting Marriott but was ignored after sending several emails. My final folio was less than what they charged my CC. Instead of correcting it they sent me a new folio 2 weeks later with what they charged my CC. They only did that when I dispute the charge with CC company.
Aurea was fantastic! Highly recommend!

Great location, it was nice to know that the hotel has such quality food and we did not need to leave the hotel. The food was good but the server AUREA was extremely helpful in helping in recommending our dishes.

We stayed at this location in advance of a cruise and throughly enjoyed the location and amenities. Unfortunately I didn’t realize I left something in the room until I returned from my cruise. I immediately contacted the hotel and spoke with Loss Prevention supervisor Yazdi Patel. A special THANK YOU to Yazdi and housekeeper Yeney Mendez for finding my item. I would definitely stay here again.
Excelente hotel. Muy buena atención. Muchas gracias
Una gran atención por parte de l@s meser@s y las opciones en el buffet son muchas, eso me gustó mucho del hotel.

My experience was excellent. Everyone was nice and professional. My waitress, Aurea, was the kindest most attentive person I’ve met in a long time. I joked with my friend that I wanted to have her as my abuela. The food was fresh and delicious. Healthy options were available too. And the hotel was clean, modern, and well decorated. 10 out of 10!
Aurea was a wonderful host and server for our family at breakfast. She was so attentive to us and especially our kids, she was kind and helpful. We would love to come back. Food was great as well.
We had a great stay here. The staff at the restaurant were exceptionally kind, specially Aurea. We are traveling with two little kids and the staff made it easier for us.

Great renovated property, clean, refreshing and very good service. Rooms and bed excellent and great value. Front desk staff is fantastic and you can clearly notice they are trying hard to satisfy guests, contrary to other airport hotels. In front of hotel, there is an excellent Cuban restaurant called Latin Cafe (best Cuban in MIA).

I’ve stayed at this hotel years ago but now it looks and feel like a complete different property. I can’t say enough good things not only about the elegant new tasteful decor but also the staff that made our stay so special. Susana Reyes on the sales team is a super star. She is not only extremely accommodating when it comes to clients requests but also thoughtful and extremely professional. So happy to see many familiar faces I knew still working here. Breakfast is great as well dinner if you don’t want to leave the hotel. Check out the stunning new bar. I would continue to come back here anytime I’m in the Miami area. Keep in mind the offer a phenomenal complementary shuttle service with live updates of where the shuttle is. Highly recommend this hotel.
The hotel is nice, well located. Ana at the restaurant is the best.
Sayda was wonderful!! She made us feel at home and very welcomed.
wilson is the best he was so sweet and attentive!

Excellent experience! The food was delicious, and the service was outstanding. Ana, Fiorela, and Wilson were all incredibly friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome. They went above and beyond to make our visit enjoyable. Highly recommend this restaurant, and we’ll definitely be back!
Great airport hotel, by far the best we have been to in Miami. One drawback is the charges for holdings packages which were not disclosed ahead of time.
The hotel is perfect, the staff was so helpful and make our stay the best.

The hotel is fantastic. Clean and organized accommodations. Staff in all departments were very attentive. I would like to highlight the service from Fatima and Gustavo at breakfast, and also from Rick and Pedro at reception. Thank you all very much. Marcos Raposo
The food was good and so was the drink.

I want to give a huge shoutout to Sayda at the Sonesta Miami Airport bar and restaurant! She is always incredibly friendly, efficient, and attentive every time I visit. Her customer service is outstanding, and she truly makes guests feel welcome and appreciated. Sayda is definitely an asset to the Sonesta team and easily my favorite bartender. She always goes above and beyond to create a great experience. If you stop by the bar, I highly recommend asking for her!
Ana made me feel so comfortable after getting stuck in miami she greeted me very well and recommended the best food & drink on the menu.

The staff were very friendly and helpful. Our check in time which was meant to be 4 was moved to 2pm when the room was ready. The chef was very accommodating to our food request and the dishes were delicious
Sayda is a sweetheart! Very attentive service and the Old Fashioned was 5 stars!
Sayda served us at the bar, and was absolutely lovely! She was kind and attentive, and a pleasure to talk to!

Had another really pleasant stay at the Sonesta Hotel near Miami Airport — this being my second visit in the past 3 months, and somehow it felt just as accommodating as the first, if not even better. One thing that stood out immediately again was how calm and relaxing the atmosphere felt throughout the stay — especially appreciated after the chaos of travel. The hotel was consistently clean, well-kept, and comfortable, which made it easy to settle in and unwind. The service was also excellent. A special mention to Sayda, who was incredibly attentive, accommodating, and genuinely welcoming. Small details and good hospitality always make a difference, and she definitely elevated the experience. Overall, another smooth and comfortable stay with great service. Would gladly return again.

The experience in Sonesta has been really good. The room is very clean and cozy. Ana, who works in the restaurant at night, is a very gentle person. By the way, the food is delicious. We really enjoyed our stay.
Sayda the bartender was an angel. It has been a very long day and she provided spectacular service. Good food was really pretty darn good and the drinks were excellent.

The restaurant has great ambiance and the food seasoned to perfection. It was quiet and the seating arrangement made dinner more intimate. Our waitress Sayda was also one of the bartenders and her attentiveness and service was excellent. She answered all of our questions and made our drinks to perfection.
Ana was very warm and welcoming and respectful. Very attentive as well and made sure I had a great experience! Thank you, Ana!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The check-in with Jasmine was seamless and easy. She was so friendly and helpful. The room was spacious, clean, and very comfortable. It was so convenient to be next to the pool as we were there for a competition.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Jasmine made our check-in at the Holiday Inn Icon incredibly easy and welcoming! She was friendly, efficient, and started our stay off on such a positive note. Great customer service and truly appreciated after a day of travel. Thank you, Jasmine!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I love staying at this hotel! The rooms are super spacious and always very clean. Shaun at the front desk is great too! Definitely recommend staying here if you’re looking for a safe, clean, inexpensive LBV area hotel.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We booked this hotel mainly for the pool area, which was exactly what’we hoped for. The pool was clean, well maintained, and the food service was excellent. Unfortunately, our checkout experience completely overshadowed an otherwise enjoyable stay. At checkout, the hotel apparently decided to run a system test at what had to be one of the busiest times of the day—possibly one of the busiest days of the year. There was no advance notice, no warning, and no communication to guests. As a result, my wife, our 11-year-old child, and I had to carry four 50-pound suitcases down 15 flights of stairs from the 15th floor to ground level, then climb another flight of stairs to reach the lobby. By the time we reached the front entrance, there were several valet attendants and bellmen standing nearby, yet not one offered to help my wife or our child with the luggage. Inside the lobby, the checkout line was nearly 20 people deep. I went to the concierge desk and asked to speak with a supervisor or front desk manager. The concierge disappeared into a back room, and a woman came out only to tell me I would have to wait in line. When I finally reached the front desk, I was assisted by Lisa, who was friendly and appeared to be new. I repeatedly asked to speak with a manager because I understood Lisa had limited authority to resolve the situation. After my final request, she told me the managers were busy directing guests to the stairwells. I left my name, phone number, and email address expecting someone from management to follow up. As of now, I have received no response. We left with damaged luggage, no explanation or apology from management, and a sweaty, exhausting ride to the airport. The only acknowledgment we received was, “Thank you for being a Diamond Member.” The pool and food service were great, but the lack of planning, communication, customer service, and follow-up during checkout completely overshadowed our stay. A little preparation and leadership could have turned a frustrating situation into a manageable one. Instead, it left us feeling ignored and disappointed.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We stayed here over the July 4th holiday weekend and had a great overall experience, with a few tips for future guests. Room: We had room 614, a double queen with a nature preserve view. It was nice and spacious, though storage was a bit tight — just three drawers under the TV and one in the nightstand. We couldn’t see Disney Springs fireworks from our room (there weren’t any on the 4th), but we could clearly see their hot air balloon ride, so fireworks should be visible on nights they run. Parking: Self-parking has plenty of spots and an easy walk to the garage, but the gate can be finicky. WiFi/cell service is spotty down there, so digital key doesn’t work well — you’ll likely be tapping your physical room key repeatedly to get it to register. A confirmation beep on successful taps would be a nice fix. Food: Breakfast buffet at Harvest Bistro ran $103 for our family of four (with a 7-year-old and 12-year-old at half price). Our server Jeff was fantastic — great recommendations for restaurants, activities, and fireworks viewing spots. For comparison, IHOP the next morning came out to the same $103 before tip, since our kids don’t eat off the kids’ menu. Worth knowing there’s not much price difference either way.

Clara in the hotel restaurant is the person you want! She’s lovely and attentive. Overall great experience at this hotel under many points: cleanliness, relaxation, pool area, general staff, and of course, Clara!
Wonderful staff and service. Attentive to our requests and explained the menu and buffet options clearly.

From the front desk to the housekeeping to the Breakfast room staff, my stay was extremely pleasant. I would especially like to complement Luan and Clara who took care of us in the breakfast room for several days. They were both extrmely attentive and welcoming. The Castle Hotel Autograph Collection in Orlando is great for everyone from families, singles, business and extremely centrally located next to the Orlando Convention Center!

Como todos los meses, venimos a este hotel por la atención tan especial que tiene Clarita, hoy extrañamos mucho a Mauricio, pero siempre regresamos a este hotel por la amabilidad y simpatía que tiene Clarita a la hora de atendernos💖
Aires in the gold Coast restaurant was amazing, friendly, professional, and caring. Thank you for having such great employees..

Alex is attentive and welcoming. Thank you for giving us an upgrade and early check-in. The restaurant staff Aurea, Gabriela and Fanny are friendly. It is good that the Marriott Biscayne Bay is spacious and newly renovated. We enjoyed our time! Thank you!
Our stay and breakfast were amazing! Thank you to Aurea for the best service at Gold Coast Kitchen!
Staff in general , very friendly , mainly the guys at the Restaurant 150% recommend, about tasty food and kindness. Thanks for everything as always.

We had a horrific experience at this over priced hotel, but not due to hotel's fault but a medical issue. Ease to take an uber is good. Room small but clean. Breakfast room service consisted of a delivery person handing over a paper bag with food, which was definitely subpar, and overpriced. When we called the front desk to enquire as to how to order room service, which tv stated was available, but not technically possible via the tv, we were instructed to go online with our personal phones and order via an app.......... I'm sorry but this is totally unacceptable for travellers who may be elderly or English not the first language. We arrived from a late flight due to a snow storm. The main desk person immediately tried to encourage us to eat in the restaurant before it closed in 10 minutes.... huh?? 9:30 pm.......Friday night....Food is definitely on our minds but hey, we don't need to be pressured at the time of check in. I only mention this as it was a very forceful encouragement to go to the restaurant immediately. Long story short.... my beef with this hotel is the little concession area downstairs, which we did go to, and once again were met with too late, we are closing. We got a slimy salad and cheese tray, and took back to our room to eat. Which we did, and nearing the end of the cheese tray, lo and behold was the mold. Disgusting. Does Marriott vet the third party people they allow to set up in their lobby? It was a huge relief when we checked out in the morning. In closing...... room was small and clean. AC worked well. Front desk staff pushy. Ease for Uber service good. Ride to cruise port 15 minutes. NOTE TO MARRIOTT... you need to think tank your pricing, and be cognizant that travellers are having to convert US dollars to their personal bank account ie..... some of us are spending huge amounts of money to travel, and you need to keep the business flowing or people will stop coming. Was this Marriott anything special???? NOT in the least!!!! I've travelled extensively and this. hotel is just run of the mill, in an easy location.

We had a truly delightful breakfast experience recently. Everything served was absolutely delicious and exceeded our expectations. Our server was attentive and incredibly helpful throughout our meal. We felt very well taken care of and appreciated the excellent service. It was a wonderful start to our day, and we highly recommend it.
Aurea was amazing! Thanks a lot.
Aurea was amazing! Great service 💪🏽

Confortable rooms, neat and quiet. As to the restaurant Gold Coast, we received excellent and promt atentions, specially from Fanny and Aurea. They are both, nice and efficient persons always assisting us with a wonderful smile. I particularly, would like to enfasis this.

We had a very nice stay before a cruise. A convenient location with beautiful views of the cruise port, and walking distance to restaurants and a grocery store to stock up on last minute items. We really appreciated having access to our room when we arrive (approximately 11:30) instead of needing to wait until around 3:00 like so many hotels make you do. That courtesy is enough to make us book there again!! At the reception desk Flo was very helpful.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: honestly just trying to get in and out without any stress. Arturo, Ella, and Eduardo made that super easy. They greeted me right away with a great attitude and just good energy overall. It was a simple interaction, but the way they carried themselves made it stand out. Really appreciate the team effort and positive

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I was in town for work and there was a lot of construction going on nearby. The noise was definitely noticeable, especially after long days of meetings. Not the most relaxing background sound. That said, the valet team really made up for it. Elia and Mario were great. super professional without being stiff. They moved quickly, handled everything smoothly, and just made the whole process easy. Even with the construction happening, their service stood out and honestly made the experience better. Appreciate them for that.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I forgot his name, but he was working valet and I even have a picture with him because he was that funny. 😄 He had such a charming energy while still handling everything professionally. He kept things moving, took care of my car, and somehow still had time to joke around and make the experience feel personal. It did not feel strict and overly formal, just genuine and welcoming. He definitely adds personality to the team. Great service and great greeter!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Listen… when I say the morning valet team (Alexis Ellie Edward Mario Arturo Diego)needs a raise, I am dead serious. The AKA Hotel in Brickell is already nice, but the customer service hits you immediately when you get there no long awkward waits, just great service and good hospitality You can tell they take pride in what they do. It is welcoming without being fake, professional without being stiff. That first impression sets the whole tone, and they do not miss. Give that morning team their flowers for real.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excellent service all around. Outstanding valet service from Cesar, Paul and Rodrigo. Food at Adrift Mare is exceptional.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I would like to leave this review especially for the valet parking team at AKA Hotel in Brickell. I park my car here every day, and I can confidently say that the service is always excellent. Eduardo, Arturo, and Eli, and also Mario and Eduardo, are incredibly professional, attentive, and respectful. They always have a positive attitude, are quick, and consistent in their work. No matter the time of day, they maintain the same level of energy and kindness. They truly make my daily experience much more convenient and pleasant. I would also like to recognize the rest of the valet team in general. Everyone is organized, hardworking, and very friendly. You can clearly see the commitment and dedication they have to their job and to the people who come in every day.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Concert eve service was great. Handles our bags and very professional Arturo, Ellie, and Eduardo are great

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Elijah Eduardo at AKA Brickell was amazing! Super professional, quick, and genuinely kind. He made the whole valet experience smooth and effortless. True 5-star service 👏

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Eli and Eduardo were really helpful and very kind!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: We had a day pass at the hotel and came with a pretty big group, so there was a lot of baggage and moving parts to manage. Eli and Mario were great from the start. They helped us with our luggage, kept everything organized, and made the whole arrival feel smooth even with the size of our group. They stayed professional, friendly, and efficient the entire time. It made a big difference having that kind of support, especially with so many people and bags. Really appreciate Eli and Mario for making it easy. 10/10 Will be back again !
We stayed for one night as we wanted to visit volcano bay. The location is excellent for the park as you can walk there in 5 mins. Hotel was clean and spaciois

I've just come back from 10 days at the Aventura and would return! It's great base for exploring. You can walk through the pool area to the entrance of Volcano Bay which takes less than 5 minutes and City Walk, Universal and IOA are a short walk, bus or water taxi shuttle away (walk across the road to Sapphire Falls for the water taxi they are so frequent and easy with an amazing view along the way and you also go through a security check here so miss all that at Universal.) We ended up using this more often than not! The food at Bar 17 is really good and the views are beautiful. You can catch the sun set and then fireworks from Magic Kingdom and Epcot in the distance. We enjoyed the pizza in the Urban Pantry and the only other things we ate there was breakfast which we didn't enjoy, but easy enough to jump over to city walk and grab a yummy breakfast from Cinnabon etc/or order something from Uber on those days with late starts 🙂 City Walk also has some great options for food in the evenings if you don't want to go too far. The staff at reception were lovely and the room was more than decent for the two of us, the bed was comfortable and we had a great view. If you miss the cleaner (we had a DND sign on the door shortly whilst we got ready) you miss them for that day and they are scheduled every other day so bare this in mind. We also found the hotel so peaceful after a day at the parks which we really appreciated! An Uber to a base Disney park was always a reasonable price and we then tended to use the free Disney transport to go between parks and disney springs. Heads up, if heading to MK to watch the fireworks you cannot get an Uber directly from the park and need to get the monorail or boat to the transportation center which has crazy ques after the fireworks, so worth hanging around and getting some rides in untill those die down.

This is a nice hotel but it’s not a 10 out of 10 in my opinion. The rooms are small, ours had a considerable amount of dust in some areas, no convenient place to store luggage, the towels are scratchy, the a/c unit is loud (we had to turn it off to sleep), the beds are very firm while the pillows and blankets are thin. Our beds didn’t have fitted sheets. For privacy, we kept the curtains drawn at night. It can be a five minute wait for the elevators and the staircases are equipped with a fire alarm if you open the door — so you’re forced to wait for the elevator. And don’t be surprised if it’s too full or you have to stop at every floor on the way down. I agree with other reviews that the hotel staff are pleasant and helpful, the hallways were clean and never smelled bad, the location is convenient, Bar 17 has the best view of all the hotels, the pool was big and warm, the Starbucks was fast even when there was a line and the food at Urban Pantry was relatively decent — although the scrambled eggs weren’t really scrambled, more of a toddler’s attempt at making an omelette.

I would describe Adventura hotel as a very mid level hotel that is lacking in very key areas you would expect from a Universal resort property. Don’t let the “sleek and modern design” fool you, this is a very mid tier hotel. First, the amenities are very sub par. The quality of the food served at the Urban Pantry is essential cafeteria food charged at resort level prices. Think $15.99 for powdered eggs and cardboard toast. The only quality food they offer is the fresh oven pizza which is very good. The cleaning service is also very porous. They only clean rooms once every two nights and if you leave a single personal item on your bed they will disregard it entirely. The front desk will not inform you of this. In a five night stay I did not get my room completely cleaned one time. The pool is very drab and not impressive whatsoever. You’re better off paying more to stay somewhere else. Considering most people vacationing to Universal expect a resort level experience you will not get that here so be warned: yes the location is convenient and yes the price is reasonable, but keep in mind you get what you pay for and you will be disappointed by Adventura if you choose to stay here.

Nice environment, clean rooms, the hotel’s design makes the pool area feel like you’re in a wind tunnel. A few food options on site. We tried the pizza, which was not bad, but it was a bit greasy. Starbucks is on-site as well.

Usually we stay in Royal Pacific or the Hard Rock hotel two of Universal’s “premium” hotels but for some reason the prices were coming in ridiculously high, literally twice the price of previous years so we had to drop down a level, with some trepidation. So glad I did, we had a wonderful stay, walking distance (if you’re relatively active) to the parks which we did a number of times but also free transportation if you wish, a lovely room, they kindly honoured my request for a certain level & view which really made the experience better. The pool was great, staff excellent, more slightly adult related so far more relaxing at night and around the pool. We bought Express passes separately and even with this we saved hundreds staying here compared to the other hotels, that impressed that I’ll probably opt to stay here in the future over the premium hotels.

We transferred to Universal Aventura for 5 nights after 9 nights at Disney. Following the manic, busy atmosphere of the Disney Hotel (which was fab), Aventura was like an oasis of calm and tranquility! There’s obviously going to be children everywhere, but Aventura is designed to appeal more to the older clientele, there was no real Universal overkill, just the shop and everything so tastefully designed and airy. The lifts were central and the wings all had their own colour so finding which direction you needed to go in was easy. Receptionist on check in was lovely. In fact everyone was that we met. Bar 17 at the top, views are amazing. Rooms were lovely, clean, beds comfy and all the gadgets appealed to a couple of big kids! Only negative was that the sink was very ‘gluggy’ and made loud gurgling noises throughout the night. I wouldn’t hesitate coming back again, it was absolutely fabulous ☺️
Great atmosphere and experience.
Nice hotel with easy to use technology in the room
Julio gave the best service possible. The view from my room was magnificent

The rooms are perfect! I was given a free upgrade to 9th floor with a theme park view room! Loved it & was able to watch fireworks from there on my first night. The air con system is different to other resorts & made intermittent whooshing sounds (apparently that’s normal when it’s changing temperature) but once I’d gotten ear plugs from the team I slept very well. I’ve stayed at Sapphire Falls & cabana bay & their air con was silent- so this was odd but it was explained to me about the eco system used. Thank you. The service is excellent- your employees at every corner are just wonderful. Especially the lady with red hair at the rooftop bar! The roof top bar is my favourite bar in universal! I went every day for a glass of prosecco around 5;30 pm! The pool scene is great. The food is also really good/ I ate at the Rooftop bar once & the pantry for lunch twice. The only thing which I noticed is the drinks… for the price I feel like measures are a splash! An example, to have an Aperol spritz there are specific measures it should have to be an Aperol spritz & the times I bought these drinks the Aperol was definitely not what would make a proper Aperol spritz. If you’re charging the prices, the measure should be adhered to. It was the same for margaritas. I can only assume it’s the staff training & business decision to not provide proper measures. I went to sapphire falls & Royal Pacific & used their pools & had the perfect Aperol spritz & margaritas- so it does feel it’s a hotel specific issue. I also took advantage of being able to use the different hotel pools! It was great to return to Loews Sapphire & try out the Royal Pacific. I took the water taxi from Loews sapphire a couple of times but I honestly enjoyed the short walk in to the parks through Sapphire ! It’s not far at all. I’d return to this & in fact I’ll likely return next April with my daughter this time. Thank you

我们休了年假，前往奥兰多游玩迪士尼世界和环球影城。在环球影城区域一共住了三天：一晚入住Loews Portofino Bay Hotel，另外两晚住在Aventura Hotel。 因为我们的英语不太流利，办理入住时，不得不请工作人员多次重复说明。在Loews Portofino Bay Hotel，我们能明显感受到工作人员对我们很不耐烦。 相比之下，在Aventura Hotel为我们办理入住的工作人员Holly，真的像一位天使。她察觉到我们英语沟通吃力后，特意放慢语速、耐心讲解，确保我们每一个细节都能听明白。她还细心为我们介绍了房间位置、酒店整体布局以及各类餐厅选择。 她的贴心周到给了我们极大的帮助，让整段旅途变得更加舒心惬意、毫无压力。我一定会把Aventura Hotel推荐给所有计划来环球影城游玩的朋友，也由衷感谢Holly无可挑剔的优质服务。

Fantastic stay at aventura. Lovely welcome when we got there and was given a free upgrade to the 12th floor skyline which we couldn’t thank them enough. The room was spacious and very modern. Everything was explained at the desk on how the room electrics work and the cleaners coming in every other day. We was given a map which the reception wrote down the shuttle frequencies and how to get to volcano bay which we couldn’t believe how close we was! Everything was comfortable and we really loved the touch of the fridge, safe, laundry service etc. the shuttles was one of the reason we stopped here. A lot of reviews elsewhere said shuttles weren’t frequent but at aventura they were and this was very true! We were always on one pretty much straight away or longest we waited was like 3 minutes which is really good! It’s a lot quieter the hotel which we loved even more because most people go to the themed hotels but we preferred this one over them by far. Wasn’t far from universal at all and you could see the firework show from the rooftop bar. We caught Ubers to Disney parks which were always very quick to get and cost about £20 each way which again was so much more worth doing this way as universal is the better parks! The wood fire pizza oven was amazing and urban pantry had a lot of variety. The staff especially Jen were so friendly and welcoming. I loved having the Starbucks in the lobby! The pool was really lovely and the area kept well clean. My only criticism of this and its not huge, but could do with more umbrella's around the pool and maybe umbrellas you could move. We was lucky to get a bed with one but we had to shadow chase when it got too hot or you had to move beds. The heat is hot and in the hotel it seems to increase a lot so could do with just some more spaces to cool down whilst staying around the pool. You could go to the bar but it’s not the same atmosphere as laying around the pool! The drinks on the rooftop bar weren’t so much for us. They weren’t what I would consider a cocktail but the vibe up there is so worth it for a night. We ordered takeaways a lot, after a day in the park it was nice to do and was so easy to do this on Uber eats we had no trouble what’s so ever. The shop did some great little presents and are the same price as in the parks. Would recommend staying here and when we come back again we would definitely come back and stay here again 100%

We have just spent 2 nights at the Aventura hotel at Universal and had a very nice experience. The rooms were big enough and the beds just a nice level of firmness for us but the view (in a higher floor room) was just great. We could've sat and looked out over the parks all day. We ate at the lobby cafe and it was good. We also had a cocktail at the bar at the top of the hotel and the views were exceptional (well worth a visit). The staff we experienced were all good and the location (next to Sapphire Falls) makes getting to City Walk etc a pleasure. The only potential downside is that buses to Epic are shared with Cabana Bay and can get rather busy. Overall 8/10 but 10/10 for value. Highly recommended.

My teenage daughter and I stayed her for a week in her Easter holidays. The hotel was great for the price, good rooms, fab top floor bar/restaurant, convenient pizza on the GF and the pool was also great. All in all a great time. My 1 star is because the day I returned, the hotel took money for my stay despite me paying up front for the holiday through UK tour operator Thomas Cook. The hotel conceded the error, but refunded me a lessor amount. Initial good communication has now ceased. I’m posting the 1 star with the aim of getting my full refund.
been there and it was very nice..

We stayed at this hotel for ten nights during a busy time. Check in was simple and Tina on the front desk was extremely helpful friendly and even gave us a generous treat when we checked in. Our room was on the 14th floor and had a view of the universal parks. The rooms were clean and the only problem we had was our tablet that controlled the rooms lights wouldn’t charge when we arrived but was sorted within an hour of going out for essentials. The buses to the parks were regular and the boat across the road in Sapphire Falls was very easy to use and great access to the parks. We had a few lunches in the hotel and the food was well priced for the quality and convenience. I stayed here with my 13 year old daughter and we would both stay here again!

We moved across to this hotel after staying at the Royal pacific and were pleasantly surprised how good this hotel was! We had a double queen deluxe room - which had a panoramic window and a fab view! We were the Cabana bay side and was lucky enough to see the Magic Kingdom fireworks! Rooms were a good size - we liked the shower cubicle better than the bath with over shower and curtain in the Royal pacific! There is a small fridge. The rooftop was great for an early evening drink and watching the sunset or just stay in your room and watch it set! Food was ok - we had noodles, pizza and again stayed in our room or you can eat in the dining area! It seemed very quiet! Slight cons - paper cups rather than glasses and not a great deal of storage (we only stayed a night so wasn’t an issue) the pool was ok - nothing special - the water was freezing! But there was a hot tub to warm up! We stayed here for the close proximity to Volcano Bay! All in all I would recommend this hotel for a short stay while visiting universal!

I rarely write reviews, but my experience at the Aventura Resort Orlando was unacceptable and needs to be shared. During my stay, my Louis Vuitton belt was taken from my room. What followed was even more concerning than the incident itself. I was passed between nearly 20 different staff members across security, front desk, and lost & found — with no ownership, no clear communication, and no resolution. At multiple points, I was told “we’ll make this right,” only to later be told that because there is “no proof,” nothing can be done. That response is not only dismissive, but it completely ignores the responsibility a property has to its guests. The issue here is bigger than a missing item — it’s the complete lack of professionalism, accountability, and basic customer care. When a guest raises a serious concern involving potential theft, the expectation is a coordinated, thoughtful response. Instead, I experienced deflection, inconsistency, and zero follow-through. For a hospitality business in a major market like Orlando, this is unacceptable. I would strongly caution others to think twice before staying here — not because issues can’t happen anywhere, but because how they are handled here falls far below any reasonable standard.

We stayed here for 5 nights in a room with 2 x double beds. The room is clean and has everything you need for a good stay. The room is serviced every other day with new towels etc. I do wish they also included shower gel as opposed to a bar of soap but that is just personal preference. All the staff are helpful and we enjoyed the Starbucks downstairs for breakfast. The staff there are also very friendly. The buses to the parks are frequent or you can go through Sapphire Falls Hotel to the ferry. We would recommend this hotel and would stay again.

This is my third time staying at this hotel. My son attends a school close by and wanted a nice place to stay. However, I found the hotel lacking in areas that were very important. Turn down service, or When a driver would be picking up a guest the 3 men who worked at the hotel parking didn’t open the door to go into my car or coming back from a day out and when my daughter didn’t care for her pasta and sent it back because it was too sweet the bus lady didn’t tell the waiter. This hotel has limited staff and lazy. Many other hotels in the area.
Beautiful hotel, amazing pool w/ fantastic views, great service (including nightly turn down service, valet, pool service, front desk), excellent location. Can't wait to return!

World class experience! First and foremost, the staff is excellent. From the bellhops like Carlos, who grabbed my bags instantly and truly wanted to help. To the front desk staff who cared very much about making sure I had a great experience. Gabriel and Rachel wanted to help me get settled in, inform me of all the perks of the stay, and were there if I ever needed anything. THE POOL IS AMAZING. Calm, chill, and NOT BUSY. I think when I was there on the Thursday before MDW, there were like 7 people there. An attentive pool staff made sure I had drinks or towels. The gym is chill and nice. And the bellini's were delicious. The location is phenomenal. There's so much going on within 2-3 blocks of the hotel. It's really convenient. Oh, and I forgot to mention, my room was SPECTACULAR. I felt like a king. I love the balcony and all of the Mr. C branidng items. I love the nautical theme of the hotel. It was an elite experience. Highly recommend.
Lovely hotel but not worth the price ..good location but very very overpriced for a room on the first floor….
Able and Joseph could not have been more attentive or friendly. They made sure we had everything we needed. Perfect days by the pool.

Great staff! But don’t stay there unless you want to hear Club music from next store pumping till 3am. Rooms are not at all sound proof. Restaurant up top was great! As was pool. But for this price point we wanted some sleep!

I had such a great experience at Mr. C Miami – Coconut Grove. From the second I walked in, everything just felt right. The staff greeted me with genuine warmth (not that forced hotel friendliness), and the welcome drink was such a nice touch after traveling. The room was super clean, beautifully styled, and honestly just felt peaceful. You can tell they care about the details — everything was polished but still comfortable. Anytime we needed something, the front desk was quick, helpful, and easy to deal with. It’s rare to stay somewhere that feels both upscale and relaxed at the same time, but Mr. C nailed it. If you’re heading to Miami and want somewhere that delivers across the board, this is it. I’ll definitely be back.

The rooms are extremely noisy as the s are paper thin. Also, the security and staff smell of marijuana when they deliver things to your room. Not exactly 4 or 5 star quality. There are 3 managers, all of which are rude and arrogant. Terrible service. I will stay at a real 5 star hotel next time. Try the Mayfair hotel where they have actually good service, or four seasons.

A wonderful hotel with a very stylish interior, great service and a marvelous restaurant. The rooms are marsterfully designed to make you feel on a luxurious boat. A very friendly, cooperative and professional staff. Amazing experience!
Great service, location and room. Bellini restaurant is also very good. A relaxing break in superb surroundings, the room was well furnished and large, bed very comfortable. Highly recommend

We chose this hotel for an overnight birthday celebration in Miami, bringing our dog along. While the Coconut Grove location proved ideal and the staff consistently demonstrated friendliness and professionalism, the room itself fell short of expectations—particularly given the nearly $1,000 cost (including pet fee) for a single night. Room 410 felt surprisingly basic: compact layout with beds, TV, desk, and bathroom, but lacking standard amenities we’ve come to expect at this price tier. Notably absent were a coffee maker and traditional iron/ironing board (only a steamer provided). The bathroom, while clean and functional, featured only a shower. There was also loud music that kept us awake for a large part of the night from a nearby venue. Having stayed at numerous Fine Hotels & Resorts properties previously, we’ve experienced exceptional quality that justifies premium pricing. Unfortunately, this property didn’t meet that standard. I’d compare it to a solid four-star European hotel or approximately 3.5-star American equivalent—perfectly adequate, but not luxury-level. Recommendation: Request detailed room information and photos before booking to ensure it meets your expectations for the price point. When told if the experience, the front desk clerk gave me a card and assured me that the room would be much better and quieter should we visit again. Polite, but not particularly helpful since we do not plan on returning.

We had an excellent 9 night stay at this hotel. The employees are superb and highly trained. The front desk, the housekeeping and Joseph at the pool bar really made our stay very enjoyable. Joseph couldn’t be more helpful, he knew our names and drinks and how we liked to be set up. He was interested in where we came from and couldn’t have done any more to make us feel welcome and appreciated. We had a lovely room with a bay view. It was quiet and clean and spacious. The robes and towels were super white and fluffy. Housekeeping did a great job and the turndown service came with Venchi chocolates and plenty of water. The roof top pool was busy over New Year but we had 2 beds and great service. The pool was heated which is appreciated at this time of the year. We loved the location as Coconut Grove had lots of restaurants and shops. We ate at the pool bar and Bellinis and they were good but expensive. WiFi was strong and I really couldn’t fault the hotel. I used the gym every other day and mostly had it to myself. The gym was small but well equipped and had water and towels. Whoever recruits and trains the people who work in the hotel is to be commended as they were efficient and polite and helpful and unlike most of Miami they didn’t constantly look for gratuities. They wanted to do a great job which is a refreshing change. Obviously we did tip but we didn’t feel pressurised like other hotels. There was no upselling either. We will most certainly return. Thank you Mr C.

I really loved this hotel. Stayed here with my mother for 2 nights in November. Room was great with a lovely view over the bay from the balcony. Bed was large and comfortable. The breakfast was delicious with a picturesque setting on the roof terrace, and the roof-top pool was beautiful and a perfect temperature to swim in. We also had snacks at the bar on the ground floor which were delicious (so much so we had them every day). The staff were also all very friendly. I'll definitely come back. We also loved the beautiful interior design shop which is attached to the hotel.

We visited for a quick 10th Anniversary getaway, and were greeted warmly with congratulations during arrival. We were assigned a beautiful room with many thoughtful amenities within that made it feel like home. This hotel has great style and meticulous cleaning standards. All staff were eager to help when asked but discreet when assistance was not required. We would gladly stay again in the future.
Overpriced. Very nice staff but poor management. Noisy room with neighborhood music at 1 am. Broken in room equipment.

If you like to pay to hear neighbors and people in the hallways go there urgently. To smell the odors of sewers that escape from showers according to the weather. Claim a turn down wholesale; quality of a motel but not at the price of a five star.
Great service, awesome food, best location and always friendly people. The pool is stylish and has a great vibe and view! We will be back!

Mr. C had an amazing service all around. Especially Abel at the pool, and many others. We spent 4 days there, and every time they were very friendly & pro-active and made it feel like a true vacation. Will be back again next year!

The staff is well trained to provide excellent service. Service is coordinated through the front desk which works well. The restaurant is delightful- attractive great service and food. Well located. Can walk to many shops restaurants etc nearby. Highly recommend.

What a wonderful hotel and staff. In particular I wish to praise Manager Jonathan Paul who has been especially kind, considerate, efficient and outstanding. He immediately established a personal connection and was amazingly responsive. We stay here all the time! Stephen P. Haber, Ann Jackler

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We stayed at this hotel for a conference and enjoyed the atmosphere. There were several public spaces so it never felt crowded. The room was bright, spacious and exceptionally clean, the beds and pillows were very comfortable. The bath products were lovely, and the towels were plush. The gym was bright with plenty of machines, and the pool and lazy river area was wonderful for relaxing after work. The drinks at the Beech Grill were outrageous, so be forewarned, we also found the front desk not super friendly, and there is loud music being pumped into the public spaces at all times which can off putting when one is trying to work or relax. The location is far removed from any amenities, so plan on dining in. There was very good food and service at Luce, and a great little coffee/convenience shop.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I visited this resort mid June in the peak of summertime and had the best time. I’m from Florida so this was more of staycation but it felt like a real vacation. The most memorable part of my experience was our server Mariano at Beech. Not only was he extremely busy but he made sure to give us service like we were the only people there. He was so incredible and truly tied the whole experience together.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: My sister and I thoroughly enjoyed our meals; as well as the hostess BriAnna. Brianna was very warm, well-versed in the Disney Park “Animal Kingom,”and welcoming. Rex our waiter and subject matter expert was very personable and professional.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Zeta was amazing as always. The fish was fresh and the curry delicious. Rex took extra care of us as we were here staying before our wedding in Disney and recommended the pineapple dessert which was beyond tasty! He also recommended the Dragon roll which was perfect to share since we also got an appetizer and split the curry too.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Amazing property, Sara our SrEM was fabulous and Mo, Manny, Polo, Juan, Yosbany and crew took perfect care of us. Food was amazing! Loved rooms and endless amenities!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: erica c was so amazing ! couldn’t ask for better service ! and the food was amazing !

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: enjoyed our trip, the BEST part was watching the USMNT play against Turkey on the deck at the Myth Bar. Maria took INCREDIBLE care of us - I would return again for sure.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We've been coming to this resort for the past nine years, and one tradition we always look forward to is having multiple dinners at Myth Bar at the Signia by Hilton. The food is consistently excellent, and the service is outstanding. Maria is truly amazing—she always remembers us year after year and makes every visit feel special. She's attentive, friendly, and one of the main reasons we keep coming back. We always look forward to seeing her and highly recommend dining here!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: All the staff were so professional and kind. They were supportive yet not intrusive.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: My experience with Christine was very memorable, she brought laughs and love to the table. Loved hanging out at the zeta and celebrating my birthday!

Although the location is interesting for its proximity to the various theme parks and the room is clean and spacious, the service was not up to standard. The staff went every two days to the rooms and soap was missing. I had to help myself. I still put two stars, because not only were the prices for food exorbitant, but when we pay at the counter for check-in especially the payment machine offers to pay either in US or CAN. I had selected in CAN of course, because in February 2026 1$ US was worth 1.37$ CAN. When I received my invoice the following week when I arrived, I realized that the company had finally loaded me in US. I contacted the company by email, they replied that it was impossible to pay in CAN on their properties. I replied that their machine offered a choice. They further replied that their properties did not accept CAN payments. Beware of hotels that promise to attract a clientele by offering them the advantage of paying in CAN currency in particular, but ultimately reject it altogether. Until then, don't offer this method of payment. It's just a tourist catcher.

We loved our stay at this hotel. It was so convenient for the parks. Rooms were clean,spacious and well equipped, beds were comfortable. Rooms were cleaned and serviced every other day. The hotel has a canteen/ grab and go type restaurant where you could order food to eat in or there were lots of take out sandwiches,fruit & snacks to go, it was nice to have the choice. There is also a pizza oven where you can get pizzas made fresh to eat in or take away. There is also a Starbucks. As this is a universal hotel you can also eat next door at sapphire falls, which was more of a formal dining experience. The swimming pool area was nice, but we didn’t use as weather wasn’t really warm enough. We used to walk to sapphire falls to get the water taxi into the park, but you can also walk there in about 15 mins along the side of the canal which the water taxis use. We also enjoyed sitting up in the rooftop bar 17 where you can enjoy food and drinks. Sometimes you can be lucky to catch the firework displays in the distance from Disney and Epcot. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay again.

We had a great experience staying at the Universal Aventura Hotel. We walked to both Universal Studios and Islands of Adventures (we chose to walk rather than waiting for the water taxi). It was convenient being able to leave whenever we want and walk to the parks. The day we went to Epic it was easy to take the shuttle from the hotel. And Volcano Bay was so close! We enjoyed staying at the hotel itself - we liked the minimal vibe. The room worked well for our family of 3 (king bed and pull out couch). We only bought breakfast in the hotel and drinks at the bar so can't comment on the restaurant. Pool and rooftop bar were nice, as was the staff. Our daughter loved seeing the robot in the hotel. We would definitely stay here again.

After reading recent bad reviews we had to do our own to say we completely disagree as we loved this hotel! 10 night stay with adult kids (22 and 19) and we all had a great time. Yes the road is a little noisy in the mornings but it certainly didn’t keep us awake during the night.
