The room and bathroom was spotless and cleaned every other day where they left fresh towels, emptied bins and brushed/ mopped the floors. Always smelt fresh after they had been in. We had adjoining skyline 2 queen bed rooms which can sleep 4 and even though had 2 people in each room we were left four towels, hand towels and face cloths so there was always a spare. Really don’t understand peoples problem with housekeeping every other day - you are out at the parks 8 to 10 hours a day so it’s not hard to keep your room tidy! All the staff were lovely and friendly. The food in the urban pantry was excellent. Highly recommend the wok bowls, the burgers and pizza station. Lots of choice for breakfast - cooked items and hot sandwiches, croissants, doughnuts, cereal pots, fruit and fruit pots, and a Starbucks with all their usual breakfast options. Location for the parks was fantastic. It’s not advertised by staff but you can walk just next door to sapphire falls and use the water taxi to get to Universal and Islands of Adventure with security on the dock so you avoid the big queues at the main entrance security. We used the shuttle bus to get to epic - very frequent reliable service- never had to wait more than 5 to 10 mins. Also a walking path to volcano bay from the back of the pool area. Didn’t use the pool as were too busy in the parks but area looked nice and clean and good shaded seating area by the pool bar. This hotel is not aimed at families with very young children but that’s exactly why we chose it as it was more chilled and quiet and no kids running around corridors or banging doors that you get in the bigger more themed hotels. We loved it and would definitely stay there again.

Stayed 2 nights in a standard room on 8th floor overlooking the main entrance. While the hotel has some positives, particularly the housekeeping, the high level of road noise 24/7 was an issue. The main road is basically an extended I-4 on/off ramp, and the traffic lights in front of the hotel effectively a starting grid. Every green light was like a speedway. Even ear plugs had no chance. Poor location and a large window design which didn’t appear to help. Would not return.

My husband and I stayed at the Aventura for 3 nights while visiting before a cruise. We checked in late (close to 11 pm) on a Wednesday evening, the lobby was mostly empty so we were checked in very quickly. We got to our room and immediately noticed the tablet wasn't properly connected to our reservation (it was displaying that the room wasn't rented) which prevented us from fully accessing everything. We called the front desk and they sent someone up, he was there for a solid 10-15 minutes but couldn't figure out what the issue was. Eventually it seemed to self-correct, though, so I guess it ended up being a non-issue? Overall though this was a perfect example of "just because you can, doesn't mean you should." The tech-enabled features of the room were really more of a hindrance than a help, as it caused issues with turning on lights (if you turn any light on or off manually by accident, it would stop working on the tablet), some of the light switches on the tablet didn't work at all, and the TV controls were finicky (and of course, the actual remote that was in our room didn't work either). It just seemed like if you're going to commit to that level of technology in every room, you need to make sure it REALLY works and is reliable. It's just not there yet. All that said, the room was extremely clean, the view from our room was beautiful, the bed was very comfortable, there was plenty of storage, the proximity to the parks was perfect, the staff was friendly, and having a Starbucks in the lobby was very convenient for quick coffees and grab-and-go breakfasts before taking the shuttle to the parks. For these reasons, we would stay at the hotel again and because we'd anticipate technology issues, it wouldn't be as much of a headache.

We recently stayed at Universal’s / Loews’ Aventura hotel and I felt compelled to write this review to warn other travellers of our experience. Firstly, the hotel room was dirty when we arrived. The bathroom still had dust, hair and dirt in the corners and the floors were not clean. However, we chose not to mention this to the staff as we had been told our room would be cleaned every other day, so figured it would soon be resolved and put it down to an oversight on the part of a likely overworked housekeeping team. On the day we were told the room would be serviced for the first time, it was not done. This was despite us being out almost the whole day at the parks, leaving the housekeeping team plenty of time to do it. We had to chase the front desk several times to ask for housekeeping, who did not come. Instead we were left a bag of towels, and new sheets for us to make our beds ourselves late at night when we returned from the parks. Again, we complained and asked that housekeeping come the following day instead to clean the room. This time they made one of the two beds, emptied the bins and replenished the coffee but still did not clean the floors, bathroom etc. When we complained yet again, we were told that it was already ‘a lot’ that housekeeping had made one of the beds as normally they only empty the bins and that’s it! So this was supposedly going above and beyond their normal service. Frankly that is not good enough for the room rates charged by the hotel. While we were offered a small room credit in compensation for the housekeeping problems, this was not a true resolution of the issue. It took until the fifth day of our stay for the room to be cleaned to a somewhat acceptable standard, and this only after a lot of chasing and complaints. As well as this, the hotel charged us 3 separate times for the same set of drinks, and twice for the same meal. When questioned why this had happened, they accused us of adding additional items to the bill after we signed the cheque for the meal to charge it to the room (we did not) and blamed ‘occasional issues with international cards’ for the triple drinks charges. When we queried why we had been charged over $200 for a meal and some drinks that came to a total of around $70, we were told repeatedly that everything was fine from their end and that all the charges were correct. This was despite us having a photograph of the cheque which clearly stated the amount authorised to be charged to the room, as well as evidence of the multiple charges debited from our account. As unauthorised charges kept getting made to my card I eventually had to contact my bank to put a block on the card before the hotel took all the available spending money I had in my account. All of this wasted hours of my day and wiped out a full day we could have enjoyed in the parks due to the stress and anxiety caused. During discussions with the manager I was repeatedly spoken to in a condescending tone and told that they ‘couldn’t explain it any simpler’ for me to understand. I was made to feel stupid for even questioning the charges, and told over and over that everything they had done was correct. Both myself and my partner were made to feel like we were causing unnecessary problems by simply chasing money that had been wrongly taken from us and asking to receive the service we paid more than £1000 for - namely a clean, comfortable hotel room for our much anticipated holiday. This has left an incredibly sour taste in our mouth and ruined the final part of our trip. As well as this: - the hotel is incredibly noisy. Despite being on the 15th floor, we had constant traffic noise day and night from the highway and the noise of other people’s toilets flushing and random banging noises 24/7. - the tablet that controls the tv advertises the ability to use Netflix, Prime video and YouTube but these do not work and you must cast from your phone. - you must control all the lights in the room using the tablet, which is pointless Overall, the only positives going for the hotel have been its proximity to universal and the better hotel next door, the free shuttles to the parks, and the friendly (but often very slow) service from some (but certainly not all) of the staff. Although billed as a prime value hotel, Aventura is nothing of the sort. You will do better to save your money for fast passes and taxis to the parks, and stay off property somewhere with proper housekeeping and better standards. I’m sure that this review will receive the standard comment that the feedback will be passed on to the manager to ensure other guests do not have the same experience. However, judging by previous similar reviews from other guests dating back several years, there is zero intention to make any meaningful improvements to the hotel and this will continue to be the way Aventura operates. Avoid.

It was the second time we stayed in this hotel, and again we had proper care. The main attraction of this hotel is its modernity, combined with the benefits of staying in a hotel with a Universal complex, such as transportation and early entry into the Universal parks.

This being my first solo trip, I wanted to ensure I stayed at a safe, comfortable hotel, and I landed on Aventura. This proved to be a great decision, and as my 7-night stay here has sadly ended, I am very happy with the quality and overall comfort levels this hotel provided! Firstly, it is quite small, and doesn’t require a ton of walking to get anywhere you need to. I LOVED this aspect. Checking in was a breeze, and I was pleasantly surprised to be upgraded to a skyline view on the 16th floor, a wonderful start to the trip! Shout out to Tina at the front desk! From my room, I had a gourgeous full view of Islands of Adventure and the beautiful resort next door, as well as sweeping views of the rest of Orlando. I have seen in other people’s comments about the 16th floor that noise from the rooftop bar being directly above was an issue, and I am pleased to say that it was it was NOT an issue for me. Perhaps it was where my room was situated in the building, but I wasn’t affected at all by noise overhead, nor from other rooms. Initially, my minifridge wasn’t working properly. A quick text to the front desk to alert them of this, and within 30 minutes a team member arrived and promptly replaced the fridge. He also helped me set up streaming on the TV and answered any other questions I had. The location of this hotel is conveniently located close to the parks, so a brisk walk, bus or water taxi ride away. The pool area is very relaxing and nicely setup. The rooftop bar is nice, though I’m not a social or drinking person so I didn’t spend a lot of time up there. Urban Pantry has a lot of options for food, and being vegetarian, this was much appreciated. Overall, this hotel was be a great place to chill and hang out as a break from busy park days. I will definitely be returning here on my next holiday. The skyline view is a must!!

We had a Kids Suite with Adjoining 2 Queen Bed Room (booked as one unit) and it was plenty of space for our 7 night stay. The room and hotel was clean and well maintained, with very helpful and friendly staff, and a great location. Between the shuttle, the water taxi available across the street, or the walking path, we could get to CityWalk, IoA, or Universal Studios in about 15 minutes. Would definitely stay again. I did take the advice of other reviewers and have a noise machine to help block out street noise while sleeping. We slept great!

LOVED this hotel. Rooms were so clean and comfy they had all the amenities you needed, coffee machine, iron, hair dryer etc. clean was freshened up everyday. The tablet was a cool touch too. The most amazing part was the view we had of islands of adventure. I could see all the rides it was amazing, as well as the firework drone show at night we were able to see that from our room too. The pool area was great nice pool and hot tub and backs onto the volcano bay water park!! There was a restaurant area and the food was delicious, a handy Starbucks too. The gym had everything you needed for a quick holiday workout. The staff were all so friendly I loved every minute of this stay. We were also a less than 15 min walk to the park, it was a beautiful garden walk. There is also regular free shuttle buses and a free water taxi which was really cute. Definitely recommend this hotel !!

Access to Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure: You can walk to Universal Studios or Islands of Adventure from this hotel - probably about 15 - 20 minutes along the garden path. You can take the water taxi available behind the Sapphire Falls hotel across the street. There is also a shuttle to all three parks including Epic Universe. Volcano Bay is located very close to the hotel. Epic Universe: You can not walk to this park. There is a regular shuttle from the hotel that runs consistently. It is a 15-20 minute bus ride to this park. Access to amenities at other Universal Hotels: You can request an amenity key at the other Lowe's properties including Sapphire Falls across the way. This gives you access to the pools at all the Universal hotel properties. Hotel accommodations: There is everything you need, but it is very basic and grey. The water pressure in the shower is great and while you can hear the roads behind you, inside the hotel is pretty quiet. The pillows are not good, however. We got two adjoining rooms - and there is a small fridge, but for families looking to spread out and prepare food - this is not the appropriate choice. Food at the hotel: There is a nice rooftop bar area with snacks and great views. In the lobby there is a Starbucks, pizza area, and cafeteria type place with family friendly food. It isn't terribly pricey.
They don’t clean the rooms during visit, which is unacceptable at these room rates. They ran out of shampoo and didn’t have any at the front desk. Motel 6 has better service and cleanliness.

Not recommended. Location is the only good thing about this hotel. You will be disappointed as I was. The building feels older. In the hallways there was permeating odor of socks or wet bathing suit. The entire hotel smelled musty. The room decor and furnishings were cheap and more in line with a discount motel then an upscale, premium product. The towels are threadbare and cheap. We stayed on a Sunday night and there are no dining options within walking distance so we ate at the hotel "restaurant" which is more like a cafeteria. The food was awful and one of the employees insisted I bus my own table and sort the dishes, silverware, and trash for her. When I declined, she called me an "entitled a**." Well, yes ma'am, I did just spend $78 for slop, I might be entitled to something. I would never stay here again and I will warn everyone visiting Universal to not stay here.

My wife and I had a wonderful stay here for two weeks from 12th November to 26th November to celebrate my 70th birthday. The hotel and room was lovely (we had a room overlooking Volcano Bay). We found all of the staff to be polite and helpful and a real credit to the hotel, unlike lots of hotels. But some were outstanding. Our amazing stay began with Brenda on check in who was very cheerful and welcoming and really did set the tone for the rest of the holiday. In the Urban Pantry Jennifer and Ines were incredible, especially when they found out it was my birthday! They were always very friendly and upbeat and certainly made my special stay even more special. I must also give a huge shout out to Raven who when we returned after a tiring day was ready to serve us with ice cream and cookies at the Pizza station to help revive us. (A big thank you from Chris "The Cookie Queen".) In the shop Hannah and Patrick were super helpful. I must also make a special mention to our Housekeeper for whom nothing was too much trouble and going out of her way to ensure our room was made up, even late into the afternoon.(I'm sorry that I didn't get your name) The position of the hotel is great even with no car. 5 minutes from Volcano Bay, 5 minutes from Sapphire Falls and the water transport and walking distance to CityWalk. We would definitely recommend this hotel and certainly stay here again!

We had a blast! We enjoyed traveling to and from the Walt Disney theme parks via shuttles daily! The beds were clean and comfortable. We had modern clean room, with entertainment equipment options throughout. Great restaurants with a variety of food options. Great view and willing to enjoy again!

After staying here in 2024 we were looking forward to staying here again. Before travelling we had requested a room with a view of the theme parks after having one last time. When we arrived we were told room wasn’t ready and would get a text when the room was ready. Time passed and had not received a text so went back and the room had been ready for a while and our keys had been sat there for a while. Got to the room and no theme park view even though a returning customer . Many times we had to chase housekeeping and sometimes new towels were not left or coffee filled up etc . The call this a budget hotel but with the price they charge it is far from. Bar staff round the pool seem very unhelpful and unfriendly even though drinks prices are steep and still expect a tip. Would definitely think twice before choosing here again

Nice clean hotel. Elevators were extremely fast. Staff was very friendly especially Barbie at the bar. The rooms could use some pictures and a little more light in the bath. The iPad controller was easy to use. The rates are good.

This hotel was fabulous! Check-in was easy and staff was very friendly. We had a room on the 10th floor overlooking Volcano Bay. You could also see Epcot and Magic Kingdom in the far distance so you could see their fireworks at night. Do yourself a favor and request a higher floor in the pink section! The room was nice and modern and everything in the room is controlled by a tablet in the room. There are not nearly as many rooms/people here as the other hotels and were hardly any kids here which was an extra bonus for us. The pool is smaller and quiet but perfect for this hotel. They do play movies at night in the pool area. Not a whole lot of food choices but they had unique choices like wok bowls. Also, it is super easy and convenient to catch the water taxi right next door at Sapphire Falls. Security is at the boat dock so you don’t have to use the big security line at Citywalk and you are dropped off in Citywalk between the entrances to both parks. Not only that but there is a direct path to Volcano Bay that goes under the road and takes you right into the park. We will definitely stay here again as this has been our favorite hotel of any hotel we have stayed at in Orlando/Kissimmee.

The hotel was nice, and we had a great view of the park from our room, but we had one hiccup that brought my experience down. Unfortunately it was after our stay so there was no way to bring it to someone's attention and it was the water taxi. My family stayed for a week, and we kept talking about and seeing the water taxi and how fun it would be to ride if we could(not to mention not having to go through park security and the walk to the parks). We had no idea that we could have if we just walked right across the street. During check in we were told about the busses that ran, but no mention ever of the water taxi. When we were checking out the attendant asked how we liked it and we told her we never got to ride it since we didn't have the opportunity. That's when we started chatting about it and she informed us that Sapphire Falls was a boarding location for it. She apologized that we weren't told, but there was nothing that could be done. On our way out we even looked for signs that indicated as such, but nothing.

Mr. C has been great. The rooms and service has been wonderful. Spent an entire afternoon at the pool with Abel and he provided incredible service! Would definitely come back just to relax at the pool again.

We stayed at this hotel for 4 nights, it was an unforgettable experience, the hotel is located in a very nice area of Miami and well connected to the most interesting places to see. The staff is very kind, the room was perfect, the bed very comfortable, the bathroom spacious and the room very bright with a fantastic view of the bay. The restaurant is amazing, you eat divinely and all the staff is professional and competent. We will definitely be back and straconsiglio!

Another amazing trip to Miami. Skip south beach and head to Coconut Grove. This hotel does NOT have an employee who does not have smile all the time, ask you how your day was and ask you if you need anything. Everyone at the front desk is amazing but Roberto rocks!!! Houskeeeping is always on point and how can you forget the staff upstairs at Bellini and the food. We cant wait to come back to visit our daughter living there (she offered for us to stay with her but lets be honest the Chocolates at Mr. C are better 😂 )

I gave it a five because there were no deficiencies, but the travelers need to know this is a boutique hotel that lacked some of the amenities of larger properties, but the highlights are a rooftop pool looking out over the bay. Bellini’s is a top-tier restaurant where you can have breakfast in the morning and look out at the water as well as fine dining in the evening the gym is small, but highly functional and there is a cool Outdoor café patio area upon entry. The rooms are quite small, but well appointed.

I'm doing this review a little differently. Instead of waiting until the end of the trip, I’ll update it daily as I experience something noteworthy. Day 1 First impressions are very nice. It’s a cool little boutique hotel in a nice part of Coconut Grove. The lobby was slightly odd, as the first "counter" you see is a pastry counter. Just past it to the left is the front desk. The service is very friendly and attentive. The woman at the front desk was quick to check me in, with an upgrade (yay), and offered me water and a Bellini. I took both! The only issue was I had to fill out information on an iPad with details I thought they’d already have—address, phone number, email, etc. My room was on the first floor, which I thought was fine, but the view was a little low, as I realized when I went to the Bellini Restaurant on the top floor. Not terrible, but I’d definitely ask for a higher floor next time. The room itself is very nice—modern without being cold. It features a nice wood desk, dresser, and closets, an impressive minibar, and some snacks. There are also sunglasses and hats, which can be purchased. A neat touch I've never seen before. Even a foam roller in the closet shows great attention to detail. There is free and paid Wi-Fi; the free option seems fast enough for Zoom and everything else I need. I was hungry, so I went upstairs to the Bellini Restaurant. Like the front desk, the service was excellent. I had a chicken sandwich that was very tasty. It came with fries, which were great—actually, some of the best fries I’ve ever had. I had dinner in my room: a different chicken sandwich (name forgotten) with tomato and avocado. Very good. Tiramisu for dessert, which was very good as well. The service again was excellent. The fridge in the room is full of alcohol, so it’s hard to fit a water or other drink in there. This is the only negative I’ve experienced with the room so far. Day 2 Had lunch in-room today. Cheeseburger with fries. Very good, and, as usual, the service was excellent. A quick issue was resolved by the front desk. The service here really is impressive—everyone seems genuinely interested in helping you have a great time at the hotel. Found one small negative: the TV is not on a mount that swings. It would have been nice when sitting on the couch, but it’s not a major issue. Something else that was a little weird is that the Wi-Fi kicks you off after 24 hours and requires you to re-establish the connection. Not a big deal, but it’s something I’ve never experienced at other hotels. Just got a courtesy call from the front desk asking how my stay has been so far and if I need anything else. They also asked when I was checking out and if I needed any transportation. Very impressive service. Had dinner, which was the club sandwich and some beer. Great, like the last meal and service. Day 3 Check-out was quick. The way they had me view the receipt was quite nice: on a leather-bound pad of some kind. They asked a few questions about how much I enjoyed my stay, if I needed transportation, etc. I really enjoyed my time here and highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in Coconut Grove.

Mr C is a wonderful property with best breakfast in town. Il Giardino is truly the best kept secret in Coconut Grove. The food is consistently delicious and the service is by far the best in the grove. Evian, Christian and Adolfo are always very attentive and extremely detailed oriented.
Great location! They buckle and dime you for everything. Very overpriced food and drinks. $26 for a glass of basic wine.
Excellent hotel across the board. Great value and service. Morgan at the front desk was awesome! Dinner in restaurant was a bit disappointing. Love the hotel and will be back!

I'm definitely adding this to my list of favorite hotels! From the moment I arrived, someone was there to open my car door and help with my bags. Check-in was a breeze, and I was welcomed with a refreshing cold beverage. The front desk staff was incredibly polite and professional - honestly, even the way they handed back my credit card with both hands felt so thoughtful and warm. Now, the room... absolutely luxurious! The Jonathan Adler toiletries and the serene blue decor were perfect. The lights had dimmers, which made it so easy to unwind and read before bed. They also offer a lovely turndown service with water and chocolates - such a nice touch of luxury. The rooftop pool was fantastic with stunning views. My only real gripe was that the poolside service could’ve been more consistent, and I wish the breakfast menu had a bit more variety. But other than that, this place is a solid 5/5!!! :)
Wonderful boutique hotel. Great communication, service and fun vibe. Bellini for dinner is a must with amazing views and service.

I had an amazing stay at Mr. C Miami in Coconut Grove. The hotel is beautifully designed with a chic, nautical aesthetic that feels both upscale and relaxing. Staff was amazing and very attentive sometimes felt overwhelming. Rooftop pool was so awesome with great poolside service. I would definitely stay here again!
The room Is beautiful! It’s a luxury to stay here! And I felt really safe! The place has gorgeous views of Miami, and I loved the lobby area!
Beautiful hotel in a beautiful location. The staff is fabulous and the views from the rooftop pool and bar are spectacular. We loved how everything in the hotel was unique and branded for Mr. C.

One of the best hotel experiences we have every had! Miami. Mr. C in Coconut Grove is stylish and modern. The location is perfect for a quiet getaway from the busy city and we loved that it is walkable to several shops and restaurants. The service was warm and personal, and the welcome Bellini was a great touch. Our room was amazing, the style and comfort were more than expected. The room is full of all the necessary amenities and more? The mini bar was well stocked with a variety of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, it also included snacks and even Mr. C branded merchandise. The staff even provided us with a hand written thank you note which included complementary gourmet chocolates. The rooftop restaurant has beautiful views of the bay and our breakfast was delicious. Mr. C Coconut Grove is a must try hotel and now one of our favorites in Miami.
Some of the best service I have ever experienced. They let us check in early, always checked if we needed water before we headed out, helped us with reservations, ect. Would highly recommend!!

Lovely room, beautiful hotel. The hotel is not only beautiful, but we never heard other guests, so great quality of sleep. Staff was professional and knowledgeable. Perfect location for our needs on this visit. We'll definitely return!
Top notch service, incredibly clean, impeccable features from years past when human interaction was priority! Classy, almost a throwback in terms of how well they treat the customer.

This is the second time my wife and I stayed at Mr. C Coconut Grove. The first time was about 5 years ago for a wedding. Mr. C was relatively new at that time so we gave them a pass when it came to the mediocare service. We ended up staying here again for another wedding. Upon arrival we were greeted by friendly staff and the welcome drinks were a nice touch. Upon entering our room, we paid for an upgraded view room and it was just a view of the church across the street and the slightest view of the bay. The room also smelled awful like BO. The smell stayed in the room the entire time. The noise at night when trying to sleep was very loud, you could easily hear people walking around/coughing/throwing up in the other room. To top it off, we were trapped in the tiny elevator with about 15 or so people with no cell service for over 20 minutes! The front staff handled this very poorly. They never called the fire dept, we finally got through on our own dialing via SOS. You could clearly see on the cameras we were trapped and most of us are now traumatized by this experience. After the fire dept got us out, NO ONE, not one manager was there, no one with waters or apologizing to us. In fact they made us go down the service staff stairs in order to not disrupt the event going on at the time. Just atrocious response to a very scary situation. It was finally asknowledged by the front desk during check out and eventually they gave us a $200 credit towards our bill. To me this does not suffice the damage this has caused both me and my wife along with the other guests. There was never a follow up phone call or a personal management staff apologizing to us upon check out. It just seemed considering the severity, we were just simply brushed off and no one showed they cared. Overall, for such a reputable brand, this was a huge let down and I have lost my faith in the Mr. C brand.

Excellent experience from the welcoming till the departure. All the staff was very friendly and ready to assist you for any matter. We had breakfast in room and a dinner at Bellini. A good experience of the Italian cuisine and an high quality food and beverage overall.

We stayed at Mr. C Coconut Grove last weekend and we loooved it! The place is gorgeous, the rooms are beautiful and super comfortable! Massive thanks to Tabata Delgado, she was so sweet and nice, made us feel right at home. Definitely booking a return trip, cant wait to go back!!

Location is great, room was super dirty. Food all over carpets, found other people’s clothes on floor. Blood stains and other odd stains on sheets and worst of all roach egg casings and a giant roach. Will not be returning.

I booked this last minute at a very good price for one. I had never stayed at a Rosen property before this and I was sceptical for the price. On arrival I had been allocated a room far from the reception area, this wasn't an issue to me but next to me was a large booking of 25 rooms all being put in the same area, the lady behind reception asked if I was okay with this to which I said I wouldn't mind. She must have seen the look of worry on my face. She then tapped away and said we have block c floor 4. This was perfect for me. I got to my room and was treated by a lovely cool, clean, spacious room. For the price I paid I was more then happy. The beds are soooooo comfortable, the pillows I need these in my own home. There was a fridge and microwave in the room with a coffee machine, some paper cups and coffee for the morning - this was restocked daily too. The towels was changed daily too. The room was dark, but this was more to do with the dark wood furniture but as I didn't spend too much time in the room it didn't bother me. The lite bites shop on site was a little pricey but nothing more then expected for an onside shop. It was well stocked, the pizza they do is lovely too. First night I just didn't want to wander to far. 3 pools, one was out of use due to works being completed when I was there but this wasn't an issue. The work started around 9am and I didn't hear anything in the evening when returning after a full day out. The hotel is a short walk from CVS, Wallgreens and a number of restaurants. There is loads to pick from. On the door step there is wonder works, and a short walk to icon park. The daily transport to universal was good too, pre book the previous day and just hop on. The way back was a little hit and miss to be fair but an user was around 6-8 $ I will definitely return to this hotel

We are a family of 7 so we had two rooms. The room was spacious and the beds were comfortable. We were in block C 4th floor the view we had was beautiful. Free shuttles to universal which had to be booked in 24hrs in advance, unfortunately we keept forgetting to book after visiting a park. so the day we were going we just had to book or the next day before the shuttle arrived. The drivers were very friendly and helpful. We ate a few times at zebras, the staff behind the bar was awesome very helpful and friendly and the guy who was cleaning up the plates was very friendly also, Both shop staff is great and have a few items we've forgot to bring. This hotel is in the heart of international drive, We definitely cant wait to come back. This was our first time ever visiting orlando and this hotel and you have left an imprint on our hearts. 💜

If you are looking for the perfect blend of unbeatable convenience, cleanliness, and exceptional value for your next trip, look no further than the Rosen Inn at Pointe Orlando. ​Situated in the heart of the International Drive, the location is truly second to none. It provides effortless access to the area's world-renowned attractions, superb dining options, and fantastic shopping venues, putting everything you could possibly want right at your doorstep. Despite being so centrally located, the property serves as a wonderfully comfortable retreat after a long, busy day of exploring. ​We were particularly impressed by the meticulous attention to detail regarding the upkeep of the property. The rooms and common areas are clean and maintained to a high standard, providing a spotless and welcoming environment to return to each evening. ​Perhaps the most astonishing aspect of our experience was the sheer value for money. When compared to the exorbitant and often inflated prices of the official on-site resort hotels, the accommodations here are very fairly priced. It allows you to maximize your trip budget without having to sacrifice comfort, quality, or convenience. It offers everything you could possibly need for a fantastic holiday at a fraction of the cost. ​Ultimately, our family wouldn't stay anywhere else.

Second time we have stayed here, and will definitely/hopefully be back in 2 years. The hotel was very central for everything we wanted to do, we didn't have a car and just used the trolley bus, which was great. The hotel has 3 swimming pools, and we sat at one of the pools for around a couple of hours most days. There is no life guard on duty, and unfortunately sunbeds hoggers, which was a shame. They put towels down and disappear. The reception staff, ground staff, cleaning staff and restaurant staff were really nice, but the staff in the little coffee shop needed lessons in customer service. Likewise the angry barman in the zebra bar, although the other 2 barmen were very pleasant. Didn't tip him, although happy to tip the other 2. Wouldn't really look to stay anywhere else on international drive.

first time we have stayed here and i loved it. staff were very helpful. everyone wqs just so lovely and we felt very safe here at night. rooms were nice and we had fresh towels everyday as well as bins emptied. beds were changed every 4 days which was fine with me and a deep clean every week. location was lovely on international drive and easy to get to everything. i would give this hotel 10/10. we will definetely stay here again

Overall the hotel is okay, but my experience with the hotel staff was terrible. Front desk doesn’t know all the details about the hotel, they would misinform you. I had booking issues. Third-party who I booked my stay with, splitted my stay into each night separate bookings. I asked the front desk if they can modify it and make it as a one booking, so that I don’t have to come to the front desk to activate my room key. They said they could and they did. But indeed, they didn’t and I had to activate my key every day. If you can’t do it, why you say you can?? The same thing happened with a shuttle. They told me shuttle reservation is open from 7am to 9pm when I can reserve the shuttle. But indeed, they’re open until 1:30pm. I came after that time and couldn’t reserve it. They reserve it 24 hours ahead. So I missed my deadline to reserve for the next day. And I missed my trip which I planned ahead. The hotel staff would knock on my door multiple times a day asking about my checkout!!!!! Wtf…. Cleaning staff is so unprofessional!!!! I had “do not disturb” sign on my door. And they still would open the door & walk in my room. They first day when it happened, I told it to the front desk. The front desk said they’d talk to the cleaning staff. But the cleaning staff still did it every single day of my stay there!!!! I do not recommend this hotel at all! The hotel staff would make your stay they’re horrible.

We stayed here for just one night and as soon as we turned in to sleep, the smoke detector in our adjoining room went off. Despite multiple phone calls to the hotel office, they couldn't fix it for hours and ruined our entire night. Worse, when we spoke about this to the manager Eli the next day, he first claimed that the incident never happened, there was no such phone call and that I was lying. When I sent him the proof, he changed his tune and said that maybe it did happen but since it was eventually resolved (which it was by ~2 AM), I shouldn't be complaining. I then reached out to the manager Terry about this, who didn't even bother to respond.

We chose to stay at this hotel again after moving from another as we have stayed here before and found it clean and comfortable. Only reason I have scored 4/5 this time is rooms are now not fully cleaned each day, After speaking to some of the staff they said this changed after the passing of Mr Rosen and was taken over by his family.

I previously stayed at this hotel in 2022 and had a very positive experience. The rooms were clean, fresh, the location was excellent, and the overall standards were good. Unfortunately, my recent stay was a huge disappointment. I am disabled, so having a clean, safe, and well-maintained room is particularly important i did make them aware. Sadly, the room was filthy, the carpets were heavily stained and sticky, there was an unpleasant smell throughout, the bathroom shower would not drain properly, the internet did not work for me, and the room door kept sticking. I also left with what appeared to be insect bites after my stay. When I went to reception for assistance with the internet and to ask a few other questions, communication was extremely difficult. I was told by the receptionist her English was limited as she was PuertoRican, and I was given a telephone number to call instead, but there was no answer. Before leaving, I reported all of these issues to the hotel manager. I received no sincere apology, no offer to investigate or resolve the problems, and no goodwill gesture despite the condition of the room and the impact the stay had on me. I left feeling that my concerns were dismissed. I was also told I was given a room which had a view of International Drive, but that was not teue, for me to see International Drive I would have to come out of the Room, stand on a side angle and try to look through the trees. It is such a shame to see how much this hotel has declined since my previous visit. Based on my recent experience, I cannot recommend staying here. The cleanliness, maintenance, and customer service fell far below the standard I expected.

Unfortunately we had a disappointing experience at Rosen Inn - would not choose to stay here again. The hotel was ok as a base for visiting the parks but the cleanliness standards were not what we expected… The room and hotel areas felt quite dirty, and we also had issues with noise from dogs barking and whining throughout the day, which made it difficult to relax after long days out. The biggest disappointment was having a personal item taken from our room during housekeeping (taken whilst we were out). I reported it immediately and completed a lost & found form, but despite chasing this several times during our stay, I received no updates or resolution. After returning home, I contacted Guest Services twice to request reimbursement for the item and received an acknowledgement stating someone would respond within 48 hours. Three weeks later, I still have had no response… It’s disappointing because the issue itself was small, but the lack of communication, ownership and customer service made the situation much worse! Another issue during our stay was the constant pressure from Wyndham services staff. We were approached repeatedly every day when trying to book a park shuttle, despite making it clear we were not interested. I would not recommend this hotel if you are looking for a clean, modern or comfortable place to relax after busy days. I stayed here 7 years ago too and unfortunately very little appears to have changed, the hotel feels dated and in need of updating. If you are only looking for a basic place to sleep and store your bags while spending most of your time at the parks, then it may be suitable, but I would not choose to stay here again based on the cleanliness, outdated condition and the poor handling of issues during our stay.

Stayed twice for three nights in Rosen Pointe, always start and end in my favourite hotel. Tried to get more or less the same room twice, unsuccessful but honestly, I didn’t care. We were met with the usual very friendly and accommodating reception staff. Our room as usual, was immaculate and all amenities were available for a comfortable stay. We travel around and had a bad experience at one hotel, we couldn’t wait to return to the Rosen Pointe where you are guaranteed a clean, comfortable room. Laundry onsite, parking onsite, everything you want is available and location is fantastic. All the staff are friendly , professional and go the extra mile to ensure you have a pleasant stay. See you all in September.

First room had an odour like urine, there were sugar ants in the bed. The chair had a rip in it. On. Positive the reception staff were lovely and the area looked well equipped We were moved to an upper floor however there was tiny bugs in the bed and the toilet didn’t flush. Staff were great and thankfully we got a refund.

We stayed here for 7 nights and it was a good base for exploring due to its location. Trolley bus stop right outside so easy to get around. Room was dated but clean. Towels and bins changed daily, and I bed change halfway through our stay. Staff were all friendly. Would stay again.

For our third Orlando trip we had three rooms and stayed 2 weeks. This hotel never lets us down. Great location on I drive, great air on, 3 pools that were never packed and clean rooms. Bar food is great if you need something quick when you arrive and staff are always good throughout the hotel. As we are really only using the hotel as a place to sleep and maybe a pool day or two this is perfect. If you want luxury then go elsewhere and pay a lot more.

We have stayed here many times over the last 25 years and each time it gets better than the last. Stand out feature of this place is the fantastic staff. All so friendly and give the place a real family feel. If we come back to Orlando this hotel will be top of our list. Thankyou Rosen once again

We recently stayed at the Rosen inn pointe Orlando over Easter We were a family of four sharing one room We had an amazing trip from start to finish and the Rosen was a great base to hit all the parks especially universal and sea world which were close by we had a hire car to get to Disney which is about a 20 mins drive Rossen inn is in a great location on international drive with loads of restaurants and bars within close walking distance after a full on day at the parks! Rossen inn rooms are a little dated but it was only a base for us to sleep after being out all day! The rooms were clean and fresh towels everyday Really great staff always friendly and helpful Nice bar serving food and drinks and a coffee and gift shop a normal shop selling snacks and essentials and a restaurant which we only used for the buffet breakfast which was decent The hotel is a universal partner hotel so there was a complementary bus service to the universal parks which you need to book the day before Overall I wouldn't really recommend the rossen inn really good value for money and a great hotel to explore the parks and all the great things Orlando has to offer

Well today we head home with mixed emotion on this place . Firstly yes it’s central and a good variety of places to eat and drink. And the staff are very polite. However we have had 11 nights here and it was on the 2nd night my daughter woke up with quite a few bites on her. My granddaughter who was in the same room but different bed wasn’t bitten at all. We obviously brought this up to management who moved our rooms straight away. Gave tokens to wash s there clothes and gave a free breakfast. We were delayed getting to the park and it ended up costing us some of our lightning lane bookings. The manager said they got independent company in to investigate and the found nothing so they ended it there. I asked to see the findings at which point the company policy doesn’t allow it. I’m not nocking the hotel or the staff but it did have an effect on my granddaughter whom it was her first trip to the USA and Disney. There was definitely evidence that they went through the room as we took photos. ( bed base was discusting ) so we have to accept the outcome. Would we stay here again , probably yes. I would like to thank the management for their prompt action . But I think they could be better at their cleaning.

Absolutely the worst hotel and experience I’ve had at a hotel. We were intimidated by the cleaner when she had to come back twice to clean the toilet from the previous guest. Patrick the manager thinks it’s acceptable to clean crusted urine and feces from the toilet and actually wipe inside the toilet bowl THEN TAKW THAT SAME TOILET CRUSTED RAG AND CLEAN THE BATHROOM VANITY WHILE MY TOOTHBRUSH IS LAYING ON THE COUNTER. This hotel needs to be shut down and tore down. By far the most uncivilized experience i’ve ever had at a hotel.

Hotel complex is larger than you think! Do not stay in Building B, facing I4. Very, very noisy. I had to move to Building C. Lot of Families. Sports bar is small, definitely could make this 2 or 3 times larger. Coffee shop and little shop are nice, has most essentials. Front desk and Security staff is awesome! I moved my room and forgot my uniforms in the old room closet! Security & cleaning staff had them in the office all bagged up for me! Pools looked cleaned and area around buildings clean & well lit. Great location and price is best deal. Have stayed here several times. Sports bar burger and fries for $13, best deal in Town & yummy! You have to place order at bar counter, see signs. They'll bring to your table. Limited seating, like said, could / should be enlarged. Parking is convenient and cheap compared to others.

My husband and I stayed at this hotel for a week and enjoyed a beautiful stay. We were attending a conference which did keep us quite busy, but the rooms, the resteraunts, and the staff as well as ballroom were all outstanding. We have stayed here off and on over 25 years and each stay gets even better.
Great layover in MCO at the Florida hotel. All the staff was really great, Greta food in the restaurant and my room was nice and clean and AC worked great. They also have a great huge pool!!
Crickets Bar, and Lounge , has the best atmosphere. Matthew is a phenomenal bartender.

The location is excellent. Everything is near. The atmosphere of the place made the trip much more enjoyable. It felt welcoming, relaxed, and friendly, which helped me feel comfortable and able to enjoy the surroundings The rooms are very clean, confortable and the noise level is almost nothing. The number of amenities we have access to is extremely useful.
It was great- rooms were very clean and tidy. And everything is at convenience! Except gum lol I checked both vending machines 🤣

From the quick and friendly service at the restaurant downstairs, to the cozy rooms with convenient amenities, this is an excellent spot to book a stay! The pool gets a lot of sunlight throughout the day, and the mall attached has great shopping without having to sit in traffic!
A great team of hospitable and helpful people. Thank you so much for looking after us airline crews!

I love how kind and helpful the staff is! I had multiple employes help with my overflow of baggage. They couldn't have been happier to do so, despite needing to drop it off in multiple locations. This is one of the few places where service comes before anything else - always so impressive!

I really enjoyed my stay here! The staff was great, everyone was friendly and you could tell they genuinely enjoyed their job. The breakfast buffet was one of the best I’ve had in a while, everything was fresh!

Clean and very quiet. Amenities for crews available. Bed was comfortable, room clean and the hallways were quiet. I didn't hear any loud speaking from staff in the hallways as I do at other hotels I stay at. Convenient location for dining and shopping.
Todo fue excelente, la atencion, la higiene de la habitacion y la ubicacion

My wife and I have been enjoying our stays at the Florida Hotel and Conference Center for more than 20 years for personal or professional appointments, conferences or just for pleasure. The hotel is a beautifully elegant and comfortable accommodation that always provides the very best in service. The hotel provides a great variety of dining experiences but also opens to an exceptional mall, so there is really no need to drive around looking for restaurants or shops. However, we are most appreciative of the gracious staff that begins with a warm welcome from Mo or Jean and then cheerful greetings at check-in. The hotel staff really go out of their way to ensure a great stay, and we thank them all for so many years of making our stays so enjoyable, relaxing, and refreshing.

This Hotel has it all. Comfortable beds in a large comfortable, spotlessly clean spacious room. The room itself has a kettle, coffee machine, microwave and fridge. The staff always go above and beyond for all their guests. The pool is large and warm with many beds to relax on. The Gym is very well equipped. Crickets bar has great food and a good selection of drinks. The breakfast buffet has literally everything you can think of including an omelet station and the coffee is perfect. And to top all of this is the wonderful shopping mall. This hotel has it all so look no further and book now. True review.

Very Good Location, the environment and treatment from the employees was great, very friendly and attentive to our needs, A+ on room cleanliness, the service was amazing,,, we go every year and will keep going ,,, Definitely Recommend

The location was great, near the water as well as shopping. The atmosphere was friendly and very cordial. Room darkening curtains were great After my red eye flight. Breakfast was delicious and service was awesome. I loved the hotel And my experience

This hotel honestly is incredible. The rooms are just amazing, spacious and clean. Your staff are just wonderful and the food in Crickets and the main restaurant are superb. Breakfast is fantastic, offering a variety of dishes. Attached to the Florida Mall and near Target, you have an abundance of 🛒 choices. The hotel gym is just amazing with a lot of machines and weights. I'll most certainly be back. Stacey
Participamos en 4 días de convención y la recepción, habitación y salones de conferencia todo excelente.
This hotel is one of the greatest location in Orlando.

The Florida Hotel is a complete 5-star experience and well worth the cost. The employees are polite, professional, and helpful beyond measure. This was my second year attending a conference at The Florida Hotel and they exceeded my expectations once again. The ENTIRE hotel is clean and smells AH-MAZING!!! The atmosphere is warm and inviting for people of all ages and demographics. I HIGHLY recommend The Florida Hotel whether you are visiting for a vacation, a conference, or a couple's getaway. You will NOT be disappointed.
Beautiful hotel and accommodations. Connected to Mall, so shopping experience easy with all inside. Hotel restaurant was fantastic!

We just spent a week at this hotel and we loved many things about it. The room was spacious, modern, comfortable and the beds were fantastic. You can use the in room tablet to control the lights, TV and air-con, and the room gets lovely and cool after a hot day in the parks. The resort buses are frequent and easy to use - we also did the 5 minute walk to Sapphire Falls to use the water taxi, which is a huge plus. The food at the hotel was good (if a little pricey). A few things that could be improved: the vanity area needs a towel hook or rail, bedside tables needed for all sides of the beds. The water pressure for the shower wasn’t amazing but it did the job & the toiletries provided were good. Room service excellent but downstairs we did encounter a surly/borderline rude employee serving the gelato. Lastly, and something we found odd - we received housekeeping only once in 7 days. On one occasion, we came back after a long day at the parks to find nobody had been again, and so we started to bag up and clear out our room ourselves and someone appeared in the corridor to remove the rubbish. We hadn’t finished and explained we were still clearing out and then would have called down to reception - we explained we’d had no housekeeping. The next morning someone did come, but that was it. We believed it to be bi-daily but it just didn’t happen. All in all, this is a great resort but the lack of some services let it down a little.

I only stayed at the Aventura for one night when I came down for Halloween Horror Nights, but I had such a wonderful experience and plan to stay again if I come back for the event next year. Every staff member I interacted with was so lovely and kind, I only wish I could remember more of their names (shout out to bartender Tabitha)! My room was so clean and comfortable, and the tablet that controlled all of the lights, TV, etc allowed me to stream content from YouTube. Aventura also has a super convenient shuttle that runs to/from Universal every 10 or so minutes all the way up to like 1AM (pretty sure I caught it to go back to the hotel at 1:10AM). So glad I stayed here and look forward to returning.

Pros: Strikes a nice balance between staying close to the action and not costing as much as other Universal properties; pleasant modern vibe; geared toward adults Cons: Parking costs, ever-increasing room costs, a multitude of room issues made recent stays stressful and frustrating, overall lapse in maintenance Once (not too long ago) one of my favorite places to stay because of its closeness to the Universal parks and affordability, costs continue rising while quality slides, slides, and slides some more. I am questioning whether or not I'll return for future reservations I booked long ago- a decision that will pain me because I love being able to walk across to Sapphire Falls, hop on a water taxi, and be at City Walk in ten minutes. On the plus side, Aventura is aimed at adults, meaning this place is quiet at night. Across many stays, I have never been woken up by doors slamming and children running up and down the halls. However, the small and minimalist rooms force compromises, such as painfully tiny refrigerators and very few drawers for clothing. A couple spending more than a few days here will likely struggle with storage limitations. For the second time in a row, I was given a room with a television that kept shutting off without warning. Unlike last time when I allowed engineering to spend four days attempting to fix the problem, this time I requested a different room. Unfortunately, the new room had an HVAC system that wasn't functioning properly, so I had to change rooms a second time. This got in the way of me going to one of the parks on my first day because I spent three hours dealing with engineering while unpacking, packing, unpacking, packing, and unpacking again. The fact that the property only refunded me $100 for this major inconvenience says much of its desire to provide exceptional customer service. The Aventura really needs to re-think its in-room technology- most of which is controlled by a bedside tablet. The system of controlling the television (when it works) and most of the room's lighting from a touch screen is unnecessarily complicated and fussy (and I am not one who typically struggles with technology). The lack of a customer-focused approach permeates most of the Aventura experience these days, from outrageous parking costs (even Disney hotels no longer change for parking), to engineering calls taking upwards of 30 minutes for a response, to a front desk that is minimally staffed (one person to check in guests), to broken lobby lighting that hasn't been repaired in years, to housekeeping reduced to once every two days. This property is a perfect example of something that used to be special, ruined by an endless desire to make more money by cutting to the bone while still raising prices.

This was the 2nd time we’ve stayed at this resort and both times have been fabulous. I didn’t get a chance to write a review on the conclusion of my first visit but I wanted to write one after this trip. The hotel is beautiful and being an onsite hotel you access to the Universal Transportation for all of the parks including Epic. The Volcano Bay walk way is only a 2 min walk, the distance is very minimal. Check-in was very easy and were given an upgrade to a corner room which is slightly larger than your standard room. The tablet in the room controls everything we loved it! The room had a good view of the parks and wonderful Sapphire Falls resort. Rooms were serviced every other day, which was great for us. Everything was clean and immaculate. The food offerings are great and every time we had something from the Urban Pantry it was very tasty. The robots are a great and novel addition to the overall aesthetic of the resorts. Very pleased we got to stay here a 2nd time. Very nice resort highly recommend!

Great location with shuttle or boat to parks , and app 20mn walk if you prefer We like that pool area which was never too busy and had poolside bar Also the convenient food court with a good selection of food and the addition of a Starbucks was a bonus for us Fabulous view from rooftop bar and reasonable price for drinks and food We were on 11th floor with great views all round

Whilst visiting from the UK on a short solo trip to attend Universal Orlando Resort's Halloween Horror Nights, I enjoyed a week at this prime value hotel. The room was well presented overall, and offered a convenient on-property location. I enjoyed walking to the theme parks, whilst also having the option of a bus to CityWalk and water taxi next door at Sapphire Falls. The availability of dining at the hotel was great for the price and the pool was fantastic. Service from all team members was wonderful, and the tower structure was very much enjoyed for great views over the Orlando area and less walking inside the resort. Some small improvements that I'd love to see though, is a hand towel rail or hook (not having one was surprisingly frustrating, especially given the bi-daily housekeeping), hooks by the door to hang rain jackets, I wasn't a fan of the tablet controlling the TV and lights, and would much prefer a remote and switches. The rooftop bar is lovely, but there's no covered seating that isn't considered 'serviced,' which meant I was asked to either sit in the rain or leave if I wasn't ordering anything. And I think daily housekeeping should be a staple of any on-property hotel, regardless of whether it's considered 'value' or not. Improvements aside, for the price per night, I thought it was a good stay overall and I'd be open to staying here again.

While staying at Sapphire Falls I decided to explore Aventura since it was conveniently just a few minutes walk away. The first thing I noticed was the modern interior and quiet atmosphere in the lobby. The pool area is nothing exotic, there is a poolside bar. The elevators are modern and have a digital pad. The floor for the roof top bar will not be on display as an option in the elevator until opening hours 4 or 5 pm. Bar 17 bistro serves Asian fusion fare. Another design element I noticed while in the elevator and the doors opened on a floor, were the room numbers placed on the exterior wall frames of each room entry. Very easy to read and find your room with ease. Im sure the rooms are equally modern and comfortable. The lobby has a Starbucks and a gift shop that has a dressing room. Gift shop at Sapphire Falls does not have a dressing room. See my review for Sapphire for more.

We stayed at Universal Aventura for 6 nights during September. We opted for an Uber from MCO airport to the hotel which was a 30 minute drive. Upon arrival, we checked in with a friendly receptionist and then redeemed our park tickets at the nearby desk. Our room was on the 4th floor with a slight view of the pool and the top of Volcano Bay The room was huge with 2 double beds and a separate sink which I really liked. Room functions such as temperature, TV, lights etc were all via an iPad. We tried to check out via the iPad but this didn’t work The room was a little noisy with traffic, but nothing major We opted for the hotel breakfast one morning (Urban Pantry) but this was basic food at high prices. We went to Walmart to grab bagels etc - there are facilities to have your own breakfast such as microwaves and toasters. This is really good The hotel is within walking distance to Volcano Bay with a private walkway. There are free shuttles to all Universal parks. You can also cross the road and use the water taxi from Sapphire Falls We really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely stay here again

Aventura was in my top 3 hotels at Universal Florida until this stay in Sept 2025. There are 6 check-in stations at the front desk. Only 1 employee named Christina was present to check guests in at 12:05 pm. After 35 minutes of waiting, I was finally able to check-in. I knew that I was early and the room would not be ready. But now the luggage clerk had disappeared. No place to check the luggage. I was looking to visit the park for a few hours and wait for the room to be ready. Those plans when down the drain.

Excellent hotel and location for universal. We were on the 16th floor (top) with theme park view and it was stunning. Room was perfect beds comfortable and good sized shower. Food in hotel is also good, especially the wok station. The hotel does have free transportation for universal and epic, however the garden walk to city walk is an easy 15 minute stroll and quicker as you miss the long queues at city walk security. There is also the water taxi at the hotel,over the road (sapphire falls) which is also free and another alternative option. You can also use the pool at sapphire falls which has a water slide. If we return to Orlando and universal in the future then we wouldn’t hesitate to return to this hotel.

No lo recomiendo súper desepcinante la atención muy mala me encuentro en el hotel en este momento en mi reserva pedí entrada temprana cumpleaños de mi esposo y la verdad que desde que llegué todo lo contrario mala atención me entregaron la habitación a las 4:50 de la tarde después que hice la l checking a la 1 pm y me dieron muchas excusas no lo recomiendo la verdad

This is a retro themed resort with 2 large pools, a lazy river, hot tubs, bowling alley, amazing gym, sandy ‘beach’, Starbucks, ice cream shop, and a couple of cafeteria like restaurants. Shuttle service runs every 10-15 minutes to the Universal parks/City Walk. The room we stayed in was a standard 2 queen. The beds were very comfortable. Only downside - 2 pillows per bed. I like 2 pillows just for me, and since each bed was fully occupied with family, I had to just deal with having only 1 pillow. The check in line was a bit long - even though I had checked in on line prior to arrival. Checking out was easier - quick email or text confirmation. There’s only a small refrigerator and packet style coffee maker in the room - no microwave. However, there’s 4 microwaves down in the dining area that were available (just a tad inconvenient imo). There’s a $26/night self parking charge, and the room keys allow for in/out privileges - however the gates seemed kind of glitchy (wouldn’t quickly read the room keys - and so the line leaving the parking lot was slow). They charge $14 for a ‘souvenir’ float for the lazy river. However, there’s an air station so we bought inexpensive floats from Walmart and just inflated them onsite. The place is pretty big - and very busy (the pool and lazy river was almost like bumper cars occasionally) It’s fairly well maintained and the staff were friendly. They offer Florida resident or military discounts. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Excellent support at check in with Connor. He upgraded us to a larger family room for $30 dollars per night. Room was v spacious and had everything we needed located in the Thunderbird section. Two pools are large - one with a slide and one with a lazy river. Lifeguards on duty and pool doesn’t close until 11pm. My only criticism is that some of the sun loungers are very tired and damaged. Parking available and a resort charge per night is also applied. 4/5 places to eat within the resort plus a Star Bucks. We used our VIP $300 on drinks and snacks for the kids. The biggest positive of this resort is its location to the parks and the early access. It is so convenient - we walked to the water park and we got the shuttle buses which leave every 15 mins to the other parks. So convenient. We walked from our hotel to City Walk in about 20 mins and Universal and Island of Adventure are both located there. Loved the early access at 8am for Epic, I of A and the water park. We got lots of rides done before the queues became mad. Overall, we loved this resort and made great memories as a family!

We stayed at this hotel 7/5-7/11 . Very clean and comfortable. Only drawback was with the room cleaning service. We would arrive back at the hotel mid afternoon and the room had not been touched. Spoke with the maid and she said she would come back in an hour. I had to call the front desk 2 hours later. Cleaning lady showed up at 7:30 PM. Another day no room cleaning was done at all. This was the only drawback we experienced. Great location and amenities.

I booked 3 rooms, 2 months in advance. 3 family suite, interior entry rooms. At the Continental. We called 7 times prior to arrival over those months to ensure a set of connecting and then an adjoining or at least reasonably located 3rd room. Despite the hotel floor not being full our rooms were 4500, 4502 and 4567 a full over 5 minute walk away. These halls are huge. A CPU program has to be better or a human has to be more intelligent about room placement. This was the biggest disappointment traveling with 4 generations of the family and the difficulty with mobility between the locations. Rooms were clean. The multiple sinks in the bathroom helped with extra people and teeth brushing and getting ready etc. microwaves and fridges. The bus to EPIC was amazing and we never waited more than 15 minutes there or returning and went twice in a day. The walk to Volcano Bay was very convenient. This hotel is huge. The large food area/cafeteria style diner was great. We booked at bowling but never made it and had to cancel. Won't stay here because of the level of disappointment with the amount I spent and the planning I attempted to have such a poor experience on arrival. (rooms not ready or even close, when they were ready we had to return to the desk because the keys didn't work.)

If you want the volcano view room it is very misleading. All the pictures show the volcano but checked in a couldn't see the volcano. But have a nice view of a line to a water slide. The staff was friendly but very little spoke English so had to rely on other guest to find anything. Hotel itself isn't bad but I feel misled. When I called, was told you can still see the waterpark. I'm staying disney from now on.

Loved staying here. It’s our 3rd time and I would recommend however DO NOT use their automatic checkout. I have been waiting for 2 months for my incidental hold to be reversed only to find out they have charged me for room charges that I didn’t have. I opened a case with my bank to get back my incidental hold and cabana bay sent over ‘evidence’ of a room charge totalling $43.58. As a result my bank declined my chargeback. After looking at their ‘evidence’ the receipt didn’t have my name, room number or signature. The room number was 2729 but my room number was 4358. It would appear that a member of staff input the receipt amount as the room number and charged me. The fact that no human picked up this error before submitting it to my bank is insane. I would have been able to dispute this on the spot if I had completed checkout but now I’m back in the UK trying to sort this out but still getting nowhere. I’m so disappointed in the hotel and the way they have handled it. It’s really put a dampener on the stay with them

Good hotel it’s huge and busy though ! The shuttle was great outside to get to Universal And the early morning access for an hour was useful ! The Buffett obviously got busy too but the food was decent for mass produced food! Room was ok too for the 5 of us we had a family room.

First and foremost, I have to say that the people were nice. The Vacation Planner was SUPER HELPFUL as we had some questions that needed answered and he was able to help us figure out when we wanted to go to Epic, and get that booked. My father decided we were doing a cruise, my sister wanted to come see the new Epic park if our cruise would happen to leave out of Canaveral. To start, my father is on 100% disability with the VA, as such, we were able to get discounts on passes for Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure. When looking into transportation, we had some issues travelling last year with five of us in a Ford Exploder (Explorer) which is a mid-size SUV at best. With our luggage and my father's walker, it was a tight fit. So initially we were looking at a rental vehicle and a hotel, Universal for a few days and then NASA for a day somewhere in there. When we figured out that NASA was not important, and that Cabana Bay also had a discount for VA Disability... it was decided to instead, Uber to this "resort" and we shouldn't need a rental vehicle as there would be shuttles to wherever we needed to go park-wise. The major benefit to a Universal hotel is that you get in an hour early to the park... BUT, they do not explain how that works. And then is it "such a benefit" that it negates all of the other issues that the hotel has? As I will never stay at a Universal property hotel again, that is for you (the reader) to decide for yourself. First and foremost, this hotel is "the cheap option" obviously you can tell this by the price point alone, but moreso by the nickel & diming once you stay here. The hotel resort is spread over a massive property with multiple hotel wings. I did not have the time or energy to "explore" other wings or floors, so take what I give you with a grain of salt as to my experience alone. Florida is hot, and muggy... it just is, it's part of being there, especially in the summer. We booked a "handicap" room for my father, and a second room adjoining for my sister and her kids. When we booked, the reservation person told me that if he did not put her in an adjoining handicap room, she would not be near us... as the system was trying to put her in a room on the wing catty-corner to where we were to be at. Nonetheless, she did not "need" that room, so she was moved, and thankfully still within the same wing about 4 rooms away from where we were at. The biggest thought process in this is that if we were to take an Uber or something somewhere and get dropped off needing two separate drop offs because we were a mile away from each other. Nonetheless, that never actually happened, so it did not matter. Our room, per my step-counter on my watch, was a half mile away from where we got our breakfast at the Bayliner Cafe (a full mile round trip...). There were the main elevator to our floor, and then we passed three elevators before we got to our room. NOWHERE on that walk were there any places to sit down and rest. Mind you after the first day at the first park, I had a blister on either foot the size of a quarter... and it was hard and painful to walk, my father has a walker, thankfully it turns into a seat if he needs to sit... but then there is the fact that the weather is? Yeah, hot and muggy... You would think (logically) that each area near the elevator would have a sitting area for people waiting for the elevator to come get them... there are after all like 7 or 8 floors at least in the Americana wing (where we were at). Who knows, maybe higher floors had sitting and lower floors didn't get any, i do not know for certain.... but it would have been great to have had a place to break up that extremely long walk, ESPECIALLY with luggage on the in or the out! And we were not by any means the last room in the wing... lol!! Biggest issue with the room is that there were two sets of drapes, one blackout, one semi-translucent to let the light in, but not allow "voyeurs" to see in per se. They were controlled by remote control.... but there was no directions on how to use it. There were three buttons that were unmarked, and an up arrow and a down arrow. One of the arrows closed both, one of them opened both. No clue to this day how you open the blackout and close the other. Where is the issue? Well, I would make sure that before I climbed into bed (as my father would go to bed super early) that I would close the drapes (both). When I woke up 5 hours later... they [both] would be open... My dad does not understand technology very well, he stayed away from the remote. They were on a damned timer. In the middle of the night at some point while we were asleep, the hotel had it programmed to open our drapes.... Which while thankfully we were on the second floor, means that anyone in the wing across from us, if they happened to look across and down... got WAY more than they were looking for when I got out of bed to close the damn things so I could get dressed in the mornings!! Something my father mentioned, was that the handicap bars near the toilet were not placed well and it was VERY HARD for him to get himself up off the toilet. For *active* "disabled Vets" (or anyone with a physical handicap) that are able to bounce up and off a toilet with ease, you may not have an issue, but for an elderly man with knee problems and a heart condition... it was horrible. The place is MASSIVE. Book early, request a room near the lobby. Everything revolves around the lobby. The restaurant, the bus pickups, Uber, the pools... everything. There are many entrances/exits to the hotel wings for each specific pool... which is a plus, but it would be far better (imo) to be located further from one pool and closer to the lobby since that is where everything revolves around. For instance, our room was a half-mile walk (one way) to get to the restaurant closest to "our wing". For someone who is handicapped (we were in a handicap room, as my father is on 100% disability) it takes FOREVER to get a half-mile at an extremely slow pace, and with no benches or sofas or.... yeah. Cheap food... as you would expect from a resort. And of course it is expensive to purchase, and it comes "this way" like it or leave it. I do not eat a lot of fried food, or a lot of starchy foods. I wanted a burger, which "comes with fries". I told the lady I did not want fries, she said it comes with fries. I told her I cannot eat the fries, she said it comes with fries. I told her just leave the damned fries off my plate, and she left the fries off the plate muttering under her breath it costs the same either way. I don't believe in wasting food, I don't think I should take the food I am not going to eat and then just throw it away!!! That is a major problem! I then headed to the salad bar to grab my salad which was "my side". Thankfully the person at the checkout "gave me a discount" for not receiving fries... because I was fully prepared to just leave the $16 burger sitting on the counter had he charged me full price. The place needs to have options for people, a cheeseburger by itself, or with a side, multiple sides to choose from, not "just fries, and only combined". The food at the Bayliner Cafe (a cafeteria style) - Collect via a tray (under the counter, which nobody points out to you, and is not labelled, so you just gotta know they are there...) and you go to different stations to get "main dishes" or "side dishes" or you can buy prepackaged crap like you would at a gas station (prepackaged sandwiches, juices, energy drinks, milk, candy, etc) and pay before finding a seat... was so-so at best and some of it was downright nasty. That said, it is a resort catering to massive amounts of people, so that is as much as can be expected. For the salads there were multiple packets of dressing. However I never found barbecue sauce for people who wanted that as a condiment... and the Tabasco sauce was in tiny 1/2 oz packages which I needed 6 of to cover an omelet. This creates a LOT of waste that was unneeded for a resort catering to a bunch of people. There were Pump canister style condiments for Ketchup, Mustard and Mayo... would have made sense (imo) to have had one for BBQ, and one for Tabasco (or another hot sauce brand, though I love Tabasco, so good choice in my opinion there at least). I feel like a LOT of people use salsa on eggs... but there was no salsa in the mornings for the flavoring of either omelets or scrambled (powdered) eggs. There also was a severe lack of "options"... such as if you got an omelet, you could "build it" with any of the listed ingredients.... but you couldn't get "additional eggs" (some places might offer a 2 egg omelet, a 3 egg omelet or a 4 egg omelet, etc. I was fine with the two egg, but some people might want more and be willing to pay more for it).
