Bacon was super expensive as a side, and having it "as a side" required a totally separate plate, you could not add it to a plate which seemed asinine as it was creating more dishes that needed to be washed, and more plates that needed to be carried with a higher chance of getting dropped or knocked over. Also, the bacon came as is... there was no Crispy or Moist... it was all the same, no choices. Omelet was probably the best breakfast item I tried. My father said the croissant was dry (even with meat and cheese on it). I did not go for "the scrambled eggs" because they looked nasty and tasteless. My dad went for them... he said they tasted like the crap the military used to feed him... *powdered eggs*. Our last morning when I went to grab some Tabasco sauce, I saw a girl approaching with her plate full of "powdered eggs" and was like, why is she bringing that? There is no salsa up here (which they should honestly have for either the scrambled eggs OR the omelet)... Well, I didn't ask, and I didn't have to ask, she must have taken a bite... because she put her plate under the ketchup dispenser and LOADED that plate with ketchup all over it to what I could only think was to offset the nastiness of those eggs!! LOL!! There is one size of "beverage cup" it is tiny... My suggestion? As soon as you get to the hotel, grab an Uber over to a grocery store and stock up on some refreshments... because buying from Universal is a HASSLE! Obviously it is not beneficial if you have a long stay to be eating all of your meals through prepackaged crap, you will need to go to a restaurant at some point, but seeing as there is no "don't bring outside drinks in" type of seating situation... you may as well go buy some 32 oz bottles of pop, water, tea, etc so you do not have to deal with their asinine system---- They have the Coca-Cola Freestyle machines (with a twist). They have them programmed to read RFID chips that they have placed on "the tiny beverage cups" (or the souvenir cups). If you buy the souvenir cup, my guess is that they program "your stay" into the RFID chip so that you are good to get your refills as you need. However, as I did not get the overpriced souvenir cup (I have too many souvenir cups at home, don't need more), I was left with the tiny beverage cup. After purchasing it, you have 90 minutes of refills after it is activated... and you can only fill it once every 2 minutes maximum... of course NOWHERE do they tell you this. Now, I understand, they need to make money, and I am sure plenty of people through the years have succeeded in gaming their system which have probably cost them thousands of dollars. So, generally speaking, I have no issue with what they did... However the execution of it was HORRIBLE. I do not drink pop anymore (for the most part, when I can), I drink unsweetened tea, or carbonated water. First issue I had, was that I did not fill my cup with ice (the beverages come out on average at 38-42 degrees and ice is just going to displace the amount of beverage going in. Likewise if for some reason I do not get to the beverage, the ice will melt and "water-down" the already cool drink before it really has a chance to "get warm"... So as I was saying, I did not fill my cup with ice, I started to fill it with my AHA lemon-lime water... the bubbles rose to the top, so I stopped pressing on the button allowing the carbonation to settle before hitting the button again... the cup was about 2.3 full, and that is where it was going to stay!! Pressing the button gave me a message to place a cup down, but my cup was already down, so I lifted my cup, and put it back down... the machine WOULD NOT allow me to fill it the rest of the way up to the top. The next time I tried, I figured out that what I need to do... is be wasteful! Just keep filling the cup past when it starts to overfill with the carbonation until you actually see liquid running down the side of the cup, THEN release the button... THAT way, you can actually get a full cup!!! On a different day... I went back and I wanted to try something... the carbonated water had only two options for flavoring, while the Vitamin Water Zero had 8 options. So thinking back in the day when we used to mix the different flavors... I figured, I would fill my cup 1/2way up with AHA Lemon-lime to get "the bubbles" and the other half up with Vitamin Water Zero Strawberry (or something). Well.... THAT was a mistake... the point of these freestyle machines were that you could leave your cup there and you could mix and match flavors to your hearts desire... at least that is what Coke's intentions were 20 years ago!! Universal (corporate) has something else up their sleeves, take away any fun you might have on your vacation, and screw anyone that wants a beverage! Well... my carbonated AHA was 1/2 the way up, and I released the button, left the cup on the sensor, hit the back arrow, selected the Vitamin Water Zero icon, and received a message that said I needed to put a cuip down on the sensor... (WHAT?!?!?!) I lifted my cup, put it back down on the sensor. hit the icon again.... SAME MESSAGE!!! I said, fine, I will go to a different machine... (I was not walking very well after I got blisters on my feet, my problem for not wearing the best shoes... but still, being forced to walk to another machine because of this asinine product feature?) I get to the next machine, put the cup down and I get a message stating that I cannot have a refill for another 1 minute and 40 seconds.... REFILL? I DIDNT GET THIS REFILL YET!!!! So I threw the cup at the machine and I walked away pissed off. 5-6 minutes got me 1/2 of a cup of sparkling water.... and I will NEVER stay at a Universal property hotel again because of it! Yes, that might seem harsh, but it was absolutely asinine the troubles it gave. You might ask about water... if you do not have an RFID chip cup, you CAN get regular (non-flavored, non-carbonated water or ice from the machines with no issues). Now, to be fair, when I brought this issue up to the hotel staff, they "made it right" per se by giving us an offer to "help us out" due to the problems we faced... and that was awesome that they did it (I am not going to tell you what they gave us, because in different situations said solution might differ, also I do not want to push that people should be "taking advantage" of something for "free crap" either). It shows that there are people, humans that work for Universal the corporate entity that actually care about other humans whereas the corporate entity obviously does not. And while I accepted that offer, I feel that the right thing for them to do is to figure out a "better way" to not screw over their customers... otherwise they will not have a business to run. I went out and bought new shoes (on our last full day at the hotel, but before our cruise) and while I was out I stopped and got some sparkling water... BEST decision ever... not to deal with the hotels asinine beverage policy, which of course they blame on their "food and beverage department" but it is all wrapped up under one packaged label of *Cabana Bay*, so it affects the hotel and the brand one way or another. When we booked this hotel, one of the benefits that I had been told (specifically that I asked about for my father) was that there was a bus that left the hotel every 15-20 minutes throughout the day that went top the parks. I asked if we would be dropped off "at the entrance to the parks" or..... "by the parking garages"? Because I had once lived in Winter Park during college and had been to City Walk many, many times... and it is a LONG WALK to get to the parks from the garages (even with the rolling walkways). I was specifically told that they would take us "right up to the gates of the parks". Well... anything to book a hotel room right?? That was a complete and utter lie. The resort buses PU/Dropoff area is between the entrance to City Walk, and the Parking Garages... so basically, you are about 700 feet from the parking garages when you get to the top of the escalator... Which meant we had to cross the massive walkways to get into the City Walk area, then go around the lake to get to Islands of Adventure which opened early (because Universal Studios did not). Also, make sure you have YOUR ROOM KEY with you... NOBODY told us this!!! We had "our passes" and the general thought process of "Early Park Access" is that you would not get "into" the park if you were not from one of the hotels... <> Everyone is allowed early entrance to "the park" apparently, so they can start doing any shopping they would like to do... you just cant get to "the rides" area without your early access which requires you to show your room key...🙄🙄🙄 I had mine, I gave my dad his, my nephews (who would be actually riding the rides) left their keys in the room, and their mom had hers with her... They went up ahead to go ride the rides, but couldnt get in because they didnt have the passes that we were told we didnt need after we got in... So they came back, found us, I passed out the passes, and they ran up again to find out that is ALSO not what was needed... they needed the room key to PROVE they were staying at a Universal hotel (your dates will be printed on your key [FYI]) so now she hurries up to show HER key which thankfully the guy allows them to go in as "the general public" who has also been let into the park early... is lining up separately in a different line, and as I get up to show my room key (since I actually had mine) they release everyone from the general public line... because it is now 9am... and I am thinking 9am they would now gain entry at the "ticket takers"... NOPE. Why am I putting this here in the "hotel" review? Because IF you are staying at a Universal property hotel, I would imagine the "reason" is to-- go to the parks... because there is zero reason that I can tell as to why you would stay here if not for that "perk" alone. Also to note, the Cabana Bay bus slot at the PU/Drop spot... is (at least at the time of my writing this) the LAST slip in the parking lot.... meaning the furthest away at Universal City Walk. However, at Epic... it is significantly closer, thankfully. It's "Slip 9" which made us think it was going to be far, but it's a slight walk around a curved area and you are to the main drag. Same thing at Epic however, everyone gets let in, and you need your room key to get "past a certain point". A note on the transportation... the bus drivers were awesome, I was honestly expecting motor coaches, so I was pleasantly surprised to see that they were low-ride buses that have a couple places for handicapped accessibility strapping. The only thing that they are severely lacking is benches or seats nearby the bus stations so that people can rest or take a break as opposed to waiting in a line with no bus in 95 degree (actual, 105 degree real feel) muggy weather. also, expect that you might be standing up on the rides over they have a person count which exceeds the seat count...

Pleasant stay here at this retro 1950’s style hotel offering reasonable value for families who wish to visit the Universal parks. Regular bus transportation provided to and from the parks. Rooms basic but adequate, clean and comfortable. Food court offers several fast food type options which we only tried once - you pay at the till after you receive the food order then finding a table and sitting down - we found food was getting too cold too quickly. No table service option which we prefer. Pool area - has a nice lazy river - down side is that there are not enough parasols to offer shade Starbucks was a nice option
The Hotels offers Everything You Need also for Kids and adults. So much fun for everybody

The rooms need renovating. It was clean but the cover on the bed was worn with threads sticking up everywhere. They don't advertise that the lazy river tubes cost extra! Never cleaned room. Asked for clean washcloths and was told they had to put a request in. Never got them!! One and done for me and the family.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Todo excelente y en recepción con la señorita Laicka muy amable y servicial

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This was an amazing hotel overall. We stayed for one night before a cruise. Scarlett at the front desk was welcoming and very pleasant. The room was super clean and the hotel had a small pool which we didn’t use and a lobby bar. I only wish they would have provided a guide in the room for restaurants in the area that you could walk to. The restaurant next door to them the Gastropub was very good but because we didn’t know the area a printed guide sheet would have helped. For the breakfast I suggest you go early. It’s your standard free hotel breakfast but it got so crowded that there were no places to sit. If you are planning on taking a 10;00 am shuttle to the cruise port which they offer for a fee, I suggest you try to go downstairs very early. The only negative feedback I have is since this property has 2 elevators, we had to wait about 15 minutes. We finally had to take one up to go down. That was frustrating as everyone was trying to leave at the same time.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: From an appearance standpoint this Hampton Inn is very nice. However; it’s after 4pm and our room still isn’t ready. Other people in the same situation were offered drink coupons as compensation yet not us. Check in counter personnel don’t seem to work with any sense of urgency.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We had a fantastic group stay at the Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Brickell Downtown! The location is unbeatable—spacious and clean rooms, great complimentary breakfast, and easy access to Brickell's top dining and transit. The staff made our group check-in effortless and provided top-notch service throughout our stay. I was extremely happy to meet Nataly in person. As a travel agent with Knight Dream Destinations, I will definitely be booking this hotel for accommodations whenever we have clients cruising out of Miami!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I had a wonderful experience at this Hampton Inn. Camila and Ernest went out of their way to help me get my phone charged when I didn’t have a charger. Because my phone was dying, I couldn’t use Uber or DoorDash to have another charger delivered, and I would not have been able to request an Uber to catch my flight home. Their kindness and willingness to help relieved so much stress and truly made a difference. This is what exceptional hospitality looks like. Thank you, Camila and Ernest!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Sherice was is so kind, friendly and polite. She was so supportive to me and I was so thankful for her.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El Hotel es excelente, muy buena ubicacion en brickell, la comida y sobre todo la atención del personal y resalto muy gratamente la amabilidad y la disposicion para asesorar y ayudar de Laicka en recepción. Recomendado 100%

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Laicka es la mejor, amable, servicial y atenta. Me encanto todo

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I like the location. (Close to Burlington, Publix, CVs...) The room is clean and comfortable. Free airport shuttle. Free breakfast. Small fee to the cruise port. What not to like!?

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown

review_text: Linda at the front desk was very friendly and efficient! Got us a good room facing the lagoon. The room was great. We were there for a medical procedure and stayed 10 nights. Our room had a kitchen a little living area a dining table everything you would need to make it like an apartment. Housekeeping is hit or miss they’re scheduled every other day but they pretty much come whenever they want and not when you want. Which was fine. I was sleeping quite a bit at the time anyway. The breakfast is great enjoyed going down there and bringing back some yogurt for later in the afternoon. On a Wednesday night they had a happy hour get together. What really sets this apart for me is when my husband brought me home from surgery on Tuesday. the front desk lady immediately met us at the door with a wheelchair, she could see that my husband was having a hard time getting me to our room. Would definitely stay here again, the value makes it a great choice!

Jean Baptist at the hotel’s concierge was fantastic. He always had our car waiting when we needed it, and he was always ready with a smile to help with our luggage. Jean was a standout in a city that struggles with customer service. We will def be back!

The front desk service is the worst, during my stay I complained about different situations first about the lacking of pillows, second about the towels over used and the third was because housekeeping didn’t passed by… they always ignored me

Muy buen servicio de parte de todos en el hotel, especialmente Kevin del valet desde que llegamos nos hizo sentir bienvenida y nos ayudó en todo el proceso nos ayudó explicando la zona y recomendando lugares a visitar. El servicio fue excepcional y todos los días nos recibió con una gran actitud. Recomiendo mucho el hotel y el restaurante.

Excelente servicio al cliente por parte del Sr Jean Batista me ayudó con mis pertenencias hasta el apartamento muy amable Al subir y acompañarme y que todo estuviera marchando a la perfección gracias por tener personas tan amables trabajando con ustedes

Estuve visitando el hotel la última semana y tuve una muy buena experiencia con todo específicamente con el valet. Fernando fue el que me atendió cuando llegué y me dio una cálida bienvenida con una sonrisa en su cara y con mucha paciencia ya q tenía muchas cosas q bajar incluyendo dos niños, él me ayudó en todo momento a bajar todas mis cosas y estuvo pendiente a los niños q estuvieran lejos de los carros q estaban circulando en la rampa, nunca perdió su amabilidad y su paciencia a pesar de q tenía otros invitados q atender y eso se agradece mucho. Quedé encantada con el servicio del valet y del hotel en general. Siempre recibí mi carro bien rápido y bien cuidado sin golpes ni nada, sin dudas estaré de vuelta muy pronto .

Had a Great experience here at the EPIC Had an awesome time at the spa and pool. The valet was amazing Jean Baptist was quick and brought my car out in no time. The hotel staff was very nice and helpful. The bell mall and door staff were there all day holding doors for us, restaurants are beautiful nice views. Will be back soon and recommend.

Es perfecto el servicio humano que atiende nuestras necesidades Jean Baptiste. En su trabajo. Y muy atento cuando necesitamos el servicio....También es honesto. Ok............ .................. el servicio de transporte para es rápido.

Excelente hotel me encantó todo estaba muy limpio y la atención del señor del parking Ramón Chávez fue excelente muy educado y profesional, en general es muy gratificante ir a lugares donde la atención y el servicio son excelentes full recomendado

Estuve con mi familia un fin de semana y nos encantó. Buen trato de parte de todo el personal. En el restaurante la comida es divina, y la atención también. Gracias a Ramón del valet que también fue muy amable. En fin, pasamos un fin de semana maravilloso.

Muy lindo lugar para compartir entre amigos y familia también, esta vez fui con unos amigos y me encantó la experiencia, quiero destacar el trabajo de vallet parking en especial el señor Jorge que fue muy amable y rápido la atención que tuvo con nosotros de lo mejor súper recomendado 👌
Muy buena atención en club lounge por parte Jaquiline, Danna y Emilia, siempre con una sonrisa, agradable conversación y por supuesto excelente atención de servicio.

My husband and I had a wonderful experience staying at InterContinental Miami. We had a king room with an ocean view and it was amazing. We got to see some cruise ships depart and arrive back in port. The view during the night was spectacular, seeing the city all lit up. The bed was incredibly comfortable and the bathroom was very spacious. I especially enjoyed that there was also a bathtub. We enjoyed the pool alongside the bar. The staff went ABOVE AND BEYOND to make us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Everyone truly exemplified the meaning of, service with a smile. The location is perfectly situated within walking distance to Bayside Marketplace, which was a + plus us. All in all we definitely enjoyed our stay and will definitely stay here again. Thanks for making our experience truly amazing.

The people are what make this hotel 5-star...from the valet guys to the bellmen to the front desk folks to the lovely lady cleaning the room to the people in the business center managing packages...every single one of them so very helpful and so genuine. The drinks and food were great too.

We had a wonderful stay for my sons 15th birthday trip at the InterContinental Miami and would highly recommend the hotel. I was warmly recognised as an IHG Ambassador member throughout our stay, which made the experience feel particularly special. Communication with the hotel before and during our stay was excellent, with very efficient and helpful responses. A very special mention must go to Jolanda, Director of Rooms, who is a true superstar. She was absolutely amazing and went out of her way to make sure everything was perfect for us. Her warmth, professionalism and attention to detail really stood out. We stayed in a beautiful one-bedroom suite, which was extremely spacious, super clean and very comfortable for ourselves and our 15-year-old son, who was celebrating his birthday during our stay. The hotel very kindly recognised the occasion with a lovely birthday cake and a personalised card, which was such a thoughtful touch. The Club Lounge was spacious, beautifully decorated and a lovely place to relax. The lounge staff were fantastic, friendly and attentive throughout our stay. One thing that really stood out was the warmth of the staff throughout the hotel. They would always say hello, goodbye, wish us a good day and make us feel genuinely welcome. Those little touches really do mean so much and make a stay feel special. We also really appreciated how accommodating after checkout, while we waited for our evening flight. This made our final day so much easier and more relaxing. This was particularly impressive given how busy the hotel was at the time, with the Miss USA contestants and their team staying there. Despite this, everything ran like clockwork and the service remained excellent throughout. We had a fantastic stay, cannot wait to return, and would highly recommend the InterContinental Miami.
Club floor 29, excelente la atención por parte de Jaqueline y Jolanda!, limpio y cómodo el hotel en general, me Encanta!
Muy buena ubicacion..cerva del puerto..buena atencion..y si tuve un problema de atencion ya que no hicieron aseo de habitacion y tuve que presentar un reclamo..pero reaccionaron muy bie n
Excelente atención y cuidado de los detalles por parte de todos los empleados
fueron pocos dias pero que comodo que es estar en esa ubicacion.

Hola me encantaría recomendar este Súper Hotel, no solo por la atmósfera Miami que se respira nada más traspasar sus puertas. Las habitaciones, las instalaciones y sus maravillosas vistas también son otro aliciente para su elección . Pero lo que quiero destacar es la calidad humana de sus trabajadores , la calidez y amabilidad. La conserjería y Mauricio en particular que año tras año solucionan todas tus dudas y problemas con cariño y paciencia. Volvería siempre .
Buena atención y muy confortable
Muy buena servicio de desayuno. Atendido por Johana que marca la diferencia por su amabilidad y profesionalidad.

Como siempre es un placer desayunar en este hotel donde nos tratan como si estuviéramos en casa, con una cercanía y una simpatía que siempre es de agradecer. Agradecer a Johana como siempre por su sonrisa y disposición a ayudar y su vocación de servicio.
Fantástica atención por parte de Johana, un placer contar con ella y su cuidado.

Fuimos con mi novio por un fin de semana. Nos atendieron muy bien. La habitación con vista a la bahía estuvo magnífica. Alrededor hay de todo para disfrutar y está muy cerca del tren y el trolley para ir a brickell y el downtown.
Excelente atención de todo el personal, amigables y buen servicio. Alberto nos vincula y entretiene a nuestra experiencia hispana.

La limpieza impecable Ubicación excelente Desayuno en el restaurante: excelente atención de Fanny , muy amable siempre con una sonrisa. Cuidado con los paquetes de Amazon, te cobran 10 dólares por cada paquete.

We were guests over Labor Day weekend in Miami. The airport had a horrible accident the day before our return flight, and we had to stay an additional two days. The staff at the Marriott Biscayne Bay was wonderful. We enjoyed our server, Fanny, at breakfast each day.

The service was absolutely amazing. The eggs Benedict is divine.

We had a great experience at Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay. Our server Aurea in the restaurant was wonderful and took great care of us. We will be back!
Comodidad y confort, no se pierdan en el restaurante los wafles del desayuno buenísimos. Aurea quien me atendió divina!!! Excelente atención.

I had a wonderful stay. Food was good, room was clean and spacious with beautiful views of the bay. The service was exceptional. My server Avrea was the best!! She made sure I celebrated my birthday the right way. She was kind , sweet, and I really appreciate her for everything. Can’t wait to come back!
Perfect breakfast experience! Wonderful food, extraordinary service by Aurea, so friendly and welcoming! Thank you very much!

Toda la experiencia fue exelente,lo único pésimo,es el control de la temperatura en los cuartos ya que estos se apagan y vuelven a encender al subir la temperatura,está terrible ese sistema!!!!
We arrived very early and Claudia at the front desk was able to get us an early check in and have our room ready by 11am.

Muy buen hotel, con habitaciones magníficas, además, de excelentes instalaciones y servicios. La mejor opción en Miami, repetiríamos. Lo peor es el trato del personal de recepción. Nos perdieron unas gafas y un pijama el personal de las habitaciones y no nos dieron una solución. También, numerosos cargos a la Visa y no sabían que era. During my stay at the InterContinental Miami, I had breakfast daily at Olé, and I can confidently say that the experience was elevated entirely by the incredible staff. A special thank you to Eliana, whose attentiveness, warmth, and professionalism truly stood out. She consistently went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, always with a genuine smile that made each morning feel welcoming and personal. I also want to recognize Yanet and Jessie, the hosts, who set the tone from the moment you arrive. Her charisma, positive energy, and friendly attitude made every breakfast start on the right note. They didn’t just provide service—they created an experience. If you’re staying at the InterContinental Miami, make sure to have breakfast at Olé—and if you’re lucky, you’ll be taken care of by them. —Antonio

I am very impressed for his outstanding hospitality. He recommended me the restaurant and many other activities in the area. I noticed he is very knowledgeable and loves giving genuine services. I enjoyed the layout of the pool and the spa looks wonderful. I'm very much looking forward to staying in the Intercontinental Hotel in the near future.

We made some small talk while they were getting me set up & it always helps having their credit card. The lobby’s atmosphere is spectacular — very wide open with a bar, restaurant, and a few small shops including a Starbucks.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We stayed here the night before a cruise. We had stayed here 12 years ago. The place looks great they updated the pool area and it has a great vibe. We thought the morning breakfast was good to get by, typical Hampton Inn. Though the breakfast area is done up nicely and feels more upscale than a Hampton Inn. We had to wait until 3 pm to get a room and then there was a long line up. We had our luggage stored for us in a room. It would have been better for them to release rooms as they were cleaned as opposed to having a large number of people all come back at the same time. Our stay was great. We had lunch at a restaurant around the corner Piola and the food there was really good. We took the free tram people mover to Bayside and had a lovely time there. The tram is around the corner from the hotel We booked transfers for our cruise on the first floor, you pay for your tickets in cash day of. The transfers were $12 per person. Also, note check in is on the 6th floor. Our room was nice a typical Hampton Inn experience. We would definitely stay here again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This hotel is well located in the popular Brickell section of Miami. Walking distance to public transportation; to a very popular nightlife area; and very near to Bayside and Coconut Grove. The hotel has a small pool area; a small gym; and a small lobby bar area - all fine though we did not have need for that. The parking lot/security staff is very helpful and the front desk personnel was efficient. The room was clean and more than adequate for our 3 day stay. The only downside of this property- the elevators! First, the building only has 3 elevators which is not enough to support the number of rooms/guests. And then 1 has apparently been broken for a LONG time meaning that there are only 2 working elevators. Not sufficient. Causes long waits. So, they gotta fix that. Other than that, all was well.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Gran hospedaje con una ubicación inmejorable. La atención de Luz fue excelente y permitió que fueran días muy agradables.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Rassoul is the best. Best customer service in any hotel in Miami.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Si buscas un hotel funcional, bien ubicado y cómodo para combinar trabajo y buenos momentos en Miami, este Hampton Inn en Brickell cumple muy bien su propósito. 💼 Ideal para trabajar • WiFi rápido y estable • Habitaciones amplias con escritorio cómodo • Ambientes tranquilos para llamadas y reuniones virtuales • Desayuno incluido que te ahorra tiempo en las mañanas Perfecto si estás en modo productividad, reuniones, o visitando clientes en el distrito financiero. 🌴 También para disfrutar • Piscina en rooftop para relajarte después del trabajo • Gym bien equipado • A pasos de restaurantes, bares y Brickell City Centre • Fácil acceso al Metromover No es un hotel de lujo extremo, pero sí es eficiente, práctico y bien administrado. Y en una zona como Brickell, eso vale mucho. ⭐ Conclusión: Una excelente opción para viajes de negocios o estadías cortas donde quieres equilibrio entre trabajo y calidad de vida. Cumple, resuelve y te mantiene en el centro de la acción.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Reception on 6th floor. Arrived around 11pm got room went to it someone's elses luggage in it. Went back down to get another room , big room. Microwave in it no kettle. Breakfast was ok not a lot of choice but plenty of seats.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: La señora Luz del desayuno muy atenta y amable

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The room was nice enough but housekeeping failed to clean or room on the first day. We even stopped by the front desk to let them know and have them follow through on getting it cleaned. We returned to our room around 5 pm and it still was not cleaned I tried to speak to two ladies with their housekeeping carts on our floor and could not communicate due to different languages. Tried to call the front desk and our phone was out of service. Therefore, I went down to the desk and the same gentleman was there and remembered me asking for the cleaning service. I was given clean towels and offered 2 free drinks. There seems to be some lack of communication between levels of service. Sure glad I was headed for a cruise the next day and would be leaving the hotel.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: What a clean beautiful hotel with friendly staff . A great breakfast offered as well with options . Very nicely decorated and near Brickell City Center and amazing restaurants

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: My stay at this hotel was very pleasing. The hotel is conveniently located, with easy access to various restaurants and a shopping center. What truly made my experience enjoyable, however, was the front desk staff—especially Sherice. She greeted me with outstanding professionalism and made me feel truly welcomed. Because of her, the hotel felt like a home away from home.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We stayed for a long weekend with friends. It’s still a Hampton Inn…but it’s the coolest, nicest Hampton Inn we’ve stayed at! We upgraded to a king suite so was nice to have extra space but the “elite floor” doesn’t really get you anything that our friends staying 2 floors down didn’t get. The pool wasn’t huge but had a variety of seating options, was never busy, and was very relaxing. Breakfast was typical for a Hampton Inn but had more nice seating than usual. They had a full bar open in the evenings, which was nice for a nightcap. And attached to the hotel at street level, the gastropub was a really fun casual option for food or drinks. The location was perfect for our stay as we didn’t expect it to be a beach kind of vacation. You’re two blocks from the water and within a short walk of dozens of fantastic dining and shopping options. It was a young sophisticated crowd in the neighborhood so countless coffee shops and brunches.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Es un hotel muy agradable, con una atención muy amable de su personal, muy bien ubicado, cerca de sitios muy lindos para cenar. El ambiente es impecable y muy limpio y los desayunos muy ricos y abundantes. Nos atendió Laicka en el frontdesk, siendo muy amable y agradable

review_text: My stay at the Hampton Inn was made extra special thanks to Rassoul! From the moment I arrived, he went above and beyond to make sure I felt welcomed and taken care of. His kindness, professionalism, and genuine smile made every interaction a pleasure. You can truly tell he loves what he does, his positive energy sets the tone for the whole hotel. Rassoul is a true asset to the Hampton team, and I’m grateful for the excellent service he provided. Thank you for making my experience unforgettable!”

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: A beautiful hotel! The rooms and bathrooms are big with lots of counter space. Beautiful pool. Very walkable, right in the Brickell district. Lots of great restaurants.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Very conveniently located. Nice clean area. Enough places close by to eat at. I forgot my book in the room and they sent me a text as well as an email. I was able to have my friend pick it up on her way back through. Room was very nice, clean and comfortable. The staff was very welcoming.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Read the reviews and found the hotel did not disappoint. The staff and cleanliness ensured my wife and I had a wonderful experience. Special shout outs to Laicka (top-notch customer care and support), Rassoul (quite the entertainer), and Carlos ( gotcha back for sho!). Despite one unprofessional response from the supervisor when asking a question during training team members, we left with a feeling of certainty that we will return and recommend others to stay at Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown. Thanks, Brickell Downtown Team!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: 1. There's an additional room charge of $49.95 when I arrived. I assumed it would be returned after I left, but it wasn't. I didn't use or request anything extra. There was no reason for such a high charge, as I was solo. 2. You can't respond to their survey/review request Email because it fails delivery when you reply. 3. I had a couple of issues with sheet stains. I always take a black light with me to public places because bedbugs are becoming endemic. The front desk moved me to another room, and then when I found stains there, too, they changed the sheet. So after a bit of annoyance, it was resolved. The front desk was helpful. 4. Parking is expensive at $39 per night. There are less expensive parking garages in walking distance. There is some misleading advertising on the Hilton website. It offers Park and Stay that permits free parking from one to seven days. However, when I made the reservation with Hilton, they said I would have to pay over one thousand dollars for a seven day stay to get the free parking. That is opposite of the advertising, and I didn't see that in the terms. 5. The procedure with the car garage is not explained before arrival, and it cost me time and energy to go back to the garage to re-park the car. The only available information was a wall sign saying 15 min. parking for hotel registration. So I did that. Then I had to go back to the garage and move the car onto the correct floor. It would be more convenient if this information was available on the hotel website or on the registration floor. On arrival I would have been able to get a ticket, park the car and be done. 6. I had lost my charger and tried to use the room USB ports. The six total ports on the desk and lamp did not work. I found a working one under the wall light at the bed, or I would have had to find a store late at night. 7. The in-room air conditioning units blow out a musty smell that is noticeable when the a/c turns on, as though there is mildew in the lines somewhere. It fades after a while. 8. It didn't affect my stay, but the floor in the lobby bar needs to be scrubbed. The tile is dirty and damaged. The loose dirt is mopped, but it's not enough. 9. There's a bit of free beer, wine, or soda at the bar. 10. I received a small pack of cookies, peanuts, and plantains and two waters. There is cold water and hot coffee stations in the lobby 24 hrs. There is coffee and a coffee maker in the room. You get a $5 off $20 Sproutz restaurant coupon. 11. The checkout time is noon. 12. The breakfast was fresh and hot and there was plenty of eggs, bacon, waffles, bagels, oatmeal, and other items available. The coffee is good. The kitchen staff are friendly and helpful. 13. The location is close or walking distance to most things downtown.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This hotel’s convenient location is only one of its perks. Is sandwiched between the train and plenty nice restaurants. Their personnel is friendly and helpful. It offers a free breakfast with real eggs, sausages, do it yourself waffles and bagels, croissants, cereals, etc. The employees in charge of breakfast deserve an honorable mention. Amparo, Camila, Freya and the others are always attentive to your needs and make you feel at home! I hope they are paying them well! Clean rooms, comfortable beds and quiet ( in spite of being in the middle of the city) await you should you choose this hotel. Thank you for making our sojourn a truly relaxing experience! We will definitely be back!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The last stay but not the least.( 2025) thanks to all the staff, who Made each Time my stay was worth it. From concierge to front desk lobby, including breakfast team. 👍🙏👏💐

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Every time I travel to Miami I love to stay at this hotel, the staff is always warm and welcoming and they definitely acknowledge my Gold status. But I want to send a special shout out to Rassoul and Diamond, they definitely represented what real hospitality is all about. Me and my wife definitely appreciated your servitude. Kudos, Kudos, Kudos, I love everything about the Brickell area. You guys are Rock Stars in my book. Thank you so much. We'll definitely return.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We used a free night reward for this stay the night before a cruise out of Miami. Hotel was easy to find, we took an Uber from the airport to the hotel. Front desk staff were super nice and upbeat, especially when we arrived at midnight after some flight delays. Room was easy to find, super clean. Breakfast was nice the next morning. We did sign up for the cruise transport from the hotel to the Miami port, it was $8 per person and it was on a charter bus. The driver was excellent. I would not hesitate to stay here again if back in the area.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Florisbett and Carlos (the package guy) were key to making our stay so special. What an amazing level of service! This was my second stay with you this year, and once again, it was a fantastic experience. The hotel’s location is perfect, super comfortable, and spotlessly clean. I’m already looking forward to coming back! Thank you for the wonderful way you’ve treated me—I truly appreciate it and want to highlight the exceptional service I received.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente servicio al cliente. Siempre muy atentos a las necesidades que teníamos. Buen desayuno. Habitación cómoda y siempre limpia. Todo es claro y práctico, casi todo está a la mano. En general el hotel es muy cómodo, y todos son muy amables. Gracias por la gran estadía.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Clean hotel and rooms. The pool is wonderful . Breakfast was plentiful. Every staff member i encountered for 2 days was professional and personable. There are plenty of food options within half mile. Great on property bar at resonable prices.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: INSTALACIONES, ATENCION Y AMBIENTE AGRADABLE PARA LLEVAR A CABO NUESTRO EVENTO, Y LOS INVITADOS QUEDARON SATISFECHOS CON TODO, GRACIAS A NATALY MEJIA POR LA ATENCIÓN BRINDADA, ESPERAMOS VERNOS EN UN PROXIMO EVENTO Y SE LOGRE CON EXITO..

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We had a lovely stay at this hotel. Very clean , updated rooms and friendly staff. It is close to everything . We booked this hotel as it is close to cruise port. Easy walking distance to many nice restaurants and shopping. Highly recommend! We will return!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Really nice hotel. The pool area is beautiful. Rooms were clean and plenty of room. Bathroom clean, complimentary shampoo/conditioner good quality. Breakfast offerings are amazing. Def recommend, will stay again if I come back to miami in the future. Parking garage nice perk and restaurants/stores within walking distance.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: First time at this Hampton location. We were impressed, to say the least. Rooms were spotless, and the customer service was amazing. We asked for an early checkin and late checkout, and we were granted both. The bar had great drinks and friendly staff. Lots of restaurants and shopping within walking distance. The free metro trolly to Biscayne was a great experience.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This is my go to hotel whenever I come to Miami to vacation. The bartender Mirellla is awesome and very welcoming! I asked her to make me a lemon drop and it was amazing! The location of this hotel is also nice because it is walking distance to different restaurants. In addition to that, the rooms are also very nice and comfortable.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: So many places to stay in downtown Miami but this just a gem. You can take the metro train from the airport and walk a half of black and your there . Free trolley to lots of sites at the metro stop. Free delicious breakfast. The staff is remarkable!! Room clean and spacious. Perfect for cruisers and first time visitors. One thing, bring your patience. There are lots of people trying to get to breakfast and there shuttles to the cruise ports so be patient with the elevators and give your self time. Good travels and rock on!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Hotel was best ever! Clean in the room was good! The breakfast is wonderful and very delicious! The bar is wonderful and reasonable price but first day to check in, they gave one free drink coupon! But one problem is one elevator was broke and three other elevators were very busy and slow! No shuttle to and from cruise port! If you add the shuttle for cruise the it will be 5 star and more people will come in!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The hotel is in BRICKELL with many restaurants nearby. Though our room was small, it was clean and up to date and quiet. When you enter the building, you go to the lobby on 6 where the breakfast will be served and there is a small bar for evening drinks. Staff are friendly and helpful. We stayed the night before a cruise and it takes about 20-30 minutes to drive to the port due to traffic!!!!! There is also a pool and hot tub. Great place for a stay.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: On arrival after a 12 hour flight, We were greeted by Carlos in reception who immediately made us feel like VIPS. Room selection and suggestions given with professionalism and great friendliness. Bar and breakfast perfect for the cruise traveller. Bedroom clean and well presented with excellent air conditioning. Hotel close to great restaurants and bars and Publix for any essentials. Only downside was an inoperative elevator which made busy times a nightmare and we used the fire stairs numerous times. Please fix this quickly as it’s a massive issue. Overall a good property made better by having personnel like Carlos.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Nice hotel, would stay here again. Convenient to lots of restaurants and Mary Brickell Village. More hot and cold breakfast choices than I have seen at other Hampton Inns. Large outdoor area off bar and breakfast room to relax, swim and/or enjoy a complimentary glass of beer or wine. Minor quibbles: slow internet, only space for one person at a time to work on laptop in room, very busy on weekend with cruise passengers which also meant long lineups to use elevators in the morning.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El día 12 de diciembre celebramos la graduación de nuestros estudiantes en el Hotel. El servicio de las personas y su equipo fue excepcional por que ya tenían todo preparado cuando llegamos, recibimos mucho apoyo con un inconveniente que tuvimos con el sonido, pero realmente ellos estuvieron dispuestos en todo momento para ayudarnos a solucionar el problema. El equipo asignado nos ayudo en todo lo que necesitamos de último momento.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I recently worked in a meeting room at Hampton inn in Brickel, and I was very impressed. The space was clean, well-designed, and bright, creating a great atmosphere for productivity. It’s also conveniently located, making access easy. The front desk staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, which added to the positive experience. I highly recommend Hampton inn in Brickell for anyone needing a meeting space!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We stayed here the night before our cruise, however plans changed with the hurricane and we needed to accommodate more of our family AND extend our trip. The staff was on point for our family and all the other people in similar situations. Alex, in particular, was extremely professional and accommodating and helped us creatively make arrangements. He was so on top of things and confident that I thought he was the manager, but he wasn’t. Customer service is a lost art, and we are thankful for this experience.
Maria baeza lo mejor que tiene el restaurante del desayuno Amable , simpática Muchas gracias Maria

My husband stayed here for two nights in between cruises and enjoyed our stay immensely. We received early check in from the very nice young man checking us. The hotel is beautiful. It is within walking distance of many great restaurants and shopping. Thanks for a great stay. We will be back.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: jorge Was the best sweet helpful and everything was smooth sailing with him . He was very professional and courteous. We really appreciate having him as a driver, considering we needed assistance because of the limited movement with the crutches thanks again greatly appreciate the service Yesssss

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Me guaria reconocer la impecabilidad y organización de Raida , Bryam, yoleisy y marta del área de breakfast ……………!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!…….,………………!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Exelente hotel, todo el personal muy amable y muy atento. Habitaciones muy cómodas y limpias. Servicio de transporte muy bueno. El señor Jorge (conductor) fue muy atento y con una exelente forma de conducir. El vehículo se siente en muy buen estado. En general muy buena experiencia

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Me hospedé en el Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami y quedé muy satisfecho con la experiencia. Es una excelente opción tanto para estancias cortas como largas, gracias a su enfoque tipo apartamento, que incluye cocina completamente equipada, sala de estar y un dormitorio separado. Perfecto para quienes valoran la comodidad del hogar incluso estando de viaje. El personal fue siempre amable y dispuesto a ayudar, haciendo que el ambiente fuera muy acogedor. El desayuno incluido cada mañana fue variado y bien servido, ideal para comenzar el día sin preocupaciones. Además, algunos días ofrecen una recepción por la tarde con snacks y bebidas, un detalle muy bien recibido. La ubicación también es conveniente, con fácil acceso a autopistas, el aeropuerto y centros comerciales. A pesar de estar cerca de zonas concurridas, el ambiente dentro del hotel es tranquilo y relajado. Las instalaciones se mantienen limpias y en buen estado, con gimnasio, piscina y lavandería disponibles, lo que lo hace especialmente práctico para familias o viajeros de negocios. En resumen, Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami ofrece una combinación de espacio, funcionalidad y excelente atención al cliente. Sin duda, lo recomendaría para quienes buscan una estancia cómoda y sin complicaciones en Miami.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: We stayed here for a couple of days after flying into MIA, and we highly recommend it. Location at the Blue Lagoon is near the airport and not too far from other Miami spots. Rooms were spacious, modern, and clean, parking is free, prices were reasonable, and the breakfasts were very good. The outdoor areas were beautiful, with chickens and ducks wandering nearby.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Probably the nicest family suite we’ve ever had with an unbelievable welcome and cleanliness like you dream about. We’d come back in a heartbeat! I can’t wait to use the gym and explore all the things there are to do around here. Breakfast is great.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: This a wonderful property. The room was a suite so spacious and extremely comfortable. The AC worked wonderfully well. I slept like a baby. Breakfast was good and there is a large area for seating. Linda the front desk clerk at night was amazingly nice and Jennifer in the day was great as well. I will stay here again and highly recommend it.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: We stayed at this very nice hotel for a night before and after a cruise. I chose this hotel because it had transportation for the airport and cruise port. They did not tell us that the return shuttle from the port was only for groups of 6 or more. We had to spend $50 for that trip instead of $30 that they told us. When we returned to the hotel to drop off our luggage (as advertised), the male at the desk said he couldn’t take our information because he was the only one working. When we came back after a city tour, which we also booked at the hotel, we were told that the airport shuttle only ran on the hour and the first trip at 6 AM the next morning was already booked. I asked about a taxi and the woman at the front desk said they could book it for us. The next morning a large SUV was there for the 2 of us. The charge was $45 for a 4 mile drive. The hotel is great. But ask questions about the transportation!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: We stayed here for our last day to transition between a cruise and airport. The hotel and room were clean and spacious. Elevators were a little rough but did the job. Pool water was chilly but we enjoyed sitting at the pool that overlooked the boats and wildlife (lizards, birds, baby birds) that were around the blue lagoon. Hotel had good snack and drink selection although way overpriced. Easy walk to some quick restaurant options such as Chipotle, Panera & Panda Express

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Great neat and friendly. Was on time drive very good and no speeding I would mostly recommend to anyone to ride with jorge he offered waters that came in handy and kept a smile on his face very professional the ride was nice and smooth thanks to jorge

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: What a wonderful experience. Even the shuttle driver Erica was so helpful and polite. She helped me with terrific suggestions about the area and helped me with the amenities at the hotel. I will book again. Especially hope that Erica is my driver. She represents the brand very well.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Great customer service. Jorge is amazing and funny. Super sweet person and the van was super clean and refreshing from the hot sun. And the front desk safe is awesome super sweet staff. The rooms were clean and the breakfast was amazing the amenities to many count.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Muy buen lugar para una escala cerca del aeropuerto de Miami, a minutos del downtown y muy cerca del dolphin mall. Las habitaciones son amplias, con vistas a una laguna y al aeropuerto. Tiene una pequeña cocina con heladera para algo rápido. Los baños algo pequeños. Desayuno incluido y cada una hora cuenta con un bus con traslado al aeropuerto

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Somos 6, y el departamento muy cómodo con dos habitaciones y dos baños completos además del living comedor integrado a una pequeña cocina , que no usamos ya que solo paramos un día , pero con todo lo necesario, el desayuno más que correcto , la ubicación cumple dos condiciones , cerca del aeropuerto con shuttle y da a la laguna

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Hotel shuttle service was very nice and able to arrange port transportation thru them was a plus! Tried for early checkin .It was not available but they did provide area to keep luggage and nice lobby area. Omar checked us in ( me and sis in law) He was very friendly but did not follow through on promises. Lobby area very nice and updated. Rooms were not. We had a 2 bedroom/2 bath suite .One bath was dirty and we moved to another suite it was clean but rooms need updating! The lobby leads one to believe the rooms are just as nice.. Ac a little difficult to work Breakfast buffet is nice and has a good variety. Located off main road nice for walking. Restaurants , grocery and shopping within walking distance. Overall good . I would stay again

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: The hotel was clean and comfy and a breakfast spread cannot be beat before heading back to the airport in the morning. It is quick and convenient to the airport. Jorge was a kind and courteous driver!! Would stay here again when visiting Miami!!!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Best view ever. Right above the water, and at night, the reflection of the buildings on the water is like glass. The room was perfect. Aliso came with a an amazing breakfast. I’m absolutely coming back. Thank you for the hospitality. -Seattle

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: My boyfriend and I stayed here on our last night in Miami and we wished we stayed here earlier! But we will be sure to book our stay here the next time we’re in Miami. The staff was great, the breakfast was delicious and the room was so nice, especially with our breathtaking view. 10/10 recommend!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: I had a fantastic stay at the Suites By Hilton Miami Airport Blue Lagoon in August. The location is ideal, just minutes from the airport, which made everything super convenient. I really enjoyed Miami Airport too. Plus, Yaine kept my room spotless every day without me even having to ask. Excellent service all around!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: The rooms are very large and the view over the water is lovely. There are several restaurants within walking distance. My sink was very slow draining and the room smelled funny, so next time I think I would try the H2 suites/Tru by Hilton, which is slightly closer to the restaurants and airport. Although they do have an airport shuttle, it doesn't start until 6:00 am. I wish it started at 5:30 to better accommodate all 7 am flights.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Hello we’ve really been enjoying our stay hospitality & customer service is excellent , Antony was so very patient , and helpful doing our check in we’re taking a cruise tomorrow So for any future cruise we plan to stay here. We enjoy having so many nice restaurants in walking distance, and the room was Very clean!! We appreciate that!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I was really disappointed to find there was no pool. It was not reflected in the price of the hotel. The rest of the hotel was ok. Clean room, comfortable my bed. Air conditioning was loud so we turned it off to enable us to sleep. Coffee was as always available. Check in staff were helpful and attentive. The breakfast was plentiful but got busy at about 8.30am. They replenished food quickly. There were no fruit platters like the photos. I can’t enthuse about the place as I was not told about the pool. Serious renovation and will not be ready for some time.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The accommodations were great! The room was clean and comfortable. The business and lounge areas were inviting. The staff was friendly and kind. I forgot an item in my room after check out. I contacted Alex on the 6th floor who contacted housekeeping and he returned my call quickly with good news explaining my item was recovered. A big Thank you to Alex. This Hampton will always be highly recommended to friends and business associates who visit Miami.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I would highly recommend this hotel! I traveled with my mom and we both agreed that the rooms are spacious and modern with great city views. Diamond helped us at check in and she was absolutely fantastic! Such a pleasure to deal with. She has a great personality and she’s fun to talk to!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The front staff was helpful and made sure we got the room we were looking for. Mirella at the bar took car of all of us and made sure to keep us fully entertained. She was a great addition to our visit. Never felt like we were left aline and if we had a question there was someone to help us out.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I checked in today and the hotel made a perfect welcome with everything from the welcome to the breakfast. It is the first hotel that I was so pleased with at the first entrance, especially Zorana Javonovic at the welcome was great………………….. …….

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We needed to stay one night before our family cruise. It was a pleasure to meet the front desk evening crew checked us in with a complimentary drink. I can’t remember the name of the first front desk associate on Friday evening. The next morning I came down to ask for some personal items. KELSEY was such a Great associate. Kelsey answered all my requests. I came back to front Kelsey made sure I was able to fine a Wellsfargo in the area. She went the extra mile to look it up on my phone along with making sure the Uber prices were reasonable. Kelsey very nice smile didn’t get upset about me answering questions. THANKS KELSEY! The hotel here was in a perfect place and conditions. When your front desk team can take the pressure off you and taking it the extra mile to make sure you’re at easy with a flow trip. The bartender Mirellce I believe I spelled it wrong INCREDIBLE bartender the drink she made the Tokyo tea she recommended was nothing but refreshing and she was very sweet and gave us all the attention we needed to make this trip more relaxing when checking in.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Todo fue bueno desde que llegamos, el trato del personal súper amable, nos regalaron una bebida, el desayuno puede variar un poco más pero es bueno (los wafles 😍), bonitas habitaciones, pero sobretodo el buen trato y amabilidad del personal y buena ubicación.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Was stunned at how rude the desk person was at check in. Acted like we were interrupting his evening. No mention of being a Hilton Gold member, no mention of wi-fi, or where free breakfast was. A terrible first impression. Now to the room. The loudest and worst AC of all time. Freight trains are quieter. At times it sounded like cats fighting. The room went back and forth between boiling hot and freezing cold. The bathroom was rundown, the fan broken and the sink slow to drain. Dirt around the shower. I expected much higher from a Hamtpon/Hilton. The area the hotel is located in is very nice, and the bed was comfortable. But I would never, ever, stay here again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I booked this hotel for my husband and I the night before our cruise. It turned out to be a perfect spot. We took the MetroRail train from MIA to Brickell and the station was 0.1 mile from the hotel which was very convenient and only cost $2.50 pp. It took about 30 minutes to get from MIA to the hotel on the train. Lobby is on the 6th floor and check in was quick and easy. The room was spacious and clean with modern features. Bed was comfy. Big walk in shower. Great in room products including shampoo, conditioner and body lotion in dispensers. Elevators were busy and it was sometimes difficult to get one especially on the weekend morning with all the cruisers that stay here so get going early or plan ahead to wait for an elevator down on the day of your check out. We waited about 20 minutes for one on the morning of our cruise. Continental breakfast was included and was on par with other Hampton Inn breakfasts. There is a nice seating area and lobby bar. We were each given a ticket for a free welcome drink at the bar which included beer and wine. Pool/jacuzzi was also on level 6 outside by the bar with some loungers and an outdoor seating area. It was quite busy on the evening we were there. Service was overall good but we didn't require much interaction with the staff during our stay. My one complaint was loud music and traffic from the street that could be heard from our room but it died down by 11PM. The Miami Metro Mover station is located near the train station 0.1 mile away and we took this to Bayside Park and back on the evening we were there. Very safe and convenient way to get around Downtown Miami if you don't have a car and don't want to spend big money on Uber/Lyft. It's also an easy walk to many shops and restaurants from this hotel. The hotel offers a cruise shuttle for $8 pp (cash to driver on day of departure) to Port Miami. Just ask about it when checking in and they will book your reservation. It was a large coach bus and you'll have to choose a departure time. I'd recommend booking an early time as the traffic to the port can get quite busy causing delays. We booked the earliest spot and had no trouble getting a seat, but again would recommend planning ahead for elevator delays and such as the bus did fill up quickly. It took nearly an hour to get to our cruise terminal due to traffic. Overall the shuttle was fine and we didn't have any issues getting to the port. Very pleased with this hotel as a pre-cruise option. Safe location with plenty to do and various transportation options. We will definitely consider this hotel again before our next cruise out of Miami!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This was a wonderful hotel and within walking distance to many wonderful restaurants. We stayed here with friends the night before embarking on a cruise. They had a shuttle to cruise port but not from the airport. The room was spacious and clean. I would definitely stay here again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Best hotel I’ve stayed in Miami , friendly , clean , offer breakfast , amazing location walking distance to everything. we loved it ! We only stayed at Hampton Inn for 2 days from the day we checked in people were extremely friendly and helpful. Carlos on 1st floor was so helpful and sweet answered every of my question and offered me his service at any time . We were very pleased with our stay , the hotel was extremely clean and smelled amazing . Walking distance to every restaurants / bar without grabbing uber was very convenient . The breakfast was delicious and we avoided spending extra money on food while there . I will stay again at Hampton Inn and planning my next trip to Miami soon , I know I will choose this hotel for my next Miami stay. Thank you to all staff at Hampton Inn @ Brickell location . Love you guys Joanna

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The breakfast was amazing. The best I've ever had at a hotel. So much variety and presented beautifully. Thanks to Luz and her team!! I felt very safe and comfortable at this hotel. Though in a very busy area you would never know that once you were inside. Everything looked and smelled clean. I'd definitely return to this hotel should the need arise to return to Miami. Thanks to the whole team!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Wow! By far the best Hampton Inn I’ve ever stayed at. The staff was incredibly pleasant and kind. The rooms were immaculate and completely modern. Beds were super comfortable and we loved the out door pool area! Will absolutely stay again!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Kelsey was super nice. She welcomed me and she speaks Spanish too. Plus she gave me cool water and bar tickets which I appreciated as a member. The hotel looks great. It is a convenient location and there is public transportation nearby with buses and the trolley. Carlos, on the first floor, was also great and took care of my luggage while I went on a city bus tour before heading to the airport on my last day. He was very nice! Alex at the front desk was helpful answering my questions too. I really enjoyed my stay and their hospitality. Mi cuarto me gustó mucho, era cómodo y bien limpio. El desayuno estaba delicioso. Quedé encantada. Me gustaría regresar con mi familia. Gracias a Kelsey, a Carlos y Alex por su amabilidad! I loved Calle Ocho in Little Havana and will definitely go back to visit Miami. Thanks.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: As a Hilton Diamond member I was especially pleased with receiving a free upgrade to a corner studio room without even asking. The room was large, clean, great decor and amenities. The best thing about the hotel was the location which was a combo of relatively quiet area, tons of restaurants close by, and one block to the metromover and metro rail.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Beautiful hotel surrounded by places to go and things to do. The service staff is one of the best even for a stay-cation! They treated my kids like one of us adults and took great care to make them feel included. I would come back again and again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Very nice, high-rise hotel close to restaurants and the metro mover. As a gold member, we were upgraded to a suite, and the room was quite large and quite comfortable and also very very clean. The staff were friendly, and the breakfast food was very good and the seating options at breakfast are also better than at any Hampton Inn we’ve been out before.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Todo muy lindo, el servicio del lobby muy bueno, el trato es demasiado bueno y son bastante educados, la comida muy rica, alguien que se destaco mucho fue una colaboradora llamada luz, atenta a nuestras solicitudes, fue demasiado amable, nos dio buenas recomendaciones y estaba pendiente de que todo estuviera en orden.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel está muy bien ubicado en la ciudad. Las habitaciones son bonitas y limpias. El desayuno es rico y tiene muchas opciones. Además, la atención al cliente es excelente, especialmente por parte de Ernest Batista, subgerente del hotel. El personal siempre está atento a ayudar y resolver dudas.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: We're repeat customers of this well located inn. We go to Marlins games but there's lots of those going on cruises or going to/from Miami International airport. Weekends are very very busy. Housekeeping does a good job and are very pleasant. Breakfasts need help-the powdered eggs are awful-but a standard. It seems they may start up with yesterdays leftovers and then change it up later. The lines for the 2 waffle makers gets lengthy depending on day/time. The absolute bright spot is Zoila, who stocks, cleans, helps out with different needs- all while smiling. Our favorite room is a 2 bedroom, 2 bath. It's large and terrific for small or large families or groups. all rooms have a full kitchen-full size refrigerator/freezer, microwave, dishwasher, plates and cutlery. The first thumbs down is that there are only 3 luggage carts. Definitely not enough most times. And uncaring guests who just stick it outside their room when they're done for someone else to hunt down. The other huge issue isn't necessarily the hotel but the litter strewn against the lagoon shore outside the patio and parking lots is disturbing. and with kayaks or other waves it really makes the lagoon less appealing.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: He was such a professional and kind. The shuttle arrived in a timely manner and was a comfortable trip to the hotel he was very knowledgeable and polite. The bus was comfortable and told us about breakfast also. Highly recommend the shuttle see

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Jorge was fantastic on my trip! I am so glad I stayed at homewood suites with my wife. We were here on a layover and we couldn’t be happier with our stay. I know that if we were to return to Miami when traveling, we would stay at homewood suites again. Our shuttle driver Jorge was amazing. He was on time and very hospitable.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Our drive to the airport was perfect!!! Jorge was right on time and was so kind! Our flight was at 10:30 and he was out front of our hotel right at 9 o clock. Took about 10 min to get to the airport and he got us there right on time. Speaks both English and Spanish 👍🏼

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Me gustó todo acerca de este hotel.La primera impresión fue con el Sr Jorge.El es el encargado del shuttle.Excelente servicio,muy amable y profesional.Comida,habitación ,y trato excelente.Las habitaciones mejor que en las fotos....

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Summary: We chose this hotel for an overnight stay before our cruise the next morning, and it served its purpose well. The hotel was clean, tidy, and recently updated. While it wasn’t extravagant, it offered all the essentials you’d expect from a Homewood Suites, which was just what we needed. With the suite layout, featuring separate rooms and a sleeper sofa, it would be an ideal spot for families needing a convenient overnight stay before or after a trip. PROS Cleanliness: The hotel was fresh, with well-maintained and tidy rooms that made for a comfortable stay. Free Breakfast: Complimentary breakfast was provided, which is always a nice perk, especially when you're in transit. Spacious Rooms: The rooms were spacious, offering plenty of space to relax, especially with the suite layout. This made it a great choice for families or anyone needing a bit more room. Convenient Location: The hotel’s location was perfect for our needs, with easy access to the airport and cruise port. CONS Communication Issues: We encountered significant communication challenges. Despite multiple attempts to call the hotel during our delayed flights to inform them of our late arrival, we received no answer. It wasn't until I messaged them through the app that we finally got a response. The next morning, we had to return to the airport to retrieve a checked bag that didn’t make it on our flight, only to find out that Delta had tried to contact the hotel multiple times to arrange an overnight drop-off, also without a response. This was particularly frustrating since I had informed the front desk that we were expecting a delivery. Improved communication is definitely needed. Bottled Water Policy: As a Hilton Honors member, I’ve always enjoyed complimentary bottled water at Hilton properties, but that wasn’t the case here. After a long, exhausting flight, we were thirsty and hungry, but when I asked for bottled water, I had to push the issue with the front desk attendant. He eventually provided it as a one-time exception, making it clear that this was not standard practice. This felt unnecessarily rigid and was a bit disappointing. Breakfast Area: The breakfast area was too small for the number of guests, leading to an overcrowded and chaotic experience. While the lobby was a decent size, the serving area felt cramped, making it difficult to access the hot food items. To make matters worse, the kitchen doors swung right into the crowd, adding to the congestion and creating an awkward situation for guests and staff alike. Overall: This is a quality hotel with minor, yet fixable, issues. We would stay here again for an overnight stop before or after a trip, but there are areas where the experience could be improved.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: El hotel está muy sucio, huele mal y hay cucarachas en los cuartos, porfavor no se hospeden aquí no vale la pena. Las camas están muy aguadas y las almohadas dan un poco de asco. En general es una mala experiencia este hotel. No vuelvo a repetir en esta cadena.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Hotel shuttle driver Jorge was welcoming and polite. He arrived to arrival pickup in a timely manner and was an excellent driver. Great service included in hotel booking. He also gave water which I was really happy to be offered. No stress needed to get to the hotel

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Shuttle service was excellent by Jorge the driver, proactive and kind person. The hotel is new and clean, very convenient location. The digital key helps a lot when you arrive and want to go straight to the room. I will come back in the future.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Un experiencia realmente gratificante, disfrute mucho mi estancia, me parece el sitio ideal para estar con la familia y el servicio prestado especialmente por la Srta Jennifer, muy dulce, amable y diligente, sin dudas lo recomiendo, los visitare pronto

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Omar was absolutely phenomenal... professional, efficient, and accommodating. We loved the view from our room. Loved that we were walking distance from shops & food. We will come back here every time we're in Miami. Thank you for hosting us for the second time in a week

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: After 3 days, Room was not cleaned on the “every other day” schedule as advised, and when queried upon a late night return, the front desk staff had no idea of the hotels housekeeping schedule nor could offer any assistance in making the rest of our stay better. Spoke with manager the following morning and was appalled by the attitude and tone received (even when attempting to extend our stay) New supervisor, Shereese, stepped in and was extremely friendly.
