We were packed and ready to move locations until we met her; and ended up extending for an additional 3 nights. This was after online attempts showed the hotel as ‘sold out’ and front desk basically shrugging us off. She searched and secured our booking. Thank you Shereese!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Omar on the reception desk provided outstanding service. Look forward to staying at this hotel again when near Miami airport. The hotel was very clean and comfortable, and very convenient to the airport and local restaurants. Also shout out to Linda for great service.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: I stayed here for one night prior to a cruise. The room was damp and all of our clothes were damp after spending the night. The shower was gross - dirty and the tub stopper was broken. I wouldn’t even give my kids a bath in it. Free breakfast was inedible - fake sausage and gross eggs. Very disappointed for the amount I paid for the room which was about $500. I would never stay here again and will never recommend this place to anyone. For the price, you can stay at a lot nicer places.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: I recently stayed at the Homewood Suites Miami/Blue Lagoon and was pleasantly surprised, earning it a solid four-star rating. The rooms were not only clean but also impressively spacious, providing a comfortable stay. The shuttle service was a highlight, with wonderful drivers offering convenient transportation to and from the airport. I did encounter an issue with the air conditioning in my initial room. It required a bit of persistence, having to contact the front desk twice, but they eventually resolved it by moving me to another room. Despite this minor hiccup, the overall experience was positive, and I would certainly consider staying here again.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Comfortable Hotel for a long stay. Great reception from Jeniffer at the front desk, always helping out, and looking for my best experience. The housekeeping team is always looking out for your necessities. You have a good breakfast, and happy hour on wednesday. The bbq is great also.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Omar was amazing and great person to deal with . Will Definitely come back to this hotel because of the service, and how clean the hotel was. Beds were great, was food great, right next to the water just a breathtaking time. Thanks once again, Omar.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Omar was so amazing and helpful. Each time I had questions, he answered them. I will return soon. Anytime I stay in Miami, I will stay here. Breakfast was great too. Bed slept amazing and very clean hotel. Much to do in the area with beautiful view

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: El hotel me brindo una experiencia maravillosa, el desayuno estaba increíble, todas las instalaciones limpias, en especial la atención de Jennifer en la recepción fue de gran ayuda, una señorita muy dulce y diligente, siempre presta para ayudarme en todos mis requerimientos, estoy muy agradecido por su atención.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Jorge es el mejor chauffeur en Miami. Nos espero con aire acondicionador y agua fría y además una muy buena charla!! Pudimos hablar de su origen y de lo nuestro mientras fuimos yendo al hotel. Siempre lo recomendaría para cualquier visitante a Miami

El hotel se encuentra al lado del mar con unas vistas preciosas y buena ubicación. La habitación me encantó con todo tipo de detalles y el personal muy amable. Especialmente Johanna que fue muy servicial en el desayuno.

El hotel está muy cerca del aeropuerto y, sin embargo no molesta el ruido de los aviones. Las habitaciones son amplias muy cómodas. El desayuno, muy completo, incluyendo verdura y fruta que no es muy normal en los hoteles, principalmente en EEUU. El trato, excepcional. Nuestra mesa la atendió Johana y fue especialmente agradable y atenta.
Excelente servicio se Mayra en el restaurant Toro Toro del hotel

La estancia fué genial,el desayuno buenísimo y la atención de Johana fué espectacular, simpática,amable y una gran profesional,fué un gusto que nos atendiera juntos con su compañero Mike,salimos encantados,muy recomendable. Volveremos a repetir,gracias!
Excelente Club 29. Alberto y Nhu Excelente atención. MUY AMABLES !!!! Muy confortable. Muy dispuestos. Comida y bebidas de calidad. Muy satisfecha.
Excelente hotel, limpieza, organizado, buen ambiente, personal simpático dinámico digno de la zona en la cual se encuentra

Luego de reclamar por ciertos servicios no dados, tuve in encuentro con la gerente de Relacion con los huéspedes, donde me dio las explicaciones de cada tema y me reconoció un crédito debido a los problemas que tuve. Debo decir que lo importante de este hotel es la atencion en parte del personal.

todo estuvo genial como siempre , pero el ultimo día no arreglaron la habitación. Por otro lado creo que debería de haber opciones mas económicas en el desayuno., Pagar 60 dólares por desayunar una tostada o comer un bol de fruta es exagerado

Hotel muy bien ubicado para pasear, cerca del railway y con unas instalaciones fantásticas, desde el Gimnasio hasta el propio restaurante, Toro Toro, las camas muy cómodas y las habitaciones con unas vistas impresionantes, lo único que no nos convencio fue la piscina, por su ubicación gran parte del dia se encuentra a la sombra.

Excelente atención por parte de personal, quiero destacar a Alberto que nos atendió siempre a mi abuelo y a mi con mucha amabilidad y buena dispoción. Instalaciones y comodidades del hotel de lujo. 100% recomendado.

¡El hotel tiene una calidad buenísima en todos los aspectos! Pero sobre todo y lo más importante en el factor humano, sus trabajadores son excelentes con un trato exquisito. ¡Especial mención a Pablo en la recepción y en el desayuno a Guillermo y Mayra! Me los llevaría a casa si pudiera, para tenerlos cerca, muchas gracias por todo de todo corazón ¡me habéis hecho sentir cómo en casa!

Location is great near to shopping areas like Bayside. Walking distance to Gesu Catholic Church had time to attend mass at this gorgeous church.? Intercontinental was spotless with friendly, courteous and professional staff!
Excelent hotel, very pleasant stay. Rooms very comfortable and very good service. The view from the room was great and the food and the attention from the business lounge was top class
Excelente servicio de valet parking de Rayner Oscar y Juan, rápidos y atentos . Excelente atención en recepción de Marcial muy amable

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The bartenders at the InterContinental Miami are outstanding! Friendly, attentive, and incredibly skilled at their craft. Drinks were perfectly mixed, beautifully presented, and always served with a smile. Gabby, Edgar, Stephanie and Roy made us feel welcome from the moment we sat down. Easily the best bar experience we’ve had in Miami — highly recommend!
Hotel was excellent and so was the location Perfect in every way Rooms very spacious and beds superb Staff extremely helpful and friendly This hotel has everything you desire

My husband and I arrived in Miami after an overnight flight. We checked into the hotel early and wanted to get some rest, but the housekeeping staff repeatedly tried to open my door (which we had locked), making a lot of noise. After I responded, they stopped trying. However, 20 minutes later, another staff member tried to open our door again, wanting to check and refill the drinks in the refrigerator. Their noise ruined our entire morning. It was a terrible experience, I think the guests can't rest in the morning, the housekeeping work so loudly.

The lounge is an absolute highlight of the hotel stay. The views are stunning, offering the perfect backdrop whether you’re starting the day with breakfast or winding down in the evening. Service throughout was impeccable – warm, attentive, and professional without ever being intrusive. A special mention to Patricia, who made us feel especially welcome and ensured everything was perfect during our visits. The food choices are excellent, and the happy hour with complimentary drinks between 5–7pm is a real treat. Breakfast in the lounge is also lovely, with plenty of variety and a relaxed atmosphere. I’d highly recommend booking a club lounge room. The extra cost is more than worth it for the amenities, comfort, and overall experience. It really elevated our stay.

Location and a nice hotel with great views. Found the location to stay before a cruise can't be beat. A walking distance to many restaurants and shops as well as a ferris wheel. Nice rooms with great views/. The doorman welcomed us in on arrival. There is a resort fee we were not informed about. Rooftop pool, bar and viewing area.
Una muy buena estadía, la atención del personal excelente. La habitación muy cómoda, limpia y con buena vista al mar. Ubicación ideal para moverse en el downtown de Miami

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente en todo, su servicio de desayuno exquisito, la señora Luz nos atendió de una forma excepcional. Lo que le.requerimos lo atiende con amabilidad, muy buena limpieza, muy tranquilo, un ambiente para estar en familia.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente hotel. El personal muy atento, desayuno variado, muy limpio, accesible a comer en áreas cercanas caminado. Facil para transportación, silencioso, ir de compara. Será mi primera opción cuando regrese.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: An amazing hotel. Better than any Hampton I’ve ever stayed in. Beautiful lobby, seining pool And hot tub. Staff is super-friendly and helpful. Cleaning staff was on top of everything. Location is amazing. Parking is easy and safe. You can eat at a different restaurant every meal for a week at a different place. The restaurants on the premises are so good you don’t have to leave. I’ll be back.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The woman who worked the night shift on Nov 4&5 gave outstanding service. Renewed my wet towels after the pool/hot tub and was extremely friendly and went above and beyond to make sure that we were satisfied with everything we needed

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The hotel facility was located in a great location near a variety of restaurants, grocery stores, and other shops. Very safe location. The hotel staff was super professional and accommodating. Last but not least the room was spacious and very clean. I highly recommend this location.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Usamos el Hampton Inn 2 noches antes de nuestro crucero. La ubicación excelente así como las instalaciones y el personal. Nos arrepentimos nos habernos quedado ahí al regreso del crucero. Va a ser nuestro hotel de elección ahora en adelante. Recomendado para familias y queda cerquita una de una gran variedad de restaurantes.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Nos encantó. Personal todos muy atentos , Ernesto nos ayudo con nuestras dudas. Por la tarde happy hour , atendidos por Rosana que fue muy atenta. Muy buena ubicación . A 5 minutos de parada Brickell,Publix, restaurantes y galería comercial ,con importantes áreas.Habitacion amplia ,camas grandes y muy cómodas.Desayuno incluido .Café y té de cortesía. Llegamos temprano y nos permitieron el ingreso antes .

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente trato del personal de recepcion. Las habitaciones están impecables. La piscina y el Jacuzzi muy agradables y 24hs!! La limpieza de toda la habitación se nota y prestan atención a todos los detalles. Excelente relación de costo beneficio.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente hotel, la ubicacion en el downtown de Miami y muy cerca de muchos puntos de interes asi como Malls. Fue todo muy comodo y disfrute mucho del servicio y la atencion del hotel. Regresaria al 200% y muy recomendando.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel esta muy bien ubicado, al lado de bares y restaurantes. Es la segunda vez que me hospedo alli. Las habitaciones amplias, modernas y muy bonitas. El desayuno muy completo y dicen que cierran a las 10:00am pero te esperan hasta mas de 10:30am

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: My overall experience was excellent! I highly recommend this hotel. The cleanliness and accommodations exceeded my expectations. Although, there were a minor issue with the A/C unit at the Lobby, my stay was not impacted.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El Hotel tiene todo lo que uno puede pedir (hasta laundry), en el centro de todo lo qué pasa en Brickell. Bajando tiene restaurantes y shopping en un radio de 300 metros todo al alcance. Las tentadoras de autos también quedan cerca y obviamente todas las oficinas a mano. El servicio del personal es otro punto a favor, las habitaciones impecables y renovadas. Muy recomendable para una estadía de negocios. Gracias.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Great customer service from Arnold on the front desk who seamlessly dealt with everything we needed for a fun stay He was a pleasure to deal and had a wicked sense of humor Would definitely stay again

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: If you going on a cruise or parking in Miami then this hotel is perfect. Hotel is clean, staff helpful and professional. Breakfast is ideal and quick. Great location for nice restaurants and bars also

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Un excelente opción, nos sorprendió, obviamente dentro de lo que es y de las tarifas económicas que tiene, llegamos en un vuelo muy temprano a la mañana y gracias a la atención de Deidre que nos consiguió una habitación que nos permitió acceder mucho antes del horario de check in aparte de ofrecernos un upgrade y ya desde el minuto 1 estábamos teniendo una excelente experiencia que a veces no se recibe de hoteles de mayor categoría, las dimensiones de la suite eran muy buenas con muchísimo espacio de guardado, y la limpieza fue muy buena y diaria así como los amenities que ofrecían también de mayor calidad a la que te podrías esperar con estas tarifas, TIP lo de la limpieza te lo tienen que cargar cuando haces el check In, así ya saben que queres que la realicen todos los días, si tiene faltantes de servicios que están asociados a la categoría del hotel, como el tener room service o algún restaurant tarde a la noche para poder cenar, la piscina es pequeña pero no la utilizamos así que tampoco fue un inconveniente para nosotros. Respecto de la zona es buenísima también si quieres estar en el centro de Brickel que era lo que buscábamos en esta oportunidad, es un corto viaje desde el aeropuerto y es una zona llena de restaurantes, lugares de compras y shopping y hasta cerca de una estación de tren y del metromover, lo recomiendo totalmente en base a nuestra experiencia y volvería a hospedarme.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente ubicacion, trato profesional y amable por parte de todo el personal, tienes desayuno incluido pero no muy variado, esta la piscina con una vista hermosa para el atardecer, tienes restaurantes y locales cerca, se duerme muy bien, no es ruidoso y almohadas buenas

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: From check-inn (thank you Nikki — you’re awesome!) to checkout, my experience was nothing but rave reviews. The room was perfect. The area perfect. And bonus, right around the corner is (now) the best pizza place I’ve EVER experienced! piolausa.com If you love pizza, put this on your bucket list. As a matter of fact? Nikki recommended it…so I ordered another large pizza to bring back to her and her colleagues to enjoy!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: My family and I have stayed here on 3 separate occasions. Each time we have found the hotel staff to be professional, courteous and kind. The facility is clean and well maintained. The rooms we have stayed in were not just clean but smelled clean. The flooring was not carpet in the rooms and the rooms were recently updated. Luz was taking care of the morning breakfast area and she did a wonderful job. Based on our positive experiences, I would definitely recommend and should our travels bring us to the Miami area again, I would definitely stay here. Thank you so much for our positive experiences.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Very friendly and helpful staff, nice big room, nice common areas and a good breakfast included, very comfy large bed, ideal pre cruise stay for us, very good Wi-Fi, nice restaurants at the bottom of the building lots of others within walking distance,. Located in a nice vibrant safe area

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: La atencion de Anna en recepcion fue increible siempre amable y con una sonrisa nos dio una habitacion excelente Nos vamos con muchas ganas de regresar El hotel muy limpio y excelente ubicación Realmente es muy recomendable Todos muy amable Ana nos dio suguerencia que sirvieron mucho para nuesta vista

We have stayed at the Intercontinental Miami numerous times and have always had an excellent experience. Unfortunately our flight departed late from Israel and we missed our connecting flight to Miami. I called to let the hotel know we would be arriving the next day. We ended up staying at the Intercontinental Barclay in NYC. When we arrived the next day, we learned that our message did not get to the night manager and we were considered a “no show”. I was concerned that our entire reservation was cancelled. The most kind and professional woman who checked us in, was very apologetic and reassured me they had a room for us. So from my standpoint, all was well. Because we have stayed at the hotel many times, she recognised us and said she liked to speak to a manager to bring a remedy to the situation. My thoughts were as long as you have a room all is good. We received a $100 food credit and an unbelievable beautiful suite from the manager. So nice and totally not expected from us. We had a wonderful stay as always; in fact a great stay in such a marvellous room. The bell men were fantastic as we as the valets. Everyone was so pleasant! Thank you Pablo you treated us so much better than we could have ever imagined. Fantastic stay, we will see you next month. Much appreciation!
Un hotel en donde su precio vale la pena por la calidad de todo, las habitaciones, las camas, el restaurante, la comida, el spa, todo lo vale.
Gran hotel. Excelente servicio. Funciona todo. Excelentes comodidades como spa, gimnasio y piscina. La atención del personal es muy buena.
Beautiful clean room with partial view of bay, very comfortable king bed, and loved tge bathroom with the huge shower, cloth rob and slippers. Perfect walking distance to Bayshore.

Gran hotel en dimensiones y calidad como suelen ser los de la cadena. Habitación con mobiliario moderno, cama amplia y confortable. Silenciosa con escritorio cómodo. Lavabo muy amplio. Gimnasio aceptable y piscina exterior. El hotel dispone de restaurantes. Personal muy amable.
Excelente la calidez del servicio, todo limpio, la vista en fin Excelente. Me volveria a quedar aqui. Me senti como una reina ojala y ubiera estado mas. La fecha que estube fue mayo 2022.

Great location. Rooms were very nice and well appointed. Close location to the Port of Miami and a short 20 min ride to MIA. The front desk and baggage guys were all very welcoming and helpful. The concierge desk was available in the lobby and just a few steps next to the front and baggage & valet desks. There lobby was grand and had plenty of space and seating if you wanted to sit and enjoy a cocktail with friends. There was a nice latin cuisine restaurant that participated in Miami Spice on site if you didn't want to go away from the hotel for dining or a night cap. Another nicety - the restaurant had an open concept. It wasn't totally closed off so the lobby felt like an extension of the restaurant. On the weekends there was a live DJ so you could sit in the lobby and share cocktails and conversation with friends. Although the lobby was very busy, I was pleasantly surprised that that noise and people traffic did not transfer to the room floors, so it made for a peaceful night's sleep. Watch out for the in-room snack/drink bar - you pick it up you buy it! Overall, my stay was wonderful and I definitely would recommend and stay again.

Nos encanto el hotel, todo el personal muy amable, la limpieza impecable, las habitaciones amplias y cómodas, fácil para llegar al aeropuerto y al puerto. La comida del restaurante las entradas que probamos súper ricas, la comida regular, nos gusto que tienen una botella de agua rellenable por un monto bien asequible, en general la experiencia fue muy buena.

Mi experiencia en el hotel buenisima super atentos, limpio, la habitación cómoda y bonita. En el desayuno y cena riquísimo y la atención en especial de Matheus y Alberto excelente pero en general la de todas las personas son super amables y atentos siempre dispuesto a ayudarte. En resumen 100% recomendado

Es un hotel excelente desde el front desk Marcial, de la recepción, hasta las personas del Vip lounge: Alvaro y Jacqueline. Nos recibieron muy bien, amables y serviciales. También housekeeping es excelente del.piso 29. Por eso seguimos visitando este hotel. Pedro Fuentes, Chile
El servicio excelente, el desayuno es completo y rico. Éramos una familia de 10 y todo estuvo super bien. Muy amable Eliana
Todo excelente! Invitados a volver! En el desayuno fuimos atendidos por Eliana, una persona muy linda, cálida que nos hizo sentir apreciados! Muchas gracias por todo!

Muy feliz con mi primera experiencia en International Miami, y comprometida de por vida por permanencer con ellos, el equipo muy amables y muy limpios como Olvidar a Alvaro y su equipo siempre con una atención de primera,. Muchas gracias International Miami
Todo super bien en nuestra estadía. Quiero destacar el servicio en el restaurante Olé que ha sido excelente, gracias a Yamara por todas sus atenciones. La comida riquísima.

El hotel es muy bueno pero podrían mejorar un poco el extractor de olores de mi baño no servía y al salir nos querían cobrar los desayunos que estaban incluidos, lo demás excelente comida del desayuno y servicio 100 puntos, las personas que reciben maletas excelentes.

Como siempre mi opinión es óptima. La recepción por el personal de puerta, excelente, amables y cariñosos. En el counter estaba todo listo conforme a mi reserva. Eduardo Rossello, extraordinario. La habitación 3402, perfecta. El Club Lounge del piso 29 atendido por Alberto, Helena, Jaqueline, Matheus y otras personas tambien formidable. Desayunos, comidas inmejorables. Y todos muy amables y amistosos. Conclusión, la nota máxima. Todo muy bueno

Realmente el servicio excelente! Desde que hicimos el ingreso al hotel se siente un servicio personalizado. Un impecable cuidado en la limpieza y aseo de las habitaciones En el Club Lounge, un espacio muy cómodo para comer com una hermosa vista de Miami, se encuentra Alberto, Jaquelin y Matheus quienes fueron muy atentos y amables en cada una de nuestras comidas. Muy agradable conocerlos y compartir conversaciones Muchas gracias!!

Fabiola Cofre nos atendió estupendo como Hostess en el restaurant Toro Toro, muy amorosa y dispuesta a que todo salga muy bien. Al igual que Edgar que nos atendió como mesero en el restaurant, muy bien atendidos, servicio espectacular. Muy recomendado

Un ambiente muy acogedor y tranquilo para una buena comida. El personal es muy amable y atento, siempre con una hermosa sonrisa. Gracias Helena y Jackeline por el bonito trabajo que hacen todos los días para hacer que cada invitado se sienta especial...

Amazing stay! Probably nicest hotel I have stayed at. Small touches like dental "kit' and nice options of food and drink in the room, electric powered backout curtains, easy and quick check out process. Excellent food and drinks and overall excellent service. Next time I am in Miami would recommend Intercontinental!

The hotel is located not very far from the city center, about a 10–15 minute walk from the NBA arena, which is very convenient. The rooms are clean and comfortable, with a nice view of the city or possibly the ocean. The hotel also has a good pool and fitness area. Breakfast was quite expensive and fairly simple, which could be improved. Overall, a good stay with a nice location and solid facilities.

Outstanding hotel, location can not be matched by anyone. Awesome customer service especially by Lio, great food & drink as I always stay at Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay when taking a cruise out of Miami. Thank you for making me feel like family.

Stayed here for a few nights pre-cruise. Very convenient location to the port and the Bayside area (via Lyft, we didn’t have a car). Grocery store within walking distance for last minute essentials. Staff at desk was very friendly. Beautiful view from our balcony. Pool looked nice but the weather prevented us from enjoying it. Long wait for elevators in the morning, normal for a high rise, but just plan accordingly. We ate at the on-site restaurant twice and enjoyed it. Convenient with a good the atmosphere, good food and good service. A bit pricy, as is most stuff in Miami. The only negative thing is that we missed that there was a daily resort charge. We booked/prepaid in full, or so we thought. Upon arrival there was an additional charge of $35/day as a resort charge. It included use of the pool (couldn’t use due to weather), bicycle rental (couldn’t use due to weather), and WiFi (didn’t need). We were already disappointed to have to pay this additional fee, but the fact that we didn’t benefit from it, was frustrating. Upon checkout the desk staff did allow us to use half of each day’s charge as a credit against our meals in the on-site restaurant. They made it sound like it was something special, but I suspect that they offer that as an option to all guests. In the end it wasn’t enough to turn us off to the place, but definitely something to watch for in the future.
Fanny, con profesionalidad, cercanía y amabilidad, nos ha atendido de maravilla.
Fani ha sido una camarera súper encantadora. No ha podido ser más atenta ni más agradable
Thank you Yazdi for your excellent service and help throughout our stay!

Nice stay at a fun property. Second time staying here. We have a cruise out of Miami and really enjoy staying here. Very close to cruise ships and you fell like a baller when you stay here. Nice rides out in the parking lot. Ate breakfast at the restaurant and had one of the best servers ever. Aurea went out of her way to make sure we had a great experience. Easily one of the best servers I’ve ever had and I eat out a lot. This alone would be a reason to return here but staff is great and really enjoy staying here. My only complaint would be drink prices are very expensive but this is coming from a guy in Ohio. $40 a drink is a little high to me but we are just traveling through and paid it. Still, a great trip. See you next year!
Service was great! Awesome hotel with amazing service. Aurea at the restaurant provided the best service ever! Always pleasant and great to talk to. Love her.
El servicio en el desayuno de Áurea expectacular.
Todo fue perfecto la atención del equipo humano fue fantástico, Áurea nos atendió de maravilla es una persona muy atenta y servicial en todo momento de la interacción
Had a wonderful stay, and really enjoyed our breakfast. Aurea was our server and was absolutely amazing!!

Very nice breakfast buffet. Staff was very very helpful. Security man yazdi helped out of the way . One gate keeper was very very nice and helped me getting a cab at very critical time . Elderly man. Thanks and kind Regards. Capt. Ajit

Chad with Security found my phone case I lost when leaving the hotel. He called me as we gave up looking for it and had just left in our Uber. Our driver made a U-turn and I was able to meet Chad in the lobby where he haded me my case, credit cards and $$ with nothing missing. Thank you Chad.
Dead on arrival. This place is void of customer service. The desk staff require training. If not replaced with staff that have a clue.

Excelente servicio en el buffet del desayuno, sobre todo de la mano de Aura, siempre atenta a cada detalle. Las mañanas comienzan distinta si pasas por el desayuno y tienes la suerte de que Aura sea tu camarera.
Áurea nos atendió de manera sensacional en el restaurante. Es muy amable y excedió nuestras expectativas. Muchas gracias!
Muy buena atención de Fanny en el desayuno. Hermoso como se vieron los fuegos artificiales de Año Nuevo! Excelente servicio al huésped.

La atención de Fanny en el salón VIP llamado M fue excelente . Siempre atenta a las necesidades de los clientes , con una enorme sonrisa . Muy amable al resolver dudas que tenemos como visitantes de Miami .
Bonita vista, bien ubicado, todo limpio y ordenado; el personal hispano muy amable en su trato sobre todo Áurea, nuestra mesera en el restaurante

I recently stayed at the Marriott Biscayne Bay and was truly impressed by the exceptional service provided by Aurea during breakfast. She was friendly, attentive, and went beyond her duties by offering menu alternatives and great suggestions on things to do in the city. My guests were delighted with her warm and thoughtful service. Thank you, Aurea, for making our experience memorable! I look forward to returning.

Una muy linda experiencia, un hotel cerca de todo, super cómodo, pero lo que más me gustó es la atención personalizada del personal, desde que llegas hasta que te retiras. Palabras mayores para Bertha Crucet, directora de ventas y marketing que nos atendió super bien y también quiero destacar a Fanny del M CLUB, que nos contó muchísimas cosas lindas del hotel y nos atendió de maravilla. Sin duda un hotel que volvería siempre.
Avrea was our server. She was wonderful. Very nice and attentive. She took the extra tine and effort to make our experience exceptional. A true delight.
Excelente servicio al cliente de la señora Aurea en el restaurante. Muchas gracias por su amabilidad. El desayuno estuvo muy bien.
I went with my family and we had an excellent experience, the service was outstanding and we felt very well cared for!!❤️

Outstanding service from Andrea at the lounge Club. Andrea always welcomes customers with a smile and always paying attention to details to make us feel satisfied. It’s always a pleasure to have such great service. Thank you Andrea !

The Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay is an amazing hotel. I had the pleasure of staying there for two days and the staff was amazing, as was the leadership was amazing, and very visible on property. The hotel has beautiful views and has undergone in amazing renovation. So if you’re looking for a hotel in the Miami area, for business or pleasure, please be sure to check out Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay. You will be glad you did. And also stop by the M Club and say hi to Fanny, whose positive and joyful energy is contagious. ✌🏻🌻
Love the eco-friendly bath amenities, front desk desk staff, they actually changed towels after the first night! Nicest surprise was a functioning Peloton bike in the fitness center.

Indrani at the front desk provided exceptional customer service. The property is beautiful newly renovated, ideal downtown location and the go to stay spot for my family. Indrani made sure to greet the family with a smile, explained the property and amenities. She is a great ambassador for Marriott.
It was exceptionally great. The rooms are clean and the staff are amazing. The customer service in the restaurants are too their. Audrea the waitress in the morning was incredible. I would recommend
Amazing hotel and restaurant experience. Aurea and Frank are amazing servers at Gold Coast Kitchen. Delicious food! The hotel was clean and the staff very friendly. The views are beautiful!!!!

Aurea nos atendió muy bonito, siempre amable y servicial. Yo desayune huevito al gusto muy rico. El resto de mi familia salió encantada con sus benedictinos, sandwiches y la fruta. Excelente también el buffet para los menores de 12 sale excelente precio. No se tardo en venir la comida.

Bonito hotel y excelente atención.Se me quedaron los zapatos de mi niña y llame al hotel para recuperarlos y dos personas maravillosas , llamadas Yazdy y Robert hocieron facil y rapida la devolucion para mi, gracias por tan rápido y efectivo servicio

Todo excelente excepto la presión del agua de la ducha, que para un hotel de esta categoría debería ser más fuerte. Muy buena vista desde el piso 18. Una mención especial para YAZDI y JEAN por su dedicación y hamabilidad con el rastreo y entrega de un envío. Saludos Diego

Maravilloso el servicio, caballeros y muy atentos , Angel y Thomas, realmente con un servicio de personas tan gentiles y muy interesadas en complacer todas las expectativas del cliente, sin duda REGRESARÍA! Wonderful service, gentlemen and very attentive, Angel and Thomas, truly with a service of people so kind and very interested in satisfying all the client's expectations, I would definitely return!

Beautiful newly renovated rooms overlooking the bay and pool. Breakfast was delicious in our host Andrea in the M club was very helpful and accommodating. She does a great job making people feel special for being part of the Bonvoy, elite, keeping things stocked up and willing to help!

Excelente hotel, Ubicación maravillosa !! La vista fantástica a Biscayne bay !! Excelente atención de todo el equipo y Isabella la hostess nos apoyó mucho!! muy amable y buena atención ! Felicitaciones . !!! Volveremos pronto ! Mucho que conocer en esta bella ciudad.

We had a great stay at the Biscayne Bay Marriott during the Miami Boat Show. After working the show all day, it was very convenient and relaxing. I had an amazon package delivered during the show and that process was super easy. Now that I am home, I placed another amazon order, and forgot to change the shipping address so my package went to the hotel. I spoke with Xavier Spaniel in Loss Prevention and not only was he kind and friendly but extremely helpful in getting my packages sent to me. Top notch customer service.

I am writing this review as honest as I can. I believe it's my responsibility to share the incompetence that we met in Miami during our stay at this hotel. Now, this is supposed to be a nice and luxury hotel located in the center of Miami. It was expensive. Way overpriced compared to the quality and service. Our family went on a 7-day vacation and three rooms at this hotel was around $9000. That is a lot of money for a standard hotel. I emailed the hotel in advance and asked if it would be possible to pay in advance since it's a large sum and didn't want to have problems with our European credit cards. That was not possible. We had to pay upon checkout although they would reserve a certain amount at check-in as a precaution. When we checked in, we wanted to know the total price, but the first receptionist couldn't tell us the exact amount due to the complicated calculation of taxes. Thats what he actually said when we checked in. They made their reservations for the money and told us we would settle all when we checked out. Then the problems started. Two out of the three rooms, they started to charge an additional $200-300 per day per room. Without telling us. Just more reservations on our cards. On day for, the reserved money was actually withdrawn on our cards for around $1600. And they made another reservation. Again, without telling us. We spent a lot of time at the front desk and talked to senior manager MS. At first, she told us that the accounting department made a mistake. Only later to tell us that it's completely normal to charge the cards once the amount exceeds $1600. So, I guess we are the first ever in history to stay more than three days, since not even the senior manager knew about this. Even after this, they tried to charge one credit card about 5 times in one day the amount of $300. The credit card company just blocked the hotel due to all the suspicious activity. When we finally checked out, they "accidentally" charged one room on the completely wrong credit card. So, we had to keep in contact and spend a lot of time to fix these issues. Which we had to fix ourselves since the hotel did not. We were given the business card for the senior manager MS, which phone number did NOT work. The last day we were offered M-club privileges and free breakfast as an apology. The M-club is the biggest joke i have ever seen. Some free cheap drinks and the driest sandwich ever. Even worse than airplane meals. Stay away. The rest of the hotel is average. The rooms are nice but standard. Nothing special. The pool is small, and you have to be down early to make sure you get a spot. The appropriate price according to the standards would be around $100/night. Not $500. Way overpriced. So, what was supposed to be a nice relaxing vacation, was worsened by the hotel experience. I have stayed in several other US (and European) cities, but this is the worst I have ever experienced. No transparency. The staff was incompetent. Just came up with excuses but didn't know what the f*ck was actually happening. It caused stress to keep overcharging our credit cards. We spent too much time at the reception tried to solve things that should have been done the right way to start with. We will never stay at a Marriot hotel ever again. I hope this review warns other and hopefully they will choose more wisely. The only way to make this good again is to refund the whole stay. That's how terrible and unprofessional the whole thing was. Regards

great views, comfortable room, recently updated, no carpet thus no mold smells, walking distance to publix, nice lounge on lobby floor, fridge in room, parking available but pricey note not a lot of restaurants nearby, but check out the happy hour at casablanca next door

This property is located very close to downtown and is right next to the water. Great views! The staff were super friendly, and want to specifically call out Mr.Yazdi Patel who helped out with our shipping logistics (we were there for a conference). Great facilities - superb outdoor pool and bar area and a pretty good gym. The gym can get crowded at times. I wouldn't recommend the restaurant if you are a vegetarian..barring a couple of sides they have nothing. And pricey too! Overall very happy with my stay.

I am extremely disappointed with my stay at the Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay. First of all, the cleanliness was unacceptable. Despite being there for several days, our room was never cleaned. No fresh towels, no bed-making, nothing! It's baffling how a hotel of this supposed caliber can overlook such basic services. To make matters worse, we had specifically booked a room for our anniversary, and to our surprise, we were given a room with a queen bed instead of a king, as requested. It was extremely frustrating, especially when we were looking forward to a special experience. When we addressed it with the staff, the response was lackluster, and they didn't seem to care at all about fixing the issue. And let’s talk about customer service – it was absolutely horrible. The staff seemed uninterested, unhelpful, and honestly just rude. It's one thing for a hotel to fall short on amenities, but when the staff adds to the frustration, it’s a dealbreaker. All in all, this hotel was a huge disappointment, and I won’t be returning. There are plenty of other places in Miami that actually know how to treat their guests. Avoid this place if you can!

This is the worst marriott ever !! This place has the worst customer service ! Didn’t clean our rooms and just terrible every thing ! I would never stay here again ! Smells like air freshener everywhere ! Never ever stay here ! Would never ever pay this amount for this kind of customer service

This is a beautiful hotel… a bit pricey for us, but probably worth the sense of security and the comfort of the room we stayed in. If we had stayed longer (and it were a bit warmer), I would have enjoyed the pool and Hot Tub! Great location with many dining options nearby. The rooms are very clean and spacious, with phenomenal views … we were on the 24th floor overlooking the Port of Miami. I would highly recommend this hotel.

El hotel muy bueno las habitaciones recién remodeladas y la ubicación también es muy buena así como las vistas del balcón de la habitacion Excelente atención en especial por parte de Fanny en el restaurante The Club muy amable y atenta durante toda la estancia sin duda regresamos a este hotel

Nicely appointed rooms, but pool area too small and food definitely not worth the prices. Location is great and within walking distance of many food options and grocery store. Views good on the east & southeast sides. Paid for a bay/partial bay view and they first gave us a pool view with a small bay view for the first night which was not good. They then moved us for the next 2 nights and we loved the views then

My husband is a platinum member for life with Marriott. We always enjoy our stay with Marriott. Until now! The dining prices are outrageous. The concierge food is limited and awful. The room and beds are ok. We are sitting by the pool which is not impressive. The staff is unable to serve any food or drink.due to staffing issues. VERY DISAPPOINTED! WE WON'T BE BACK! LINDA GRIFFITH HILTON HEAD SC

I'm a loyal Marriott customer, but I will never stay here again. I don't like to be scammed. The hotel is nothing special; however, the location is good. The housekeeping staff were great, but all the others could care less. The problem I have is I don't like getting the shaft at the front desk when it's too late to do anything. They tell you upon check-in that a mandatory $35 per day resort fee is non-refundable. Add that to the already high room cost for what you get, and IT's NOT WORTH IT! It's just a way to post fake prices and then gouge you. Stay at the Doubletree next door or any of the AirBNB's nearby!

The Hotel is beautiful, great location, room is nice. Unfortunately, the service is lackluster. I stayed at the Marriott for 7 days and out of the 10 times I called the front desk, they answered the phone once. This was at different times of the day, so no, the staff wasn't busy checking people in. Sometimes the phone rang for minutes with no answer. V annoying. What was more disappointing is the lack of concern Marriott Biscayne has for customers and their safety. My rental car was broken in to and I had $5,000 worth of personal items stolen. My car was parked in the hotel garage which has a security gate and you must go up a ramp to access it. Initially, Rey, head of security had let me know that no one had accessed my car. Upon double-checking he did confirm someone appeared to break-in and walked away with my valuables. This was extremely unsettling as you can imagine. The hotel claimed no responsibility & offered to show local PD security footage, if subpoenaed. I never spoke with a manager for the property nor did they ever reach out. Where is the customer service?

We orded some packages from Amazon. The delivery service was very good. Mr Yazdi Patel helped us very professional and kind. Thank you for the excellent service. This Marriott location is the best, whenever traveling on a cruiseship, we recommend Marriot at Bayshore.

I had a great experience at this hotel for a conference I attended 9/17-9/18. My room was perfect with an excellent water view. I did lose my wallet one morning during breakfast and Tommy Hamilton at the restaurant and Yazdi in security were gracious and honest in securing my wallet and returning it to me! Thank you both so much!!

Yazdi P and the security team came through in a massive way for me this stay! I accidentally left some valuable bags in the parking garage and his team gathered my belongings and held them safely until I returned. Really great feeling on being able to trust people doing the right thing. He and his team along with Kelly at the front desk were LIFE SAVERS. Huge kudos to them and I will be returning on business trips in the future.

Stayed here for a couple of days. Hotel room was ok. Walls are thin and you can hear noisy neighbouring rooms. Badly designed bathroom. We far too close to shower glass. Shower bottles are wall mounted at the end you shower at so you can't stand under the shower without hitting the bottles. Nice views over the bay. Frustrating that the hotel still uses single use plastics for drinks at the pool. In this day we should be reusable plastic vessels. No water in room. Asked for couple of bottles of water and was billed almost 30 dollars. As a platinum member water is usually complimentary at other Marriott resorts. Checkout was underwhelming. Colleague was busy talking to someone else. I said we're checking out. He simply said whether I need a printed receipt. No how was your stay, thank you for staying etc.

Great stay updated room to half bay and half city view for 60$ to get in the room at 11:00 very nice and newly renovated Front desk very helpful only downside is the 35 $ you have to spend at the hotel ………………….,.,,,,……………………..,,,,..,,,,,,,,,,

The entire stay and service was a 10/10! The concierge, valet, housekeeping, and all hotel staff were amazing. We always felt welcomed and safe here. Everything was clean and comfortable. The valet service was one of the best we’ve ever experienced. They were very timely and helpful during our stay. The location is also very convenient. We will be staying at more Marriott hotels!

We enjoyed our stay and did not encounter any issues. The King room had a great view of the Bay - we were on a very high floor but no balcony. Love the floor not being fully carpeted, the reusable water bottles and the various lighting options in the room. Bathroom was a little on small side but not a huge drawback. Love the This Works products especially the pillow spray. Not much hall or noise from rooms around us. There is some wasted space near the window area that could afford for a larger table or additional chair. There was no luggage rack so we had to use the stools in room because there are very few drawers. Nice size closet with plenty of hangers and a safe. Room service came in a brown bag with all disposable or recyclable items - when we put number eating 2 i thought we’d get a pot or at least 2 cups but only one came. Breakfast overall was good. Very clean pool area and pool. Nice walk along bay front to nearby park. There is also an inside shopping center adjacent that has all kinds of food options including Starbucks. Valet was pleasant and always efficient. Lots of spots around the hotel to sit and work or eat food you may bring in. Definitely would stay again.

Most of the things that happened during our stay weren't that big of a deal and would have never prompted me to become angry and/or write a review, but the final straw was charging us almost $500 to park in the garage for 5 nights and ghosting us. Singly, most of these things are really no big deal, but collectively I will leave them as a heads up/survival guide for any future brave souls: #1. We were booked a king, but ended up with a very small double queen with nowhere to put our luggage. We had to share one bed and keep luggage on the other. #2. The television didn't work during our stay. Side note: no one answered when calling the front desk so husband stopped to talk to someone while he was down there, but no one spoke English. Seemed odd for the front desk. #3. Husband ordered overnight dry cleaning. It was dinner time two days later and it still hadn't shown up, so I stopped at the desk (no big deal, but he needed it by the next morning.) The valet retrieved it from "the closet" that was about 15' away, then stood there smiling and waiting for a tip. I didn't, but would have if he would have brought it to the room, even a day late. #4. When we ordered (the same two) drinks from the bar, they would often change in price. Sometimes a beer and a vodka soda was around $30 and sometimes it was around $40, which (after looking back) left us puzzled. My husband picked up most of the tabs, but the one I grabbed had an extra drink on it (different than our other two drinks.) The bar staff openly complained that our drinks vouchers "only tipped them $3 per drink". Also, once, when I bought a round in cash, my change was not returned to me (side note: gratuity is included in the bill.) #5. Room service forgot one of my food items. I called and they brought it up promptly, but charged me another $7 service fee to do so (the item they forgot was less than $7 to purchase.) We also tipped them additional cash on the first trip up. The front desk does state that the service fee is "split" between the runners. She didn't specify whether it was the entire service fee, or only part of it. Another side note: don't order the chicken & waffles, the chicken is cooked beyond being able to eat. I've worked in a kitchen, it takes special dedication to burn something in a deep fryer, but they pulled it off. #6. They did not credit at least one day of our 'resort fee' credits. My advice is to not feel pressured to utilize anything extra in house by trying to recoup your resort fee, you'll only end up with extra (confusing) charges. #7. There was a valet charge on our bill, but we self parked and our vehicle never left the hotel during our stay. #8. I could not find a thermostat to adjust our in room refrigerator. It froze everything, including our glass bottles of iced coffee. I had quite the mess to clean up and had to throw all of our coffee soaked food away. #9. If you're looking for the microwave, it's in the laundry room. There are two on the counter for folding clothes (I know, gross.) Also, the washer 2nd in from the door was eating quarters at the time of our visit. #10. We self parked because we weren't sure if our room would be ready (we arrived the last day of the boat show) and didn't want to unload our luggage with nowhere to go with it. Self parking was listed at $42/night at the time of our stay on the hotel's website. When we left the parking garage, we were charged about $430 for 5 nights, more than twice what we should have been charged (not to mention the erroneous valet charge.) My husband called Marriott to ask them to resolve the parking and valet charge discrepancies. They acted very concerned, apologetic and helpful on the phone, but after two months we have yet to hear anything from them. We have called, IM'd, messaged and emailed Marriott with no resolution after promising they'd "look into it and promptly get back to us" each time. Both of us understand that things happen and we usually overlook them and rarely complain, but this experience was really cringe-worthy in the end. We can be pretty laissez faire about scrutinizing our bill (which goes to show how obvious and obnoxious it must have been for us to notice.) I do know that I would never choose to stay at this property again and I would also urge others not to do so as well. If you do, please limit what you spend on property, scrutinize all of your charges promptly and make sure to receive an itemized portfolio at the end of your stay.

Hotel by the water, a room with a view of cruise ships passing by. We could see both the sunrise and the sunset from our bed. The view was breathtaking! The room was spacious, the bed was big and comfortable, and the bathroom was clean. There is a mini shopping promenade just by the hotel (it is actually a cluster of hotels). There is also an assortment of eateries nearby - just go through the doors from the reception, and you can either shop for clothes, get a massage, get your hair styled , have a manicure /pedicure or just have breakfast! There are a number of restaurants to choose from - from breakfast places, to dinner - international cuisine! If you are religious, there is a church right outside the hotel with services in English and Spanish. The people at the reception were friendly and helpful, but the doormen were fantastic. They are an efficient group of people. I warmly recommend this hotel. PS. Inform the reception if you want your room cleaned.

Great service from all in areas…in particular from the security team Mr Yazd and Mr Robert. Great service and amazing professionalism. Hotel is extremely clean and welcoming. Good location and great views of the water. would recommend this hotel.

BEWARE: My traveling party and I were blatently lied to by 2 managers and received such shockingly bad service, I wrote to Marriott CEO regarding the unethical behavior. I promised the manager that I would take the time to write about my experience (which could have and should have just been resolved at the hotel). When my friend and I went to check in at midnight after a long travel day and we had a problem, I asked the employee working the desk if we could talk to the manager. When he came out he was aggressive and combative indicating that we were at fault instead of the hotel...which we were not - escalating the situation. Mistakes happen and I understand that. Not once did the manager apologize. After 30 minutes of going back and forth he finally agreed to a resolution that we found palatible. I did not trust that he would do what he said and asked at least 4 times (my friend says I asked more than that) if he promised he would do what he said. The next morning when we went down to resolve with him according to plan, he was gone. We had a lovely desk employee - who was THE only person to apologize and asked her to get the manager on duty. The manager finally came out and was as aggressive and combative off the bat as the night duty manager. Repeatedly throughout the conversation, we indicated we were shocked that neither she nor the night manager ever once apologized. Each and every time she just stared at us. it was unbelievable. My teenage boys knew how to deescalate better than that when they had jobs! Bottom line, she finally agreed to call the night manager and came back and told us he said he never agreed to his resolution. To add insult to injury, she suggested we get breakfast and check back in 30 minutes. We paid $85 for a couple of eggs and coffee! Which of course she refused to refund. There is a lovely Hilton property right next store. I would stay there. After quite a bit of time invested in talking to the CEO staff, we finally recieved the agreed upon resolution. I don't recall ever being so blatently lied to and I advised the leadership team at Marriott that they have a serious ethical issue and at the least, the need to train the managers.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Jorge es un buen conductor. Ello habla Español y ingles. Mi esposa y yo nos gusta el viaje. Jorge es amable y me preguntó sober mi viaje a Miami. Doy cinco Estrellas para su servicio due excelente. Gracias Jorge!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Excepto por la demora en la asignacion de la habitacion reservada on line, la atencion en el front desk fue excelente. Felicitaciones a Jennifer por su amabilidad y ayuda. Las habitaciones y el servicio perfecto

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: El hotel es perfecto para larga estadía, el staff es muy amable, muy buena atención por parte de Jennifer en el front desk. Su amabilidad me hizo sentir como en casa ademas de su excelente servicio y disposición para ayudar.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Muy buen hotel en general. Sí lo recomendaría. Me hospedé recientemente con mi familia (esposa y dos hijos, de 9 y 3 años). Para empezar, el servicio de transporte del aeropuerto al hotel un poco tardado. Tuvimos que esperar alrededor de una hora para que nos recogieran. La primera vez que pasó el trasporte, ya iba lleno. Sin embargo, la conductora se disculpó y era amable. Hice check-in por medio de la app, lo cual fue fabuloso, ya que hasta pude escoger la habitación y no tuvimos que esperar en recepción. La ubicación es muy buena. Área tranquila, con Publix cerca. La habitación muy limpia, completa y con suficiente espacio. Sólo había una silla rota y lo que no me gustó fue el espacio en el sanitario, ya que era demasiado reducido y la puerta apenas cerraba, pero era funcional. Las camas súper cómodas, los televisores bien pero deberían tener acceso a streaming. La cocina completa. Los ascensores un poco lentos. El desayuno incluido es bastante bueno y completo, pero se vuelve monótono después de dos días. Deberían variar un poco las opciones calientes. Una lástima que ya no haya recepción con comida y bebida por las tardes como antes. La piscina adecuada y limpia pero muy fría, incluso para Miami. Y no hay jacuzzi. Por último el personal muy servicial y amable. Volvería.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Autobús súper puntua, nuestra reserva era ora las 10:00 pm y a la misma 10:00 salió ! Cómodos , con suficiente espacio y el conductor súper decente y amable y siempre condujo con precaución. Sin duda lo recomiendo a cualquiera persona!!!! Le doy un 20 de 10 .

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Servicio excelente por George. Debemos mencionar Adriana tambien. Ellos son muy amicables. Regresaremos otra vez a esto hotel, es nuestra visita segundo por el ano con Homewood Suites Blue Lagoon. Thanks!!

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Al extraviar Movil tuve que realizar llamada de emergencia de Lima-Peru desde habitación. Tres llamadas totalizando 7 minutos. Al hacer check-out me di con la sorpresa que me cobraron US 300 DOLARES!!. AL reclamar, la manager se excusó diciendo que esos son los rates que les cobra AT&T, argumento q es una burla. Estamos seguros que si la manager hace esa misma llamada desde su desk, no le cobran US 50 el minuto. Lo real es que esa tarifa es exclusiva para sus preciados HUÉSPEDES. Les pedí consideren la irracionalidad de dicho cobro pero se negaron a darme una tarifa aceptable. Considero que fui estafado, y dicha práctica debería se ilegal, sobre todo si no existe ningún warning o tarifa publicada en la habitación. Nunca más paso por el Homewoods suites.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Me gustaría reconocer la amabilidad de Adriana, al área de breakfast por estar atentos siempre con una sonrisa para el huesped. La calidad humana en general del staff del hotel es de resaltar. Gracias por sus atenciones y por el cariño que le ponen a su trabajo.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Gracias al área de Breakfast Bryan, Raída y Patricia por hacer mi desayuno especial con estos Danish.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: La habitación super tranquila, los chicos muy amables y sobre todo el señor del shuttle muy servicial. Reciben los paquetes con un cargo siempre que aun no estés en el hotel, pero si estas ya alojado y lo recoges de recepción ese mismo día no hay cobro.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: El hotel se encuentra muy bien ubicado, cerca del aeropuerto y de varios restaurantes y supermercados. Ya me había hospedado en 2014 y se le empieza a notar el paso de los años. Las habitaciones son muy cómodas y amplias aunque deberían tener mas iluminación. El desayuno es completo y variado. No le pongo 5 estrellas porqué el estacionamiento es pago U$S 15+tax (antes era sin cargo), no hay housekeeping diario, hay que pedirlo el día anterior y en mi caso no lo hicieron temprano y tuve que reclamarlo. Otra cosa que perdió eran los cenas sin cargo un par de días a la semana. El staff es muy servicial y hablan español.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Nos recibieron muy bien comida y estadia y el tranporte hacia el aeropuerto nos llevo ericka una muy buena persona, igualmente las personas que nos dieron la comida muy buenas personas, y del hotel muy comodo los cuartos son espaciosos tienen todo lo que se ocupa en una habitacion y nos brinda una piscina muy bonita es muy bonito

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Excelente la atención y felicito a Zoila Rosa por su buen trabajo le doy 10 puntos buena compañera se relaciona con todos las personas , mantiene limpio el sitio del hotel, y te soluciona cualquier problema

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Nilwin was amazing and brought the items we asked for immediately! He was friendly and super attentive. He made sure we had everything we needed and made sure we knew his name to ask for anything that may come up.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: La estadía fue excelente. La atención de Omar fue estupenda, nos ayudó a solucionar un problema que teníamos . Le estamos muy agradecidos. La instalaciones muy limpias, la sala De espera huele muy rico. La vista al aeropuerto hermosa . La verdad lo recomiendo

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: We had a two bedroom suite that was perfect for us and our travel companions. The only thing missing was an ice bucket for our cocktails. The beds were extremely comfortable. The airport noise was not bad at all.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: This was truly the worst experience I have ever had at a hotel. I was there with my parents, husband, annd infant child. We called to request a pack and play when we initially made the reservation, when we confirmed a few days prior, and even called to remind them we needed a pack and play the morning before we arrived. When we arrived in the early evening sure enough there was no pack and play in the room. In addition to this, when we pulled out the sofa bed there was balled up dirty sheets. We nicely went back down to the front desk and requested a pack and play as well as new sheets. They said they would send someone up. Fast forward to 30 minutes later and still no one brought anything up. We called down and was told someone would be bringing things up shortly. 20 minutes later a staff member came up and literally threw a new set of sheets at my husband when he opened the door. When we asked about the pack and play he said he didn't know anything about that. At this point it was way past my daughter's bedtime, so my mother went down to the front desk to inquire about it again. After waiting in a long line for someone to help her (there was only one person working the front desk) she finds out that there are actually no pack and plays available. We had no other option so my infant daughter had to sleep on a blanket we laid on the floor. To make sure she was safe one of us was awake watching her all night. It was beyond horrible. After our vacation when we called corporate to inform them of this issue they had no remorse and didn't even apologize. I am still in disbelief that this is how they treat customers. In addition do not fall for their false promises and use the shuttle services they arrange to drive you to the cruise ports. Our van arrived 45 minutes late (we kept being told 5 more minutes) and we were jammed into the van with 2 other families. There was not enough room for everyone's luggage and things, so we had to sit with the car seat on our lap, the stroller leaning against someone who needed to hold it so it would not fall and hit anyone, and everyone had a bag on their lap. Plus all three families were not going to the same cruise port so it took forever dropping everyone off at their individual ports. It would have been much less expensive, much faster, and a much better experience if we just did Uber.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: The property is located less than 10mins from the airport which we appreciated after landing in the night. Check-in was very efficient. The room was spacious and clean and the staff were very friendly. The breakfast has more than enough options and runs from 6am to 9am. Things to note: Packages delivered there incurred a $5/pkg charge Parking is only paid think it was 15/day Room service is only if requested and the request must be made 24hrs before, however front desk can help with things like towels etc. The odd number rooms are lake view, the even are road side. Only one sore point were the duck. One day we were surrounding by about 9 of them which scrared my daughter and had her fearful of the carpark the entire stay. Not sure what can be done though its their home to.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Hotel was clean and very acomadating, van pick was great,Front Desk employee Adrianna was excellent in answer local question for my group of 50 plus. Sales Rep for group Cecilia was quick to answer question when needed , she kept me up todate on my booking when asked. GM Sandy was Aproachable we had a great conversation, help out when needed including printing so info for me and my group, I would book this hotel again as needed.

hotel_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Miami-Airport/Blue Lagoon
review_text: Estuvimos con mi familia 3 dias previos a un crucero. Muy lindas instalaciones, el lobby amplio y con un perfume riquisimo, buena vista a la laguna para un lado y para otro. La habitacion familiar era buena pero un poco chica, al abrir el sofa bed, no quedaba espacio para caminar. Y a la cocina le faltaban algunas cosas, tenia pocos utensillos para comer. El desayuno bueno, bastante completo y reponian comida seguido. El estacionamiento es pago, sale 15 dolares el dia, pero como no teniamos telefono local, no pudimos pagar con la aplicacion y al final no nos cobraron.

I really appreciate the professionalism showed by Mr.Yazdi and Mr.Jean for helping recover a lost item . Rooms were good and neat. Amazing view. Really nice place to stay at . Right next to the supermarket. Would totally comeback to this hotel .

Fantastic service even during a tropical storm during a festival. Got extra towels really quick and room service was top notch. Lobby was extremely nice even with the issue of soaking wet guests coming in. Would definitely stay again. 10/10

We stay here when cruising out of Miami. This is a nice hotel, near shops and the port. The staff are always super freindly and helpful. Also a a bonus the people mover is close! We like this hotel and will be back, but the new toiletry brand is not good, just an FYI if you use the hotels hand soap, shampoo or body wash.

I left a personal item behind in my room and Jonathan Savinovich with Safety and Security quickly assisted and helped get my item in the mail back to me. He was so helpful and efficient and provided me with excellent customer service! Thank you for your help!

Great hotel in a great location - very convenient to Miami cruise port and walkable to many areas. Very comfortable room and beautiful views of the cruise ships and Biscayne Bay. Special thanks to Jose, the bellman, who was wonderful with assisting with luggage. Highly recommend this hotel.

Got locked out of the safe in my room. Mr. Patel came up immediately from security and had the safe opened and explained what I did wrong!! GREAT employee, prompt service!!! Additionally, the hotel location is AWESOME!!!! The hotel sits right on the Bay with great water view...

The hotel is quite nice. Friendly and welcoming staff. The room felt a bit dated even after the recent re-decorations. The issue overall was noise. I get that the hotel cannot be responsible for inconsiderate guests talking noisily into the early hours on their return from a night out. However, the lack of insulation cannot be overstated. The guy in the next room even woke me up with his snoring on two nights! There could probably be a couple more lifts / elevators with 31 floors. Restaurant is fine but a little on the expensive side, e.g. $42 for a buffet breakfast.

No special elite treatment Weren’t told breakfast ended at 9:30 at m lounge Pool closed Very noisy rooms Destination fee??? Ridiculous / they claim you get bike rentals but are fully booked….. Parking is very expensive too Not worth it unless you get a great hotel rate

i cannot tell you how much we enjoyed out stay at the hotel for the Sell it like serhant sales meeting -- the front desk was very professional and very accommodating - the location was spot on - -the restaurant had the best hamburgers in the world - and i want to give a shot out to someone who actually was very helpful to me and my team - - he was security guard - Yazdi Patel -- he was very helpful during the seminar helping my team of five agents - -- great employee -- but everyone was amazing -

In the laundry room one commercial washing machine and one dryer are not working for about a month or more… In addition an upgrade to a credit card payment instead of the old coin Maxine’s would be nice9

Joined a friend at this “renovated” property, overall cheap feeling like everything was purchased from Ikea. Stagnant and sterile environment, dirty empty bar, zero vibe and a pool that’s been closed for almost 2 years. Typical bottom of the brand Marriott!

Entire property is beautiful, staff is exceptional. Norberto went above and beyond his duties and located a lost item that was not initially found by staff, after I checked out. He is courteous, diligent, and an outstanding professional that the property is lucky to have.

the remodel of the property is going well as the rooms are up to date and have great water views if you choose the bay view. i dont use the pool and that looks to be under remodeling at current time. the Valet is always the best of all the places i stay at in Miami area. Jose is one of the best, he always greets me and our guest like we live there and his customer service skills are awesome. i come and go a lot and the wait times for my vehicle are only minutes at the most. the staff are really responsive

Stayed 5 nights at the Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay. I come to Miami quite a bit for work, and usually stay at the Miami Airport Marriott as pricing fits the budget. Sometimes I can find a hotel in South Beach for the right price, but not usually this time of year. I have also searched this hotel in the past, but it's usually out of my work budget price. I was able to find a great member, special rate for a King, Biscayne Bay view room, 5,000 extra points per night, free self parking and 2 welcome drinks at the bar. The hotel does have a $30/day resort fee - there are various things to do with it, or just apply it as a nightly $30 Food and Beverage credit from the bar or restaurant. Check in with the FDA went fantastic. There were a few people checking in, but the line moved quick. I chatted it up a bit with the FDA, letting her know it was my 1st time here vs my usual stays at the airport. I asked if any of the Jr. suites with the amazing Biscayne Bay views were available - she had already slotted me into a King Bayview room on the 28th floor. She asked me to hold on, went in the back to speak to someone, and came out with a smile. Do I want the good or bad news? Well with that smile, there can't be any bad news 😃 She was able to move me to a Jr. suite on the 16th floor. The bad news? It's 2 Queens instead of 1 King. Not a problem at all!! The room is fantastic! The hotel is newly remodeled, and its so nice with everything fresh and new. The room has 2 thermostats and they are tied together to adjust the temp all the way down to 64 degrees in unison. The M club here is open 24 hours, offers breakfast, all day snacks/drinks/coffee, along with evening bites and dessert. I will say the club here, quality of food and overall experience is noticeable above what is offered at the Airport Marriott. Then pool is closed for refurbishment, guests can use the pool at the DoubleTree Hotel that shares the building. Outside the hotel M club there is a "party deck" that has chairs, tables, foosball, ping pong and outdoor billiards. So far this place is hitting it out of the park for a work stay.

We booked this hotel as it offered the convenience of an on-site restaurant which was very convenient as well as it was near to Bascom Palmer where family members had scheduled appointments. The rooms were very modern and very clean. The hotel staff were very friendly and accommodating. Although we did not have our own transportation Alvaro (Valet) provided us with awesome service and arranged transportation on days we had appointments. He is a true ambassador for Marriott Biscayne Bay and should be recognized for his friendly personality and excellent service.

Great welcome from Samantha, she represents the company and has s an asset to the Marriott brand! Our experience with the team and the grounds were among the best I have experienced with Marriott. Thx

Todo muy bien, a pesar de que el segundo día no hicieron la limpieza de la habitación. El servicio fue excelente. En especial de Fanny de M Club nos atendió de maravilla, hizo nuestra estancia muy amena, siempre al pendiente de nosotros. Muchas gracias

First off- shout out to Yazdi & Will in the security/bellman area. I had a package to pick up for an event I was going to and at first the staff couldn't find it. I mentioned that I needed it for an event in 30 minutes and they put extra people on it and found my package within 10 minutes and SAVED THE DAY! Hotel was clean & comfortable, you receive a free drink & a $30 voucher to the restaurant which was a welcome touch when we first arrived. We requested late check out by 1 hour on Friday morning but were told they couldn't accommodate. A bit of a bummer since I had a very important 11am work call I wanted to take in my room, but overall pretty understandable given it was a Friday morning and they likely had to get the room ready for weekend visitors.

Our two-night stay was decent but some details brought the experience to a lower level. The room was airy and clean, with a nice balcony and view of the bay. However, our coffee and tea supplies were not replenished, and the bathroom wasn’t as clean as it could have been (smudged mirrors and trash not emptied). We also had to deal with the following issues: - at 1:45am on our first night, a very loud guest decided to walk up and down the hallway while screaming/ giggling at her mom. It was impossible to fall asleep so I called the reception and they said security would handle it. One hour later, the noise finally stopped. - we had dinner at the hotel restaurant and ordered two glasses of wine. Menu indicated said wine was $14. When we got the check, we had been charged $18/ glass. Waitress informed us that the only Sauvignon Blanc they had was the expensive one so… that’s what we got. I asked to speak to a manager; that request was denied and I was told they would lower then price to $15 but that’s was the best they could do. I do not understand how this is acceptable; why wouldn’t they let us know the wine we wanted was out of stock? Would they have charged me for filet mignon if my chicken was not available? - on the second night, we ordered a cocktail and a rosé. Once again, even though I asked for the rosé by name and noted the price, they overcharged me. Refused to adjust the price when I mentioned the mistake. - reception desk staff was snappy and dismissive. They did not like me asking for the receipt before checking out, and rushed the whole process. - staff at the coffee shop was clueless and super slow, didn’t know prices of anything in the store and made no effort to answer questions. The hotel is nice but even though centrally located, there’s nothing nearby. No coffee shops, no restaurants, no stores. Not sure I would I go back if ever visit Miami again.

Awesome hotel. Been staying here since 2006. First time I’ve written a review. Best setting , great views and very close to South Beach. Absolutely love this hotel. My personal favorite.Staff are great. Very close to stores in the city. Always look forward to coming here.

I've stayed in and reviewed this hotel in the past. Recently, the property completed a total renovation and it was much needed. I spent a couple nights here before and after a cruise and while the hotel looks 1000% nicer than it did, it still wasn't perfect and some of the renovations (specifically the lack of space for luggage and storage in the rooms) leaves me scratching my head. I arrived after check in time for my first stay and before check in for my second. As it was spring break, I wasn't able to get my preferred port view room for my first stay. The rooms are nicely redone BUT some of them do NOT have anyplace other than the bed to put your luggage. One room had a ledge on the dresser, but the other did not. And, did this 600 room hotel save ANY luggage racks that were removed before the reno? NO! I suggested to the ops manager, who's very nice, that he purchase some. Many travelers do not want to put dirty luggage on beds for a number of reasons. Not thinking about this shows a lack of common sense. (Ex hotel manager here! I'd have saved a dozen or so). The concierge lounge is now closed and there is an M Club on the lobby level next to the restaurant. My status gets me access to the lounge though there isn't really access to coffee or soft drinks 24/7 like there is at every other M Club I've been in since they were rolled out. It's nice enough but it gets VERY hot during the day and please, get the 3 pounds of peppers and onions out of the breakfast potatoes. Can there be plain ones please? And you're in Miami. How about some salsa for the eggs. I also understand that this hotel is in Miami and not everyone speaks English but if you ask for milk or a fork or spoon or tell someone that there are fruit flies all over the half and half pitcher, please have someone working in the lounge who understands the language. The new restaurant is nice though I wish they had smaller items to eat and that the prices weren't so ridiculously high. Yes, you get a $30 F&B credit as part of the new destination fee (translation: we need more cash to pay for the redo) but that gets eaten up fast. There is a burger and I was able to order chicken tenders (I am probably the only human in the USA who hates chicken wings), but I think that there are a few things missing. Or maybe the food focuses too much on seafood. Can't put my finger on it really and there are 1000 other places to eat in Miami. Service was also rather slow.
