Not sure whether it was a staffing issue though I didn't really see a big crowd at any time. Also you get 2 welcome cocktails. The first stay, these were actual cocktails. The second stay it was "tequila and a mixer" That isn't a welcome cocktail. It's nothing actually. Just make a weekly cocktail and be done with it. Tequila sunrise, Mojito (your hotel in the past actually won best Mojito in Miami), Margarita, whatever. Not a shot in a glass of juice. Make it a LITTLE special please. The "reusable" water bottles (part of the destination fee) are simply thin, metal bottles like the aluminum beer bottles. Nice to get, sure but not much value. That's also part of your destination fee along with a specialty coffee from the market and free bike rentals and HOHO bus tours. (I didn't bother with either of those. TBH, no value). The former iLLY coffee bar still has coffee and light snacks but they've also turned it into a small market with souvenirs, more snacks and basic over the counter meds that you may have forgotten. My rooms were clean and they did install more plugs and USB chargers during the remodel; however, several of them only worked when the lights were turned on. Seems that the electricians didn't do the best job and that the punch lists before the rooms were turned over to the hotel after the reno were either poorly executed, not completed or totally ignored. Some of the TVs were not getting the full channel guide either. The pool area was redone except for the bar and that should be open soon. Some of the associates have learned some customer service skills since my last visit and that was refreshing. Special thanks to Jadore, Johanna, Kevin, Daniela, Jose and Jules for going the extra step. The property is located close to a Publix and is attached to a small shopping plaza with a couple places to eat and a few boutiques as well. The hotel offers both self and valet parking at typical city prices. All in all, the Marriott Miami Biscayne Bay is way better than it was the last time I was there. Sure there are places that were skipped during the renovation (look up in the lobby near the windows) but the rooms, aside from lack of storage and room for luggage, are a breath of fresh air. It was a much needed renovation but this minimalistic style needs to give way to style and common sensical, useful, well though out designs please.

Brutal, nos hospedamos para la serie de baseball Y el hotel ha sido remodelado, las habitaciones modernas la piscina brutal, el servicio de A La Carte( Room Service) muy bueno. El restaurante de desayuno muy bueno y la calidad de comida espectacular. Gracias a Patricia en el Front Desk, y a los muchachos del Valet Parking por toda la información que nos dieron. Los Recomiendo BRUTAL HOTEL. GRACIAS

Basically this hotel has great potential but after staying here 4 nights the main problem is the service that must improv ! We experienced several disturbing service issues that affected our stay in a very disturbing manner Check in: as Platinum Elite members we checked in at the Elite lane that was unfortunately occupied by a young associate named Daniella that was very nice but lacked all the necessary knowledge of dealing with Elite members .First she claimed she was giving us an upgrade by giving us a room with bay view but that was what we had ordered in the first place…. Then she gave us a terrible room on a low floor adjacent to the 24/7 open fitness center ! she gave us wrong information about the lounge and was very unhappy to get the manager involved but luckily we insisted . Eventually Kevin ,the manager ,was able to find a much better room for us. Housekeeping: there was always something missing in the room and you needed to call more than once to get it ( towels, shower cup, disposal of garbage etc. The bathroom has only the minimal essentials. One would expect a little more from a 4 star hotel. The M lounge: this is a limited service lounge. Breakfast is only served until 9:30am ( the hotels restaurant serves it until 11) so even if you are on vacation and it’s the weekend you better wake up early because by 9:31am the food is gone. On Fridays and Saturdays the lounge closes at 2pm and then there is absolutely NOTHING there! Even the coffee machine is turned off, the refrigerator locked so there is nothing there as opposed to most other Marriott lounges that you might at least get something to drink , in some cases even 24/7.so basically lounge access means almost nothing Friday and Saturday . There are supposed to be a light meal between 5:30-7:30pm but food is taken away at 7pm. Concierge: this service exists “ formally” but in reality you can not get too much information. There are no maps , brochures etc. we were told “ to go online” to get all the info needed about Miami and its attractions. Wow, thanks for that advice! On the bright side of things we need to comment that there is still some hope for good service as on our first night we met Yazdi the security officer who was very helpful in better understanding the neighborhood . And upon check out we met Louis who was pleasant and professional .

Jose Perez was amazing. He took care of our luggage and directed us to an amazing restaurant. His smile and professionalism was second to none. It’s hard to find great customer service these days but he super-ceded my expectations!

We've been to this property several times now. It's recently renovated and very nice. $30 amenity fee is well worth it! Rooms are nice and spacious. Food and drinks are tasty. Location on the bay is very nice with balconies in each room I've had.

I had a problem with my room and had to wait for another room to be cleaned. My luggage stayed in my old room, so security had to come let me in so I could move it to my new room. Yazdi Patel opened the room and then helped me take my luggage up to my new room. I was really tired from traveling and had been on 5 flights in 5 days and it was so nice to have help. He was courteous and professional. Thank you so much Yazdi!

I had an amazing stay here! The hotel is very clean and is in a great location. My customer service experience was lovely and the staff were extremely friendly and helpful, especially from Yazdi at the Safety and Security team! I would recommend for anyone looking for a hotel in Miami - I will be back!

Great location for our event. Parking fees can be as high as $45/day not including tips. Hotel lobby and certain rooms are being renovated. Should be nice when complete. Staff was friendly. Room 3129 air conditioner was barely able to keep up with the heat demand. Engineering staff was not able to make a difference. The thermostat was already set to 60 degrees when we came into the room, but the room temp was more like 76. Not a coil icing issue. Beds are hard. Nice restaurant choices on site.

The worst experience I’ve ever had in a hotel. I booked thru my credit card and wasn’t notified that there is construction in the hotel. No one told me at check in, and there was no any sign indicating renovations in progress . On Marriott website there was a message only about the pool access!!! My Experience: At 8am on Sunday morning they started drilling and demolishing the room right above us. The noise was unbearable!!! I called the front desk and asked them to do something about it and they said they will check. They called back and said that nothing can be done and that they can give me free breakfast. I already had breakfast included in my reservation!!! Pieces started falling from the ceiling and at that point we left the room immediately because my girlfriend has allergies to dust and also felt unsafe to stay there. I went to the front desk and they were extremely rude and unprofessional. I was told that it’s my own fault I didn’t know the hotel is under renovation . I asked for a manager but I got very rude and arrogant hotel ambassador instead. Her name is Marjorie and she explained to me that I don’t have the right to complain and it’s perfectly normal pieces to fall from the ceiling on me, because the vibrations are high from the demolition of the room above ! I couldn’t believe my ears and I asked for a manager again. I was told that the manager doesn’t want to talk to me and that I should go. I made complaint through reservations case #388105583 but no one has contacted me yet. This is unacceptable for hotel of any kind and Marriott is claiming to be better than most. I still think about it and can’t believe that this whole experience could happen in any hotel!

Forgot my kindle in the room so called to see if I could pick up. Yazdi Patel and Norberto Pagan were so helpful and offered to immediately FedEx instead. I immediately received the FedEx tracking number. It so nice to have such great customer service, especially when it was all my fault. So grateful!

I had a great stay at this hotel . Everyone was very attentive and helpful. The Bellman , Jose Perez in particular was very gracious and kind for securing my belongings while I waited for my delayed flight and made sure I was comfortable within the hotel even though I had already checked out of my room. I am very grateful and would definitely stay here again because of their outstanding customer service.

We had a great stay at Marriott Biscayne Bay. This hotel have Some very good employers, especially Alberto. A. He gave us advice to visit some places, for example Las holas beach, everglades. He told us how to drive and what we can do for adventures. He made us stay very special. We also had a good laugh with HIM. A big thank you for Alberto. A. We Will see you next year!!! Much love from family Kisoenpersad 🇺🇸

Lo primero que hay que saber de este hotel es que está en una seria remodelación hasta diciembre del 2022, así que si no quieren sorpresas, no es para ustedes. Sin embargo en la actualidad tiene unas super tarifas que pueden compensar el problema. En nuestro caso, fue una estadía larga por temas médicos. La ubicación en midtown es muy buena. Cerca de buenos restaurantes y del teatro (no dejen de chequear la cartelera es walking distance). Lo bueno: ubicación y espectaculares vistas. Lo malo: pisicna en remodelación (ofrecen servicio de shuttle y poltronas para south beach en otro Marriot), el servicio del counter es muy irregular (hay encantadores y personas con poca vocación de servicio), el servicio de limpieza tienes que pedirlo y van a hacer el cuarto a cualquier hora (muchas veces tarde en la tarde). Servicio de alimentación muy limitado (usen el deli de al lado del hotel, abre de 8 am a 10 pm y soluciona todo!). La remodelación puede ser un dolor de cabeza si se quedan en el hotel durante el día (cortes de agua, quedarte sin agua caliente, escuchar el martilleo, entre otros). Lo mejor: gracias Marjorie (rescataste nuestra estadía!!!), gracias a Alvaro (que tuvo que mudarnos de cuarto 3 veces y con una sonrisa) y gracias a los chicos del valet parking por siempre entregarnos nuestro auto rápidamente!!

Old building with small bathrooms, old towels and a low flow shower. The pool is also under renovation. Not the nicest place. Maybe they are not doing well financially. Marriotts usually have bathroom gels in the shower that are in three tubes. These cheapos give out these small bottles. Not my favorite Marriott experience.

La piscina reformandose es temporada baja y lo puedo entender, el bufet no es self service y hay q pedir de la carta pero te limitan con lo q no puedes repetir de fruta o lo q te apetezca, solo puedes elegir un plato. Pero la ginda del pastel es q un hotel de 4 estrellas de la cadena marriot resulta q no te hacen el servicio de habitaciones y el servicio pasa de hacerte la habitacion estando avisada y sabiendolo, ya q les dijimos a las 8 de la tarde cuando pasaron q en 10 min. Podian hacer la habitacion, sin contar q habian tenido todo el dia. A las 8 de la mañana ya estan picando y haciendo ruido, vamos resumiendo si teneis alternativas por ese precio encontrareis mejores hoteles.

Excelente hotel, vista y ubicación increíbles! La mejor atención desde que llegamos para hacer el check in lilyeth (creo que se escribía así) nos recibió con una sonrisa y nos dio una lindisima habitación con balcón. Jose Pérez nos ayudó con las valijas súper amable, cada vez que necesitábamos algo estaba dispuesto a ayudarnos con la mejor sonrisa. Lo mismo los chicos del valet parking. La pileta ya nos habían informado que estaba en remodelación pero nos dieron la posibilidad de usar las Reposeras del hotel Marriott de south beach. Pasamos una lindisima estadía! Sin duda volveremos!

Buen hotel. Destacó la atención de la gente de seguridad que nos brindó un gentil servicio en la recepción de algunas encomiendas. En especial El señor Yazdi Patel y Norberto Pagan.Buenas gentes. Respecto al hotel es un hotel amplio con todas las instalaciones para un hotel de este nivel Llama la atención que cobren por el uso del internet en las habitaciones no me había encontrado con hoteles que cobraran desde inicios de siglo (2000) por este servicio y he visitado muchos Es un hotel amplio con muy buenas s

The guys from Catch, where you can actually dine with the best catch of the day, found my debit card. And Turned it over to Lost & Found. And Yazdi came to deliver it at my room at 10 PM at night! Not just that: he delivered a package too! Happy to recommend Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay.

We booked and paid $950 CND for a Concierge Level room for 2 nights 11-13 March. We arrived at 9pm last night to be told that the Lounge is not open at weekends! We specifically wanted a lounge available as we both suffer from jet-lag and it would enable us to have somewhere to sit if necessary. I asked for an upgrade but was told the hotel was completely full. I was surprised to hear that as the pool deck is unavailable due to a refurbishment. I asked if there was another Marriott available and was told I would have to look for it myself. We knew that there was being work done on the hotel we were aware that we could not use the balcony. On arrival we were told that work on our room had been finished and we could use the balcony. It has one seat on it and a tiny table. Inside there room there is one office chair and a coffee table with nowhere to sit. Wifi is available at a charge of $9.95 per day. There are no universal plugs or adaptors in the room. The decor is old and careworn and doesn't look as if it has been changed for 20 years. All this for $950. To say it is shameful is an understatement.

Had a large sum of packages mailed to the hotel and despite the long wait to get them retrieved, Yazdi and Jean were very helpful and patient in gathering them all up for me and assisting with loading them into my car. Overall, the hotel is in a great location and everyone I interacted with was very pleasant and helpful.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: No hicieron la limpieza. Lo que me importaba era la habitación de mis papás dos personas de 83 y 84 años. Pero no cumplieron . Se pidió toallas y papel toilet. Lo dije en el lobby y supuestamente lo tuvieron que haber hecho en ese mismo acto. Pero no fue asi

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente en Todo sentido!!!!!, Desde la ubicacion, la cual es perfecta hasta su personal, El cual es altamente calificado. No fue mi primera estadia alli y Dios mediante, espero poder regresar muy pronto

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Me encanto el servicio al cliente, pude obtener early checking a las 10am, las habitaciones son amplias y modernas, el hotel está en una muy buena ubicación en brickell por lo que todo está cerca y puedes caminar, si diría qué hay que mejorar el desayuno al menos con algún tipo de fruta básica, por lo demás todo estuvo muy bien.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Limpieza excelente. El desayuno es un resuelve para todos hay de todo para todos. Las camas son muy cómodas al igual que sus almohadas. Toiletries son un buen detalle. Los empleados muy atentos. Siempre será una opción

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Quiero reconocer este hotel y sus empleadores!! fueron muy amables en la estadía de una noche que estuvimos antes de tomar nuestro crucero de una semana. La atención de Anais fue muy amable y contesto todas mis dudas!!!! excelente empleada gracias por su atención. El desayuno muy bueno y con variedades a escoger. Regresaremos desde luego que si para nuestro crucero lo renta riamos nuevamente. gracias por todo hasta la proxima !!!!!!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El personal es muy amable, excelente ubicación, habitaciones muy cómodas y muy limpias. Es una excelente opción para ir al centro de Miami, no es necesario alquilar vehículo si piensa quedarse en la zona. Es buena opción para un viaje familiar, de pareja y de negocios.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Hice un viaje con dos amigas y nos alojamos en el hotel. Impecable todo, no hay habitaciones triples, pero estuvimos comodas. El hotel tiene una excelente ubicacion muy cerca de los restaurants y bares de Brickell. Lo recomiendo

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Hotel muy bien ubicado , en una zona moderna El personal muy amable Las instalaciones muy bien mantenidas y la habitación amplia y con linda vista Tiene parking en el hotel y nos permitieron dejar el auto luego de hacer el check out

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Nikki at the front was excellent!! She made our check in easy and full of laughter, she was awesome 🤩👍🏾. The rooms were amazing, by far the nicest we’ve been in this far. The room view was great!!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: The stay at the Hampton Inn was spectacular. Excellent location, good parking, very nice upscale appearance. Amenities were great. They do use of the pool, lobby bar, and most of all the free breakfast buffet. We had evacuated from Fort Myers because of hurricane Ian. The staff was extremely kind and I especially would like to commend the front desk staff members Nikki and Ziv.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Mi estadía en este total ha sido un total desastre, 2 noches sin cerrar los ojos debido a un aire acondicionado con un ruido infernal, la primera noche notificamos el problema prometieron corregir y al llegar en la noche cansados el ruido continúa igual o peor, un total desastre. No recomendado

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel me encantó porque está en el centro de la cuidad de miami el servicio de los empleado muy afable te puedes movilizar a cualquier lugar con facilidad todo está cerca relativamente como restaurante, plazas,supermercado.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Escogimos este hotel a nuestra vuelta de Bahamas por su ubicación en Miami y por las buenas valoraciones que tenían. Un ERROR. No te hacen la cama diariamente por “protocolo Covid” pero después todo el personal del hotel iba sin mascarilla. Las señoras de la limpieza groseras y maleducadas, el chico de recepción bostezaba constantemente mientras nos hablaba, la habitación pequeña… Del desayuno mejor no hablar.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel tiene muy buena ubicación cerca de restaurantes, tiendas y transporte. Las habitaciones son amplias, bien decoradas y completas, ya que tienen microondas, refrigeradora y cafetera. Tiene una pequeña sala. El personal del hotel es muy amable y servicial

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El lugar tiene una excelente ubicación. No me gustó que me dieran una habitación con el baño sucio pero ante mi reclamo lo cambiaron. También me estaban cobrando por estacionamiento cuando yo no tenía auto. Por suerte revisé mi estado de cuenta de la tarjeta y pudieron anularlo a tiempo. Pero por esos hechos, sólo se disculparon pero no ofrecieron ninguna reparación

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El servicio, las habitaciones, la limpieza, el desayuno, las instalaciones y la ubicación excelentes. El personal de recepción muy amable, preocupado y gentil, destaca Ashwin, quien nos hizo sentir como en casa.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Céntrico hotel ( si lo que quieres es la zona de Brickell) en Miami, hay varios parkings en la misma calle para coches. La recepción está en el sexto piso y el personal hablan todos ( o casi) español. Muy amables y serviciales. La habitación está realmente bien, excelente cama, buen tamaño, cuarto de baño moderno y en general un hotel bien cuidado y con toques de modernidad. La televisión está muy bien y es de buen tamaño, hay vending e hielo en cada planta y tienen una habitación de gimnasio que puede dar el apaño para el que sepa entrenar (si no, no vale) con demasiadas maquinas de cardio y poco trabajo de pesas/maquinas (eché de menos una barra y discos). El desayuno está bastante por debajo de la media del hotel, es buffet y te sirves tú pero la variedad es bastante corta, y los huevos no están demasiado buenos de sabor, lo demás es pasable. El lobby está bien y los ascensores son rápidos.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Es un hotel excelentemente ubicado En pleno corazon de Brickell El establecimiento esta perfectamente mantenido Las habitaciones son cómodas y muy bien equipadas El servicio optimo Dan desayuno muy completo Excelente opcion Tiene garage Difícil en esa zona Esta muy próxima al tren lo que facilita el poder moverse de una lado al otro Incluso en minutos al aeropuerto

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente ubicación en el centro de la ciudad con múltiples accesos a transporte y entretenimiento nocturna. Buenos desayunos pero deberían evaluar limpieza de las habitaciones de manera diaria. Muy buen servicio pero no tienen personal habla castellano

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This hotel is in a great neighborhood; very safe and clean area. Lots of restaurants nearby. The hotel itself offers great amenities for a family trip. Excellent facility; and the staff is very accommodating. Expect to pay for parking and a rollaway.

overall good experience but not worth the price, a great location. Kudos to bellman Jose Reyes as no one received us and he immediately jump in to help us out, really friendly and made our experience a whole lot better.

This property has a very consistent bad service, across all areas. The people at the front desk are neither nice, nor helpful; they have no concept of hospitality. The hotel is under renovation and the noice is unbearable at times. The hotel charges an incredible fee for receiving mail, and it takes ages before security (???) actually retrieves your mail. The bellboys will not help you get a taxi, but will tell you to get an Uber. I am a Gold Elite member and was allowed to check out at 2pm. I requested 2:30pm and was refused—so I ended up checking out at 9am, because I knew I would only be back at 2:30pm. Yellow cabs will not drive there from the airport, so you need to find something called a Blue cab, whatever that is. If you have an alternative, I would recommend staying away from this hotel.

I stayed at this hotel because it was the host hotel for the Miami boat show 2022. Left pillow in Room - they had it and sent it back to me. Very happy! Hotel is in a good location, but is very dated, it appears that they are entering a renovation phase and that should be a good thing for future guests.

I was there for a 3 day convention. The rooms were well appointed and the food and bar staff must have been hand selected as everyone moved in synchronicity. I was having a blast with my friends from the industry. Then, in my haste to check out for a flight, I left my prized suit coat hanging in the closet! I noticed it as it was getting too cold at the airport and it wasn't in my bags. I called the Loss Prevention team at the Marriott and spoke with Jonathan Savinovich. He said I found your coat and if you send me a FedEx label via email I will have it sent to you! Immediately I had confirmation from Jonathan and Norberto (they took a picture of the sealed box) that it was on the way. The anxiety was gone. There was so many staff to thank but at the end of the day I wanted to say this in writing. I hope you can read it guys. All the best! . . . . . . .

Everyone at the hotel was very helpful and pleasant, even though we were only there for one night. We were traveling with our brother in law and he has stayed at your Hotel for the last several years. Even though there was a Boating Show that weekend we did manage to get reservations for dinner which was lovely.

The hotel cancelled our reservation on us day prior to arrival. It would make a lot more sense to reach out to the guest to update credit card information rather than canceling the reservation and emailing them a cancellation notice and that their reservation is not able to be reinstated . Just glad I saw the email before I left for the trip. Sad that we had to cancel our trip. Wouldn’t trust the hotel with a reservation going forward.

I really liked the hotel and specially one of the staff who was very helpful his name is yazdi patel .Hi assisted me with my package and offered to take it with me and i asked about few places to visit he took the time to explain to me how to get there and wich one shoud i visit first .thanks mr yazdi patel

A quick getaway over Thanksgiving for my partner and I…This Marriott is undergoing a bunch of renovation work and it needs it. The hotel is near the cruise terminal and hosts a good share of folks and families who are cruise bound which is fine. The restaurant needs work, the pool and hot tub area need a total refresh/ redo and overall, the facility is tired…rooms were typical Marriott but the bathrooms need to be redone and modernized. There was a great Italian coffee cafe on the ground level inside the front entry which was wonderful. The neighboring properties need some TLC as well but all in all, it’s a tired facility…

Yazdi Patel And the staff at Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay were amazing! Super helpful when I needed things shipped home and had issues with my travel! Can't say enough about the services! The property is so beautiful!

Had a great time here recently staying overnight for a wedding from 2/11-2/13. The views are fantastic and the venue for the ceremony was all we could have hoped for. The staff did an amazing job organizing the venue and the bartender staff was also excellent. About an hour after checking out and right before leaving, I remembered I had forgotten my laptop in my room. I was in a hurry to the airport so I ran back inside and found our bellman Jose Diaz who I went to for help. He swiftly got me back up to the room, unlocked it, and I got my laptock back. Jose was super helpful and kind during our entire stay. You all have a really good one here! Give the guy a raise/promotion!

Like many others in the hospitality and F&B field. You can tell the hotel is struggling. However our Valet Alex, and Bellmen Jose Perez where fantastic very attentive and remembered my family and I through the stay.

I traveled here with family over Christmas, and I can honestly say, as a Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite member, this experience made me want to transition to a different hotel brand. Here are just some of the issues we encountered: -First room we checked into had a broken sliding door to the balcony (which was inaccessible due to renovation) so the room was open to the outside with no way to close it. This room also had ripped and stained sheets and was generally run down. The hotel moved us to a second room after we complained -The hotel is under construction and many advertised amenities such as the pool and hot tub are closed. Balconies are inaccessible due to scaffolding -After being told we could self-park in the garage, we returned to find out that unannounced, the garage was closed due to construction and we would need to valet. Valet-ing a rental car is stressful enough, but it was worse when we saw the valet drivers speeding around tight turns in a car that I was responsible for. After reaching out in person at the desk upon checkout, I was told there was nobody from management to speak with. I called the main Marriott number when I got home, and after they opened a case, I was emailed by KEVIN GEUDTNER with an apology and offer to credit me points to make up for the bad stay. It's now 2 months later, and I realized last week I was never credited the points I was supposed to get. I called the main Marriott number, and opened another case, and was emailed by Isaac Soria, who stated he would credit me an even greater number of points, and apologized again. We are several days past that point now, and I still haven't been credited the points I was supposed to. This must be some kind of game the hotel plays, where they just keep promising imaginary points and then hope you give up. I implore anyone going to Miami to find a different place to stay and save yourself the headache and frustration.

La atención en la carpeta específicamente al solicitar la opción de un late check out el trato de la mujer que me atendió ( mayorie) nefasta y desagradable. Inicialmente le pregunté por la opción de salir más tarde me dijo que podía salir a las 12. Más tarde pregunté la opción de pagar un extra por tener la habitación hasta las 5 de la tarde , a un compañero, algo que ofrecen Y aceptan muchísimos hoteles en todo el mundo, ella se entrometió y con malas formas le dijo q a partir de las 12 había q pagar la habitación completa. Asumí que no había posibilidad salvo que me guardaran las maletas en la carpeta hasta mi partida. Realice el check out a las 11:30 y no se aclaraban sobre los cargos de mi habitación esta mujer nuevamente se entrometió en las tareas del compañero que estaba atendiéndome. Fue muy desagradable ciertamente. Una lastima porque el hotel es muy lindo , el maletero jose me atendió excelentemente y aunque la habitación no es nada del otro mundo las vistas son maravillosas .

This hotel is tired and needs to be updated. The concierge was off on a Wednesday so we had no help there. It’s truly disappointing. There was no water or regular coffee in the room. The bathroom is small and outdated. I would not recommend it here. The bar closes at 11 and that’s too early. The food stops at 11. Went to a concert and wanted a snack and drinks

Tuvimos una incidencia con la limpieza y funcionamiento del cuadro eléctrico en la habitación que nos asignaron. Se comunicó en la recepción y el señor José Pérez se encargó de cambiarnos de habitación la , cuál contaba con unas vistas preciosas. Un agradecimiento especial para él.

El hotel está bien pero tienen que remodelarlo poco a poco, ya se siente viejo y las habitaciones tienen detalles de descuido. La ubicación está bien si vas a salir de crucero. Esta cerca de las terminales. Tema aparte: Pedimos el arroz teriyaki a la habitación y estaba completamente crudo, muy muy mal.

Siempre Marriott nos deja con la mejor experiencia! Desde el desayuno y el servicio dentro del restaurante! Las habitaciones siempre perfectas. El servicio del valet parking fue espectacular todos los días! Excelente servicio! Solo que nos faltó el servicio de habitaciones!

Péssima experiência Las fotos no condicen con la realidad, hotel viejo, sucio, los personales no están capacitados y no respetan al cliente.. Los muebles son viejos, la tele no funciona, y el baño sale agua sucia. El olor es desagradable, así como las recepcionistas.

Fea sorpresa ! Acompañé a mi hija a hacer su check in el 20/6/21. O sea actualmente esta hospedada allí. Y la recepcionista nos comenta mientras nos recibe y describe los amenities, que en el hotel no había limpieza diaria de habitación. Ni diaria ni nada que al 6 * día porque ella se quedará 10 le harán , un servicio de cambio de sabanas y una única limpieza. Después de esto no se puede esperar mucho más. Si no hubiera sido que yo ya me estaba volviendo a Buenos Aires, en ese mismo momento me iba a buscar otro hotel. ESTEN ATENTOS, es un hotel sin servicio de LIMPIEZA !!!!! TOTALMENTE SORPRENDIDA Y DECEPCIONADA. Me gustaría recibir alguna explicación del manager. Gracias.

Estuvimos en este hotel y nos encontramos con un hotel viejo, en mal estado y sucio. Nos quedamos allí por dos noches, y la habitación jamás la fueron a arreglar, por aquí no pasó nunca la camarera. En la habitación del frente de la nuestra encontramos una bolsa con basura que seguramente había sido dejado allí por los huéspedes de esa habitación, la cual permaneció en el mismo sitio durante nuestras dos noches. El hotel no tiene wifi gratis, el mini bar es vacío, las toallas del baño están viejas, ya delgadas y con manchas, al igual que el estado del baño con la cortina del baño manchada y todo en general muy viejo. El precio de este hotel no corresponde con lo que ofrece. No volveré jamás y no se lo recomiendo a nadie.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I can't believe I'm staying at a Hilton Hotel! I've never seen anything like this in terms of bad service! At Check-in we were attended by the employee Deidre with no courtesy, bad temper and no manners - no training by the Hilton? Today at 5:05 PM, our room still hadn't been cleaned. Again we spoke to the receptionist Deidre, who simply said that she had "nothing" to do. There was no more Housekeeping!!! Incredible! This is not Hilton standard! want pictures of the room?

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: An all around well-managed facility. Much more attractive than the drab entry would lead you to expect. Bright, clean and well planned common areas. Good security . Nice small pool and hot tub with a bar for happy hour. Room was exceptionally well appointed, good lighting and layout. There was an AC prob first nite that sounded like a commercial vac was running thru the ducts the middle of the night(so no sleep). Resolved by the second nite. Front desk staff was not particularly friendly and acted like they were doing us a HUGE favor granting a 30 minute later checkout. We are Diamond members and expect better. Later discovered we could have paid a (smallish) sum to extend our stay several hours, this option was. not offered. There is an open air pub affiliated with the hotel on street level, also a good Cuban and Asian adjacent to the property. Walking distance to all nitelife,shopping and public transport. Fee for parking. Very pricey in season, but in line with similar accomodations in the Brickell neighborhood. Plan to stay again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We were pleased to stay in this excellent hotel which was clean, safe and affordable! We were able to conveniently take the Orange Line Metro from the airport after a long flight from San Francisco to our hotel after only a short walk. The room and entire hotel were very clean and inviting. The breakfast the next morning was superb. It was a buffet near the reception area that was not crowded nor cluttered. The guests could also eat in a quiet area near the beautiful pool. This hotel looks out upon an architecturally restored elementary school in the bustling downtown Brickell area. The reception personnel gave us their suggestions for finding a restaurant and we were well pleased with the results. At breakfast the next day, other guests were also pleased w/ the recommendation of a seafood restaurant. I was pleased to meet Mr. Armando Cervera, Dir. of Safety, so that I could thank him for the professional level of security that I felt in and around this fine hotel. I received extra assistance from two professional housekeeping staff: one helped procure a "Do not disturb" doorhanger and one personally went with me to the correct floor after calling the front desk to confirm my room number as I had remembered the incorrect floor!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Atención de primera, clara comunicación, limpio y ordenado. Un buen sitio para estar con la familia al tener piscina y jacuzzi. Te guardan el equipaje en caso necesites un poco de tiempo antes de retirarte del hotel. El desayuno fue de primera y bien limpio.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Servicio del personal de recepción y cocina absolutamente excelente: amables, cordiales y muy dispuestos a ayudar y resolver nuestros requerimientos. Luz y Vivian en cocina y Victoria, Deirdre y Claudia en recepción impecables. Tiene desayuno incluido que es bastante bueno. Tremenda ubicación a pasos del centro y al lado de estación de metro. Recomendable 100%

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Es una muy buena opción para quien quiera alojarse en plena zona Brickell . Lo están remodelando y está muy bien . Solo me incomodo que no limpien todos los días en forma obligatoria . Te lo informan cuando ingresas

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Estuve por temas de trabajo, pero, que puedo decir de este hotel, excelente servicio, excelentes instalaciones, excelente ubicación, precio asequible, excelente atenciones, la habitacion excelente y amplia, etc. Ubicado en el downtown desde donde puedes moverte caminando a importantes lugares de la ciudad como es el CITY CENTER BRICKELL, la Pequeña Habana, Bayside, restaurantes, etc. Será una de mis primeras opciones las siguiente vez que visite la ciudad.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Buen servicio , buena ubicación , habitación perfecta , desayuno muy bueno recomendable 100% instalaciones muy acogedoras , el personal amable , servicial , nos ayudaron en todo , parking barato para la zona

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente trato, ubicación e instalaciones!! Habitaciones renovadas e impecables, personal amable y atento. El hotel esta ubicado al alcance de todo. El desayuno es muy bueno y tiene servicio de parking.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Buena ubicación, hotel clásico con todos los servicios. Desayuno medio acotado, pero dentro de todo buen servicio. Estuve 6 noches por trabajo y la verdad que también podrían dejar al menos un agua en el frigobar de cortesía por más qué hay máquina en el pasillo.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Muy buena la atención del personal y la ubicación La habitación un poco pobre Máquina de hielo no funcionaba y la habitación no tenía frigobar Por Covid no hay limpieza de las habitaciones, y complica

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente ubicación , el desayuno que incluye esta súper bien , los cuartos de buen tamaño y limpios … lo único malo es que no hacen el aseo ! Pero me encanto la ubicación , lo recomiendo mucho por eso

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel se encuentra muy ubicado para poder salir a comer, hacer ejercicios o y hasta el Mall. Las habitaciones son cómodas y el servicio de limpieza impecable. Excelente atención por parte de todo el personal.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel es muy limpio y el personal muy amable y atenta, me ayudaron con mis inquietudes y solicitudes. El desayuno fue bueno y siempre había mínimo una persona a cargo de rellenar. La habitación muy limpia y cómoda

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Bajo pretexto del covid ha bajado mucho en servicios y calidad. La habitación la limpian cada tercer día a las 5 de la tarde. El desayuno ha bajado a su mínima expresión. Las toallas y las sábanas raspan, usen un poco decsuavizante y compren de mejor calidad. Disminuyeron la cantidad de canales de la televisión. Te piden que uses mascarilla, si embargo mucha gente va sin ella por el hotel y nadie les dice nada. Bajó todo menos el precio, ese se mantiene elevado.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Las instalaciones y habitaciones son lindas. Buena atención, buena limpieza y ubicacion. El desayuno es el mismo todos los días por lo que no es recomendable si viajas más de dos dias. Se siente un poco de ruido en las habitaciones por los vehículos que pasan por las vias

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente servicio, amabilidad del personal, limpieza de las habitaciones, amplias, variedad en el menú del desayuno. Buena ubicación, gran variedad de restaurantes cerca, servicio de transporte muy cercano.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Desayuno regular y si vas menos de tres noches no te arreglan la habitación. El sitio del hotel es muy bueno porque tienes restaurantes y almacenes para conocer caminando. Queda muy cerca al aeropuerto

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: No ofrecen ningún servicio. Una muy desagradable experiencia. Me sentí estafado. Estaba sucio, terribles ruidos. Un desastre de experiencia y una vergüenza para Hilton. Dan ganas de nunca volver a un Hilton.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Con la disculpa de COVID, no prestan servicio de limpieza de cuartos a pesar de estar 3 días alojado. Con esas condiciones es preferible usar una alternativa de ArBnb. La limpieza deja mucho que desear.

Realmente una muy mala decision tomar este hotel , En el check in me dijeron que mi tarjeta no pasaba y me pidieron que la pase de nuevo y de nuevo , paso 5 veces y a la quinta con otra maquina paso Tuve los fondos ( varios miles de dolares ) retenidos en proceso lo que sobregiro mi tarjeta de credito y me impidio usarla este dia para alquiler de auto y me impidió pagar con este método de pago mi siguiente reserva en otro hotel después . Durante mi estadía pase horas por telefono con mi banco a tratar de resolver el problema , genial . En fin me desgraciaron el viaje al cargar miles de dólares que no me fueron devueltos quizas nunca no lo se porque es todo un proceso entre bancos que esta en tramite y no se resuelve en 3 días . Que hicieron para compensarme todo este problema aparte enviar un correo a mi banco no me ofrecieron ni una rebaja en la tarifa . Increíble . Me fregaron la tarjeta no pude ni alquilar carro ni moverme del hotel hasta encontrar una manera de conseguir fondos y no te dan ni un centavo de rebaja es hallucinante . .Muy mala atención de la manager Ruby a la hora del check out que no ofreció nada a parte contactar mi banco lo que es su deber no un favor . El hotel es muy ruidoso a toda hora de la noche gritan en los pasillos , no es para familia Le falta mantenimiento en todas las áreas es muy viejo y no muy bien cuidado . .No vayan en este hotel ni gratis y si van por tercos lleven efectivo porque para pagar con tarjeta es la ruleta rusa . A huir definitivamente hay mucho mejor en la zona .

Excelente opción No está en la playa pero si te gusta Miami para shopping y otras cosas que no sea playa esta es una buena opción El hotel está en buen estado, a pesar de sus años, los cuartos y servicios de muy buena calidad El area de alberca pues tiene el problema de que a cierta hora, muy temprano se queda sin sol pero es un problema literal en Miami Cerca de muchos restaurantes y bares Área tranquila Te cobran el estacionamiento

If you expect something extra you would be disappointed. Room was ok , ac worked , bed was comfy . Balkony is nice , if you do not mind you see everything going on in next building . After all it cpuld be more entertaining than watching TV. And you can live life comedy if you ask cleaning lady to clean the room. She told us that she cleaned one bed only because to clean two beds is too much for her .:)))))

Stayed here and my experience was overall very good. The front desk staff were excellent and friendly as was all the staff that I interacted with. The hotel itself is looking a little dated. The location is good. Try to get a bay view. Walking to and from Venetian Island was a great way to stretch out your legs. The gym had everything I needed. The pool area was nice.

I would highly recommend this hotel. Their service is awesome!!! Everyone was polite and helped in anyway that they could. I will definitely be back anytime I visit Miami, and the view to my room was amazing.

I booked a double bed, high floor, bay view with a balcony. I was told over the phone by a customer service rep that ALL bay view rooms come with a balcony. I later learned that was not the case. When I checked into the room it did not have a balcony. I briefly spoke with Ruby at the front desk who initially told me they didn’t have any rooms with balconies available. Although that is what I booked. I asked her to call me to discuss as I was rushing out to an appointment. After several hours I called back and she told me she had the only one in the entire hotel on hold for us and we could switch rooms when we return to the hotel. We did that and although we now have a balcony, our views are mostly the hotel next door, pool and a partial bay view. Fine. I find out later balcony rooms only have the partial bay view. False advertising but whatever. I get into bed and notice it’s not the standard queen size but a FULL size bed. I was very uncomfortable. How can two adults sleep in a full size bed. Nevertheless I go sleep and wake up at 3am (and I’m still up writing this review it’s now 8am) I have never experienced such a horrible sleep. My back is killing me. I got up to see my son sleeping on the floor so I go downstairs at 4am and Jenny helped me to get a rollaway bed and explained to me that in this hotel all double bed rooms have full size beds. So there was no switching rooms to a queen double. It doesn’t exist. Both Jenny and Ruby were very professional and helpful. The gentlemen who brought up the bed was also very helpful. We have traveled with our sons or many years and always request a double bed room. They are ALWAYS queen size. Also the comforter was so thin I thought they weren’t allowing for down comforters because of COVID but when I looked closer the comforter was in fact down but flat and lacked feathers. Probably very old. Not plush and comfy at all. On another note the hotel was clean & staff was friendly. Needless to say I will not be staying here ever again. The photo of the down comforter is not dirty. The darker color is where the feathers are.

I stayed here the night before a cruise and it was an excellent location. There is a Publix nearby for any last-minute items (and/or your soda and wine). Nice and close to the cruise terminals. I could see the ships from my suite. We booked a suite with our points and got a great room with access to the club lounge. The snacks provided in the lounge were okay but the access was nice since we arrived at the hotel before we were able to check-in. The hotel lobby was clean and modern. Breakfast was a bit pricey but there was a ton of food and options. There's also a beautiful pool with a pool bar and hot tub.

We stayed 2 couples on the 7th March 2020 for one night pre-cruise,when we checked in, the receptionist asked us for our credit card just in case anything was charged during our stay which there was not. The Hotel staff were friendly and we enjoyed our stay. But on the 28th March we noticed that the hotel had taken for the two rooms which had already been paid for before our stay. We contacted them this was there reply Thank you for reaching out to us regarding an additional charge from our Miami Marriott Biscayne Bay. I would be delighted to assist you. I am very sorry for this additional charge. The hotel has replied to this case and stated that they stated that hey have submitted to have this refund processed. Please allow up to 90 days refund to be received; We have sent a number of emails and we still have not received our refund as a result I will not be returning or recommending this hotel a very frustrated customer

We had the pleasure of meeting Mr. Yazdi in the lobby and he went over and beyond to help and accommodate us with our needs even though the hotel was limited on resources. I thank you for your kindness Mr. Yazdi.

It was a great stay before our cruise. The staff was very friendly. The food in the dining area was good and little to no wait. The room was small but the view was amazing. I will stay again in the future.

We found this Marriott on line while looking for a hotel near the pier for our cruise. Jose Perez, a baggage handler and recommender of restaurants, met us at the door. While chatting with him, he recommended an Italian restaurant near to the hotel and also told us about a connecting small mall to the hotel. He also recommended the hotel restaurant, Catch, which was also very good with an excellent breakfast buffet. The hotel room was very comfortable with all the ammenities that one expects from a Marriott. The room was chilly for us; we asked for and received an extra blanket. My husband usually does an excellent job of checking the room when we are leaving. I had placed some personal clothing items in a cabinet which he overlooked in his checking out; I also forgot to look in there. I didn't realize the items were missing until we were at sea. After returning home to Virginia, I called the Marriott to ask about the missing items and was referred to the security office. Roberto answered the phone and did in fact locate the items in the Lost & Found place. He gave me his email address to send to him with all my contact information. I miswrote the address and sent it into the netherland of lost emails. When I didn't hear back or receive the items, I called again. This time I spoke with Luis. Both Roberto and Luis were patient, kind, and very helpful. I gave Luis my address; he promised to send the items by FedEx. Again I didn't get the items so called again about two weeks later and talked with Victor who answered the phone; he is the Supervisor of the Security Office at the Marriott. He was very apologic, found the items in a returned FedEx package with a single misspelling in the address (one letter M instead of two). He sent the items in an overnight express package, gave me his full name and phone number and told me to call him if the items weren't delivered the next day. They came!! My sincere appreciation to Roberto, Luis, and Victor for their excellet manner and dedication to their jobs. From Jose at the front door to the worker bees in the Security Department go my heartfelt thanks for jobs well-done!!

I’m really appreciate for having Mr.Norberto as a helpful and approachable hotel staff. I had a package arrived later than my checkout date, I called the hotel, the reception is very helpful and friendly to help me redirect the call to Mr. Norberto who’s in charge of the case. Mr. Norberto take very good care of my package and agreed to wait for me till next time I return to Miami to pick it up, and due to the circumstances that Covid-19 Virus has cost,I couldn’t travel to Miami this month, Mr.Norberto even provide a solution for me that he would like to send the package to me without any hesitation. I really appreciate the efforts, thank you very much Please stay safe and healthy, I cannot wait to visit Miami again. Emily Hsu

Las habitaciones me parecieron viejas y descuidadas en mantenimiento. Me tocó una habitación donde había ruido constante, lo manifeste y me dijeron que no tenían otra que ofrecer pues por la época alta había poca disponibilidad. La tarifa que me habían dado la variaron de una manera excesiva. Me atrajeron con 313 dólares la primera noche para acabar em 567 dólares la tercera noche. Desgraciadamente ya había comprometido asuntos de trabajo en el hotel y no podía cambiarme pero lo hubiera hecho por el costo tan elevado que no incluía desayuno. Lo único bueno es que tienes vista el mar pero lo demás. Malooo. Mejor buscar otra opción y disfrutar la playa de otra manera.

El hotel está bien ubicado cerca del centro de Miami y muy cerca del puerto de embarque de cruceros, justamente la decisión de tomarlo era por la cercanía al puerto. No es un hotel nuevo ya tiene sus añitos y se nota en algunos temas como el baño que a mi gusto ya requiere una remodelación. La habitación es de buen tamaño y algo a destacar es que puedes conectarte a netflix que ahora a mi entender es fundamental en los hoteles. Tome la tarifa con desayuno incluido y no me arrepiento el bufete muy bueno con variedad para todos los gustos. Resumiendo es un buen hotel, bien ubicado con detalles a mejorar.

Salimos de la habitación a las 10 de la mañana y nuestra habitación no fue limpiada sobre eso preguntamos por parqueo y nos dijeron que solo estaba el valet parking entonces eso hicimos cuando luego los dimos cuenta que uno podía parquer por su cuenta y el valet era un servicio adicional.

Ruidoso, en una zona peligrosa, la piscina es una charca, las colas para dejar la habitación son interminables, y el trato del personal deja mucho que desear. El desayuno está muy bien, muy completo. El room service te lo dan en una bolsa de papel, ni bandeja ni nada

Muy buena atención de Junior y Alberto sobretodo en el alquiler de las bicis incluso nos dieron solución aún no teniendo datos en América también nos dijeron un buen sitio para comprar lo cual es de agradecer.

Llegamos el día 27 de diciembre. A las 20:00 hrs confiados de ingresar directamente a nuestra habitación. Pues error fue a las 23:00 hrs. Habitación no estaba lista al igual que muchos otros pasajeros. Personal de recepción no daba soluciones concretas. Cero consideración en hablar español. Ni siquiera la supervisora. Por otra parte Sra Marjorie de concierge Lounge con actitud casi matonesca. Lo que ofrecen en concierge lounge vip, lugar sucio y casi sin reposición de alimentos. No volveria

ëxtasis total la vista que tiene este lugar. Mucha belleza conjugada en una sola Bahia. Vale la pena a cualquier hora del día pero por la noche es épico. Show de luces que se reflejan en el agua, con un clima una emeratura todo el año que permite disfrutar siempre.

Bonito hotel, limpio, habitaciones grandes y con vista a la bahia, buena comida pero el agua cara $ 5 una botella, buena atencion aunque no todos los empleados del counter hablaban espanol. Buena ubicacion ademas. Recomendado.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Es permitido fumar marihuana en miami pero dentro del hotel o habitaciones no me parece. No estoy de acuerdo en eso. Para lo demás todo muy bien limpio y perfecto, termómetros de temperatura o más gel sería bueno.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Es un hotel muy viejo, donde todo esta feo o maltrecho, le falta una renovación urgente, las camas viejas, todo esta pasado de uso. Se ve feo y el entorno no hace que uno se sienta limpio. Me parece un hotel demasiado caro para tan malas instalaciones

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Pasamos 6 días en el hotel y quedé absolutamente sorprendido con el servicio, todos muy atentos, educados y cordiales; tratando de ver siempre cómo ayudarte. Las medidas de seguridad q han implementado son simples pero efectivas. La ubicación del hotel es céntrica, cerca de todos lados y las habitaciones e instalaciones en general muy bien cuidadas. Dentro del servicio outstanding que recibimos de todos los empleados, quisiera resaltar el de Victoria y Beatriz en el front desk...eso hace una gran diferencia y de seguro q volveremos!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Solo informan que no asearán las habitaciones todos los días ya cuando ya se ha realizado el check in y se ha pagado por la estadía . Desayuno malo todo el empacado en bolsas. Muy poca variedad. Muy alta la tarifa para los servicios ofrecidos.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Encantada con todo. Lobby muy limpio, organizado y bonito. La habitación contaba con lo necesario, limpia y amplia. El personal muy amable y atento. La ubicación bastante céntrica, cerca de bares, food truck, mercado y otras cosas que cualquier viajero necesitaría.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Nos entregaron la habitación antes de la hora señalada. En la salida nos dejaron quedarnos hasta la 1:00 pm sin costo adicional. Esto para nosostros hace la diferencia de lo q significa servicio y comodidad para el pasajero. Volveremos de todas maneras.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente ubicación a 15 minutos en auto de cualquier lugar turístico. Además, Brickell como tal es un sector lleno de restaurantes y sitios por visitar y con un súper centro comercial a un par de cuadras. Personal amable, instalaciones antiguas pero bien mantenidas y acogedoras. La piscina es pequeña pero un lugar lindo para fotografías. Habitación cómoda con secador, plancha, máquina de café y sus cápsulas. El wi-fi funciona perfecto en todo el hotel. Por mejorar solo el desayuno ya que es poco saludable, pero en general súper, súper recomendado!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: La estadía fue de regular a buena, lamentablemente por la Covid 19 no se disfrutaron de todos los servicios y, algunos fueron recortados por la seguridad de los huéspedes. Es entendible, sin embargo el desayuno se puede mejorar, la ubicación y la relación precio producto es muy buena. Lamentablemente también recortaron los servicios a la habitación que fueron muy extrañados en la estadía pero, en general, un lugar bueno donde pueden disfrutar desde familia y amigos. Ubicación muy buena.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Es un excelente Hotel, la transportación pública a pocos pasos , todo queda a pocos pasos del hotel. El personal es muy amable. El hotel es 3 estrellas pero el trató la ubicación y el servicio es de 5 estrellas. Definitivamente voy a regresar.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Stayed here r4ecently, and the staff and hotel are clean and nice... Huge room with nice bed, desk, as well as huge bathroom... Perfect location, right in the middle of all that Brickell has to offer. Metro Rail and free Metro Mover are only a block away... I will most definitely be returning...

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I stayed in this hotel for a week. The staff was very helpful and they help me with an upgrade when I explained a personal situation.the hotel has a recycling program and takrs excellent measures due to Covid 19. The rooms are confortable and quiet. I will definetively return.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Es un lugar céntrico, cerca de todo, si lo que necesitas es moverte hacia cualquier lugar es ideal. La atención del personal es muy buena. Dejamos algo en la caja fuerte, di aviso, regresamos y allí estaba todo sin inconvenientes.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Nos alojamos en el Hampton Inn Downtown Brickell por las reseñas en Tripadvisor, cuando llegamos al hotel efectivamente queda en el downtown cerca de todo, pero en una calle oscura y nada bonita, apenas entramos al hotel nos dimos cuenta que no fue una buena decisión, tiene una decoración de mal gusto y el ambiente es extraño, las habitaciones necesitan urgentemente una renovación, alfombras desgastadas con olor a humedad, baño anticuado, no tienen mini refrigerador y ni siquiera televisor de inteligente, no me volvería a alojar en ese hotel ni se lo recomiendo a nadie que viaje con familia, el ambiente no te hacía sentir seguro no cómodo

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I loved nearly everything about this hotel. The location was prime for downtown Miami. Our room was 1622 - fridge and microwave included. I like that our hotel key was required to get to our floor for safety reasons. We were extremely close to the Metromover & Trolleys. We always felt safe walking to the store (7-11 or Publix) or from the Brickell station at night. BUT, sand (actual sand from the the beach) was on the sheets when I pulled the comforter back. This made me question the cleanliness of our room. We had not gone to the beach and I was just turning the covers back. I called the front desk immediately. New sheets were brought up. The young man at the desk apologized and offered to switch our rooms but it was a little after 10 p.m. and after a long day of travel, my kids were already asleep in their bed. Again, the sand is my bed was noticeable and can only be explained as a failure to change bed linen. Normally, this would result in a much lower rating, but the hotel seemed to hit the mark on every other aspect. Plus, I used disinfectant that I brought from home (per usual). I liked the different containers for used and sanitized ink pens and the breakfast setup which required guests to tell gloved and masked employees what they wanted. All meals were then bagged and handed to guests. The pool is on the small side but when we my son went, he was the only one there so it was perfect. Also, the pool area has nice lounging furniture for when we just wanted fresh air without leaving the property. When I return to the area, I will definitely consider this property again. We used the Metromover a few times and it was very convenient. I don’t think we fully utilized the free transportation system though. We relied on Uber/Lyft quite a bit. Other than location, the best thing about this property is the employees! They were all phenomenal (concierge, doormen/women, front desk members (who greeted us every morning for breakfast and handled all of our needs quickly), and breakfast and cleaning staff! All smiles and a sincere desire to make our stay memorable. Overall, a solid property and good vacation.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Nice hotel, friendly staff, good American breakfast, we stayed there 2 nights. We will stay there again, good service! We stayed with our family. We recommend you to stay there! It in the heart of downtown.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel está muy bien localizado y el servicio del personal es muy bueno. Está cerca del Consulado mexicano y del downtown en Brickell. Hay muy buenos restaurante en loa alrededores y shopping mall. La vista del room es hermosa.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: This by far is the nicest, cleanest and most up to date Hampton Inn I’ve ever stayed in. Front Desk staff were very customer service friendly and made it a point to welcome you. The Operational Manager Victoria Greber had her desk up front and interacted with guests and helping the staff with check outs. She was available for questions and had a very pleasant and welcoming attitude about her. The hotel was spotless !! Staff was continually wiping down and cleaning public areas. The rooms were fresh, crisp, clean and up to date !! The breakfast staff (the two women) were outstanding !! They remembered me from the previous visits. They greeted each and every guest with a smile and a good morning, they went out of their way to accommodate people’s requests. I highly recommend ‘this’ Hampton Inn & Suites.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We moved to Miami from Mexico City as part of my job’s relocation. We were housed the first two weeks here while I got basics for my new and current home just one block away. Today, I see this hotel from my terrace. My office is also just four blocks away. Great hotel. We were surprised as I travel (pre Covid) often on business. Our Miami house hunting trip housed us at Four Seasons. We appreciated the free breakfast, reasonable pricing for food and drinks, newspaper and service all around that was excellent. Great front desk, security guards, barmen, servers, housekeepers. We stiil credit this hotel with our success in feeling confortable as we relocated.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Although we were unable to visit this hotel due to travel restrictions following COVID-19' they were very understanding about our circumstances and refunded our room very promptly. Thank you for your understanding.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I stayed here for a night prior to my cruise in October and December 2019. Room was comfortable. Enjoyed a free drink at the bar as a Hilton Diamond Member. I didn't try the complimentary breakfast so can't comment on it. They offer transport to the Miami cruise port for a fee that was very reasonable. The gym was great, clean, and had all the needed equipment. 2 thumbs up!

Excelente hotel, habitaciones grandes cama muy cómoda 2 versiones de almohadas. con vista espectacular hacia la bahía.Muy buen customer service. Al lado de la bahía muchas opciones de restaurantes fuera del hotel. El desayuno muy rico.

Excelente atencion y muy bonito hotel, tanto bar como restaurante muy comodos y boniots, la ubicacion perfecta, una vista y acceso al mar incomparable, la atencion de Roberto Cordova de lo mejor, nos asistio pronta y amablemente, muy recomendado.

Típico hotel estadounidense, máquina de vending y de hielo en cada planta, servicio correcto, personal amable, pero sin ser extraordinario.recomiendo comer fuera, o pedir UBER EATS en vez de pedir room service.

Hermoso lugar y paseo para recomendar todo impecable,muchas gracias antes no lo conocía hay montón de lugares para n ir descubriendo en Miami south beach viajo todos los años a south Miami beach para mi ,sin duda nunca me aburriría

El Sr. Alvaro del poormap, excelente servicio. Gracias. Muy agradecido y excelente servicio, la del counter la Srta. Sharon muy servicial y amable. El hotel muy limpio, excepto la parte donde se fuma frente al lobby principal muy sucio, nesecita mas cariño. Gracias por la estadía. 👌😉🕶🍻

Te entregan la habitación así y se quedan tan anchos. They give you the room like that. Increible. Unbelievable. Ni un aviso, ni una disculpa. No warnings and no apologies. Cada visita a este hotel es aún peor que la anterior

Cada dia me arrepiento mas de ser propietario Marriott y ahora miembro Bonvoy, no entiendo porque esta cadena en vez de querer venderle cada dia a uno mas cosas, no se preocupan por el servicio, en este hotel NO te arreglan la habitación antes de 12:00 del medio dia, toca rogar por toallas y amenities en los baños, las sabanas estan rotas, la amabilidad de atención al telefono no la conocen, y ni hablar sel roomservice una total porqueria, Bovoy debería preocuparse mas por tenernos contentos a los miembros en vez de querer vedernos mas cosas, me voy con el peor sabor de este hotel, espero no tener que utilizarlo nunca jamas.

Wi Fi malo e intermitente, queda el magnifico trato de todo el personal,de primera,desde el Check inn hasta nuestra salida,una Señora muy amable y cortes mas eficiente,la Sra Gina. Sera cosa de invertir,sino es muy caro por las otras alternativas,en nuestro caso ya vinimos 5 veces y no nos gustaria cambiar

Bien localizado y personal amable ofrecer variedad de desayunos y hay muchos restaurantes cerca tambien estan cerca la Cvs y wholefoods tiene police y biller una alberca padrisima vale la pena hospedarse Los cuartos son de lujo

La habitación muy limpia, grande y cómoda. Las vistas a la bahía muy buenas. El personal del hotel muy atento y amable. El restaurante muy bueno y con calidad. Tuvieron un pequeño despiste a la hora de servirnos el desayuno, pero supieron reaccionar y solucionar de manera correcta. Volvería sin dudarlo

Uno de los hoteles más ruidosos de Miami. Imposible dormir sin tapones. A la chica de recepción le pedimos una habitación silenciosa y su respuesta fue que no sabía, que ella no dormía en ellas. Muy desagradables en general. Las habitaciones antiguas

La habitación muy cómoda limpia amplia, excelente vista al muelle, la ubicación excelente, el personal en el lobby sobre todo el Sr. Alberto A. excelente guía, me recomendó, restaurantes, playas y lugares para visitar en Miami.

Fue realmente increíble haberme alojado aquí. Un lujo!! Piscina en 5to piso, vista espectacular desde la habitación. Lobby superconfortable...estaba comunicado con el Omni Mall en su momento. Fui en 1993 en mi primera visita a Miami. Inolvidable!

Quiero felicitarlos por el excelente servicio, el apoyo incondicional con los clientes es muy valioso, recibimos toda la atención de Roberto Córdova quien nos colaboró de una forma muy eficiente y quedamos muy complacidos. Mil gracias!!

Un poco anticuadas las habitaciones, pero con muy buena ubicacion y espectacular restaurante. El costo no es de lo mas economico, pero siempre vale la pena un Marriott. Excelente el personal de servicio, en especial Yazdi Patel, Ruben Colen y Norberto Pagan.

El edificio denota sus años, la puerta a terraza corre mal y no cierra --> ruido exterior; el baño debe dar paso a una buena ducha. La habitación la limpian a su manera y cuando quieren (un día de los 7 que estuvimos ni pasaron). El vidrio de las ventanas no se limpia desde hace tiempo. Los pasillos huelen a comida. El personal de recepción muy bien, el del comedor a reeducar, empezando por la cocinera del desayuno (que se molesta si le pides una tortilla y encima la hace, la deja sobre el mostrador y ni avisa) El resto del personal del comedor es como mucho "buena gente", necesitan que un profesional de la hostelería les instruya en servicio y atención. Lo cierto es que está muy bien situado y mejoraría mucho con una pequeña reforma de habitaciones y preparación hostelera del personal de comedor y habitaciones.

El Hotel no esta muy bien ubicado , el desayuno es correcto , personal amable En este hotel se oyen las sirenas de los barcos , los aviones pasando por encima toda la noche etc.. Es una pena que no insonorice. Las habitaciones de los hoteles

Enorme hotel con habitaciones amplias aunque algo anticuadas. Baño necesita alguna reforma y no existen cargadores usb en al menos el cuarto que yo estuve. Desayuno tipo buffet correcto en sala tremendamente ruidosa. Su clientela es es su mayoría turista de cruceros. Lo mejor su personal amable y siempre con ganas de agradar y ayudar al cliente.

Inmenso, habitaciones enormes en un edificio de 20 plantas o más. Confortables, gran baño sensible de ser reformado en breve. No es mi tipo de hotel: faraónico, espacios enormes, impersonal. Lo peor: internet no gratuita en las habitaciones. Me parece un absoluto desfase.

Recien el sabado pasado trabaje en el Hotel para un evento que se realizo , y durante el tiemnpo que estuve trabajando , cuidaba de mi monedero que estuviera seguro, resulta que al llegare a mi casa, al otro dia me doy cuanta que no lo tenia, pues comence a buscarlo por tadas partes , hasta que me llego la idea de ir abuscarlo donde creia que podia estar, en el hotel, para mi sorpresa , cuando llego y despues de hacer algunas averiguaciones, pues lo encontre y por esta via quiero agradecerle a Junior Valet, gracias por tu atencion y tu actitud y por regresarme mi monedero, gracias

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I am very happy with my stay at this Hampton Inn! The location is great, the staff is so nice and the room was VERY clean. The manager asked more than once how our stay was going and everyone was very friendly. The hotel is family friendly and within walking distance of Starbucks & several great restaurants. We will be back again!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: We arrived here just at the start of the pandemic, in early March. We were nervous about travelling, but everything about this hotel put us at ease. The room and common areas are impeccable, the pool area was a lot of fun, food was great and we felt welcomed! This is our "go to" hotel in Miami from now on. Location is great, its a little quiet but walking distance to the action.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: I just had to take a moment to recognize Sales Manager, Christina Delaney, of the Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Miami-Brickell/Downtown. While making travel arrangements for a group that regularly travels to Miami in the spring, I was transferred to Ms. Delaney for assistance with our booking. She went above and beyond in making sure our multiple room reservation was accurate according to our preferences. Additionally, she was so willing to work with us to ensure ease during the check-in process. Ms. Delaney demonstrates such professionalism, exceptional customer service, and the most refreshing disposition of any hospitality representative I have ever come across. I am speaking as someone who makes a tremendous amount of travel arrangements each year. She is incredibly capable and personable, which makes all the difference. It is because of the service and hospitality provided by Ms. Delaney, that we will consider this hotel again for future stays. She is an absolute gem and asset to the Hilton brand.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Stayed here the night before we were suppose to cruise. We came in late the same day that cruise lines were canceling because of the Corona virus. There was a bit of a problem because they had let a guest stay in the room that we had reserved and they didn't have any more of that class. They did give us another room with a rollaway bed though. They also comp'd the kids some snacks and the adults some drinks at the bar. The location is great if you are going on a cruise. Close to the port and easy to find transportation. The lobby bar and pool are good. The complimentary breakfast is decent. Would stay here again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Hotel con muy buena ubicación, muy limpio, muy buen servicio, los cuartos están cómodos, el único detalle es que el desayuno que incluye no es muy bueno, es muy simple. Otro detalle que no me gustó es que el estacionamiento tiene costo, no es gratis. El Internet si es gratuito y las camas son muy cómodas.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Hotel excelentemente ubicado en una zona increíblemente moderna y bella , realmente el nuevo corazón de Miami, cerca del nuevo centro comercial y rodeado de opciones gastronómicas La habitación es grande y cómoda , sin frigobar , y el desayuno muy variado de calidad más que aceptable . Especial mención para todo el personal , especialmente el de registración ( 6to piso ), cuya amabilidad es muy elogiable . Seguramente volveremos en nuestra próxima visita

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Este hotel está en una ubicación muy buena cerca de downtown, rodeado de edificios muy bonitos, centros comerciales y restaurantes para comer todo tipo de comida, en el centro de negocios de la ciudad es una una buena opción para hospedarse lejos del ruido de Miami Beach, nada fuera de lo normal, buena atención del personal, habitaciones cómodas.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente ubicación, moderno, personal amable. Lo califico normal por los siguientes aspectos: 1. La recepción es en el piso 6 y para subir las maletas tuvimos bastantes problemas ya que llegamos tarde y no encontramos carrito para moverlas y nadie nos ayudó 2. El desayuno en vajilla desechable que no es encantador 3. Espacio para desayuno insuficiente 4. Piscina pequeña 5. Mi esposo es asmático y paso muy mala noche dado que le dio mucha alergia en la habitación que le suele suceder cuando hay muchos ácaros, mencionamos en la recepción pero no contaban con un limpiador de ambiente o con habitaciones hipoalergenicas que suelen tener en los hoteles.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Esta súper bien ubicado cerca a todos los restaurantes, bares y la estación de Brickell. El desayuno bastante diverso y rico. María y Beatriz súper lindas y amables. Rodolfo el del bar muy buena onda. 100% recomendable.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Hotel muy correcto, habitaciones amplias y bien dotadas (pero sin frigorifico) muy centrico personal muy profesional, el desayuno muy correcto y variado, aunque Este hotel no dispose de servicio de restaurante, solo desayuno, precio correcto con relacion a la media del lugar.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Escogí este hotel por la cercanía al puerto (teníamos previsto embarcarnos en un crucero). y como teníamos 2 días previos nos ayudo mucho a conocer esta parte de la ciudad. Llegamos a partir del medio día, me sorprendí que la recepción del hotel está en el sexto piso. Nos encantó que a solo una cuadra esté la estación de Metromover, que es un monoriel gratuito que tiene tres recorridos, la que escogimos fue el LOOP BRICKEL, que nos permitió acceder a pocas paradas de un bonito paseo al Mall City Center Brickel que es un moderno centro comercial para pasear, al Bayfront y al Bayside en este ultimo lugar cogimos el city tour y el paseo por la bahia, este sitio es muy recomendado para comer ya que tiene un patio de comidas y un sinnumero de restaurantes, también tiene un corredor comercial con múltiples ofertas de compras. El desayuno en el hotel es muy bueno y variado. Las habitaciones muy confortables, lo único molestoso fue que el acceso al baño no tenia una luz pequeña permanente para la noche (me tropece buscando el interruptor y acabe molestando a todos al prender las luces) El trato de las personas de recepción fue muy bueno, hablan español con agrado. Me gusto su ubicación, precio y comodidades!! Lo recomiendo!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: muy buena relación precio-calidad, personal muy atento y amable. Muy buena experiencia, bien ubicado para el propósito de mi viaje. Lo recomiendo y sin duda si tengo que volver a Brickell lo haré al mismo hotel.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Fue la primera vez que nos quedamos en este hotel. La verdad que no esperaba que fuera tan bueno porque tiene un precio bastante razonable La atención es excelente.
