La habitación enorme ( nos dieron un upgrate) muy limpia , con muchas toallas. Tiene una pequeña cocina con heladera y microondas Ayer temprano cuando llegamos nos dijeron que el desayuno de este día tambien estaba incluido , cosa que nunca pasa en otros hoteles Los artículos del baño son neutrogena ( muy buenos) El desayuno es súper completo Hay Waffles para que unos Miami lo prepare, frutas muy buenas ( frambuesas frutilla moras blueberry) Reponen todo constantemente Muy recomendable

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Primera vez en Miami y muchas dudas respecto a los hoteles, una vez estado en este hotel no tengo duda de que si vuelvo será mi elección. Excelente servicio en todo aspecto, su personal muy cordial y atento, el desayuno muy bueno y con suficiente variedad, un aplauso para todo los que ahi trabajan.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Definitivamente excelente opción para la zona de Brickell, literalmente a la vuelta de la esquina una gran variedad de buenos restaurantes. A unos pasos está el transporte que te lleva a varios lugares por el centro de Miami, Tiendas de conveniencia, cerca de centros comerciales, en pocas palabras, justo lo que se necesita para un muy buen viaje, ya sea de placer o trabajo. Un staff atentado y servicial, agradables amenidades y un ambiente familiar. Las habitaciones cómodas, gran vista. La relación calidad/precio muy buena. Si tienes pensado venir a Miami, esta es una muy buena opción.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Genial para el área del downtown y con conexión al transporte público gratuito del metromover (loop) y metrorail (público, económico y eficiente). Cerca a muchos de los puntos de interés de la ciudad, como por ejemplo a 10 minutos del bayside usando el transporte público gratuito que queda a media calle de distancia.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Recibí 3 camisetas w compre por internet, 75 US por las 3 por unos días, un abuso, tampoco avisan de este cobro tanto algo, si lo hubiera sabido ni siquiera me hubiera alojado allí, 100% satisfacción o me devuelven mi dinero, veremos mañana? Aldo

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: estuvimos 3 noches. tiene una ubicacion ideal porque tambien se puede tomar el trencito en la esquina hacia downtown. el hotel es tranquilo con habitaciones confortables y limpias.El desayuno es muy rico con diferentes opciones cada dia. Y Ademas me mandaron un correo electronico diciendo que me habia olvidado la billetera en la caja fuerte y me la habian guardado. Increible. Muy honestos. El staff de la recepcion muy profesional y amable y resuelven cualquier problema. Muy recomendable

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: La llegada fue rápida, el estacionamiento está muy bien pensado, las habitaciones limpias, amplias y cómodas. El desayuno de cortesía excelente, tiene mucha variedad y la calidad es buena. Excelente ubicación. Lo recomiendo ampliamente.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Este hotel está muy cerca del puerto de cruceros si vas a tomar uno o quieres recorrer down town este está muy bien ubicado ,está a media cuadra del metro mover ,medio de transporte gratis ,rápido a muchos lugares ,la pileta del hotel muy linda ....el desayuno espectacular.....l.súper recomendable.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Estuvimos 4 noches en este hotel, localizado en Brickell, en Downtown. La habitación era bastante grande para cuatro, con dos camas de matrimonio. Hay piscina (con servicio de toallas gratis) descubierta y con un pequeño jacuzzi. Por las tardes y noches, además, hay un pequeño bar (pool bar) que solamente sirven bebidas. Con el check-in dan un ticket por persona para hacer una consumición gratis. En el hall hay café, te y agua fresca gratis todo el día. Tiene la parada de Brickell a pocos metros y de allí se puede coger el Metromover y el Metrorail para llegar al centro fácilmente. El Metrorail permite llegar al aeropuerto. Nosotros fuimos en taxi y nos costó 30$.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El mejor hotel!! Una ubicación perfecta, a pasos del metromover, metrorail y trolley. El personal muy amable, siempre dispuestos a ayudar en todo, un trato excelente. El desayuno super bueno, muy variado, la habitación muy buena y cómoda, la piscina 24/7 al igual que el área de té, café y chocolate caliente, me encantó!, lo recomendaría sin duda, y volvería mil veces!.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Una ubicación inmejorable, el servicio excepcional, las habitaciones muy bien diseñadas y con una gran vista a la ciudad. Fui con mi familia y nos sentimos en casa. Lo único que recomendaría es bajar un poco es costo del estacionamiento. USD$28 por día, considero que es un exceso.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel me pareció excelente. Linda piscina, un desayuno súper completo, los cuartos son muy limpios y confortables Los funcionarios son muy amables, Rodolfo de la barra nos trató cómo se fuéramos familia. Regresando a Miami ya ni busco hotel, me quedo acá de nuevo y de nuevo y recomendó a todos

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Hicimos el check in antes de la hora y no tuvimos ningún problema. Buen hotel, con una ubicación excelente y el personal es muy amable. La habitación amplia y con harta iluminación. El desayuno es muy surtido.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Rodolfo el señor del bar en el lobby es genial. Súper agradable y cordial, además de hacernos favores cómo esperar por nosotros antes de que cierren la cocina... un trato inmejorable. Definitivamente vale la pena este hotel solo por la atención del bar!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El personal del frontdesk extremadamente amable y con regia actitud mención especial para Erick y Fabiola (encantadores). Las instalaciones muy lindas y bien decoradas. El desayuno muy completo y variado (saludos para Luz que nos atendió con mucha cordialidad y con detalles que nos hicieron sentir como en casa). Habitación de buen tamaño y confortable cama. La ubicación en la zona de Brickell nos encantó, a unas cuadras de Centro Comercial City Centre y a metros del Metromover, (transporte publico "Free"): La zona de Brickell absolutamente recomendable!! En el primer piso hay varios locales donde puedes comer rico y a buen precio especialmente en Sergio’s Cuban Café and Grill (deliciosa comida cubana), también hay un boliche (Batch Gastropub) que funciona de día y de noche, muy animado. También cuentan con cajero automático y un mini mercadito con bebidas snack. En Gym con equipos nuevos, audífonos, agua y toallas. La piscina pequeña pero cumple.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: La zona en la que se ubica este hotel es perfecta para visitar la ciudad. Se encuentra fuera del bullicio de miami beach pero al alcance de todo. El metromover se encuentra a la vuelta de la esquina. Las instalaciones del hotel son muy cómodas, al estilo de los Hampton. La piscina está abierta hasta muy tarde, y es un buen punto cuando llegas después de un día pateando la ciudad. El desayuno completo: frutas, proteínas, cereales, yogures, dulces, quesos. Un 10. La única pega es que el aire acondicionado está extremadamente fuerte en las zonas comunes. Necesitas llevar una chaqueta para estar realmente cómodo.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Un hotel cómodo con espacios grandes, amigable y una ambientación de los años 70 donde todos los detalles están cuidados. Muy buena atención. Desayunos abundantes y servicio de te/café las 24 hs. también provedor de hielo en todos los pisos.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Estuve casi 6 dias de vacaciones, tienen mucha rotacion de clientes. El servicio muy bueno, el personal muy amable, las habitaciones muy limpias. lo mejor de todo la ubicacion, alrededor tienes de todo. Para regresar en el siguiente viaje.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Es un hotel hermoso limpio, espacioso, con personal atento, la habitación amplia con espacio para cocinar, elegiría la opción de desayuno, muy cerca a todo a 7 minutos en carro del Dolphin mall y a 25 del aeropuerto sin duda regresaría

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente hotel con habitaciones muy cómodas. Atención cuidada de todo el personal. Desayuno muy completo, solo cambiaria la patisserie que no es de muy buena calidad. Servicios y amenities 10 puntos. Todo el personal es muy amable, siempre dispuesto a solucionar cualquier problema

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: El hotel es muy cómodo y las habitaciones amplias. El desayuno es muy completo y la amabilidad de todo el personal es para destacar. La ubicacion es excelente para el downtown y el estacionamiento muy comodo .

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Fue un muy buen lugar, habitaciones cómodas, con linda vista, tranquilo y seguro, desayuno muy rico y completo, a cuadra y media del traporte público gratuito y del metro, demasiado central!!... volvería sin pensarlo

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Realice el check out a las 11am, a las dos horas regrese porque me di cuenta que habia dejado dentro de la caja de seguridad olvidado mi dinero. cuando regrese se me informo que se habia abierto la caja, nunca me llamaron ni me enviaron un mail para avisarme ni que habia dejado cerrada la caja, ni que iban a abrirla, ni que al abrirla habian encontrado pertenencias mias. solo habian pasado dos horas del check out. por ultimo cuando nos dimos cuenta del olvido y volvimos al hotel, nos entregan los retirado de la caja, y dentro faltaron 4000 usd de los 5000 que habiamos guardado. cuando alertamos del faltante, la respuesta fue: "nosotros seguimos nuestro protocolo de "seguridad" dos personas abren la caja y retiran lo que hay dentro, hagan una denuncia policial". nosotros nos estabamos tomando un crucero ese dia en ese momento. el "protocolo" que referenciaron no incluye dar aviso de la caja cerrada, de la apertura de caja ni de descubrir pertenencias huespedes dentro. ademas este protocolo fallo, las pruebas a la vista, no? ni nos contuvieron, ni asumieron nunca ninguna responsabilidad. lamentable, todo lo bueno que puede ser como hotel se convierte en malo arruinando unas vacaciones de familia

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Se convirtió en mi destino para descansar y estar a mano de todo cuando voy por negocios a MIAMI, pero últimamente he notado que va mucha familia. Decidí que mi próximo viaje llevo a mis hijas, porque ahora veo que los huéspedes utilizan mucho mas la piscina, y el hotel quedo rodeado del mejor desarrollo inmobiliario para descansar y entretenerse por la zona. Excelente ubicación, a mano de todo y con muchos medios públicos para trasladarse.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Personal amable, buenos servicios, buffet adecuado, habitaciones amplias e inmejorable ubicación. Hablan perfectamente castellano por lo que en caso de no saber inglés no te sientes indefenso. Hotel en el que se alojan numerosos cruceristas. Parking amplio en el mismo edificio y cercano a lugares de ocio y restauración.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Perfecto hotel para visitar Miami pudiendo salir a los supermercados que se encuentran en los alrededores y los diferentes restaurantes, así como caminando unos 10 minutos al Brickell City Centre (Centro Comercial). Bien comunicado con el Metromover y el Metrorail. Habitación con cama perfecta para el descanso y desayuno más que correcto incluido en el precio. Aire acondicionado un poco ruidoso (se puede dormir sin problemas). Parking (de pago) en el mismo que facilita el dejar el vehículo y subir directamente a recepción (en el 6 piso); los accesos al mismo son ilimitados durante los días de estancia. Pequeña piscina en la que relajarse con vistas a los impresionantes edificios que lo rodean. Se pueden recibir paquetes de compras (Amazon) Opción para el alojamiento totalmente recomendable en la ciudad de Miami. Si vuelvo a la ciudad, tengo clara mi elección.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Excelente ubicación en el Brickell. En mi caso fui por un viaje de trabajo con reuniones en la zona y resulta super comodo. La habitacion espaciosa con todos los detalles para una estadia confortable. Excelente Wi fi, reciben paquetes de Amazon y otros sin cargo. Pude ingresar antes a la habitación tambien sin cargo. Se puede ir a comer y varios lugares sin necesidad de alquilar un auto, incluso a metros se encuentra el Metro. Todo perfecto! Volveria sin dudas.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites By Hilton Miami Brickell Downtown
review_text: Desde l reserva, la atención, los servicios, el personal muy amable. Habitaciones amplias y limpias, buena climatización, amplio parqueo y un desayuno bastante variado con opciones para todos los gustos y necesidades

Gran servicio de Alberto Agudelo, fue muy bueno conmigo desde el comienzo de mi estadía en el Marriott. Alberto siempre me estaba ayudando con mi auto y mis necesidades cada vez que regresaba a los hoteles. No tengo palabras para decir lo bien que me hizo sentir a mí y a mi familia. Regresaré para visitar y hospedarme en el mismo hotel del Miami Marriott. Gracias por hacerme sentir tan bien y tener una gran experiencia.

Muy bueno. Tiene una vista maravillosa. El cuarto y hotel siempre impecable. Con una cama y almohada deliciosa. Tienen wiffi. El desayuno buffet cuesta 22$ y el servicio a la habitación tiene unas pizzas a 15$ riquísimas y grandes! Nos dieron el wiffi gratis. Tiene una piscina, un jacuzzi y gym. El estacionamiento tiene costo 7$ una hora, 11$ max 3 horas y 24$ aprox toda la noche. Queda a 3 cuadras de un publics. Y junto al hotel hay un mall con buenos restaurantes (primo’s comida italiana riquísimo), algunas tiendas y heladerías.

Muy buen hotel, excelente ubicación. Sin embargo lo más destacado la atención de su personal, en especial de Yazdi Patel quien se esmeró en atendernos y guiarnos con los servicios que presta el hotel. Igual el personal del Lobby en especial Alfred Robles que solucionó nuestro problema de la habitación cuando llegamos cansados

Exelente sevicio, un hotel en muy buena posicion, muy limpio organizado. Se merecen 5 estrellas. el team de valet parking exelentes empleados especialemente JUNIOR JESUS ROSE. Gracias por ayudarme en todo, fueron todos muy amables

El hotel brinda excelente vistas a la Bahia y esta bien ubicado si lo que buscas es tranquilidad y la vez comodida de estar cerca de todo,el hotel esta muy cuidado , buena atencion , comida y servicios.

Felicitación al personal de recepción y catch. Reconocimiento especial al equipo de bienvenida y entrega del vehículo Álvaro, Junior, Rose y Waldo por su disposición permanente para atender al cliente.

La peor experiencia en cuanto al servicio al cliente, Estoy alojando en estos momentos y no puedo opinar nada bueno sobre su atención al cliente. Especialmente de la recepcionista Mary acabó de llegar a la recepción con mi bebé durmiendo en brazo pidiendo por favor que me ayuden a entrar a la habitación más pronto ya que mi esposo no logra encontrar estacionamiento ( que se paga usd 30) y no hay donde estacionar, Le pido que me dé una llave a la recepcionista que hace un par de horas habíamos estado hablando por una cafetera que no funcionaba y que era la tercera vez que la pedía y aún no la llevaban, que me diera una llave para entrar a mi habitación o que me acompañaran. lo que encontré un nefasto NO, si no tiene Identificación no puede entrar, entiendo que es por seguridad, pero tenia a mi hijo en brazo durmiendo, sin. Is docimentos, y ella me dijo que lo podía pasar incluso a la recepción si no tenía el Id!! Siendo que el hotel está lleno de gente qué pasa y yo no podía con mi bebé en brazos!! Pido hablar con el manager cosa que también me lo negó, hasta que eleve la voz y aprecio el manager dándome prontamente la solución. Era tan fácil! Que mal servicio son cliente! Pésimo! Lejos el peor de los Marriott que he estado. No lo recomiendo por ningún motivo

Un excelente hotel, reitero mi preferencia por Marriott, se que no hay como equivocarse cuando uno se aloja ahí. Es la segunda vez que me hospedo en este hotel y la verdad es que mantiene sus estándares de buen servicio y buenas habitaciones. Colchón y almohadas siempre excelentes, baño muy bueno pero ya necesitan pensar en una renovación. Lo único que me afecto en esta ocasión fue el ruido de la autopista que pese a tener una hermosa vista de la bahía, a la hora de dormir, me fastidio bastante.

Creo que por el precio se puede encontrar mejor propuesta. Hay más nuevos y con mayores facilidades.....además de que hay que pagar parqueo y también es CARO !!! POR una noche y antes de abordar un crucero la próxima vez busco otra opción de las muchas que hay cercanas ....

Un hotel con buen servicio, infraestructura antigua, limpio, desayuno adecuado y buena relación precio calidad. A diez minutos en automóvil de bares y restaurantes. Cuenta con tiendas y cafetería en el primer piso.

Viajamos con mi familia desde Latinoamérica y fue una excelente experiencia en calidad y atención. Sobretodo por parte de Junior, William y Rose. Todos muy serviciales y dispuestos a ayudar al cliente!

Un hotel al que ya se le notan los años. Sin embargo el servicio del personal es bueno y tienen servicios agradables. Gimnasio 24 horas, Internet gratuito, etc. Está super bien ubicado y el área donde se encuentra es agradable.

Hotel excelente, trato inmejorable y ubicación buena, con parada de trolley en la puerta!! Además de un botones formidable(José perez)el cual te puede ayudar con el tema de visitas y excursiones, además de ayudarte en todo lo que esté a su alcance y más!! Recomendable 100%

Muy buena atención muy cordiales y atentos la habitación muy cómoda me toco una vista hacia la bahía la ubicación muy buena recomendado para visitar la ciudad en familia o amigos lo demás es disfrutar del lugar.

Para quienes viajan sin esperar ser atendidos y sentir la atmósfera especial de los pequeños hoteles, está bien. Todo funciona, las habitaciones limpias... pero es un monstruo! El restaurant es adecuado, bien atendido pero algo ruidoso. El sector de la piscina, muy urbano, eficiente pero poco atractivo.

Les puedo comentar que mi experiencia en el Marriott Miami Biscaye junto a mi familia fue muy buena, gracias a la buena atencion de su personal. Desde el momento que llegas al hotel te hacen sentir en casa. Quiero destacar a don Alberto Agudelo por su buena disposicion para mi familia y los consejos de viaje que siempre nos entregaba. Gracias por todo don Alberto. 100% recomendable quedarse en el hotel, la vista al downtown es preciosa, sobre todo de noche. Gracias al hotel por todo.

Estoy muy agradecida con el hotel y el servicio de post estadia. Tuve unos inconvenientes con unos envios de compras y gracias a la atención y dedicación del Sr. Roberto Cordova lo solucione en cuestión de horas. Lo relacionado con al estadia, excelente también!

El hotel, impecable. Pero quiero destacar la atención de Roberto Córdova, quien me ayudó a resolver un problema que tuve con unas encomiendas. Mi hermano estuvo hospedado 4 días y dos días después de su estadía, llegaron unas encomiendas de unas compras que había realizado. Cuando llame al hotel, me dijeron que hable con Roberto, y el enseguida me sugirió una solución. La cual fue enviármelas a un conocido que tenía en otra ciudad. Muy atento y buena predisposición.

Brinda un excelente servicio. Es muy atento, cordial y servicial. Siempre dispuesto a ayudar. Se muestra interesado y preocupado por el bienestar y comodidad de los huéspedes y visitantes. Lo recomiendo en su totalidad.

Nuestra estancia fue con nuestros dos hijos y nos dieron habitación con vistas a la bahía, el mobiliario con gusto aunque no nuevo. Personal muy atento. Hay una cafetería Illy en la recepción, lo necesario para hacer un café y salir a visitar . Alrededor no hay mucho que ver aunque con coche está todo a pocos minutos . Por recibir un paquete nos cobraron 5$.
Lily Guest Ambassador - very, very emphatic in explaining the promotion and friendly. Loved talking and doing business with her.
Chasity has amazing! Found camaraderie instantly
Carol the guest ambassador was awesome. She was very friendly, excited to tell us about where we could go. I would recommend her to my family and friends
Guest Ambassador Sammi Hilton Orlando

My birthday staycation to recenter my chi was absolutely fantastic! The property was amazing with one of the biggest pools I have seen. We got a cabana and that was the best decision of the day. It was right next to pool entrance and close to both the water slide (definitely not for me but the kids loved it) and the lazy river entrance….and it was not lazy because you had to out in a lot of work to keep afloat and moving hahaha. Tyson and Zach were our cabana attendants and kudos to them for being super attentive. The amenities that came with the cabana were beverages (water and soda) and a decent size fruit platter. The menu was typical pool bar menu with the absolute best nachos (and we added chili topping) and the naked wings were huge and crispy. Drinks were kinda weak but very flavorful (Caribbean Cooker Punch Bucket and Passion Punch Bucket). The Virgin frozen Pina Colada was da bomb….grandkids loved it. There was a minor issue with the cabana BUT it was swiftly resolved to higher than our expectations by Justin (pool manager). Great hospitality. We ate dinner at Trabucco and it was delicioso. They gave us a private room which was not anticipated but definitely impressive. Our party of 8 (with 3 birthday guests) felt kinda regal around that table with the beautiful teardrop chandeliers! The young ones got to run around a bit without disturbing the other guests. We opted for the Disney Dining choice (3 courses) and it did not disappoint. All food was well seasoned, cooked to perfection (only hiccup was a medium well steak was ordered but came well well done) and served quickly. Worth every cent. Our attendant (Omar) was attentive, humorous, knowledgeable about the food, and just pleasant. We also had quick bites at their FastBreak restaurant. It’s their version of a sports Bar. Food was good and ‘quick’. The kids menu was the best deal! Overall, this was the quintessential birthday staycation and I will return in a heartbeat.
Had a pleasant stay at Hilton Orlando. Great location, very clean and staff was very welcoming and attentive. I especially want to thank Toye Toye at Scratch Market for her exceptional service.

Nuestra experiencia en el hotel fue excelente, y tengo que destacar la atención de Diego Guzmán. Fue súper amable, y coqueto🙊✨ Lo mejor es que siempre fue muy respetuoso y profesional. Definitivamente hizo que la pasáramos increíble. ¡Gracias, Diego! 🫶🏼
Dorey at the front desk was a delight! She checked us in so easily and efficiently with a smile and a sensitivity to our presence. She should get a raise!

Ive been here for a week long work event here in the hotel. Housekeeping has been amazing. Polite and accommodating when I pass by, they happily provide the extra towels requested, and we exchange friendly greetings every morning. When I come back to my room after a long and exhausting day, my bed is tightly made, the bathroom is clean, my towels are replaced, and it just feels like someone attentive was here. Housekeeping really made my work trip feel like a vacation. Thank you. I also noticed the employees working the event were very professional and worked well as a team, the employees in this hotel function like clockwork, Im very impressed.
El hotel nos gustó muchísimo sobre todo el área de la piscina. La atención de Adriana la Guest Ambasador fue extraordinaria y muy buenas sus recomendaciones
Adriana guest ambassador fue muy amable con nosotras, nuestra estadía en familia es muy agradable, todos son atentos, y la área de la piscina para los niños está súper. Recomiendo mucho el hotel
Utilizamos el day pass y los recomendamos al 100% súper completo y disfrutamos en familia

Stayed at the Hilton Orlando and it continues to be a great choice - especially if you’re attending anything at the convention center. The location couldn’t be more convenient, making it easy to get back and forth without any hassle. A special shoutout to Alex at the front desk, who was incredibly friendly and helpful throughout the stay. Service like that really makes a difference. I’ve stayed here a few times now, and it’s consistently a solid experience. Looking forward to being back again soon.

Very clean and amazing environment! Loved how friendly the staff are and always was so helpful! Loved how good our server was. She was so friendly and always asked if we needed anything else. Genesis was super sweet!
The atmosphere is wonderful. The guest service agents were impeccable.
Loved the poolside atmosphere! The service was attentive and friendly, and everything came out quickly. It made for a really relaxing experience. Definitely a great spot to unwind, thanks Amber!

Everything about the hotel is fine aside from the beds, which are bad enough to not return. The mattresses are below average , but the sheets are unacceptable for a Hilton property. They would be unacceptable for a Motel 6. I am here with my company and the feedback has been the same from everyone. It's a shame because the rest of the hotel/rooms are nice and the facilities are all good. Lots of food options but didn't try anything. The prices of everything in the market feel closer to airport pricing than the usually inflated hotel pricing. It's also very close to the OCCC with a walkway direct from the hotel.

This property was great for kids. The room was very spacious and the pool and lazy river were ideal. Charis was our guest ambassador and took great care of our family - we would definitely come back!!
Joey was excellent at Fastbreak. Great food. Great service.

This is a re-review of the Hiton Orlando. It's been a while since I've been in the area and am happy to report that one of my favorite hotels remains near the top of my list! This is a big hotel that somehow feels small. The only time you'll notice it's size, is when there is a big convention next door. Then, the bars & restaurants will be loaded and hard to get into. The only exceptions to that rule are The Scratch Market (not the best name) off of the lobby and the Fast Break sports bar on the lower level. The Scratch Market is a grab-n-go sandwich & bakery spot. Fast Break has a small, but mighty, menu. The burgers are great. There are many restaurant options nearby, so don't let the possible crowds dissuade you. The hotel underwent a redo 2+ years ago and the additions are a welcome update. Rooms continue to be well equipped, clean, quiet, and comfortable. I do miss the old Executive Club, but that's a small dis. I'll stay at the Orlando Hilton any chance I get and so should you.
Great room and pool! Octavio was very helpful

While sitting poolside, Mario (Ambassador) approached my wife and I and asked if we would be interested in purchasing one of the packages that Hilton was offering. Not five minutes into the conversation, my wife handed Mario her credit card and we purchased one of the VIP Packages. I write this review to let the “Higher-Ups” at Hilton know just how wonderful Mario (Ambassador) is. Mario took the time and explained everything about what we had purchased. Mario answered every single question we had, gave us all the details about the package we purchased, and most importantly, gave us a presentation that was incredible. Mario was generous with his time, an absolute gentleman, and so pleasant to deal with. I hope you will take this review into consideration when Mario comes up for his monthly/yearly review relating to customer care and satisfaction. Thank you and have a wonderful day. Jack Caruso
Excelente atención, muy buen hotel la señorita Adriana embajadora de guest me presto una excelente atencion. Todas la áreas muy limpias, personal muy profesional
Buen trato, disfrute mucho la experiencia y conocer a una recepcionista tan agradable como Julia fue un plus que hizo la estancia mucho más agradable

Asistí al Hilton de Orlando para participar en un evento, por lo que todas las fotos que comparto son de los salones y pasillos del hotel. El espacio es realmente amplio y cómodo, ideal para convenciones y reuniones grandes. El servicio fue excelente: constantemente había refrigerios y bebidas disponibles en varias áreas, lo que hizo que la jornada fuera mucho más agradable. Almorzamos en uno de los salones y, para despejarme un poco, pude salir a tomar aire fresco en un parque que está justo al lado del Ballroom, lo cual fue un gran plus para relajarse entre sesiones. Un aspecto muy conveniente es que el hotel está conectado directamente al Orlando Convention Center, lo que facilita el acceso a eventos y exposiciones. En varias ocasiones utilicé el i-Ride Trolley para moverme por la zona; tiene una parada muy cerca del hotel, lo que facilita la movilidad para quienes no cuentan con auto. En resumen, el Hilton Orlando es una excelente opción para eventos, con instalaciones de primer nivel, atención sobresaliente y una ubicación estratégica.
As usual, Hilton offers great hospitality and cleanliness. Exceptional staff and service. I was a bit surprised at the cost of a draft beer and glass of wine exceeding $50 from the lobby bar.
Priscilla and Sami was amazing! I had a good time and they came to check on me and offered some great benefits! Book with Hilton and ask for Priscilla and Sami!
The staff is amazing! From the front desk agent that checked me in, to the restaurant, banquet, elevator, and bar staff - everyone was friendly, warm, and helpful. Hospitality is not dead!
From the valet upon arrival to the front desk… everyone was kind and welcoming. The hotel entire staff did a wonderful job hosting all of us with Hilton for the Leadership Conference.
Had a good time on our son's B Day trip. Very accommodating and professional staff! We loved the pool, slide, and lazy river :)
Julie at the front desk was extremely helpful, she help me set up my stay and document i need it. The hotel is great thank you i will come back

Excelente hospitalidad, la atención en general pero debo destacar el excelente trato humano de Yovani en la barra sector de la piscina nos hizo sentir muy acogidos se agradece la hospitalidad. Gracias totales espero volver muy pronto.
Manuel Gonzalez, is very helpful and informative 👍 he is polite and a Gentleman
Ubicación privilegiada. Muy céntrico. Ernesto nos atendió muy bien.
Lauren is the best!! Excelent service and attention. Thanks
Muy bonito hotel, tiene unas amenidades estupendas y hubiera querido pasar más días. Muy buen servicio. Altamente recomendable.

I had a great experience staying at The Elser Hotel in Miami. The property is beautiful, modern, and very well maintained, and the views of Downtown Miami and Biscayne Bay were amazing. The room was spacious, clean, and comfortable, and I really liked the overall design of the hotel. The location is also extremely convenient, especially for exploring Downtown, Brickell, and nearby areas. The amenities were a nice bonus and made the stay feel more upscale. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely come back!
Excelente ubicación, vista hermosa y atenciones de primera de parte de Cori. Gracias!!
pase una excelente estadía con mi familia , cori nos ayudó con el early check in es muy amable con todas las preguntas sobre el pago
Manuel 10/10 customer service

The parking is ridiculous the prices are outrageous if your already paying over 400 dollars a day for a room the parking from 75 to 100 a day is ridiculous the parking to get out is ridiculous the pay by scan code was ridiculous I mean the worst part of the hotel experience everything else in the hotel was excellent
Excelente ambiente y muy gentil
Muy agradable experiencia, nos atendió Raúl y fue muy amable en todo momento, la comida estuvo deliciosa, recomiendo para pasar un momento tranquilo con buena vista
Magnifico hotel en el Downtown de Miami, céntrico, moderno, con habitaciones grandes y espaciosas, cocina con todo el equipamiento y unas vistas increíbles al mar
Mi estadia estuvo fenomenal la chica de recepción Julie fue muy atenta volvere
I ate the beef tacos and they were really good. My server was Sayday. She was AMAZING. She was very friendly and always asked how I was doing.

El hotel nos sorprendió gratamente. Es muy lindo, nuevo, con buen gusto, y limpio. La habitación doble muy cómoda y linda. Ideal si tenes un vuelo muy temprano como teníamos nosotros. Cada 20 minutos sale una combi gratis al aeropuerto y en 7 minutos estábamos en la terminal. No lo dudes. Súper recomendable.
The bartender was outstanding. Sayda was super helpful and so friendly. True professional.
Staff was extremely friendly!
Sayda best waitress I had in my whole in tired life
Jorge at Tailwinds was amazing! So welcoming and the food was great. We were just passing though but he made us feel so welcomed and truly enriched out stay with his warmth!

Had an amazing experience at the Sonesta Miami Airport—especially at Tailwinds Bar! Ana Lorena and Wilson truly went above and beyond to deliver exceptional service. From the moment I sat down, they were welcoming, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect. Their professionalism combined with such a warm and friendly attitude made the whole experience stand out. Great drinks, great atmosphere, but what really made it unforgettable was the outstanding service from Ana Lorena and Wilson. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area—you won’t be disappoint
Sayda was are waitress at the hotel restaurant. She was very happy and knowledge in the menu.
El hotel tiene excelente ubicación El servicio es de excelencia. La hospitalidad de la empleomanía es única. La limpieza de la habitación fue de excelencia de igual manera.
El hotel está súper limpio, el restaurante delicioso, muy buen precio. el arroz blanco al cilantro y el salmón del buffet, una maravilla!
Sayda and Ana provided the best service of 2026. They were both so kinde and treated me with the upmost professionalism. Cant wait to come back!
Say da & Ana were the best! I enjoyed my experience so much. They both treated me with kindness and professionalism, while making the best drinks! Thanks again ladies

The last two times that I have been here, the airport shuttle bus to and from the airport has been TERRIBLE. After a long exhausting flight, they had me standing outside for an hour! I watched him SPEED past the pickup area TWICE before I was picked up. I have been back again and the same thing happened. The driver doesn't try to slow down or stop for a second to see who needs to be picked up from the airport. Then when im ready to go back to the airport, they take off before the departure time. Nobody at the destination is helpful at all! They will just stare with a blank face and no reaction.

Quiero destacar en esta ocasión que la remuneración del hotel ha quedado muy linda sus diferentes áreas son muy cómodas y placenteras. En cuanto al servicio muy amable y cordial como siempre. Les agradezco muchísimo al grupo de meseros del restaurante en el turno de la mañana Fatima, Gustavo y Wilder por excelente atención durante nuestra estadía. Muchas gracias. Hotel super recomendado ✅️

Muchas gracias. Pasamos un fin de semana espectacular. Aprovechamos el bar y el restaurante delicioso. La atención del argentino genial. La próxima vez escojo una vista diferente de la habitación . Muy recomendado

Super recomendado. El hotel excelente, pensamos que por estar cerca del aeropuerto pero nada, descansamos muy bien, lo mejor el servicio al cliente, todos muy atentos, en el restaurante excelente la atención los chicos el Sr de Argentina y sus compañeros muy agradable con nosotros como turistas. Llegamos con compras y genial nos facilitaron mucho todo.

I recently stayed at Hyde 3 times over 7 weeks while traveling for work; I’m so happy that I did. There were times I showed up running on fumes and staying here helped me recalibrate. The location is very convenient with all kinds of shops and restaurants close by. The atmosphere feels elevated but accessible, the rooms are clean and spacious (I love the corner suite 609), the pool is quiet and peaceful, the valet is fast and easy, and the staff are beyond friendly and helpful. To be honest, the staff are the reason I kept choosing Hyde. Traveling is a privilege, but being far from home for stretches of time can wear on the spirit. Thank you to George, Carol, and Jessa for taking good care of me. You helped me make it to the finish line!

Hyde is a great option if you’re looking for a convenient location, walking distance to Design District and Wynwood. There are plenty of great restaurant options all within a 5 minute walk. Carol at the front desk is amazing. I had a booking issue and she literally made the difference in helping me secure a new reservation. She was so helpful that I will only stay at the Hyde Midtown. The suites are spacious and clean. The pool and gym are great as well.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We had a great experience here for our pre-cruise stay! The staff were friendly. We dropped off our luggage upon arrival (pre-check in) to store while we did a city tour. Check in/out was quick. The rooms were large, clean and comfortable. Breakfast was good. We used their shuttle ($10/person) to get to port. That was easy and efficient. The area was convenient to many things. Would stay again!
Excelente atención una señorita muy amable eficiente en todo momento

Super clean room in Wynwood district of Miami. Good size bathroom/shower and a nice comfortable bed. The rooftop pool is a super nice amenity as was the weight room. Also had breakfast in the restaurant that was in the lobby. No complaints! The Valet service is a must as parking is definitely difficult to find in that area.
I had an amazing time here mainly bc Jonathan. The service was great, the drink was spot on and mixed well, I will literally come back for him. Ask for this man when ur here, he does not disappoint.

This is a beautiful hotel in a cool location. The rooms were spacious and clean and the staff (especially Oscar & Chris G. ) were very friendly and accommodating. The next time I am in Miami, I will be sure to return.

My stay at Arlo Wynwood was exceptional from the very start. When my Uber arrived, Julian, the bellman, greeted me immediately and took my luggage straight from the trunk. I walked inside with just my phone and wallet in hand — no stress, no heavy bags — and it made the entire arrival feel smooth, intentional, and elevated. The location is truly unbeatable. Everything I wanted to experience was either a quick 5-minute Uber or a relaxed 15-minute walk away. I explored local nail studios, soaked in Wynwood’s unmistakable energy, and visited rooftop bars with views and vibes that were absolutely unmatched. Shortly after I arrived, Andres greeted me with a warm welcome, a curated Wynwood visitor guide, and a complimentary birthday drink ticket — such a thoughtful, personal touch that made me feel instantly celebrated. And then there’s the bar team… they were the heartbeat of my entire trip. Pedro, Victor, Mladen, Jose, and Julia were phenomenal. As a former bartender, I was genuinely impressed by how they blended craft-cocktail artistry with the speed and precision of a high-volume nightlife setting. Every drink was sexy, consistent, and executed with intention — and they made it all look effortless. One moment I’ll never forget: watching Mladen “throw” the espresso martinis we ordered. That technique is bold, refined, and rarely done well in a fast-paced environment. If you know, you know — and he nailed it. Mornings were just as memorable thanks to Lourdes at Wyn Wyn, who made me the best iced coffee I’ve had in ages. I’m seriously tempted to bring her recipe back to DC. Finally, checkout with Oscar and Mayra was smooth, warm, and perfectly efficient — a seamless ending to a seamless stay. Overall, Arlo Wynwood exceeded every expectation. The service, the energy, the design, the people — everything felt elevated, effortless, and full of personality. I cannot recommend this property enough and can’t wait for my next visit. Come visit us in DC!! We would love to host each and every one of you! Til next time, Xoxo -GS

Hidden resort fees as soon as we checked in which were not disclosed online. Valet also took cash from our car, I reported it to front desk, and security. No follow up, I’ve called a few times and asked to speak to the manager. Still yet no solution or response from management.
Had an amazing experience. Every thing was great. Visited for my friend’s birthday! Oscar made sure we enjoyed our stay!

I stayed at the Arlo recently. It was just a quick one nighter. I went down from Fort Lauderdale because I wanted to see a band I love. Since I’m local I got a great deal with HelloCity. I read in the reviews they like to add on fees after you get there, i.e., resort fees etc. I was bringing my little 4lb chihuahua. I’m OCD so I called several times to ask questions. I was told to bring my dog there was a $20 per night dog fee. I also asked if my special discounted rate included the resort fee. I was told it was included. I called one last time a few days before arrival. I spoke to Asia. She was so helpful and nice to me. She confirmed the fact that my special rate included the resort fees. She told me the overnight dog fee was $25. I told her the two times I called prior they told me $20. She said they would probably honor that when I check in. On arrival, my check-in experience was the most wonderful. Asia was there, along with Oscar and Fabi. I had my little dog in my arms and she charms anyone who notices her. She’s the sweetest. The whole front desk staff was the best. I ended up getting my room right away and I got upgraded to a high floor with a balcony and view. They also gave me complimentary late check-out at 1pm. Oh and you get 15% off the bar. Great perk for guests. I couldn’t believe it. They were so helpful. On the next day when I checked out it was another smooth process. When I checked my itemized bill I noticed they did not charge me a dog fee after all. What a wonderful experience. I will be sure to stay again when I return.
Nicolas help me bring my suitcase in my car, he was very helpful, i will definitely come back to for my next trip , see you soon Arlo👍🏼
Great location and close to many great restaurants. All within walking range

The Mayfair House is one of our favorite places and has been since our daughter attended the University of Miami for law school. We had plans for Labor Day weekend that fell apart and last minute we were able to get two rooms in our favorite resort. From the moment we arrived with our two goldendoodles, we were treated like family. David, the concierge/desk clerk, went above and beyond during our stay. He helped relieve our stress and made our visit the best we’ve had to date! His colleague, Ariana, was also incredibly welcoming and helpful. When I say David went the extra mile, he had someone walk me across with an umbrella to Cocowalk so I wouldn’t get wet on my way to dinner. I happened to cut my finger and he provided multiple options to take care of my cut, including alcohol swabs and Band-Aids. He sent water to our room, took care of our luggage for us. Any need we had was immediately met by him or Ariana. The hotel also was not charging pet fees which made this even more friendly for our family. We had never brought the dogs in the past, but we sure will in the future! His sense of humor was the icing on the cake. It is without reservation that our family recommends the Mayfair House and we hope that both of these wonderful employees are given some recognition for the incredible service they provide. If we could give more than five stars we would! Thank you for a wonderful Labor Day weekend.
Perfect for bz travellers. Great location, spacious rooms, outstanding customer service.
Excelente atención de todo el personal, Patricia. Increíblemente atenta
Beautiful hotel! Fabian was super helpful! Had a great time, really captured Miami culture with salsa music playing in the garden.
Fabian, Fernando & Landon make this hotel such a pleasure! they are so accommodating recommend to anyone coming to the grove!

From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt like a little tropical escape right in the middle of Miami. The whole place is gorgeous—lush plants everywhere, cozy courtyards, and beautiful architecture that gives it so much character. My room was spacious, stylish, and spotless. The private terrace was such a treat! The staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and always ready with a smile or a great local recommendation. It’s clear they take real pride in making guests feel welcome. If you’re visiting Miami and want something that feels unique, upscale and peaceful, this is the place. Can’t wait to come back!

No entiendo como lo recomienda American Express y tiene 2 estrellas en la guía Michelin, no hay manera. El restaurante lento y malo, no hay día, sin estar lleno, en que no esperes 20 minutos para sentarte y, la comida en el mejor de los casos, regular. No hacen el cuarto, son muy atentos al preguntar a qué hora quieres el servicio, y luego no pasa nada, toallas en todo caso. Evítenlo.

This boutique hotel has a completely different vibe from the larger south beach or downtown Miami hotels. The hotel is very relaxed and the neighborhood is quiet. Jeffrey helped us check in and gave us an upgrade to a suite with claw tub bathtub. Highly recommended for a couple. The complementary breakfast is somewhat limited, but then again, it's complementary.
Manuel fue excelente, muy amable y simpático. Colaboró siempre para resolver cualquier inquietud
Una experiencia súper buena. Excelente servicio al cliente de Raúl. 10/10. Muy recomendable. 🤩🤩🤩🙌🏻
Henry muy responsable a la entrega del paquete
Ernesto es el mejor en este hotel. Un servicio 10000/10. Volvería a pedir su servicio
Me encantó la disponibilidad de Ernesto, muy atento servicial y volvería al hotel contando con el servicio brindado

Stayed here with my wife and honestly it was great. The Elser has an amazing location but the staff is what makes it. I had a few deliveries arriving and Henry was super helpful and on top of everything. Made the whole process very easy for us. Rooms were clean and the view is hard to beat. Will definitely come back.
Nos teníamos que ir y no teníamos donde dejar las maletas, Ernesto fue súper servicial y estuvo pendiente de nosotros y nuestro equipaje en todo momento, muchas gracias ! Fantástico
Ernesto es una excelente persona. Atención De 10. Muy recomendable
JD was AMAZING super accommodating and kind
Fabian was amazing and so helpful!
Beautiful views Fabian was an amazing help The entire place is beautiful

I had such an amazing experience here and i really want to recognize two incredible women who made my visit so pleasant. Ginevra at the front desk was absolutely wonderful. she was kind, professional, and went out of her way to help me. not only was she extremely sweet and welcoming, but she also helped me with a discount and made the whole process smooth and stress-free. she truly has a beautiful energy and made me feel valued as a customer. i also want to recognize leah, the vice director, for clearly running such a great establishment. you can tell the leadership and ethics here are strong because the staff reflects it. everything was organized, professional, and handled with care. it’s rare to find a place where the staff is both this kind and this professional. thank you ginevra and leah for making the experience so positive. i will definitely be recommending this place to others.

Las instalaciones en general buenas y la ubicación excelente. Lo mejor del hotel es su personal, en particular la buena predisposición y profesionalismo de la recepcionista Anyi. Son varias las veces que visitamos Miami, y esto último es difícil de encontrar. Gracias
Encantado con este hotel, siempre disfruto mis estadías, cada que vengo a Miami The Elser es mi primera opción. Gracias a Jennifer que siempre me recibe con gran carisma y hace mejor mis estadías.
Russell was a great server! Very attentive and kind.
Excelente atención de Manuel, muy buen hotel excelente ubicación y bonitas instalaciones . Volvería sin pensarlo …..
Fabián súper amable en la entrada del valet 🙏🏼la experiencia súper súper bien
Manuel nos ayudo con nuestro equipaje su servicio y amabilidad hizo de nuestra llegada y salida una experiencia maravillosa! Gracias por su excelente trabajo!
Everything was great about this place, and Fabian in valet was awesome!!

Desde el momento en el que llegue al hotel Juan fue extremadamente amable, atento y profesional. Tenía algunas dudas y se tomó el tiempo de brindarme toda la información necesaria para mi estancia, resolviendo cada duda con una excelente disposición y una actitud súper servicial. Su actitud y disposición hizo una gran diferencia en mi experiencia, transmitiendo confianza, organización y un nivel de atención al cliente excepcional. Sin duda, personas como Juan elevan la calidad del servicio y merecen ser reconocidas. ¡Gracias por todo y excelente equipo de hotel!

Hay dos Hoteles Sonesta AirPort. Asi que pongo mi comentario aquí también. Muy agradecidos con el hotel, quedo muy lindo con la remodelación, el bar super! Y aunque con los niños a veces se torna más complicado nos facilitaron mucho las cosas. El restaurante como siempre la atención inmejorable Gustavo, Fátima y el muchacho. Muchas gracias Sonesta. Iré a Pereira este año…espero tener también una experiencia igual
Lavina, George and Wilson at the restaurant/bar went above and beyond so kind and accommodating! Wow! Customer service is hard to find these days and they did an amazing job with their service!!!

Extremely disappointed with the customer service. The front desk supervisor, Jasmine, was disorganized and unhelpful. My reservation was booked with the wrong dates, and when Hotels.com attempted to work with the resort to correct the issue, the staff offered little to no assistance. I’ve called multiple times, and each time I’m told to “call back,” yet nothing is ever resolved. The lack of competence and accountability is frustrating. Once I return home, I plan to escalate my experience to upper management.
I love this hotel! Transportation to airport free. Very clean, friendly, and stylish hotel. Room a great! Very clean and roomy.
Beautiful renovation. Very clean. Excellent food and wine. Friendly and welcoming staff, especially Jorge in the restaurant.

I was not planning in staying at this hotel. But my flight got cancelled and we needed to spend the night at Sonesta Hotel. We checked in and then me and my family were starving. We went to the restaurant area and Lorena took care of us while taking care of other 50 people that was waiting to be attended. Super multitasking skills of this girl, being a bartender, order taker and server. I’ve never seen such a thing. Congrats to Lorena for always going above and beyond for her guests .

My boyfriend and I decided to go to the hotel lobby restaurant for a drink, and we met the nicest bartender named Wilson. We asked what drinks he recommended, and he made two different delicious drinks for us! Wilson was not wrong! The lavender one I had was SO delicious! Hats off to Wilson and the crew that was on staff that night! They were wonderful.

Look we got here due to a late flight and a missed flight. No luggage, just us and our carry-on’s. The staff at the bar on Friday night were amazing. They cheered us up and went above and beyond the call of duty! Thank you, Lorena, Jorge & Wilson you all were great at keeping us with smiles and good conversation!

Pesimo! La actitud de servicio al cliente es deplorable, especialmente en el proceso de check in en las noches, te cobran 28 dólares diarios por el uso del parqueadero, no hay servicio de limpieza en la habitación diariamente por lo que tendrás una estancia incomoda, no tiene nada que ofrecer mas que una simple estadía, hay mejores hoteles por el mismo precio, no lo recomiendo!

The Sonesta is one of the closest hotels to Miami Airport; combined with their free shuttle to and from MIA, this alone makes it worth a stay if you have a long layover as I did. Sonesta's whole brand MO is buying up properties that have been cast off by other brands and renovating them about 90% as much as they need to be renovated. That trend continues here. Everything is well put together and clean, but you can still sense that there's some negative age to the property. I did like the cool lighting design in the rooms, which gives a hint of art deco vibes in keeping with the Miami location. There is no free breakfast, and the lone restaurant's prices are grossly inflated. There are some off-property restaurants nearby, but none of them are great and you have to brave a very busy highway to access most of them. The service level leaves a bit to be desired. Front desk service was perfunctory, but every shuttle driver I encountered was sullen and perfectly happy to take off without you. They also make no secret about airline flight crews being their bread-and-butter; you will be kicked off the shuttle or moved back in line at the desk to make room for them even if you were there first. I did like the linked map the hotel texted to me that showed exactly where the shuttle was at a given time, though. It was definitely needed given the drivers' propensity for coming and going unannounced.
Jorge at the bar was awesome! He made the best mojitos and was super friendly! Can’t wait to go back and see him again! Thanks, Jorge!

Sayda was amazing!!! She was prompt, excelled in hospitality, and makes a great old fashioned. Excellent treatment from start to finish. 5 Stars!!!! We would highly recommend! SWA Famous!!! If not….should BE!!!! THE BEST!!! The best!!!!

The rooms have been nicely renovated since our last stay in 2017. The hotel is located a mile from the airport, a five-to ten-minute shuttle ride, depending on traffic, yet the area is quiet at night. Their 24-hour airport shuttle service runs at 20-minute intervals. We appreciated the comfortable beds and plenty of hot water to unwind from a long flight with a nice shower. I took away one star because the bathroom light is activated by a motion detector that blinded me and woke up my husband when I had to go in the middle of the night. The person at the front desk was unable to tell me how to deactivate it. We also especially like that it is right across the street from Latin Café, a pleasant Cuban restaurant open from 6:30 a.m. to 11 p.m.

Great customer service Lorena 😁 Valdillia.Wilson.Anthony. muchas gracias por El servicio, e El vino. Todos, Bien, respectables, e feliz. Que bonito equipo. Muchas gracias. El vino esta excellente! Xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

There people are amazing, charming; their service is unique, and I really enjoy my time here. Susana from sales, Wilson who makes delicious cocktails, Lorena and Dayton from food and beverage are great professionals. Come for a great experience!!!! 👍

Francina at the front desk was simply amazing and so helpful! The checkin process was extremely smooth and that was a major benefit! I was also offered water and a complimentary drink! Thanks Francina! I have never experienced such great customer service from a hotel and this one by far has been the best!

The staff are amazing especially the front desk staff with Franceina! José who cleans the front was also great! The beds are very comfortable and the rooms are very clean! I wish the pool was open, but that gives me more of a reason to come back! Thank you All! Maurice from Panama! I will be back!

Very nice Hotel! Room was nicely updated. Parking was great and close to the airport. Free shuttle service. The restaurant food was amazing. Susanna Reyes went above and beyond. She made sure everything was taken care of for us. She is a huge asset to the hotel!!

I went to the restaurant in the lobby. I’m a flight crew member. The bartender named Sayda, was so welcoming and knowledgeable about the menu. I took several recommendations from her, on what to eat. Wow. The food was better than many lobby restaurants, I have experienced. Extremely flavorful and unexpected. I stayed longer than usual and even had dessert, which I never do. All because she recommended them. I actually cannot wait to have this hotel again. And I hope, she is my bartender again. She treated us crew members like we were guests in her home!!!

The place looks amazing now! Love the revamp! Aesthetics give luxury! Oh and Jorge at the bar... was the best bartender like oh my gosh!!! Love him! Lorena at the bar was also a pleasure as well! She was so sweet, attentive, and nice! I was hesitate about this hotel until I got here and saw all the improvements! I definitely will be back!

Spacious, modern, clean rooms. Surprisingly quiet for being on such a busy road. But… Service atrocious. My room was left not made up for the 1 night I stayed. No bed service, garbage not emptied, coffee and water not refilled. When I went to reception to ask about it, there was a line 6 people deep not moving for 25 mins. I called the guest services number. They said they’d send someone around- who never came. Went up to roof bar to get a drink. I stood waiting for service at the counter while the staff chatted to each other totally ignoring me. Breakfast: $35 for avocado toast and a side sausage. “Resort fee” of $30/day over advertised price is just a price increase. I hate it when hotels do that but most give you something of value. Here they give you a $15 discount at their restaurant and nothing else usable (3 hour bike rental- thanks but I’m here on business). It could be good. But it’s really not.
cynthia was phenomenal and made the best drinks!

Llegamos el 1 de agosto a las 23:50 y en recepción no había personal bilingüe por lo tanto atencion No fue ágil y no nos informaron de los beneficios que teníamos derecho durante la estancia y de un cobro Destination Fee por 30 USD diarios para usarlos en en entradas a un museo y bicicletas además que teniamos derecho a $15 USD por dia consumibles en el hotel. Nos asignaron una habitación en el 2 piso pero esta se encontraba sin asear, toallas por el piso , la cama sin hacer y basura en el baño por lo tanto hicimos el reclamo y nos asignaron otra en el 605.

I stayed there for only just one night and arrived quite late but the service was more than excellent and the room was spacious and so comfortable. The location is great as well. I really want to thank Monet that welcomed my boyfriend and I that night. She was absolutely amazing, she made us feel right at home while staying professional. She checked us in with a great attentive and friendly attitude making our simple one night stay feel really special. Monet is a true ray of sunshine and will go above and beyond to answer your questions and guide you around, give you tips and tricks for your stay in Miami while listening and answering to your needs to her best abilities. The only thing I regret is not staying longer at this hotel and not being able to see her on our check out day. A big thank you to the rest of the team as well. I will definitely try to come again. Clémentine

Charming boutique hotel with a fun retro-Miami vibe. The rooms are clean,, comfortable, and stylish, while the beautiful pool area is a real highlight. The staff are friendly and helpful. Great budget friendly option.

We really liked this place. The retro feel outside, in the room and at the pool are very appealing. The staff was friendly. The room was nice. (Spring for the room w/ a mini fridge.) We LOVED all the places nearby to eat or grab a coffee within a couple minutes’ walk. Our only knock would be the air conditioning. It was HOT in August and the A/C was ALMOST there, but we wished it had been a little cooler. PS- The pool and the pool area are very nice. I hope they reopen the bar at the pool. That would be even better.
Great hotel. Clean, excellent coffee, and a great pool. Lots of good food in the immediate walking area.

We stayed at the Vagabond Motel in Miami for two nights in November 2025 and it was a unique experience! The property is vibrant, has a retro-modern charm that feels both stylish and genuinely welcoming. Our room was clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed. The pool area was a highlight—peaceful, well-kept, and we spent one evening with wine and snacks though the day was too cold for a swim. The staff was friendly and attentive, making check-in and day-to-day interactions very pleasant. Overall, the Vagabond Motel delivered a memorable stay and excellent value; we’d gladly return.

The Vagabond was the perfect place to stay! My husband and I loved the gorgeous pool and courtyard, and the whole vibe was so relaxing and vibrant! The location in MiMo was great - loved the proximity to other neighborhoods and there were plenty of food options around! The room was clean, peaceful, and funky. The front desk service was fantastic and we loved the list of recommendations that they gave us for local restaurants. If we ever go return to Miami, we’ll definitely be staying there again!

I love The Vagabond! It is very clean, the staff is very friendly, welcoming and professional. The location is great, I feel very safe while staying. Thank you Vagabond, I will be back! PS, great hot coffee available 24/7👌

The room & hotel was hip and beautiful. Spacious walk in shower. The TV was too small. Unfortunately the pool water temp was cold and the pool was dirty & needed vacuuming. The worse part about it wax that the pool bar and restaurant were closed even though the hotels website advertised them as being open. I would be willing to try this place again if the amenities were available.
Love this place, great vibe and location. Very comfortable beds and the rooms are spotless. And ..super terrific staff!

I enjoyed a relaxing weekend stay at the Vagabond in late October. I have stayed in the area many times and this is my first stay at this hotel. The outdoor areas are as welcoming as the pictures show. Plenty of places to sit down and enjoy the beautiful setting. The room was clean, smelled fresh thanks to the dehumidifier running and was thoughtfully appointed. I was in an Electra King room on the second floor. Do note that there are no elevators. If stairs are a problem, communicate with the staff before arriving and I am sure they will accommodate you. They were fabulous during my stay. I witnessed them patiently helping many guests with making their plans for the day. There are multiple places within walking distance to get good food and excellent coffee. The onsite restaurant is currently closed but I was told that that it is set to reopen next month.Parking is available at the hotel at no additional charge which is a bonus. Beach access is an easy 15 minute drive. Already looking forward to my next stay.
Bruce was exceedingly helpful as valet and made my stay smooth and easy while I was in Miami on business. I will certainly return to the Arlo Wynwood Hotel in the future.

This hotel is located in the heart of Wynwood and is easy walking distance from many of the restaurants and bars in the neighborhood. They have been offering a wonderful discount program for Florida residents that includes free valet parking and a discount on food and beverage in the restaurant and bar when charged to your room and their room rate is reasonable. The staff is very friendly and professional. In particular we received excellent service and advice from the valet manager Ernesto and his evening associate Javier as well as the front desk staff. The onsite restaurant is decent, but service can be a little slow, which is why we didn't give a 5 star review. They also have a really nice rooftop swimming pool and an onsite workout room. We've stayed here before and will stay here again when we come to the Miami area.

Very nice and clean hotel. Oscar and Pedro were extremely friendly and accommodating. We were offered a selection of different rooms and had the opportunity to view them beforehand. We truly enjoyed our stay at Arlo Wynwood. Many thanks!!!
Excelente servicio. Pedro, Aisha y Myra fueron super amigables y de gran ayuda en todo! Check-in fue super rápido. Muy buenas instalaciones y super buena ubicación .

La experiencia en el hotel 10/10 el personal del hotel super amable y profesional, Oscar nos dio recomendaciones muy acertadas y nos colaboró con todas nuestras inquietudes, tanto así que decidimos reservar otra fecha para repetir la experiencia, excelente experiencia

We enjoyed our quick overnight stay at the Arlo. The receptionist was extremely friendly. The room reminded me of a European hotel room. There were no frills, but truthfully we didn't need much since it was a quick trip. The bathroom was nice the lighting was a bit low. There are bars downstairs and on the rooftop. Even though there were no gluten free opens on the food menu, I appreciate the bartender checking . Valet seemed a bit much at $60/night; however, in comparison to the street parking rates, valet was cheaper. Overall, for what we needed, it was decent stay. Im unfamiliar with the surrounding area, so I am unable to make any comparisons.

Hotel con muy buena presencia, bonito y ubicado en una muy buena zona de Wynwood. Lo conocí y me impresionaron lo sobrio de sus habitaciones, limpieza, orden y lo agradable de las vistas de parte de Miami. Excelente piscina y facilidad de movilización entre áreas y pisos. Quedo pendiente de volver al Arlo. Mi familia lo disfruto gratamente.

Me encantó su estética moderna y minimalista. Destaco su espectacular terraza con piscina y vistas a la ciudad. Tiene un hermoso jardín con bar. Las habitaciones son cómodas, impecables y bien equipadas. La ubicación es inmejorable, ya que está a pasos de galerías, bares y restaurantes. Es el perfecto punto de partida para explorar la zona de Wynwood a pie.

Victor was the best! He was our poolside bartender/server and went above and beyond the entire time. Super friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without ever having to ask. He had such a great attitude and really made the experience even better. Thank you, Victor!

Pasamos una noche en el, buena piscina en el último piso, check in rápido, habitaciones nuevas, cómodas en relación calidad precio. Muy buena opción para alojarse en la zona, y salir de lo habitual de South Beach o Brickell, a precio muy razonable y bien comunicados.

Nice hotel! I had an especially nice check-in experience with Pedro and Savery. The rooms are simple, but they have nice touches like a white noise machine and water. There are nice amenities in the hotel as well. I didn't explore the area too much, but there do seem to be good food options around.

You can NEVER go wrong with the Arlo! The decor is top tier the room amenities are updated which is hard to find at a lot of hotels. Pedro and Savery were sooo welcoming upon my arrival with great smiles and an amazing energy. They made checking in very seamless

The atmosphere at ARLO is second to none. The customer service is impeccable, from start to finish. The vibe on each floor & rooftop views are magnificent. Heavily recommended to stay & Im sure to return, next Miami visit. Shout out to Oscar, Shatoya, Mladen & Savery for my stay an everlasting memory. Where I come from, we say, go where you celebrated, not tolerated. I appreciate you framily!!!

Was great overall . Daniela front desk was awesome very kind and helpful / accommodating. Need more staff like her. Will be back again as I work in Miami often and this location is close to the exits of destination. Pool is also cool with nice views of the city.

I forgot my medication, wallet and passport in my room and checked out! Christofer assisted me and retrieved all my belongings and held them for me to pick up the next day. He was so helpful and kind. Excellent customer service. Life saver!!!

We spent two nights at the Arlo Wynwood. Great location for checking out the murals and graffiti in the area. Lots of restaurants within walking distance. Walking distance to Thomas Dambo’s Joen and the Giant Beetle sculpture, Wynwood Walls and the Museum of Graffiti. Our room was very comfortable. The facility had a café, bar, lounge, sunset deck, and lovely rooftop pool deck. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. A special shout out to employees Savery and Facundo, who made us feel especially welcome.

Oscar represented the company amazingly. My name is Lavern and it was my first time coming to Miami. I was in a crisis. My flight came in late, the first hotel I was at was horrifying. I was terrified. I was afraid and also alone waiting to meet up with my fellow coworkers the next day. I’m not going to get into that story. I’m so glad that everything worked out so well for me, coming to Arlo Wynwood. Everyone who worked here were so kind and made my first experience to Miami a pleasant one. Oscar went up and beyond to show support and amazing customer service skills. I’m so grateful my experience in Miami turned around with the help of Oscar. He made all my worries go away with a kind smile, great work ethics and a drive to make each customer feel important and seen. Thank you, Oscar. I truly appreciate you as an employee. He needs a raise. Every time I come to Miami expect me to be at this hotel. Have an amazing day to whoever reads my review.

The bartender Victor, in the lobby bar, was an absolute gem! We were on a very quick stopover in Miami and he was very accommodating even though we were punchy-tired and indecisive. He packed everything up for us to take to our room too. He mixes a great cocktail!

We came for a business trip- the arlo Wynwood did not disappoint! Victor and “M” at the bar in the lobby were amazing and were really helpful in recommendations for other restaurants in town. Drinks were amazing! Can’t wait to come back. The rooftop is lovely and the parties are a blast!

I booking directly on their web site and get a great last minute deal . Included in the price 15 bucks food and drinks credit at the bar in the lobby ( by the way the waitress Christina from Chilli is awesome ) and 2 hours bike from the hotel . Room is small but very nice with great shower gel . The 3 rd floor japonaise sushi bar and cocktail ( sushi by Lou ) is a plus for the vibes . All of the staff is great and here to help you with everything you need . The negative point is the valet parking : 40 bucks for a regular car and 61 bucks for a big truck ?!?!?! So I decide to park across in the street and paid 20 bucks for 8 hours and wake up early morning to move it to another zone ??? W the F .

Pros: Comfy beds, nice room, felt safe traveling solo, good proximity to food/shopping/workout spots. Nice pool. 15-20 min to the beach. Room was ready well before check-in time and they gave me a late checkout with no fee. Fine for a one night stay and decent prices if you book ahead Cons: Lobby smelled like cheap air freshener/cleaner, Room smelled super musty, Subpar customer service - Called ahead to request a late checkout, was told I could have one and then when I arrived they had no note of this, Did not tell me where any of the amenities were upon arrival, I just kind of wandered around til I found the pool/gym. Charged me but did not send me my final bill, had to call 3 separate times to get it

This is our second time in the Hyde suites. We had a great time on our first visit that’s why we picked it again for our second trip. You can’t beat the location. Minutes from the design district with all the shopping and restaurants. Claire at the front desk is really great, sweet and helpful. She gave us options for restaurants and bars & made our stay more enjoyable!

Excelente hotel muy bien localizado en midtown miami limpio funcionários atenciosos habitaciones modernas piscina, canja de tennis, gym y sauna, restaurantes cerca para desayuno y otros para almuerzo y cena para tomar un buen vino seguramente regresaré

La atención y disposición de su personal! En todo momento estuvieron pendientes para ayudarme, orientarme y solucionar cualquier necesidad propias de un viajero. Les envío un saludo muy especial y GRACIAS TOTALES!!! Saludos desde Colombia!!!!

Most pleasant set of front desk staff I have encountered, efficient and very friendly and cheerful. Family had several suites, well laid out with expansive balconies overlooking the Midtown square. Great location, close to restaurants, coffee shops, stores, and of course, the Design District and Winwood. Cleaning could have been a bit better.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: BRICKELL Arch Luxury Collection! A name to be remembered when booking Miami hotel.Room was spacious, separated bathtub/ shower, nice decoration! Location is very good! But, the best part of the hotel is the front desk staff! Marilyn, and the gentleman who was working in the morning today, were outstanding!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Queremos felicitar a todo el personal por los excelentes servicios y atenciones recibidas. Nos hospedamos del 13 al 16 Agosto y nos sentimos como en casa. La ubicación es inmejorable. El descanso, el desayuno y la limpieza fueron impecables. Todo el personal se mostró siempre atento y dispuesto a ayudar. Mención especial para el equipo de desayuno, muy atento; para recepción y parqueo, todos muy amables; y en especial para Eduard, quien nos orientó con mucha amabilidad y disposición. Gracias por tener un equipo con un verdadero don de servicio.
older property, but spacious rooms very comfortable and nice staff. The location is great right in the heart of Coconut Grove.

We recently stayed here while my husband was on a work trip and it was nothing short of magical! The rooms are huge and clean. Our two little girls, ages 4 and 2 had a blast at the pool, loved the complimentary breakfast and enjoyed exploring the hotel. The surrounding area is safe, walkable with great restaurants. The staff go above and beyond to make you feel welcome and taken care of. Fernando at the concierge desk was a highlight of our trip! He greeted us with a friendly smile, gave us recommendations in the area and was sweet to our kids. If you are in the Coconut Grove area, this hotel is a MUST!!

I wanted to stay at this hotel in March 2024, but it was booked by the time we got around to it. When we planned our next Miami trip I said “I don’t care what we do, but I need to stay at Mayfair.” I am so glad. I loved every second. The front door and the scent when you enter is magical. The staff was maybe the most outgoing, friendly people I’ve ever interacted with. I loved the ambiance of our room(the cardinal suite). The room did have a musty smell, but it wasn’t overpowering. I used the claw foot tub and watched the office. We enjoyed our patio. Breakfast was great. We went to the guest reception and everyone was so kind. I would stay here again and again. We walked all over coconut grove. Checked every box on our list. And then we took a quick uber to our cruise.

The hotel is absolutely beautiful I just need to note that the coffee shop employees shouldn’t roll their eyes or physically demonstrate the guest is annoying… as we can all see it! We were there! It was my first time and they genuinely made me feel sad. At no point a guest should feel lowkey bullied by the staff, and even less at a hotel! I understand my ignorance could seem annoying to the staff, but smiling and being understanding can go a long way.

The stay at this hotel was magical. From the minute you walk in the staff was super Nice and provided to us anything we needed. It was such a relaxing stay overall I recommend anybody to stay at this hotel if you want a new experience. Also the are around the hotel has nice restaurants.

Love the Mayfair House. Absolutely gorgeous atrium, big rooms and the service is fantastic. From Robert, who checked us in on Sunday and read our notes for the request of an outdoor shower to Fabian, who handled it car, everyone is always wanting to give the best experience possible.

Desde que nos recibió en el hotel Fernando, súper atento, querido con la niña y nosotras, habitación cómoda, grande, con televisor, hasta la retirada con el Valet con Fabian, súper atento, disponible, querido, y servicial. La comida deliciosa, la piscina con temperatura perfecta, ideal para niños al igual que las asoleadoras.

Really enjoyed the hotel room and pool. Staff was very friendly and the service was excellent. We lived the unique room layout with lots of space and standing bathtub. The breakfast was very tasty and healthy also. Great location in the center of coconut grove.

We had a great stay, loved the unique vibe of the hotel. The pool was so inviting and calm, and the food for dinner and breakfast was delicious. The staff were all friendly and professional, in particular Fabian was very kind and helpful when greeting us!

We stayed one night. The hotel is wonderfully and artfully designed. We found the service to be exceptional, but not overbearing. The room was wonderful, though being there only one night we didn’t take full advantage of it. All around, one of the best hotel stays we’ve had for some time.

Fabian, Fabricio, and Carlos were outstanding during our two-week stay. They provided invaluable support throughout our production days, both in the hotel and with all crew Vehicles. Truly appreciated, no complaints and on time thank you 😊

The hotel was lovely but the staff helped make the stay really wonderful. Traveling for work with tons of luggage is hard but Fabian, Fabricio and Carlos truly went above and beyond! The hotel was very pretty and an awesome location. Lovely stay and will be back

I stay here for production job. Hotel was near lots of restaurants. Their own restaurant was good. Enjoyed the compl breakfast options. I did really like the staff. Fabian was alway so happy to help with my car. Carlos and Fabricio as well. It was like your family welcoming back each day I return to hotel. Room was nice as well.

Just got home after 3 nights at this hotel - we had a great time overall with friends and family and we appreciated the beautiful space, overall hotel vibe (super chill) and location in coconut grove (very convenient and next to a ton of shops and good restaurants).
