Now the not so fun stuff which I genuinely hope management will address: 1) the hotel is severely understaffed (an hour wait for fresh towels to be brought to the room, 6 different phone calls to the front desk asking for cutlery and plates to be delivered to the room (doordash delivery forgot to add paper plates) only to be told after 40 minutes that room staff are busy and to call the restaurant in the hotel to get plates (shocking) 2) breakfast on the mezzanine floor was a traffic jam with hungry disgruntled guests waiting for tables (not enough staff to clean tables and rotate people in an out ) 3) the elevators are from 1940 or something and just caused chaos all weekend notably during saturday’s wedding cocktail reception; one elevator was “under inspection” which is pretty crazy given the wedding. Elevator C’s motion sensors don’t work so well and during the cocktail hour multiple Karens and Kens were losing their marbles not being able to get to the promised champagne as hoped. So close yet so far! At one point one couple hurdled over my child and his stroller to get their body into the elevator before it shut. I sincerely hope management addresses these very obvious issues!

This hotel is a gem. We absolutely fell in love with this hotel. The location is perfect. It allows you to be close to the city life, but at night you can unwind in peace. All of the employees treated us like royalty. If I could give this hotel more stars, I would.

Fantastic stay. Unique suite-style rooms for all rooms. Great view from the 5th floor. Desk staff and parking staff were very attentive and helpful. Fabian with parking staff was always on top of my car requests. With a text request, my car was always available as soon as we stepped outside.

Ideally located in the quietly chic former hippie haven of Coconut Grove, this luxe stay is serenity now, zen and later. Unbelievable five star accommodations, service, style and cuisine. Rooftop pool and bar are splendid and Mayfair Grill with hot Michelin star chef Giorgio Rapicavoli is smokin—literally, with a wood fire grill that beckons you in with savory scents of something stellar. The free full breakfast, 3:05 cafecito shots in the lobby and assorted wellness offerings like sound baths in the lush garden lobby are only some of the reasons to run here and relax.

La pasamos súper lindo! Muy amable el personal! Los desayunos buenísimos! Todo maravilloso! Fabiàn el Valet Parking un genio! ❤️🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈 Hermosa estadía y ojalá que podamos volver pronto! Lo vamos a recomendar a todos nuestros amigos

El brunch de Mayfair house en una sola palabra increíble! La comida, el ambiente, la música en vivo, el servicio de nuestra server Daniela fue increíble! El lugar hermoso perfecto para una tarde de amigas! Simplemente delicioso, súper recomendado!

Landan is awesome! Awesome drinks and great conversation! Great place to hang out. Gorgeous weather. So much fun!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Todo fue excelente! En especial Fabian nos ayudó mucho y fue muy amable con nosotras. Nos ha encantado la experiencia, sin duda repetiremos.
Muy buen servicio Muy seguro El gym gimnasio es genial, muy grande y bonito. Todos son muy amables En especial Fabián fue muy amable y servicial
Pésima experiencia, nos hicieron dar 200 dólares de “depósito” que supuestamente iban a regresar después de la estadía, NUNCA REGRESARON NADA, les he escrito y NUNCA CONTESTAN. Tengan mucho cuidado.

Mi experiencia fue increíble la atención es impecable Pero quiero felicitar en especial al equipo de valet parking fueron muy eficientes con su trabajo Gracias Juan por el servicio brindado de tu equipo

La ubicación es extraordinaria y las instalaciones están muy bien, el servicio es pésimo. Me quedé con mi familia y a la 1 de la mañana alguien entró a la habitación, prendió la luz y al ver que mi hijo lo descubrió, cerró la puerta y se fue dejando la luz prendida. Hablé a recepción y me dijeron que fue alguien de servicio les comenté que nunca había visto que entraran en la madrugada y menos sin avisar. Lo comenté en la recepción en la mañana y me dijeron que iban a ver que pasó y me informarían. Total que mejor cambié de hotel y ya hasta regresé a casa y a nadie le importó. Y no tuve el servicio de hacer la habitación y si quieres el sofá-cama lo tienes que hacer tú. En fin, en mi opinión, es el peor lugar para quedarse en Miami.
Estuve en la piscina , las bebidas fueron 10/10 y la atención de Jean fue excelente. Volveremos pronto! El Elser Hotel volvió a sorprendernos.
Excelente ubicación y estancia con muy buena vista al mar. La atención por parte de el valet mánager Juan de primera gracias!!
Excelente servicio de César quedamos agradecidos con el, lo máximo más personas como el Saludos César y muchas gracias

Russell was very friendly, professional and provides wonderful hospitality. I recommend coming to the Rooftop Bar at the Elsers and ask for Russell! Thank you Russell for making our time here memorable! -Karla and Bianca

The Elser Hotel was absolutely incredible from the moment we walked through the door until we left. The vibe, cleanliness were next level. Alexander was super attentive and helpful. He made our stay here memorable. Specifically , I should mention that we flew in from Phoenix overnight and got into Miami around 5 AM. We were greeted warmly by Alexander at 6 AM at the Elser. When we got there, we had already assumed that we would have to wait for a room. Much to our surprise, Alexander made sure that we had a place to go. He found us the perfect room on the perfect floor with the perfect view and we were in our room by 615. He proceeded to make sure we had everything that we needed and that we were happy to be at the Elser. Needless to say we would come back anytime we find ourselves in Miami just to experience Alexander’s service again. 10/10 would absolutely recommend The Elser! Thank you, Alexander The Great for making our experience memorable!!
Jennifer Rivera del Lobby es muy atenta y de buen humor, sin lugar a dudas volvería a reservar en este hotel por su ubicación y servicio

Me encantó las instalaciones del hotel. El servicio increíble tanto en el del lobby y el área del pool and Bar como la recepción ! Jennifer fue muy amable y profesional con su servicio! Volvería una y otra mes ! Mil gracias :)
Fuimos atendidos maravillosamente, por Jennifer muy amable y con toda la experiencia en atención también Nicolás fue muy amable y atento
Anyi nos atendió muy bien. Muy buen servicio Todo al 100. Excelentísimo. Ya quiero dejar de escribir. Se pasan de lanza . A la madre

Cuidado con este hotel aparte de que te cobran $66 dolares extra por noche por el resort. Te piden un cargo extra de $200 dolares en la tarjeta. Dicen que se devuelve al hacer check out, pues después de más de un mes no me han devuelto este cargo a la tarjeta.

Hotel muy bonito y céntrico en el corazón del Bayside! La habitación era bonita con unas vistas espectaculares. El sofá cama incómodo para 2 personas. El toallero del baño estaba roto. Tuvimos que llamar para que nos trajeran sábanas para el sofá cama y nos hicieran la cama. Deberíamos haberla encontrado hecha, ya que llegamos de noche. No nos gustó nada que nos cobraran una fianza de 200$ por noche (estuvimos 3 noches) y no nos devolvieran los 600$ hasta que pasó 1 mes. Personal amable, pero siempre buscando la propina. Vestíbulo siempre abarrotado de gente del bar musical colindante, pequeño para el tamaño del hotel y caótico en general. No repetiría la experiencia para lo que se paga. Buscaría otras opciones por la zona.
Increíble servicio, vistas, ubicación y desayuno con Elba. Regresaría nuevamente al mismo hotel. Totalmente agradecida

Staying at The Elser Hotel and Residences is a most wonderful experience. The location and atmosphere are unparalleled. Well appointed, gorgeous rooms are welcoming and provide a respite from the day's activities. The impeccable staff are knowledgeable and helpful. I would stay at this hotel again and again

Unbelievably good service!! Me and my girlfriend just checked ourselves in, and were really anxious that there were gonna be some problems but thanks to Jennifer and Alejandro at the check in we felt really welcome and accommodated.
Great vibes! Amazing service! Lovely views! Jennifer is the absolute best! Alejandro is the sweetest man! 100% would reccomend.

After a challenging trip, arriving at SONESTA MIAMI AIRPORT was a true relief. From the warm welcome to the seamless check-in, the staff went above and beyond—especially SUSANA REYES she was so helpful and to make my stay exceptional. My immaculate room, plush bedding, and thoughtful amenities provided the perfect space to unwind. The attention to detail, outstanding service, and delicious dining turned my experience around. I highly recommend this hotel and will definitely be returning!

Totalmente renovado muy cerca del aeropuerto Internacional. El personal es muy amable. El lobby amplio con check in y check out rapidísimo. Las habitación impecable con muy buenas camas y ropa de blanco. Baño totalmente nuevo con muy buenas toallas y toallones. A pesar de la cercanía del aeropuerto las habitaciones están insonorizadas. El desayuno buffet tiene una excelente oferta. Muy buen mobiliario. Tiene parking privado en el predio y servicio de traslados al aeropuerto. Muy buena relación precio/calidad

Everything is very clean and brand new. Very comfy.bartenders are super attentive and friendly. Hotel is very clean and just perfect. The area is so convenient great restaurants around. The food here is actually very good . I’ll absolutely come again ,

The room was so clean and cheerful!!! The TV was nice and big!! Food and drinks in lounge were really tasty! Brunch was yummy!!! Servers and bartenders were fantastic!! Justin and Alena at the front desk were very helpful and friendly! I would totally stay here again!! And free shuttle from airport!! Driver was super helpful with luggage!

Todas y todos los camareros son unos auténticos profesionales......... Me encontré como en casa. ...........Siempre atentos 😍 Siempre volveré a este hotel. Espero veros en breve. Cuidaros mucho y mucha suerte para todos. Abrazos y besos

Waooo, soy dominicana y nosotras cocinamos bueno, mas comí en el buffet del hotel y me encantó la comida, todo en su punto, buena presencia, a la verdad que me encantó, Barbara cocina espectacular , eso vegetales, la ensalada de papa, Dios, todo ricoooo, mi amiga que disfrutó de otras partes de la comida le encaró todo.

Muy buen servicio, en especial la remarcable atención y cuidado de Fátima del restaurante, muchas gracias por todo especialmente por el servicio ofrecido en el restaurante, su carisma y sonrisa estuvo siempre presente, muchas gracias ❣️❣️❣️

We rented a “Day Room” at The Sonesta Miami Airport Hotel through ResortPass for a comfortable place to rest until our post cruise evening flight home. The airline informed us that our scheduled 7 pm flight was delayed until midnight. We asked for an extension of our check out time and Franceina at the front desk graciously allowed us to stay another four hours with no additional cost. Our room was very comfortable (far, far better than waiting in the airport’s hard seats). We thank Franceina and the Sonesta for making our return trip home more comfortable.

I have stayed here off and on for years and always loved it.. things have changed. I was not informed about all the construction.. which I can understand.. however the gym was filthy and absolutely no furniture to sit outside by the pool to enjoy reading or just being outside. The restaurant would not let me take tacos to my room as they were to messy. However the most disgusting thing was the POOP on the toilet seat. It was so gross. I called for the bathroom to be infected and no response.. then I thought about it and really wanted to change rooms.. no return phone call. The cleaning lady finally arrived and did not understand the word disinfectant.. I am so disappointed with this stay. I waited until they asked for a review and responded that they would look into this.. crickets. Feeds on a toilet seat is simply unacceptable.. no apology, no reimbursement .. silence. .

Did young man in the bar area was very nice Mr. Wilson very great guy pleasant attitude present appearance pleasant everything who is so great. I really enjoyed being at the bar thank you Will. You was a great customer service. I would recommend this hotel customer Mr. Wilson is a great host at the bar area. The food area. He was a great presence to be with great attitude. Great people presents. He recognize when you sit at his bar area. I really enjoyed his presence.

Excelentes habitaciones. Excelente servicio. Me gustó. Fátima y la gente del resto fueron muy amables dando info y excelentes tips. Volvería sin dudar. Ideal para estar cerca del aeropuerto . Las habitaciones son perfectas . Tienen todo

Gracias Sayda y Jorge personal del restaurante del hotel, generan muy lindo ambiente entre los que vamos solos, gracias también por la comida muy buena la calidad y el sabor, siempre atienden con muy buena onda. Espero volverlos a ver la próxima vez que venga

The staff was awesome and extremely welcoming and helpful. There are renovations being done right now but the bar is newly renovated as well as our room . Both were extremely beautiful, clean and very comfortable. The bar is beautiful and the bar tender, Wilson, was extremely helpful, easy to talk to and had great recommendations for us. I will definitely be returning.

It's good comfortable great service Doing great keep it up have a wonderful day and to the hotel. Great food and the staff very friendly. And Ms.Fatima Gustavo shes been friendly since we arrive a hotel and 5 star to this wonderful lady keep it up always have a good day great service.

Not enough words to describe the treatment we received by all the staff at this hotel at a time of despair. Having to stay at this hotel during Hurricane Milton with thoughts about the safety of our families and friends the staff at this Sonesta Hotel succeeded in easing our fears with their professionalism and compassion. Especially the front desk and restaurant staff. Gustavo/Fatima were super restaurant hosts. The hot meals were well prepared and tasty. No problems encountered. Great job guys.

Sayda and Anthony are exceptional humans!!! Wonderfully competent and jovial. It was just a layover for me but next time I come to Miami I am 100% going to stay here. Rooms are great, just completed big renovations, staff is amazing. Fully recommend. AND THE GYM IS OPEN 24hr!!!

Excelente comida!!! Muy rico todo, muchas gracias Gustavo y Fátima 🤗🤗 el desayuno estuvo muy bueno! El lugar es muy bueno para hospedarse también, el señor conductor del shuttle es lo máximo! Señor Jesús nunca lo olvidaré!! Viva Latinoamérica 🥰

After a long day of international travel I was relieved and impressed by the level of service that the staff displayed. The kitchen had just closed but Jorge , the restaurant manager overheard me talking at the front desk about starving went above and beyond to get me a hot meal nevertheless! Rick and Davian were also very helpful as well; their professionalism and hospitality that hit the spot for this weary traveller. And the shuttle drivers were friendly and went out of their way to handle everyone’s bags with care. I’m an executive in the hospitality industry and I must say that from the cleanliness and well appointed rooms, I was beyond satisfied. I was only there for one night but wish I could have stayed longer as the room was great and the bed so comfortable. Although it was Jorge from the restaurant that made my stay truly unforgettable. Great job guys. Thank You!

Conveniently located near the airport, priced fairly and comes with all essential commodities. We stayed there before going on Royal Carribbean Cruise and the hotel was a great way to recover from a lengthy flight. They were also very kind in helping us store our luggage safely while we were on the cruise

I went to the bar/resturant .. there was a very WONDERFUL gentleman name Wilson the was outstanding his derives , personality & his character was at outstanding although the restaurant was very over crowded due to a function wit a large party he conducted business with a smile & care for each patron.. we need more people like Wilson on the front line

Fantastic location in the heart of the Miami Modern district. Ultra-cool and excellent restaurants, boutiques and 1950s architecture. Easy drive to downtown and the beaches. Rooms are immaculate and unique, nothing like a typical hotel room. Beautiful, secluded pool area with outdoor bar. The best sushi, Greek, Italian and bakery are literally a two minute walk away. And of course the staff is friendly and housekeeping is excellent.
A super great GEM in Miami. So private🫶…..a must to get together with friends and family:) Quiet and great vibes. Kinda like the Jetson’s

A truly lovely stay at the Vagabond. Our room was spacious, spotless and charmingly decorated in a cool, mid century style. Really wide and super comfortable bed and a great shower added to the high level of comfort we experienced. The staff were really friendly and helpful. We had the good sized pool all to ourselves in the morning, so a great start to the day! They provide non stop coffee/tea. No breakfast is offered, but there are many very good cafes/bakeries within a two minute walk. Parking is free, another plus. Overall, we couldn’t have asked for a more enjoyable stay at the the Vagabond.

What a fabulous find! This little gem in downtown Miami was exactly what we needed once we landed in Miami. Set back from the main road, we could barely hear the traffic and my girls were straight in the pool and lounging on the spacious sun chairs. It was also only a 10 minute drive from the airport and easy to find. The whole build has been refurbished in the style of a typical 1950s motel (after being saved from demolition) and has been completed to a high standard. The rooms had everything in that we needed, were spacious and the beds comfy. My teenage girls also liked that the wash stand and vanity table were completely separate from the shower which meant we weren't arguing over whose turn it was to use the bathroom! Front desk staff were all very friendly and helpful. We didn't explore the area as we were only here for 1 night but there is a small section adjacent to the motel with a liquor store (and basic snacks) and a Venezuelan restaurant called Doggi's which has superb reviews and fantastic food (we ate here and loved it). Overall, I would highly recommend Vagabond for it's unique style and set up, still being close and with access to Miami Beach and surrounding areas without the exorbitant costs of some of the Miami hotels.

This is such a hidden gem! The pool and rooms are marvelous. The management and staff are warm and authentic. I would describe it as a chique boutique motel. Very stylish while still being comfortable. Also very conveniently located. I can’t wait to return!

Brilliant hotel; the hospitality of the staff (especially the co-owner) was second to none. The passion and love for the place was clear in every conversation, whether offering a local restaurant/cafe tip, or just checking in to make sure everything was okay. Really comforting when visiting the US from the UK. Rooms were immaculate. Would definitely recommend over a larger hotel chain in Miami.

I am so happy I discovered this charming little hotel on Biscayne. I would describe this place as a "boutique-y Howard Johnsons". I loved that they preserved their mod heritage and all of the creative touches thrown in. My room was very comfortable temperature-wise, the shower is spacious, and there's enough counter space for all of your toiletries and devices. My favorite area was the pool - it is gorgeous, clean and very inviting. I want to go back when I have more time just to lounge at the pool all day long. As a solo female traveler, I felt safe here. The front office is available 24 hours and the employees were very warm, friendly and accommodating.

Great stay here amazing facilities and the staff always up for a conversation. can't fault a single thing loved every minute there The little northern curly tail lizards and iguanas are so awesome too Planning a future trip to Miami will be back here for sure

Stayed here for an event nearby, this was a gorgeous hotel. No complaints. Love the style/decor, and the pool was lovely. Staff was so friendly too. Would stay again for sure. It was quiet and relaxing despite being off a somewhat busy street. Wasn't bothered by noise at all.

We were there with the whole family (13 people) for 2 days. Without question an extraordinary place, like a little oasis in the middle of Miami. Everyone was very dedicated and arranged the best possible setup for us. You feel very comfortable. Breakfast places, bakery and restaurants are just around the corner within walking distance. An ideal place from which to explore the city and relax by the pool at the end of the day.

I recently stayed here for a few days when I was down in Miami visiting my daughter. What a pleasant surprise! The rooms are all decorated in a throwback to the 1950s which I loved. Very clean as well. The pool itself is like a tropical oasis. Can’t wait to go back!

Great experience, lovely staff. Great interior design especially for lovers of 50s and 60s vibes. I came here for a holiday and business purposes. Neighbourhood is quieter than South Beach and more relaxed. I could unwind and do remote work from here. I’ll be definitely coming back

Beautifully restored. Friendly staff. Comfortable bed and room. It was a lot of fun to stay there. Nice pool area. We would stay there again. Excellent location, accessible to downtown Miami and Miami Beach. National Historic Registry property.

We loved our trip to Vagabond! My 3YO spent hours by the pool, couch hopping, chasing lizards. Our room was great, spacious, and extremely clean. The staff (May, Juan, and Andy) were amazing. They all took time to talk to my kiddo, they really made our trip special. We will definitely be back!

We loved the Vagabond Hotel. I just wish it was warm enough that we were able to use the outside pool. The staff at the front desk were exceptional. They were very helpful and would go out of their way to help. The room was very nice but it does need more lighting especially over the bathroom mirror. Loved the shower, nice and big. Overall, we would definitely would stay there again.

This was a great place to stay. The rooms were clean, comfy and so cute! The staff were so great to my daughter and I. We stayed here after a cruise and they were so accommodating. The staff recommended us go the diner down the street and the food was delicious. Would stay here again anytime I'm in Miami.

A beautiful vintage hotel with modern updates. The area is full of other classic hotels but I think we chose the best one. The staff was extremely friendly and the room was spacious, clean and comfortable. We really enjoyed the pool and vibes. I will be back.

Exceptional stay, my first. PERFECTLY clean, delightful staff, and a fantastic location for my local meeting and business dinner in the Design District. I really dug the vibe and fantastic coffee and pastries nearby. Highly recommend! With gratitude!

Nice hotel with a great history. Room was nice, clean and vintage updated. We stayed a Saturday night before getting on a cruise Sunday. Only complaints are the bar pool was closed and the manager said the bartender would not be coming in because there was an event there the night before. When we booked we really looked forward to sitting in the awesome pool are at the bar for the evening to relax after the drive, instead we had to drive to a restaurant a few miles away for a drink. The diner on the property was also closed for renovation. For the price it would have been nice to have the full experience.

Vagabond was cute. Nice and close to great restaurants to be able to walk to. The pool bar hours vs normal pool hours were a bit confusing and they closed early 2 nights we were there, which was a big bummer. Would have been nice to have a microwave option with longer stays. Staff was diligent about cleaning the room daily which was a nice touch!

Such a lovely hotel experience. Great staff, great room, fantastic wrap-around terrace, and... cool Salvaje bar upstairs for a quick (multiple) nightcap(s)! The location was perfect for hopping between Wynwood, Little River, and on over to South Beach. Will be back here soon, Hyde Midtown Miami!

Incredible staff! I was greeted with the warmest welcome and a complimentary cocktail. The location had everything and more in walking distance. Beautiful rooftop pool and fitness center plus a spa and nearby beach access!! Definitely would book here again!

We evacuated Cape Coral ahead of Milton. Although we had the stress of uncertainty about our house, it was nice to have a home away from home. Midtown Miami is a great location with lots to explore as well as many dining options. Luckily when we got home, we had power and the house was fine. All staff we had contact with were wonderful!

Staff was so accommodating and friendly. Asked for early check in and late check out with no hassles! Front desk staff knew a lot about the area and made great recommendations. Hotel amenities 👍👍 top notch! Pool and hot tub a great spot for relaxation. Will definitely check in again soon!

The pillows are very good and so is the living room. Some wall noises in the main room were not comfortable for me to rest. Someone threw my water bottle in the trash without my consent. Otherwise the location and the hotel seem very good to me. Thanks

Had a short but lovely stay at Hyde Midtown. The room was spacious, comfy bed and an unexpected balcony!! Staff was very welcoming and accommodating. Valet was worth the money and they were so attentive and respectful of our things. Will be staying again!

Checked in with Gwen! She was amazing, hotel is clean and nice rooms are great will definitely come back the Japanese restaurant is a rooftop and really nice the amenities are also nice poool spa and jacuuzi the staff is friendly and everything is good

Everything was outstanding. Ms. Reneta was especially very friendly and helpful 🙏🏻 Thanks very much Hyde Midtown Hotel Team…we’d love to visit again …………………………..…………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………..

Everything was perfect - except there are no ice machines close to the room. Love the design and the bed was very comfy and cozy! The proximity to Design District and restaurants is fantastic! It would have be nice to have lights inside the shower as well. I will be back!!! Thank you for your services!

Room: great A/C and hot water. Found room to be quiet unless there was street maintenance vehicles doing stuff. So, what do you do? You have to call to have ice delivered to room, but always arrived promptly. Valet service was responsive. Loved the balcony and watching the neighborhood goings on from there. Mid-town is a great location for those who don't need to spend time on beach.

We went for a one night, mini anniversary getaway. Excellent hotel, the room was clean and modern, the service was friendly and helpful. The location is great, in the middle of midtown, and it's relatively easy to get in and out of. It's surrounded by nice shops and restaurants as well.

Amazing hotel with great amenities. The rooms are spacious, the bed is so comfortable and the staff is very polite and professional. The area is the best if you want restaurants, bars in a walking distance. Definitely recommend 10/10. Will be back!

Had a wedding to attend and stayed at the Hyde. I loved my room especially the balcony. My bed was super comfortable. The pool was nice too. It’s also in a very walkable area which made it easier to make plans with friends. All in all I had a great trip. I’ll definitely stay here again.

My friend and I stayed at the Hyde Midtown Hotel for 3 nights, and we truly enjoyed it. The hotel was nice and the staff members were very professional and courteous. The bed felt AMAZING, which we all know is what you expect at hotels. The rooftop restaurant was beautiful and such a vibe. Although we LOVED everything about the hotel, as it was within walking distance to stores and restaurants, I must mention the nightly noise. We had read a review or two regarding this before we booked, but we decided to risk it anyway. I'm not sure if it came from the rooftop restaurant (which I'd be surprised about as it was very nice and quiet when we went) or if there was a club or something across the street (it always sounded like it was coming from outside). We always looked across the street but never saw anything of the sort. There were, also, drivers who honked at people for anything so sometimes we would hear people honking at 2 am. I was so glad I took my earplugs with me. I would gladly stay at the Hyde hotel again if I didn't have to deal with any noise because I don't particularly like sleeping with earplugs.

Nice bed very comfy, good staff. The pool and amenities are great. The restaurant has great food and wonderful views of miami The gym is fully equipped for everyone. The pool at the 7th floor was great and also has a tennis court. I highly recommend to stay at Hyde midtown

Elizabeth, our exceptional housekeeper, consistently went above and beyond in ensuring our every need was meticulously attended to. From maintaining the immaculate cleanliness of our home to anticipating our preferences, she demonstrated an unparalleled level of dedication and skill. Her commitment to excellence made our experience truly exceptional, and we are incredibly grateful for the exceptional care she provided.

The Hyde is a beautiful hotel. Friendly Staff with luxurious rooms to match. Salvaje was amazing as well. Good food and even better drinks! Atmosphere was top notch. Staff knows how to party up there that’s for sure!! I will book here every trip to Miami from now on!

Love this place I come monthly while visiting my daughter . Staff are great . They they will go Out of there way to help and rooms are very comfortable ! The location is amazing!! Midtown Miami has an amazing vibe . Lots of shops and restaurants .

Location is very good .Hotel is good nearst the shopping and food place you can go everywhere easily .i will say my friends come and stay here hotel staff have good House keeping was good we have always received support for this thank you Elizabeth

The suite was a nice space, it did need some perks though. For example - chairs for the porch/balcony? Extra blankets, maybe throw pillows for the couch? The bathrobes were fine but quite small- would fit someone 120 lbs but not larger. Also the balcony area needs better upkeep/cleaning - ( bird poop on the railing and floor). The front desk staff was wonderful though! I think we would come back, not sure.

Excelente Hotel. El servicio brindado fue uno de excelencia en su totalidad. Toda su empleomania denota mucho profesionalismo y empatia. El proceso del check in fue uno sumamente sencillo y eficaz. El servicio del shuttle de excelencia de igual manera.

Yesterday I had the best experience. Our server Gustavo was very attentive, we never had to ask for anything twice. Gustavo is a huge asset to your restaurant, and he deserves much kudos. I can't say enough good things about the service at this restaurant. We will definitely be back soon! Gustavo thank you for being absolutely the best.

Las 2 personas que nos recibieron anoche en el counter nada corteses, no dieron informacion completa sobre el wifi. Cero sonrisa. No esta habilitada la piscina y tienes la opción de ir a otro hotel y llevar tu toalla, el gimnasio esta en refacción. No dieron información de horarios del restaurante para desayuno y almuerzo, pobre el desayuno, no lo recomiendo pues el trato al cliente es malo.

The one thing that stands out the most at the Sonesta Miami airport is the cleanliness. As you walk in the front door you can feel the clean. Floors shiny and the windows spotless. The front desk agent was very friendly. After checking in we proceeded up to our floor where one of the safety measures kicked in at the fact that you need your key card to be able to go anywhere that is up. Walking into the room was like going into a spa the air was fresh and the room was very clean. The beds a comfortable and enough pillows to cushion around you if you want to. The pool was closed due to work being done in the area but nonetheless when looking down at it from your window the area was very clean. The gym is in a temporary suite but with what you need for a quick workout. The breakfast bar has everything needed for a quick breakfast with fruits breads meat and eggs. Although I did not need it they offer shuttle to and from the airport which can probably save you a bundle. Shopping and delicious Cuban bakeries are right around the corner if you have a sweet tooth like me 😊. I only stayed for the weekend but this hotel is definitely a place to considering should you want to come to Miami. South Beach is only about 12 miles away and this hotel will save you a bundle on hotels stay.

Legué aquí por las fantásticas recomendaciones pero una vez acá, parecía The Twilight Zone. Dónde se alojó toda esa gente que calificó tan generosamente? Hotel viejo y sin servicio. Self Parking entre 20 y 30 dólares Envío de paquetes usd5.- c/u Internet de mala a nula (Gratis) Estuve en el piso 3 y hay olor a humedad. Personal de recepción de frío a desganados. No hay nadie que te ayude con las valijas. Tiene un pequeño store para indispensables pero es caro y muy pocas opciones. Resumen: Solo para dormir si hay que tomar un vuelo temprano. De todas maneras buscaría otra opción

We were sent to the hotel along with 190 other passengers by Virgin Atlantic after they cancelled our flight. The rooms are dimly lit and came with 2 double beds. The bathroom was dated but had a bath with shower overhead. We had food vouchers and the buffet food was ok but not worth the $35 dinner, $25 breakfast and $25 lunch vouchers that we were issued. Someone made a lot of money there. Unfortunately the pool was being refurbished so there was nothing else to do other than sit and chat after we left our room at 11am until our shuttle bus came at 2:30pm. I wouldn’t want to stay any longer than 1 night due to the lack of facilities at the hotel and around it.

The room was old tied and smelly some of sheets were stained with what I don't know No complimentary water in fridge thought that was standard Food would have been expensive at @ $24 person and there was 6 of us we arrived late (due to missing our connecting flight after being sent the wrong queues nut thats another story) and the buffet was closing up

This is a great option if you need a shuttle to the airport at odd hours. The Sonestra provides a 24 hour shuttle that runs every twenty minutes. Catching it at 3:40 am was seamless, and both the hotel staff and shuttle driver were pleasant and efficient, even at that ugly hour. The room itself was clean, comfortable and quiet. I will for sure stay here again when flying in/out.

I was first introduced to Cigar at Sonesta Hotel. Cigar was amazing at customer service ! He helped me with my reservations, and everything I needed in a quickly manner. Also was very professional. Really appreciated his services and will be returning next visit

DESASTRE, un total y completo desastre! Sobre todo la atención de los empleados de front deck, conductor del shuttle, meseros del bar, comida, todo! Los empleados: mentirosos, vagos, irrespetuosos, y muy caro teniendo en cuenta el servicio que prestan

Breakfast buffet is excellent, they are open 6am to 11am very accommodating staff.. kudos to sir anthony the waiter and the hostess.. over all experience 10 out of 10.. the market place is so cool it's like a 24hr convenient store. Rooms are big 5 to 10 mins from miami international airport

Very nice people , all the time clean the room. , Nice area, Clean please , Very, very good Service , I am not to buy some foods a breakfast because they're very expensive. The champion he's the champion. He's very good and the snakes also. Thank you so much.

Franceina was so kind and patient checking me in and answering all my questions. The parking lot is gated plus they provide 24 hour shuttle service. Fantastic ease if you need lodging and parking by Miami Airport.

Cozy and comfortable accomodations just a few minutes from the airport. We had the breakfast buffet which was a very good selection and open until 11:00 am. Quiet room with all the amenities. After a busy day visited the hotel lounge and met Wilson, Jorge and Wilder who extended their hospitality at the bar. No lack of security here. Gated parking and key access to your room floor. Definitely recommend this hotel and say hello to Wilson and staff at the bar 👍

Excellent service. Excellent quality. Excellent experience. The front desk is responsive, the beds are clean, and the shower pressure is great. There’s breakfast every morning and the friendly bar staff help unwind in the evenings. Shoutout to Wilson, Jorge, and Wilder - you guys rock!

Lo de las almohadas es real, soñadas. La habitación muy linda, grande. La limpieza excelente. La gente de recepción excelente. El desayuno exquisito y muy completo, los chicos muy amables, atentos, pendientes de cada detalle.

Mrs. Franceina was very pleasant and helpful made my check in process seamless by acknowledging me as soon as k walked up help make sure my park & fly is in order for my up coming travel for the next day and the rm was exactly what I requested. She’s a sweetheart

Bern was amazing after a difficult day. He was so understanding and made us feel welcome! He changed our bad day into an amazing one! He also delivered so we will always choose Sonesta while traveling to Miami! The beds are so comfortable! Hotel is clean and fresh! Staff is amazing! The shuttle to the airport is always on time! Super convenient and close to the airport!

Fatima in the restaurant for breakfast was the absolute BEST. She was professional, helpful, and made my unexpected stay at Sonesta great. She was attentive and pleasant. Overall the staff here is professional and helpful, but Fatima definitely went above and beyond. Thanks Fatima!

Hotel cercano al aeropuerto para pasar la noche mientras haces un transbordo o esperas a que salga tu vuelo al día siguiente, cumple con las expectativas, muy cómodas las camas y mas almohadas , buena presión de agua en ducha . Tiene gimnasio y piscina para disfrutar.

I’m currently on a five night stay here for a work trip and it is SO LOUD!!! I’ve never experienced this kind of volume at a hotel in my life lol. Bass was literally BOOMING until past 2AM last night and past midnight the night before. I am so tired. There’s hardly any storage in the room, which sucks for a 5 night trip. There’s cubbies under a bench to store stuff so I literally have to get on my hands and knees to grab my clothes. The front desk staff were friendly but everyone else I’ve encountered has been so grumpy and unhelpful. I’m currently at the pool where I’ve just receive the pizza I ordered after waiting 41 minutes and it’s cold 😭. The decor is nice though!

This is a high-end property with professional staff that go above and beyond! This will be my solution for staying in Wynwood in the future. The property is within walking distance of nearby amenities, such as The Spot Barbershop, Wynwood Walls, and the Museum of Graffiti.

Good hotel,reasonably priced Nice space in bathroom to put things Rather less good for unpacking, but only there 3 nights so left things in case. Might have been harder if 2 in the room Noisy- needed earplugs- traffic Lovely breakfast We spent a lot of time paying to get to South beach area. Not sure why we chose this area - nothing to walk out to for example.

We had a delightful stay at the Arlo in Miami! Located right in the arts district, the hotel is incredibly walkable, with plenty to see and do nearby. Our room was comfortable and offered fantastic views. The bed and pillows were great, ensuring a restful night’s sleep, and while the bathroom had just a walk-in shower, it was fine. Despite the busy area, the room was pleasantly quiet, and the whole hotel had an inviting scent. The staff were exceptionally friendly and made us feel right at home. Valet parking was seamless with no issues. We also enjoyed the on-site restaurant and coffee bar—both added a nice touch to our mornings. Although we didn’t get a chance to check out the pool, everything else was lovely. Recommended for anyone looking for a chic, walkable stay in Miami’s vibrant arts district!

Awesome dinning experience at new restaurant sushi by bou. very modern, welcoming and affordable. customer service was great and staff very attentive. Pool area super nice for drinks and view. Definitely will come back with friends and family

Comfortable room. loud nightlife but we New Yorkers slept through it. The sushi omakase was the best sushi I’ve ever had. I feel like I’ve been eating it wrong my entire life. Victor at the rooftop bar is so kind and funny and he makes excellent drinks. The pool was saltwater or at least I could not smell chlorine. The temperature of the water was perfect!

Amazing staff! Highly recommend! From the moment we walked in, we greeted with friendliness from the entire staff and at the restaurant and bar Victor made our experience absolutely amazing! The pool area is nice, clean rooms, and dog friendly!

Hoy la host Daniela nos recibió y nos ayudó con mucha felicidad y entusiasmo. Fue súper amable con nosotros e hizo de nuestro check in una experiencia inolvidable. Nos dio la habitación 637 más temprano. Me encantó el hotel muchas facilidades y todo bien Moderno y limpio por el momento

Pasé una excelente velada en el bar del hotel durante mi estancia en Miami. El ambiente era perfecto para relajarse después de un día lleno de actividades, pero lo que realmente hizo la diferencia fue el servicio de Víctor. Su atención fue impecable, siempre atento y con una actitud súper amigable que hizo que nuestra experiencia fuera mucho más amena. Definitivamente, un lugar al que regresaré y que recomiendo a todos los que buscan un buen rato en un ambiente agradable.

Dined with a friend and Victor was our bartender a d food server. He was kind, helpful and attentive. Highly recommended this experience! The Arlo in Wynwood is new to me. The hotel is absolutely amazing! Checkin was a breeze and I was given a room upgrade. You must try this facility on your next Miami visit!

A nice hotel in the Wynwood Arts area of Miami. Reasonably priced. Very good rooftop pool with drink and food service. Good restaurant. All personnel were very helpful. Rooms were nice but on the small side. No place for luggage. Had to store under the bed.

Recomiendo a cristina la mejor del hotel sin dudas muy amorosa y amable me ayudo en todo lo que le pedía y mas no sabría cómo agradecerle todo lo que hizo por mi Gabriel. Y voy a voy a volver en agosto y sin duda ese es el hotel elegido para estar miami

I had an excellent experience during my stay. I was visiting the area for a pool party at the hotel and decided to book a room for the night. The hotel is nestled in the art district, conveniently close to many Wynwood attractions. Upon arrival, I was warmly greeted by the staff, promptly checked in, and provided with my room keys. The room itself was charming, clean, and modern, capturing the vibe and soul of the surrounding area. I would undoubtedly choose to stay here again.

I went on a short family trip to Arlo Wynwood and we had a blast! This place is perfect for friends, couples, business or as a family like we did. The staff was very friendly and we really enjoyed the rooftop pool. Also, the food in the restaurant is amazing!!!! Very fresh and delicious. My very picky 9 year old son even loved it. Will def return!

Arlo Wynwood is situated in a great location if the beach isn’t your focus. The hotel itself is modern, friendly and professional while the rooms are clean and functional. Can be a bit of a party hotel, so can get a but noisy at times . Daniela and all the front desk team super helpful.

Great accommodations! Daniela was so helpful and friendly. Loved being there. Would recommend it if you are thinking of visiting Miami. Great restaurant. Service all together was absolutely amazing. We were visiting during a major downpour and valet service could not have more helpful!

I went to Mary gold's on Thursday night and I would like to highlight my bartender Joao. He was great and attentive to us all night. Very friendly and very fast, great conversation, we were only going there for a couple of drinks but ended up staying for a couple hours because of him. Definitely will be back.

Had such a fun time at the beautiful Mary Gold’s on the first floor this Saturday! The bar itself is gorgeous and the people are just as nice! Our bartender, Joao, served us the best drinks - he was so attentive and friendly! Will definitely be spending more nights here.

Víctor was the best bar tender, come to visit him, best roof top in Wynwood area. U should go. Close to the club area and food truck. Perfect spot to stay in Miami area. The spot has two rooftop to dance and chill………………………………………………………………………..

It was really disappointing: - The room cleaning service was not done till late in the afternoon (5-6 pm), later on the housekeeping lady explained to me that they prioritized the check out rooms and later the rooms of actual guests. This decision is so bad for the guests you have in house still! - When I went to ask for the cleaning service the person that was in the front desk was very rude and corrected my English with a very bad attitude and being sarcastic - They didn’t left complimentary water cans in the room for 3 days in a row - They didn’t changed towels or bed sheets/quilt for our entire stay (6 nights) - They have a SMS service that supposedly listens to you and solve problems but they never answered any of my messages - They gave us the room in the 4th floor that is above the bar, even with double glass window everything filters inside - The rooms of the 1st two categories are really small - The AC and telephone didn’t work In general, nice location, new hotel, very bad service, very bad housekeeping and not a great experience ☹️

My family and I stayed there so we could attend a wedding and we were astounded by the layout of the hotel! It felt like being in a greenhouse and we loved the lobby and the lounge area in the center of the hotel with all the greenery and water around us. Each suite has its own unique name which was fun, the room was decorated well and most of all the bed was comfy. Staff was also pleasant and professional. I would definitely stay there again and recommend.

This place was fantastic! From the moment we arrived we were greeted by friendly people and surrounded by exquisite accommodations. We arrived prior to check in and the staff quickly assured us they would hold our luggage safely until our room was ready, and provided us with a cold water to take. Once our room was ready, the staff guided us to our room which was HUGE! The space was beautiful, clean, and roomy.

I couldn’t have asked for better service! Everyone was so welcoming and made sure we had everything we needed. From check-in to check-out there was always some around to ask us if we needed anything. We arrived early and were able to leave our luggage with the valet and when we checked out we left our luggage while we were looking around during the day.

this is truly one of the most detail oriented hotels I have stayed in. The hospitality of the team is 10/10 especially Jason, Greg and Taylor. Not only is the hotel beautiful, but extremely welcoming and a true taste of the coconut grove lifestyle. The food at the Mayfair Grill and Sip Sip were both delicious and an amazing experience. The room was amazing- I got to try out the sleep well journey and I can confidently say this was one of the best sleeps I’ve had in my life. Also don’t miss out on the opulence menu, the collagen milk bath is an amazing, relaxing experience and my skin has never felt better. Truly one of the best hotels in Miami. You will not regret staying here

The hotel has always been accommodating and customer service is great! The rooms are spacious, very well maintained.. the only issue we face is when there’s a wedding.. it can get too loud and hard to sleep.. Fabian, the valet is always smiling and welcoming!

The Mayfair went above and beyond to make our unexpected evacuation trip from Tampa to Miami as stress free as possible. The staff was gracious, patient, and accommodating. We traveled with pets and kids. The room was spacious for all of us. The cleaning crew were so kind and patient as well. The hotel was also very clean, charming and truly a unique tropical property- an expected yet pleasant surprise.

Great service from the minute you check in. Convenient location - rooms are pretty big, very comfortable bed. The private patio is amazing, lush with plants make it feel like you’re in paradise- happy hour at the bar was nice- you just try the fig dish!

The best hotel experience I’ve had! The hotel staff was absolutely wonderful. Robert at the front desk went above and beyond to tailor our Miami trip to make it exactly the way we want it! So kind and helpful. Also Fabian at the valet was quick and kind. Overall 10/10 experience.

We loved our stay at the Mayfair Hotel. Ricky, our bartender, at the grill made delicious drinks and was so friendly and delightful. We loved the ambiance and our room was beautiful. Location of the hotel in Coconut Grove can’t be beat. Everything was top notch!

El bar es espectacular, el rooftop no me recuerda que estoy en vacaciones sino que sumo mente me hace vivirlas, ahora al momento de pedir los tragos estaba un poco perdido y no sabía que ordenar hasta que en un momento un chico Colombiano llamado Santiago me ayuda a mi y a mi espesa. Probé varios tipos de cócteles pero sin dudar su fuerte son las margaritas y el expreso martini. Pero aparte de eso más allá de los licores es la atención y lo dedicado que con los clientes nunca dejo de estar pendiente de nosotros y siempre chequeba si necesitábamos algo. Gracias al hotel y gracias al rooftop no tuve la necesidad de ir a otro lugar para disfrutar de Miami.

Ame este lugar, en especial la atención de Santiago que trabaja en el rooftop bar. Realmente enamorada con los hermosos jardines, cocteles deliciosos y una comida exquisita. definitivamente volveré muy pronto a celebrar ovaciones especiales con amigos y familia. Mil gracias Santi por tus cocteles

Had a wonderful meal at the restaurant. Salmon dish along with the mushroom and fish tacos. The wood fire is a fantastic touch. Beautiful ambiance. The host Nia was so welcoming with a warm smile annd anccomodating vibe. Most of aLL amazing service by Nico! A+

Very unique hotel with a garden right in the middle of it. Outside of the hotel you are very close to many restaurants and shops so overall it’s in a great location. At the hotel, we enjoyed the different restaurants on site and were met with exceptional service from the entire hotel staff. Also special thanks to Nik at the front desk for being so helpful throughout our stay. We will be returning here soon!
Jason W was excellent. Helped us with our luggage upon check in and departure. Very friendly, very helpful! He was great!

Everyone was from the hotel was kind and helpful. Jason was responsive to our questions and assisted in our checkout. The room was large, which we liked. We had to call a few times during our stay for face and bath towels. Also for hangars. The lighting in the room was dark. Could be improved. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you! Sheryl Negrin Michael Rudman

Great hotel and location. Fairly close to airport but far enough away from downtown. Lots of restaurants and bars within walking distance. Staff was very professional and accommodating. Jason W was very helpful when I had issues checking out on a tight schedule. Took down my info and had it resolved for me before I made it home. Overall a great experience.

Being originally from Coconut Grove the Mayfair building is iconic and a classic piece of the Grove. Coming back 40 years later I was excited to stay at this landmark. The hotel is unique and beautiful. The jungle, open sky feeling is one of a kind. Check in process was easy, room was clean, rooftop pool, sip-sip, and the daybeds were amazing! Loved that the pool had an intimate atmosphere and feel! Only 4 stars… a few little things worth mentioning. No mini fridge to keep things cold, even though room had a mini bar, the room had an outdoor shower but it only was a rinse off and no temperature controls, i wanted to use this feature but didnt want to take a cold shower, the inside bathroom shower was not designed well and when you showered water would get all over the floor, no washcloths or hand towels. So 3.5 stars for room but felt it should gave more because they do have such a beautiful hotel, fitness classes on Saturdays- yoga and cycling, excellent location, plus great drinks and food at restaurants! Definitely go back just make sure i had a room with a different bathroom!!

Amazing hotel!! We enjoyed our stay. Super cute hotel and delicious food. The staff was extremely helpful. The rooms are perfect and the entire stay was pleasant. Fabian at Valet was incredibly nice also. Super friendly and helpful. We will be back!

1. Get a small front desk, the current lobby situation is not working, most comments about the check in-lobby are negative 2. Have a valet attendant outside front door near check in 3. More pool chairs for guests, don’t allow outside day pass for non guests for pool area 4. Breakfast menu for room service, not just lunch and dinner 5. concierge desk, even if it’s open part time, it could help guests tremendously 6. normal elevator buttons 7. More wash cloths and towels in room 8. slippers with robes in room 9. Eliminate $25 destination fee which is unclear in some booking channels, and just seems like a shady hidden fee 10. Monitor noise/music comming for atrium lobby area 11. Housekeeping service is inconsistent at times, sometimes lackluster, ensure rooms are always properly cleaned And while it’s a beautiful hotel on the surface, fixing these small things will make a huge difference to a four star luxury hotel experience.

My daughters and I had a wonderful stay at Mayfair House. We all felt very safe. Staff was incredible - Fabian and Jason went out of their way to help us each time we came or left or rooms! Pool day was one for the books! We will never forget our stay!

Sorry for the delayed review. I’ve been so busy. But I wanted to post a review because Flavia is doing such an amazing job of managing the hotel. I feel like she made sure that all of my needs were met. Also, she clearly explains how the $30 Destination Fee and credit works. Most Miami hotels charge a destination fee but they do not credit the fee back to the guest for us to spend. I enjoyed this since I had to eat anyway. The hotel is clean and if you have any problems they will fix it. I also want to say a big thank you for being so nice but also professional to the employees that I met and chatted with. I wish that I wrote down names. My stay was very nice and I enjoyed it. I used to stay at another hotel nearby but I’ll stay at this hotel in the future.

Buena área, cerca de un pequeño mall y lugares de restaurantes y tiendas, en el hotel hay de todo desde gym hasta dos pequeños pero alegres y completos bares. La cocina a la carta Excelente mi agradecimiento especial a Daniela Diego Patricia Fredy entre otros Felicidades para mi 💯 recomendado Saludos desde Panamá 🇵🇦 Evelia Sáenz

Hotel of choice in design district Miami; friendly staff, bar/restaurant is open late & breakfast staff are delightful. Rooms are quiet & accessible & I personally love the showers–easy to operate with tons of hot water. Easy 15 minute journey to Miami International Airport.

I was disappointed in my recent stay at AC hotel Miami Wynwood. The price is listed while I was making. My booking did not include a $30 per day destination fee. Is there a hotel room that is not a destination? There are certainly better destinations in the Miami area! I’m scared to know what those fees would be. I spent the Christmas holiday there with my adult son. when checking in on the app, I was given the option of no maid service or every other day maid service. Everyone should be aware that this is the best that they offer. On arriving, we found only three towels and two washcloths in the room. I asked the front desk later that day if they felt like that was an appropriate amount of towels or washcloths. I was told they would send more up. They did not. I was told there would be no towel service on the days there was no maid service. I saved my washcloth until the morning of the maid service. After the maid service that day, I found that while they did take away the used washcloth, they did not replace it with a clean one! Orherwise, the maid service was excellent. I suspect this is a management decision. I was also disappointed that I was not able to choose my room or at least the side of the building that my room was on. Other Marriott properties offer this. We were on the noisy side of the building. There was significant road noise.

Great hotel and great location to be in Wynwood. Besides the convenience, the hotel is very nice and the service was exceptional. Management checked on several times and check in and elite check out was easy and convenient. Perfect for Art Basel and local sightseeing. Highly recommended

Hotel was so welcoming! Thank you to Freddy who made me feel so welcome after having a horrible experience at Marriott Biscayne Bay and needed a last minute room. They got me a room right away. They have bar downstars and the gentleman serving was also so kind and the food and drinks were fabulous. Highly recommend.

La experiencia fue excelente. El hotel es impecable, con muy buena ubicación. Destacto principalmente la atención de Diego y Patricia que tuvieron siempre excelente predisposición para ayudarme ante todas mis consultas. En el restaurant del hotel se come muy bien, y también hay un rooftop con vistas muy lindas.

I have stayed at this hotel four times now and would not consider another hotel in Miami! The staff goes out of their way to provide a very memorable experience and all the amenities of the hotel are all you could ask for! Great location and rooftop pool just add to the ambience! The management team will also go out of their way to make sure that you’re given the white glove treatment while there and it’s why this is the only hotel I will stay at in Miami!

They have no designated smoking areas...none! They make you stand outside on the sidewalk on busy Biscayne Blvd.! No ashtrays outside, no bench, nothing. Ok, AC Miami Wynwood we don't like you either!

Excellent hotel and service. Love the ambience and the food and drinks! Awesome rooftop pool with music and pretty views ! 13miles from the cruise port The maids greeted me every morning The area has a lot of stores and fast food Diner Denny a block away

I would highly recommend this hotel if you’re coming to Miami! The staff are friendly and helpful, and the facilities are sleek and modern. We just had breakfast downstairs here for the first time and the food was delicious and very large portions! We wish we ate here the whole time. Definitely coming back!

Hermoso hotel , vista bellísima, piscina gym lobby bar cuarto servicio un 100/100🫶🏻👌, acceso a lugares de compras y restaurantes La comida muy rica la atención del personal todo servicio a recámara meseras y demás personal, saludos para Angie en Recepción y

Personal competente y muy amable, en particular Patricia que trabaja en recepción. Hotel muy buen ubicado, con instalaciones nuevas y modernas. Comida agradable. Muy grato caminar por los alrededores.

The experience was just fun overall my fav was the few on the roof top where also the pool and the fitness are in and the food was good to I will definitely be coming back here probably with either friends or family

This hotel was clean and the staff was amazing. I’d definitely recommend staying here for your Miami, Fl trips and vacations. The food was good and the views are amazing. The roof top is a great addition to the other areas.

My stay started in room 203, which sadly has a noise problem that comes from machinery within the hotel. I could not sleep at all and approached the night staff who had no better comment than "I don´t know what that is, good night". However, the next morning guest service agent Juan checked my issue and immediately decided to give me room 108 which has no machinery close by. Thank you Juan. Without the noise issue and the night agent´s attitude, I would have surely rated at least 4 out of 5 points. Again, thanks to Juan for easy and quick help.

The rooms are beautiful, spacious and very comfortable. Probably one of the cleanest places I’ve ever stayed. For the previous two nights I stayed at 2 different Hiltons and Vagabond was so much better. The pool area is wonderful and relaxing. We used their meeting room and it was just what we needed. And the people who work there are so professional and helpful. I have been telling everyone about this motel and we will definitely be back.

Very pleasant stay at The Vagabond in September. The room is a good size with modern furniture and a king size bed and the air conditioner worked pretty well. We made good use of the dehumidifier and the ceiling fan. The shower had good water pressure and there was a nice size vanity in the bathroom. Actually the room was bigger than some of the other nearby motels we have stayed at. I appreciated the 24 hour lobby which had an electric tea kettle for making tea, and they also provide coffee. The pool was refreshing and the area around the pool is very nice. We met some other guests while hanging out in the pool. I highly recommend The Vagabond, and we will surely visit again.

Highly recommend this quaint, modern and clean hotel within the mimo district. Staff were friendly and welcoming; shoutout to Linda - thank you for your proactive recommendations and exceptional hospitality! We truly had a pleasant stay at Vagabond.

Motel ubicado cerca de Little Haití con habitaciones amplias, cama enorme y súper cómoda, limpieza impoluta y decoración súper bonita. Todo, toallas, sábanas, moqueta, baño, está híper limpio, felicidades al personal. El jardín muy bonito con una piscina enorme y un bar pool que está atendido por Sebastián, que es súper amable y simpático. El silencio por la noche es absoluto aunque las paredes dejan pasar el sonido de los clientes de al lado, sobre todo si son un poquito “ruidosos” a la hora del amor. Ojo, no hay ascensor, por lo que te tocará subir el equipaje por escaleras

Quite a pleasant experience. Appears unexceptional from the street but the room was very nice, roomy and quiet. Convenient parking. A little oasis in the city, actually. It has amenities like a pool that looks nice, but I had no time to try it out.

Everything excelent, big room and shower, nice pool surroundings, enough shadow. Then even have dehumidifier to the airconditioning. Bottle of water pro person every day. The only thing worth mentioning is: there is no refrigerator, coffe maker in the room. You can "only"get coffee and tee at the reception.

The rooms are super clean and nicely remodeled. The shower was huge. It was convenient and run well. There was bottled water in the room. The beach and pier were close. I liked being able to park on-site with no additional fees. I would stay there again. I felt safe during the check-in process and stay. It was almost a little overboard (asking for my niece’s ID after getting all my info.), but I was happy they knew exactly who was staying there. The only negative that I could possibly say was that early in the morning I could hear someone with a high-pitched voice talking pretty loud in what sounded like the room next to me. I’m really glad I didn’t have to hear that during my whole stay. I was planning on staying on the beach somewhere, but after realizing that parking would be an issue, I found the vagabond and it worked out well. If you have a car, and don’t mind driving 10+ minutes or so then this place is a bargain.

I tried to book a stay at the Vagabond last year but they were sold out. So I booked early this year. So glad I did! The hotel really lives up to the hype...decor was fantastic, staff was super helpful, pool was fabulous (heated!), bartender made us some personalized cocktails...plus free parking. Overall a great stay.

Rooms were very clean and staff was very helpful and nice. The pool area is wonderful and well maintained and feels nice and secluded from the outside. We didn't have an opportunity to try out the pool bar, but will leave that for our next visit.

This motel is located in such a great little area. Tons of food options. Pool area is dreamy and relaxing! Pool Bar was a fun addition to the stay. Rooms were very clean. Fantastic customer service and interaction with staff members. Would definitely go back.

The Vagabond Hotel is a perfect, retro hotel to stay at in Miami. The rooms were clean and decorated with a midcentury modern flare. The pool was very enjoyable and the bar by the pool was great as well. Staff was very courteous and friendly. The room was very affordable. It's a great place to stay for anyone visiting Miami!

The Vagabond is a very neat retro hotel. It was likely really great when it was first remodeled but it was showing it's age when we were there. The paint on the bathroom area floor in our unit was flaking and tracking everywhere. The fixtures (towel rack and single tiny shelf in the shower) were rickety and needed tightening up or replacing. While they don't allow smoking in the rooms, there is a large smoking area right outside some of the rooms and that was not great. All that said, I'd stay there again if I happen to be back in Miami.

We stayed here for one night in April 2024. The hotel is stylish and relatively close to the airport. The bar is good and there are a few good restaurants in the immediate area (including connected to the hotel). There is a pool and a gym as well.

Cute retro motel off the beaten path. Clean and small. Nice places to eat in the area that are within walking distance. Good vibe all around. A place I would visit again. Juan was very helpful and great conversationalist. Outdoor bar near pool proved great service.

Comfortable beds, very quiet for sleeping, clean and modern. The staff is very helpful and friendly, and Juan, at the front desk, even gave me a jump-start when I found my battery was dead on the morning of my cruise departure. Bonus is an Italian restaurant right next door, and the excellent Caracas Coffee Emporium in the next block. Highly recommend!

The CUTEST motel ever ! The rooms are super clean and the decor is great. We were allowed an early check-in which was a life saver. The staff were gracious and welcoming. There are some little shops and two beautiful consignment shops in the area and a great Colombian/Asian fusion restaurant just about a block down the road. We loved our stay here. We will be back.

We stayed at the Vagabond for three nights pre-cruise in January and totally enjoyed this unique property. Our room was large, clean and very comfortable. Management and staff helpful and friendly. Great eating places nearby as recommended by people in the office, including right across the parking lot. Also shout out to Sebastian at the pool bar. Good conversations! We will be back!

This hotel is a hidden gem. The hotel is modern and retro a real 1960 feel. It is not on the beach which is perfect as it was not super crowded. (although, this morning, I could not believe the chair savers were out at 0900. First time my entire stay). My room was well laid out with a very comfortable bed. The softest sheets I have ever slept on. A huge walk in shower (black and white tiles). Spotless! Restaurants within walking distance or right across the parking lot to appeal to all types of food lovers. The staff, everyone, was helpful and friendly! They made you feel welcome! Absolutely would stay here again!

I stayed at a hotel on South Beach for 2 days before moving to the Vagabond, I had it planned this way. I'm glad I did, I loved the Vagabond, Juan, LINDA, and Ariel were all very helpful. I meant Linda on the first night there when I checked in she was very welcoming and helpful with info on places to eat at and the area in general , she really made me feel completely welcomed and relaxed. I had actually talked to Juan on the phone when I made the reservation. I am 62 years old and have been sober 21 years so when I read the Vagabond had a bar by the pool I was concerned it may be a big party place. So I called and talked with Juan who told me the bar is a nice relaxing place that is not an all night party place. Juan also assured me he would try to get me in a room that was in a very quiet area of the hotel. I love to swim and the Vagabond has a very beautiful pool area. And I agree with Juan the crowd on Saturday afternoon at the bar was a very jovial and respectful group of people. While I did not speak to the bartenders they seemed as nice as the rest of the staff at the Vagabond. Ariel helped me when I decided to stay another night. I think the Vagabond is a hidden gem and I will always stay there when I travel to Miami. This was my first trip to Miami, I had a friend move to Miami last year and I was visiting him and I expect I will be visiting more. He actually started a business in Miami and I expect a lot of our mutual friends will be visiting there also, I would recommend the Vagabond to all my friends, I really liked this place a lot. My only negative would be no fridge or microwave in the room, but I worked around that. And not directly about the Vagabond but more about the Mandolin restaurant there. I went in there on a Sunday evening it was very slow and an employee said hello to me, but then I stood there for at least 5 mins with no-one acknowledging me so I left and went next door to NiDo. Nearby food I would recommend Doggis Arepa Bar best I ever had, NiDo Italian great food - a little high price point, Can't beat Jimmy's eastside diner on the corner good food at a good price and great staff, and I found a place a little ways down the street that was fast food Pollo Tropical great Cuban sandwich.

Huele demasiado a cigarro la habitación y se supone que es un hotel libre de alergias y no fumadores además tardaron una hora en darnos la habitación es demasiado tarde el check in, si vienes de crucero no lo recomiendo es mucha la espera, te cobran club de playa y no la puedes usar porque no te dan habitación y cierra a las seis, al día siguiente
Vinimos a disfrutar en familia y fuimos muy buen atendidos y recomendados por María la bartender. Fue muy amable con nosotros. El lugar es tranquilo y muy hermoso. Volveré!!

This was our second time staying here. Leandro did a great job checking us in and making us feel welcome. This is the go to spot whenever there is an event such as a concert or game as it’s walking distance from the Kaseya Center.

Amamos nuestra estadía en The Elser Hotel. La ubicación es lo mejor!! Frente al Bayside, cerca de paradas de buses para Lincoln, para aventura mall, Brickell, Wynwood, metromover y las paradas del tren. Puedes llegar perfectamente en tren desde el aeropuerto. A 200 m de una farmacia y muy buenos lugares cercanos para comer. Desde de la recepción que fue muy cálida y amable con Nicole, quien nos entregó la habitación incluso antes de la hora esperada; aunque sabíamos que podíamos tener que esperar. La habitación era estilo estudio, pequeña pero muy cómoda incluso para 4 personas. Bien equipada con refrigeradora, cocina, lavaplatos, microondas. Realmente ideal para una familia de 4 que no va a estar mucho tiempo ahí. Pedí algunos paquetes que llegaron bien y tienen un excelente sistema de entrega. La habitación se hace cada 2 días (más que suficiente para nosotros) pero nos entregaron todo lo que necesitamos solo con una llamada. También pedimos desayuno que fue recibido y entregado muy bien. Las instalaciones son espectaculares: el Gym con unas buenas clases de estudio, la piscina buenísima. El horrible no estuvo disponible en esta visita. La salida también fue muy ágil. Alejandro siempre pendiente de lo que necesitábamos y Sofía me ayudó también de manera ágil a recuperar un electrónico que había dejado en la habitación. En general nuestra visita fue de lo mejor! Volveremos!
Bert was the best valet attendant. Got our car super quick and gave us spots to get around out around town. He can play some ball too. GO NYK

Always a great experience at the Elser! Thank you to the amazing staff for always coming through, Santana, Pedro, Frank, are always attentive and solution driven. Joseph, Bertrand, & Jean in the valet parking are amazing! Thank you all for always making my experience effortless.

I would especially like to recommend the receptionist Jennifer for her excellent service, always smiling and patient! There is no doubt that if I come to Miami, I will come to this hotel again, thanks to her 💪🏻
Anyi nos atendió muy bien! Nos explicó cómo fuinciona el hotel, los beneficios y nos dio un trago de bienvenida El departamento es hermoso con una vista espectacular. Volveremos!!
Excelentes instalaciones, las habitaciones cómodas y modernas todo de 10 Y la atención de Jennifer al hacer el check in fue muy buena

HERMOSO EDIFICIO UBICACIÓN, EL APARTAMENTO DIVINO, ANYI NOS CONSINTIÓ POR MI CUMPLEAÑOS Y TUVIMOS UN APTO CON UNA VISTA ESPECTACULAR EN EL PISO 36! WOW WOW WOW ÉPICO, inolvidable, MUCHAS GRACIAS ANYI!
Jennifer la mejor de todo el hotel con diferencia, un 10 si os puede atender es la N1. Las habitaciones tienen muy buenas vistas y la piscina está genial con la tele

The unpleasant aspect of my stay stemmed from the hotel’s inflexible payment policy, which does not accept Apple Pay or cash for covering the room and insurance. What made this more frustrating was the unfriendly, borderline rude attitude of a supervisor, whose approach lacked both empathy and professionalism. On the other hand, the pleasant part of my experience came entirely from Jennifer at the front desk. She was incredibly kind, attentive, and compassionate, making a sincere effort to help—even though the issue was beyond her control. Her genuine warmth and professionalism stood out and left a lasting impression. She truly made a difficult situation more bearable.
Increibles vistas. Joe Lewis en el Front Desk es el mejor! Gracias por hacer que nuestras vaciones fueran las mejores!!!
Excelente mi estadía me encantó y un buen servicio todos fueron geniales y especial la atención yoe su servicio fue excelente

Hotel encantador con muy buenas vistas. Jennifer muy atenta a nuestra llegada, explicándonos todo perfectamente. Ayudandonos con el ascensor y con todo lo necesario para nuestra estancia. Recomendable 100%, una opcion segura a la hora de venir a Miami.

Best Hotel expience ever .!!! Stefano at the reception desk welcomed us and was gently helpful and I can't tell enough about the way he treat us. Manuel, the guy that help us with the bags also was amazing, very attentive and gentle. We are reserving to come back as soon as next weekend. We had a really good time and we just stayed for.one night to attend a concert at the Kaseya Center . Lis and Ray

We had a wonderful stay at The Elser Hotel in Miami. The location is absolutely perfect — just a short walk to great bars, local shops, and with easy transport links to the main beaches. Whether you’re exploring the city or heading out for some sun and sand, everything is within easy reach. The hotel itself is beautiful. Our room was spacious, modern, and had everything we needed, with stunning views that made it feel extra special. The heated outdoor pool was a real highlight — perfect for relaxing after a day out — and the gym access was a great bonus. One small issue we had was an incorrect minibar charge, but it was handled professionally and quickly refunded, which we really appreciated. The staff were excellent throughout — polite, helpful, and welcoming. Special mention to the door staff who were always on hand to help with bags and offer assistance. All in all, a fantastic experience. We’d absolutely stay here again

La atención de Jorge en recepción fue de diez. Amable, simpático y siempre dispuesto a ayudar. Se nota su profesionalismo y hace que la experiencia en el hotel sea mucho más agradable. ¡Un lujo tenerlo allí! ¡Muy recomendable! ¡Volveré sin duda!

Todo excelente, la atención de Jeanny en la alberca increible, muy amable y agradable, trato inigualable, las habitaciones limpias y todo muy cómodo Lo único que mejoraría son los precios en alimentos y bebidas, pedimos muy poco porque si son precios altos

What an amazing hotel - the service, efficiency, the rooms - this was our second time staying at the Elser and we loved it so much that we had to extend our stay! Thank you for having us. 10/10 our go to hotel for Miami trips! Feels like home to us - staff are super friendly and warm. They are also very patient. Holding open the doors, looking after our luggage, helping with parcels and directions. Their restaurant downstairs is also delicious if you want a convenient quick bite. Me and my sisters are big fans!

I just recently relocated back to Miami, I wanted to try this hotel out as I remember the process prior to it opening. I love the location and wanted to pursue a career at this particular property so I decided to do a staycation to see what it had to offer. The service was great Angelica at check in met my needs. VV at the bar and Josh pool bar great service and amazing conversation. Cant wait to return.

Great hotel.. comfortable rooms and beds.. Great location. This was my second stay here and will be back for a third! Clean, excellent service and good. ! Beautiful rooftop with amazing Bay views and lounge areas.. a winner in Wynwood

Freddy me atendio super bien, muy profesional. Un encanto. El hotel esta super bien ubicado. El baño es precioso y las camas muy acojedoras. Todo perfecto para estar unos dias en Miami. Muy recomendable

Las chicas de front desk fueron excelentes: Mayda, Angie y Ana. También las chicas del restaurante muy amable, la atención hizo que mi experiencia sea genial pese a no hablar el inglés. Que sepan hablar otro idioma es excelente.

We didn’t know Miami well and only had one night there because of a delayed travel itn. That had nothing to do with the hotel of course. Breakfast was pretty decent. The rooms are nice, clean, beds comfortable. My view was of the city and the water but it is not large enough or high enough to see mostly water. You need to go a few blocks for that. Again we weren’t there for long so didn’t feel the need to get anything closer to the water. The service was great as usual.
