I should mention we are bonvoy members so I always feel like we get much better service. My room was upgraded and they have a parking garage which is helpful for us since we had a rental car. The rooftop pool and bar were pretty nice. The pool was a little small and not too bad. The bar closed early for us.. 11pm. Breakfast was what you expect at a hotel. Pricey. But that’s to be expected. The showers were very nice. Rain shower and hand held shower head, all amenities and just a nice shower overall. Good water pressure and clean. If I was in Miami again i would probably try for the Marriott beach front properties but this is still a great one in wynwood if you know what is there to see! My only suggestion as a hotel in the area it is in… It would be great if they had some recommendations at the front desk for food and things to do in the area! We asked but they didn’t provide much.

I went to dinner at the rooftop a couple of days ago with my Girlfriend i would have to say the food was amazing those tacos are delicious and the service was phenomenal my server eirly was so kínd and attentive. I really would recommend this restaurant to anyone cant forget to mentían the view!!

We came for a little family getaway from Tampa. We have never been to the Wynwood area and decided to stay at the AC. My experience overall was a great one and the kids enjoyed it very much (17yr old and a 5yr old). The location is perfect and there are some main streets with shopping stores and restaurants that are all within walking distance. The beds are super comfy and the hotel is super clean. However, what made my stay the best ever was seeing Carla every morning for breakfast. She made my daughter feel so special! She was attentive, showed genuine care, and just shined like a bright light. I watched her work the room being on top of all the orders and making sure everyone was taken well care of. Even with how busy it was, she made us feel like we were the only ones there. Carla is definitely an asset and because of her, my family and I will definitely be coming back for sure. Thank you AC for such a pleasant stay.

La comida muy rica, el servicio rápido y amable, muy recomendable. Los tacos de carne asado y pollo de un sabor muy bueno. El chef Delvis muy simpático y de buena mano, vale la pena probar los distintos platos, tales como las pizzas y los tacos.

Muy lindo hotel, la atención excelente, cómodas habitaciones, buen desayuno, muy buen parking (de pago). Sector de pileta y gimnasio completan los amenities. Súper recomendable. Solo agregaria ensalada de frutas al desayuno.

Buen hotel en general, de buen entorno familiar. Personal alegre y servicio muy cordial. En especifico muy conforme con el servicio por parte de Daniela y Ana, muy atentas y siempre a la orden para ayudar.

The hotel service It was super lovely. They make you feel welcome. The breakfast had a good variety, and the service was excellent. Paula did a great job serving us during breakfast. AC Hotel is a good option!

This was a wonderful experience! The community is diverse and just a couple of blocks away from a high-end fashion area. Simultaneously you are also on the cusp of a typical Miami residential neighborhood. I loved it all. Everything you need is within walking distance & 15 minutes in a car and you are on Miami beach. Really an easy and central location that’s better than downtown and away from the hustle bustle of the beach itself. Even if you don’t leave the neighborhood there’s plenty to do. The hotel is in excellent condition, and well kept. Staff is consistently friendly and the rooftop bar and lounge area is lovely, with beautiful views. I can highly recommend it. Special thanks to Cynthia for her knowledge, professionalism, great customer service and generous spirit. You will be a happy if she checks you in and even if she doesn’t she’s doing her best to train the staff to do things the same way that she does - with an authentic heart and smile.

Daniela and Cinthya at the front desk were very kind, and helpful. They accommodated my needs, and were always eager to help with whatever I needed. a gentleman from security, I guess, helped me very kindly bringing up my luggage plus the rooftop. It’s very cool.!

During an overly busy shift we were checking in with our two year old, two dogs, two grandmasand , me and my husband- we were the chaos at 12a. Sherly Had several guests to handle, she worked to make everyone feeltaken care of and did it was such grace. She handled everyone She connected with Patience. Give this girl a raise! There were multiple employees and she seemed to be the only one attending to guests positively and with urgency. 5 stars for her customer service - a great representation of the hotel.

Atención en el restaurante y en especial en el personal del desayuno excelentes por parte de Paula.👏👏👏 En el lobby se presentaron inconvenientes el 12 de Sept en la noche y anisetes llegada el día 11 por fallas técnicas en el sistema,pero el Sr encargado muy amable nos colaboró Muchas gracias.

Paula is a very efficient kind and helpful staff. Very satisfied with all the help she has given us to be comfortable during our stay. Hotel is very clean and well kept with excellent staff and service. Would definitely refer to friends and relatives.

Near Mount Sinai Hospital and near Kosher eateries of the area. Near the Miami airport. If you trip is for doctors appointment this is the place to stay. New hotel with ample room and clean bathroom. Front desk staff very competent and friendly. Park for $20 daily.

the food was very tasty and it arrived at my table on time, very satisfied with the attention, Marina was very kind and was aware that we did not miss anything! a very good option to spend a good time with friends !!! I will definitely come back!!!

Stayed for a quick anniversary weekend. The staff were all very friendly and had a beautiful room overlooking the city and water. The breakfast buffet was outstanding - not your ordinary old pancakes and bagged eggs. Our server, Paula, really made our day!!!

Excellent vibes , brilliant service Jorge the bartender extremely attentive and helpful! DJ v Kool Food delicious and views breathtaking! Fabricio ! You are a RockStar!!! We definitely will be back Loved it .

Really expected a better experience. Really pretty and clean rooms, but there are TONS of kids. Did not really expect it to be that way given it doesn't appear to be a kid friendly hotel. To pay the price we did as a couple to lounge by the pool and have drinks from the Rooftop pool bar it was extremely disappointing to have kids throwing footballs, being loud, splashing, running around unsupervised jumping in and out of the pool (that is really just for wading, 4ft deep) it wasn't just one family, it was multiple. One 1st day One child choked on water and threw up all over the ground and no one cleaned it up for HOURS. The pool area does not have as many chairs as needed and it's crazy they are allowing people to buy 'day passes to the pool' when they can't even fit their staying customers. Also, they never had enough clean towels. We had to wait at least an hour for towels everyday. If you want a luxe couples getaway- this looks like the place to be but it isn't sadly.

Hotel pretencioso poco funcional. Llegamos a las 6 PM y no estaba lista la habitación. Nos la dieron a las 7 PM… sin embargo no dejaron shampoo, ni cartel de “do not disturb” y había pelusas en el piso. La habitación es muy muy muy oscura. No entra la luz del día y además está pintada de oscuro. Es de diseño, elegante y con detalles cool pero definitivamente no sirve para pasar diez días. No hay placard ni lugar donde dejar la ropa. Solo dos hangers y dos cajones pequeños que no sirven para nada. Si quieres venir a aparentar con una pareja nueva el fin de semana este es tu lugar. Si necesitas estar diez días con algo de ropa y te interesa ver si hay sol o no, este no es tu lugar. No vengan quienes necesitan luz de día. Me siento Wilma Flinstone en la cueva.

I'm a local who really needed the WiFi for work, and a place to stay while waiting for a 2 day internet outage to be fixed. We were completely blown away by this absolutely gorgeous property. It's an oasis. But the people are truly the reason that this place is such a standout. Everyone (front desk, valet, bellhop, restaurant, etc) made the highest efforts to ensure that the transition into, during, and out of the hotel was seamless, easy, and enjoyable. The highest honors to Owen who checked us into an incredible room, expedited our very early checkout, ensured we had everything correct on the account, and guided us throughout the stay, and Jason who personally made sure that we lacked for nothing.

The Mayfair Hotel & Garden exceeded my expectations in every way. The impeccable service, combined with the friendly and helpful staff, made my stay truly enjoyable. The on-site dining options were a delight – each dish surpassed the last, eliminating the need to venture elsewhere. The rooms, notably clean and comfortable, boasted an abundance of windows, inviting in ample natural sunlight for a perfect stay. Highly recommended for a memorable experience.

The hotel is gorgeous, my group was impressed with the vibe of the property and the excellent hospitality. All of the staff we came in contact with have been on point, friendly and very professional . I have stayed in hotels across the globe from the Ritz to a Courtyard to boutique hotels and none of them beat what we experienced at the Mayfair.

Great + convenient location. Stylish + clean accommodations. Excellent + warm atmosphere. Top-tier service. SipSip rooftop bar was the bonus. Very nice job Mayfair House Team….keep it up. I’ll be back!

Jason at concierge displayed excellent customer service from when we checked in until we checked out. He was very courteous and helpful. It was so pretty on the rooftop with the bar and pool. And great gym facilities

Very friendly staff (especially Jason one of the hotel managers) was extremely helpful, attentive and made our stay very enjoyable. When we arrived our room was on the 4th floor, with not much light coming in. Right away Jadon found us a solution and put us on a similar room but on the 5th floor with much mire light

This is by far one of the most beautiful and tranquil hotels I have ever stayed at. The service was impeccable, and Jason helped us with everything and was so kind. There is so much design and style that goes into every element of the space. I highly recommend the Mayfield to any guest traveling into Miami.

This was our second stay here and we will be back as often as possible! We had an issue come up with our room but the staff fixed it right away and were so nice about it. Maintenance and the front desk kept checking in to be sure everything was going well each time we ran into them in the lobby. The rooms are super clean, unique, comfortable and the beds are heavenly. Jason at the front desk is super helpful and nice. Valet people are efficient and friendly. It’s a unique place so close to great restaurants and boutiques. Highly recommend!

Architecturally beautiful property. Close to all the Grove’s action. Jason from the front staff was very professional and helpful. Housekeeping needs improvement; feels like an afterthought for this property

The food, the staff (valet, front desk concierge, the valet, the servers, the barista, room service) the service, the rooms, and patios!!!! Everything was above and beyond my expectations!!! High quality service from high quality place. Also private at the same time. In love and can't wait to come back.

Excelente Hotel. Arquitectura original con una excelente atención. Robert Leyton y todos los demás se esmeran por dar un trato cercano. La habitación tenía una terraza amplia, con jardín y una ducha. Buena terraza con piscina y un buen bar. Todo con excelente vista a la bahía

Las habitaciones comodas, al igual que el baño. La zona de piscina esta buena, pero el bar no atiende durante el dia. El servicio a la habitacion bastante bueno. Esta ubicado cerca a un mall que es muy conveniente

No parece un hotel de cinco estrellas el desayuno no esperes un bufet sino una cafetería anexa te lo sirve con poca calidad Las habitaciones están pintadas de verde oscuro y la ventana da a una pared que te hace sentirte encerrado muy poca luz

Excelente atención y servicio, celebré mi cumpleaños ahí y nos trataron increíble, Robert Leyton el Front Desk Supervisor me ayudó con toda la organización, reservas, selección de habitaciones, fiesta. Gracias gracias

The entire staff at the Mayfair House Hotel was absolutely amazing—from start to finish—during a brief business trip I took this week. From greeters, to cleaning staff, to bartenders, it was great. I definitely recommend considering a stay!

Everything was Wonderful!!! Shout out to Robert Leyton who bent over backwards to accommodate us and insure an amazing vacation ! We loved the food, the pool, and the really spectacular rooftop bar! The hotel is right in the middle of everything downtown Coconut Grove on a very quaint side street. We have rebooked and look forward to our NEXT visit in May🥂

I feel like I am at a resort on an exotic island somewhere. A warm, friendly staff, spacious beautiful rooms and an awesome rooftop pool and bar. We had a blast! ...and the beds... very comfortable...

Everything from start to finish was excellent. The hotel has a beautiful tropical decor. The staff was courteous and responsive. The rooms were spacious and well designed. Everything was very clean and you always see staff cleaning. I also thought the gym was one of the best I have used for a hotel. The hotel was well located in The Grove to all the shops and restaurants. But the hotel itself has a great restaurant, and rooftop pool and bar. We have stayed in many places in South Beach and The Grove and this is a new favorite.

Fluffy pillows and amazing customer service from Jeanny and Robinson. Gracias Robinson y Jeanny por ser tan amables fue in placer saber que podia contar con ustedes hasta en los mínimos detalles. Very secure and safe hotel Room.i highly recommend 3501

No real restaurant for breakfast or lunch. Check-in and lobby were a chaotic mess. They changed our check-in time after we were registered. finally got a room (not disabed - accessible). Furnishings were overdue for a refresh. Everywhere was overcrowded - we picked up virus and were sick for thee next four days. Oceania needs a different hotel partner in Miami Elser hotel genuinely sucks.

We just completed a 3 day stay and the staff at this property are fantastic! Their service and helpfulness are truly extraordinary. All have been trained well and the staffing is such, that waits are very short. The elevators are fast and whisk you quickly up and down if you’re staying on an upper floor. We would definitely stay here again. A special shout out to Jhoseph, the lead valet supervisor who solved our initial reservation issue by getting us to Nat, the front manager. Nat solved the problem and was very kind. Juan, the bell concierge was also incredible helping us with multiple pieces of baggage. Yes, that was their job but they were warm and welcoming and went beyond in their service levels. We were tired from 7 weeks of travel and 6 hours of driving to get to Miami. The kindness, training and efficiency of all the staff we encountered is to be commended!

Terrible service. An iron in the room was damaged and caused a tear in a brand new shirt. I reached out kindly to the hotel to ask for compensation and was rejected, despite providing detailed documentation of the incident. If you’re expecting quality service, look elsewhere.

My group had the best checkin experience with Jasmine! She helped make this weekend so special for my friend’s bachelorette and truly cared about creating a memorable experience. I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a fun getaway with all the right amenities, location and price! Very clean and everyone was very friendly. Looking forward to having another excuse to come stay.

The room was large, modern, great shower, nice kitchen area very well equipped and beautiful view off the balcony! Very comfortable bed with nice bedding! The elevator access system was great and doorman were very helpful. Enjoyed my stay!

!Excelente ubicación, con vistas espectaculares!. Habitaciones bien equipadas y confortables. El joven William es un excelente colaborador, nos recibió con una gran sonrisa y un delicioso cóctel y a la salida nos despidió con la misma amabilidad y sonrisa.

Nuestra estancia en The Elser fue excelente. William fue muy amable y estuvimos hablando sobre mi ciudad, Málaga. Un chico muy simpático. Nos ayudó con el check-in, guardó nuestro equipaje y también nos asistió en el check-out. La piscina era increíble y nos encantaron las bebidas del bar. Además, la ubicación del hotel era perfecta, en el centro de todo. Sin duda, un lugar al que queremos volver.

El hotel es el mejor de Miami, el personal es muy amable, y el ambiente es increíble. William fue muy atento durante toda nuestra estancia y sus recomendaciones de restaurantes fueron excelentes. Incluso logró hacernos reservas de último minuto que fueron increíbles. Si necesitan algo, pregunten a él. También nos encantó el acceso a sillas y sombrilla en South Beach. Muy felices de haber elegido este hotel para nuestra experiencia en Miami.

Came here for a bachelorette party with friends and had the best time! William helped us get checked in and made sure we were in good hands the duration of our trip. Beach club, pool, views, and surrounding nightlife was amazing. Best hotel in Miami!!

El Elser es un lugar espectacular en Miami, y la atención de William fue insuperable. Las habitaciones son amplias, con cocinas completas y vistas hermosas de la ciudad. La piscina en la azotea es ideal para relajarse, y su ubicación facilita explorar Bayside y más. Gracias William por hacer nuestra visita especial!

William fue nuestro concierge personal en el Elser y nos ayudó a descubrir los mejores lugares en Miami. Desde restaurantes hasta actividades, sus recomendaciones fueron increíbles. El hotel tiene suites elegantes, una piscina con vista al puerto y todo lo necesario para una estancia inolvidable. Gracias William!

Tuve una experiencia increíble en el Elser Hotel. Es un lugar moderno, bonito, y muy bien cuidado. Las vistas del rooftop son increíbles! Quiero dar las gracias especialmente a William por su hospitalidad y la excelente conversación. Nos vemos en España! ❤️

Me hospede en el hotel y fui atendida por la señorita Nicole en el front desk, si bien tuve algunos inconvenientes ella me los súper solucionar a la brevedad y siempre con una sonrisa; haciéndonos sentir cómodos en nuestro hospedaje. Da gusto encontrarse con personas tan amenas y que te solucionen todo al instante cuando uno está de vacaciones y lo que quiere es disfrutar! Muchas gracias Nicole por tu atención!

Jennifer at front desk delivered amazing customer service. We was able to check in early with no problems. We was checked in alongside a passion fruit margarita . Our room was clean and besides the construction, the view is amazing. I highly recommend this hotel especially if there’s a deal or sale

First time staying at the Elser and trying I Prefer hotel brand. Due to our loyalty status, Ruhan was able to upgrade us to a room with an amazing view! This is really the highlight of staying at the hotel. Haven't tried the amenities but pool and fitness area look great as well. Overall the location is pretty good and the price was fair for the quality of the rooms. I recommend staying here.

To start with the Good News: Location, pooldeck and Gym are outstanding. That’s it. The rest was a major disappointment. We had booked a luxury 1 BR suite, quite expensive. What did we get: a small room less than 500sqft, dark, a living room without windows, a 90sqf bedroom with a window and a balcony. Complaints did not help, no options, although we received daily messages about paid upgrades. The TV in the living room did not work, but nothing was done about it. And then they charged more than 60 $ per night for services. At 5 pm the room was not made, and it’s hard to complain without a phone in the room. The service fee also mentioned Internet: this was the worst hotel WLAN we had for years. I do not understand where all the popsicle Reviews come from. For us it was a bad and very expensive experience. Never again.

Excelente servicio en front desk, deneb y jeyre nos explicaron muy bien todo con respecto a nuestra estadia y nos ayudaron en el proceso y estamos super encantados con ello, siempre buscando en volver y tener una linda experiencia nuevamente en the elser hotel, Sin duda alguna amazing front desk!

En el front desk recibi la mejor atención de Jeyre que me guió en toda mi estadía. Agradezco sea reconocido ampliamente su calidad de servicio. La habitación del hoyel estuvo excelente y la vista espectacular. Me gusto muchísimo. Gracias por todo.

Not the warmest or welcoming hotel. Arrived a little before check in and told our room wasn't ready and should be ready by 4p. I was told by Josue I would get an email/text when it's ready. Never received it and now it's almost 45m after check in time especially after a long day of traveling. I had to go back up to him and remind him. I understand if you're understaffed but communication/transparency goes a long way with customers. I would have realistic expectations. I wouldn't bother staying here again, I didn't care for the customer service.

This Place is a gem. Funky fun and lots of flavor. Linda the front desk person made the experience extra special. It was recommended to my by a friend whose daughter was having a wedding that weekend. She knew I would love the place and I did! Stay here when you need to be in the area!

I’m currently staying here. It’s our last night of a four night stay. I’m not necessarily sorry we stayed here for our trip to Miami, but I just do not understand all of the wildly positive reviews. The pool is far from warm. It’s pretty darn chilly. You don’t want to stay in it after jumping in. The pool bar that gets a lot if love on tripadvisor is only open 3 nights a week (and didn’t open tonight, Thursday, as promised).. So, there’s really nothing going on by the pool otherwise. The room isn’t very comfortable, including the bed. The only lights to potentially read by in bed or on the couch is a single light hanging over the side table. It can’t be directed so it just lights up the side table. So, if I try to read after 4pm on the couch or in bed, I can’t. It’s just dark. The handle to the door of our room came off in our hands as we were leaving yesterday morning. The did fix it when we’d returned after letting them know. The phone in our room didn’t work…no dial tone. They did also fix that when we told them about it. All said and done, I don’t understand what there is to love here. If I’d known how it actually is to stay here, I definitely would have thought about other options.

This hotel is my go to every time I am in Miami. I believe this was my 4th or 5th stay. The rooms are very clean, the pool is beautiful and well-maintained, and the grounds are lovely. I would have given it 5 stars but this time, I did have an interaction upon my check-in on Wednesday with a gentleman who was lacking in politeness and customer service acumen. When I walked in ready to check-in, he barely acknowledged me and just said "Yes?" like I was inconveniencing him by my presence. I tried giving him the benefit of the doubt however my original impression of my presence being an inconvenience continued to be the case. There was an additional charge of $250 that I was not told about ahead of my stay and was not in the documentation I had received, and he could not have been more rude explaining it to me in a manner that was both condescending and as if I were a child--telling me "it has always been this way." In my experience, that wasn't the case, however he was sure to let me know that I was not correct. I avoided the office the remainder of the evening and the next one in spite of it having been easier to walk through the office from the parking lot. I walked around so I would not have to engage with this staff member further as he definitely was not giving off good vibes. Hopefully it was just a bad week for him, and this was not the standard of his typical service. The staff that were there the other days were all friendly and wonderful, and gave us the experience we have come to know and love about the Vagabond. I am just happy that I had stayed their previously, as if I hadn't I definitely would have been deterred from returning due to my experience at check-in. My experience at check-out was a pleasant one, with the Saturday guest relations member being very positive, upbeat, and jovial. The cleaning staff members did an exemplary job, and the rooms continue to be very well-maintained after coming year after year. The location is also ideal as it is a short drive to many of the best sights in Miami including Wynwood, Downtown, and even South Beach is not far. I also love several of the restaurants that are in close proximity to the Vagabond, including Blue Collar. If you stay at the Vagabond, be sure to check them out as well as the other local restaurants as they are wonderful!

Great hotel. Retro style was awesome. Clean and comfortable. Great pool. Staff was extremely accommodating! The front desk staff was wonderful. Bartender was great! Perfect for a girls trip. Will definitely come back

Buying a new bed at home because this one was amazing. The staff was very friendly, the rooms and accommodation very clean and well maintained. Loved our stay here, would for sure stay here again, perfect location.

Loved the Art Deco era design my room. My family and I enjoyed the pool, the restaurant Mr. Mandolin. Vagabond was in close proximity to the park, restaurant and boutique shops. Vagabond made our vacation memorable. I will recommend it to anyone visiting Miami.

Like a trip back in time with modern comforts in a great location. Rooms were beautifully decorated with Miami modern style and custom wall mural. The pool and bar have great atmosphere and the perfect spot to unwind. We ate at the amazing on-site restaurant, Mr. Mandolin. Easy drive to Mid-town, the Design District, and Wynwood. Loved our time there.

Third stay at the Vagabond. The rooms are always clean and comfortable. Having the refrigerator and coffeemaker makes the stay even better. The mattresses provide great sleeping. The staff are delightful and always helpful. Pool and landscaping are well maintained and access to the bar provides for a relaxing stay.

Clean, cute, friendly, and lots of personality! This motel is a gem and nicer than many other larger-chain hotels I’ve stayed in. The staff is so friendly, there are so many delicious restaurants in walking distance, and the pool is out of a magazine. Can’t wait to come back to Miami just to stay here!

the cutest place! never wanted to leave:) the interior design was amazing. had the sweetest workers, best service of any hotel i’ve been at. they also have great places all around their hotel to eat and shop at!

Stayed at this hotel from reviews I found here and on TikTok. Wanted to feel a connection to Miami mid century heyday. This hotel and the neighborhood didn’t disappoint. Rooms are super clean and the housekeeping spot on. 2 free waters daily. Pool is clean and comfortable open during daylight hours. Free well lit parking, real room keys, rainfall and handheld spray showers. Staff is super friendly. Neighborhood is looking to the past to make a comeback. This step of route 1 is neon mile with this motel and others neon signs. Walkable too great restaurants breakfast or dinner. 5 minute drive to design district which is trendy with lots of high end stores and cool restaurants. 10-15 minute drive straight down to downtown Miami. 20 minute drive straight up to FLL and many restaurants along route one. Obviously it not on the beach if that what you want be prepared to pay nightly parking/valet costs. Otherwise this is perfect spot to explore NSEW as it been since the 50s. Safety I never had an issue and felt safer here than in downtown, wynwood, little havana, etc. which are also super fun to visit and never had a problem. 5 stars definitely worth it!

Very nice people, quiet and good location. Nice pool and good restaurant. We really enjoyed the stay. Nothing to complain. For families has all you need. Good coffee in the morning and the bed was fine as well

Completely restored landmark motel, sets you 70 years back in time, yet very modern. Great bar and pool together with the possibility to watch photoshoots. Close by the Blue Collar which is a great neighborhood restaurant with the best key lime pie ever!

My best friend and I stayed here on either end of our cruise that left from Miami. This hotel is adorable! Love the modern retro feel. Rooms are spacious, beds are comfy, and all provided toiletries are great. We loved lounging by the pool. Most of all, the staff was very kind and helpful. They allowed us to store our bags to work around our travel schedule, and we were beyond pleased with the stay.

Spontaneously booked a room for our anniversary getaway. Everything here was adorably vintage, very clean, and the service was fantastic. The bar at the pool is top notch. Breakfast at Mrs. Mandolin’s is delicious. All of the restaurants nearby were excellent as well. We’ll definitely be back!

The Vagabond Motel is Wonderful in every respect. Luis was so good with taking care of my parents needs even before we got to the motel. They grounds are beautiful and customer service is friendly and welcoming. Rooms are beautiful and the showers are fantastic. Miss Mandolin in the morning has delicious gf options and Mr Mandolin has the best happy hour, with incredible food. Overall our stay was amazing. Easy to get to everywhere. Can’t wait to visit again! Thank you Vagabond for making this trip amazing.

This was just a one-night stop before we got on the cruise. What a cool little hotel! We loved the retro design. The property is super clean and was exactly like pictured on line. The pool and pool bar is a great place to hang out and the adjoining greek restaurant & bakery was a life saver because we didn't have a rental car so walking to the somewhat local restaurants in 85+degrees sucked. Aside from a few restaurants there's really not all that much to do in the area and alot of the buildings were vacant or run down but Vagabond owners are trying to revitalize the area so in a few years I bet this will be a hotspot again. Was bummed they didn't have Bacardi/Rum or popular beers at the pool bar but we managed through. The only thing that really needs addressing is the room a/c. It's mounted in the weird open bathroom area; the bathroom was nice & cold but the cold air just can't make it out to the sleeping area so we literally had a cold zone and a warm zone. (FYI only the toilet had a door in this particular room; the sink and shower area were open to the sleeping area with no door) There was a dehumidifier in the room but those generate heat so it was counter productive so we had to shut it off. Very glad there was a ceiling fan and that I packed my personal size rechargeable fan cuz I wouldn't have been able to sleep in that heat without them! All in all loved the hotel; if there was more to do in the immediate area on foot we'd come back but IMHO you really need a car. Additional recommendation: YOU MUST GO TO Ms. Cheesius for lunch across the street for the most amazing grill cheese creations you ever saw.

This was the third time we have stayed at the Vagabond. It is now our go-to place when we head for Miami. We have also stayed there before leaving on a cruise the next day. It is close to the Port. It is close to the airport. It is close to the interstate. It's beautiful. If you like mid- century modern, you will love the room decor. Huge, beautiful pool. In the evening, have a seat at the poolside bar and get to know Sebastian. Walk down Biscayne Blvd for nearby great Italian or Cuban fusion. In the morning, get great coffee in the lobby. Then cross the street to We We's and have an amazing breakfast outside. Just the best small "old Florida" hotel anywhere.

We stayed the first night of our honeymoon before leaving for our cruise. From start to finish the staff was truly amazing. We received an email a couple days before check in to confirm what time we would be arriving, if we needed any recommendations and to let us know they were there if we needed anything. We arrived extremely early and were able to do early check in, lounge by the pool and take a much needed nap after an early travel day. The pool bar opened at 3 and was a nice spot to relax and have a couple cocktails without needing to leave the hotel. There are many restaurants nearby that are family owned with delicious food. Overall, well worth the visit and we will be back!

We had a fantastic experience here. The rooms are clean and are decorated in a cool nod to Miami Modern design with bright colors, and sculptural furniture. The bed was so comfortable and the staff super helpful and friendly. Great pool and lounge area. Amazing gem.

Excellent customer service, Oscar & Pedro went above and beyond to accommodate me. Great amenities - pool, restaurant, hot strong shower, stylish etc at this location. Appreciated the perks like dining discount card, free bike rental. Will gladly come back again.

Beware of the massive amount of construction directly adjacent to this hotel. I was awoken at 4am by jackhammers, cement mixers and beeping trucks right outside my window. Yes, they work at 4am! Completely ruined my night’s sleep and although Arlo puts earplugs bedside for you, they aren’t enough to mask the noise unfortunately. If you must stay here, request a room on the side of the building that is not construction facing. Also, the pillows have gone flat since I first started staying here, time to refresh! I told the girl at the front desk about my stay and she didn’t offer anything other than an explanation that there is nothing they can do about it and have tried to talk to the city.

Stayed a week in this new modern, stylish hotel. Would certainly stay again! Thanks to Daniela and Apuhina at front desk, very friendly and helpful. Ate at hotel ‘higher ground’ bar area often and food & drinks very good and enjoyed the couple of vegetarian options and had wonderful service and attention from Maria Laura and was great energy from Obi. Did not try the ground floor restaurant. It looked lovely but not so many vegetarian options on menu. Very good breakfast options there though. Loved the free 2 hour bike hire the hotel offer. Special thanks to Mauricio who was always smiling and helpful. He prepared me a bike that would enable me to reach the ground as not confident on a bike but managed to cycle to the venetian way bridge. There is a cycle path only some of the time so did have to navigate the traffic at times. Loved the artworks in the hotel which mirrored the art scene this area is known for. Hotel is only a 20 minute taxi from MIA. This hotel is about a 20min drive to south beach. I enjoyed exploring Wynwood and seeing lots of colourful murals. During the day felt safe enough but like a lot of places I wouldn't venture far alone late at night. Lots of bars, coffee shops, eating places and the museum of graffiti was very interesting and informative and changed my view on graffiti. The Wynwood walls offered great photo opportunities. This is a great location as a base from which to see everything Miami has to offer. The rooms are comfortable and have everything you need. I didn’t have a problem with noise from music or construction and was in a non balcony room on floor 5 facing the road where the hotel entrance is. Generally there is a lot of construction and development in Wynwood currently. Only one small issue in room was lack of a closet. There were hooks and a few hangers which is fine for a couple of days. A few days did not have room cleaning as accidentally knocked on the ‘do not disturb’ light which is on the light switch panel by door and lights up red outside the door. Lifts excellent! There is a lovely clean and modern rooftop bar and heated pool area where towels are provided. Had a fantastic trip and would return and stay at the Arlo Wynwood and drive/taxi daily to the various Miami areas I wanted to see or visit again as the areas of interest are quite spaced out anyway.

Great food!! Specially the steak. It is a very relaxing and cool place!! Kids had fun and loved the art around the hotel. Service was great. And everyone had a welcoming attitude. We did Valet and our car came really quick, even thou it was busy.
Great, modern, clean, well maintained hotel. Fantastic customer service. The front desk is unbelievable. Super commentating. Will definitely come back! Oscar, Agustina, Shatoya, Daniela are the best!

My first time traveling solo and Arlo Wynwood created my experience! Vanda at the FD was super informative, kind, and helpful! I was made aware of all the amazing amenities Arlo had to offer from complimentary comedy shows, to yoga classes! Not to mention their in house bars and restaurants, MaryGolds, that all had amazing service. Considering I was traveling independently around the holidays, I felt safe at all times and was still able to have an amazing time. Thank you Arlo Wynwood, you’ll see me again 😜❤️

Arlo hotel nos conquistó! De echo dejamos nuestro hotel de Miami Beach para volver a Arlo! Habitaciones como en las fotos, ni más ni menos, nuevo y con una cama comodisima. Está situado perfecto para poder recorrer Miami y con las bicis del hotel en 35 minutos estás en la playa! Pero sin duda lo que hace la diferencia en este hotel es la gente que trabaja en él, en especial Vanda, Oscar y Agustina, gracias por todo! Cristina y Andrea

I often stay at this hotel, but last time I was there I had the worst experience with the front desk manager, Mr. Thurman Anderson. He was VERY rude and treated guests with a sarcastic and disrespectful tone. Also, the hotel had parties all weekend and there was too much noise in my room, couldn’t sleep. Won’t be bringing my business to this hotel anymore. Thank you Mr. Thurman

First time visit to the Arlo. A friend of mine helped build the hotel and my wife heard the hotel was celebrating its first anniversary. we decided to get away for the night. Check in was very smooth and everybody genuinely seemed happy helping people. We felt appreciated from the moment we arrived. The room was very comfortable and had a mini bar and stocked fridge. You don't see that anymore at the big hotels. We didn't use any of the items since we were their just for the one night and the roof top anniversary party but their were a lot of choices to tempt. Hotel is right in the heart of the art area in wynwood. walking distance to lots of restaurants and bars. I'd uber around at night but during the day we felt completely safe. for check out I never gave my name or room number. the person helping me rememebred my first and last name from check in the day before. That made us feel special. Thank you Arlo team for a great and well needed get away. We'll be back again.

Excellent hotel! Clean, modern, fun, great location (near restaurants, nightlife, shopping), great rooftop pool, excellent service and great fitness center. I would definitely go back and book another stay here.

Estuve en el bar en Higher Ground. La atención fue excelente 10/10 la chica que nos atendió María muy amable, además de muy buen ambiente y conversación. La comida muy rica y fresca, recomiendo mucho las hamburguesas y los cócteles deliciosos. Mi favorito fue Mojito Guayaba.

Such a beautiful space just a short UBER from MIA. Walkable to Wynwood Miami to explore street art, restaurants, and shops. Be sure to head to the 3rd floor bar for a chill vibe after a long day. Wifi is great, friendly staff, easy checkin/checkout.
Such a vibe. A beautiful hotel with great amenities and service. Also located in the beautiful Wynwood neighborhood. This is definitely my go to hotel from now on when visiting Miami. Def worth it.

The views are very great! The hotel was clean. The bar staff was really nice and the Vallet and the people working at the desk were super welcoming and really friendly. Had a tiny issue and they fixed it with no questions asked. Not any issue with the stay but it was handled in a timely manner and I was really pleased with this stay. Definitely coming again just to stay in the hotel.

I loooooove this hotel, my new favorite go to! From the decor to the atmosphere to the yoga on the deck to the pool party, and how close it is to everything, I looooooooooooove this hotel! The only thing better than the actual hotel was Mauricio! He was so helpful from everything like my bags, directions, and his beautiful smile and light conversation definitely deserves some recognition! Thank you to Mauricio, and all the staff at Arlo, will definitely be returning!

While staying at the Arlo Wynwood, I sustained an injury on my way to try to buy donuts at The Salty. The staff rushed to assist me upon my dramatic return. They cleaned me up, got me a car to the nearest hospital and made sure I had their number so they could send a car back to get me. When I returned to my room, there was a Salty donut and a wish for a speedy recovery. The next day, they assisted me with changing bandages. Aside from the hotel having lovely, clean rooms, and a beautiful rooftop pool and bar, they have remarkable staff and are in a great location for exploring Wynwood. Thank you so much for going above and beyond.

Well disappointing. Bartender at night not friendly. Desk clerk likewise. Need some trsining. Artwork is nice. And room okay. Never reviewed before. The upstairs pool area was nice. Bartender very friendly. Needs work with front of house staff.

Arlo Wynwood exceeded all of our expectations. Great service. Even offered a concierge via text messaging. The rooms were perfection. Absolutely loved the pool and the bar in the lobby with their amazing mixologists.

This is a great place to stay if you are interested in checking out the local Wynwood scene. It's very walkable and the stay includes tickets to the Museum of Graffiti Art. The hotel is brand new, very hip, and has a rooftop pool and excellent food. We had drinks at Higher Ground, the indoor/outdoor bar on the 3rd floor. It was beautiful there, and the food was also excellent. We can recommend their crudite platter, the oysters, and the pork belly. We also really enjoyed chatting with the bartender. The downsides are that the rooms are on the small side, and while the hotel is very high tech, that means that things can go awry, especially as this is their first year of operation, and kinks are probably being worked out. Our first night none of the televisions on our floor were working (they moved us to a different floor on our second night). The second day the phones were not working. However, the staff are very personable and helpful, and I believe that by the end of their first year they'll have the tech sorted out.

Here is a long review that explains what I liked about this hotel but also points out some things that may not be to your liking and might be worth taking into consideration. Let me start by stating that I am not the target client for this hotel. I’m over 40 and certifiably unhip! Nonetheless, I enjoyed my stay at the Arlo Wynwood and was quite comfortable. I will note that anybody who desires a conventional/old-style hotel – by that, I mean rooms that have dresser drawers, overhead light, carpeting, a desk, a microwave, etc. — might want to think twice about staying here. These rooms are minimalist and sleek in design. The only drawers are in the nightstands...not large enough for clothes. (There are a couple of shelves in the closet.) The closet space for hanging clothes is narrow, and you hang the clothes facing forward so you often have to go through your other clothes to reach the one you want. Floors are bare, and just one not-large, not-centered artwork hangs on the walls. The sitting area has one chair at a small round table. The refrigerator is really a minibar: It’s fully stocked with bottles and cans, so you have to either remove some of them to use it as a refrigerator or just squeeze in what you want to refrigerate. But it is not as deep as a real mini-fridge, so many containers and plates don’t fit. The bathroom is nice; only complaint there was dim lighting. Beds are comfy, and linens are plush. I also liked the ledge-type shelf that ran along one wall...a convenient place for keycards, jewelry, wallets and whatever else you take out of your pocket, and other small items. Even though we had a lot of clothes with us and a few pieces of luggage, we managed with the storage space; since another small table or chair would fit in the room, we just put our suitcase standing up in that unfurnished space and stacked clothes on top of it. What made our stay such a positive experience were the staff — especially the bellboys (I’m sure they don’t call them that!) — the location, the roof deck and the fitness amenities. These include free classes, including yoga, for guests Thurs. to Mon. and complimentary use of bicycles any day. Also, the gym is tidy and well-equipped with state-of-the-art cardio and weight machines. The rooftop pool is wonderfully clean, very long and heated (possibly heated a little too much). The hotel also has a great lobby: large, with chairs, sofas and work tables with USB ports. Some commenters here complained about the resort fee, which the Arlo Wynwood calls an “urban fee.” It seems ALL hotels charge this now, and I generally find the concept bogus and annoying, as many hotels say it’s for things like use of the pool or parking (hotels not in cities), which guests never used to pay for! At least the Arlo Wynwood gives you something for the urban fee: the previously mentioned fitness classes and bicycles, two bottles of water and free admission to the nearby Museum of Graffiti. BTW: state and occupancy taxes are charged on the urban fee, so it's actually closer to $32 than $28 daily. (Taxes add nearly 15% to the cost of your accommodations overall.) The hotel is in a trendy neighborhood still in transition. Wynwood’s outdoor art is amazing, and there are plenty of restaurants, dessert shops, breweries, bars and clubs. It’s close to both downtown Miami and Miami Beach – you could bike to both! All balcony rooms face the courtyard, where there’s music every night Thurs. through Sun. till midnight or 1am. We were on the 7th floor and did not find it too noisy. Perhaps certain DJs or bands play louder than the ones who entertained while we were there, but we really didn’t hear much with our balcony door closed. One thing I realized is that Miami can be too hot and sunny to get a lot of use out of a balcony (too hot to sit outside for any length of time), so if you’re concerned about the noise, consider that as well and just book a room without a balcony that doesn’t face the courtyard. But remember, music may be coming from other places in the area – for example, from the Jungle, a retail and restaurant complex down the block. Overall, we found the Arlo Wynwood to be a beautiful-looking and beautifully run property. Dining on-site is very expensive, whether at MaryGold’s restaurant, the rooftop bar or the breakfast/lunch counter. MaryGold’s has a happy hour at its bar 5-6pm with savings on cocktails and some food. Highly recommend that!

Amazing prime location— very European. Close to design district, great restaurants, easy to shop when you forget something back home, close to beaches, Brickell and near the airport. Hotel staff is very friendly and accommodating with everything.

Front desk service was supreme! Kudos to Sofia Moreno for her exceptional hospitality! I also want to send praise to her colleague who provided needed assistance regarding a language barrier between me and an Uber driver. The room was large with excellent views of MidTown!! The hotel is ideally located next to luxury shopping and dining in the Design District!!

Este hotel ha mejorado mucho su servicio al cliente luego de la pandemia. Habitaciones limpias, buen desayuno y una excelente ubicación en Midtown Miami. Las instalaciones son nuevas y el nivel de ruido es aceptable.

Convenient, great location to access stores and shopping and the staff was very accommodating. The room was fine and the bed comfortable. Xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxmost people won’t do this if have to write 200 characters

Friendly staff, location convenient, nice neighborhood and many Restaurants reachable on foot. Would recommend the place for their good prices, clean rooms that are well equipped with all necessary amenities.

Great location, i could easily walk to Wynwood for work and there were so many restaurants and shops nearby. The staff is so friendly and helpful, they never failed to say good morning or welcome me back each time i was in and out. I had a great experience staying here and will definitely be back.

Horrible hotel, I stay 80 nights in hotels a year. One of the worst. Elevators didn't work, no hotel staff, no hot water, no coffee, apartment building that slapped some rental rooms, checkin took forever.

Shaina! Was amazing :) thanks for taking care of us, see you next weekend! 5 star customer service and experience, perfect location and room, pool and tennis are awesome, gym also, great location and restaurants.

Came here with a few friends while celebrating my bachelor party. Jason and his team went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. I will definitely be coming back the next time we are in Miami.

Hyde Midtown consists of both a hotel as well as serviced residence suites for longer term stays. Each room is very large, much like what you’d expect of a new high-end residential condo. But its real plus is its proximity to the Shops at Midtown Miami, which includes Target, Ross Dress for Less and Marshall’s. There are two front desks, one for the hotel and one for the residences but they share a common lobby seating-lounge area. The hotel clearly considers itself an art hotel, considering the many works of art are in the lobby, the hallways and the guest rooms. All the front desk staff are exceptionally courteous and helpful. The room-suite starts with the dining-kitchenette area that leads to the living room with sofa, arm chair, coffee table, and a large TV screen. The kitchenette has a coffee maker and a microwave. The dining table has two bar stools and is made in ultra-modern black-colored steel frames. A sliding door separates this area from the bedroom and T&B. The bed sits on a wooden platform some 6 inches from the floor – we guessed so you could put your feet on it before setting them completely down on the floor. There is a long minimalist desk in front of the bed with a large screen TV above it. We appreciated that the room had enough electrical outlets so none of our devices were left wanting for power. It had a large T&B area, with a his and hers wash basin that we as a couple really appreciated. The fixtures were also in that consistent black color. The shower area was completely enclosed but it was all glass walls so it would probably be awkward if you were only friends. We didn’t appreciate that at 3:30 in the early morning, the room intercom went blaring about an emergency and that everyone had to vacate and not use the elevators. What?! It was raining heavily outside but the hotel intercom just kept blaring that loud message. We kept deciding if we really should go down. Finally, after a few minutes, the broadcast stopped. My wife finally got through to the front desk and it turned out it was a false alarm. They apologized to her but they never bother letting anyone know by similar intercom broadcast that it was a false alarm and to stop getting ready to evacuate. What a bummer! My wife never got back to sleep after that. There was no coffee shop where you could get breakfast but they did have a sushi bar for evenings.

Wanted a small staycation with the wife. Didn’t want to do the beach. So decided on checking out Hyde midtown. Was not disappointed, rooms are spectacular, completely updated. Staff was on point did not miss a beat. Great location to all the hotspots. Will definitely stay here again.

I had been there before and the actual experience was great. The attention, the cleanliness, the room and other details have positively changed. The location its ideal for all purposes. The installations looks great and very comfortable.

The hotel is beautiful. The room is well designed for the most part (the closet is a joke, there is about 6 inches where you can hang long garments). Overall it is very clean and modern. The amenities are pretty nice and overall this would be a great hotel IF they had room service. Even the holiday inn serves breakfast. When I called to inquire about room service I was told that the hotel does not have a kitchen… I found that interesting as there is a restaurant located on the 7th floor. Regardless the unavailability of room service is what really put a damper on my trip. Had I known there was no room service I would’ve stayed elsewhere. It’s nice but it is NOT a 4-star hotel.

El valet parking es muy demorado ya que los empleados prefieren atender primero a los que van para el restaurante Salvaje y dejan a los huéspedes del hotel de último. No prestaron el servicio de aseo a la habitación. No tienen toallas en la zona de la piscina

Fantastic location, quiet, excellent linens (particularly the pillows), don’t need a car, enjoyed sitting on patio, and staff - particularly Henry - were delightful and helpful. The restaurant, pool, hot tub and gym were top notch.

Excellent location, clean rooms and pool/restaurant view amazing. Jason was very attentive and accommodating to our needs and requests. Midtown has everything tou need from across the street dinner places, convenience stores and walking distance from wynwood walls

The hotel was very pretty to look at, but it was substandard in terms of quality of amenities and quality of the property in general. First, my room keys wouldn't work in the elevator. And once it worked, it would only work one time so if I went out and came back I needed to get another room key made. This happened at least 4 times over 2 nights which is pathetic. In my room, the knob fell off the shower and I couldn't turn it on. I eventually figured out a way to make it work, but even after mentioning it to the front desk, it wasn't fixed. The pump for the soap in the shower wouldn't work, but I didn't find out until I was IN the shower. It took me 5min of standing in the water fiddling with it just to get it to pump soap. The snacks in the mini bar was all stale. The robes in the room were sized for a 5ft tall 90lb woman. The television had someone else's name and room number listed on the HOME screen, and then when I was watching a show the TV just shut off in the middle of the program and reset itself. When it came back on, the room number and name on the home screen were STILL wrong. And then, to add insult to injury, the hot water stopped working. THE HOT WATER STOPPED WORKING. I mentioned this to the front desk and they said they would send someone up to fix it, but this was never done and the issue was never addressed by the front desk again. This was one of the absolute WORST hotel experiences that I've ever had. I brought all of these issues to the attention of the person at the front desk and she offered to refund my facilities fees ... what amounts to $50 over two days for a SUITE. I should have been COMPED the entire stay. It was AWFUL. DO NOT RECOMMEND
Excelente atención y servicio de todo el Personal. Nicole en el front desk esta en todos los detalles! La ubicación muy buena por los negocios cercanos y zona muy tranquila. Volveré seguramente 👏🏼👏🏼

Very nice hotel. Clean. Great area. However, they Need to upgrade the tech. I stayed for 2 days and had to reprogram my keys 5tine to allow me on the elevator. Also, would be nice if the desk staff wasn’t on instagram every time I approached them.

Check in was at 4pm but I stopped by at 12 pm and Maria at the front desk let me check in early with no fee! I really appreciated that! She was very accommodating and made the process easy and quick. Thank you Maria!

I love the property! I went to Miami for a retreat. I wanted to stay in a peaceful hotel and picked the perfect one! I valet my vehicle—an easy way to get in and out earlier in the morning. Carlos helped me to unload my vehicle and park my vehicle. Check-in was more straightforward (I don't remember her name, but she was polite and sweet). I came early, so I knew my room wasn't ready. She told me they would text me when my room was ready. She helped me to store my luggage. I went to check out the beautiful garden. It was gorgeous, and one hour later, Greg texted me that my room was ready. I picked up my keys, used the text feature message, and had a great conversation with the front desk team. They responded very quickly. Afterward, I went to Mayfair Grill for a Drink, It was nice, and the service was fantastic. My room was more than I expected; I felt like a Queen: beautiful balcony and a friendly and classic bar. The pillow and bed were comfortable—shower, bathtub, perfect pressure water. I slept so well, better than at my own house. The following day, my vehicle was ready for me. When I came back to the hotel, my room was clean and with fresh towels. Loved it! I spent all my nights inside the bathtub. It was amazing. I will definitely be back to this iconic property. Thank you. Keep up the great work.

My mother had to get emergency surgery at UMH and the drive from PB to Miami became really taxing. I wanted to find a hotel that would ease her anxiety. The photos of the Mayfair house is what initially drew me in. HOWEVER, the photos do not do it justice. Arriving to the hotel, it feels like you’re transported to a serene island. The hotel is breath taking and the rooms are large which I loved. Theres a rooftop pool with a bar that has parties at night. The only thing more beautiful than the hotel is its staff! The Front Desk supervisor Robert treated us as if we were part of his family. He went above and beyond to make sure my mother was comfortable. He was one of the reasons my mom decided to stay an extra night. The manager of the Restaurant Maria and her staff was so accommodating we didn’t want to eat anywhere else. Guest service coordinator Owen, exceeded our expectations with coordinating services for my mom to lift her spirits. Valet and housekeeping was truly amazing. I seriously have no complaints (which is a first) lol. We are beyond grateful for the care and attentiveness provided to us doing a stressful time. We plan to become regulars! We will be back next month to celebrate my mothers birthday!

Wow. Haven’t been here in 30 years. What an unbelievable refurbish. I was blown away. The room was decorated so well. Bed comfy. Huge bathroom. Very very clean. Had a sliding glass door to lounge area outside. Delightfully appointed with outdoor shower. Privacy. Lush natural landscaping. The hotel outdoor lobby area was beautifully tropical with water features and flying iron ibis (nice touch!!!). The rooftop bar area was very nice. I’ve stayed at a lot of hotels in Miami and the beach. This ranks up there. Very very pleasantly surprised.

Wonderful service from the moment you arrive. Luxurious rooms with unique amenities. Greeted with a signature cocktail upon arrival and upgraded without having to request it. Room had a veranda complete with an outside shower! Truly special.

Lovely hotel with friendly staff and excellent service. I got a room upgrade (loved my room!) and used the pool and both restaurants. Everything was great. Shoutout Anderson, who went above and beyond. But everyone was helpful and friendly and made me feel pampered! Thank you!

We had such a great Girls Trip this past week and absolutely enjoyed our stay at Mayfair House. Everything about the hotel was fabulous, especially the decor and overall vibe! We arrived very early on Sunday and were immediately greeted by the beautiful Daniella who was so helpful and welcoming. She took great care of us, gave us our Welcome Drinks and was even able to facilitate an early check-in which was so appreciated since we had been traveling since 4 am. All the staff, from bartenders to housekeeping, were friendly and helpful whenever you asked for anything. They have a great text system we used for any questions and we received recommendations for restaurants and places to check out in South Beach. The location of this hotel is perfect. We ate out at the most amazing restaurants and loved walking the quaint streets of Coconut Grove. Bravo to management for running such a wonderful establishment and congrats to the staff for making our trip so memorable. We will be back soon!

What an amazing retreat from the outside world. From walking through the beautiful sculpted wood doors at the entrance to the warm inviting check in area. We were greeted with warmth and friendliness not seen nowadays. The plush greenery and ornate setting inside is breathtaking. The rooms are warmly lit, beautifully decorated with private balcony. The rooftop pool is absolutely a stunning retreat. The breakfast was delicious and every staff member an absolute joy. A four star experience, there is no need to stay anywhere else in Miami. Thank you Mayfair for a wonderful experience.

My husband and I had the best staycation ever this past weekend. We were so excited to check out the newly remodeled hotel and it definitely lived up to our expectations. The decor is stunning! There are beautiful plants all along the balconies which give off such a beautiful tropical vibe. We were obsessed. We spent our Saturday upstairs at the pool where you have so many choices of where to lay out and get some sun. The rooftop pool was perfect and the music made us feel like we were on some tropical island somewhere. Our room was also soooo nice. We stayed in a King suite and it was the perfect place to disconnect. It was beautifully decorated like the rest of the hotel. The mini bar was so cute and filled with local goodies. The bed was so comfortable and plush. We can’t wait to come back. Overall we highly recommend spending a weekend at the Mayfair Hotel and checking out everything Coconut grove has to offer.

Plant lovers, this is your Eden. Once the discrete carved wood doors smack dab in the middle of bustling Coconut Grove open, your jaw hits the floor when you find yourself in an oasis, surrounded by towering open floors around you trimmed with palm leaves spilling over the balconies, and at ground level, the greenery is interspersed with fountains and pools. What a gorgeous property! A perfect retreat for a couple looking to relax, a solo traveler looking to disconnect. And once you're done relaxing through your zen walks through the hotel's corridors, you can take the lift up to SipSip, the rooftop pool, and have the gorgeous sunset and lively atmosphere breathe you back to life. We had a wonderful stay and it was the perfect "staycation" we needed as busy parents to a baby. The comfy bed and blackout curtains were just what the doctor ordered.

This is an absolute stunning hotel nestled perfectly in the heart of Coconut Grove . From the moment we walked in the customer service was outstanding . We were greeted and welcomed so warmly by the staff . Just entering into the Mayfair was like being transported to somewhere else , some secluded paradise. The rooms were immaculate , beautiful and wonderfully lit. Everything about this hotel makes you feel like you can decompress and truly enjoy your stay. And breakfast was exceptional with the most engaging wait staff.

Mayfair Hotel is back and looks better than ever! Beautiful design and thoughtful service! Great views from the pool deck on the roof, comfortable beds and the best location in the Grove. Highly recommend!

The Mayfield House Hotel & Garden Is beyond amazing. It is modern fabulousness! The staff are friendly and helpful, the property is very clean and the greenery is absolutely breathtaking. The rooms are very spacious and inviting. I have no complaints. I can’t wait to book my next stay

What a beautiful stay this was! My boyfriend and I wanted to do a staycation in Miami, and I am so glad we chose this spot. The hotel is absolutely stunning. The architecture, decor and greenery invoke this luxurious, retro Miami vibe - perfect for pictures. Our room was very spacious, clean and the bed was so comfy!! I could live in the bath robes. They were so soft and cozy! The rooftop pool and bar area was gorgeous as well. We couldn't have asked for a better location in Coconut Grove. We were steps away from countless restaurants, shops and bars. This neighborhood was really buzzing on the weekend! I would definitely stay here again!

This hotel is very tropical! It really captures the essence of Coconut grove. Plants everywhere, carved wood accents throughout the hotel, masculine decor with highlight tones of mustard and emerald green. The room was great, we had a balcony, great blackout shades, and king bed was super comfy, i melted into the pillows. Not your typical white/beige cookie cutter furniture modern hotel. It’s walking distance to the best restaurants, marina, parks, and coco walk mall is across the street. BTW, morning coffee and banana bread in the courtyard is must !

Great location in the middle of everything the grove has to offer. Beautiful ambience takes you away from the typical miami style. Staff was attentive to our every needs. Can’t wait to come back and stay again.

We spent one night at the Elser before joining a cruise. Check in was really busy, but was fairly quick moving. All the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. The apartment was well appointed, clean and well maintained. We had breakfast and this was delicious and very reasonably priced. The hotel were happy to store our luggage, and loaded our cab on departure. We were unable to find any issues during our stay, and would thoroughly recommend the Elser

Elser hotel Miami is the best place to stay before or after a cruise. It’s super close to the port. The balcony overlooks the bay ocean. Woke up at 5am and watched the view of cruise ships coming in. CVS, food, and other places walking distance. Would love to recognize Jade for being super nice at check in and recognizing my face and calling me by name if I ever went out to the lobby for anything. Would also like to recognize Jasmine for getting our two room reservations side by side on the same floor. I think the rate is excellent by Miami standards and the balconies have the best ocean view or city view depending on your preference. Elser is definitely my goto from now on when I’m in the Miami area.

Ruhan es un gran anfitrión El hotel es maravilloso y la atención es excelente Las instalaciones son limpias y todo es muy ordenado. Mi familia está muy feliz de hospedarse aquí. De seguro volveremos a quedarnos. Muy recomendado en todo momento

La 1era habitación tenia el AA dañado, no habia control remoto en la habitación , enviaron a dos personas arreglar el AA , super incomodo tener personas ajenas a mi familia en la habitación. Nos cambiaron luego de perdir el cambio de habitación. Definitivamente No es un hotel familiar, notamos mucho movimiento de personas de “VIDA Alegre” extrema!!! La distribución de la habitación es super incomoda. No tienen estacionamientos, cobran por noche el uso de los valet parking. No regreso.

Wonderful appartment room with lounge full kitchen washer and dryer, felt like home from home. Wonderful welcoming attentive staff. The pool is epic with fantastic views over the bay from the giant and I mean huge terrace with a bar. Liked it so much I extended my stay. Shout out to Heberle!

Jasmine at the reception made the experience great, friendly, helpful and funny! Great restaurant recommendations too. The only thing I think could improve is room service- they came once very early in 3 days, we were asleep so didn’t have any service on the room, but other than that the facilites are awesome, great gym and amazing pool. Very good location. We can’t wait to go back!

El servicio recibido y las instalaciones impecables. La ubicacion perfecta para accesar Miami Beach, Brickel, etc. Un sitio que definitivamente hay que repetir, las vistas de bahía son espectaculares y cada vez más sitios interesantes en down town

Amazing service . Helpful staff. Clean property. Jennifer R assist us with our early check in and we are super happy. Fantastic view. Thank you Elser Hotel. I would stay again :) :) :) :) :) ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,

From the time we arrived we were treated so well. Assistance with bags, welcome drink, room ready earlier than expected! Our desk agent Jasmine was PHENOMENAL!!! She heard me when I casually shared that it was our anniversary and you can tell she genuinely cared. It was heartwarming and far exceeded our expectations. Our room and all the touches Jasmine made possible really made the trip for us and sealed the Elser as our go to spot when cruising out of Miami. You can see the ship from our balcony with the amazing ocean view. Also they have a beach club access agreement so you still get that beach action you expect included in your stay.

Jennifer Rivera es una persona excepcional, su atención espectacular, durante mi estadía tuve un par de percances y ella fue la única que supo cómo sacarme de apuros, al igual que Roberto de valet, una joven muy atento, infinitamente agradecida con sus atenciones y contenta con The Elser Hotel.La asistencia de Gigi me ayudó mucho para poder completar mis actividades.

El hotel es hermoso, hubieron pormenores pero lo solucionaron, quiero agradecer a Deneb que me atendió, brindo soluciones en todo momento en mis dos estadías que suman 15 dias, volveré pronto ! solo estoy esperando q me me devuelvan los 2 depositos de garantia que aun no llegan a pesar de haber pasado mas de 10 dias luego de hacer el checkout

Excelente las instalaciones, el Valet parking muy eficiente, las vistas a la bahía de las habitaciones es espectacular, muy bueno el gimnasio...una mencion especial para la atención del personal y en especial de Katy y Deneb en la recepción, ellas me resolvieron mis problemas Volveremos!

La verdad no se puede calificar a the Elser con menos de 5 , ubicación , limpieza y amabilidad del staff es excelente, no tengo quejas, solo que se debe mejorar el amenities , más temprano la hora , a la hora que los dan te matan la mañana, debería ser a las 8 am , y el desayuno es algo para tomar y se agradece, pero se debe varias , Yo me quedé 15 días y siempre fue igual , pero estos puntos no dañan mi calificación de 5/5

Jennifer Rivera was a great help and very accommodating at check in. Complimentary cocktail upon arrival was a great touch. Room was beautiful clean and classy. Comfortable bed, full kitchen and great amenities. We Will definitely return

the view is pretty good and we enjoy it. Welcome to the Elser hotel to book the vacation and I believe that it would be a not bad experience. But more free service offered will be better for guests because we have spent a lot for the room. Hope I can enjoy the hotel again in the future.

Our stay at The Elser has been wonderful. Deneb helped us when we arrived and she gracefully accommodated our needs! Our experience has been even better thanks to her and her service! Room is incredibly complete with everything you need, silverware, pots and pans, dishes, laundry tower, you name it. The full kitchen is incredibly useful. Views are A1 and the pool and gym are amazing. They have an EV charging station on site too. This place truly has everything you need!

Excelente !! Mejor imposible y DENEB nos trató muy bien estamos felices, el hotel queda literal al frente de bayside y el kaseya Center, hay muchas opciones de comida cerca y puedes pasear por el boulevard y regresar a pie sin problema 100% recomendado

El hotel Elser es sin duda el mejor de Miami. Ya es nuestra tercera estadía acá y no tenemos ni una sola critica. En cada estadía se ha superado un poco más. Las limpieza de las habitaciones es impecable, los empleados del hotel siempre están dispuestos a ayudarte y te atienden siempre con una sonrisa. Las vistas desde todas las habitaciones es insuperable así como también la decoración de las mismas. El gimnasio es algo q no he visto en ningún otro hotel y la piscina es un sueño. Sin dudas seguiremos volviendo cada vez q viajemos a Miami

Todo maravilloso, mis felicitaciones a la muchacha de la recepción JEYRE muy gentil y amable, habitación con vista hermosa y cerca de muchos restaurantes y locales de vida nocturna, hotel con un ambiente muy tranquilo y relajante. Volveré en este espectacular hotel seguramente!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: The area for this hotel is pretty good and staff was friendly but here is feedback from my wife and I. I was caught off guard by the security deposit and parking fee as a guest at the hotel but it is all good. Overall, we had a good experience. We appreciate how the staff kept the breakfast area clean and they were attentive. Abdul was a HUGE help during our visit. We appreciate his kindness and patience with us.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I had an amazing experience thanks to Abdulrahman Barradah and his outstanding customer service! From the moment I arrived, he went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect with my stay. He was incredibly friendly, professional, and attentive — always ready to help with a smile. When I had a small issue with my room, Abdulrahman handled it immediately and made sure I was completely comfortable. His dedication and genuine care truly made me feel welcomed and valued as a guest. Thank you, Abdulrahman, for making my stay exceptional! You’re a great example of what true hospitality looks like.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: First impression is the behaviour of front desk staff. Abul Rahman and Brandon were awesome. Highly professional and pleasent attitude we have noticed during our check-in. Dealing with House keeping staff and maintenence personel was also a very good experience. Room are quite spacious, comfirtable beds and pillows. We had s very nice sleep after very long flight. Breakfast area was huge, too many options to choose from. Over all it was a great experience. I will definetly recommend the Hamtons to our friend and families.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: We called ahead a reserved the Stay, Park, and Cruise package. We drive from north FL and with the Hampton’s package the parking is much less expensive than the ports. And the shuttles to and from the ports are convenient and inexpensive. Our room was very clean, comfortable, and huge. It may have been large as it was an accessible room. The accessible rooms were all that were left when we got to the Select Your Room time. We had panoramic views of city blocks and the Bay a bit past the blocks. The room had a mini fridge, coffee set-up, closet, iron, ironing board, full-length mirror; all the necessities, including a sofa and two ottomans, which was very nice. The water pressure was pleasantly quite strong. Breakfast was what you would expect at any Hampton Inn and perfect for us. Unfortunately, when we checked in on September 6 around 5ish the lady who checked us in was…indifferent. I would say a forced smile, at best. I asked about the parking and she somewhat explained what we needed to do. I just wanted to know we were getting the package pricing, but couldn’t quite get reassured. We had several pieces of luggage to carry in and I asked if they had a luggage cart. She was quick to say “We don’t have them”. I looked surprised. She then looked past me and flatly said “Oh, there’s one”. I asked about the shuttle and she scheduled it. I asked about the return shuttle, and she said, flatly, “We don’t provide a return shuttle”. Seriously, it’s a one-way Stay, Park, and Cruise package? When we tried to drive into the parking garage, we couldn’t get the arm to lift. We didn’t have a scannable ticket, she just gave us a stub for the dashboard. We had to buzz to get help in. The shuttle pick-up was a bit scattered. We did change our pick-up shuttle schedule by one hour, and they accommodated. Surprisingly, as we were departing the shuttle for port, we heard the shuttle driver say “ pick you up back here” as she hopped in the shuttle. To confirm details, since we were told there was no shuttle pick up, we called the hotel three times while on the cruise, but were placed on hold too long. The fourth time they provided a disconnected number. The last attempt, we got a number to a private shuttle service. We were calling and making arrangements with them the last night and all the way past customs after disembarkation. We had the same issue exiting the garage as we had entering. I’m usually pretty easy on reviews. There were other service issues here, as well. Mostly were all directly related to the unhelpful and unhappy check-in associate. I swear, I think her goal was to make our experience as unpleasant as humanly possible.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I booked a stay at this hotel for multiple rooms prior to us boarding a cruise. The location is an easy walk to shopping and so many food options. The hotel itself is super clean and convenient to malls and the cruise port. We had excellent, prompt, service upon check in. We requested additional towels for our rooms and again received them quickly from kind employees. The rooms are large and spacious. Several options available with the included breakfast with a larger seating area to eat. The gym had multiple treadmills, cable machines, free weights and even Peleton bikes. This is a great hotel in a beautiful area. I would stay here again.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I sent this as an email to the hotel and have not received a response as of yet. I'm copying and pasting it here also. "There was a situation that happened on August 2nd around 12:15ish when my family (myself and my parents) decided to use transportation that was provided at the hotel to get to the port for our cruise. The original price quoted was ten dollars per person which we were fine with. When the driver(older man, grey hair, stocky build) dropped us off, we gave him 30 dollars plus a 5 dollar tip. When we were walking away, he stated that it was 15 more dollars because he used AC. We stated that at the hotel we were quoted 10 dollars. He said well it's 15 more dollars. We gave him the money because it was time for us to get on the ship. This situation did not sit well with my family. First of all, he dropped off other guests who were Caucasian to another terminal and I heard him clearly say it was 10 dollars plus whatever tip they wanted to give him.
