There was also an African American woman that paid with her card at the hotel so I don't know if he was frustrated that she did not tip him. I don't know if it was a race issue or that my parents were elderly and did not speak fluent English that he thought he could get away with this. This driver might not be employed by the hotel but this is the transportation that was provided. It left my parents and I feeling frustrated before the start of a wonderful trip. 15 dollars might not be a lot of money but it was the way he said it and the way it made us feel especially towards a family that saved for months for this wonderful trip. We knew he was lying and trying to get a bigger tip. We had no issues with the hotel. My mom still raves about our room but this situation put a damper on things. I just wanted to inform you of this incident because I do not want this happening to other guests."

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: From the moment we arrived, the experience at the Hampton Inn Wynwood Miami was seamless. The front desk staff was welcoming and efficient and housekeeping kept everything spotless during our stay. Even the breakfast staff was friendly and on top of everything each morning. We didn’t have a single issue throughout our visit, and that kind of consistency is worth praising. If you’re headed to the cruise ports, getting there is truly easy peasy — the location makes it super convenient. Plus, you’re right in the heart of Wynwood, so there’s plenty to explore, eat, and enjoy. Highly recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Miami or catching a cruise. We’ll definitely be back!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: The hotel was great when we stayed, but I realized I left something at the hotel and I have been trying to call them and I either go straight to voicemail or no one picks up. I even called the hampton inn people higher up and they could not even get in contact with this hotel. I still have not been able to get the item because I don’t know if they have it since I cannot ask them due to the lack of communication they have. Overall great stay but don’t waste your breath trying to get in contact with these people.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Nice hotel but the staff needs an injection of joy. Bunch of monotonous, dry and blah individuals. Breakfast is OK abiding by Hilton’s policy of providing as little as possible. Parking overpriced in a very small and tight garage and the area is ok.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: The room was dirty. The sitting cubes were clearly not moved when the room was cleaned/vacuumed. When we moved them to sit, there was a ton of food left behind. We also found a pair of socks. The pool closed at 8 p.m., and upon checking in, we were not told about breakfast or the pool's hours.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: So: I contacted the hotel through Booking.com to request an earlier check-in. The hotel replied to say this should be ok, but to phone on the day to make sure. I phoned about 8am only to be cut off twice by reception staff. I then phoned again to be told I had to ring at 10 am. This meant when we were in the taxi so I tried but could not get through. We arrived at the hotel to find that this was not possible and we had to wait until 3pm. We went away and came back to find we had to wait until 320pm in their non-airconditioned lobby. We finally got into the room and relaxed. About half an hour later when I was changing a member of staff opened the door and shall we say politiely saw more than he bargained for. Things actually got worse - we had put items in the safe while we went out to dinner. When we got back the safe batteries had malfunctioned and closed our stuff inside. We called maintenance and a man (I think the same one!) opened it with a master key and then said are we going to use it again as if so he won't bother replacing the batteries! At this point we were fed up so said yes. We then had the experience of trying to sleep with the really loud aircon - we had to have it operating as the room was unusually hot. In the morning we had breakfast, which was ok but most items barely warm. We then went to relax in our room until taxi pickup. Then the fire alarm sounded - we shot out to go down the stairs only for it to stop. No one was around to let us know and there were people millign around not sure what to do. Then it started again, so we went downstairs to be told it was a 'test'. We asked why we were not informed and the receptionist (the rude one from yesterday) just shrugged her shoulders! It continued going off and on for the next hour - not a pleasant experience as by this time we felt we could not trust the hotel at all. We finally left what was probbaly the worst hotel I have ever stayed in.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Just want to commend your front desk Representatives at the hotel, Travis and Abdul. They were so friendly, and very responsive to any request I had during my stay. They help make my business trip a pleasure, and I thank them for their professionalism and helping me out during my stay.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Eric the from clerk was extremely unprofessional ! Said in plain English as soon as I pull up to the gate, he would open it with my vehicle sitting there. I sat for about five minutes push the button I could see him inside looking at me did not open the gate I went inside to the lobby again, stood in front of him clearly by myself did not acknowledge me. Acted like he was busy doing paperwork Meantime, two more vehicles were behind mine waiting to exit started honking their horns. Finally, somebody came into the lobby from one of the vehicles and said can someone please open the gate at which time Eric woke up and open the gate wake up Eric it’s called work time.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I do not write reviews like at all & ever !! But I must say this hotel is great! This was our second time staying with our family, we are from NYC so our standards are pretty high expectation wise. Location is great from airport and awesome being in midtown Miami, not too far from anything. One morning my family & I went for a swim and when getting back in our room we noticed water all over the bathroom floor and realized our toilet was clogged. We called guest services and the staff was top tier specially front desk staff, Chris. The cleaning staff was amazing as well from cleaning it up ASAP and Chris switching our room/upgrading us. They made it even more convenient by keeping us on the same floor knowing we had three little children which was amazing. Definitely recommend this hotel, very kid friendly, great area and amazing respectful & accommodating staff. Cannot wait to return.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Excellent staff that helped us find local restaurants and made sure we had everything we needed. Shout out to Eric for going above and beyond to make sure we had a great stay! Walking distance to so many areas including Wynwood district , mid town and the design district !!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: A large, comfortable, well-appointed room. Comfortable bed either fluffy pillows. Friendly staff. Welcomed by Jeannette. Professional and friendly. Overall, a fine experience. Good buffet breakfast in a spacious area overlooking the rooftop.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: At check-in, Eric provided exceptional customer service!!. He actively listened and addressed each of our areas of concern. His smile and warm personality were so refreshing! Further, I’d be remiss if I did not acknowledge the breakfast workers. On the very first day, I shared with the workers how impressed I was with the preparation of the food and cleanliness of the serving and sitting areas. For our three night stay, we had a five-star experience!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Currently staying here. The food is really, REALLY bad despite advertising their Michelin star menu. Room service order of "prawns" was 5 frozen/thawed, probably steamed grocery store small shrimp. Salad was very bitter somehow. Chicken Caesar salad to the pool was dry/hard chicken jerky. Morning breakfast buffet was reminiscent of a holiday inn-thawed frozen cantaloupe honeydew mix, cereal and a couple pastries. All of this is of course pricey and includes a 20% tip. There is also a delivery fee for room service-around $7 and automatic 20% gratuity. Honestly I would be ok paying if the food wasn't terrible. Everyone has to go to the 25th floor and then transfer to a second elevator to get to their room. The pool is in a separate building altogether. Getting ice for the room is challenging as no one ever picks up when you call front desk/room service. One morning they had construction in the room above us. Nonstop drilling at 7am. I sleep with earplugs and it was still loud enough to wake me. A visit to the front desk to complain got a “so what is the problem?” Any complaints are met with attitude. The lobby and staff is impersonal and hard to get someone to even look up from their laptops. Check out we got a pointed finger to go to the next person who pointed us to another person without a greeting or even looking up from their screens. The 25th lounge offers beautiful water views however ordering a glass of prosecco will set you back $25 The room is very nice, clean and roomy. The pool gets sun around 3-4hours for the day due to surrounding buildings. 4 high rise structures are currently being built around the property so expect nonstop construction noise during working hours. Bring noise cancelling headphones if you want to visit the pool or surrounding areas outside. The spa is OK. For prices so high I would expect a better lounge area. There is one meditation room the size of a bathroom to spend time between services without water, tea, or snacks available. However, the massage was lovely. Despite suggestions they can accommodate late check outs they refused the entire company team saying they are fully booked however i only saw one person on my floor the entire week. Overall I would stay somewhere else with staff that are even remotely attentive, less construction noise, decent food and a quiet/ sunny pool to enjoy. I see the responses to other negative reviews with Managment saying to email them after the fact. What is the point is they are unwilling to address while you are still in the building and refuse to visit their hotel again?

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Dulce y Washington son lo mejor Que tienen en front desk . De verdad loa felicito por tener un excelente staff. 🫶🫶

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excelente todo. La atención desde el Valet con Eduardo y Paul. Siempre es una placer quedarse en el AKA.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: La experiencia fue excelente, tanto por la comida como por el servicio impecable. Había buenas opciones gastronómicas, sobre todo en el menú del almuerzo. La sala de conferencias estaba muy limpia y moderna. El personal de banquetes fue muy amable y atento. Sin duda, uno de los mejores hoteles para reuniones y conferencias.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: My stay was uneventful at best, forgettable at worst. Good location in Brickell. Mandatory Valet exorbitantly priced but thats everywhere in Miami. Front desk staff efficient but robotic. Room was basic but clean: bed comfortable, coffee machine and stocked mini bar in room, no view.This used to be a Hilton Conrad hotel and it still feels that way… a bit sterile, soulless, corporate, boring, and dated bathrooms with low boy toilets and weak water pressure. That being said, my only real complaint is that I requested an additional luggage rack twice and it was never delivered… but all points considered, I don’t really see anything that makes this hotel special, you’re better off just picking a corporate chain across the street so you can earn points.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Choose the AKA Brickell for the location, accommodations and great price. We only stayed for one nite on a Saturday for an Anniversary weekend. Upon check-in we were warmly greeted and acknowledged with a Happy Anniversary for our stay. The Bayview room was modern and a nice large bathroom. The room was very clean and the bed and pillows were great. Very convenient with walking distance to great restaurants. Would definitely not hesitate to stay again. All the staff including valet attendants were very friendly and helpful.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Seamless check into a great modern space with a very friendly staff. Nice amenities and great location, accessible to area attractions.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Nuestra experiencia en Hotel AKA Brickell fue maravillosa. El personal fue muy atento, las instalaciones modernas y elegantes, y la ubicación perfecta en el corazón de Brickell. La habitación superó nuestras expectativas y la vista fue espectacular. Sin duda, un lugar al que volveremos.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Girls’ trip to celebrate a milestone birthday! From the moment we arrived, we noticed how clean and welcoming the hotel was. The lobby is beautiful, and every staff member we met was friendly and helpful. A special shoutout to Harris, our concierge, who made our stay unforgettable. He welcomed us warmly, checked us in smoothly (even though we arrived early), and went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed. His positive energy set the tone for our trip. Thanks to Harris and the entire AKA Brickell team, our birthday celebration was stress-free and memorable. If you’re visiting Miami, stay here — and if you get Harris at the front desk, you’ll be in excellent hands!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Booked it for my birthday weekend and Washington was beyond helpful in helping me find the best room! Thank you for the amazing customer service 💙

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The property is elegant and well maintained, but what really stood out was the service. The bellmen were exceptional!! always attentive, professional, and genuinely looking out for guests. They made me feel welcomed and cared for when leaving and entering the hotel. Thank you Cesar, Diego and Jorg.! I will think of you all when I return to Miami!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: This is our second time staying here, and unfortunately, the service and employees have changed drastically since our first visit. There is simply no real service anymore, but the prices remain high, which does not match the experience. I truly don’t see how this property qualifies as a 5 star hotel. The room was not clean, and housekeeping only came if we repeatedly called the front desk if anyone even answered the phone. The hotel setup is also inconvenient, with only two elevators for the rooms and a separate one in another building just to access the pool. The valet team was the only positive part of our stay helpful and professional. Unfortunately, the same cannot be said about the restaurant staff, who seemed unhappy to be there. Even simple requests, like sugar or bread, were delayed until breakfast service was practically over. The reception staff were also dismissive and unhelpful, often with an attitude when asked for assistance. When we shared our concerns with the manager, instead of listening or trying to help, he gave us attitude and acted as if our feedback wasn’t worth his time. He made us feel as though we were just looking for discounts, which was insulting. Overall, this hotel does not deliver the level of service expected from a 5 star property. I would not return and cannot recommend it to others.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Great people at the Valet. Specially Eduardo, Elijah and Diego. Nice to meet you guys! Keep up the excellent work! Hope to see you again next time we stay at the AKA hotel in Brickell

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: ¡Una experiencia increíble la atenciónen el hotel fue excepcional. Corami siempre estuvo pendiente de que estuviéramos cómodos, haciendo que nos sintiéramos como en casa. Washintong también fue súper amable, profesional y muy atento a cada detalle. ¡Ambos hicieron que nuestra visita fuera aún más especial! Sin duda, recomendaría este lugar, por el excelente equipo humano.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: From the moment we stepped into Hotel AKA Brickell, we knew we were in for something special. The level of service, the luxury, and the attention to detail were top-tier — but what truly made our stay unforgettable was Oscar at the front desk. Oscar went above and beyond from the second we arrived. Not only was he warm and welcoming, but he also took the time to walk us through everything we needed to know about the hotel and the local area. We had a few specific requests regarding our room and plans in Miami, and Oscar handled everything with incredible professionalism and genuine kindness. You could tell he truly cared about making our experience perfect — and he did just that! The room itself was stunning — modern, impeccably clean, and designed with comfort in mind. The windows gave us breathtaking views of the Brickell skyline, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. Every detail, from the lighting to the luxurious bathroom, made us feel pampered. As for the location — you can’t beat it. Nestled right in the heart of Brickell, we were steps away from incredible restaurants, cafes, shopping, and nightlife. Plus, the hotel is just a short ride to South Beach, Wynwood, and other top Miami spots. This was hands down one of the best hotel experiences we’ve ever had, and a big part of that was thanks to Oscar’s outstanding hospitality. Hotel AKA Brickell has it all — luxury, convenience, and world-class service. We can’t wait to come back!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Muy cómodo y amplio. Limpio y en muy buen estado. Buena comida y gran atención. Me exigen 100 caracteres y tengo que seguir escribiendo …. Ya las cumplí

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Atención de Washington y Corami en recepción demasiado increíble, eficiente y amigable. Atención de Catalina en el sector de la piscina un 10 de 10, amable y cariñosa. Las personas de valet parking también muy amables y eficientes, todo perfecto.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Debo recalcar la atención de Oscar, en recepción súper cálido amable me ayudó en todo lo que necesite. Da placer hospedarse en un lugar así cuando la calidez de la persona traspasa niveles. Gracias!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excelente ubicación. Todo perfecto. Seguramente volveremos. Gracias por la amabilidad de Corami que nos recibió tan amablemente. La pasamos increíble en nuestra estadía.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: El hotel está muy bien ubicado! La habitación cómoda! Y la atención en el lobby fue excelente! Nos atendió en recepción la Srta Ileana Dulce espectacular! Los señores del valet parking nos atienden muy bien! La relación precio/calidad está bien justificada!

Outstanding customer service from the staff and i highly recommend dining at MaryGold’s Brasserie! The menu selections made it difficult to choose and the presentation was outstanding. I highly recommend the steak au Poivre with truffle mushroom sauce. The hotel was very well maintained and very clean.

Tiny rooms, loud music, style over substance. Can't get a receipt unless you pay $3 on top of resort fee. Stay away. Front desk is clueless, asked the front desk for a safety pin this morning and his response was "to break into a safe?" WTF?

Hotel nuevo, muy lindo. Habitaciones cómodas, linda deco, buen solárium y café de especialidad en planta baja. Todos muy atentos muy en especial Santiago de recepción! y Lucas del valet. Sin duda volveremos en un próximo viaje!!!!!!!!!!

I’ll start by saying the service was very good. Really. The rooftop pool is also quite nice. My gripe is with the size of the room. We booked a two bed room, with balcony. Well, that was the smallest room I’ve ever been to, and I’ve been to quite a few. Make sure you check that before booking. Also, the smoke detector was flashing all night, making it quite annoying to fall asleep.

Somehow I got lucky enough to land a room in THE neighborhood you want to be in during this EXTREMELY busy time of season for Miami hotels. Haven't been to Basel since '15 and Wynwood is THE place to be if you want to be within walking distance to amazing restaurants (that don't cost $$$$ for subpar food and service) and graffiti/ Miami Arts Week. The hotel had been open less than 30 days and I tip my hat to the entire staff for pulling off an opening/ followed by Thanksgiving/ Basel and now straight into season. Monica, Guest Services Manager, went above and beyond answering my many, many logistical questions I had pre-arrival and truly embodies what it means to be a hospitality professional. A gem, Arlo you are lucky to have her! Also being greeted at registration by my fellow St. Thomian Khalil (who has a smile that lights up a room- yes I) is a true testament that this property has assembled a fantastic team to ensure everyone who stays at this property is treated truly as a valued guest. The property is gorgeous and smart in design. The roof top pool perfect size with great views opens at sunrise/closed at sundown. Rooms were clean and comfortable, housekeeping diligent and worked swiftly. Stayed in 847 which had a balcony and enjoyed the ability to have a coffee (they have Nespresso machines- super big win in my book) or a cocktail (gracious enough to send a bottle of bubbles for boyfriends bday). Design wise I could see that the closet is a tad small for an over-packer like myself, but was into the smartly designed under bed storage for luggage. Mini bar was aptly stocked with in my opinion, really reasonably priced ammenities. Fresh water was stocked everyday (if you don't let housekeeping in to do their magic, it won't get restocked, duh. call the desk they'll send anything up you need!) Walking distance to really great coffee and donuts at Salty Dog, Bagel sandwiches at The Bagel Club, Tacos at Coyo Taco, ate at the bar at Le Chick ($100 for two people with drinks and apps and sandwiches is a STEAL in Miami). The price of admission is included to the Museum of Graffiti which had parties every day (w. free Margaritas and Modelos) in their backyard for Art Week.. I could go on & on. Oh btw if anyone complains about noise,... It's Miami, it's nightlife, it's expected. I'll end with this, Arlo is the first of its kind in Wynwood but will definitely not be the last. Thank you again to Monica & Khalil and we'll see you next December. xox Jennifer and Jimmy

Had never stayed at an Arlo hotel and have fallen in love. Super clean design, floors (hate nasty carpet), and perfectly designed. Rooms on the smaller side but comfortable. Cute balcony with beautiful views of wynwood. Bathroom amenities on point. Wished for a little more light in bathroom and faster arriving hot water. Other than that, perfect stay. Thanks to Santi at the front desk for great check in. Hotel is beautiful and clean with great spaces. Pool deck must visit at sundown. All the staff are helpful. Crown jewel of Wynwood!

Mere last minute trip to Art Basel. I've been to HK Basel and expected the Miami flare. Hotel - every one was friendly and polite . The valet, bell hop team were great. Checked in on my birthday and forgot I was at a hipster place and even after the receptionist checked my passport ID and no birthday wishes, nothing. Don't expect anything more than a mere friendly smile there. Rooms are clean as it's new. Overall nice vibes & design throughout. Turned on the TV - immediate error on there. Sent them a photo of the error message and they had someone come up right away. It came with ear plugs by the bed, so you KNOW it's going to be noisy. The bar on the 3rd floor is loud till closing. You can also here music from nearby since it's Basel crazy week on top of normal entertainment in the area. You can hear the plane as it's on the flight path. There's a balcony for most if not all rooms. Well, my neighbours strolled in 5am and continued to enjoy their awesome time laughing, and talking, and I finally had to let the hotel know 30 mins in to them having fun. I get Basel everything is more expensive but a can of Ginger Ale went from $5 to 7 when by the time I left and I only stayed 2 nights! I didn't see a CVS around so I was at the mercy of $7 soda before I jumped in my uber for the airport. They have their team on text message. Mostly responsive! I did request no housekeeping which they noted and asked if I needed fresh towels which was nice. I said I'll be fine, and will let them know if I need anything else. A few hours, they sent me the same preset message. Weird. Maybe they meant to ask me if I want turn down service but I don't know and not sure if they have it. There is 2 small boxed water upon arrival in your room (NOT REPLENISHED) that comes with the $25 urban fee a night. Overpaid for the wifi and use for their gym / pool I guess. I didn't use their amenities. I get the brand is from NYC so but in Miami I always had bigger rooms for the price, so they literally brought NYC hotel rooms to FL. No closet space. Just a few hangers. They do provide a steamer but it runs out of water quick. Maybe every 2nd item I would have to refill it. Hiccup with their front desk IPAD and guest program. I gave them my email when checking in. Check out I asked to be emailed and they want me to give my email again. I didn't need the headache, I asked for a print out instead. Location - it's good within Wynwood as I wanted to explore the neighbourhood outside of my time from Art Basel.

It was a very nice hotel. Staff was excellent! Rooms are new and clean. They advertised a restaurant and it was not open for breakfast. For travelers without a car ( night before leaving on a cruise), it was not convenient. Had drinks in bar but very expensive. Plan to spend a chunk of change if having a drink or appetizer.

Seldom do I feel it compulsory to write a review but my experience with the Arlo brand has astounded me Initially I reserved this new hotel for a special pre cruise three night stay based on the hotel amenities and facilities to enjoy my partners 60th birthday After reserving I was informed that the pool facilities were limited opening times and the restaurant was not ready to be opened as it indeed was the first week of opening initially I was upset with this news however those emotions were soon diminished by what I can only describe as the most personal caring and genuine customer service I have ever experienced and I travel world wide and stay in high end five star resorts This was attributed to Drysdelle the manager whom is customer service incarnate ! She is the role model of what luxury service should be Immediately she personally engaged with me through every aspect of my stay even decorating the room with bespoke ballons champagne and a card from all the staff for my partners birthday and also empathised with my dismay and offered a substantial credit to use I was astounded that conversationally I mentioned I was feeling a little unwell one day and to my amazement I returned to the room to find a beautiful get well card and herbal tea and hot water I cannot recommend this hotel enough The pool is astounding so chic and the staff are like your own personal dedicated assistants at your every whim so welcoming without being over powering The rooms the bar area and the cocktails are beyond words It felt like a concept made up of all your dreams of perfection Please please experience this at least once Thankyou Arlo and Drysdelle you are an absolute asset to the company and as a leader in world class service for your staff to learn from although they alone are astounding we will be seeing you again very soon thankyou

I had a staycation planned with my fiancé. The stay here was great. The service was amazing and it was a beautiful property! I will be staying here again in the future and will definitely recommend to family/friends!

I chose this hotel because it was within walking distance of the Mana Wynwood center where I was attending a meeting. There were no reviews on the hotels since it had opened only a couple days before I arrived. So I was a little nervous about what things might be like. I am really glad I took a chance and stayed there! The room was wonderful-just fine for a solo business traveler, the staff was courteous and attentive, and housekeeping kept the room spotlessly clean. The hotel restaurant/bar served a beautifully prepared and tasty salad. My room did not have a conventional desk and chair, but I was able to work on my computer from the rolling table and the bench at the window. Very comfortable and more than enough. But some business travelers might want to ask about a more conventional desk set up. I would stay there again and highly recommend this hotel to others.

Everything about out stay was perfect! The hotel is gorgeous and all of the staff incredibly helpful and friendly! The door men, bell men, front desk staff, housekeeping, pool staff, bartenders, basically everyone we came across was lovely/helpful! The third floor has an outdoor bar and patio that is a magical oasis! Inside is a pool table, bar and an incredible gym sign Pelatons, water tower tons of new and top quality machines! Huge and beautiful rooftop pool! The rooms were clean and beautifully designed. We were here for a convention at the Mana Wynwood, so the location was perfect. Great restaurants nearby (1-800 Lucky was amazing!) We will definitely stay here again next time we’re in Miami. Highly recommend!

The new Arlo in Wynwood is something out of a magazine, the hotel is conveniently around all the best restaurants and bars in Wynwood you honestly don’t need to leave the area. The hotel has an amazing rooftop pool that showcases the best sunsets! The staff is very welcoming and the restaurant Mary Golds is perfect for a nice dinner date and the art displayed around the property makes for the best IG pics. There honestly isn’t a hotel in Wynwood that does it quite like them.

Fatal que su personal en front desk proporcione información confidencial, que den datos de sus huéspedes y peor aún permitan el acceso hasta la habitación a cualquier persona sin importar la seguridad de sus huéspedes, increíble que no sepan manejar situaciones así

Robinson at the front desk took great care of us and I would recommend this hotel to all who come to visit miami. It’s has a full court rev is on the roof , huge pool and cool relaxed vibe. Thank you to Robinson, Henry and the entire team for the hospitality

Excelente atención y servicio en el hotel. Todo el personal muy amable, un sitio para regresar. Las instalaciones muy limpias, la piscina hermosa, realmente agradecida con la atención en mi visita. Muchas gracias

The front desk was extremely helpful and welcoming! Maria was accommodating and made my arrival after a long overnight flight so much easier. The restaurant upstairs also has amazing food. I will definitely book here again!

We had a great experience at this hotel. Check In was Incredibly smooth. Maria M was exceptionally pleasant, helpful and accommodating. The pool is awesome. The room is roomy and clean. I would recommend this place and will be returning***

Maria was very helpful and knowledgeable. Super professional ! I recommend her to everyone. She was super nice and kind to us. She helped me with a early check in and was very patient and understanding with me thanks Maria

Mariam at the front desk was super helpful. In general the location is really good, you don’t really need a car to go around. Also the facilities are really good as well - like the pool and gym etc. You wont regret staying here

10/10 now i have to make it 200 characters but the hotel was pretty nice, other than the housekeeping walking in but overall not bad. Shower and balcony are the main sell. Private balcony with decent privacy

Hyde es mi hotel favorite en miami, me encanta las habitaciones, son amplias, comodas, y limpias, principalmente el servicio amable de las personas del lobby, principalmente la joven Maria es super amable y servicial.

Excellent Service Very friendly staff, Maria M. at the front desk made my checkin easy and gave me a excellent room. I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking to stay for business or pleasure. There is a Starbucks right next store for convenience as well. Gary.

María Medina was a amazing front desk attendant. Greets you with great energy and a sweet smile. Very helpful and kind. Helped us with all the amenities and explaining all the neighbors restaurants and activities.

This hotel was amazing. Great location and service was excellent. Still chic but family friendly. And Maria at the front desk was very helpful. I stayed her with a friend who was in town for a conference. I will definitely stay here again when I'm in town.

This is a very excellent hotel and was very clean. Great location with alot of restaurants near by. The staff was great as well. Will be staying there again. Maria M is the best and was very helpful with my stay.

Hyde Midtown Miami- I did not like the place. This place is a little worn out. . I did not like the room placement I did not like the attitude of management (not interested in fixing problems). I did not like the speed at which the valet got the car pulled up. Also if you are sensitive to smells the 5th floor smelled. Just stay away. STAY AWAY!!!!!!!!!!! 832111392 I am not sure what to say about the place. I hate writing negative reviews. We picked the hotel for location and value so we had low to reasonable expectations. Low expectations was too high a bar for this place to meet. If this was the last hotel in Miami I would rather sleep on the streets. STAY AWAY!!!!!!!

We loved the Hyde. I went with a few friends and we were on a food & drink tour of Miami. The Hyde was well positioned to get out and about and the rooms were spaces, well appointed and immaculate! The staff are lovely, especially the Manager Pierre-Alex who gave us some great pointers around town and helped with reservations. We will be back!

Great spot near to everything awesome roof terrace bar and restaurant Sajvaje. Friendly staff and clean large suites. The general manager Alex was especially accommodating and had great tips for restaurants etc in Miami. Highly recommend as weekend base for exploring Miami.

The service was great! Pool is super cute. If you’re looking to play tennis make sure to bring your own racket! Love the location of this hotel! You can walk to design district & Wynwood. & make sure to check out the restaurant on the 7th floor! Food was amazing but it gets a little loud because they perform so you decide if you’re into that or not. I liked it! The staff at the restaurant were all very nice as well! All around was it was a really great trip mostly due to Hyde midtown! Thank you to everyone we encountered at the hotel everything was great!!

Very well located in Miami to visit the different neighborhoods. Everything went smoothly from the arrival. No waiting to check in, then the room was up to my expectation, as shown on the site. Friendly and helpful staff to advice places to dine and go. I enjoyed my stay at the hotel and would come again.

Location was great service staff attentive and kind. We enjoyed the coolest restaurant and the gym amenities are awesome. Check in check and out was a breeze!!! Only thing disappointing was we didn’t have a time to stay a few more nights :)))

Esta es mi segunda vez en este estupendo hotel y mi primera opinión acerca de él. Hyde Midtown Miami es un hotel excelente en su categoría. Esta situado en una muy buena zona de Miami, donde se puede pasear, con muchos restaurantes y tiendas a su alrededor y a muy pocos minutos caminando de Wynwood y del Design District . Todo aquí es nuevo, moderno y con grandes detalles. Habitaciones silenciosas y muy amplias, con terraza, sala y pequeña cocina. La cama es comodísima, las amenities excelentes y muy variadas, la toallas esponjosas, televisión de gran tamaño. El lobby es muy bonito, muy moderno, decorado con mucho gusto, la piscina en la última planta es un gran complemento. Hemos probado el restaurante Salvaje, también en la última planta y nos encantó el servicio, el ambiente y la comida. Es nuestra segunda vez, y volveríamos s elegirlo sin dudar por todos los detalles y por su excelente relación calidad precio. Si la zona te encaja, no lo dudes, es una gran elección.

Muy buena ubicación, excelente servicio, muy buena atención de parte de Daniela Barbera, me ayudó con todo lo que necesitaba. El hotel bastante limpio, cumplió con mis espectativas. Todo espectacular 👌

Queremos agradecer todas la atenciones recibidas en el hotel, especialmente por parte de Carolina y Francisco, han sido tan profesionales, atentos y amables que se han esmerado en cada detalle para que nos sintamos como en casa. Hemos estado una semana en el hotel, desde que llegamos nos dieron un cálido recibimiento, siempre con una gran sonrisa y durante la estadía nos colmaron de atenciones, da gusto tratar con profesionales tan dedicados, solo podemos decir gracias de corazón por hacernos sentir tan bien. Destacar además la buena ubicación, el confort de las habitaciones donde dispones de todo lo necesario y la excelente limpieza, tanto de la habitación como de las diferentes zonas. Sin duda recomendamos este hotel y seguro volveremos muy pronto! Felicitaciones por tan gran trabajo!

That place have a beautiful view and good music !!!! An amazing bartender’s from Brazil especially Rosângela ! Very nice vibes! I truly recommend! The food it’s very good also and they cook churrasco front off us !

I’m taking the time to share my experience with AC Hotel by Marriott. The location and facilities of this hotel are perfect to access easily all Miami must DO places and also enjoy a stunning view on the rooftop and a calm night to recharge. The staff and design of this hotel bring a positive and chill atmosphere that we are all looking for during holidays. We had a stressful days before our stay and we ended up arriving one day before our reservation starts at night with 2 little kids. Vito found out a solution during a very very busy time before ULTRA. During the whole stay the whole staff, especially Kaytlyn and Vito were very kind with our family. I highly recommend this hotel for Miami and for all kind of stays

Stayed at the hotel Feb. 17-19th. Good hotel and would have given it 4 stars for location and also good house-keeping and breakfast/service at breakfast and bar. Stay made sour by lack of follow through by reception staff. Was charged for 2 drinks that were stated to be complimentary at the time of check-in. Was assured (By Caesar Pinto) that this charge would be credited at the time of check-out. Have called 3 times and am getting the run around. No return calls from Caesar. Am Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Member. Lack of follow-through very disappointing, and a waste of my time!

High Points: clean, good walking area for Midtown; our friendly bartender server each day was funny, polite and efficient, though he often was sitting down and never asked our names to get to know hotel guests--keep him! Low Points: severely understaffed for as booked as the hotel was; no makeup magnifying mirror; as always I wear white socks around the hardwood plastic floors to see the cleanliness factor and my socks were quickly black Unique Points: $15 breakfast is ample and includes hot items made to order (they say); extremely spacious

For the price, a great option. Convenient to most Miami locations. Rooms look newly renovated. Water pressure and amenities are top notch. (Though mounted to wall so no travel size bottles to bring home) went to rooftop deck both evenings. Got Spanish snacks (manchego and Brie cheeses, olives, prosciutto, salami) and coconut shrimp with salsa. Wine options are decent - Kim Crawford Chardonnay and a Pinot noir. (No cab though) breakfast ($15 pp) was excellent: eggs ordered the way you want, yogurt and granola and fruit, freshly squeezed Orange and apple and passion fruit juices.

Modern hotel away from hustle and bustle of Miami Beach but still close enough to the beach. We used hotel bikes to ride via Venetian Parkway (dedicated bike path) to South Beach. Nice pool area with bar and lots of comfy seating. Some good dining options a 10 minute walk by the Target store.

We were looking for a clean and modern hotel close to the art district of wynwood in downtown Miami with a roof top pool and bar . À parking and good for your wallet . Bingo . Good vibes . Delicious breakfast . Friendly and professional staff . Very convenient .

I’ll start with the positives.. $25 + till and top for Uber was a good deal. Modern finishings, great view, comfy pillows and bed. Amazing bathroom mirror to do make up. Located only 9 minute walk to target. And you get a $25 room credit to buy food or beverages. Only 2 miles to Bayside market. Picked up some good deals on Groupon and used them there. This is a great hotel. Gas station and wendys is across the street. I’d stay here again. The only negative is that the food we ordered that night made us sick. Oh and the neighborhood is a little spotty.

I stayed at multiple Marriott properties across the Miami area and I have to say that was by far my favorite. The hotel has one of the best treatments of Marriott Silver/Gold/Platinum etc members. I was upgraded to a very clean and spacious corner room and had no problem requesting the Platinum 4pm checkout even during one of the busiest weeks of the year (Art Basel) when they were sold out. On top of that they give Marriott elite members 2 free cocktails a day! They do have an amenity/destination fee like most hotels in Miami but they actually give you a food and beverage credit equal to this fee and their food is both high quality and reasonably priced. The bartenders I dealt with at both the rooftop pool and in the lobby bar were extremely friendly and helpful, and the front desk staff were great. But by far the best thing about the hotel is the help they provided in getting back some valuable and important personal items I left in my room after my stay. Firstly they phoned me to inform me they had found the items even before I realized I had left them. In many hotels, the items would have just "disappeared". On top of this, they were extremely patient and helpful in working with me to Fedex the items back to California. Overall, I cannot recommend this hotel enough.

I stay at Marriotts 100+ days a year and will always be a loyal Bonvoy Member. This trip showed me once again why I am loyal to the brand. Michelle at the hotel Lobby bar literally made our stay. I don’t know how she did it but on one of the busiest weekends of the year in Miami (due to Art Basel) she was a constant amazing host to me, my travel mates and the people that visited her bar. Overall the service was amazing from all the staff but a huge thank you to Michelle for the extra mile service. PS if you visit ask her to make her Mezcal drink with the Kiwi, you won’t be disappointed!! I would also recommend this hotel if you are traveling in the future for Art Basel it’s location in terms of the activities in Wynwood (where most of Art Basel is hosted) and the fact that it’s right next to one of the causeways to South Beach makes it ideal to navigate a weekend that is usually packed with foot and vehicle traffic!

Look I’ve stayed here twice for like 10 days each time. It’s modern, pretty rooms, quiet, and very central. Now here’s the rub: they’ve decided they don’t want to clean your room at all. They note Covid as the reasoning although how is a cleaner getting covid from cleaning an empty room? Marriott is just being cheap and using the pandemic as an excuse when you know Trump Miami no one is wearing a mask. Secondly horrible service. Literally no one is nice. Third I know this is dumb but something is wrong with their toilet seats. I’ve been to three rooms and they’re always dislodging which is a problem for obvious reasons. Also check your account after you stay here… they erroneously charges me $188 so you know this company is shady af. It’s very inexpensive to stay here and I like the design so I just swallow my problems and stay here. So you get what you pay for but yeah… if I had the choice I would not stay here.

Nice hotel with friendly front desk. Room was clean but the sofa bed was away from the wall tv so best view was from the bed instead. Nice pool on rooftop. Parking is $20/night next door at Hampton Inn. The sliding bathroom door is heavy and a bit annoying if you get your fingers caught closing it. The food choices in immediate neighborhood are fast foods. You need to walk to 36th, then 4 more blocks across train tracks to good local dining and some shopping. Overall a good stay.

Housekeeping woke us up by entering our room before 8am stating it was check out time and they needed us out to clean the room. The lady was tapping aggressively on a paper showing that days date and a check out time of 12:00pm saying “checkout” “checkout” I then argued with her that check out wasn’t until 12:00pm and even pointed at the paper she was holding and then she proceeded to say “no English” she left and then 4 other times in the next two hours came back, letting herself in to the room unannounced, trying getting us to leave again. I contacted the front desk for this concern and they were rude then and the day prior at check in. After contacting the front desk the housekeeper continued to open our door trying to enter the room and invading our privacy (my wife was in the shower, and I was getting dressed) telling us “checkout” raising her voice and getting upset with us… all this was prior to 10am when we left the hotel. By far this was the worst hotel experience I’ve had and I’m shocked that it was at a marriott property. I feel like I could have stayed somewhere else for much less and received better customer service. I have never in my life felt more disrespected by hotel staff or felt the need to report issues like this to a corporate center in my life and if I hadn’t already had other great Marriott experiences it probably would have deterred me from being a future customer.

I am a very disappointed about the General Manager never contact me since a few months after I stayed on May 8 for one night stay. I did inform to the Marriott Bonvoy Social Media Rep make sure follow up to this hotel 3 times so far. I am disappointed about the pillows are not super firmer at all. I used to be stay at another AC hotel and they do have super firm or microfiber types pillows. I did not quiet get sleep well quality because of this. I have to use 3 feather pillows to sleep with. They only did left 2 more extra feather pillows on the bed before I arrived. I also am disappointed about they do not have ADA hearing impaired device kit during my stay at all. :( I am highly recommend consider replace new blind shade due it look alike possible getting old due there are some wrinkles and strings kinda damage on the left bottom blind shade. I also am highly recommend replacement AC hotels brand new towels and wash cloths since I notice there wash cloths and towels are coming from the Marriott. The lady who was a front desk at the check out and she was not too friendly. :-( I would like to request compensation for this stay please. Thank you.

Stayed here a few months ago and called down to the concierge late that night to request the most basic of things, a comforter, because there wasn't one on the bed and there wasn't one folded up in the closet (like there normally is with other hotels that I've visited), the room got cold so I requested one, a few moments later there was a knock on the door and it was housekeeping with my "comforter" which turned out to be 3 fitted sheets because they "ran out of comforters", don't waste your money!

This AC hotel located on biscayne bay was an absolute blessing. The rates were favorable and the staff was pleasant and very accommodating. I’ve stayed in various AC hotels across the US and this one in biscayne was by far the best. This AC brought a sense of serenity to the miami experience. We welll be staying here again for certain!

From beginning to end, I truly enjoyed my stay. The associates were pleasant and helpful! This hotel is located in the heart of Miami. 5 minutes away from Midtown, Wynwood, and Bayside. Looking for somewhere nice, quiet, and pleasant to stay... this is for you! I will be returning in the near future.

El servicio fue pésimo!!! 4 veces pedí en recepción que organizaran la habitación, me fui del hotel y nadie la organizo. El baño estaba obstruido y nadie nos ayudó arreglando el tema... conclusión el servicio muy malo para un hotel con tan buenas instalaciones y ubicación.

Beyond amazing, the rooms are large and so clean - exactly as shown on the website! - A renovated Mid century modern gem that manages to feel super modern while maintaining its original charm & character… the pool area/bar (Sebastian amazing) is fab!!…front desk always super helpful esp. Linda …

This really is a hidden gem. The hotel room had been restored to a high standard in funky 1950's style. The room was very clean and the bed extremely comfortable. Management were polite and helpful and there was plenty of free car parking. Unfortunately we were only there for one night and never made use of the inviting swimming pool, although we did have a relaxing drink at the poolside bar. Again the barman, Sebastian, was very friendly and made us feel extremely welcome. We only wish that we had booked a longer stay and would not recommend this hotel more highly.

The Vagabond is a great hotel! They did a terrific job landscaping the grounds. It’s off a busy, noisy street and you would never know it when you’re at the pool. Rooms are a good size, clean, and has everything you need. There’s a restaurant attached with great coffee and pastries, and also great lunch and happy hour options.

From the reviews and the pictures, this looked like such a cute place. It is clean and roomy. There is no elevator so we had to schlep all our luggage for a week long business trip with 4 computers and multiple monitors up the stairs. The room was 85 degrees and took forever to cool off. No coffee maker or mini fridge (unless you want to rent one). Serious lack of outlets. if you plan to work in room, you better have a power strip. Bar drinks are expensive and not that good for what you get. I really wanted to like this but it fell short of my hopes.

This place is so cute and quirky. My husband and I spent the night here before cruising. Such a fun place. Wish we'd had more time to enjoy the amenities. Our room was clean and well-equipped. The staff were friendly and the hotel is a great location as far as proximity to food and drug stores. There's a bakery across the street that is to die for. My only minor complaint is that the ac unit didn't cool the entire room so the bedroom area was uncomfortably warm. Overall this place gets a solid A. Look forward to returning in the future.

Wally and May were amazing and so kind! Rare to go to a hotel that is so accommodating and clean! I’m very picky about cleanliness when I visit hotels and this is truly insanely fresh! The pool is EVERYTHING TOO

We really loved staying here in a 2 twin bed room! Juan Arias was a great guest services agent and gave us really great pointers of the area. The rooms were so exciting to stay in. The beds were super comfy and roomy, the shower actually had great pressure and was a huge walk in so it was very accessible. The pool and it’s lounging area around it was also really comfy and fun. Overall really great experience. Highly recommend if you want to get out of the typical hotel aesthetic and be close to an activity and cultural filled area.

We loved it! I’m not normally a motel person and was nervous- but this adorable retro property exceeded my expectations. It was clean, quiet, free parking and affordable, and provided great service by Juan Arias, who helped us with recommendations on what to do in the area. This is a great location with super cool interior design, right near Miami and the Design District… book it and you won’t regret it!

I’ve traveled over the years to many states and stayed in many types of lodging: hotels, resorts, B and B, Etc. I’ve been to many parts of Florida too. Having a family member who has lived in Fort Lauderdale area for many years, I have always heard what a “dump” Miami was. I should have considered the source. For my first time there, I stayed with my husband in North Miami near the road that takes you to North Beach. Our lovely hotel was the Vagabond Hotel; a reborn 50’s era vintage hotel that is a sparkling diamond in the rough. Prior to our trip, I read hundreds of reviews of many hotels in the area. I looked at photos of the hotel rooms, pools, neighborhood, Google Earth images, customer photos, and crime statistics. Over the top? Maybe, but my due diligence paid off. Reasonably priced and meticulously clean, this location did not disappoint. The pool gets sunlight from 9am until about 5:30 pm and there are plenty of lawn chairs to be had. Limited guests means no overcrowding in the pool area. There are shaded areas and umbrellas if you prefer less sun. The king size suite we reserved had a mini fridge and a shower that is big enough for 6 people- we did not try that, but I am sure of this as it is really big. Every spot of this property is well kept and has no hidden secrets. Valdi and Mary (cleaning staff) were helpful and obviously care about their work and deserve so much praise for the upkeep. Make sure to tip them - housekeeping is so often forgotten. As you sun by the pool, you might catch a glimpse of a gecko or two while you listen to the multitude of tropical birds waiting to head North. Office staff are helpful and friendly and willing to advise on the best beaching spots as well as restaurants. Thank you to Louis, Linda, and Juan for all your smiles and help. Less than a one block walk away is the East Side Diner which has the most amazing breakfast as well as customer Service. The area is obviously going through a new re-development, I am certain this BOHO place will be hard to book in the very near future! We will be back for sure! We loved Miami, the people, and the beautiful cultures that make it what it is.

I was a little nervous booking the Vagabond, I usually stay in a national chain. I couldn't be more pleased with my visit. The staff was friendly and helpful and the rooms were clean, even to my picky standards. The pool area was peaceful, I had food delivered and enjoyed the nice pool vibes for dinner. I will definitely stay again when in the area.

I needed a one night stop in Miami after coming from 3 nights staying in Key West right on Mallory Square. I had a budget for this night that was gg]reader than what I spent here. We had time and could have stayed in a different area but then I googled “Unique Hotels in Miami” and this one popped up. In the traditional sense, this is a Motel not a Hotel…but that was the fun quirky part of this to me. We’ve stayed in plenty of hotels, generic hotels in generic spots that fit specific generic purposes. This was in a location we needed but this was not generic at all. How fun! We were in room 123 pool level. As somebody that cannot walk long distances this was great for me as it was very close to the pool, restaurant and parking area on the restaurant side. The pool area looked very quirky and fun. We were not able to enjoy it but there was a bar right there and plenty of loungers about. The rooms are well designed, a bit sparse but in a 50’s/Jetsons quirky colorful way that makes it fun. No boring tan carpet with tan bedding and tan bathrooms. This is an old building. Be prepared for some things to not look perfect, 5 star etc because this is not about that although the place is CLEAN. This is about staying in a quirky throwback better than boring/average hotel. The restaurant is awesome also.

My wife and I had a recent two-night stay and we LOVED this place. Great room. Bed was super comfortable. And the staff was very friendly and attentive. The pool is great. The weather didn't cooperate, so we didn't get a chance to really experience the great pool-side bar scene. The restaurant/baked goods/bar next door was wonderful and very convenient. We stayed at 3 different hotels on this trip through Florida. This was the best. We will be back, for sure.

May and team are fantastic.. felt like we were staying with friends.. great suggestions for food, fun, and golf.. the bakery across the street is incredible.. pool was perfect, 12 min to everything.. all the reviews are legit, the neighborhood has some very good restaurants, Italian next door, and one down the street were excellent. It's not fancy, nor is it swanky, but for the price and amenities, we wouldn't stay anywhere else in Miami.. note.. car is required, unless you have unlimited Uber budget..

My fiancée and I loved the Vagabond. The room was well-designed and clean. The bed was comfortable. Even the pillows were comfortable--not horribly flat like most hotel pillows seem to be. The lush grounds were well cared for. The pool was warm and clean. The staff was helpful and friendly. There were numerous places to eat within a few blocks. Going forward, any trip to Miami will include a stay at the Vagabond.

the place is super nice and peaceful, lots of space and close to the art and design district. I loved the neighborhood as well. The food at the restaurant is outstanding and so was the service. We launched at the pool all day, the water was perfect and warm.

Where do I begin? Is it the super friendly staff or the fact that it's a hidden gem? Both! Won't stay anywhere else in miami Thanks for everyone who made our honeymoon the best of all time even though it's my 3rd marriage.

I was ready to book a stay at one of the many hotel chains, when I stumbled online to this gem. What a nice boutique hotel with midcentury tropical character. Gorgeous pool area and comfortable rooms with all the necessary amenities. The convenient onsite restaurant provides a great spot for breakfast lunch and dinner. Juan did an excellent job and really took an interest in making sure that my stay was exceptional. If I make it back to that area, I would not hesitate booking a return stay.

The team at the Vagabond Motel was very helpful. I was there for a business trip so for me it was the ideal location for work and a little play. There are several great restaurants in walking distance, Wee Wee's across the street has great pastries and excellent coffee. May and her team were excellent!

We stayed five nights at Vagabond for a wedding. The rooms, pool, and grounds are kept clean. The pool is heated and has plenty of seating for relaxing. The beds are very comfortable...very, very comfortable. The room could have used a few more towel racks or clothes hooks to hang wet or damp items but the hotel was generous with clean towels. There were tons of cafes and restaurants within a few blocks or less. We were half a hour from the airport, 15 mins from Miami beaches, and 30 mins (or less) from several Miami attractions.

Our check-in time was 3pm, but our flight arrived to MIA at 8:30am, I called to ask if they had somewhere we could leave our luggage until our check-in at 3pm, but the office manager went above and beyond and offered to let us check-in 6 hours early.. The room was clean and nicely kept. The retro design of the whole hotel made us really feel like we were in Miami, it wasn’t obnoxious or overpowering either, it was retro yet modern. Although we stayed only one night, it was a very nice experience.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Amazing and easy check in and stay Eric and jonya were absolutely wonderful. After a very, very long day of traveling, it was an incredible experience to feel the ease of this next part of the trip, extraordinary efficiency, and super helpful with the surrounding area to discover

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Stayed here for pre cruise night before and true to the Hampton brand could not have been happier. Clean room, professional staff and felt very safe. Breakfast was beyond expectation with 3 staff making sure everything was fresh and plentiful. Make sure you take advantage of the shuttle that's provided by a separate contractor and not only was reasonable but employee very courteous and professional. Thanks Staff for everything!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: “Making you happy, makes us happy.” My partner and I had an exceptional experience at this Hampton Inn location. The rooms were very comfortable; we were thrilled with the amenities, especially the guest laundry and pool; and the customer service was top-notch. But for all intents and purposes, it was Janya who was responsible for making us truly happy with our stay. She was pleasant, overly patient (because I can be a bit much), able to answer all of our travel questions, and always with a smile. Thank you Janya for an excellent couple of days.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: . The service was excellent, the location was great,wonderful breakfast very friendly workers,this will now be our place of stay when in Miami also the rooms and gym were nice and clean.we had a problem with our television upon arrival but once we called to report it, the service person tested and repaired the problem promptly

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: The rooms were cozy and very clean. The complimentary breakfast was delicious and had a variety of healthy options...which can be a scarcity when traveling. The shuttle service was so handy for getting to the ship for 10 dollars, and the drivers were so accommodating. The front counter was amazing! Her welcoming smile and positive attitude were such a breath of fresh air. She went above and beyond to make sure our stay was as enjoyable as possible. I’d recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a nice, clean, quiet hotel close to the ship.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I love this hotel, is lowkey in midtown but the place is amazing and the facilities are amazing. The staff is 5 stars, Jeanette I think thats her name from the front desk shes such an amazing person I love her lol, I’ll be back soon and I really appreciate the experience…

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: It was a great experience. The continental breakfast was very good. There was a vegetarian selection on Sunday. The room has hardwood floors which is great for those with allergies like me and my husband. The staff friendly and courteous. All around great hotel experience.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: First, the toilet stopped working. Now, I know the hotel cannot foresee that and I understand. But it was an inconvenience at 11:30pm with a 4 and 7 yr old that was just about to go to bed, but then had to move, then told I was not allowed to get any type of compensation for this. I was not expecting a free night, but anything. Then come down for breakfast at 9am and was told they were running out of food, like potatoes. Barely was able to get a waffle for my kids with eggs, sausage, juice and a banana. Go back to try and get something for myself at now 9:30am, they were already out of potatoes at 9, but now they ran out of eggs, sausage, bacon, and bananas. I've been at other hotels and I've never experienced this before. No compensation for inconvenience and running out of food, even on a busy night. This was a bad experience for me and my family. And I don't ever expect white glove cleanliness, I get it with the turnaround time, however, I do not expect leftover hair in the shower that is not mine.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Eric was super helpful at the hotel. We had a great stay and appreciate his assistance. The room was clean and comfortable and the breakfast was wonderful. The check-in was super easy. The hotel is conveniently located to downtown. We definitely stay there again

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: reservé para unos cliente porque me parecía una buena opción , solicitaron un depósitos y como el cliente llevaba un vehículo cobraron todo el deposito por parking 40 usd por noche lo cual me parece un cobro exagerado , y preciso es el valor total del deposito por noche , no lo podría volver a recomendar, perdí mi cliente y al final una mala experiencia

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Great place! Close to downtown, I was on a vaction trip and it was so handy that had near by malls, of course Wynwood art activities, close to nice restaurants,bars. Hotel was clean, the staff was kind and always attentive. Parking $40 per night but Miami is already expensive so it was kind of expected. I totally recommend it for a vacation

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Excelent! 100% recomendable, ubicación, servicios y trato del personal. Las camas inmejorables, las habitaciones impecables, el desayuno correcto y suficiente. El gimnasio y piscina no los utilizamos pero los vimos y están muy bien. Sin dudas muy buenas relación costo - beneficio Volveremos!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: The sleek feel carries from the lobby into the individual rooms, and it is located right in the heart of Wynwood. Chantel and Travis took amazing care of me through check in and recommended a fabulous place for dinner delivery! Rooftop bar at hotel next door was a fantastic feature.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: My guess is that all this five points reviews here rate the price to quality ratio involving location as a big part of it. But to summarize This is a standard 3 star hotel in a good location to explore Miami, but don’t expect 4 star rooms or premises, as all the enthusiastic reviews here may imply. It is adequate for one night but unless you’re on a budget, I would suggest other places (adjacent AC is one of them) where for 10 or 15% more per night you can find better options in the same area, and the difference may be justified if you like to feel really comfortable. But if you’re looking for just a good bed in a nice location, for a couple of nights or so, this place fits these needs

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: On May 29, 2024 my husband had eye surgery at Bascom-Palmer in Miami. That evening we stayed at the Hampton Inn Miami Wynwood. Our check-in was expeditiously done by Eric at the front desk. Eric was very polite, accommodating and knowledgeable. Our room was very clean and the beds were comfortable. I appreciated the fact that our small dog was permitted. Underground parking is conveniently located outside the entrance door. Restaurants, fast food, and shopping are within walking distance. Travis was very helpful giving me directions to the nearby pharmacy for medication. Also, Ruben was prompt to bring us a coffee pot for our room. I would highly recommend the Hampton Inn Miami Wynwood for a comfortable and pleasurable stay. Audrey Williams

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Booked via airmiles for 3 nights Arrived around 3PM and was provided a room with king bed, large LCD TV with streaming capacity, small fridge, view of pool, nice ottoman chair, clean bathroom with shower stall. Pool was very nice, a tad on small size, nice gym, and great breakfast room, with some varied items every morning, like types of eggs, cheeses, breads, etc... Close to public transit so easy to go around and walking distance from art and design districts. Very cool

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Reception amazing Rooms phenomenal Breakfast perfect Parking nice and secure but if you have a bigger vehicle it requires a bit more driving skill. Overall amazing stay. Since this place is close to downtown it gets heavy traffic but as soon as you get to your room you won’t even hear a thing.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Best HI&S for me, so far. Great breakfast rooms and staff. Great all-around staff ALL times and positions. Corn Tots were new to me! Gotta find those!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Best services ever! The hotel was nice and clean , good breakfast and friendly service. Ms. CHANTRELL was a great service provider! Thank you so much! and May God keep continuing you success! I recommend this hotel to any one that is visiting in Miami. Thank everyone for their great hospitality!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: I can’t never go wrong with this hotel Alex is very friendly customer service is 5star Bensy is top notch Angie is very nice also i love coming to this hotel the Breakfast staff is always friendly also it Home from home I will be returning back soon.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excelente la atención de todos y en especial de la señorita Corami, quien fue muy atenta y nos explicó con detalle y paciencia todos los servicios. La comida del restaurante está deliciosa también. Regresaremos sin duda a este hotel. Congratulations!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Servicio espectacular ... muy cómoda la habitación y la vista muy bella... cerca de muy buenos lugares de diversión y restaurantes... Paul del valet ... 101% calificación Servicio garantizado... super agradecido... ganaron un cliente ...👌👌👌👌

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excelente servicio de eduardo, leo, Diego y cesar, llegamos muy temprano y nos cuidaron las maletas para poder ir a pasear antes del check inn. Las instalaciones muy buenas, alberca, restaurante, alberca, cancha de tenis, cuartos. Muy bueno todo

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: La atención de Eduardo, Leo y Diego mejor imposible! Súper simpáticos, atentos y agradables. Estaban al servicio de la recepción pero de fuera y con las maletas para cuando haces el check out y fueron súper caballerosos. Volveremos seguro!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Husband and I stayed a night here to attend the UFC fight and we enjoyed our stay at the Hotel AKA Brickell! The most friendly pleasant staff here were Eduardo and Jonathan! Thank you for everything! You guys rock! Restaurants in the area were great! We stopped in at the Burgermeister which was fabulous!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I stayed at Hotel AKA Brickell from April 4th to April 6th and, unfortunately, my experience was far from what I expected. I booked a king bed with a city view through TripAdvisor, but upon arrival, I was given a room with two double beds instead. When I brought this issue to the attention of the front desk, they were dismissive and made no effort to resolve the situation—even after I showed them my reservation confirming the king bed. The hotel itself is modern, clean, and in a great location in Brickell, which makes this experience even more frustrating. I reached out to TripAdvisor for assistance, but when they attempted to contact the hotel, the staff didn’t answer calls or respond to emails. At checkout, I asked to speak with a manager. While they did apologize, they informed me that all rooms are the same price on weekends and refused to offer any credit or compensation for the inconvenience. Overall, this stay left a bad taste. The lack of customer service and unwillingness to correct a clear mistake was disappointing. I won’t be staying at this hotel again and would not recommend it to others based on my experience.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Oscar and Corami for their exceptional service at the front desk. Both were incredibly helpful, attentive, and had such a positive attitude throughout my experience. I loved the hotel and my room, I will definitely come back!!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: The staff is what makes this hotel truly amazing. I absolutely adore Leandro, the banquet captain. He remembered me immediately from last year and does everything with a passionate heart and smile. Petra is such a force-in the best way you could imagine. She faces anything thrown her way with a smile and welcoming presence. Love her. There are too many to count, but Haydee—simply incredible. Even brought a scarf to me while I was out in the wind, chilly but not saying anything about it. Such a kind gesture! Iri—so sweet and helpful Wilson—such a great help, wonderful person, all smiles, so fun to know! Randall—solves every problem quickly and happily. He’s also hilarious. Anyone I’m forgetting, they are truly awesome as well and I’m thankful for the hospitality and joy they bring to every trip!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I am wowed every time I stay here! This is such a luxurious stay from the suites, to the amenities, the food, and the service. I booked this trip for my birthday and Corami & Nicholas at the front desk were more than accommodating upon check-in to ensure I had a great stay. Hotel AKA comes with so much that you almost don't even want to leave the hotel. I love that it's also a short walk away from Brickell City Center so you can have access to more restaurants and a ton of shopping without getting a ride. This is the only hotel I book when I'm in Miami!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: La atención de Paul y César en el Valet es excelente. Voy periódicamente al hotel y siempre la mejor disposición. También destaco la atención en la recepción, muy buena. Especial cuidado de resolver cualquier inconveniente. Felicitaciones!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: The stay was great, I loved the room and spaces, the restaurant was so good. Cesar and Paul were of great help! Bilingual staff everywhere too and very nice restaurants and places to walk to close by. I would just add bags for laundy in the room. Thanks

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: My husband and I just finished to stay at the a.k.a. Brickell for my son and daughter-in-law‘s wedding.Melike Aritz the front desk manager made this an amazing experience for us. My husband just spent the last eight months having surgeries and cancer treatments, this was our first outing.Melike made sure our stay was smooth and comfortable and she helped with all of our special needs. Most importantly she made us feel welcome and she was so compassionate. We had many guests as a hotel block for the wedding and all agreed that Melike is a gem! she is highly skilled and efficient. How lucky is the AKA brand to be represented in such a way? Thank you Melike! we will come back because of you!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: What an absolutely terrible hotel, starting from initial reservation all the way through the stay. I went for a conference, so the hotel was not my choice. We had to call 3x to clarify the reservation 3 months in advance. Upon arrival, confirmed the length of stay, then confirmed it again. When I received an email stating the wrong name, then confirmed again at the front desk on the second day. Finally, on the day before departure, two of my colleagues were locked out of their rooms, so I called to confirm departure date again. Guest services hung up on me 3x and stated they couldn’t help. Finally managed to convince them that my check out was one day later, after over 45 minutes on the phone while I was trying to enjoy one day of sightseeing. On top of all that, the elevator situation is ridiculous. To get to the room, you have to go to floor 25, get out, walk down a hallway, get in another elevator, and go down to your room. The pool is down two elevators, across the street, and up a third elevator. Customer service is nonexistent, and all the employees are rude. I had to ask a housekeeper in a hallway to please clean my room on day 3, which was the only day it was cleaned during a 5 day stay. There are a ton of other options in the area. Avoid this place.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Magnífica ubicación, instalaciones, servicio y atención. Gracias en especial a Corami, Óscar y Jesse, este último de Adrift Mare, por hacer todo lo que pudieron para que nuestra estancia fuese formidable. Gracias a todos por su amabilidad

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excellent hotel! Really nice rooms good location really good restaurants pool everything was incredible but the most excellent service is valet parking Eduardo and Elijah are the best, very kind and worried to give a nice experience to everyone

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Yo estuve muy encantada con este hotel. Me trataron sumamente bien. Disfrute en mi vacacion con mi amigos. Avía muchas cosas que hacer en la área. Muchas gracias a Jonathan, Eduardo, y Leo que me ayudaron con mi Carro rental y con mis maletas que estaban un poco pesadas.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Just stayed at the aka Brickell. The checkin was simple. The staff was real friendly and patient. The location was very convenient. Definitely an Amazing stay. The valet really held it down. Thanks Eduado and Elijah. Those waters came in clutch great .............. .. ...

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
