review_text: I spent one night at the property and I had the best night sleep I've had in a while! The room was so beautiful and the view was amazing. Everything was so clean! The food is extremely good too! I will definitely go back! If you're looking for a very nice hotel, located in the heart of brickell this is the place

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: The bill was very confusing and we had to call the desk at night because we had a roach in one of our beds. I would not go back.. it was a good location but that’s it. The carpet was dirty and for the price it was not worth it! I would not go back. What else can I say.. it was very confusing trying to figure out our bill..still don’t think it was correct!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: La experiencia muy buena. Hotel nuevo en una zona animada e interesante. En recepción me trataron muy bien todos y especialmente Ivana. La habitación tenía una vistas preciosas y en todo momento me sentí cómoda. La piscina está en otro edificio pero está bien. En Google Maps aparece con otra entrada si vas en coche. Volveré, satisfecha con la experiencia :)

Pasé un muy buen fin de semana, desde el entrar al hotel es agradable por lo bien que huele y el servicio en la recepción. La habitación bien limpia y nítida. Las camas muy cómodas. En general un servicio de calidad.

Llegue a las 4:30 de la mañana y sin importar la hora fueron sumamente amables y serviciales conmigo. No me arrepiento de haberme quedado ya que es bastante céntrico, cómodo, tranquilo y a la hora de dormir no hay ruidos. Las habitaciones muy limpias, ordenadas y no hizo falta pedir nada en el mostrador. Espero regresar pronto a hospedarme y disfrutar !

Excelente servicio del personal, la ubicación es ideal para personas con vuelos al siguiente día, estacionamiento seguro, desayuno buffet conveniente. El acceso al transporte al aeropuerto es 24 horas y el personal muy servicial

No me gustó....atención del mesón de entrada mala....habitación cln mal olor.....a humedad. Hotel viejo...utilizado para pasajeros de cruceros...mal restaurant...barrió sin nada cerca...solo 1 restaurant....no volvería por ningún motivo.

We booked a one-night stay due to an airport layover; waited about 12 minutes for the shuttle, and checked in around 9 pm. The desk clerk was so warm, attentive, and efficient. We wanted to print out boarding passes for the next day, and she graciously steered us to their computer/printer room. We accomplished that task with ease. We were very impressed with the cleanliness, the security measures, the quiet room, comfortable bedding, plenty of towels, etc. Check out the next morning was equally easy, and the shuttle returned us to the airport at 5 am. Although our stay was brief, we could not have been more pleased that we had ended up at the Sonesta Miami Airport hotel.

We stayed here due to American Airlines putting us up for the night due to a missed connecting flight. If we had a choice we would have stayed somewhere else. We were placed in a room by the elevators. You hear the noise of the elevator all night long. It is horrible! We had a friend in the bathroom too- a wasp! The people that work here are miserable and rude. The breakfast buffet is a total joke. Especially to charge $21!!!!! It is the worse buffet I have eaten at. Fruit looks old. Choices are slim. If American Airlines gives you the choice of Sheraton or Sonesta- choose Sheraton. The only business this place gets is from the airlines bumping passengers. Stay away!

We stayed for one night between flights. The shuttle back and forth from/to the airport is great. The rooms were clean and comfortable. Service was very good. I received multiple texts making sure we were happy and asking if anything was needed. This is a great place when you need a night near the airport.

It was during a flight cancellation we got this hotel, nice clean big rooms, easy access, non smoking was the good feature for Miami hotels Fresh towels Good bathing accessories were there Would call it good experience

Great experience...especially the very helpful front desk and especially Franceina! She was able to accomodate our early access to our room, and stored the luggage until the room was ready! Will stay thereagain!

No lo recomiendo. Nos deben $250 del depósito, no quieren devolvernos el dinero, solo excusas. Son deshonestos y muy mal servicio. They owe us $250 of the deposit, they don't want to give us the money back, just excuses. They are dishonest and very poor service. I don't recommend

NO recomiendo este hotel, tengan cuidado porque hacen el rebajo del depósito y luego no quieren devolverlo, les hemos escrito varias veces para que nos devuelvan nuestro dinero y solo excusas. Son deshonestos! Nos deben $250 y no quieren reembolsarnos. I do not recommend this hotel, be careful because they charged in our card the deposit and now they do not want to return it, we have written several times to get our money back and only excuses. They are dishonest! They owe us $250 and they don't want to give it back.

Excelente atención de Gustavo y Fátima,muchas gracias! Muy bueno hotel, cómodo, accesible, bien ubicado. Espero volver pronto y disfrutarlo por más tiempo. Ya que está vez solo estaba de paso. Por esta hermosa Ciudad.

Impecable servicio y atención de Gustavo y Fátima. Siempre muy atentos y con mucha disposición para ayudar al huésped. Muy bueno el desayuno! Sobre todo los waffles! Excelente servicio chicos!!!!!!!!!

Nos hospedamos con mi familia en sonesta, la atención de fatima en el restaurante fue increíble! Nos encantó sus servicios y su amabilidad, definitivamente volveríamos y pediriamos por ella en el restaurante

Muy buena atención gracias Fatima por ser una excelente persona y tener tan buena atención y tratar a todos como familia y lo haces sentir muy bien con ganas d3 volver y repetir la experiencia gracias

Un hotel muy hermoso , la vista desde que llegas es fascinante , y la atención es de 10 , me gusto mucho el lobby y la manera de atender de los muchachos de recepción, la verdad que lo recomiendo mucho además de estar muy céntrico y tener una habitaciones muy cómodas

Hacia mucho tiempo no me sentía tan relajada en un hotel 😂 desde que llegas la atención de los muchachos del from desk es súper amable y dispuestos a ayudarte en lo que sea , las habitaciones son muy amplias y con camas muy cómodas y limpias , definitivamente es un hotel que vale la pena visitar

Un hotel muy bello y la atención de la recepción es impecable, definitivamente lo recomiendo mil veces , eso sin contar que las habitaciones son super cómodas , y la ubicación es muy buena pq tienes muy cerca la calle 8 y cientos de lugares muy interesante

Estuve hospedada la noche del 11 sept en el hotel por conexión de vuelo. Perdí mis lentes multifocales en la habitación y estuve llamando sin suerte para confirmar que los habia dejado en el hotel. Ya que justo Volvía a los 2 días a Miami y aproveché de ir al hotel para salir de dudas. Conocí a Dyron Epstein el manager de Alimentos y Bebidas quien con un EXCELENTE TRATO!! me atendió. Fue personalmente a buscar en todos los paquetes de cosas perdidas, pero no hubo suerte ese día tampoco. Finalmente aparecieron pero yo ya había viajado a Jamaica. Me comuniqué via correo con Dyron y él se encargó de coordinar que me los lleven al aeropuerto para poder recogerlos a mi regreso de Jamaica en conexión hacia Lima. Así fue que el Manager de Front Desk, AGSEL CORREDERA, me los llevó personalmente al aeropuerto en su camioneta a pesar de ser su día de descanso. Me los entregó en mis manos directamente… un éxito!!! Estoy super agradecida con AMBOS!! Un servicio excelente!! Y muy contenta con mis lentes :)

Desde la havana chica y el pueblo colonial de coral gables. Este lugar ha sido maravilloso para nosotras. El personal del Hotel siempre muy atento y dedicado, me huviese encantado quedarme mas tiempo. Al igual que a mi hija. Nos ha encantado el lugar.

OMG, this is a very nice place and the customer service provided by Ms Sheresse was top notch. She was really attentive and very knowledgeable. I will recommend the place and visit again and again. ASK FOR MS SHERESSE.

This hotel is great. It is new, great location in Wynwood, next to Design District and a shirt Uber ride away from Miami Beach . The rooftop pool and gym are great. The rooms are very clean and comfortable. The hotel was very busy when I was there and I really appreciate the front desk staff taking time to give me great local recommendations. Sam at the front desk was especially helpful . she gave us some amazing restaurant suggestions and us all the ins and outs of Miami.

We booked the hotel because of the location and proxitity to Midtown and the Design District and on the part it was great. The room was very comfortable. After the second day, we were told that the rooms are cleaned and serviced only after the 3-4 day, so basicaly in a 3 day stay, the room was never cleaned. We requested some packages delived to the hotel from amazon, and when i went to pick them up, the told me that there was a charge for receiving packages, and it was not a small charge. I have stayed at AC and many other Marriot Properties before and was never charged for this, so that was not something i apreciated and it was never writen in any of the reservation confirmations. In summary, its a nice hotel, with a good location, but service wise, needs to improve.

Nice to have more options in Midtown Miami, just a few blocks from the Design District. Typical AC brand property from Marriott with modern, functional rooms. Really nice rooftop with pool and good views of the city. Jay at the front desk was especially helpful during our stay.

This year for my birthday I chose to have a nice staycation and the staff at the AC really made my stay one for the books. When I arrived I didn't know my friends sent a lovely package from Salty Donut for me and after checking in, Sabrina and Quanzell gave me the box and card complete with a Happy Birthday song (the Stevie Wonder version). This type of care and customer service is unmatched and truly warmed my heart. They were extremely hospitable and kicked off my stay phenomenally. When I got to my room it was pristine and a great ambience for a relaxing weekend. This hotel is in a great spot because it's not too far from any major Miami attractions and it's also right next to one of my favorite spots, Lagniappe which has great music, food, and vibes, so I couldn't ask for much more. The rooftop was lovely and my cocktails were great! I'd definitely recommend staying here, and will most definitely consider staying again,

The hotel is fine. Rooms are clean. Staff is usually around. It’s a very limited service hotel. Even though Marriott says they offer valet parking, it’s definitely self park (and they charge more than they say they will). It’s pretty tacky actually—in order to find a place to park you need to drive upstairs two floors passing a line of parking spots reserved for the hotel’s general manager and staff who you’ll never actually see. They don’t offer any Marriott Elite benefits, even after asking. Late checkout? No! Bonus or food credit at check in? No! I’ve had a back and forth with Marriott regarding an elite benefit guarantee claim. Multiple times they’ve told me management would reach out and multiple times they’ve failed to do so. I’ve been back to Miami a few times since this stay and chose better hotels. Do the same.

We recently stayed at the hotel for a girls weekend. The rooms are very nice, stylish and clean. The pool is everything! But, there was an armed robbery outside the hotel and they staff were very relaxed about it. We were trying to leave at 5am for the airport but police barricades didn’t allow for that because they were looking for suspect. No guests were permitted to leave or enter for 2 hours. The part that upset me is that the staff didn’t alert any guests considering our safety was at risk. As I asked questions that didn’t provide any information, reconciliation or simple contrition for the situation. No nothing. When were able to leave they said nothing. No thanks for staying, we’re sorry for the inconvenience—nothing. I was just expecting better customer service or protocol when guests safety is involved. I’ll end by saying crime is up everywhere. My issue was the lack of communication and customer service considering I nearly missed my flight due to the hold up.

Loyalty to this site does not matter. Spending thousands of dollars to this site (during a pandemic) does not matter. My wife's flight got cancelled due to the nation-wide snowstorm that impacted the US on 2/1-2/2. I messaged the hotel (via their app)in the morning notifying them we needed to extend the stay by a night. The person on the other side said they can extend the stay and to just swing by the front desk. My wife does just that and they give her a hard time. Luckily I was able to fly out the day before, but unfortunately my wife's flight was later. Rather than being sympathetic and understanding, the hotel was rude, combative and would not help my wife. Being an Ambassador member I would think my status has some pull, but again this hotel does not care about guests, their comfort or helping in any way. My wife called me sobbing stating the hotel would not let her use OUR CC with the SAME LAST NAME (funny because she used it twice before BY HERSELF with no issue). I told her to calm down and she explained that she had to check out due to the staff not being willing to help her out. My wife is not an American and English is her second language, this is obvious. I called the hotel to confirm they were not completely sold out of rooms, rather than giving a simple answer the woman went on this tangent about how they are sold out of king but not queens. Not sure when I asked about a king vs queen room, but that set the pace for the convo. Confirmed with her they were not sold out and she finally said "no". Then asked her why my wife wasn't allowed to extend her stay and the woman replied because we used our LOYALTY points, we would need to use the app or call the ambassador hotline. Imagine being told this in a language you don't speak fluently. I can understand my wife's confusion and embarrassment. I give my wife OUR MARRIOTT CC for situations such as these. out of my 76 nights spend in hotels during COVID not once has my wife had an issue checking in with OUR CC. Even at this location. But these people rather than helping her, or calling me or suggesting her to call me, they make her feel stupid and then have the audacity to argue with me that us having the SAME LAST NAME does not allow her to use my CC. I would imagine MILLIONS of married people would whole heartily disagree with that ignorant statement. If that were true CC companies would not make as much money as they do. So the woman Kate (what she claimed her name was) did not offer an apology, was argumentative, rude and frankly a disgusting human being with the lack of sympathy for someone who is asking for help and belittled rather than helped. You'd think during a pandemic people would have a little more compassion than, "we can't allow you to use that CC". I'm glad my project for work is wrapping up soon so I don't have to subjugate my wife to something that humiliating again. I guess when you're loyal to a company who sees people for $$ amounts vs humans expect to be treated like dirt. Don't worry, we will never be back to your location again and I'll make sure to tell friends, family and my extensive network of business colleagues not to use your location for traveling purposes ever again. Saying these people should be ashamed of themselves is an understatement, they truly need to find another line of work, HOSPITALITY is not something Kate and JH are meant to be in.

Thank you all for the great stay, very clean and excellent property, and good service. I would highly recommend this property and would come again. I think the AC brand seems compelling and haven't stayed at one before now but am impressed.

TERRIBLE service (they blame it on Covid regulations) BUT they dont make your room or help you in ANY way.... DONT stay here you will be paying to be treated like an unwanted family member that visit too often... the room is the size of a matchbox

We recently stayed here Labor Day weekend. The rooms were clean and cozy. There were lots of people in the pool so we didn’t go in but it was a nice pool and you could see the city from the roof view. The gym is located on the rooftop as well. Parking was cheaper then most hotels so that was a plus. If you’re looking for a quiet stay away from beach this is it.

I have been in this hotel for about a month now, the stay literally go out of their way to make sure I'm comfortable. I have stayed in many places and never gotten service this excellent. They are friendly, and very professional. The front desk staff and day time manager are my favorite. The rooms are beautiful, bathroom has the perfect vanity / lighting. It's very safe you need a key to get into the hotel and elevators, rooftop is very cute, and the lobby / elevators always smell great. I suggested this hotel to my friends who were visiting and they also loved it and said they will be back. The thing ill miss most about this place is the staff.

I love the concept of AC hotels. They are modern and minimalist spaces with sufficient creature comforts. I have been to the one in Tampa which is beautiful and the staff went above and beyond. The Miami midtown AC is brand new and is similarly designed and furnished like the Tampa one. However, that is where all similarities end. My 1st impression of the hotel was a poor one due to the unprofessionalism of the front desk personnel. While checking in, I inquired if my status as a Marriott Gold member entitled me to a free breakfast. At the Tampa one, I was provided with vouchers to try out the onsite restaurant. The gentleman dealing with me politely answered no. Shockingly, his female coworker next to him who overheard our interaction, laughed and said to him, "They are asking for a free breakfast." I was very shocked at the interaction and in hindsight wished I addressed it on the spot. Since it was a 1 night stay before my cruise, we were provided with a room that barely had a view. This didn't matter to me since we were only there for 1 night. However, I have to agree with other reviewers that the sound proofing in this hotel is one of the poorest. If you are a light sleeper, find another hotel. I can hear people talking in the hallways, the operation of the elevator, slamming of doors and would you believe it people swimming on the rooftop pool. Laying on the headboard of the beds, I felt the vibrations of doors slamming almost every 5 minutes during high traffic hours. It doesn't help that this hotel is close to the trendy Wynwood district. Therefore the crowd that prefers this hotel is definitely more into the night life so peak hours are during dinner time to early morning hours. The hotel is close to various fastfood chains like Taco Bell and McDonalds. If you are a heavy sleeper, couples or young single partiers, this is the hotel for you. I will not recommend this hotel for business travelers, families and especially not for light sleepers (you will not be getting any sleep).

The hotel is very new, so all the rooms are in amazing condition. It was quiet at night, even though we were on the 2nd floor. We arrived earlier than check in and were able get a room. That's amazing service. The pool deck is also really nice and although the hotel isn't a high rise, there's still a great view of the bay. The location is also phenomenal - ten minutes walk from Wynwood and the Design District. 17 minutes by car from Miami airport. 20 to Calle Ocho. Will definitely stay there again.

Here you have a hotel built on a very busy street but the sound insulation is very poor. The architecture should have done a better job here as its very new. Cost saving put before guest needs. Whats worse is the staff told me I was getting a quiet room. Nice pool area. Breakfast very average. Valet service very slow.

Ok so boom, booked this hotel, my card thought it was fraud 💵😠.. had to pay for room or was told I’d get put out .. explained situation to staff who was all very nice but didn’t really care just wanted payment for room (i get it nothing in life is free) however even i tell you RASHAD went above and beyond helping me out, even talked to my Bank, let me use his phone charger and was MAJORLY understanding .. it’s the kind of service you dream of but rarely get. Well with him i got it! Side note: Mario was very kind too and seemed to really relate Room was cute, spacious, a gorgeous view and a comfortable bed. Very clean and quiet . Also only 7 floors so it’s a nice size hotel but not overly large. Trendy and in a cute location close to the art deco area and brickell ..

This past weekend my husband surprised me with a early Valentine’s Day weekend . We are from Miami and love visiting hotels throughout the year for our staycations . We Arrived to this hotel 2 hours early before our check in and we were greeted with smiles , and the most friendliest staff we have ever encountered. Meeting Julian was a breathe of fresh air .. he was the most hospitable and most accommodating hotel staffer. Julian we love you and thank you for making our stay a memorable one ! See you soon ! Mario, thank you as well!! Jesus at the roof top bar - amazing ! Wess- It was a pleasure meeting you ! Overall this hotel is new , clean and the staff is very very nice and very helpful ! See you guys soon !!! Vivianne and rolando rodriguez

Christian y Fabrice eran extraordinarios ayudándome con todo lo que hacían. Desde dándome la bienvenida, hasta llevándose el equipaje para al cuarto en una manera rápido y efectiva. Cada vez que ordenaba el auto, ellos estaban ya listo con el de una manera tan rápida para atenderme que estaban más rápido que yo en lo que yo bajaba hasta el primer piso de la habitación. Sinceramente, era el mejor servicio de Valet de mi vida. Espero regresar pronto para quedarme.

We had a 5 and a half hour train delay which got us to the hotel at midnight. Check in was strange. I had already checked in by mobile app, handed the gentleman at the front desk my ID and credit card but it still seemed like there was an issue. It was resolved straight away and we headed for a drink at the bar. Feeling like we were FINALLY on vacation. The 2 drinks pictured, glasses not even full, came to $36. That's outrageous but it is Miami. We orderd one more drink, the total check coming to $54. For THREE DRINKS. Then I noticed the check. They INCLUDE 18% service charge but the bartender doesn't tell you. When I said "Is the tip included?" He said "OH yes, 'they' do that". Like it was a revelation. I don't take kindly to this. The lady sitting next to me said "So I've been double tipping for 2 days??" Obviously, you need to check your bill, but the bartender SHOULD BRING IT TO YOUR ATTENTION. These kinds of shenanigans make me stay somewhere else next time. Never again here.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: First time and WILL NOT RETURN. If you're looking for a cold and modern building managed as a hotel, then this is the one. Far away from a warm, friendly and quality service oriented place. There are many options around that will be grateful to welcome and host you. Pamper yourself without letting other think they do!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Wonderful service from our CSM and the Banquets team. The food was delicious and they were flexible with all our last minute changes and requests. I would happily host another group at this property in the future. Very hardworking banquet/events team!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Great location with wonderful service. Meeting spaces and lounges were perfect. Restaurant and roof top pool! Very convenient to all things Miami. Would recommend for business or pleasure. Ask for Raphael at the main desk - He is very helpful.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Stayed at this hotel last weekend and everything was A+. Staff was very friendly and super attentive. Their restaurant was amazing. Valet was on point, once you order your vehicle from the room they will have your vehicle up front by the time you get to the lobby. If you are looking for a hotel to stay at in Brickell AKA is the way to go.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Sophia nos recibió y atendió de forma eficiente, amable y resolutiva Un 10 La habitación preciosa , la vista espectacular!! Está cerca de todo!! Vinimos por un día, pero repetiremos la experiencia!! Muy recomendable!! Volveremos Cerca de lo lindo del dawn town !!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Lovely hotel, upscale, fancy and with a lot of quality in the rooms… the service y amazing, personnel is warm. I would definitely repeat. Paul @ the Valet is great, service oriented and always smiling!!! The bar is good, drinks are really well made.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I had my baby shower at Adrift Amare and it was absolutely a great experience. Anne Laure was my event coordinator and she was extremely helpful through the whole process. Tiffani processed payments and was clear on all the payments posted to my account. Anne Laure reached out to my outside party vendors which was one less step for me. My husband showed up to the event with some friends and Anne Laure asked the Chef to accommodate some dishes for them since the restaurant was closed for summer. She was so accommodating from the start to the end. Thank you for making my baby shower so memorable.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: The location is convenient, the room was really comfortable and clean. The best of the hotel was the service from all the staff, they are nice and willing to help. Thanks Eduardo and Elijah and all the valet parking staff for your amazing service.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: FELICITO A OS.CAR CHAPITAL., EXCELENTE SERVIVIO., ACTITUD DE 100% y MUY PROFESIONAL., OJALA DURE MUCHO EN ESTE HOREL., FASCINADAS CON OSCAR., LA HAB MUY BUENA Y EL HOTELMARAVILLOSO., VOLVEREMOS MUY PRONTO!!! YA NO TENGO NADA MAS QUE DECUR., GRACIAS GRACIAS GRACIAS

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Nos encantó el hotel. El servicio fue fenomenal, desde Leo abriendo la puerta con una gran sonrisa, hasta Dulce y Sergio en la reception. Dulce nos registró con una sobredosis de dulzura y amabilidad que nos hizo sentir como en casa. La habitación era perfecta. El restaurante estaba bien, la comida era buena, pero el servicio era muy lento. Definitivamente nos alojaremos aquí de nuevo en la próxima temporada de cruceros, el hotel está muy cerca de la terminal.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Es un lindo hotel, bien ubicado con habitaciones cómodas y espaciosa con todos los insumos. Cama extra cómoda. Buenas almohadas y ropa blanca. El inconveniente del ascensor (hay que cambiar para llegar a la habitación) no es grave porque son 3 elevadores muy dinámicos. El piso 25 ha quedado hermoso y muy disfrutable!! El personal muy amable especialmente el señor Luis, encargado de recibir los paquetes quien actuó de forma extremadamente profesional, buscando solucionar los problemas . Un agradecimiento especial para el.!! (por favor hacérselo llegar!!) La excepción fue la señora que estaba en recepción hoy jueves 6 a la mañana que realmente nos trató de una manera grosera y poco profesional..Una pena.. Muchos buenos restaurantes en la zona. Es una buena opción!!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: El hotel está ubicado en el sector financiero, muy buena ubicación, es perfecto para ir caminando a Brickell Centre, restaurants, farmacias, etc. El hotel es muy lindo, cómodo, habitaciones cómodas y con linda vista. Atención del personal increíble: Raphael en recepción, Paul en Valet Parking y Jessie en el sector de restaurant, amables al 100% La única observación que le haría es más variedad en el desayuno, sobre todo para los niños tener más opciones sería muy buena idea (jamón, queso, etc.)

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: La estadía fue perfecta. Super limpio, huele divino. Lujoso. La habitación es amplia y lo tiene todo. El trato del personal fue de primera. Es cerca de todo pero alejado del bullicio. Lo recomiendo sin duda alguna. Es mi hogar en Brickell!!!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Paul - Cesar muy atentos, excelente atención. . . . . Excelente atención muy buena la gente, buenas habitaciones y el servicio de botones de los mejores que he experimentado. De lo mejor que he estado en Miami y en estados unidos me encantó todo

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: we had a wonderful trip. It was overall a great experience hassel free tranfers and site visits and required updates were done on the go without any questions asked It was a trip filled with memories. They used to respond to our queries on time.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: As a participant in the Transform Solarwinds partner program work sessions that took place for three days at the AKA Hotel Brickell Miami; I was able to feel the impressive and phenomenal service of the Banquets team that assisted us; particularly LEANDRO is beyond any expectation, always friendly, helpful and very attentive. Thank you Leandro for making our time count every day when with a fun and different musical touch you reminded us of the start or resumption of each session.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: El hotel es tranquilo, cuenta con un buen ambiente, es limpio y su atención impecable. La atención en especial el Valet Parking con Alexis, Eduardo y Leonel. Muy bien ubicado!! Una excelente opción a la hora de escoger en esta zona algún sitio para hospedarse…

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Had exceptional service from the valet staff. Eduardo, Alexis and Leonel were very welcoming and made our arrival and departure a pleasant experience. We are especially grateful to Eduardo’s professionalism and thoughtfulness to guest’s needs. We had a flat tire on our departure day and Eduardo went out of his way to help us to temporarily drive our car to replace our tire. We were so touched by his genuine desire to be helpful. Thank you so much. We love AkA BRICKELL. See you soon. Monica and Arthur Kingsbury Sarasota FL

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: My name is Martin and I visited Miami last week, I stayed with my friends at the AKA Hotel in Miami a very unique Hotel in the center of Miami, everything was excellent, but when I left, I asked one of the VALETs named Eduardo for a yellow taxi and called a car that had parked on the ramp a Toyota Highlander without signs. It seemed like he and the driver already knew each other and had an agreement. That guy asked me to pay $80 in cash when I arrived at the Miami Airport. I felt robbed and it doesn't seem fair that so much money for such a short trip considering that the yellow taxi from the airport to the hotel only cost me $40. Very dishonest, I only recommend taking a yellow taxi or asking for a price before getting in. Be careful with this valet who seems quite friendly.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Paul at the Valet station was terrific First person you meet when arriving Helpful without being pushy Knowledgeable about hotel and area He helped us find out any information we neede Always a delight when I needed to get my car Really a great guy an asset to the hotel.

The Hotel is dirty. Corridors are filthy, and when requesting for cleaning of room - which surely should be fine regardless - they made my bed only! Left the room uncleaned and had to request for additional cups, toilet roll, etc. Pretty basic. Won’t be staying again.

Great service from beginning to end!!! Very welcoming at the hotel desk. The pool and garden Amazing! Beautiful setting! Rooms are super clean! Whenever we needed towels or ice etc……. hotel staff arrived extremely fast. Awesome sunset views… Fantastic hood with all the restaurants, bars, and cafes. Miami Design District steps away which was so nice to see. Definitely a 5 Star vibe at Hyde!!!! Highly recommend to anyone who loves high class and service!!! Jim

Hyde Midtown Miami is a gem! Clean, rooms, friendly customer service, great location, modern design with chic flair. What more could you ask for? My experience was nothing short of impeccable, and I will absolutely be staying here on future trips to Miami. Thank you to the staff and team at Hyde Midtown Miami for making my stay a comfortable one!

Stayed here with my wife and son before catching our flight the next morning. Great service and friendly front desk staff that really make you feel at home. The hotel is well located in Midtown Miami with many good restaurants only a few blocks away. We also enjoyed the relaxing rooftop pool after our long drive from Orlando. We were glad to be away from the noise on Collins Ave. I definitely recommend this hotel for a quick stay.

Antes de regresar al College decidí pasar un fin de semanas en Miami con un amigo. Reservé una habitación en Hyde Midtown a último minuto. La ubicación de este hotel en Midtown era perfecta, a solo unos minutos de Wynwood y del Design district . El personal de recepción fue muy amable. ¡Un agradecimiento especial a Candy y Alain! Suites limpias, espaciosas y cómodas. Sin duda volveré a este hotel en un futuro cercano

We booked for a night on a spontaneous trip to Miami since some friends were in town. Since we just got married on Monday they upgraded our room for free. It had everything you could possibly need. An AMAZING view and an extremely comfy bed. Service was perfect and they valet your car and everything. I’d recommend this hotel to everyone!

I enjoyed my brief stay at the Hyde Hotel, wish I could have stayed longer to enjoy the area more. The suite was cozy, and the front desk staff were helpful and friendly. The location is great with a small neighborhood feel within the big city. Would definitely come back!

Hotel was a good location, rooms were decent. The service and front desk is absolutely horrendous. We used a 3rd party booking site which paid for the room and taxes. After my check-out, the hotel charged my card for the full room rate, taxes, and parking after confirming with the front desk (Stephanie) that were would be no further charges on my account. They charged my card for the full amount without informing me, even though they had my printed 3rd party booking reservation which shows that I have already paid. After numerous calls to the hotel (they never answer their calls) and about 10 days after the charge, I finally got hold of someone named Candy Lemos - She informed me that there was a misunderstanding and she would credit back my card. About 1 month later - They charge my card again (once again without informing me or speaking to me on what these charges are for). Once again, I have to reach out to the hotel and after numerous attempts (once again, hotel does not answer their phones) - I finally got ahold of Alan (very rude "manager") - who explained that they charged my card for the facility fees and taxes (which I'm fine with, if I was informed on the charges and do not have to jump through hoops to get a real answer on the charges). Mr. Alan mentioned that "It's not us that do the charges, it's our accounting department" -- From a customer standpoint, it does not matter if its you (Alan) personally or if it's your accounting department that makes the charges, at the end of the day - it's the Hyde Hotel as a whole. Save your money, time and the hassle and look somewhere else for a hotel, there's plenty of other options that provide better customer service and have the courtesy to inform their guests before randomly charging their credit cards.

The instalations looks great and well located. But the service of the hotel its defficient. Imagine you in a hotel (not cheap), that you need ask for almost everything. To clean your room you have to go personally to front desk and ask for the service. To replenish soap, paper, sugar, coffee and everything you need you have to ask for and wait until they can... And do this for portions. I wrote a valuation of this situacion 4 days back and still nobody have contact me... The rooms in front of the street are very noysi and the balcon is full of dust.. They do not clean it. When you arrives, few information about services. No restaurant available...

Where do I begin? Micky mouse operation .its a shambles !!!!!!! They have no house keeping staff on duty . 😕 if you want to get your room cleaned you have to request between 10.00 am to 2.00 pm .we stayed here 4 nights and 3 days and not once did we have our room cleaned . You do not want to out on a schedule when you are on holiday. But I made an effort of getting up early one of the days and called the receptionist to organise the housekeeper for my room and I reminded them 3 times but I was shell shocked when I came back to a messy room with 2 toddlers and being heavily pregnant with my 3rd child. So the night manager gave us a so called cleaned room as he didn't have house keeping staff at night . We check in to that new room and guess what that room hasn't been cleaned properly either . The toilet seat was as if an animal has been using it. Even the previous bin bag wasn't changed ,will attache the photos I took as soon as we checked in . I can go on and on and on . Please do not bother with this atrocities place .

The place is good, with great service. Unfortunately, the Internet Connection/Wifi is slow in public areas. The 5mbps is way too much slower. Please see attached screenshot of the speed test for your reference.

everything was perfect and very nice staff , responsive and trying to help on every request. The room is spacious , the hotel is well located surrounded by very good restaurants. the pool is large and clean.

I stayed at the Hyde Midtown for one night over the past weekend and have to say that I had an all around awesome experience. I only had booked a suite and although the room was very nice, it didn't have a balcony as I had expected it to from pictures that were shown while booking through the AMEX platform. I decided to call the front desk and see if they could help me, and although it wasn't their fault, one of the managers (Tomas Duggan) not only found me a room with a balcony but upgraded me to a suite! The room was beautiful and made the experience so much better. The rest of the staff members were very friendly as well. Would definitely stay at this hotel again.

This was my second time in for a business trip in Miami. The first round was definitely nothing compared to this one. I was greeted with such kindness by Stephanie. She welcomed me and made me feel like I was at home. Everyone had a smile on their face and that isn’t always easy to get during this time! So it is extremely appreciated. The room itself was incredible. Great amenities, great location, BEST BALCONY EVER!! Highly recommend if you’re in town.

The staff, specially Stephanie, was really really nice to us. The suites are awesome and if you are in one with the park view, it totally pays off. The location is awesome because is not full of tourists, there are more locals. A lot of nice restaurants nearby.

The customer service was outstanding, the room was very comfortable and clean. The bed was perfect, the view was perfect... everything was perfect. This hotel was more like an apartment, the treated us more like family then guest. The 3 women that were there during my whole stay, were very nice and had excellent customer service skills. I have absolutely no complaints about this place and I will be returning soon! Even during Covid the staff made sure we were well taken care of. Thank you, Hyde Suites Midtown! Job well done!!

Literally, everything is great! The staff are wonderful, thoughtful, and kind. The check-in experience was efficient and quick. I really appreciate all of the covid-19 safety and mitigation strategies the hotel uses to keep us all safe and I def felt that. Honestly, I stay here almost every single time I come to Miami because I know that I will have a wonderful experience and I’m glad that not even a pandemic could impact the highest quality of service they offer. I highly recommend it! Also, shout out to to the two Stephanie’s who helped me out during my stay, made helpful recommendations for dinner, and just showed up with a spirit and went of excellence! So stay here! Totally worth it!

The service was impeccable from the time I arrived to the time I left. The Front desk Manager Candy and her staff were as accomdodating or more than any 5 star resort. I arrived on a red-eye from the West Coast and asked if i could check in earlier because I had called and requested it. I also offered to pay an extra fee if they could accomodate me. Not only was I able to check in, I was offered an upgrade.After checking in, I got to me room which was quite spacious , basically a one bedroom apartment impeccably designed with top notch bedding. ( Im still trying to buy the same pillows) As I was unpacking, I had a knock at my door and they had brought me welcoming chocolates and asked me if I needed more hangers and almost immediately the hangers arrived. I was there for 4 nights and every time I passed any of the staff or front desk, they always said hello and front desk actually remembered my name. I was also greated by the the Hotel manager Tomas who texted me welcoming me and then greeted me at the front desk as well. This gentleman truly nows the meaning of class and hospitality and operates a top notch hotel worthy of 5 stars. Although I am familar with Miami Beach, I had only heard about midtown area of Miami. The staff and Tomas were more than happy to recomend some great restaurants in the area which were all amazing. The hottest shopping in Miami is in the design district only a few walking blocks away rivalling Rodeo Drive and Worth Avenue I assure. you. There are also many amazing restaurants there too as well and I loved the staying in this area even though there was no beach. However, for the record, the pool is huge , great hot tub and the gym is quite large with all types of equipment and very clean. I cannot remember the last time I felt so welcomed in a hotel. This hotel and its staff delivers in every way and I look forward to going back and staying there again. I highly recommend staying even though I wish I could keep it a secret if you know what I mean.

It has been a week after returning home from the Hyde Midtown and I have been missing it ever since. My family and I stayed at the Hyde for 7 nights and enjoyed every minute. We came from an AirB&B which was not as expected and needed plan B. Tomas surely came to the rescue! Every aspect about our stay deserves a 5-star rating. The staff’s friendliness and ability to accommodate our needs was exceptional. In terms of COVID, we felt incredibly safe and never once had to question anyone’s mask-wearing and or sanitizing rules. On the pool deck, the chairs were spread out, clean towels, and water was perfect temp. Our Suite has a sink, a great size fridge and a microwave. The balcony overlooking the park in front of the hotel was delightful. We were a very short walk away from target, SO many restaurants, the design district and Wynwood. My family and I would return back to the Hyde Midtown in a heartbeat.

I had an amazing experience staying at the Hyde Midtown Miami for the month of January. First, the service was excellent. Candy was super friendly and very helpful. Tomas, Jennifer and everyone else were very accommodating. The hotel is modern, clean and the room was awesome. The location is incredible, right in the heart of mid-town. There are great restaurants and stores in every direction and you don't even need a car as everything is walkable. You can easily walk to Wynwood which is quite the arts scene. I highly recommend this hotel and will absolutely stay here whenever I'm in town.

Check in was great. Folks were kind. Room was clean, good mattress and pillows but room never cools down and air conditioning is regulated apparently. Set on 65 and room stays at 75. With ceiling fan it is just ok. It’s very hard to sleep when temperature cannot cool down. Pool area is nice. Just cannot stay here again due to no cooling at night.

I love this hotel. So for my first job back in almost 7 months, I knew I wanted to stay at The Vagabond. I had to stay the weekend between projects, and wanted to enjoy the awesome pool. Which I did! The beds were just as comfy and cozy as I remembered, the walk-in shower still a favorite (not a bathtub girl.) Missed my robe, but with Covid, I get it. I was able to walk to several restaurants for dinner pick-up. And took a 2 hour walk in the neighborhoods behind the hotel Saturday morning. They just always make me feel welcome and at home... THANK YOU MAY! You are the best making sure my stay was safe and comfortable. Having a keurig and refrigerator was great. I recommend getting the room with these. Can't wait to visit again!

Absolutely amazing property. Newly renovated, impeccably clean with the most amazing and helpful staff. Luis and Walter made me feel like I was home. The room was perfect. The Hotel is located in a great area, full of amazing places to hang out even during this time. The staff ensured that the entire place was completely clean. Dont hesitate to visit Miami and book this place before its sold out. Easy access to I-95, Midtown, Wynwood and about 15 min drive to the beach. Welcome back Miami, Welcome Back Vagabond.

Absolutely loved this place. The pool area feels like an over sized back yard, and the bar is lovely. Staff is very friendly. The on site restaurant is fantastic also! Highly recommend this little gem in Miami.

second time we stayed here and loved it. everyone is so nice and the place is supper clean. the decor is wonderful.you can walk to restaurants and or drugstores. the grounds are so clean and neat and the pool is sparkling clean.

Excelente hotel reciclado buena servicio de restaurante y pileta muy buena. Hermosa estadía ideal para pasar un fin de semana en pareja. Muy bueno todo Cuidado al máximo detalle reciclado con muy buen gusto precios acepatables La zona no es la mejor pero para ir es muy fácil es par estar 2 días no más muy

The Vagabond Hotel is a modern, much improved take on the traditional 1950s motel. While retaining the design of a motel, the Vagabond Hotel offers all the trappings of an excellent contemporary hotel, such as large rooms with huge beds, in addition to outstanding amenities and a friendly, helpful staff. Within the hotel's premises, guests can enjoy sunbathing on very comfortable lounge chairs and swimming in a beautiful large pool. To top it all, a well stocked pool-side bar provides excellent refreshments. The Vagabond Hotel's location is ideal to visit Miami, especially Miami Beach and downtown. It is a reasonably priced and convenient property for any visitors to the city. I recommend it strongly.

Great place very spacious rooms and shower beautiful decor and big pool stayed there 2 nights also close to restaurants walking distance missing mini fridges but vending machine available went there during slow season but end of October the bar at the pool is open again

Super friendly staff! Very helpful. Rooms are very clean / spotless. The grounds are a lush tropical paradise. Many restaurants in walking distance and very close drive to many Miami landmarks. Only a 15 minute drive to Miami Beach Convention Center!

They recently renovated the hotel and it looked great. My bestfriend and I stayed here for ULTRA. It was perfect though no elevator, pool was right outside the door, nice happy hour, super spacious. I loved the look of the hotel on the inside, however the room had a stench as if the old room had the exact odor. I would stay again.

great staff, nice pool with bar, comfy room , simple breakfast (bagel, coffee, cereal) ... walking distance to a few good restaurants. I was there to go to some SF Giants vs Miami Marlins baseball games, the hotel is "uber " close. I also played tourist and everything was close.

A beautiful pool, well landscaped, quiet, with a pool bar. This retro motel is a great buy at the price. Family run, intimate, with friendly service, and a nice continental breakfast, it was our home base for 5 days, and we thoroughly enjoyed it.Three eateries offering varied delicious choices within one block was a big plus for us, since we didn't rent a car, and used Uber all week. They want your business, and work for it.

Pros: Comfortable beds, very nice shower, good pool area Cons: Location too far from anything interesting, unprofessional service that does not live up to the branding, noisy cleaning staff (one day out of three), mouldy smelling air conditioner My friend and I stayed here for 3 days in March. Although there has been a lot of effort put into the design of the hotel, the service does not live up to this. For example, there is a second building on the lot (a restaurant and bar) that looks like it is the entrance to the hotel. We waited there for 10 minutes not realizing that the hotel lobby is in another building. It would be a simple matter to put up a sign clearly indicating where the actual hotel is. Overall, my impression of front-desk staff was that they came through if you really pushed, but that they were unprofessional - sort of taken aback if you asked a question. Although our room was cleaned well, on the third day we were woken up by super noisy cleaning staff and not able to get back to sleep. We were not able to use the air conditioner at all because of a mouldy smell emanating from it. On the good side, the shower is amazing, the beds are comfortable, and in general the hotel is quiet because it apparently has been soundproofed. For me, the location turned out to be too far away, although there is a very good restaurant nearby - Blue Collar.

Visiting Miami between Christmas & New Year, hiked rates at our preferred South Beach locations meant options there were way over budget. I'm so glad we found The Vagabond as a great, budget friendly alternative in the up and coming MIMO district. You can clearly see the bones of the original motel (therefore rooms are not super sound-proofed etc) however it's been very cleverly renovated into a stylish, retro alternative vacation spot. Rooms are relatively spacious - bathrooms are fully open plan to the bedroom making it feel more roomy. Only a frosted glass door gives privacy to the WC though so if privacy is a concern you might want to book elsewhere! The pool area is lovely - exactly as it looks on their website photos. Don't be put off by the very basic reception on arrival, staff are very friendly and helpful. The breakfast room is pretty small and basic too but visiting in Dec we were able to comfortably take our breakfast outside and eat on the terrace. There's a choice of cereals, yogurts, juices/coffee and a supply of bagels for toasting with butter, preserves and cream cheese - it's basic but tasty and included in your room rate so what's not to love! Ground floor rooms looked a bit dark so we were glad we had upper floor rooms, however there's no lift so if carrying luggage up a flight of concrete, external steps is an issue request a ground floor. There's very little in the surrounding area but an Uber will take you to South Beach in around 20mins for approx $12. It's all about where you want to spend your money but this place is a great option if you want to save on your hotel bill and don't mind being a bit further out.

We recently stayed at the Vagabond for two nights. It was a great little motel in Mimo - very botique. If you love mid-century modern this hotel is for you. We visited several nearby restaurants in the up-and-coming area. We also easily accessed the beaches and South Beach from our rental car and an Uber. The property's pool has a large bar which is a great feature. Continental breakfast is more of a coffee/holdover situation. The staff was helpful and the premises and rooms were very clean. This is a great budget option instead of paying big bucks on South Beach.

We stayed here for 4 nights during our travels around America and it was great! We were greeted warmly and they gave us a quiet room away from the pool where they played music in the evenings. The room itself was big and the bed was super comfy! They had a great bathroom set up for doing hair and make up and the shower was really good too. The staff were really helpful when we wanted an Everglades tour and the breakfast was a good add on with bagels, cereal and yoghurts to choose from. I would strongly recommend and stay again.

I found this hotel via TripAdvisor site. This place was so cool. Very trendy. The beds were extremely comfy and the room very clean. The staff was attentive and answered any question we had. The hotel was located pretty much close to everything. We got to the hotel on Sat evening and the Pool Bar area was in full swing. Our room faced the pool and the activity there didn't bother us at all. Would totally recommend and would totally stay here again!

Que experiencia! El lugar esta impecable, la habitación es linda, todo limpio, nuevo y bien cuidado. Decoración genial, excelente servicio, la alberca!!!! Wow! El “desayuno simple continental” es muy rico y variaso o sea, todo es increíble. Hay donde estacionar y el hotel esta súper bien ubicado y cerca de todo! La zona es segura y hay varios restaurantes para desfrutar caminando, gasolinera, farmacia, o sea: genial. Y esta James: el recepcionista cantante español x africano x gitano x cantante es la neta del planeta! Divertido, atento...James: ven a visitarnos en Mexico! Abrazos, Lety y Isaias!

We absolutely LOVED this hotel. We were on a tight budget to go to a friend's wedding and this hotel not only hit the mark but was a remodeled art deco style Mimo hotel which was fantastic. It had all the vintage charm but was completely re done. The rooms were huge. We stayed in a Galaxie King, it was either 204 or 205 but it was on the second floor facing the pool and was just delightful. It reminded me a bit of the Jetson's with all the fun and fabulous colors. The room had a great desk area and bench as well as a super comfy king bed and a huge bathroom with a gigantic walk in shower and huge vanity area with a stool to sit on. The shower had three levels too. You could do the rainforest showerhead, a faucet, or a smaller lower showerhead that was detachable. I only mention this because I had my hair done for the wedding and didn't want to get it wet so their set up worked out great. The amenities at this place for it being such a great price were fantastic as well. First of all NO RESORT FEE and NO PARKING FEE. This was huge for Miami, as I couldn't find anywhere that this was the case. I was sold on those two things alone as parking in Miami can be from $25-$65 a night and resort fees can get as high as $35 so combined we could have spent $100 more a night on those two things so it was really nice that they were included. They also include a continental breakfast. It was really basic but completely unexpected. My husband could get coffee in the morning and they had English muffins, cereal, tangerines, and yogurt most mornings. They also give you free water bottles, which I just found wonderful. The pool area is lovely, and has a great bar and sometimes has live entertainment. The restaurant is fantastic as well and has a wonderful happy hour from 5-8pm.Amanda was our server both nights and she was just wonderful. The staff also made the experience delightful. Micah was great prior to our stay and gave us all sorts of recommendations for places to visit in Miami and followed up on her recommendations when we arrived. Brett was absolutely fantastic. We came in on an overnight flight and we were strictly told by the manager under no circumstances would we be able to check in early and there was a $75 charge if we could, but we were able to drop our bags off at 6am and then check in by around noon which was so nice to take a nap before the classical concert that was taking place that afternoon by the pool. Brett was also fantastic in answering any questions and was friendly, upbeat, and extremely genuine throughout our stay. He constantly asked how we were doing and if there was anything we needed. James was also fantastic. He answered all of my questions about places to visit and was genuine and kind as well. For the price you absolutely can't beat this hotel and it was centrally located to everywhere we needed to be in Miami and was not far from Fort Lauderdale either. I love how they kept the nostalgic feeling of the property during the remodel. The art deco mermaids and the Vagabond sign give the place so much character. Our room was also really quiet. It is on a main street so I was worried about noise but the rooms are tucked in the back and the pool is in front of the hotel so the street noise didn't travel to the rooms. Also you get 10% off if you stay 3 nights and 15% off if you stay 5 nights, which really helped. The Galaxie King was plenty big for us but if you would like more room or are bringing kids, the Electra deluxe is bigger and has a pull out couch, a fridge, and a keurig coffee maker. I honestly can't say enough wonderful things about this hotel. The price was phenomenal and was one of the reasons we were able to afford our trip and yet the rooms were so fantastic and the staff was absolutely charming. Thank you Vagabond for making this stay so wonderful. If we ever visit Miami again we will be sure to stay here and tell all of our friends that may visit as well.

I stayed at the Vagabond with two girlfriends for a weekend getaway. We could not have been more impressed with the accommodations. The room was spacious, impeccably clean, with extremely comfortable beds. The location was ideal, as we attended a concert at the Hard Rock Stadium, but were still able to get to South Beach with ease. The pool area was gorgeous and very well maintained. We enjoyed sitting by the pool every morning. In the evening, we enjoyed the outdoor bar thoroughly. The staff were all very helpful and incredibly friendly.

review_text: Had a wonderful experience staying at this hotel prior to our cruise. We wish we had more nights here. Check in was a breeze and staff were very nice and helpful. review_text: Me recomendaron el hotel pero no pense estuviera en construccion pero a pesar de todo, todos fueron muy amables pero Cristina M. es super amable con mucha dedicacion ojala todos los hoteles tuvieran una Cristina es fantastica

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excelente estadia , Cristina de front desk y su equipo fueron muy amables, siempre con una sonrisa en su rostro ayudando en todo lo que nesecitamos , ofreciendo champgane al momento de check in , la piscina asombrosa todo perfecto.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Aunque todavía está en remodelación, el personal está siendo muy amable Muy especialmente la gerente Dulce, a quien pueden buscar y los atenderá muy bien y tiene el mejor valet parking de toda miami. Si personal Cesar, Ulis, Paul y todos son muy amables

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Rente una unidad Vesper me explicaron que no pertenece al hotel, eso fue a pricipios de abril , lastimosamente sali una noche a recoger un delivery y olvide mi llave telefono y y todo en la habitacion era muy tarde y Cristina estaba aun en Front desk a medianoche a pesar se estar dutrante muchas horas amablemente me ayudo a llamar a mi esposa que dormia en repetidas ocasiones hasta que logro comunicarme y dejarme entrar mientras se lo agradezco enormemente hizo lo posible por ayudarme muchs gracias fue uno de los mejores gestos que han hecho por mi , es lo mejor

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: excelente opción!! La habitación impecable, muy cómoda y amplia. Buenos colchones y almohadas . La relación precio calidad es absolutamente favorable. Muy bien ubicado, con muchas opciones para cenar en las cercanias! Y mención especial al personal: profesional, amable, muy bien dispuesto!! Gran opción en Brickel!!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Excelente estadía de fin de semana. disfrute el area y todas las actividades alrededor del hotel. Será mejor aun cuando terminen las renovaciones. Muchas gracias por sus atenciones y atención a todo detalle.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Durante nuestra estadía fuimos atendidos por FACUNDO en el desayuno que se ha portado de las mil maravillas ! Súper Atencion, súper educado, volveremos. Las instalaciones del hotel muy modernas, habitaciones limpias y confortables. La recepción del hotel a nuestra llegada no fue la mejor, nos hubiese gustado algo más de amabilidad pero todos podemos tener un mal día.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Cristina de front desk fue muy amable me brindo champagne y me acompaño hasta el piso 25 para entender como llegar a mi habitación ella fue increíble, la piscina muy bonita y con buen servicio por parte de Anie

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Me gusto mucho el hotel. Las habitaciones son muy cómodas, con una vista hermosa y está cerca de una farmacia y varios restaurantes. Tiene el servicio de valet parking con costo pero en general la experiencia fue muy buena. Solo me quede una sola noche asique no pudimos ver todas sus instalaciones. No le di las 5 estrellas solo porque para llegar a tu habitación tenías que subir a un piso específico para luego caminar y agarrar otros elevadores y a veces era un poco confuso.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: Personalmente recomendaría quedarse en AKA pero pero solo después de que esté completamente renovado el sistema de 2 ascensores fue demasiado confuso durante nuestra estadía y fue un problema para algunos Además, la piscina está en el edificio de al lado, que está en algún lugar lejos de las habitaciones. pero la mejor parte es la experiencia de servicio al huésped. el proceso de registro fue sencillo y la señora que nos registró en dulce supongo que fue lo mejor ella nos ofreció 2 copas de champán a nuestra llegada Además, el agente del mostrador de conserjería, yug, fue el mejor al sugerir lugares para pasar el rato que no estaban muy concurridos e incluso no estaban bien establecidos en Google. Solicitaría a la autoridad del hotel que haga el proceso de renovación lo más rápido posible y me encantaría volver a ser huésped de AKA.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: The rooftop bar is was such a pleasant experience! The eats were tasty and the drinks hand crafted with excellence. Rekey was delightful and super accommodating- a lovely time all around. Cannot wait until all of the construction is complete so I can experience the new renovations.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I recently stayed with my boyfriend for 3 nights at AKA and the experience was awesome. I went through the review section after booking and I was shocked to read the construction complaints by other guests but to be very honest it seemed all myth to me during my stay. The stay was really smooth and I would love to visit AKA again during my next trip to Miami. I would like to mention the point where I was a little disappointed was the room service. My boyfriend ordered a bottle of champagne but it took 1 hour to get it delivered and the restaurant staff was too rude on call when we called for the order update. I would like to mention the Front desk team, especially Ariana and Yug/Huge helped me a lot and they answered my calls regarding the bottle in a very hospitable manner.

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I truly had a great stay, the room was great and the waterfront view was fantastic. All of the staff members were super nice, especially the Valet team with Ulis and Eduardo. I will definitely be back!

hotel_name: Brickell Arch, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami
review_text: I attended the yoga class with Loreto on Saturday and it was amazing!! She guides you through the whole class and breath work. The ambiance and views of the hotel terrace are a perfect place to start the weekend. I felt so relaxed and energized. I encourage to try it out!

We love to stay in this hotel Tomas Duggan , Operations Supervisor saved us ! We came from a very bad experience and called the Hyde Midtown Hotel to make a RUSH reservation and Mr Duggan immediately rescued us ! Staying at this hotel is like being at home, excellent rooms , with all the COVID security protocols and cleanliness . Hope to come back soon ! We very great full and for sure we’ll stay there again

I'd recommend staying here if you like a trendy vibe in an awesome area. Shops and restaurants are close by if you want to avoid hopping in an uber or lyft to get somewhere. Plus, the UFC gym across the street is great for a quick workout!

I cannot say enough great things about the Hyde and the staff there! The accommodations are lovely, roomy, and very clean. The rooftop pool and hot tub are so relaxing and have gorgeous views. I come to town 2-3 times a month, and since finding the Hyde, its become my home away from home. Tomas and his staff always greet with a smile and go out of there way to make each stay better than the last! And you can't find a better location, its close to everything you might want access to in Miami. Midtown has everything you need, and the Hyde is the perfect place to get away and enjoy all that Miami has to offer.

I have to go to Miami on a regular basis for business and my Hotel of choice is the Hyde Midtown Hotel, perfectly located at 5 mn walk from the stylish and vibrant Miami Design district. As well you will find numerous choices of bars, restaurants and grocery shopping nearby. But the major reason why I always comes back is the dedicated and warm Hospitality from Tomas and his team. They are really helpful in many ways and during this Covid period, you feel perfectly safe here where everyone is following protocol, you have many hand sanitizer all over the property . WIFI is easy to connect and never lets you down. Rooms are spacious and full of light, and the terrace a real plus to relax with a drink or coffee ! The design is contemporary, yet comfortable, with a excellent mattress quality, note that you are having a closet dedicated for your large suitcases, very practical detail... Definitely a place that I will warmly recommend for business or leisure.

Fenomenal hotel en la mejor ubicación de Miami, y con un servicio 5 estrellas. El diseño, la atención, las instalaciones, la piscina, el gimnasio esta cerca de los mejores restaurantes y tiendas , zona fashion total . SUPERRECOMENDABLE

My father had the pleasure of spending a month in one of the suites at The Hyde in Midtown, Miami to be near his dr's at Mt. Sinai in Miami Beach. The hotel is in a great location in Midtown to move around Miami, you're a 10 minute drive to anything. There is a ton of options around the hotel (Target, restaurants, bars, stores etc) so anything you need is within a 5 minute walk of the hotel. The hotel is also a one minute drive from the bridge over to South Beach, you can be at the beach in 10 minutes or less. The rooms are fabulous, beautifully appointed, super modern and have a wonderful bed (my father said it's the best bed he's slept on), they also have great balconies in every room. What we were particularly impressed by was the service of all of the hotel staff from the front desk, to the back office, valet attendants and the housekeeping staff (seriously the loveliest and kind housekeeping staff). With Covid, we had to be extra careful and we felt super safe the entire stay. Everyone was wearing masks, housekeeping went above and beyond to make sure my father had everything he needed and Tomas and the team at the front desk we're truly fantastic and hospitable. For example, my father had major surgery in Miami and the hotel went above and beyond to accommodate his limited mobility and bring a smile to his face. The hotel has everything you need, a beautiful gym, rooftop pool, hot tub, business center, tennis court, spa etc. If you're looking for a modern luxury hotel in Miami, seriously, book here, we could not have been more happy with our choice with The Hyde. I basically live in hotels for work (during normal times) and this was one of the best overall hotels I've had the pleasure to stay in. There was also hand sanitizer everywhere which I greatly appreciated! Many thanks to Tomas for helping us with a month long reservation and making sure we had an incredible stay, I hope your managers see this as you are a rockstar and SBE is super lucky to have you on their staff. 10/10 review, thank you Hyde Suites, staying with you took so much stress away during a stressful time for our family!

I always receive amazing service from the reservations/sales team - Tomas, Katrina & Ranin. The front desk's colleagues - Candy - always on point, Jennifer - new colleague goes above and beyond.. went out of her way to assist. Thank you!

The team was exceptionally kind and professional. I will continue to stay with the Hyde for all of my upcoming business visits. I highly recommend this location. I Truly enjoyed my stay and I look forward to my next visit.

I love this hotel! Built in 2018, everything is still so clean, modern, and well through out. Great beds, showers, and STAFF. Thomas and Candy helped me everything I needed, and were so friendly and attentive. The location is stellar, with plenty of great restaurants, shopping, and green space just steps away. I highly recommend this hotel and will definitely be back!

Have been staying at South Beach fo 12 years. First tine staying in north midtown at the Hyde. What a great hotel and hotspot for shopping and dining. The Hyde's staff was stellar. Extremely accommodating and very friendly. Candy, Tomas and staff were always happy greeting our work team day and night. Will be staying at the Hyde whenever in town from here in out.

This was our second stay at the Hyde Midtown Miami. Both experiences were great with clean, well appointed rooms and a friendly, helpful staff. The location is perfect for our trips to the Miami Design District. Somehow while booking this recent stay, the transaction didn't get completed, so I didn't have a booked reservation when we arrived at the hotel. Candy at the front desk and Tomas the operations supervisor graciously rebooked the reservation for us at the rate I had found on the website 10 days earlier. It was wonderful to be treated so well and not taken advantage of in that situation. I will return to the Hyde Suites Midtown Miami!

Viajamos para celebrar el cumpleaños de mi esposa y quedamos maravillados. La atención del personal en el hotel HYDE es de primera. Son estrictos con el tema del COVID, debes usar mascarilla fuera de la habitación lo cual nos dio mucha seguridad. Las habitaciones son amplias, modernas y muy limpias. La terraza tiene una vista espectacular. El area es excelente para hacer shopping. Jenifer y Jerrod fueron muy amables en nuestra estadia en el Hotel.

An amazing stay with exceptional service!!The staff was extremely kind and followed health measures exceptionally well. The room so chic and modern with a wellness vibe. Definitely recommend it for a stay in Miami Hyde Midtown

Chose the hotel for location to my office but continue to stay even for leisure. This place is clean and the nicest staff that greeted me with open arms. I love the SBE brand and this Hyde hotel is on top of my list of the ones ive stayed at.

Wow! Our stay at the Hyde hotel in Midtown Miami was the best hotel experience we have ever had (and we are big time travelers). The hotel is colorful with beautiful artwork, very modern, has high ceilings, huge TVs, big balcony and the mattress is extremely comfortable. But what really set this hotel a part from other hotels is their customer service. My husband and I had a lot of special requests, they met and exceeded every single one of them, and did so with a huge smile. Every staff member was more kind and more accommodating than the next. Eleven out of ten!!!

Ha sido mi primera estancia en Miami por motivos profesionales y he quedado muy contenta con la elección del hotel. En primer lugar tiene una muy buena localización a 15 minutos del aeropuerto, a pocos pasos de Wynwood y Design District así como muy cerca de South Beach a pie. Las habitaciones son muy amplias, confortables y acogedoras y a la limpieza le doy un 10. En general todos los servicios y zonas nobles del hotel se ven cuidados y muy agradables. A destacar Daisy, Liz y Alexandra que han sido muy serviciales en todo momento y han estado pendientes de todos los detalles durante mi estancia, en general todo el personal es muy profesional y son muy eficientes y amables. Me he sentido muy acogida y si tuviera que volver en un futuro a esta ciudad por ocio o negocio volvería al mismo establecimiento. Raffaella

Excelente hotel todo limpio y cómodo, buena atención lo recomiendo, buena ubicación y muchos restaurantes alrededor. Varios sitios alrededor para caminar y conocer. Buenas instalaciones tiene el hotel.

El mejor hotel para conocer y disfrutar de la zona de compras en Miami. La ubicación perfecta para caminar. Tiene buena gastronomía a su alrededor. Fácil acceso al servicio de transporte gratiuto. El servicio de habitación excelente. Recomendado a todos los que quieran visitar la zona cosmopolita de Miami

El hotel, súper limpio, cumpliendo con todas las normas de higiene (Libre de COVID). El staff, además de amables y serviciales, están dispuestos a ayudarte en todo momento haciendo que pases días de relajo y diversión, sin preocupaciones. BONUS: Está muy cerca de Wynwood Walls y del aeropuerto. ¡Espero poder regresar pronto!

Excelente atención,el lugar en general y al estadía fue maravillosa. Volvería mil veces más. Una Excelente experiencia con mis padres y hermana,todos quedamos encantados y esperamos sea cercano nuestro retorno

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: La ubicación cerca a Design District, tiendas como Marshall y restaurantes. El desayuno variado y con buen horario muy bueno y sobretodo la excelente atencion de Angie y Zully en recepción estuvo de primera

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Muy buena atención Excelente desayuno Jose ha sido muy amable Deje la recepción agendada para recibir paquetes y todo impecable para recibirlo y demás. La pisicina muy linda, el gym 24 hrs genial Super conforme con el confort de habitaciones, super limpio, todo impecable. Gracias por tanto!!!

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Desde que llegue al Hotel me senti segura y comfortable porque la instalacion tiene medios de seguridad confiables ,En el lobby la acogida fue magnifica y profesional ;Francisco muy atento y su companera Rachel me recomendo varios sitios donde podiamos comer ,El security muy vigilante y cuidadoso con todo a nuestro alrededor Al llegar a la habitacion todo muy limpio . Definitivamente recomiendo este servicio a todas mis amistades y El Hotel por su buena Atencion .

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Excelente experiencia los chicos son unos genios. Jose y Rachel. Muy buena la atención. Muy atentos con todo. Volveríamos. El hotel muy completo desayuno muy rico y variado. Pileta limpia y excelentes instalaciones

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Buena atención en general. Buena ubicación. Algo ruidosa la zona. Pero bien. Deberían cambiar las puertas del baño de corrediza a puerta de abrir. La atención al cliente muy bien. El desayunador amplio y con variedad de elección. Estacionamiento bien

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: This hotel was very good, excellent service, specially Francisco, Derick and Mickey Suarez, they are the best hostess, I was on vacation with my family with my wife and three kids. The breakfast excellent, the room Awesome.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: El Hotel es muy bueno, limpio y comodo. Pero el Personal es de lo mas amable! Francisco una persona muy amable, servicial, resuelve lo que se le pida. En general una buenisima experiencia. El desayuno es muy bueno y practico

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: El Personal muy Amable!!! Sr. Francisco, muy Profesional!! Supo ayudarme rapidamente y solucionar un inconveniente!!! Las instalaciones son muy lindas!!Falta un pequeño Resto-Cafe por las noche poder comer algo. Todo lo demas excelente!!! Caminando se llega Shopping Midtown, muchos negocios y casa de comidas allí. También cerca Design District.Hotel Tiene parking propio cubierto. (Creo que es con cargo adicional) Muy bueno porque esto techado y entra directo al Hotel. Muchas Gracias!!! Valeria

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Excelente atencion en recepcion. MEJORAS : faltan mesas y sillas en el desayuno, falta restaurante en las noches. Finalmente, el lavado y limpieza de la cochera en el lugar de parqueo para registro de huespedes, deben ser programados durante las horas de poco transito vehicular y peatonal, pero lo realizaron en horarios de mucha congestion y no solo 1 sino 3 dias en 1 semana.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
review_text: Fue una estadía mixta con personal muy amable, pero una persona de recepción que no quiso dar su nombre creo que se llama Mario es muy irresponsable, falta de respeto, sin ningún criterio y coloco a los huespedes en peligro de su integridad, dado que hubo emergencia de incendio 3 veces en un noche y el muy relajado tomando café indicaba a los pasajeros con un tono burlesco que no pasaba nada y que había sido que alguien apreto botón de emergencia, asunto que es falso dado que llegaron los bomberos y revisaron. Esa persona no puede estar atendiendo a los huespedes, lo cual podrán revisar en las respectivas grabaciones de la camaras de seguridad.

hotel_name: Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Wynwood Design District
