Fuimos a desayunar con nuestra familia, Fatima fue quien nos atendio y el servicio fue maravilloso. Aunque no era la mesara fue muy atenta. Gracias por la atencion espero volvamos pronto y encontrar de nuevo a Fatima. Excelente servicio

Nos quedamos con unas amistades y todo estaba muy limpio y organizado. Gracias a housekeeping por encargarse tan bien de nosotros. Cada ves que pedíamos algo de inmediato lo traían. Gracias a todos por las atenciones tan bonitas.

Me quedé con mi esposo hacer unas noches atrás y todo fue muy placentero. Los empleados fueron muy amables y la habitación estaba muy limpia. Tuvimos un problema con el televisor y enseguida lo arreglaron. Muchas gracias por todo.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: First Trip Advisory review. Had to leave a 10/10 review for this burger we came back the next night! Jacob and Jeff were very friendly!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Great hotel, well set up for Disney Friendly staff. Pool is looking a bit tired

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Israel at the Beech Restaurant by the pool provided excellent service. He was attentive and friendly. The food was also delicious!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We had a decent time here at Signia. The major issue was 2/4 elevators being down during our stay and it caused a lot of lines to get on the elevators and waiting. The rooms were nice but when we first arrived we noticed the refrigerator was not cleaned out from the previous guest. You can also hear everyone in the hallways as they walk by but that wasn’t too big of a problem. I do think the beds caused some back and neck pain for me personally but that varies by each person. We had a few drinks at the bar and honestly they were very expensive for a bar, $20-$26 per drink! The hotel is very beautiful though with the marble accents and the pool is fun with the lazy river pool! I don’t know if I’d stay here again but I’d definitely think it’s great for families on a budget that don’t drink and want to be close to Disney!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Hilton Bonnet creek by insignia has become a tradition for our family when we visit Disney. The hotel has the best pool/ lazy river. The staff is accommodating and friendly. The restaurants are great. On this trip we ordered room service and the food was fresh and really good.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Roberto nos atendió en Starbucks y fue súper amable. Nosotros venimos de Sevilla (España) y gracias a él nos sentimos mucho más cómodos y arropados. Es un gusto encontrar personas así. Gracias Roberto, eres el mejor!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Great food. Luke was especially great.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Great experience and Mariano at the pool restaurant was awesome!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Stephon, porvided excellent service and was very accommodating and make sure we were satisfied. I would definitely request his service anytime I patronize the restaurant.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Marilyn was our server while we entertained clients at the cabanas. She was AMAZING!!! Thank you for helping us host such a great party.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Beautiful property. Comfortable amenities that make you feel like you are truly on vacation. The Beech bar and Mariano were excellent. Service and food choices were so much better than we expected and the best in the area. Great for kids and couples alike!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Stephon was very attentive, knew the menu helped with selections with wines pairing with appetizers. Great menu suggestions. Asked what we liked and directed us in the right direction!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We had a wonderful experience at the Signia. It had a beautiful lobby and ambience throughout the hotel and on site restaurants which served delicious foods. The primary reason for my review is to share my experiences at the Harvest Bistro. Specifically, Erica C. had us coming back for multiple meals. She was so incredibly sweet, attentive and went above and beyond to make my girls feel extra special on their birthday (and each visit). I honestly have never met anyone in the hospitality industry like her before. I hope she is recognized by management because she is truly one-of-a-kind (and that’s coming from someone who has high expectations).

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Great stay experience at the Signia By Hilton. I got in early from a red eye flight and thankfully they were able to accommodate an early check so I really appreciate it! Staff are courteous from valet service to the front desk and restaurant staff. I love the pool and the lazy river. I can hang out there all day. The hotel is pretty nice, very relaxing it gives a nice vacation vibe! Lots of restaurant choices onsite plus you can also access the restaurant at the Waldorf as the hotel is connected. Lots of conventions while I am there but the lobby is spacious so there's enough room. It's also family friendly and free shuttle to Disney. I will definitely stay here again.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: ​"We had a fantastic dining experience at Signia, and a huge part of that was thanks to our waiter, Mariano. From the moment we were seated, Mariano was warm, professional, and incredibly attentive. He knew the menu inside and out—his recommendations were spot-on and he made sure every detail of our order was perfect. It’s rare to find service that is this efficient while still being so friendly. If you are dining at Signia, I highly recommend asking for Mariano's section. He truly elevated our experience!"

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Our experience at Signia by Hilton Bonnet Creek had always been fantastic! We have stayed here with our family numerous times and keep coming back. The hotel has everything we could ask for especially the restaurant, LaLuce. The food is excellent, the selections are varied and the service is fabulous! Our server, Stefan, accommodated our family of 9 and made our dining experience superb. The hostesses, Camila and Vera were understanding and kind even as we changed our reservation several times. All in all, we highly recommend LaLuce, Stefan, Camila, Vera and the Signia by Hilton Bonnet Creek in Orlando Florida!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Melanie and Jacob were awesome! Attentive, very personable and professional. I can’t recommend them higher. If you’re at The Signia, make sure to stop by for a cocktail.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We visit this hotel often and the bar is always a highlight of our stay. Melina, Dorian, Melanie and Jacob are so friendly and attentive it feels like visiting old friends. They make every visit special and we always look forward to seeing them again. Amazing service all around!

Stayed here for 3 nights while we visited Universal parks nd we had a really nice time. It’s a very modern and minimalist appearance. It was very clean and well maintained throughout. The hotel is directly next to Sapphire Falls so it was easier to get to City Walk by walking there and getting the water taxi. There is also a bus service from the hotel to Epic Universe and to Citywalk. We didn’t have to wait longer than ten minutes for a bus. There is a walkway directly to Volcano Bay at the back of the hotel that takes no longer than five minutes. Staff were really friendly and helpful throughout our stay. We arrived a few hours early but the front desk let us check-in early. The room had a brilliant view of the parks. It had high ceilings, was very clean and had lots of space. Only issue with the room was the beds were uncomfortable. We didn’t have time to use the pool here but it looked nice. We used the main dining area in the mornings which was good and the staff were friendly. Great stay and would stay here again.

Love this hotel, while probably not the highest rated or highest price it does what it's supposed to. Rooms were clean, hotel staff was attentive and shuttle busses were always there to make getting to the parks a breeze. Dining could have been better in the lobby but it worked. Ate once and they delivered one out of five meals completely incorrect. Plus side they did have stir fry meal options that were gluten free. Room faced Universal Islands of Adventure and the view on floor 16 was spectacular. We just got home and already looking forward to going back when they replace Mythos. Let's hope it's a Legend of Zelda area!!

I stayed at the Universal Aventura Hotel for two nights in July 2026. I chose this hotel since the price was right, and I also wanted early park entry to the Universal theme parks. Checking in was an easy and friendly process (my room was ready well before 4:00pm). Walking through the lobby and hallway, it seemed to me that this hotel gives off more of a "modern urban apartment building" vibe rather than a "vacation destination" vibe. After requesting a high floor with a view, I was placed in an 11th floor room with a nice view of the Orlando area (I could see a tiny bit of Epic Universe in the distance). The room was nice and large, and I liked the automated light system (controlled on an iPad). The main perk of staying here is the proximity to Universal CityWalk and the Universal theme parks. I took the picturesque Garden Walk to these locations several times (I clocked it at about 18-20 minutes each way walking at a brisk pace). Buses are also available; note that when you take the bus, you are dropped off near the parking garages (and thus you have a farther walk from CityWalk/theme park entrances). Walking through the Garden Walk, you come out right at Margaritaville/directly across the bridge from Islands of Adventure. During my park day, I went back to the resort for a break/pool time. The pool here is very relaxing and pretty big. There is not much ambiance in the pool area, but again this makes sense with the urban apartment building vibe. I wouldn't come back solely for the pool, but it was actually a highlight of the hotel for me. I did not eat anything at the hotel besides a pastry from Starbucks in the morning. The food court area looked underwhelming, so I didn't even try to order food here. I did buy a $14 beer from the lobby bar, which was more than a little overpriced... but at least it was good. If I were to go back to Universal Orlando, I would probably try a different hotel. I liked my stay here, but I'm not rushing to return.

Rosen Inn has a lot of potential. You can see it could be a lovely hotel, but unfortunately it seems to be in the hands of the wrong management. As per other reviews it seems that the hotel has just been going downhill. The place needs a good renovation for starters and a deep clean. We were booked for two weeks but left a week early to move to a new hotel. We left with many bites in unusual places. We had to strip the bed sheets to see if they were clean, insects were in the room - even when the door had been shut all day and no windows were opened. The curtains and carpet were filthy. We had to wear shoes in our room when walking around or from getting out the shower. The toilet seat was broken, the bathroom and front doors were too. The entire room and decor is dated and old. Air conditioning is on the outside of the rooms which faces the outside corridor, which causes the floors to be quite slippy when water leaks. It's an eyesore. The hotel itself is just old, needs to be done up and repainted again. The sunbeds are dirty and the pool isn't that amazing either. It's generally just an unpleasant place to stay. The only decent things were that the beds were comfy and the location is excellent. Other than that, I won't be returning to this hotel again in the future. Disappointing. Save your money and go elsewhere until the hotel is sorted out.

Have been coming to this place for 28 years and things have changed and not for the best. Check in wasn’t great, on arrival I asked for a specific block and was immediately declined as everyone who checked in had to go into block A (this apparently was the managers decision). I was gutted as this is not the hotels ethos of accommodating requests when clearly they could. Next day I pleaded with a very nice receptionist who allowed me to move where I wanted to go to. Thank you. Rooms are replenished with fresh towels and bins emptied daily. Last year beds were also made but not anymore. We should have had a linen refresh on our fourth day and deep clean on the seventh. This never happened. Stayed for breakfast a few times, still serving the same food since we started coming all those years ago however it’s still ok and good value for money. Dinner in the evening has now stopped. You had to get food from zebras if you wanted anything. Parking is now payable with a $50 max charge. All in all it appears the Rosen team have cut costs where they can but not for the better. The rooms still have comfy beds and great showers but really need updating. In the evening I always like to sit out in the deli. This used to always be busy but not anymore. Why not provide board games for guests to play and have music on over the tv rather than the doom and gloom news. Surely this will entice people to spend money in your deli. Despite all this I do love this hotel as I have great holiday memories here. Would I return again. Me yes, my husband a defiant no.

We arrived just before midnight, exhausted after a long journey, and things went downhill fast. We’d booked a room for 5 but were told at check-in we’d need to pay extra for a roll-out bed something we were never informed of at the time of booking. That may not be the hotel’s fault, but the process afterward was frustrating: we asked for the bed to be brought up straight away since we were desperate to sleep, but ended up waiting almost 30 minutes. When it finally arrived, we had to make it up ourselves, and even then we weren’t given the correct bedding instead we were mistakenly handed 10 pillowcases. By that point it was well past midnight and we simply didn’t have the energy to call guest services again. Cleanliness was another letdown. Some of the bedsheets had visible stains, and there were cobwebs in the room. Despite the room being cramped for a family of 5 with 7 pieces of luggage, it wasn’t cleaned once during our entire stay.

3rd time unlucky. The first time was 10 years ago and the 2nd was 5. Both great very memorable stays. This time, not so great. We were put in D block top floor facing the pool and all I can say is we didn't really get a sleep because of 1. The noise from the traffic 2. The mattress was like a brick The bed sheets were not cleaned in 11 nights. The lite bites is rip off prices and the zebra bar hasn't got much to offer either with little to no atmosphere compared with the years gone by. Pool at E block was quiet and peaceful on the 2 or 3 days that we chilled away from the parks but we found ourselves going across to millers for food and drinks on they days. The room was clean enough though but the sliding door into the toilet area was broke. Great location but not sure if I will return

amazing love this hotel been over 17 times now booked again for later this year and looking to book again for next year . friendly staff , lovely and clean , great pools , great location wouldn't stay anywhere else .

Ive been coming to this hotel for many years with family and nothing has changed, well its changed but not for the better. Location is great i cant fault that, we were only staying for 1 night this timeand tobe honest having a room on the ground floor was not great. My neighbours were english and smoking like chimneys jusging by the fag pile outside the door and the wonderful aroma of weed in the air. I would have thought the room may have changed but since my first visit in 1993 the room is exactly the same as it was then, i hope to god they changed the mattresses. It needs a major make over and money spending on it, it is no longer a 3 stsr , more like a 2 star. Nothing wrong with the grounds but sort out the rooms, the dated lobby and lower your prices cause down the road they are $ 40 per night cheaper and better. Its such a shame as i have very fond memories of my first time in Orlando because of this hotel. Do t let her rot, do something i stead of sitting back and tzking thr money

Beware the parking fee, We have stayed at this hotel on and off for years but we're able to book it and did not find out about the parking fee of $10 per day until check-in. Very frustrating to be surprised at check-in by that when I was able to pay for everything in advance and had no clue there was a parking fee. Besides that this day was fine except if you book request a room that is not facing the highway on an elevated floor as it is very noisy

the staff at the front desk very kind, the location perfect. All is good if You like to do your room during vacation. After allá day in parks we came late at night and found that our bed was not done. Asking for the reason for that, one perdón told us was because we left our pijamas over the bed and the lady that dies the room, don't touch personal belongins, we insiste for an explanation at the front the desk and they told us that they do the bed every four nights because they don't have enough personal for cleaning, unveliabable, never happened to us before. Been there in february the 25 and26

I travelled here with my family in February 2026 (4 adults 1 child) and it was great. Normally we stay on site at Universal. However, this was a first stay for us and I was so nervous as this is partly a motel style hotel. Turns out, I had nothing to be nervous about. There is security at every entrance to the car park and they check you have a parking validation before entry. The rooms were basic and a little dated. However, they were very clean and very comfortable. The beds were great and we slept like babies. There was a bit of road noise as faced the I4, but I found it relaxing. The breakfast in the hotel was great value for money $15pp +tax and was a buffet style. The staff were great with me as I have coeliac disease and showed me what I could and could not eat. The staff in the hotel were lovely and helpful. We will definitely stay here again. It is a no frills hotel and is cheap and cheerful bit a fabulous place to stay and reat your head 🥰 The hotel is in a perfect location for places to eat and shop on Idrive, there is the I trolley and its central for the parks too.

While this hotel is in a prime location for those attending events at the Orange County Convention Center, my recent stay for a trade show in early 2026 was deeply disappointing due to significant service and facility issues. Check-in Nightmare I arrived at 11:00 PM the night before my trade show began, only to be met with a massive line at the front desk. Despite the late hour and the influx of business travelers, there were only two staff members working the desk. Even more frustrating was seeing a manager standing in the background who periodically appeared but offered no assistance to the two overwhelmed employees. It took a full 90 minutes just to reach the front desk and get my room key. Outdated and Poorly Equipped Rooms The rooms are extremely outdated and in need of a serious refresh. Specific issues during my stay included: Dim Lighting: The lighting was incredibly weak, making it nearly impossible to apply makeup or prepare for a professional event. Poor Bath Amenities: The "bath towels" provided were tiny—hardly larger than hand towels—and the water pressure in the shower was extremely low, making for a very unsatisfying experience. Lackluster Fitness Center For a hotel of this size, the fitness center is severely inadequate. It is very small with limited hours (6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, which is not ideal for early-rising business travelers). The equipment is sparse, consisting of only two treadmills, a stair master and some weights. Verdict The proximity to the convention center is the only real advantage here. If you are traveling for a trade show, the long wait times and poor room quality may not be worth the convenience of the location.

A bit dated but not too much. Very safe area. Guards booth upon entry. Staff very welcoming and always working. Geounds as well as the room are very clean. Shuttle buses are free to the attraction parks. Stores etc are a bit of a walk to get to. Might want to drive. Parking is $10 a day.

I have visited this hotel twice and each time I never receive my money back which is paid when you check in. I have e-mailed them numerous times and they just ignore the message. There was noting wrong with our room when we left it so they should have refunded the deposit which is paid to cover any damages. I will not be visiting them again.

It’s my third time visiting this hotel and with all the choices of hotel I will always come back here, the next trip is already in the planning stage. The staff are friendly the rooms are clean and most importantly the beds are comfortable. It’s in a great location and it’s not expensive so hope to see you soon!

Located at international drive, specifically at Pointe. Located in the best area to go explore food. The hotel offers buffet style breakfast $18 plus tax isnt too bad for all you can eat. They offer buffet style evening meal 4 out of 7 nights for around about the same price - they are speciality nights. Staff are friendly and extremely helpful. In regards to rooms there are only 2 issues: first is the noise of the freeway but thats only an issue to some, and bedding is only changed after you leave. We were only here for 2 weeks and it has been a good experience, especially the staff. Info on website is accurate for options and timings so you can research beforehand.

We stayed here with friends again after 6 years of not going to Orlando. Check in was a breeze,straight forward no queues. I had contacted the hotel prior to arrival as we wanted both rooms to face I Drive as have found the I 4 direction rooms can be really noisey and being a light sleeper it doesn't help,all sorted we were in Block E 3rd Floor. The rooms are slightly dated but we knew that,the facilities in them & cleanliness was perfect for us all. No issues with the building works,it may have even finished. Reception was a 4 minute walk away if we needed to go for extra coffee. No problem with any smells in the room eg mould etc. Housekeeping did a great job and we always made a point to say hello to them. We used Lyft a lot to get about as to park at Disney was $35 a day. Plenty of places to eat,Millers,iHop,Dennis,Longhorns & BJ Brewhouse. The hotel had some Christmas decorations up whilst staying and it was nice to see them. Overall another good stay,hopefully it won't be a 6yr gap again 😁

I was in town for a conference at a nearby hotel and decided to extend my trip by a day to visit friends in Clearwater. The plan was to stay overnight there and head straight to the airport in the morning, but things didn’t go as expected. I ended up driving back to Orlando late at night, completely exhausted, and booked a room at the Rosen Inn. I arrived about 15 minutes after booking, hoping for a quick check-in and a few hours of sleep before my 4 a.m. airport departure. Unfortunately, that didn’t happen. Despite only four people being ahead of me, I waited 20 minutes in line. When I finally reached the desk, I told the staff member I had booked a reservation through Expedia. He said he couldn’t find my reservation and said that it would probably take a while before uploading. Then, without any further attempt to help or show any empathy, he looked past me and called the next guest forward. I explained I was exhausted and asked how long it might take—10 minutes? Half an hour? An hour? His response: “Yes.” And again, he ignored me and moved on. I had booked a non-refundable room because I was literally in the parking lot and knew I’d be showing up. I stepped outside and called Expedia. After 45 minutes on hold, even they couldn’t get anyone at the hotel to answer the phone. Thankfully, Expedia refunded me. At that point, I was so tired and frustrated, I returned my rental car and slept in the airport. Absolutely insane. Bottom line: If you’re looking for a hotel that values basic hospitality and can handle a simple reservation, look elsewhere. I wouldn’t risk staying here again.

My stay here was a 100000/10 the staff was friendly and helpful, super close to food and shopping (literally the mall entrance is in the lobby hotel) you would think it was loud but NO the hotel staff make sure it’s not chaotic

Everything about the hotel was amazing. All the staff were super friendly from reception, concierge, restaurant, bar, function centre and room service. The room was great and the hotel facilities were excellent.
Really pleasant and comfortable place to stay, shop, eat, drink and relax. Every aspect was thoroughly pleasant and will definitely be looking to stay again.
Front desk excellent service. Went beyond the call of duty. House keeping on time. Cricket restaurant ask for Pete, great service.

I work for major airline and had a two night layover at the Florida Hotel. The hotel staff were very friendly, engaging and delightful. The hotel is connected to a mall, which gave plenty of inexpensive food options, and shopping opportunities. The hotel is a short distance from major entertainment such as Disney World. The hotel is also a very short distance from the Orlando International Airport making it a great place for short and long layovers. The standard rooms were a sufficient size and clean. Other hotel amenities, such as the pool and gym were adequate size and never busy. The hotel has a Starbucks and Chick-fil-A on site at the entrance to the mall from the hotel lobby. One thing they made this hotel stand out for me as an airline employee is the way they take care of us. They offer generous 50% off on food in their restaurants and have a crew closet on each floor, which contain things such as shampoo, conditioner, soap, and other toiletries including razors and shaving cream. The hotel goes out of its way to make airline crews welcome, including delicious cookies at check-in. They could be a model to other Hotel chains on how to treat airline employees. I look forward to my next layover and stay at the Florida Hotel

Es un gran hotel te sientes como en casa, la atención es extraordinaria, el personal en los desayunos es super atento con un amabilidad y disposición a hacerte sentir en casa inigualable sobre todo la Srta. Lorena y la Srta. Olexys. Espero volver pronto y disfrutar de un exquisito café y excelente desayuno.

Hotel staff was very helpful and super polite. Hotel was very pleasant, clean, and presentable. Location is prime as you can walk right into the mall to many stores of your liking. I hope to return soon and enjoy some time here with my family. Thank you for your great hospitality!
Good , every room it was clean, the personal friendly

I am a frequent flyer at the Florida Hotel and Conference Center. Whether for Business or pleasure I highly recommend them! From the personable front seat staff and maids to the business relationship I have with ALL the staff , this is where you want to stay ! 10+++
I stayed here as part of the American girl experience and it was amazing it is so close to the store that I just walked there.

The Florida Hotel is my first option when staying in Orlando. The location is centrally located with easy access to all of the major highways. I appreciate the warm welcome from the security, bell and front desk team upon arrival and their all very helpful when I require assistance. The modern design of the rooms is still warm and comfortable with a fabulous and comfy chaise in my king room. The housekeeping staff is very attentive and my room is always immaculate. I highly recommend staying here in the future. I know I will be! Oh and the shopping is a plus too at the mall that is attached!

The service was excellent both from the hotel staff and the staff that helped with the conference I was attending. The location was very convenient with restaurants and entertainment nearby. Everything I had from the hotel restaurants was high quality and delicious.
Very nice hotel and greeting from staff. It was a last minute reservation from my airlines and I was pleasing surprised to know that the hotel was there.

I always enjoy staying here when I'm in town (3 years and counting)! The rooms are immaculate, well stocked with the necessary items and beds are so comfortable. The staff, attendants and service are top notch! They are always welcoming and ready to assist when/if there are questions or concerns. The atmosphere is great, and it doesn't hurt that the mall is attached!

El restaurante, tanto en servicio como atención es excelente, nos atendieron Clara y Ernesto y fue una experiencia súper agradable. En cuanto al hotel tiene muchos puntos de mejora, es caro para las instalaciones con las que cuenta, el gimnasio demasiado pequeño y poco equipado; nuestro pasillo olía mal
Wonderful place. Atended a quince and it was amazing.

Imagine meeting up with friends in a shared room, only to find out at check in about the exorbitant parking fee PER VEHICLE PER NIGHT!!!!?!?! >:-( That is a really shady business practice, and they offered absolutely no apology or making amends. Musty smell in all the hallways, staff not helpful, grounds unkempt. Can do so much better for the cost here, no wonder they sneak in fees.
Genial , clara fue muy amable y servicial y atenta
Buena atension muy amable. El mejor desayuno de hotel del mundo!
Me encantó la atención y la comida todo muy rico, me comí un omelet y estaba deli, Clara fue muy atenta y muy amable

We had a great time at Castle Hotel. Our boys loved the castle theme and us parents loved the customer service. Everyone was very pleasant to be around and very customer satisfaction focused. If you stay here, make sure to grab breakfast downstairs as the buffet is great for kids and the custom omelette is amazing off the menu! Clara was our server and she took great care of my family and I. She also brought a treasure box for my little boys to grab a toy from and they were thrilled! Would definitely stay again.
Wonderful experience excellent customer service.

Wow I can't begin to rave about how wonderful my stay was at this hotel. Jenna was so helpful at checkin and checkout . Joe went above and beyond when it came to leaving the hotel he helped hold my bags and get everything in my car. David & Holden remembered my exact drink order and made sure to take great care of my team during are dinners and event. Hands down some of the best customer service I have ever experienced. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming the hotel was beautiful and clean. I loved Mauricio friendly attitude he was such bright soul and he was very helpful with there menu suggestions.
Clarita is the best and all the team!

The staff is very friendly - especially Joe at the front door who very attentive and kind! Location was ideal for my conference at the convention center and the hotel was walkable to a fun strip of bars, restaurants, and ride. Less than 10 minute drive/uber to universal studios.

We had a wonderful stay at the hotel. Although it doesn’t have a Disney theme, it is excellent in every way. A special thank you to Clara and Luana at the restaurant — they were incredibly kind, attentive, and so caring with my young child. They truly made our experience even more special. Highly recommend!
Clara was great! Very helpful and attentive.

We are locals here in Orlando and decided to do a last minute staycation. Wow what an amazing experience! From the moment we checked in the staff was so amazing! Savannah was our check in agent and she was very helpful! In the morning we had breakfast and they made us feel at home! Our server was Clara and she was so delightful! She made sure our son was taken care of and she even brought him a toy. Very nice experience and will definitely be coming back!

Great experience easy access good breakfast Clara was wonderful for breakfast and Robert was awesome bar tender good parking access can walk to convention center if required. Good location to Universal as well. Would suggest that pool area is great for kids although we did not use it
Excelente servicio muy buena la atención
Excelente atención en el restaurante por clara y Mauricio, muy atentos y serviciales!!! Regresaría solo por la atención de ellos ❤️✅

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Yes the Buffett breakfast is excellent and Jeff our waiter was exceptional!! He went above and beyond anticipating our every need. He had information regarding the parks and was an all around great guy!! 5 stars for him!!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We stayed at Signia for three nights and had a great stay! This property is beautiful and the rooms are clean and comfortable. The pool area and lazy river were easy to access and towels are provided. We enjoyed the breakfast Buffet one morning and food from the bar one evening. Maria in the bar was wonderful serving us so close to closing time. We will definitely stay here again!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I am getting confused on whether this is a Family Resort or a dog boarding facility. Nothing is worse than getting in an elevator shortly after a rainstorm with a couple of soaking wet (and stinky dogs). I can ONLY imagine what the rooms smells like after they check out. Staff was very nice, but this pet issue has to do with upper management at Hilton- not the employees who have to smile and pretend it's OK that your wet dog marches through the lobby and even into the cafe shop on lobby level (GROSS). Pool area was kept clean and servers did a great job in the blazing sun serving guests. BUT you can't even escape the puppy brigade at the pool- as some guests think it's alright to shlep their dog poolside. Hilton really needs to take a serious look at their pet policy. Hotel rates have gone up and food/beverage is NOT cheap but probably on par with most Lake Buena "Deluxe" Resorts. The parking fee is also absurdly high.. I am being generous with my "average" rating- as it fell slightly below that.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Luke was great! Teresa was amazing! We had the best time, the food was divine, and the beautiful ambiance topped everything off! Thank you!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We love the Cigna at Bonnet Creek. We go all the time and bring all our kids and grandkids. We went into the restaurant La Luce and our server Keller was outstanding! He was pleasant, offered amazing food recommendations and made sure we had everything we needed. He is very kind and easy to talk to and we enjoyed his time.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I stayed at Signia by Hilton Orlando – Walt Disney World® Hotel and was shocked to discover dried blood stains from a previous guest on my comforter the very first day. This is a serious health and sanitation failure that should never happen at any hotel, let alone one with Hilton’s name. While the manager initially offered a room with a “better view,” a $50/night discount, and a $100 dining credit, the issue was not handled with the seriousness it deserved. The upgraded room was the same type, and the following day the manager became dismissive and avoided addressing the incident. When I escalated to Hilton Guest Services, they simply merged me into a call with the same manager I had complained about, leaving me feeling uncomfortable and unwelcome for the rest of my stay. To make matters worse, I developed a skin reaction after being exposed to the unsanitary bedding, which has added to the stress of this experience. I expected much higher standards of cleanliness and guest care from Hilton. This experience was extremely disappointing, and I hope the company takes this seriously to prevent other guests from going through the same thing.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Tony and Josh working the Flgisa event at the Zeta Asia was amazing. You need to hire more people like them and all your customers would leave happy.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We’ve just spent 10 fantastic days at the Hilton Signia, the highlight of which was meeting Milena and Maria at Myth bar! They are incredible - super lovely, kind, and attentive. They could not do enough for us and made us feel so welcome. It is people like this who make you want to return to a resort. We will be back - see you next year!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We had an amazing stay at the Signia Hilton Bonnet Creek, the hotel grounds were amazing, great service, restaurants were superb, and the rooms were very clean, My only feedback would be the lazy river wasnt so lazy, just needs a little more flows so you can move throughout without moving yourself. We will be back for sure Thank you for the hospitality.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: The overall experience has been amazing. We came in early and were able to go by the pool with no hesitation to wait for our room. They allowed us to go into our room by noon. We were so grateful since we were so tired from our journey. Also Geraldina our housekeeper is just over the top of kindness, compassion and always willing to help me in any way possible. Geraldina always greets me with a smile and wishes me a wonderful day. We have stayed in every Disney resort from the grand Floridian, Polynesian, boardwalk, yacht and beach, dolphin, swan, etc. . This Signia Hilton Bonnet Creek has been the best stay ever and will be staying here from this day forward on every vacation. This hotel is impeccable clean, and has great food options. Thank you Signia for making our stay amazing!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: My son will be 18 next month… Orlando is always an easy spot for a flight, but he is too old for parks and crowds…. Enter the Signia by Hilton and the Waldorf Astoria! Awesome time… great restaurants and the best exercise facility of any hotel by far. Free weights are great for my offensive lineman son who has to bench and squat daily or he is in a bad mood!! Service is excellent, beds and sheets divine and the lazy river is great! Definitely will be back!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Shay Signia at the front desk was outstanding. She has the best attitude at all time, she help me with my room when I arrived after a lot flight. Helped me with a little bit of a late check out since my car rental wasn’t on time. Thank you Shay for making my stay so comfortable.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Stayed at here in February 2025 for 4 nights. The room and property are well maintained. The staff are friendly and helpful. We received daily housekeeping without asking. The pool is heated and very clean. The hot tubs were a bit crowded with unattended kids, at times. The property is connected to the Waldorf Astoria via a beautiful walkway for a stroll. The pool there is also accessible with your Hilton stay. Close to Disney and other attractions. Would recommend and stay again.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Had last minute reservation change. It took only 4 minutes online chat! This is the most wonderful and efficient hotel customer service I have ever received. Thank you Emily and Amyrah! Amazing. This was within 24 hours of the reservation start!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Love this property so much, this is my second year in a row and I will continue to use Signia. The Signia is beautiful, the staff is amazing. So many options to choose from golfing, restaurants, and spas and more. I would recommend this property to anyone.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I'll start this review by stating that I know there are cockroaches in Florida and that in the cleanest of hotels it's impossible to keep out all bugs. HOWEVER, this review is to share with other travelers the snarky and cavalier approach to cockroaches from the front desk and customer service which has to mean this is a VERY common issue. We only stayed at this hotel for one night and it looked great. Early in the morning when I walked into the bathroom I found a german cockroach scurrying around on the floor. I trapped it in a towel and killed it. As we left for the airport later in the morning, I stopped by the front desk to let them know for the maintenance staff that there was a cockroach in a towel in the bathroom. The first warning sign was the front desk attendant's response was "Oh, how many were there?". I responded that I saw one, but where there is one there are usually more and I was only there for one night. She then responded, "Oh, well I'll write it down but I don't think they're going to do anything about it if there's just one." At this point I was shocked how the conversation was going so I asked if management could contact me about it and she said she'd write it down for them to do so. I flew home and after about four days no one contacted me so I reached out to the hotel customer service through Expedia. In that thread I got the same dismissive comments that I did from the front desk, including telling me that "Here in Florida, we have all sorts of interesting creatures that wander in from the nature preserve we border along." That's wonderful they border a nature preserve and again I understand there are cockroaches in Florida, but I was on a high floor and the windows do not open. So, I highly doubt this one cockroach wandered in and made it all the way up to my room by himself. What is much more likely is there are nests in the hotel and they spread and made there way up to my high floor. Which has been the point since the beginning, I just wanted someone at the hotel to say "Sorry you almost stepped on a cockroach in your expensive hotel room, we'll get the exterminator up there to make sure the situation is dealt with." I requested to online customer service that management reach out to me, but they still have not. So, I am now writing this review and will post in a few different places. TLDR - Please factor into your hotel choice that management, the front desk, and online customer service consider it par for the course for you to find a cockroach in your hotel room. If you find multiple during your stay then they will presumably start to care, though my guess is if they can't contact a guest back who asked multiple times to speak then they have much bigger issues than cockroaches going on in this hotel.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Great stay. Erika and Brenda in the restaurant are the very best. They always remember us when we come back!! The pool and hot tub were great. Our room was perfect and the amenities they were sent for our daughters birthday were above and beyond

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Another amazing stay at the Signia Hilton Bonnet Creek. The location is superb and the service and grounds are exceptional. Maryanne and Kaitlyn at the front desk went above and beyond to ensure we had a spectacular stay. Alisha, Priscilla and Amanda made themselves available through the hotel text line and quickly responded to any inquiries or requests we made. This is my go to hotel when visiting the Disney parks. They are within 5 minutes to the parks and the hotel offers shuttle service to the jerks as well as Disney springs.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: An absolute stunning hotel, especially with the recent renovations. Rooms are very comfortable and clean, the pool and lazy river are absolutely awesome. I highly recommend this property as it’s super clean extremely nice and a great location to Disney Springs.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: From check in to check out we really couldn't fault the Hylton. Add to that you can walk inside to the Wardolf Astoria for a nice drink or food makes it even better. Great pool, great food and lovely people. Nor sure if we will visit orlando again but if we do we will stay here. Front desk staff lovely, we couldn't fault it. Well done everyone....

We found this hotel to be a good base for seeing all that Orlando has to offer. Being a budget hotel and the location are main reasons why this hotel stays as busy as it is. Overall clean but very dated. The room was ok. But yes dated. We had a few breakfasts in the restaurant which were very nice and good value. We used the lite bite mini market quite often too. That was also good value and the burgers and the chicken tenders were yummy. The bar area was ok but a bit dark and dated. Was nice to have somewhere to go though for a few drinks to unwind after a full on day at the parks. The pool was refreshing and the hotel provide towels. If you hire a car then you will usually find a spot near to your room. Cleaners and reception staff deserve a mention as they were all very friendly and helpful. Would I return to this hotel? Certainly as a budget option.

We have just returned from a 13 night stay. During the stay we had a 2 night mini break at the new Terra Luna Universal Hotel so that we could take advantage of the early park admission to Epic Universe so it was inevitable we would compare the two. The Universal Hotel was considerably more expensive, the parking is at a substantial daily rate, the room was only serviced every other day and the rooms were insipid and soulless. I have seen reviews refer to the Rosen as being somewhat dated, but our experience for this holiday, as well as our previous three stays, have been that the rooms are kept immaculately with housekeeping daily. The facilities include a microwave as well as a fridge and coffee machine. There is ample parking at a reasonable token fee and to top it off, the staff are personable and polite. Returning to the Rosen always feels familiar, relaxing and welcoming and I am sure we will be returning in the not too distant future.

We’ve had a wonderful stay at the Rosen Inn at Pointe Orlando! The hotel has been excellent and housekeeping has been fantastic – we tipped $2 a day and every day the room was cleaned thoroughly with the beds made before 2pm. Everything has been smooth and we really have no complaints about the hotel itself. The only small recommendation I would make is to request an above-ground room. Being on the ground floor, we did notice quite a bit of outside noise at times – from lawn mowers, housekeeping staff chatting, and other guests passing by. An upper floor would likely be quieter and more private. Overall, though, we’re very happy with our stay and would absolutely recommend this hotel. Great value, great service, and a very comfortable experience! The location is also excellent – it’s within walking distance of plenty of great bars and restaurants, which made it really convenient for evenings out.

This was our 3rd time staying here, and it won’t be our last. The rooms are slightly dated as others have mentioned, but they’re always clean, comfortable, and have everything you could need for your stay. The food in the bar is really nice, and the shop has everything you could possibly need. We will be booking here again really soon.

Having just come home to the UK after spending 2 weeks in the hotel, I had to leave a review to thank you all for a comfortable stay, Firstly, stand out service from Randy, having ran hotels myself all I can say is Randy is on a different level to any of the staff that I had the pleasure of meeting, yes all were competent (one or two were more concerned with their phones) but Randy did everything he possibly could to make not just myself and my partner feel we were important, but also my 4 year old daughter and my 16 year old son, he does it all with a smile, with an energy that should be encouraged throughout, bringing that “human factor” to the role that is easily forgotten throughout any establishment. So thank you Randy, not only for your energy, but for your genuine way of making every opportunity to make a difference, our holiday was supposed to be special regardless as we were doing a family holiday to Disney/universal for the first time together, but your service and friendship away from the parks made it just as memorable as any mickey encounter or lightsaber build 🙂 Thank you again for everything Pete, Saoirse, Caoimhe and Jae We WILL be back

After staying previously at the Rosen Inns in Lake Buena Vista, as well as two other locations on International Drive, This Pointe Orlando Location in the Rosen chain of hotels was another very good choice, i decided to try this location on International drive to see if i would get the same great service, room & decent rates as all the other locations that i have stayed in..... Well, the verdict is in...YES, This Rosen Inn Pointe Orlando location was perfect for my stay in Orlando, along with a great rate, great room, great pool areas, as they have more than one pool, friendly staff and of course a great location. The rooms are a dated, but they are maintained better than some newer resorts. It is obvious the Rosen Hotel Chain knows what they are doing. This location is within walking distance to many, many restaurants,shops, etc. The Rosen Inns now charge a $10.00 parking fee which is not right in my opinion, just raise your rate by $10.00 and include parking ! However, it is still a good value. I am Looking forward to trying another Rosen Inn in the Future or staying at this location again. Bottom Line is this Rosen Inn is perfect for your Orlando/Disney vacation.... Rosen Inns~ Keep up the good work! Overall Rating ~ Very Good. More

We had visited this hotel previously in 2022 and it was an extremely different hotel to what it is now. Our previous stay at this hotel made us question many different negative factors. However, 3 years later in 2025 the hotel has changed for the better. From the beginning of our stay until the end, we faced no major issues at all. The hotel staff were extremely friendly and helpful and gave you their time when you needed help. We were on the 6th floor facing the I4 and it was an amazing view, but could be a little noisy at night when cars were speeding down the roads. The room we stayed in was spotless and cleaned very well by the friendly maids who made sure all rooms were cleaned amazingly. This time round we did not decide to eat in the restaurant, as we ate out most nights or in the hotels zebra bar. The bar staff member Cyril was always in the brightest mood and treated the guests very well. Within the hotel, there is a convenience store which the staff in there were also really kind. The hotel is in a great area with good access to the whole international drive. The pool seemed to close at 10pm but a lot of the time we faced many children running around soaking wet in towels around near the elevators on the bottom floor, which made the floors very slippy, but i can imagine how annoying this must be for people in their rooms resting on the bottom floor and this is going on. Although we did not have a brilliant experience last time we stayed, we definitely could see the improvements made on the hotel and were very impressed. There was free wifi provided throughout the hotel, and pool area. When we come back to Orlando, we would definitely consider staying here again.

Just back 2 days ago with my partner and 12 year old son. Great hotel, spotless. Visit zebra bar if you go the food was lovely and mega cheap. I would 💯 go back. Great location 👌 right across from The Pointe full of bars and restaurants. Pool area was spotless and gardens around it well maintained.

The Rosen Inn complex is huge and has several buildings with three pools. I found the rooms to be clean, comfortable and well appointed with shampoo/conditioner, blow dryer, ironing board/iron, in room safe, with reliable wifi and a good deal for the price. I did not use the restaurant, bar or market/deli so I can't speak to those offerings because I walked across the street to The Pointe which is packed full of bars and restaurants. There is a CVS within walking distance and it is conveniently located to the Convention Center West Building. I had hoped to walk there every day but it was so hot I would have been a puddle of sweat had I done that, so I drove to the convention center. I had a good experience, I felt safe staying there and walking around the area, I have no complaints, and would stay at the Rosen Inn again.

Absolutely love this hotel. Booked with Tui on a B&B basis. Rooms are functional though in need of updating, if just to make them more lighter. Beds comfy but small for 2 adults, showers great, safe, coffee making facilities, fridge, microwave all great additions. Pools & gym fab, deli & bar good to have if not quite expensive. Staff all welcoming especially in the restaurant. What disappointed me was not the closure of the restaurant for new flooring and being moved to the bar but going from a lot of choices to limited (if I’d just arrived I’d know no different but I’d been there over a week so wasn’t happy about this when told a lot of items weren’t on the menu) Had to beg for cereal. In the end we ate at ihop. Just wasn’t worth the hassle. Would it put me off returning, probably not but will check before hand if any renovations would be taking place as we weren’t aware of the new flooring until the waiter told us the day before.

I stayed at the Rosen Inn at pointe Orlando with my youngest daughter for 10 nights and loved it. The staff were all friendly, the room was a bit dated but other than that it was fine. The beds were comfy and the shower was lovely. Before we went I emailed them to ask for a room where it was quiet as I had read reviews saying if you have a room on the I4 side it was noisy. They gave us a room on the ground floor facing I drive which was perfect. The only thing I would say is that you do not get a kettle in the room only a coffee maker which was no good for us as we don't drink coffee. The rooms were cleaned daily and clean towels were also left daily. we did try the food in the bar, my daughter had the chicken and liked it but I had the fish and chips and found the batter was over cooked but the fish inside was undercooked so I didn't eat it. The pools were lovely and there are towels so you don't need to bring one from the room. We enjoyed our stay here and would stay here again

This a motel type rooms , rooms are very old and dark carpet smells like cheap motel , breakfast is not included, it is located right next to I.4 highway is noisy all night long, also a helicopter tour it is next door so hear the helicopter taking off and landing all day long ,lot of people making noise in the hotel area

The hotel is in an amazing position on I Drive the rooms were cleaned everyday, the pool was great and not overcrowded the Bar was great the lads who worked there were always pleasant and tried to help guests. The Breakfast was amazing and really good value $17.95 just the start to a long day at the park. would I recommend this hotel YES I would it was Brilliant and I am fussy Thank you to all the Staff they were Brilliant We asked for a room on the Ground floor of Block A facing the Pool and we got it I did email in advance.

I feel the need to warn others who book with virgin Myself daughter and 3 grandsons stayed here,on arriving after a long flight,got to room and found two double beds,we payed for 5 people? 2 of my grandsons are 6ft how can you fit 5 in 2 double beds? Had to go down to reception and ask for another bed,at a cost of 280 dollers,this was then pushed into our room not even putting it out,I called staff to please remove the chair so we could put bed there,why is this chair is not a pull out bed? I never complain but just to warn others ,they take money for 5 but the room is so small,please don't book if you got 5 people in your party Another thing I found was you have to book transport to universal studios day before,not a problem,but the staff on the desk I found very rude,not even looking at you? You pay alot ofmoney to go on holiday,why the attitude? Don't let me put you off booking,the pools are lovely 3 of them ,the room itself you only sleep and shower,but could do with updating very dark furniture and carpets need a good scrub , perhaps something that can be washed would be better, location Ideal,millers opposite lovely Helicopter rides nextdoor is a must Hopefully will help others,as I said I never complain but it's a cost for extra bed

Decent hotel with a good central location on I-Drive for where the majority of the action is. Stayed here a couple of times before too. Pools were clean and not overly busy when we were there. Water was extremely cold so assume it isn’t heated but I quite like it really cold so didn’t bother me. Shop sells a fair amount but isn’t cheap. We got a few bits from there. Staff in there were always very helpful and cheerful. Didn’t use the restaurant or bar. Thing I love about Rosen Hotels and the reason we always stay in them is because the air con works brilliantly. So many hotels where the air con doesn’t seem to cool the room down. No issues here. Rooms was always clean and tidy. That’s all we look for with the room as we are barely in it. Shower wasn’t great but did its job. We were in building 4 on 9th floor. Had a decent view of the I-4 which was very noisy at times and did wake us up so maybe ask to face I-Drive if you aren’t a good sleeper like me. Also one of the only hotels that doesn’t charge resort or parking fee. The gym is very small and was busy all the time when I went in. Previous visits it’s been empty but it was just as Spring Break was starting. Would stay here again for sure.

I’ve never write a review but feel I need to let people know of our experience in December. Have stayed here many times and as much as it’s dated we always had a pleasant time. We flew from Ireland and stopped in Boston where we got stranded for 2 nights. Finally got to Orlando and the travel agent had called to inform them of this delay. Tried to check in at reception on arrival and my god the girl was so rude. Tried to explain but she barely made eye contact and didn’t answer when I asked if there was any problem. Not a great start after being stressed from being delayed. Eventually got the keys to our three rooms. The rooms, my god they were filthy, dated and need to refurbished. The door was filthy on the outside, the door also opened without the key or then wouldn’t open with the key on many occasions, carpets were filthy and any socks we wore went into the bin as the dirt from the carpet was disgusting. The safe broke aswell and the lift was broken also. The bathroom, bath and toilet has dust or dirt on it when we arrived and the dust was still there when we left, I didn’t wipe it as I wanted to see if they were actually cleaning the rooms, which after 9 nights they just made the beds.tiles were coming off walls and hairdryer broken. Smell of must from the rooms was shocking. Smell of weed throughout the landings constantly and sick on the stairs not cleaned up for days. We had to move one room as there was a smell of sewage coming through bathroom vents. They cover the vent with masking tape and we had to move as the kids had nose bleeds and headaches from this. The same girl at check in barely listened to us and said oh ok sorry I’ll move you. Didn’t care how the kids were. Next room wasn’t any better as the kids got bit from sleeping in the beds or spider in room and were on three week antibiotics when we arrived home even though we cleaned the area daily. The staff in the coffee shop were so rude and ignored you until they stopped talking or just finished up what they were doing. Not even I’ll be with you in a minute just blanked us on a few occasions. The bar staff were so lovely and some of the staff in the lite bite were friendly but there were about 5 of them for the whole trip that were just rude. Overall our stay was ruined and the place is honestly not fit for human stay. As i said I’ve stayed here many times but it’s not as friendly as it use to be and the rooms need a total renovation before allowing anyone to stay in them. I honestly will never stay again I’m just raging I didn’t ring the travel agent to try move us to better accommodation. Rosen inn really needs to sort out rooms as there were so many people at reception daily complaining about smells, cockroaches, rooms unfit or stuff not working. It’s a shame the accommodation is no longer fit for public use as it’s always been a nice place to stay and great location

Had a reservation via a booking site for this property. Arrived and the front desk was horridly understaffed and the service was poor. Despite having a confirmation via a booking site they said they had no reservation for me. I showed them my confirmation number and the desk staff just shrugged. They offered no help no new reservation no referral to another of their properties and no apology. I had to scramble to find a room at another property which was hard as there were several conferences in town. I messaged the property via the booking site and was told 3 times that the mgmt would reach out to me. As of yet, I’ve heard nothing. I had several colleagues tell me they had the same thing happen at this property as well. All around a horrid experience and an unprofessional and untrustworthy hotel chain. Stay away!

Muy buen servicio,buena ubicación cerca de todo caminando,buen trato de personal y muy buena limpieza...lo único malo que me toco en el bloque A en la 3 planta y no tenía ascensor y me tocó a mi cargar con las maletas y un poco de olor a humedad en la habitación por las alfombras pero en general todo de 100

I had stayed on International Drive, twice before, once in 2017 and the second time in 2018, both times we had stayed in the Wyndham Orlando on Intl Dv, but when booking this 2024 trip we were informed that the Wyndham now charged daily parking as well as the dreaded daily resort fee, we were then offered the Rosen Inn at Pointe as they charged neither fees and it was excellent advice as the Rosen was the perfect hotel for our Orlando stay. Unlike the Wyndham, the Rosen was situated at the optimum position for International Drive, with everything you would need within walking distance. The check-in was smooth and efficient, and the rooms were clean and well-equipped, yes the rooms could do with an ‘update’ but the room rates and the lack of any additional fees is a ‘trade-off’ I was happy to make. Our room had two queen-double beds, very comfortable, a fridge, a microwave, a coffee machine and a large flat-screen TV, housekeeping was efficient and punctual, the parking was plentiful and the coffee shop and 24-hour shop nicely complimented the hotel facilities, I even found time to use two of the three pools which were again with a good source of poolside chairs and free towels. Our time in Orlando was broken up by a four-day trip to Miami so we stayed at the Rosen twice on either side of the Miami trip and the hotel definitely exceeded our expectations and we would absolutely return.

Stayed at this hotel in November 2024 and left after one night due to a number of issues. The main one was cockroaches that were in the sink, and in the bath/shower. Other issues included a broken safe which kept sounding an alarm, room had a weird smell (a bit like cat's pee), and the door lock was dodgy. To be fair to the staff, they were friendly and I have been refunded for my bad stay, it was supposed to be a 12 nigh stay but due to the issues I checked out after the first night. So to summarise, polite and friendly staff but a poor hotel experience overall.

This is a hidden gem, we have stayed in many hotels in Orlando and without a doubt this one is the finest properties, with great food, service and location. Super clean, updated, great service, friendly and the attached to a high-end mall is a plus.
Great hotel with great people , rooms were very nice close too shopping ,warm welcome. Location for walking to other places
Todos los años vamos para esta época y el servicio y la atención es muy buena. Además está localizado en un área muy conveniente no solo por el Mall sino también otras tiendas alrededor

The hotel is very welcoming and the rooms are clean and well maintained. The refrigerator , microwave and Kerrigan were very nice amenities. The security of using room key for elevator access was a nice security measure. The meeting rooms were well equipped. The inclusion of a chick-fil-a in the lobby was a great addition since it provided inexpensive and quick lunch breaks. Starbucks.is also appreciated for that special latte mid-day. The large meeting/banquet rooms were comfortable and table set-ups were well done. The biggest issue was the Saturday night banquet dinner. Our cost was $74 and while that covered more than one dinner, the entree was seriously lacking. A dried out chicken breast covered in a gravy to help keep it palatable did not hold up as a satisfactory meal. That chicken was the talk of the evening after the banquet. I was told that the hotel’s equipment charges for items such as microphones was very high resulting our having to provide such equipment. One other item was the room amenity charge. Orlando hotels do this but it should have been more visibly presented to the attendees, (Show total room charge including amenities and then indicate specifics on the rate,). Always nice to visit the hotel and hope to return soon.
Excellent lodging and location. Connected to a mall with many amenities; staff helpful and attentive. Good restaurant in hotel with informed staff.
As always a great overnight stay in Orlando. The hotel has everything that is needed. Rooms are comfortable. Gym is one of the best at a hotel. Staff are friendly and helpful.

First time in America so expectations were high. I would not recommend staying here. The room we had was filthy make up on cotton wool and dirty cotton buds paper on bathroom floor. The main bedroom floor was dirty and gritty when walking across it. Took 2 days for them to clean properly. The house keeper got the right hump. I had just got out the shower and she came into the bathroom crashing and muttering. She had the room door wide open while I stood there in my towel. I never got dressed so quick in my life. I had left my glasses in the room and went back to get them and she would not let me back in MY room!! I went straight down to the desk nearly in tears and they were defensive and dismissive. I hated staying here which made my trip so disappointing. We were due to stay 2 weeks but got another hotel in the end. This had never happened before anywhere I stayed.
Amazing experience, it was my first time here, this hotel has everything you could ever ask for Very friendly staff, clean and comfortable room
It was a beautiful hotel, great service from the staff, clean and pleasant stay all around. We were there for a conference and all the rooms were taken care of well! Thank you!

El hotel en general me pareció bien, con un servicio en la media. Sin embargo, hubo algo que no me encantó respecto a un beneficio que me habían mencionado: por mi nivel en un programa de puntos me prometieron un “upgrade” que finalmente no se realizó. Solo me dieron unos cupones por 2 cafés “Starbucks” restaurante que está también en sus instalaciones. (Eso sí fue un acierto) El servicio a la habitación me resultó excesivamente costoso en relación con la calidad de los platillos, que eran bastante comerciales. Además, aplican un cargo de 25 USD únicamente por llevar la comida al cuarto, sin incluir la propina —que siempre estoy dispuesta a dar—, pero en este caso la comida no cumplió con las expectativas. Pague una cuenta de $180 USD por unas alitas, consomé de pollo, y una ensalada César! Si bien la ubicación es conveniente al encontrarse dentro del centro comercial, las habitaciones son demasiado oscuras y transmiten una atmósfera un tanto incómoda (vibra extraña). Por estos motivos, es probable que en mi próxima visita considere otras opciones. Lo que sí es divino, poder comprar en el mall y no estar batallando con las bolsas que puedes ir a dejarlas al cuarto sin problema y continuar con tus compras…
Always a pleasure staying here. From the front desk, to cleaning staff always friendly and eager to help. Can’t wait to stay here again.

I was in attendance at the Department of Florida VFW Conference held at your hotel from July 31 through August 3, 2025. During our stay, we held meetings on both Friday and Saturday and also attended a group dinner with members of the VFW and Auxiliary State and District Officers. I would like to commend your team—the facilities provided were adequate and well-suited for the needs of our conference. Additionally, the meal served during our evening dinner was enjoyable and contributed to the success of our event. Thank you for your hospitality and support throughout our stay.

My experience at The Florida Hotel was excellent. The front desk was very accommodating and helpful. The guest room was clean and fresh and the housekeeper was friendly. Because I was there on business we had meals in the hotel and they were well prepared and reasonably priced. The conference room was more than adequate. I look forward to meeting there again or visiting for fun. Nelda Webb

The hotel was very beautiful! The Customer service we received at the time of arriving from the bellman was amazing! To see the beautiful smiles at the front desk and the way we were greeted I will recommend this hotel to everybody. The room was beautiful and nice and cool. I was very pleased

The room was spacious and we had everything we needed included. The staff was excellent! It was very convenient having a Chickfila and Starbucks inside. We used both. The pool was nice as well as the gym. Being connected to the Mall was a big plus. We had a great stay! We would stay there again.

Every visit has been a seamless experience, thanks to their friendly and attentive team. The facilities are always well-maintained and spotlessly clean, ensuring a comfortable stay every time. The beds are incredibly comfortable, making it easy to relax after a long day. One of the highlights is the hotel's convenient access to the mall, which adds a lot of value to my stay. It’s a great feature that makes my time here even more enjoyable. I look forward to many more stays at The Florida Hotel and highly recommend it to anyone seeking a top-notch experience.

Hello, my name is Lincoln Umezo, and I am a flight attendant for GOL Airlines. Among all the hotels I stay in during my layovers, this one is by far the best! The team is incredibly warm and welcoming, and I am truly grateful for their attention and kindness. I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks to Sebastian, Steve, and Jasmin at the front desk for always making me feel so at home. A big thank you as well to Daniel, Ricky, Luísa, Olexys, and Lorena for their exceptional service at the restaurants! The room is very comfortable, with great amenities such as a microwave, iron, and coffee maker, all within the room, making my stay even more convenient. The hotel’s location is perfect, situated inside a famous shopping mall in Orlando and near a bus stop, which makes getting around super easy. Thank you for being amazing and for making me feel like a valued guest, not just a crew member. Every time I stay here, I truly feel at home! Looking forward to my next visit!

We were traveling to Orlando for our son’s travel baseball tournament and knew we would not have time for any of the parks. The Florida Resort and Conference Center was in the ideal location near the field. The hotel met and exceeded our expectations! Very clean with friendly staff, the hotel is updated and is very convenient. The rooms were immaculate, with clean vinyl wood look floors and crisp sheets. Bathrooms also up to date. We even had a few minutes to enjoy the pool, which was also very neat, with towels offered.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: **Bed bugs confirmed by hotel staff — I would not stay here** I really don’t like leaving reviews like this, but I feel like I need to share my experience so other families and travelers know before booking. I stayed at the Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-Icon and during my stay I started noticing bites on my body. At first, I didn’t know what they were from. Then, in the early morning hours, I actually found a **live bug crawling on my mattress**. I immediately took a video and contacted the hotel. Someone from the hotel came to inspect the room and checked behind the headboard. **They confirmed there were bed bugs and also found dead bugs behind the headboard.** So this wasn’t just me seeing bites and assuming they came from bed bugs. I physically saw a live bug on the mattress, recorded it, and then had the presence of bed bugs confirmed by the hotel. I’m including photos of some of the bites I developed as well as documentation from the room. The bites appeared on several areas of my body, including my chest, shoulder and arms. One of the worst parts was the stress afterward. Once we knew there were bed bugs in the room, I was terrified of bringing them back home with us. We had to wash and dry our clothing and treat our luggage and belongings before bringing everything into our house. It was an awful way to end what was supposed to be an enjoyable trip. I understand that bed bugs can unfortunately happen, even at hotels. But finding one **crawling on the mattress I had been sleeping on** and then having hotel staff find additional evidence behind the headboard was extremely upsetting and made me seriously question how thoroughly the rooms are being inspected. I debated whether to post pictures of the bites because these obviously aren’t photos I would normally share publicly, but I decided to include them because I would want another traveler to do the same for me. If I had seen a review like this, along with the photos and video evidence, before my trip, **I absolutely would not have booked this hotel.** Unfortunately, based on what I personally experienced, I cannot recommend staying here. I would choose another hotel.
