Charis was very personable and provided a great service and presentation. She made things easy to understand. Looking forward to our vacation.

The hotel was clean and the customer service was great! When we checked in Julia was very attentive and accommodating! Check out was quick and simple! I wish we had more time to stay and enjoy the activities provided by the Hilton Orlando.
Absolutely fantastic service by the pool by Val, Jordan and Ari. They were so helpful and quick to make sure we had everything we needed.

A top-quality business standard hotel which offers a high standard of facilities for any visit. The room was clean, large, well-equipped and comfortable. There’s an excellent bar and restaurant and a lovely outdoor pool. It’s a big hotel but the staff are friendly and make you feel at home.
This resort is the best!! Wait staff(Rachel) and employees are awesome! Charis who talked to us about a promotion was very detailed and super sweet!! She was great!! Love her!

Nos encontramos con unos amigos en el área de la piscina y nos atendió DARÍO fue espectacular el trato la atención de él fue muy amable con cada uno de nosotros rápido cn lo que pedimos para tomar y comer de verdad cuando vayan al área de la piscina pidan ser atendido por Darío no se van arrepentir

We had a very late flight the day we arrived back from a cruise so we decided to book a room for the day. This would give us a place to drop our luggage, access a pool and restaurant, and spread out before heading to the airport. We decided to book a room as opposed to paying to access the pool for the day as we wanted a placed to shower, etc. after the pool. The hotel is clean and the pool area was great. The staff is professional and friendly, and the poolside restaurant had good food. The only downside was that there was a FL high school business event for high school students this weekend. There were hundreds of high schoolers making it difficult to navigate at times, crowded, and quite loud. I would definitely use this as a landing spot again, but would call in advance to ask whether the hotel was hosting a convention/workshop on site.

We had a great spring break trip at the Hilton Orlando. There is no shortage of fun activities including a water slide, lazy river and basketball court. My husband enjoyed the gym too. Rooms are clean & spacious and there are several restaurants including family friendly options. We enjoyed a cabana for a day and the service was great. Thank you to Angel for making sure we were well taken care of. We are already looking forward to our next visit.

Beautiful hotel, really great views of the city and international drive. The breakfast was overpriced and nothing crazy, but the other food was very good. Plenty of amenities and activities for families to do. Had a great time in the pool and the basketball courts were up to date.

Amazing hotel and event space! Clyde in guest services was so friendly and professional. He made check in easy and ensured my friends and I had rooms near one another. Hotel was clean and laid out very well. Signs clearly posted to help navigate where to go. I liked it had a 24 hour store that had an array of food options.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I had booked the Signia By Hilton at Bonnet creek Orlando, for a one night stay with my wife and 1 year old child for a disney weekend stay. When I arrived at the hotel I had decided to leave my vehicle with a valet for peace of mind and security. On the night of September 23rd, while my vehicle was under the care of the valet overnight parking at your Hilton location, it was broken into. This led to considerable damages. Naturally, I was shocked and expected the hotel to handle the situation promptly. Unfortunately, that was not the case. I immediately reached out via email and phone, providing all necessary details, and have been patiently waiting for over a year for a resolution. No one has responded to my calls or emails, and my situation has been completely ignored. This is absolutely unacceptable for a brand as large as Hilton. Guests trust their properties for safety and security, but it appears they do not take responsibility when things go wrong. I am still waiting for any acknowledgment or assistance from them. This level of customer service is appalling. If you care about your safety and want a hotel that actually addresses issues, I highly recommend avoiding this location.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Our family had a wonderful time staying at the Signia by Hilton at Bonnet Creek. The pool was perfect for our kids, and we spent the entire day there during our "off-day" from visiting Disney. We had a great time chatting with Mariano who was our waiter at Beech. He was extremely friendly, and was kind enough to offer some tips and tricks when visiting Disney. As this was our first trip to WDW, we were lucky to get some extra inside info from a local. Mariano was really fun to chat with and the hotel (and guests) are lucky to have him. Thanks Mariano!!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Excelente! Personal del recepción muy buena actitud y servicio 😃, la limpieza súper impecable lo recomiendo mucho y volveré 🙂, la pisicina es muy divertida se puede usar hasta las 10 pm no había estado en una piscina, el parque de tracciones está muy cerca..

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This is my second stay here. Once way back in 2017 and now 2024. This hotel is top notch. Awesome resort property. You can’t go wrong staying here. Maybe next time I’ll have more time to enjoy more of what they offer. Very convenient to all of Disney.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This was my third time bringing my family to stay at this resort. As always, the staff was absolutely amazing. Super friendly and accommodating. A few team members that went above and beyond were Robin (EA), Mitch (Sales) and Elle (Front Desk). The room and hotel were super clean, as well as the pool area(s). The team was so on point the entire stay, even though they had a huge conference arriving. We tried the golf practice area at the Waldorf Astoria. That was very nice. Also, the food was excellent and the fitness center was clean and had everything we needed to (try) and stay in shape during the vacation. Overall, an absolute gem of a hotel.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Worst experience ever. We checked out 6 days ago and the hotel is refusing to pay me over $500 back that they owe me in a refund from the pre authorisation charge taken at check in. No one at the hotel will accept the mistake, they have been so rude, consistently being condescending. And racking up further bills when I have to phone them to try and sort this out with them and my bank. Currently to no avail. Do not stay here, they take your money at check in and don’t give it back!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This hotel is beautiful, most staff were friendly and helpful. One stand out team member? Melanie at Myth- the main bar in the lobby. Melanie was everything you look for while on vacation- someone personable, sweet, knowledgeable, accommodating, and the entire meal was fantastic because Melanie made sure we had everything we needed. She exceeded our expectations and made this experience bright and beautiful. Kudos also to Rocky at Harvest Bistro- a loyal, dedicated and charming human. About the resort: The lazy river was just perfect. Spa service was a short golf cart ride away at the Waldorf. The grounds are clean and the property is easy to navigate. We are locals, and we will stay-cation here again!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Horrible service. They continue to change the check in times and constantly try to charge additional fees. I ask for a manager and corporate phone number and they refused to provide it. I usually always stay at hotels in the Marriott chain and this reinforces that decision. I hold honesty and respect as the highest pillars of a business. I could not believe the rude and unprofessional interactions of the staff. Very very disappointed by this location.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Signia Bonnet Creek is a lovely and large property located close to Disney world. It is easily accessible to the main high way but is really inside the Walt Disney World roadways which is a plus. Definitely more convenient than any of the Disney Spring properties. We stayed for five nights as part of a family vacation. The best part of this visit was the size of the room. We booked a Junior king suite that included a sitting area with a wall separating the king bed. The room also had a large table with two chairs for dining or working. The room was spacious and was perfect for the whole family. In addition to this, the view at night was great! Because our room faced Disney Springs, we got to see the nightly Drone show at 9:00 pm and on July 4th we got to see about three different fireworks displays without paying extra for a fireworks view. The Drone show will be occurring until September 2, 2024 so it is a nice perk. We requested a high floor prior to checking in and were located on the 16th floor in room 1608. If you book any rooms on floor 14 or higher facing Disney Springs (not the pool or Disney View) you should be able to see the drone show. While the hotel has several food options, room service menu is limited midday or late afternoon so be aware of that. We ate breakfast at Harvest Bistro each morning and the Buffett was worth the price. The service there was top notch. Some days kids ate free for breakfast, some days they didn’t not sure why and didn’t question it because it says five and under eats free so if it was free we kept quiet about it. Also at La Luce, it states online that kids eat free ordering from the children’s menu but you have to tell them that your kids are children and remind them that they should eat for free or else you have to pay. Our best meal was the sushi from Seta, we ordered at the bar and ate in our room which was nice. The shuttle bus to the parks is nice and is pretty punctual you just need to use the app to make sure you are at the bus stop on time. Pick-ups are also at specific times so we usually took a Lyft to return to the hotel instead of waiting. We booked a prepaid room using a AAA discount that gave us a great rate and a fifty dollar daily credit. When we checked out, the credit was not listed so we had to go to the front desk and get the credit added on so keep an eye on you bill upon check out if you book a rate that includes a credit. Luckily the staff was very helpful and fixed our bill immediately so that was a plus. The cons we had were the bathroom was always hot and muggy whether we showered or didn’t shower. My guess is that it needs better ventilation. The pool area is expansive but many hotel guests are slobs and leave cups, cans, and food containers all around the lazy river and pool steps. More pool attendants and stricter rules might help minimize this mess because some people are just sloppy. I feel bad for whoever has to clean up after the messy guests. Also, being a pet friendly hotel has its downside, one day a guest with a dog allowed it to poop in the lobby by the elevators and did not pick up after it, again this is a reflection of the guest, not the hotel. Our last cons were that the restaurants let a table have its barking dog which made for an awkward dinner at La Luce, this made us not go back there. Please note that the water slide closed at 6:00 sharp so do not expect to have it open in the evening. Otherwise we had a nice stay and we would definitely stay here again because the room was great and the location and view were above average.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This is a great hotel, I don’t like crowded places but even thought the building is big it is very kids friendly and easy to get around . Polk is fantastic and had the DJ all day, food is good and everyone can find something they like, even with gluten and dairy sensitivities. I used the spa and Jermaine was fantastic doing my massage and he literally fixed my shoulder pain.I also booked my facial with Maria V and she was fantastic. I recommend it !

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Lovely, clean, new hotel with outstanding pool, helpful staff and quiet, comfortable rooms. Easy access to Disney and other Orlando parks. Tasty restaurants on site, including grab and go for early theme park mornings. Family friendly restaurant hours. Highly recommended.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Wonderful stay at the hotel. The buses ran every 30 minutes to the parks and they were never crowded. All the personnel we experienced during this trip were very friendly and hospitable and we have even sent our family to stay here and they all return from their stay expressing the same satisfaction. This will definitely be our choice of hotel when we come to visit the Disney parks. Given that we traveled during cold weather (Thanksgiving week), we did not get to enjoy the pool area but definitely do plan to.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: 3.5 Stars. This hotel is a very nice non-Disney hotel that is convenient to the parks. The best part is the huge pool area, complete with lazy river and hot tub. We spent one afternoon at the Waldorf pool and that was super nice too - not so many kids. It is refreshing if you have older kids to not be inundated with Disney characters. The rooms are SMALL. For myself and two teens we had one King and one rollaway. There was hardly space to move around. The bathroom is more of a Hampton Inn style - sparsely designed with very few amenities. We got exactly three towels each day - no more. You don’t even get a pen to fill out the laundry sheet. Housekeeping came every day which these days feels like a luxury. If you have a problem it is impossible to get in touch with anyone. The front desk is understaffed and never answers the phone. The worst thing about this hotel is the awful shuttle bus service. If you are serious about visiting Disney parks, you must use Lyft or Uber. I was VERY disappointed in the shuttle bus frequency. Even if you got on a bus, it would usually visit two other stops before the hotel. And also there is very little information offered about where to meet the buses. Don’t use the shuttles! On the plus side, I enjoyed the food options on site - although it was expensive. The coffee shop was a great option for early morning and there was never a line. We also had a delicious meal at Luce - better than most Disney restaurants. Would I stay here again if visiting Disney parks? Probably not. It’s not worth the extra hassle and parking was expensive.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: 2/5: Firstly, even though I purchased a package that included parking their original folio added parking as an additional expense. Secondly, I left the hotel at ~830 am and returned ~ 930 am; when I came back, the room key did not allow access to the garage because their system had already checked me out and sent a folio. They issued me another access card, but who wants to go through that?

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: First time at this property and great experience. Really nice staff. Loved that we could control the room temperature! Most hotels now lock it at 68 which is too warm for sleep. Fitness center is nice but could be larger. So many people workout now so hotels need larger gyms. Still, a nice experience. Restaurants also good.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Advanced reserved golf course view King room and used digital check-in to reserve in advance. Arrived at hotel before noon and room was still not ready at 5:30 pm. Was offered comparable view room at front desk and when I arrived in my room had a parking lot view. Called guest services to try and make it right and was told the room I originally reserved had been given to another guest. Highly recommend calling local front desk reservations in advance to confirm room reservation so you don’t end up in a bait and switch situation.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I had the great opportunity to dine at Beech for lunch with 3 colleagues during a conference. Several of us descended upon the poolside eatery at once. Mariano quickly assessed the situation and jumped right in to help his team. Observing his haste, I made eye contact and he came to assist promptly. He took our drink and food order immediately to get ahead of the crowd. Two of us changed our drink and food order after hearing the third, Mariano didn't blink nor complain. When he returned with the drinks precisely as we ordered, and when he returned with the food, he instinctively brought the check. The next day, I returned with two other colleagues the next day where we received equally prompt and great service from Alyssa who was literally running feverishly to service her tables, I asked for the manager and relayed this sentiments expressed here to Brian. He was thankful for the feedback and I was happy to deliver it... Job well done!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Our wonderful experience would not have happened if not for Alexia at the front desk - she was so helpful in getting everything we needed - from big to small / she took care of it - will definitely come back and it’s because of Alexia - thx again - you were great

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: The rooms were so clean and nice! The beds were very comfortable. Quick trip to Disney and Disney Springs. We loved the mile of sidewalk. Great for walking and lots of green space! Our daughter ran the Disney Marathon and they even had a Marathon Party at 2:30 am!! Wow! Buses run to Disney Theme parks - this was so convenient.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Desde nuestro arribo al hotel empezamos a vivir la cordialidad de los miembros del equipo de este lugar. En el front desk alguien de hacer notar por su amabilidad es Emily que nos ayudó con con lo confuso de la transportación a los parques ella se tomó el tiempo de llamar a la compañía de buses para aclarar nuestra duda y siempre que le solicitamos algo siempre amable y sonriente. Megan and Jill cada vez que necesitamos algo por medio del servicio texto siempre respondieron prontamente y nos solucionaron nuestras solicitudes. En el restaurante Harvest Bistro las veces que comimos allí Jeff, John y el nombre del otro mesero creo que es Chris fue estupendo siempre a la altura de nuestras expectativas. Las instalaciones muy confortables y limpias La habitación muy cómoda y con todo lo necesario para una estadía como se espera de un Hilton, lo único fue lo de la calefacción de la habitación que se sentía fría, la temperatura estaba entre 70 y 73 grados Fahrenheit y a nosotros nos gusta a 75 nos comunicamos con Front desk quienes mandaron a alguien de mantenimiento pero siempre se sintió igual hasta nuestra partida. Con lo de la transportación de los parques hacia el hotel en un par de ocasiones pudimos ver iba gente de pie en especial en nuestro último día que el bus iba repleto de huéspedes sentados y de pie. En general una estadía excelente.
Clara was fantastic! Such an attentive and kind server.

Castle Hotel te brinda una increíble experiencia el trato de su personal como el Sr. Joel fue muy grato, volvería a este hotel un y mil veces y lo puedo recomendar a todos a ojos cerrados, si Disney es tu destino nada mejor que este increíble Hotel.

The location is convenient if you’re heading to Universal’s Epic Universe. But don’t let that fool you — this hotel is a nightmare. - Online check-in is a joke. It only spits out a room number. The mobile key doesn’t work at all, so you’re forced to waste time at the front desk for a physical card. - The property feels tired and neglected. Hallways reek of dampness, and the rooms look dated. - No bottled water in the room. When I called, they promised “free water” in 5 minutes — instead they sent overpriced “premium water.” When I double-checked, they admitted it was chargeable. Apparently, free water is only at check-in, but they didn’t bother to give us any, you also need to return it at check-in counter. - The billing is outrageous. Two days after leaving, I was hit with bogus charges: parking (we didn’t park!) and a mysterious room rate fee. When I called, they shrugged it off as “probably a mistake” and told me to wait and see if it actually gets charged. This is beyond sloppy — it’s downright dishonest. The management is chaotic, the staff either clueless or careless, and the whole operation feels like a scam. Don’t waste your money here. It will ruin your trip.

We had a wonderful stay at the Castle Hotel. The service was excellent and the staff went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. Everything felt thoughtfully arranged, from the provided water to the convenient pantry with medicine available for when you need it. The staff were all kind and helpful. A special thank you to Kiara, who checked us out—she was incredibly sweet and made our last interaction a warm and friendly goodbye. Another staff member, a blonde woman at the front desk, was also extremely helpful with information about Universal’s Halloween Horror Nights, giving us clear directions and transportation tips that made our trip much easier. Overall, our stay was a 10/10 experience. Clean, comfortable, and welcoming from start to finish. Highly recommend the Castle Hotel!

She made our check-in process smooth and seamless, walking me through everything and even handing me a brochure with local attractions to explore. Her professionalism and warmth set the tone for a great stay. And I can’t forget Carolyn—she truly went above and beyond! When I realized our flight was much later than expected, I asked about a late checkout for myself and my 11-year-old daughter. Thank you for living up to — and exceeding — the high standards we expect from Marriott. Luis at the pool — after staying here nearly ten times, this was the first time we had a truly standout poolside experience! Your cocktail skills are top-notch, and your cheerful, welcoming presence made our afternoons a blast. You managed multiple tabs for my (very needy) colleagues while keeping us well-fed and well-hydrated — salud! You took great care of my wife for five days straight, and your dedication made her stay exceptional. Castle, you’ve got something special here. Holden and Luis didn’t just give us a hotel stay — they turned it into a resort experience. Thanks for making my Ambassador Elite status truly worth it!

This drink brought me back to the motherland, Russia. The icy coolness of the beverage when freshly served brought me back to the deep tundra of northern Russia. Hotel is super dated, room smelled like bleach, bathroom was a little dirty when I arrived. They charge $27 a day for parking and will give you a sign to put on your dash, but sometimes they fail to mention that it cost money. I called and asked about it and the lady at the front desk on 2/20 around noon eastern time didn't really care and just said, "well it's on our website and should've been mentioned by the person when you checked in." I must add that it's literally a parking lot, there's no security, no gate arm, or anything like that. It's a regular parking lot. The only reason I'm writing this review is because of the way I was treated when I called and asked about it. I wasn't even calling to get a refund/credit or anything like that. I was letting them know I wasn't aware and maybe they can be sure to mention that to future guests. I was just treated like my experience didn't matter and I should've visited their website. I travel for work and booked this hotel the same day (yesterday) that I checked in. I shouldn't have to visit the hotel's website when I'm not even using it to reserve the room when the front desk could've been courteous and mentioned that WHILE GIVING ME THE PARKING PASS. I'll never be back here again...$209 was the rate and ended up being $260 when it was all said and done with a $27 money grab. Have already reported them to Bonvoy.

Joe is a doorman extraordinaire! He is engaging, helpful , and informative . He offered some great tips during our trip and was a welcomed friendly addition to our Christmas Vacation. I would recommend talking to Joe about Orlando and just a great conversation.

I called the front desk to ask for the recommended temperature to put on the thermostat since the night of my stay was going to be a very cold night. The staff at the Castle hotel are amazing! They remember us every year that we come for an annual conference, and treat us so kindly. The hotel is fine, clean and in a strategical location. The staff is friendly and helpful. We had a chance to talk to Joe: a great guy, ready to help people, let them feel al home and ... very well prepared on GOLF ⛳️! Thanks. Happy to have been here.

Amazing service by Yucepp, food and attention were great! Clean and nice atmosphere! We enjoy all the food and the coffee was amazing. Overall the experience in the restaurant was great we enjoy each other and had a great time during our meal

This hotel is probably one of the best in Orlando. If you’re not staying here you’re missing out. Such a friendly staff. Holden at the bar in the evenings is the best bar tender I’ve ever had hands down. The rooms are always clean, the staff is always nice. Just simply the best hotel in Orlando!

My daughter and I celebrated our 40th & 16th birthdays. This hotel was a great choice. Staff was amazing, very welcoming, friendly and accommodating. Decor was beautiful.. The dining experience for breakfast was great! Ms. P provided exceptional service during breakfast

This hotel is absolutely brilliant. Excellent rooms, immaculate and clean. Staff are amazingly helpful and so curtious and cheery. Go above and beyond with any requests. Nicolle has phenomenal customer service. I needed my complimentary robe and free water, and she made sure I received all my amenities. I love the location because it was backed up to Pirate Cove and Icon Park.

Holden and David were amazing and made every accommodation when an issue arose. The housekeeping left something to be desired. They were reluctant to clean the room fully and made excuses when asked. The front desk was kind and hospitable. Overall this was a good experience.

Joel the engineer was so polite and quick to resolve our situation. Breakfast was Amazing, the pool was perfect, the staff are very friendly and welcoming. We definitely coming back. Great Front desk .Parking availability, many restaurants in the area

I had a fantastic stay at the castle hotel in Orlando last week! The front desk staff was amazing, providing exceptional service with a smile. They were friendly, helpful, and made me feel right at home. The bedding was top-notch, super comfortable, and ensured a great night's sleep. The hotel's castle themed ambiance was truly magical, adding a special touch to my stay. I highly recommend this hotel for a unique and wonderful experience in Orlando!

David is the best bartender ever! He really do amazing cocktails, is super nice and respectful. He even takes the time to know the customers. Really great experience and service. Castle hotel has amazing staff. My daughters and husband love this hotel. Definitely will come again.

Room was very clean and comfortable. The art and decor is very unique and stylish. All of the staff I encountered were smiling and eager to assist whenever I requested something. No issues at all with my stay. Lina at front desk was awesome! Food at restaurant in house and also nearby at icon park are clean and tasty. Service was great as well. I know I forgot a few names but can’t forget faces when everyone was smiling and happy even at 11pm/midnight

Last stayed here in Nov 2021 when it was under going some renovations. We had no complaints then and thought that it would be great when finished We were right, a short stopover 2 nights Orlando, saw reviews were good and price was very good so booked it Arrival, staff excellent, the room was great and lived up to what we foresaw in 2021 Bed very comfortable Breakfast was good Location excellent for International Drive bars and restaurants Highly recommend a visit Sure we will be back when in Orlando

David at Castle Hotel was absolutely phenomenal! He was so accommodating and attended to my needs right from the poolside. I signed up through Resort Pass and I swear to you this has been a highlight of my whole trip! Book now and get your experience with David!

Love this place! The restaurant staff is consistently dependable! Consistency is of utmost importance to me… especially in the coffee game… they have it. :) it’s always clean and smells wonderfully. The workout room is always clean! The rooms are clean! The pillows and linens are so soft!

Customer service is poor. They’ll advise you can have late check out till 3pm when you check in, but when trying to arrange they change it to 12pm. The rooms, in fact the whole hotel, is very dated. The doors fit poorly and you’ll constantly hear traffic from either the freeway behind the hotel, or international drive at the front. Our room frequently smelt of marijuana despite neither of us taking it. The only redeeming feature of the hotel is the location, and the housekeeping staff who do a great job.

Staid for 11 nights. Have to agree with the others that the rooms were cleaned every day but minimum done. My bed was made but even though the sheets were dirty as spilt drink on them not changed so slept in dirty bedding for a week. Carpet only vacuumed once in our stay brushed every other day so feet often black when walking on it. Very dated but everything worked and they kept up with the maintenance, Didn’t want a bath as the enamel had worn off the bottom and was very scratchy and yes air con kept us awake as so noisy but at least we had aircon. Staff were very helpful and friendly and food was very good but only ate a few times in hotel restaurant. There is only a complimentary bus to Universal you have to pay to go to the other parks by bus and only pick up once a day. Pool was brilliant at the end of the day but far too busy if you did not reserve beds early you had nowhere to sit seemed like everyone was using the pool near us. There was maintenance work being carried in other parts so not sure if any other pools open and work was done with the minimum amount of disruption as possible. Three stars is due to state of rooms and beds not being changed even though dirty.

This hotel located on International Drive is ideal for visiting all the attractions with a free shuttle to and from the hotel to Universal Studios . The hotel is a bit dated but functional . Plenty of parking , nice restaurant and bar. There’s an outside pool which was lovely .

Only given a 3 for location and breakfast. The room size and layout is exactly the same as Disneys Caribbean beach resort, that's where the similarity ends. The bathroom floor was filthy and I had to clean it before using, used toilet roll and picked up a large amount of hair and debris. From then on I wore my crocs and the one time I didn't my feet were dirty from the carpet. The whole room was in need of updating . No where to hang wet swimwear or clothes. Rooms dark as the windows have to be tinted so that people walking past don't stare in. Although it's close to he i4 we couldn't hear the noise of that over the din of the air con. We only went for a week, we couldn't have stayed there any longer than that. The buffet breakfast was good with a great selection. Shuttle bus only goes 3 times in the morning and late afternoon/evening and ubers are a nightmare for pickups from universal and cost $18. No parking or resort fees which is a real bonus. Have been going to Orlando for many years and this was the best location on idrive but the worst hotel we've stayed in. We had asked to move because of the noise of the air con and were told emphatically NO! The 3 stars is generous.

I would like to thank misha and terry -anne and there team for a nother lovely holiday at the rosen the hotel is in an ideal position on idrive for eating and drinking and getting to shops and parks it is very competitively priced you get what you pay for its clean and comfortable the staff are second to none from the cleaners to the bar staff and security special mention to Cyril Ricardo and karelle in the bar and the lady who does the cooking who makes the nicest cheeseburger in orlando!! All the food in the bar is excellent and has a great atmosphere every night also special mention to julio and jose on security but all the staff are very friendly and helpful we will be back again very soon ... ...

Stayed here for 10 days for my 50th birthday was a great hotel and a great holiday. Rooms are a great size with two double beds. Check in was smooth and quick all you want after a long flight Cleaner comes every day to your room would highly recommend this hotel

As the title says, this is my 5th visit to this hotel since first coming in 2013. To be honest, there’s not many negatives to say about the hotel; however, the major downside is that in the 11 years I’ve been coming, nothing has changed. The hotel is in need of a refurbishment so the rooms are a bit more welcoming. Currently they are very dark and gloomy and the shower is dated and signs of black mould. This time staying there are people smoking cannabis which isn’t great and the hotel needs to clamp down on this in my opinion. Some staff are rather noisy in a morning talking very loud outside the rooms, but I’m being fussy here. The good points are the staff are really nice in both the shops and the bar staff work hard as ever. There’s still karaoke a couple of times a week by the Mark and he was here in 2013. I would like to bring management attention to Randy in the shop. He’s a really great guy and you’re lucky to have him. He’s friendly and always willing to chat. The pool was rammed this time around for some reason and typically British putting towels down like they do haha. So I didn’t bother with the pool. Great that guests have access to free transportation to universal but this needs looking at. The system is a first come first serve in the way back and I seen British people arguing because it’s a free for all. You have to book going and I think should be the same coming back. It can horrendous All in all, I’m always happy to stay here and I’ll come back again but I’d only come after it’s been refreshed. The rooms are so outdated sadly and needed looking at. Other thin that, thanks to all at the Rosen Inn at Pointe Orlando, especially for accommodating my disabled needs. Derek

This is a worn out hotel. We booked it to have somewhere to sleep during our Orlando stay and ended up here because it was close to the malls we wanted to visit and of course to universal. The rooms doesn’t feel that fresh and the cleaning is alright but not great. Outside our window the view offered a roof and a chimney which made the view very ugly. None of the common areas are renovated and the pool area is also a bit outdated. Wouldn’t stay here if you want to enjoy your hotel, but if you are just looking for somewhere to sleep it’s ok. Anyhow, the staff is alright - in one of the receptions a coordinator for universal is available during the day, at this counter you may also book your tickets for free to ride with the bus to universal. The reception for the hotel isn’t as helpful though. There are a lot of parking spaces available and feels safe to park the car in this place. Parking was included for us. In a few minutes walk you have a few souvenir stores and a Applebees, but with taking the car you will reach better restaurants in the neighborhood just a few minutes drive away. Overall this is a alright stay. But I would rather pay 10-50 dollars more to stay in a fresher hotel with more friendly staff. And also, be aware that there is a hotel on the same street with the same name (that is renovated and more fresh). We don’t know this before arriving and the GPS made us go there first and we actually tried to check in until the staff figured we went to the wrong place and helped us find the right hotel.

To be honest we booked this hotel through Virgin holidays as it was the cheapest on the basis it was really somewhere to crash and sleep whilst visiting the usual orlando attractions. Despite the well managed block refurbishments which didn't cause any issues, we were pleasantly surprised. Staff friendly and helpful. Our room was large, clean and even had coffee making facilities as well as microwave and fridge. (I think it was only a standard double room). Only 20 minutes drive from universal or disney parks. There are shuttle buses but we drove for flexibility. Small shop on site selling most things for toiletries, food drink and coffee although the walgreens over the road is cheaper. If or when should I say we return to orlando, no hesitation staying here again :)

This is my 6th stay at this hotel in 30yrs! Admittedly it wouldn't be my first choice had I had a much larger budget or if it was a relaxing, sunbathing holiday but I find this hotel good vfm if you'd prefer to spend yr money on trips etc. Hotel is basic. Buffet breakfast is simple but adequate $17 pp. Hotel is clean. Basic bar with pool table. Pint beer and spirit with mixer $17, alcohol seems expensive everywhere. Lite bites shop and coffee shop on site too. Free and ample parking. Rooms are basic but clean and very comfi bed. The air con is noisy and fbe rooms are a bit dark. Coffee making facilities topped up daily. Housekeeping daily. Fridge, TV, safe, microwave, iron and board, hairdryer all in room. Ice machines and drink vending machines in each block. Pool towels and sun loungers supplied. Hotel has a fantastic location opposite restaurants and entertainment venues. Pizza hut opposite does great pizzas altho the restaurant is tired but can order take out. Our room was I Drive side which I was pleased about as quieter than I4 side. We were block D level 3. A Reception staff friendly. All in all, I'd say this hotel is well worth a stay for those willing to compromise a tad on where they'll sleep, given you'll be out all day. Building work just starting on block E. Very tidy site and didnt hear a peep Well done to cleaning and grounds teams.

First time to the US, Spent 14 nights here and I have to say I cannot fault the staff or the hotel at all really. Everyone we had to interact with were friendly and helpful. Car parking was easy and plenty of it. it was totally clean and fit for what I wanted it for as a base for the parks and exploring Orlando. Also on the Orlando note, the location of this hotel is ideal! Everything is within a short drive or you can hop on the I Drive Trolley directly outside and go enjoy the nightlife. Also I thought the bar at the hotel was a great atmosphere. If i had to pick on some of things, only minor things, it would be… 1) I wish the fridge had a small freezer. 2) i wish there was some extra sockets in my room that were not in a lamp or radio as I couldn’t fit my travel adapter in them due to its shape so had to buy a USA usb plug while out there. Neither of these had an impact on my holiday though so I have not changed the 5 rating. Overall I loved it here, and would love to come back! Thank you for playing your part in making my holiday enjoyable! Worth every penny.

Muy contenta con la experiencia que me brindó el hotel, la temporada de verano fue la mejor junto a mis amigos. La piscina es buena, el hotel tiene la mejor vista a la ciudad y las mejores facilidades. Buena ubicación con restaurantes y tiendas cerca. Sin duda volvería.

Antes de elegir este hotel vi opiniones muy polarizadas. O muy buenas, o muy malas. Me decidí mas que nada por la ubicacion y el costo y la verdad la estancia no fue para nada mala, sino al contrario. El check in fue muy rapido y el personal super amable. La habitacion si adolece de unos cuantos años, pero no es como dicen muchos por allí de "motel". He estado en lugares bastante peores y mas caros. Por el precio que se está pagando (de lo mas barato sin llegar a ser cadena "budget"), todo está aceptablemente bien. La TV funcionaba bien y era bastante nueva (de lo mas nuevo), refrigerador, horno de microondas, etc. El baño y el agua caliente bien. La cama bastante comoda. El cuarto fué limpiado todos los dias. No utilicé los otros servicios del hotel como la piscina. En general me fuí bastante satisfecho. Cosas positivas: + Ubicacion + Costo beneficio + Todo en la habitacion fué funcional sin ningun disgusto + Estacionamiento gratuito + Fee de 50 dolares independiente a la cantidad de noches Negativas: - Mobiliario un poco anticuado en la habitacion - El hotel tiene sus años, por lo que puede derivar en otro problema (aunque no me sucedió) como insectos, olores o funcionalidad en algunos casos

Just had another 3 weeks holiday at the Rosen Inn at Points Orlando Would like to thank Misha and her team for a warm welcoming and excellent service of looking after you and seeing to all your needs.Also thanks to all the bar staff in Zebras Cyril, Ricardo,Will and Kharyl for some great night's in the bar very pleasant and hard working lads and Mark on the karaoke.Also a special thanks to all security staff for all there hard work.Will definitely seeing you all again in November.Thanks again for another great stay

Myself and my auntie stayed here in September 2023, place was a little outdated not modern but for a place to sleep it was rather okay. Only downside was the pools were regularly closed possibly due to weather so understandable but the location was great with a bus stop outdoors in front of the hotel. They had a really nice restaurant inside with optional outdoor seating and great karaoke. Loved my stay non the less

Location cannot be beat, walk to Icon Park or all that I-Drive offers. Room d we xor is a little dated but clean and comfortable with good beds, a refrigerator, and microwave. On site restaurant, small grocery, and gift shop. 3 pools and 2 heated plus gameroom! Great value and $15 pet fee, the best in Orlando!

DO NOT... I repeat DO NOT go to this place. I was there and I had the most worst experience. The staff employers was awful and rude and even used racial words towards me. They had my dog and items held hostage. I was so devastated when the guard told me that he will take my service animal. I pleaded with them to please open the door for me and they would not open. .I was in the hot sun over 23 minutes waiting or someone to open the door to get the keys, purse and my beloved dog once it locked behind me. In addition, because they were wrong the man Jose followed behind me, taking pictures of me using words that were not choicey. I had a prestigious business event where I had to were all white preparing my self to stay in another one of the rooms and missed the entire event that was the reason I was there. If you do have pets DO NOT go there. The elevator with only 6 floors are extremely hot and slow. My items were left in there and the man Jose answered the line who harassed me saying that he was the owner when I was making a complaint. This is the worst experience for me I have ever encountered in my entire life and I will be contacting PETA of the situation trying to hold my pet hostage and threatening me of keeping my pet and purse items!!!!! I was scared to even go back because the man Jose was harassing me and trying to reflect and tarnish my character. After that I just left and not stay another day!!

Hotel con buen relacion precio/calidad en Orlando, muy carca del centro de cnvenciones Orange. Buenas instalaciones, habitaciones correctas, buenas camas, muchas piscinas chicas, son varios edificios rodeados de jardin, tiene parking y un minigimnasio. Las habitaciones tienen cafetera, microondas, heladera,etc. Tienen un bus de cortesia al paruqe Universal y la zona es linda y tiene muchas opciones de restaurantes y lugares de diversion, como Wonderworks, Skydiving, paseos en helicoptero, etc. Quiero destacar la excelencia de la manager Delmi que resolvio un error mio en la registraccion con mucha empatia y rapidez, junto con Ivonne quien es nueva en el staff y tiene una simpatia y actitud fabulosa, y te hace sentir bienvenido en el hotel. Cabe destacar que ellas tambien hablan español y eso es un plus para los que no dominamos el ingles. Hasta Pronto.

This hotel is a good value at a great location. 48 hours before our arrival we called the hotel. Our reservation had been cancelled. After hours on the phone with hotel and the 3rd party booking, the hotel eventually found it and reinstated it. A couple hours later we called again to confirm the reservation. Our flight was several hours late and upon arrival at 12:30am at the hotel we were first told we did not have a reservation. After some delay we were informed we had already been "checked in." Waiting for about an hour to fix the hotel's mistake to be resolved we were checked in. Upon approaching the room we found the door open, lights on, empty liquor bottle on the table, and bath linens on chairs. Hotel security escorted us to our 2nd room. We discovered this room had a malfunctioning shower valve so it was cold shower. Our 3rd room the next day was fine. When the reservation was reinstated it changed from a 5 night reservation to a 1 night reservation. After spending an hour or so the next day with front desk manager it was finally resolved to 5 nights. The manager did confirm the hotel kept the funds from our first reservation so we did end up paying for our rooms TWICE. For the $750 overpayment and inconvenience of the all the hotel reservation mistakes we were graciously provided 2 breakfast coupons. We've stayed at the hotel several times and this stay will likely be our last.

We stayed for six nights and although the room was dated it was very clean. Great location, wonder works is opposite and lots of places to eat. Pool areas were clean and the hotel is well cared for. Excellent value for money and all the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. I would happily come back year after year!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Son unos delincuentes. Te cobran el uso de piscina y gim más tasas. Eso no se aclara en la reserva por qué de lo contrario hubiésemos ido a otro hotel. Entiendo las tasas locales pero piscina y gim unos verdaderos delincuentes. Les seguirémos publicando mi familia y yo por lo menos para que estafen a menos familias.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Truly gorgeous hotel and amenities and first rate staff. The treats that were sent for my birthday were absolutely beautiful! Kudos to the restaurant manager and staff! I did not expect such a wonderful surprise. We will be back FOR SURE!!!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We went to the pool bar, Beech, and were served by Ricky who was absolutely amazing. He was very attentive with our orders and was so funny. We really enjoyed the food and drinks. The atmosphere with the pool was enjoyable. Would definitely recommend this spot and definitely ask for Ricky!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Wonderful hotel. There were attentive and friendly staff members everywhere. Small touches to improve the experience everywhere. The room was very comfortable and the food was amazing as well. Highly recommend.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Beautiful resort. Guest amenities and grounds were wonderful! Loved the food shop in the lobby. The bar was really nice and fun. Pool was beautiful! Close proximity to Disney parks. Just watch the fireworks from the hotel and a wood the crowds at the parks! We will definitely stay here again.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: What an amazing place to bring your family. Everything from the room, pool, dining and accommodations to Disney was top notch. The harvest bistro staff were absolutely the best (Erica, Rickey and Stan) for breakfast and lunch made the experience unforgettable.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Jason at the Beech is an exceptional staff member. He provided us with excellent service and is just so nice!! The food was delicious (super spicy wings, yum) and great cookie ice cream sandwich. Highly recommend!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Front desk staff was very friendly. Housekeeping staff provided the items promptly we needed. Only negative feedback which is not the fault of this hotel- $30 room credit per day for 2 guests as a Diamond Member is insufficient to make use for Breakfast in this property. Overall an enjoyable stay.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We just recently completed our 12th stay at the Signa by Hilton at Bonnet Creek. There is so much we love about the resort it's hard to know where to start, however, I am on Trip Advisor to specifically highlight a great experience I had with the housekeeping staff, in particular Marta Caceres. I had returned to my room only to find the inside latch engaged, leaving me unable to enter with my key card. I was slightly startled by this, as I was concerned that someone may have accessed our room. Marta happened to be working in the guest room next to mine, noticed this issue, and took proactive steps to see if she could help. She immediately notified her supervisor to help me get in contact with security. As I waited, Marta ensured she stayed close and assured me she wouldn’t go far until I was back in my room and until things had been checked out. In the end, we don’t know how the inside latch was engaged, however, security was able to get us back into our room without incident. It’s people like Marta that create these memorable, people-first experiences that keep us coming back. She went above and beyond in helping me resolve the issue and in also making me feel comfortable. There are many things to love about this resort, from their amazing lazy river, slide, zero entry pool, restaurants, arcade, lounges, etc, but it’s the people that really set this beautiful resort apart.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This resort is so beautiful! The experience was one of a kind from the moment I checked in to the moment I checked out. All of the staff was wonderful. Specially Alexia and Daryus who made my staycation magical. I will absolutely come back for future occasions because nothing will top this wonderful experience.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We stayed there for the first time and was excited to spend our holiday there. We had a few issues with the confirmation on the phone a week before we arrived a lot of misinformation. We arrived and I must say the front desk team was awesome!! Cleared up all misinformation and effectively took care of our reservation. The front desk turned our whole experience around ! !! That was until we entered our room…. There turned out to be many different things that occurred during our stay that fell short of our experiences we have had staying at other Hiltons. I responded to the survey the hotel sent out detailing some of our experiences both positive and some not so positive. I was not expecting a response but I got one. The response I received is what prompted me to write this review. The response addressed to us was incredibly insulting. It not only didn’t address any of our experiences but discussed an experience we never had. The response went to state it had read our survey and was addressing it with management team, when clearly they hadn’t, since they were addressing issues with us that we never had!!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Unos estafadores. NO se alojen en este hotel con la factura de salida te cobran el uso de gimnasio y piscina aunque ni lo hallas pisado más impuestos. Entiendo las tasas locales pero no la estafa de uso de zonas comunes como en cualquier hotel. Ya no piso nunca más una cadena HILTON .

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We had an amazing stay. Shoutout to the staff especially the pool manager Allison who went above and beyond! We couldn’t have asked for better service from the bartenders, wait staff to pool attendants. We loved the lazy river, restaurants, shuttle to Disney and lobby bar. We even ate twice at the Asian restaurant. Thank you Hilton staff for a truly memorable stay!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Fantastic service by all the staff. Bar service did a great job for our after hours events. Very nice rooms and lobby. Would stay here again for sure next time we have a conference or event. Thanks again

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: My family and I did a little stay cation and it was well worth it. Hotel staff is friendly and professional, and rooms were clean and comfortable. Food quality was great too. Restaurants located on property are of good quality and reasonably priced. I will recommend walking with snacks if you have small children below age 13 to cut down on cost.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Before arriving to Signia Hilton, I noticed that the room I was being assigned to was not going to work out for me due to my disability. I live locally (only an hour away from the hotel), and began a texting conversation with the front desk. Rodney was the gentleman at the other end of the conversation and assured me that my concerns would be taken care of by the time I arrived and would have a room for me that would better suit me. Due to most places not having ANY customer service any more, I did not have much faith. To my surprise, I was wrong. Upon.arriving, the valet team greeted me with a smile and were ready to help in any way that they could. After unpacking my truck and handling my luggage, I took the often dreaded trip to the front desk to check in. (A little background - I was completely humiliated at the Hilton St.Petersburg Bayfront and discriminated against and the only thing said to me after was that the guy said to me that he was sorry and just trying to do his job....)Any ways, to continue, Rodney had already changed my room and made sure that where he put me was sufficient for my needs and he actually upgraded me. I am a diamond member and upgrades only happen if rooms are available and they were hosting quite a large conference so I completely understood if they could not upgrade me. I was so relieved and elated that it was all taken care of and no humiliation on my part. Just happy tears. Thank you Rodney and the front desk team; obviously your manager believes in customer service because it all comes from the top. I stayed at the resort for 4 nights and had the best time with absolutely no complaints. Comfortable room, comfortable bedding, delicious restaurants, great bar service, great room service, great valet service; all.around 5 star service with every experience I had at the hotel. Thanks to all the employees for taking such great care of your guests. I cannot wait to do another staycation there!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We always choose Signa , the staff is the friendliest and the hotel is beautifully kept. Everything is clean and attention to guests is important to this hotel! The check on staff and messaging is amazing - but this visit I am calling out a special employee named Melanie at the bar , wow ! She kept us coming back nightly , she was very friendly and made us feel special - we would recommend this hotel to any type of group or visit .

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: La limpieza de la habitación corresponde a un hotel de 2 estrellas. Toallas sucias, cortina del baño sucia, muy poco higiénico. El lobby se transforma cada noche en un bar sucio y ruidoso. Jamás volveré.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Estafadores NO VALLAN a ese hotel me alojé con mi familia desde el día 29 de diciembre hasta el 4 de enero. Mi sorpresa a llegar a casa la factura del hotel 748,99 más 130,42 más 32,62. Si bien luego de quejarme me devolvieron el valet parking, me facturaron dos veces el parking normal. Debo aclarar que fui con hotel y desayuno pago. El resto es impuestos que te cobran por la cara ya que dicen son las instalaciones del hotel las cuales no use. En estos momentos estamos tratando con un abogado ya que nos informan de que esas tasas no son legales. Mi consejo después de pasar ya por 3 Hoteles HILTON es que no acudan a ellos, de esa cadena solo queda el nombre

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: El hotel está muy bien en todos los aspectos Muy contentos con nuestra estancia Los únicos inconvenientes fue que se reportó quebla caja de seguridad no funcionaba y no fueron a arreglarla El valet parking es tardado

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I usually stay there is one of my favorites Holiday Inn in the area. And the personal at the front desk are excellent, specially “Akeylah”.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The only place I’ll stay in Orlando. Akeylah is the greatest front desk person I’ve ever dealt with. Being diamond elite member I stay at IHG on a regular basis. The restaurant is fantastic. Always clean and comfortable.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I had the pleasure of staying at your hotel and had a wonderful experiencing the Seattle best coffee Café with Uhma the barista this was by far the best coffee I had in Florida. It’s definitely almost try.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Del personal de empleados Braulio fue el mejor Que nos atendió, muy atento, amable, y todos Fueron muy excelentes pero Braulio fue el que más destacó. 100% recomendado el hotel.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The attendants at the front desk went above and beyond with their customer service. They were professional yet kind. 10/10 These two deserve a raise!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The personal are the best and the most amazing people Toda la atención la limpieza del hotel estaban muy bien la comida siempre caliente el cuarto muy limpio en general el personal estaban super atentos El parqués amplio y el sitio del hotel todo estaba cerca

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I do a lot of business in Orlando and I always stay at Holiday Inn international drive. The staff is super friendly especially Akeylah she always gives me great service when I check in but the whole staff is excellent. You can’t go wrong staying here if you’re on business or vacationing at the parks.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great customer service!! The whole staff was very friendly, welcoming and accommodating!! I had to extend my trip three times! I feel my hotel room is an extension of my home… and it was spotless! First thing I do is check the bath and bed.. both super clean! Bright white sheets and towels! I have RSVPed four times, and the fifth in less than a week! Great location and walking distance from everything!! Thank you Akeylah, Anabel, Larysa…everyone!! See you in a couple days! :)

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: This is a utility hotel, convenient to pick up Greyline tours at the ICON wheel and there are plenty of chain restaurants nearby. The beds were comfortable and the towel swan an interesting touch. If you aren't planning to spend any time at your hotel other than 8 hours to sleep, it's fine.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Would like to give a shout out and many thanks to Anabel who is the front desk supervisor. First and foremost, besides her knowledge of the area, and her job, she was so accommodating to our EVERY need! We ended up extending our vacation two or three times with no issues from Anabel. In fact, she honored our rate every time and kept us in the same room. Besides her friendly excellent customer service, our room was very spacious with one of the most comfortable bed we've ever slept in! Along with the General Manager Atif, Anabel is one of the reasons this hotel has such good ratings and reviews. During our one hour conversation, I felt as Atif was one of my long time FD or Airline colleagues that I've known for years! He is one of the most easiest Hotel Managers I've ever talked to. He really knows how to run this awesome hotel and hire competent very customer service based employees. If you ever find yourself needing accommodations in the Orlando area stay here! You won't regret it! During your stay, make sure you oder a coffee from Samila who owns the coffee shop inside the Lobby serving Seattle's Best coffee. The prices are awesome, she is super nice and the coffee is great! Once again, thank you very much Atif and Anabel for making our week in Orlando a great one! ❤️

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Amazing traditional Indian flavors as well as American favorites. They have an authentic tandori oven where they cook everything including authentic naan bread. The service was second to none. A fantastic surprise. We will definitely be back.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I was staying here for a business trip, and my bar experience exceeded my expectations. Carissa went above and beyond, and did not disappoint. The food was excellent, and I would definitely stay here again. Ask for Carissa on your next visit, she’s amazing at what she does!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great stay . I loved holiday inn. Close to lots of restaurants of different cuisines within walking distance Very friendly staff and great bar tender Bar tender Carissa was very curteous The room was very clean The hotel area was very maintained

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Carissa made our visit unforgettable with her outstanding service. From the moment we sat down, she was attentive, friendly, and quick to recommend drinks that perfectly matched our tastes. Her cocktails were expertly crafted, each one a delightful blend of flavors. She has a genuine passion for her work, which was evident in every interaction, and it's no surprise that she's our favorite bartender. Beyond the drinks, the food was another highlight. We were impressed by how authentic and flavorful the dishes were. It felt like a true taste of the Indian cuisine, made with care and high-quality ingredients. Every bite was delicious! The entire experience—great drinks, tasty food, and exceptional service—made it clear that this place is worth returning to. I’m already looking forward to my next visit, and based on this experience, I know I’ll be back soon. The location is also fantastic, making it an ideal spot to relax and enjoy a meal or drink in a lively atmosphere.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The Bar is amazing and service is exceptional. The Bartenders Ezgi and Karissa are very attentive and fun to interact with. I highly recommend a visit to the bar. I have been impressed with the quality of food that is offered. The rooms are well maintained and management is always accessible for any issues

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Avi was super helpful to me and my family. She got us in early since we wanted to go to the parks. The location is super cool and the hotel is very accessible to icon park as well as has a bunch of information on the attractions nearby. Would recommend.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I so love the staff! Linda with guest services was the sweetest, kindest, caring and beautiful smile. I was having a very bad experience from a prior stay at another hotel; which was not Holiday Inn. She listened to me take and whine and when I was done she assured me that I would definitely enjoy my stay with her hotel, and my all means I did. Carissa is the bar Manager and she was such a people’s person! She so jolly, happy go lucky, friendly, with Amazing drink skills. I have never met a Bar Manager like her; EVER! Akeylah, is so soft spoken, but has a good demeanor to make all of the guest feel at home. I met Akeylah through Linda and I am so grateful to have met them both. I will miss the clean rooms, great breakfast, friendly staff and of course FUSION BAR!!! Until we meet again it’s been SUPER!!! Sincerely, Your favorite guest from Rm# 2225
