hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: We stayed here for our Orlando holiday and are very glad we chose this hotel. It’s centrally located for both parks, though Disney is a bit further than we initially thought. Positioned on International Drive across from the Icon Park, the hotel is surrounded by a fantastic variety of restaurants, so dining options are endless. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by how clean and well-presented the hotel is. Our room was spacious and equipped with everything we needed—apart from a safe, which would have been useful for our passports, but we found a way to secure them. Although we didn’t try the hotel restaurant, we became regulars at the coffee shop, which served great coffee to kick off our mornings. It also offers a nice selection of pastries and snacks. There’s a small shop in the hotel too, though we didn’t end up using it. The Wi-Fi worked well both in our room and in the lobby, which was a relief. Our only minor complaint would be the lifts—there are only two, and it felt like three would have been better given the demand. The hotel offers a shuttle to the parks, but the schedule wasn’t ideal for us, so we decided against using it. The staff were friendly, always available, and even kept their cool during Hurricane Milton. We did experience a Wi-Fi drop in our room during the storm, although the lobby Wi-Fi stayed on, which may have been an effort by management to create a sense of community. Overall, this hotel offers excellent value for the comfort level, and it’s perfectly central to everything. My wife and I would definitely stay here again. Thank you!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Carissa is easily one of the best bartenders I’ve ever had!! She makes some of the most beautiful drinks I’ve seen and they tasted even better!! Even the water was gorgeous! She was so attentive and the food was amazing too! Will definitely be coming back soon!

I've always enjoyed my stay there. The beds are really comfortable and everything is clean. They are always on-time especially when we asked for towels. We were there for a tournament, they had everything organized well. But being in the Florida Mall put this hotel over the top. You didn't have to leave unless you wanted to. Thank you.

High-level service, a very clean and organized hotel. A quiet room that provides you with a good rest and a great shower. You can also enjoy an incredible gastronomic experience. The staff is well-trained and attentive, striving to provide excellent service throughout your stay.

Great location! Many restaurants, Great gym, clean well kept pool. Clean hotel , no complaints- mall closed at7pm on sunday. Some restaurants and fast food open til 8pm. Huge parking lot. Bed / shower, all nice. Felt safe. Pool on first floor

Had the cleanest rooms and nicest people working there. My wife and I really felt safe. The breakfast was a little high but it was sensational. I loved the bar the were good and the food portions were large. I would tell anyone to book a room in your hotel.

Property was stellar and staff very accommodating. Great location and a very nice environment to relax. In driving distance to everything that makes Orlando great. Can’t wait to bring my family! And yes it is a dog friendly hotel what a wonderful stay

First let me say, I have no affiliation with The Florida Hotel in any manner. Having family near Orlando, my wife and I visit (usually a Disney resort) several times a year. Due to a convention held at the hotel, we decided to stay on site. The hotel staff were super! Everyone was friendly and engaging in a welcoming fashion. They did not take a back seat to our Disney experiences. While an older hotel, we had no problems with the updated rooms; everything was clean and neat. The bathroom offered the little bottles of shampoo, conditioner, and body lotion and not the wall-secured 'pump' bottles most places, including Disney, now provide. Off the lobby, there is a Starbucks cafe and a Chick-fil-a. The hotel offers a restaurant and a very nice bar (with food, drinks, and a great staff!) The hotel elevators are room key initiated adding to the feeling of security. Also, the hotel has a gated parking section which you enter with your room key. We really enjoyed and were very pleased with our stay at the Florida Hotel and easily recommend it!!

The room was clean and having the Florida Mall attached to the hotel is very convenient if you want to do some window shopping or are looking for a place to eat. The hotel staff was very helpul and friendly. There is always a security on guard so no need to worry

The staff is friendly and amazing, the rooms are spotlessly clean, the location is exceptional. The gym and pool area are well equipped and clean.Would highly recommend this hotel for business or leisure, there are many restaurants in the mall and within the vicinity.

Hotel is lovely Checkin was effortless, everything ready. Front desk staff very friendly and helpful. They gave great recommendations for what to do and an amazing dinner tip as well. Room was updated, very clean and well stocked with amenities. Pool was great Towels and lounge chairs available Had a great stay

Very quick and efficient check in. All staff polite and helpful. Meeting rooms are comfortable. The bedrooms were clean, large, and very comfortable. I usually can't sleep well on the first night in a new place, but do not have that worry here.

Very comfortable bed. Light spacious room. Immaculate clean with friendly cleaning staff. Fantastc, sun drenched pool about 6’ 4” in depth open 7am til 10pm. Lovely seating area outside to enjoy coffee or own food. Staff very helpful & friendly. A great hotel who genuinely seem to have their customers interest at heart & not just saying so as a marketing tool!

The room was clean and the amenities were great. The staff was outstanding! The conference rooms were clean. The staff assisted in anyway possible to ensure that you had a great stay. My family enjoyed the hotel connection to the mall and you had a wide variety of food to choose from.

Stay here a lot for work..this hotel is always clean, I feel safe when I stay here fit to the security measures they put in place. Front desk staff always nice and helpful. Restaurant is good as well. With it being attached to a mall is even better plenty of options!

An excellent hotel with a prime location. The room was spotless, and access to the mall was incredibly convenient. It was also very easy to reach places like BestBuy, Dollar Tree, and several other stores at Florida Mall. The staff was friendly and helpful, making our stay even more enjoyable. The amenities provided were top-notch, and the overall experience was fantastic. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area!

Excellent service, great hotel! We arrived late due to weather delays. The staff at the bar/restaurant that was open were understanding and accommodating to get us in as quick as possible. The food was excellent (love those sweet potato waffle fries). I loved the texting to check in, and the conference staff was amazing! Highly recommend to others for business & pleasure - great location with easy access to the mall.

I really like the hotel's service. They are always very good. The hotel is safe. The rooms are comfortable. The breakfast is delicious and the service provided from the all hotel staff is very attentive. And It is easy to shop at the mall. Thank you very much.

Regularly staying in many varied hotels around the world, The Florida Hotel is among my favourites. The staff are friendly and very helpful, the rooms are clean and comfortable and appear well noise insulated. The hotel offers a very good fitness center with numerous cardio, strength and weight options (a decent gym!) and a very nice pool/pool area. Reasonably priced food and drink available in Crickets bar and Marcelos restaurant. Located adjoining the Florida Mall, and only a short distance from both Orlando International Airport and International Drive attractions

Everyone at the Hotel was really friendly and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable. I will definetly come back for pleasure. The mall being attached to the hotel is an even better incentive. The Crickets Bar and Restaurant has amazing food and service also.

The staff are exceptional - it’s like home from home and the beds are 5 star you really fee part of the family.. the crickets staff are exceptional too as well as the reception staff very knowledgeable and helpful with queries- gym is very modern although some of the running machines could do with some TLc

We felt very well cared for, I appreciated the text from Clarissa at the front desk--just checking in with us to see if we needed anything! Jean was also so helpful with our luggage and the best attitude and big smile. The room was comfortable, the bed felt great, plenty of towels and amenities.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I came down for Hurricane relief. When I tell you guys this place has the best bar around!! Bar tenders Clarisa and Ezgi are amazing! Great drinks and the best bar foods I’ve heard of. How can you get chicken kabobs and steak at a bar! The chef makes the best seasoned foods I’ve had in Florida! I 100 percent recommend this place to everyone. I’ve stayed in 4 to 5 star hotels and when I say this place beats most, I mean it. Come check it out.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Last minute booking to the hotel but stayed in a double queen premium. I'm an IHG diamond so recieved free breakfast and a warm welcome. Hotel has clearly undergone some renovations recently (reception area and the living areas of the bedrooms). The hotel does the job and more, the rooms were really nice and really benefited from the renovation. Staff were polite. Unfortunately due to only staying 5 nights, i didn't get chance to see the pool but it looked good from a distance. Would stay again. Areas for improvement - The bathrooms could do with a refresh, as well as the lifts and the corridoors. - Having water fountains/machines on the hotel room floors.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Carissa is an amazing bartender, wonderful service, she is the best. The food and drinks were especially good!! The drinks she made me were amazingly amazing she really knows what she’s doing behind the bar!!! Love her! The whole staff is the bestest.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Fusion: Carissa greeted us with a warm welcome and interacted with my neice lots. She was open to feedback regarding the menu options. We suggested that the resturant advertises the pizza abit more, because we were not aware of this, until we had a conversation at the bar area with her. We ordered a side dish of fish and chips, which was a great portion size, and a lemonade, which we made an error with, but Carissa sorted this by turning it pink which impressed my neice and got a big thumbs up approval. Josh then come out to check on us and the food, and had a great conversation around the resturant, food and what we had been upto at the parks and discussed local attractions and events in the area. We then returned 2 nights later and was seen by Ergi/Erzi (apologies didn't get the name fully). She was just as welcoming and was happy to talk about our day and what we had been upto and gave recommendations of what's good on the menu. We ordered the pizza which was so big, and was very tasty, too much sauce for my liking, but still very yummy and would eat again. The lamb korma and tikka masarla was amazing. The kids option could be abit more, just chicken tenders as an option could be a little better. Like one piece of fish and chips for the kids would be a great second option. Josh then came out and was very welcoming again, and we had a great conversation regarding future attractions to the area, and they might be adding a nintendo world down the road, and we suggested theming the food, to Mario pizza, luigi burger etc. As suggested the resturant is amazing and could do with some better advertisement. All staff are amazing and have a passion to bring more people into the resturant. The hotel was good, the shop had a good selection of items and the gentleman behind there was great and welcoming. However the hotel was authorising $400 a day, which was taking out 3 days of our available funds. Luckily we had a credit card to use, while we wait for this to be sorted.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I always choose the Holiday Inn at International drive because is in front of the Icon Park and everything is walking distance. Clarissa is is the best at the bar. I had chicken wings at the bar, the are fantastic. Thank you for all the amenities.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The holiday inn is awesome! Carissa is and was the best Bartender and the food was great! I didn't see the pool so I don't know if it's good though. It's in a great location and in walking distance of all the major parks and the giftshop had some cool souvenirs. Great experience overall.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Amazing family stay. Staff were friendly and room was brilliant. Large, spacious and extremely clean. We had breakfast here a couple of times and it was faultless too. The one and only downfall was the noise from other guests. Our room was adjoining to a group of the most inconsiderate excuses for human beings it is possible to encounter. They were banging around and 'singing' ( cat being strangled) at 5am. WORSE still they failed to turn off the TV at night so the noise was non stop. We had to get security to speak with them on 2 of the 3 nights they next to us. Very poor sound proofing

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great food, clean hotel and special shout out to Shannon and Ezgi in the fusion restaurant, amazing service. Amazing selection of cocktails. Location is perfect at Icon park, lots of amenities near by. I look forward to staying here the next time I’m in Orlando

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Shannon the bartender was amazing. Had a great time at bar playing pool. Good atmosphere. Will recommend to others. Room was great too. But another shout out Shannon. The Hotel was clean and the front desk friendly and helpful. The Hotel was great location!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Welcoming staff with great proximity to ICON park, shops, and additional restaurants. Room was nice size, clean, updated, bathroom was HUGE and populated with Dove products! Staff was welcoming and lobby smelled so good!! Pool was great getaway…wish we could’ve stayed longer. Definitely be back!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The hotel has a great staff, the bartender Shannon is exceptional at making you feel at home. My wife and I travel very much and we love coming here. The food is awesome and the environment is welcoming. I usually don't post, but they deserve it...

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Shannon was a friendly face and she went above and beyond with her service. Great experience. I am working out of town and I'm always appreciative of friendly people. I'm quick to complain about bad service and lack of service so I like to acknowledge good service when I get it. I had a horrible week and Shannon made it a little better

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: A great hotel located in an ideal location. On I-Drive and opposite Icon Park. Staff have been brilliant, especially Shannon. A great host in the Fusion lounge and bar. Reception staff were excellent on check in, and housekeeping have been faultless.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Quite disappointed to be honest. Very expensive hotel, very impersonal. No carpets in rooms, cold floor to step on when you get out of bed - probably great during long spells of heat but not when temperature is 12 degrees! No safe in the room which I couldn't get over for the price we paid! Toilet area was grubby hair in the sink - not ours I hasten to add. Tiniest coffee maker, randomly replenished as was the loo roll. The only plus for this hotel is that it's directly opposite Icon Park, but so are several others. Won't be staying here again.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: stayed for daughters wedding during Christmas so booked lovely king suite we were given two queen beds room .upon complaining we were told they don't offer this room it was booking.com fault they lied the room is advertised on there site . we were offered another room right next to lift and ice machine and small the staff were very unhelpful rude even and actually ignored us at one point

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Abysmal experience. Paper thin walls, one of our rooms was missing a shower curtain, and the staff were unhelpful and rude. We will never stay at this hotel again. Do not stay here, especially if it is for a business trip. Avoid at all costs!!!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great location walking distance to the convention center and restaurants. Our room was absolutely clean and comfortable. Lucas at the front desk made sure we felt at home, always smiling and ready to help. Kudos to him and the entire team. We will definitely be back and we highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Orlando.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Hotel is nice and clean. Staff is sympathetic. Location is excellent while pricing is decent. I stayed at this hotel a few times and will certainly stay there again once in Orlando. I do recommend it for families on vacation or a person on a business trip.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Hotel is nice newly remodeled clean spacious rooms comfortable beds and pillows! Staff was very friendly! Shannon at the bar was great! Burger was as good as any hotel restaurant. Overall great experience!

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Shannon is the best the bathroom is not so much! Shannon can make whatever drink you want and it’s the best you’ll have! She makes phenomenal margaritas you can’t go wrong!! She is truly the best!!!!!!!!!!!!

Outstanding service. Jairo was a wonderful server. Polite and exceptionally professional. Attended for breakfast. Food was very good. Ambiance was welcoming. However the service truly set the experience above the bar. I highly recommend it.

Great hotel, ideal location and fantastic staff. Good food and bar. Surrounded by some great restaurants. The hotel is ideally located for all the parks, transportation available immediately on request. Comfortable and clean rooms. The ideal hotel for our stay.

Danny at the front desk was absolutely amazing. He was very welcoming and knowledgeable about both the hotel and the area. He deserves to be recognized. Thank you Danny for helping to make our stay amazing. We will be back!

My hub and I are big fans of Marriott's Autograph Collection, and The Castle kept that going! First, such a fun and warm greeting by Danny at the front desk and his call to our room soon after check-in to ensure all was well. Then, there's the overall design/ambience of the property. My hub aptly described it as "fairy tale, but not childish." The elements of "castle" theming are all whimsical and tasteful. And if you haven't been to this geographic area of Orlando, try it! We've been to Disney, Universal, SeaWorld, etc., and all are great...but this is such a fun, new area, and if you go, The Castle is THE place to stay! We rode the ICON ferris wheel (400'! So cool), played a really fun putt-putt course right in the area, Top Golf right nearby, super bars and restaurants, etc.-- again, all walking distance from the hotel! You can create a new Orlando experience if you haven't been in this area before, and The Castle is the perfect base for it.

Our flight was delayed several times before we arrived, so I called the Castle and Shanice Gayle, the front desk supervisor assured us that someone would be there to welcome us. We came in well after 1:00 in the morning and Shanice was right there waiting. Check-in was quick and seamless. Castle Hotel is pet-friendly with a fee. Bottles of water are available at the front desk, just ask. They keep a pantry full of snacks which came in handy. Their staff members are just really kind, courteous and professional. They’ll make you feel at home. Jeffrey Exact knows how to make a great cocktail. I wanted to see some relatives and see some sights and Jeffrey helped us figure it out. The ICON Amusement park is literally around the corner and you can see the Big Wheel from the hotel. We enjoyed the Castle burger poolside and the bourbon bbq wings from room service. The food was tasty, well above my expectations. Getting cleaning service is available upon request and I appreciate that because I don’t want to be awakened for that daily. Marie took care of our room and she was very sweet. Jennifer welcomed us for breakfast and in the five days we stayed, I only missed breakfast once. Can we talk about the coffee? Their regular coffee is excellent! That was enough for me to make sure I made it in time each morning (except that one time). Along with the breakfast buffet, they offer specialty omelettes made how you like it. There’s also a Starbucks if you need it. Castle Hotel was clean, super comfortable, and cozy. I enjoyed the decor and the scent. It smelled so good. They sell the scent at the front desk so I took some home to extend the feeling. Now my home smells like magic.

This is the second time staying at this hotel. Just as previously, the stay was great. The rooms are spacious and very clean. I love the decor and the little sitting area, every room comes with. There is a bar downstairs and they offer Starbucks drinks as well. The front desk staff is always wonderful. Shanice checked me in and she was very helpful, efficient, professional and nice. I also briefly interacted with Lisa and she was amazing as well. Overall a great experience. Will be back.

We took 7 or 8 trips this year and the bed in the Castle was the most comfortable. I have a bad back and most hotel beds are really uncomfortable. My husband noticed the difference as well. The location is great. We walked to great restaurants and Pirates Cove mini golf course is right next door which is a plus for us, lots of fun. And short car trips took us to other adventures. Last, but certainly not least, we always love the front desk staff, especially Danny and Gabriel. They make you feel valued and strive to make you happy with your accommodations. Fresh soft cookies at the front desk are also great!

Danny was absolutely amazing! I had a slight problem with my reservation and he fixed the mess up in record timing. The food at the hotel was superb as well. The entire staff was super nice and really held the Marriott standard

A great stay! Danny at the front desk was exceptional from the point of check-in throughout our stay. He is very friendly and inviting made you feel very welcome. The doorman was just as inviting each time we came back and I can’t say enough about the housekeeping it seemed we had the same lady each morning as we would need additional towels and coffee. She was very sweet and helpful and didn’t seem to be bothered of our request which was very nice. The breakfast at the hotel was very overpriced as it seemed no more than what used to be offered as a continental breakfast. I do not recommend breakfast at this hotel.

Lovely hotel as long as you don't expect to have heat in your room when it is cold in Florida. It took 4 visits from the hotel engineer over a 5 hour period to determine that although he adjusted the wall panel, there was solely air conditioning being blown out the vent and it was in the 60's outside. I was finally moved to a room with actual heat at 10:30 p.m. while still wearing a coat in my room.

Cute hotel! This was an impromptu stay. I found the Castle Hotel on the Marriott Bonvoy app while traveling and booked the same day. Checked in via the app and received a mobile key several minutes later. The hotel is just as pictured and exceptionally clean. The decor is unique and full of character. I had a king room and it was spacious and comfortable. Very close to restaurants and things to do on I-drive. I will definitely be back and I highly recommend!

This was an amazing place to stay!!!! Lisa and Roney were great….very upbeat and helpful! The bartenders Deangelo and Holden kept us going with the amazing drinks. But more than all of these..JOEL was the best!!! He helped us by the pool with our music and just keeping us comfortable! He wasn’t shy in holding a conversation with me. I will definitely be back! 10 Out of 10 recommend!!!

Danny and Gabe at the front desk were amazing during our staycation here! Really, the entire staff at this property are all very attentive and polite. The hotel is in a great location and the rooms are clean. It’s also AAA 4 Diamond certified and as a former hospitality professional- that isn’t easy to achieve.

A cute spot to stay for a night or two with your partner. We will definitely come back and try more of their amenities. I’d loved the fact that they’ve used authentic artifacts from Middle Ages! We stayed on the higher floor and you are able to go up to the roof to see Orlando. It is beautiful in the evening.

I’ve stayed at the Castle several years in a row and have been so pleased. The hotel is a great size with easy parking and newly renovated facilities. Would like to shout out wonderful staff members Danny and Lisa from front desk management and Carlos L. who all helped to make our stay so wonderful. Hope to be back next year!

This hotel was a gem! Nicely decorated, clean and in an amazing location for restaurants and night life. The roof top terrace was also a cute location! The poolside bar was nice as well. Not a huge pool but clean and neat!

This hotel provides world class service. The entire front desk team is top notch. Well trained, hospitable and friendly. Lisa was amazing. She recognized our Marriott Elite status, made sure that that the room was ready for our 1pm check in (very much appreciated after being in the car for over 6 hours). We used the Marriott member chat to communicate and they were the most curtious and prompt in responding. . It is obvious that the front desk focuses on hearing guest needs and quickly responding and meeting guest needs. Bravo! Our room was clean, located in the tower. Just beautiful. Yusefe at the restaurant was lovely too. They have a great pool and are 5 minutes from the convention center by car. Lunch options were great at the hotel. Another great restaurant next to the hotel is Cafe Tu Tu. Suggestion: breakfast was just okay plus as a Titanium member we normally get free breakfast (here it is 50% off). Fitness center sign on the second floor is incorrect. The arrow should be pointing left. These are just minor things. We will be back! The hotel is top notch. Bravo to the GM and the amazing team!

Castle Hotel: Where fairytales come to life! Immerse yourself in a medieval wonderland with majestic architecture and more enchantment than you can joust a lance at. It's like stepping into a time of knights and castles, with a touch of modern comfort. As a USMC Veteran, I can confidently say it's a mission accomplished in luxury and relaxation. Semper Fi! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

it was super clean and the service was excellent. I would suggest this hotel to everyone when coming to Orlando area. the employees where great they helped me allot when I first arrived. the food served was also top tier taste.

First and foremost the staff was beyond amazing. Very nice people in every department we encountered. With that being said, the hotel was not what we expected. It was very dated, cramped and above all, had a horrible smell like urine. The hallways were musty. Our room was hard to regulate the temperature and as i mentioned, had a terrible urine smell to it. It was clean, for the most part but there was some lack of attention to detail. The extra large shower head was covered in a dirty residue. For comparative hotels in the area between price and amenities, this hotel had everything as an up charge. Breakfast was an up charge that was priced out of line, $20 per person is a lot. They also charge $25 a night (per their website) to park your car which I think is absurd. Overall the hotel needs a lot of renovations if they want to stay competitive with repeat business. As I mentioned though, this is not a reflection of the staff, only the management/ownership.

El hotel es lindo , para nosotros no fue una linda experiencia ya que el check -in no fue amable ni agradable . la habitación que nos toco estaba en la otra punta del hotel , entendemos que alquilamos esa habitación o la habitación económica pero realmente esta a 10 min de la zona del comedor y recepción. Nos regalaron una gif card de u$s 300 para usar dentro del hotel , preguntamos varias veces y nos dijeron para usar dentro del hotel con la tarjeta de la habitación. fuimos a comer y a comprar unos souvenir, el ultimo día cuando fuimos a comprar algo mas nos dijeron que solo se puede usar hasta las 7 am del día del check-out y ademas que en la tienda de souvenir no servia . Nunca nos informaron nada de esto y eso hizo que tuviéramos que hablar con un encargado . Todo se soluciono pero ojo con estos datos. Luego el sector de resto es linda y cómoda , no les recomiendo comprar los vasos recargables ya que las gaseosa que tienen no son buenas y para servirte café te hacen usar otra taza que también debes comprar por lo cual utilizaría cualquier vaso para rellenar café y tomarla agua. El transporte a los parques funciona muy bien y la piscina también es agradable . Tienen un rio lento pero también tienes que comprar el inflable psique si vas por eso yo no lo recomiendo ya que el inflable sale u$s 20 . Si te hospedas por la cercania al volvano bay , esta muy bien pero tiene en cuenta de llevarte toalla porque en el parque tampoco te dan gratuitamente , tener que abonar por una o alquilar por día. La limpieza en la habitación estaba bien , pero varias veces no pasaban un trapo en el baño

Came to Orlando end of Aug/beg of Sept for an 8-day vacation to Universals parks. I've never stayed on site with Universal before, but I was hoping not to rent a car, so wanted to be able to use their free busses to the parks. In doing some research into which hotel to pick, we went with Cabana Bay because everyone says its well loved by families and kids. I was quite pleased with our choice. We were on floor 2 of building 6 Americana. The lazy river pool was right outside our building, which was nice. The walk to the main food court/front desk building wasn't bad. Our 2-bed queen room was comfortable, we had no noise issues. Quite appreciated that maid service came by every day of our trip - it was nice to come back after a day in the parks to beds made and trash emptied. My only real room complaint for the room is the lack of microwave....we had leftover pizza in our little fridge that we were just too lazy one night to take back over to the cafeteria to microwave so we had cold pizza for dinner - not a favorite. Hotel amenities are pretty nice- kiddo enjoyed the waterslide, we both loved the lazy river (brought our own tubes though as I heard theirs are over priced) - I spent a lot of the time my little one was swimming reading on a lounge chair. It is especially cool that the pool stays open late so we were able to go for a quick swim after the parks closed and we had come back to the hotel for the night. Buses to the parks were great - we never waited more than 15-20 mins. Seemed like the buses to Epic were less frequent - but not too bad. I loved that their was an ample gift shop on site - my kiddo even picked out her birthday present there finding a very nice carry-on Harry Potter themed luggage. My least favorite part is the food at the cafeteria though - we did two breakfasts there, which were fine, but the dinner food was gross and extremely overpriced. And then - I dont understand why because it really seems like the fine print says they should - but the hotel cafe doesn't do the 10% card holder discount, which I find almost offensive. As if they on-site hotels dining options aren't part of Universal? Really think Universal needs to re-think that.... But all in all, I would stay again - I would just eat anything other than breakfast off-site.

We stayed at Cabana Bay in a Volcano Bay view room in the bay side building. Check in was fantastic, Conner was a joy to chat with. He answered all our questions and even gifted us some free drinks to celebrate our Anniversary. He explained the text service to use during our stay. Just a note, as useful as this is, texting to request housekeeping etc, it is an SMS service so if you only have a foreign number (only a data package), it will cost you per message. Our room was very clean and a fab view. There was plenty of space and storage. The bathroom was a little bit tired and could have done with a deep clean but nothing crazy. Housekeeping was very consistent and speedy. I'm not sure if it's because we had a room lower down (5th floor) but the music that was playing in Volcano Bay that started around 8am every day was VERY loud. Cool at first but it got annoying waking up because of it after a few days. Just something to consider if you're wanting a room near the water park, maybe request a higher floor. The hotel itself is fairly sprawling so just bare in mind that you may be walking a fair distance. Some of the corridors we waked through in the Americana & Continental buildings were incredibly run down and dirty. Not the nicest areas. The door key system to get in and out of the pool areas was incredibly frustrating. It only worked half of the time and we ended up walking in circles until someone could let us through. The food court and Starbucks were great. Plenty of choice and never massive queues. Also the bus transportation to the parks was great, very regular and clearly sign posted. We found ourselves walking to Sapphire falls a fair amount and using the water taxi service to City Walk. It's a lovely walk and well maintained. Because of the easy access to Volcano Bay, we didn't use the pool at all, instead opting to spend time at the water park, but the pools looked very nice and fairly calm most of the time. Overall, a good base for the price. I hope to see the main buildings renovated soon as they let down the rest of the hotel. We would stay again though.

Todo está súper bonito , son muy amables , en especial Maria Duprate quien amablemente nos apoyo a subir nuestras cosas agua , snacks ,solo con vernos pasar ,y nos recomendó maneras más fáciles de llegar a nuestra habitación,gracias por tu esfuerzo Maria ... Gracias a dios por conocerte...y hacer nuestra estadía más bonita. También Housekeeping Sylvia quien se porto muy linda servicial ... Una buena empresa la hacen todos su equipo de trabajo y eso lo tiene este lugar .. gracias a dios por sus vidas..

Good atmosphere at the hotel, nice holiday environment. The hotel is clean, the food is lovely and the staff are really friendly. Great location for Universal only a 5 minute ride on the buses and they're very efficient. They have towels at the side of the pool and you can use as many as you wish. The pool was never packed which is always a bonus. The reasons i agree it is a 3 star hotel is the rooms are very cramped. We had a room with 2 double beds in and a lounge with a sofa bed. Once the sofa bed is up there is no lounge left. Where the 2 double beds are is a tight space, especially with 3 teenage boys. There is no window in the rooms which i never considered but found very depressing over the course of a week. There is hardly any storage and for 5 people you need plenty. We had 4 drawers, so the boys had 1 each and me and my Husband shared. There was a rail about half a meter so we hung up some best clothes the rest stayed in the cases. I didn't realise i would miss a balcony but i did and it's very handy for drying things so when we got wet in the rain or at the parks i took the trainers and whatever else down to the sunbeds and dried everything in the sun. They are also handy for getting away from people in the room and having some quiet time so i will consider this in future. Having an exterior room if you want to get to the main building and it's throwing it down (as it often was) you have to go out and get wet. Lastly the rooms were tired. The bath was all marked, the tile grout yellow, furniture ripped and chipped. I believe it was built in 2014 so they are ready for a refurb. However £6,000 for 5 people in August i'd have to pay more than that for anything above a 3 star.

Stayed here as a family group of 8 in July 2017, have popped in over the years since for coffee or food when we have been staying at other Universal hotels, and we returned to stay here in July/August 2026. Place is still amazing! Rooms, reception, diner area all great. Ate in the diner many times or grabbed food on the way in or out. Very good value, and re fill drink cup excellent value. Starbucks handy and plenty of choice. The pool does get busy on a weekend but plenty of areas to sit at either of the two pool areas. Lazy river is great. Can get large rings inflated by the pool. We took ours with us, and inflated ourselves. Easy access to volcano bay, can walk in in few minutes. Shuttle bus runs from hotel to city walk and back. Also can catch the boat if go across the bridge to Sapphire Falls Hotel or walk along the river walk, felt safe even late at night. Movies by the pool on a night. Plenty of seating to sit and watch the movies too. We had a room on third floor Americana Building and it was so nice and quiet, non of our party had disturbed sleep. Would 100% stay again.

£1500 fraudulent charges on my credit card since leaving the hotel last week. Multiple attempts at contact have been ignored. Read and respond to your customer service emails, instead of attempting to look like you have integrity - only replying apologetically because a public negative review is now online.

The location is a good pick, about a 5 min drive from universal itself. The atmosphere here is very welcoming, and staff will do anything to accommodate and make sure you have the best possible experience. The rooms are very spacious: we had a family of 4 and we stayed in the standard suite (no kitchen or sofa or anything) and it was perfect. Beds were comfy and soft, and we were so lucky with our view as there was volcano bay right in front and it lite up at night which was cool. Cabana Bay was VERY good value, £900 for a family of 4 for 5 nights. Cleanliness was mixed - a few scraps and dirt on the walls but nothing that threw us off on our stay. Noise level was actually not that bad, considering it’s a family hotel and we thought it would be loud. Amenities were plentiful, the shake shop was the highlight as we had a shake almost every night! We stayed in Americana so our pool with lazy river was very nice. The lazy river was a bit dirty when I went under water but it didn’t really matter to me. Bayliner diner was quite cool, because it was a proper American authentic diner, and as someone from the UK this was a very nice touch. Very happy with my stay here and I absolutely would return, but I live in the ukkkkkk :(( great place, and if your staying at universal, deffo come

Great location for Volcano Bay. No boats to theme parks or City Walk. Only buses which is ok except when returning at night. We walked across the street to Sapphire Bay & took boat to City Walk. Disappointed at no daily room service as informed at check in. Family suite was spacious, restroom layout excellent, comfortable beds (even sleeper sofa), great constant room temperature & spacious mini-fridge. Will return for our next Volcano Bay vacation.

El hotel ubicado en las cercanías de los parques de Universal, el hotel es muy amplio, grandísimo, las habitaciones son confortables y muy lindas y muy amplias. Las nuestras poseían microondas, frigobar, cafetera y utensillos descartables. Ademas podes comprarte la jarra de bebidas frias y calientes y poseen bar comedor inmenso. la pileta es bellisima.

hotel muy comodo! personal amable. instalaciones acordes y muy limpio. es un hotel que se encuentra al lado del parque de agua volcano bay. recomendable para ir caminando. tiene como facilidad el transporte gratis a los parques de universal. los espacios de areas comunes de piscinas y de desayunador y restaurante son inmensos y muy buenos. calidad de la comida excelente. tiene un starbucks adentro.
Un hotel muy limpio el servicio de todo el personal es muy atento en todo momento siempre fueron muy amables gran espacio buena comida y divertido

I had an awesome time I love Florida Awesome breakfast Hotel is Very Clean I love Starbucks and the Pool they have I didn’t look at the other options because I was on a Field Trip for Choir I will definitely Stay here again I give this Place a 10 out of 10

I came with my two sons during a rough time at home. Kate greeted us with the biggest most contagious smile. She was warm and helpful and had no idea I was sad. When giving us our key she smiled and said we were upgraded to a suite with a pool view. What a blessing! We had the absolute best time. Shout out for my girl Kate and Cabana Bay

The best food is cafeteria style and the quality is significantly lower than the two hospitals my family uses. It is very efficient for large groups and it’s fine if you don’t much care about the quality of the food, so it’s perfect for big groups of kids. If you’re a grown up who likes a relaxing atmosphere, table service, and healthy food you would have positive memories of, this is not the place. Also it is a hotel and my room was not serviced at all, even though it was vacant all day. And, to find my kid’s room (in a school group), I walked 2800 steps. Good for exercise but ridiculous. I have a great sense of direction and also had to ask for directions twice. Knowing how complicated it is to navigate, one person offered to walk me halfway to where I was headed.

We went back at the beginning of May 2025. We had such an amazing time. The rooms are very spacious and the beds were comfortable after being on our feet all day. We really enjoyed the pools especially the lazy river that was definitely my 9 year old son’s favorite spot. The staff was wonderful everyone from the front desk staff to the security staff and the personnel in both the Bayliner diner and the Malt shop which we also enjoyed. Unfortunately we didn’t get to enjoy a movie by the pool because it decided to rain every night but that’s Florida for ya lol. I can’t wait to come back and stay here again and multiple times through the future. You have guests for life. Keep up the great work. I highly recommend Cabana Bay Beach Resort to anyone.

We recently stayed at Universal’s Cabana Bay Beach Resort and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. Our first room was extremely far from everything and had several issues. The couch had stains, there was no hot water, and the shower was literally coming apart. After reporting the problems, we were moved to another room, but that one had issues as well. The air conditioning didn’t work properly, and when my son got out of the shower he immediately said the towel smelled awful. When I checked, several towels smelled like vomit. We also encountered multiple bugs in the room that we had to kill ourselves. The pool experience was frustrating too. There are so many rules that it made it difficult to relax. Lifeguards were constantly blowing whistles at guests for things like kids having small balls in the pool or adults having a cocktail while in the water. It felt excessive and took away from the fun atmosphere you expect on vacation. For the amount of money we spent, the stay was extremely disappointing. At this price point, basic cleanliness, working amenities, and a comfortable environment should be expected. Honestly, you might as well save your money and stay at a motel for the same experience.

W have just returned from a 10 day stay at universal’s Cabana bay beach resort. We have visited Orlando a few times we usually stay on I drive and drive everywhere. However this year we took family with us and for ease of getting to the parks and the facilities after doing some research we decided this was the place for us. We booked two standard rooms - we contemplated upgrading but as we had planned to be in the parks as much as possible decided not to. On arrival we knew we had made the right decision. The lady on reception was lovely so helpful - on check in she asked if we wanted inter connecting rooms - we said it wasn’t necessary but if we could be close by that would be great. She then said well I’ve just upgraded you both to suites and they are interconnecting - which was really kind of her - she then gave us so much info of where to park the car and all the amenities and times. Our rooms were lovely - we were in the continental building on the ground floor right next to the hideaway pool area. Our corridor was connected to the bayliner diner so we were so close to everything. Both pool were lovely and clean with ample seating facilities and plenty of clean towels the staff were amazing at keeping these topped up. We only used the bayliner diner once for lunch and it was nice - the kids said the tenders were great. We only ate here once as we wanted to try a lot of different places. Every member of staff you met asking around was pleasant and welcoming. The buses to the resort were constant and a really helpful amenity. We were incredibly close to the walkway to volcano bay which is exclusive to this hotel. Would I stay here again - absolutely without hesitation - the rest of my family said they would too. I’m jus sad to be home already

I had been placed here as part of a conference room block. All the doors open to the outside and the lock on my door was subpar. You could of easily kicked the door in the room was dark and dingy. I did not feel safe. After 1 night, I left as did others attending the conference. Luckily, my corporate travel was able to relocate me. I felt bad for those who got stuck there.

Me hospedé en el hotel la noche del 23 de noviembre de 2023. El hotel es antiguo pero pude sobrevivir con ello. Mi gran molestía se ha dado porque hice la reserva a través de la plataforma Agoda, y al llegar al hotel me indicaron que era correcta la reserva y que el pago se había realizado a través de dicha plataforma de manera corercta. No obstante a ello, me pidieron dejar US$50 de garantía. Al dejar el hotel el día 24 de noviembre a las 7am, me indicaron que me devolverían la garantía por no haber ningún costo cargado a mi habitación. No obstante, me veo con la sorpresa que no solo no me devolvieron el monto de la garantía sino que además me cargaron indebidamente a mi TC la suma de US$130 adicionales. Es decir, tengo un consumo realizado en el Hotel por US$ 180, cargados indebidamente porque la estadía ya se encontraba pagada y la garantía me la debían devolver. He llamado y escrito indefinidamente al hotel y a la fecha no me dan respuesta ni mucho menos realizan el reembolso de dicho cobro. Pésimo servicio y abuso de la confianza que tiene el usuario al dejar la Tarjeta de Crédito en calidad de "garantía".

Rosen Inn is very well taken care of, clean, and every employee with whom I interacted was competent and professional. My room was comfortable. The heater was my only problem; I think it could not keep up with unseasonably cold temperatures. The hotel provided extra blankets. The buffet was excellent, well prepared and good choices.

When we arrived after a very long and tiring flight from Gatwick we were met by very disinterested and grumpy reception staff who appeared to wish they were anywhere else but at work! We were shown on the map where our room was. The decor was very dated and the electric sockets were badly in need of upgrading. The hairdryer didn’t work and maintenance had to be called. Each day on returning to our room our key cards failed to work which was really annoying having to go down to reception to get new ones after being out all day from 9am til 10 pm. On one occasion it turned out that the battery was flat for the key card so security and a handy man had to be called. The air con was very noisy so we ended up turning it off. However the beds and pillows were comfy and there’s a safety deposit box in the room. Breakfast was plentiful with cheerful waiting staff although the breakfast was pretty much the same every day. There is no direct route to Disney Parks do we used Uber which ranged in price from $15 to $30 each way. I won’t stay here again although it was cheap compared to Disney resort hotels.

I’m really not sure how this hotel has any good reviews! We arrived to an unwelcoming bad mannered receptionist. After waiting 30 mins to check in with only one person in front with no apology! Eventually checked in and on the way to the room the walkways just smelled like weed! Got to the room and If I had a car I’d of slept in it! Dull, dated and musky smelling! The bathroom was nothing short of horrible, the taps made noises, the wardrobes didn’t open the front door wouldn’t lock properly! It was just a disaster! The floor was dirty and reading reviews about bed bugs topped it off! We ended up checking out the next morning and moving hotels! Although it’s probably cheap and convenient I’d rather spend the extra 100/150$ to stay in something I’d feel comfortable in!

We’ve stayed here previously in 2015 for 16 nights, and at the time I gave the place a less than favourable review. It didn’t deliver as promised and we were left disappointed. However, 8 years later and we found ourselves back here. Mostly due to an error by our travel company and when we found out that we’d be getting sent here again my heart sank. But there was no need. The rooms have been internally decorated. It’s pretty much just a lick of paint, but it’s made a difference and the disappearance of the old yellow walls is welcome. They were also performing some exterior works whilst we were there. I’m not sure what this was, but it was none instructive and didn’t impact us at all. Nice to see the hotel is being invested in and improved regardless. Our room. Still basic, but the beds are very comfortable, the cleaners did a great job and it was cleaned daily. It’s high traffic areas all round, so expect the odd bit of wear and tear but the reasonable price ( for the area) reflects this. Fitness room was small, but did the job. Pools were small, but there are three to choose from and again decent. Shop is handy, a little more expensive than the supermarkets but convenient. The staff we dealt with were also all friendly. Security presence is high throughly the day and the night, and at no point did the property ever feel unsafe. A 180 from me on this place. I’ve gone from really not being keen at all to feeling as if I’d actually like to go back if I’m in the area again and need a hotel as I really enjoyed our week there.

Stayed at the Rosen Inn at Pointe Orlando. Great location for bars and restaurants and a 15 minute walk to Icon park. Rooms clean. They have hairdryer, microwave and fridge and coffee machine. Would have preferred a kettle to make tea but there was a Starbucks in hotel. My only complaint about the hotel was the Zebras bar! Staff rude and no customer service. Also there was a service charge on your bill and they still were expecting a tip!

We always use this hotel when we come to Orlando. The location is excellent, there are no hidden fees, plenty parking spaces, everything you need is onsite. We stayed for three nights in August, then three nights in September. In September we were on the fifth floor, the room was immaculate and obviously just been cleaned, it smelled lovely and fresh and the bed linen was pristine, the bathroom was spotless. We had travelled up to Nashville and I was honestly so glad to return to this hotel. The staff are so friendly, helpful and professional. We will return again next year as we feel so welcome and comfortable in this hotel.

Where to start, check in wasn't to bad no apologies for the delay as we were behind a large group but theye did ask if we wanted a high or low floor which I thought was nice. Rooms - DATED, DARK, SMALL can't open nets as people walking passed, light don't give off much light, furniture dark brown, carpet not sure if there were dark our just pure dirty. One chair in room but no where to sit and have a snack apart from sitting on the bed could do with getting rid of the desk and putting a small table with two chairs in its place. Bathroom / Kitchen area- shower ridiculous slow had to run around to get wet, around the plug hole dirty, sink is by the coffee machine all a little to close for my liking, fridge not very cold, light in bathroom not very bright the lights are something from the 80's. Pool - pool area ok plenty of sunbeds and fresh towels just a shame people can't put used towels in the big black bins provided, could do with a little music to brighten the place up. Lifts - one lift out of three working and thats so slow 🐌. Pub - one word EXPENSIVE Shop - So EXPENSIVE Now the smell of cannabis is not what I want to smell but its all around the complex you even have people standing outside your rooms doing it and it comes thought the VERY NOISY AIRCON UNIT. This is definitely a budget motel.

The pillows hard ,unable to get onto bed ,Sked for disabled room only to find out that none available so thus unable to use bathroom, moved into a king size room but you need to have a stepladder to get into the bed ,the staff at reception on Sunday were rude ,couldn't care less attitude. Trying to get through to the reception that family not husband and wife , Only have clean linen on bed once a week and vacuum once a week , Had to sleep on the floor

Firstly, the on site shop is extremely expensive, even for basics like water and milk. Absolutely extortionate prices. Go over the road to Walgreens, much cheaper but still expensive compared to U.K reason is it’s a tourist area. Hotel is fine, clean room although dated but functional. Comfortable beds. Good air con in rooms which is essential in this heat. All in good value but just avoid that shop in the hotel, Absolute rip off.

This is a very early review as we have 4nmore nights. But honestly I just got security to my room to make sure we were okay because I hadn't locked ny door as I was going for another cig. Thanks so soooo much guys for caring! Amazing! I will leave a full review which I'm sure will be fabulous when we leave xxxx

Yes it might be a little old fashioned but some of the best staff and service I have received. Nothing was too much for them. Room dated but immaculate. Lovely clean sheets and towels. Lovely clean pool with pool towels. Great breakfast and good cafe, coffee shop and bar on site. Any questions. Please ask

Great budget hotel. Situated in an ideal location near all the good restaurants and bars. Bus stops outside hotel were great. Staff were all very nice and friendly. Rooms cleaned every day. Beds made and fresh towels were supplied. We asked for block B and 2 rooms together and we got that. We were on the ground floor. Could hear people passing but no big issue with it. Pool was very close and towels supplied at pool.

Already looking to book again. Completely does what it says. Smack bang in the middle of everything, plenty to do just across the road, including two supermarkets. Yes it is not the ritz, but who goes to Orlando and want to sit in their room all day? The rooms were cleaned everyday, I need to know how they keep their towels and sheets so white. The maids were always smiling and happy, not always taking the tip we left for them everyday. The bar staff were great and meals were reasonably priced and filled a gap after a busy day. The restaurant staff were always friendly at breakfast, and yes the breakfast buffet was always the same, bacon, sausage, egg, potatoes, beans, toast, French toast, pancakes, tortillas, pastries, yogurts, cheeses, choice of fruit, choice of cereal and Mickey waffles, what more could you ask for? Only used the pool in the evening always towels available. The reception were always ready to help, yes might take a minute or two to see to you, but always seemed very busy. 100% would stay again, and would recommend to everyone. Thank you to all the staff a Rosen inn at pointe, for making our family holiday fantastic. See you next yea🤞🤞🤞🤞🤞🤞🤞

Please don’t waste your money on this so called hotel. It’s a downgrade hotel to a one night stay motel as confirmed by its sister hotel’s manager. Rooms smelt of urine and filthy dirty. Mould in bathroom. It was that bad the rep moved us to another hotel as it wasn’t fit to stay in. The motorway is over the fence which it’s a drone of traffic all day and night. This is the cheapest place around and even the taxi driver warned us by saying good luck on staying there. He was right saying it’s like staying in a place they use in a horror movie. You have been warned. They say pictures lie they are right about this place. All uk holiday companies push this Hotel as its cheap And you will see why it’s cheap.

thank god my trip had a full itinerary and we spent minimal time in this hotel because it was a nightmare. on top of the many bugs we found in the small shower area and inside the sink, the hotel has an odd “do not disturb” sign that allows any staff to come into the room at any time to check on the safety of its guests. this policy was used to the staffs full advantage when the housekeeping aggressively knocked on our door twice in one morning before 9am. the second time the housekeeping knocked, they physically opened our door while we were sleeping !! and don’t bother trying to get the wifi to work any place other than the pool. save your money and go somewhere else.

Very clean and staff super friendly! Our stay included the breakfast buffet, which the kids really enjoyed. Right down the street from Icon Park and 20 minutes from Universal. There’s a free shuttle service to Universal but with kids and strollers, we chose to drive instead. Would definitely stay there again.

Just come back from a stay …upon check in we were greeted by the wonderful Ivonne! She was lovely, great customer service so friendly so helpful! Couldn’t have done more for us! There’s a bar, restaurant and a little shop inside the lobby. We were in block B - at the end of the day you get what you pay for. The hotel is cheap and cheerful! Comfy beds, very clean the room smelt of bleach when I walked in! Working safe and tv only bad thing was a few plug sockets didn’t work but it wasn’t the end of the world! Fridge and microwave were both clean. I am really funny about hotels and was worried about staying here due to some reviews, but honestly it’s great!!! Main thing is that it’s clean and the beds are comfy AND FREE PARKING! What more could you want? Also great access to Idrive too. Also there’s buses to sea world, Disney and universal etc!

Tengo sentimientos encontrados con este hotel. La ubicación es fantástica. Tienes cerca restaurantes y farmacias donde puedes ir caminando. Las atracciones como universal, see world y los outletss entre otras están en un radio de 13 a 20 minutos. El estacionamiento no tiene costo y siempre es un plus. Tiene restaurantes pero solo funcionan en ciertos horarios. La cama es cómoda y tiene micro y una pequeña nevera que sirve mucho si vas con niños. Ahora vamos con la parte negativa. Es un hotel evidentemente muy viejo y por ende el elevador es super lento, la primera vez que entre a la habitación estaba extremadamente húmedo y mas para personas como yo, que sufren de alergias y asma, tuve que comprar un Lyssol y tirarlo por toda la habitación para poder dormir y se sentía el ruido de la autopista, pero si llegas muy cansado seguro ni te darás cuenta.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The room was oversized and very comfortable. Housekeeping was always on top of their game. Shannon in the bar/restaurant was by far the the highlight of the stay. She was very attentive and always stayed on top of both food and drinks. Extremely friendly and laughing for the 12 days I was here.

Avoid staying in any IHG hotel worldwide if you don't support this racist and women hate behaviour.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Hotel recién remodelado, camas súper cómodas. El cuarto lucia moderno y súper limpio. Todo fue excelente. Céntrico y muy cerca de lugares para comer, divertirse y el ICON PARK esta al cruzar al cruzar la calle. También muy buen valor por lo que ofrece. El aire siempre estuvo frió todo la noche. El check in fue rápido.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Clean and spacious rooms with a modern vibe. We stayed one night but we plan to stay longer next time. The location was extremely convenient for walking. Located across from Icon Park - great restaurants, bars and attractions.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The hotel is in a great location and spotlessly clean in the common areas. It has only recently been converted to a Holiday Inn and not all the IHG Benefits and status are fully acknowledged as yet. Rooms are basic but clean with loads of power sockets. The WIFI is great all around the hotel. On check in, I did ask for a bottle of water to take some medication, this was a bit like asking for the Crown Jewels. Breakfast was simple but fresh. All the basics were provided. I was impressed with the choice of fresh fruit. A shuttle is available to Disney. This runs once a day and can be a bit late.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: This hotel is just beautiful and the customer service was amazing. We were able to have drinks at the bar great food and they are across from the ICON park! They have shuttles to the theme parks park your car for the duration of your stay,

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: The hotel itself is nice with a recent remodel. Unfortunately, the customer service and being charged a resort fee when I did not use any amenities (except for the standard internet, which is complimentary for IHG One rewards members (I am a Platinum Elite), on my one-night stay is ridiculous. I asked the hotel front desk to remove the resort fee and they would not even though I did not use any amenity offered during my quick one night there. When I asked to speak to the manager, I was denied even though he was there. After my stay I emailed the hotel twice and they did not even have the decency to respond. I am not impressed with the customer care received and object to these resort fees.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Great hotel BUT..... Nice newly remodeled room, very large, 2 queen ADA accessible with roll in shower. Rooms are in separate building from the lobby with room key only access. Restaurant on site, however after checking in, on way to the room right outside of the restaurant, a large rat was running around the walkway, so I did not eat there ! Hotel has plenty of parking. Is right across the street from the Icon Park, within walking distance to that and other attractions and restaurants. Other than the rat, this is a very nice property, and what you would expect from a Holiday Inn.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: I travel a lot but usually stay at another brand that features more luxury hotels. This was a last minute booking for a busy convention so I had few choices. The hotel and room were clean, WiFi worked great, the bed was comfortable, and the staff were very helpful and friendly. I did not try the restaurant but there are plenty of dining options within walking distance. I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Orlando International Dr-ICON by IHG
review_text: Dionna, the frontdesk staff, was very helpful to me -- a solo traveler from another country. My card isn't working and she helped me with other payment option. Her mindset was, their guests go there to have and relax, she won't defeat that purpose. She is truly a gem in IHG! The hotel is very near the tourists spots in Orlando area. Parking lot is available, too. Wifi signal was strong, no interruption since I checked in. There was a free shuttle going to parks, just ask the frontdesk for details. The room was very spacious. Everything was clean to my liking. Mariana cleaned my room so well. One feedback only was the room wasn'y well lit. I find it a bit dark. Only lamps were available. But the Dove products in the bathroom made up for it!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: La verdad con el precio, esperaba algo mejor. El desayuno muy bien. Pero si pides capuchino es extra, y no creas que es un italiano, es que el cafe americano es imposible de disfrutar. El dia de llegada ya nos pidieron un deposito de 600 dolares… teniendo todo pagado, aun estoy esperando que me lo devuelvan . Pero bueno no queda otra q aceptar. Luego parking eran 32 dolares por dia… no queda otra ya que no hay lugar donde aparcar. El valet son 45. Un abuso realmente al Turista. La habitación bien dentro de todo. Siempre moqueta. La odio por los acaros y alergias al polvo. La Paris H, parece que no sabe de mantenimiento de hoteles.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Fue una experiencia muy buena la atención de Brenda Maldonado en el restaurante Harvest, fue excepcional siempre atenta a todo los detalles, con una sonrisa y atención perfecta. 100 % recomendado.....

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Carlos at the front desk was so helpful during my stay. Gave lots of water bottles and allowed me to access my Amazon package of socks after hours. Also delivered to my room! Towels are plenty too! Mostly good service and staff for staying at.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Under construction while we were there but still a very pleasant stay. Great food, very nice staff. Pool area is awesome, they have a mini acrade and gift shop. Overall great experience. Would recommend staying here

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: From the amazing accommodations to the surprises in our rooms, we all felt spoiled! The Suite was used by our group morning, noon and night and made it possible for us to reconnect after these past crazy years. Our time in the Cabana was so much fun and we found the space the perfect size for our group. The food at Beech and Harvest were both so good! Our entire group commented on the quality and creativity. We ended up eating at your hotel for all our lunches and dinners with the exception of one night. The team at LaLuce was such a delight! And having the private room was such a fun treat! (The olives are still amazing!) The rooms were well laid out and we appreciated the view and location together on the same floor. The suite had great space for our group of eight to gather. I liked the full size sink, Keurig machine and larger beverage fridge in the kitchen. Our check-in process was efficient. The Guest Services Team was always helpful both in person at the front desk and via the app. In fact, the app was awesome! Always received a quick, concise response that answered our questions.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Not only was the hotel gorgeous (THAT LAZY RIVER) and conveniently located, but every staff member we came into contact with throughout our stay was extremely friendly and helpful. Texting with staff via the Hilton Honors app was such a quick and easy way to have our questions answered and needs met in just minutes. We ate at several of the on site restaurants and were blown away by the quality of food and service, the breakfast buffet was our personal favorite! A highlight of our trip was meeting Roxene, the Deaf Housekeeper in charge of our floor. As an CODA (Child of Deaf Adults) ASL Interpreter with a lot of Deaf family, I was thrilled to meet her in passing and get the opportunity to chat with her. She was beyond friendly and helpful, asking how our stay was going and making sure we had everything we needed. Overall, we felt so welcomed and appreciated and absolutely enjoyed our time at this beautiful resort. 10/10 will stay again next time we visit Orlando and will be recommending Signia by Hilton Orlando Bonnet Creek to all our family and friends!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We have stayed at Hilton Bonnet Creek many times and always love the service, hotel and room cleanliness and awesome staff. We stayed over Labor Day and were very surprised to see how many things were closed due to remodeling. You have no access to lobby, bar or stairwell which is a fun place to hang around. There is only one room bathroom in fitness area for everyone dining at Harvest Bistro to use so that made it incredibly difficult with 3 kids. They really should have thought ahead on a few closures. We were also surprised they have not updated the pool, the floor is very rough and tears up your feet, tiles cracking and falling off and sides are very discolored and look dirty. In line with most places food and drink and resort fee have gone up a lot. We are hoping the new renovations over to Signia will be worth coming back but we will wait until major ones are finished before returning.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Traveled here for business. The entire staff was very nice, but one staff member went out of her way to accommodate my sudden change in schedule. Shanelle was absolutely awesome! She took the time to answer my questions and handled my problem with grace! Thank you so much!!!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This hotel is very close to Disney world and also affords you Disney partnership benefits. It’s ideally placed for Disney parks and not far from other Orlando attractions. Some of the staff were amazing, 5 star and some seemed a little disinterested. In my opinion guests staying for 21 nights should be looked after particularly well but I didn’t feel that we were. It seemed that priority was given to conference guests. We did have a good 3 week stay but I wouldn’t stay here again. It was let down by a few things. There were several big conferences whilst we there and they took over the hotel, to me it lacked a family/Disney feel Monday to Friday. Something to think about if you want a Disney holiday, it may be perfect for you otherwise. The bedrooms are clean and have lots of plug/usb sockets and a large TV, desk and good sized fridge and a safe, and with a Disney view you get an amazing view of the fireworks at Epcot. My daughters apple air pods went missing, I must stress I do think that this was an accident, I think she left them in her bed and they were picked up with the laundry. I do not blame the housekeeping staff who were meticulous in their work. But when I went to speak to reception twice about it, to see if they could be found, Nobody seemed particularly interested. I’m sure that if they were in the laundry they might’ve turned up at some point but the first man I spoke to seemed as though it was an effort to make the call, I had to ask him to put a note somewhere that if they were found they were ours. He should’ve done this without me asking. Customer service! The main problem with the hotel is the construction work that is going on. There is a new lobby area being built and guests are woken up to drills and hammers in the mornings. 4 out of the 8 elevators were taken out of service which meant long waits when the hotel was full. The lobby/elevator area is just like a building site, dusty, work men everywhere and noisy. There is also a new convention centre being built at the back of the hotel which was noisy and left the rear of the hotel looking nothing like it does on the pictures. The hotel charges a high ‘resort fee’ which I Understood when I booked however I think due to the fact that guests are putting up with all of the construction work it should be reduced. It’s not the holiday weekend experience that people are expecting.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: How in the world is the construction not disclosed when booking?? It was not on the website, app, or anywhere when booking. I’m extremely disappointed in Hilton for not disclosing this or offering a significant discount. There was no lobby. They did try to dress up the walk to the elevator with black tarps, pergolas and fake boxwoods. I would have been MUCH more forgiving if this was disclosed ahead of time, but it feels like Hilton intentionally hid this information to secure bookings.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We stayed for 3 weeks in this amazing hotel. There is currently some construction going on but you would hardly know it and the hotel is very clean. The staff are very courteous and the housekeeping was excellent. Our room was cleaned etc every day and supplied with ample of toiletries, towels, coffee and 2 bottles of water every day. As with all hotels there is a lack of hangers (why is that). Hugh windows gave us a vast view towards Disney Springs and we had a great view of several rocket launches. There is also a side window on the landing which allowed us to watch all the Disney firework displays. The hotel is attached to the Waldorf and share facilities. The lazy river is a great feature and although very clean, the floor could do with repainting. The pool dj’s weren’t too loud you couldn’t that you couldn’t escape the noise. They were at the pool on Fri & sat for our visit. The poolside dining at the weekend was too busy for the staff on duty and we had to wait far too long for our food. On that particular day there wasn’t a server around the pool to be found. Weekdays was not an issue. Pre arrival I’d contacted the hotel re an ‘allergy room’ and they provided us with an air filter which was set up and running upon our arrival which we appreciated. The car park was easy to use and connected to the hotel so we didn’t get wet walking to and from it. The lobby has a shop and an arcade 3 of us stayed for 3 weeks and we found the space in the room to be ample. After the parks we just watch to for a bit and crashed. Because of food allergies, a larger fridge with freezer and microwave would have been a much appreciated addition. The room had lots of USB ports. In lamps, side table, the wall and radio clock alarm. They didn’t all work for me but that could have been because our leads were UK (don’t know if it makes a difference). For iPads and phones I used the sockets in the side table (between the beds) with an adapter which worked perfectly. The window has a wide window fill which is great for drying wet clothes. Final note, I’ve stayed here before and I’d stay here again. I love this hotel and where it is. We got a fantastic deal through Virgin Holidays and look forward to visiting again.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Estuvimos con mi señora en Marzo de este año. Es un hotel excepcional, con una atencion de primera linea, con todos los servicios de primer nivel, con una pileta increible, un excelente desayuno, una especie de cafe que te saca de cualquier apuro que tengas, Habitaciones grandes e impecables. Limpieza total Volveremos !!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: While we usually enjoy Hilton brand, this Hotel was very dis-appointing. The major issues were room cleanliness, missing items, and lack of response. No one was there to answer the phone!!!!!!!! on multiple occasions. It would simply ring and ring.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: First off, this hotel is very clean! I was able to pick my own room, and the room itself was nice. We frequented the Myth bar in the lobby area and had great service with food and drink multiple nights. Jacob mainly served us and was one of the best servers in our entire trip. Only downside of the resort I felt like the resort fee per day is quite high for what is offered and by the time you get back from Disney almost everything is closed (even though we left Disney parks early each night)

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We live in FL and just went for a couple day get-away and enjoyed the hotel. The staff was attentive, the pool was great for families but they really didn't have a spot for adults, fortunately they share amenities with the adjacent Waldorf Astoria and found their pool more to our liking. We had a superb breakfast at Harvest and a late bite at La Luce was also delicious. Out King room was very comfortable although a hike to get to from the elevator which was a slight problem for my husband. The elevator banks are at one end of the building (not the middle) so if you are towards the end of the building (as we were) it's far! Because of the distance within the hotel that we had to navigate we valet the car otherwise he wouldn't have made it out.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We really enjoyed our stay at this location. It was very classy. The lazy river made it perfect for my granddaughter. We had an incredible time at this location. They have very nice restaurants in the hotel so you do not have to leave.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I am Hilton diamond and return visitor to Disney. This is a great property on Disney grounds linked to your passes etc. The lobby amenities are great - pool deck is awesome. We rented a cabana for the day and had lunch drinks and appetizers out by the pool. Food and drinks over achieved. The rooms are clean and spacious - we had a junior suite and connecting queens room. Worked out excellent. Finally. Huge shoutout to Mario and Shanelle at the front desk. Friendly, helpful and smart. We will be back. Thanks Hilton SBC!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
