review_text: I stayed at the Hilton Signia from 2/26/22-3/2/22 and received a great rate through Capital One Spring who partners with Priceline. The resort fee is $45.00 per day but felt the amenities the hotel offered was worth it. My room was very clean and modern and had a great view of the pool and the Epcot fireworks. There is a small refrigerator, coffee maker, safe, small closet and plenty of drawer space. Bathroom was a little on the small side. The lazy river pool was very nice and the pool bar Beech had delicious tuna tacos! There was lounge chair service but it was quicker to just walk to the pool bar and get it yourself. Most of my time was spent next door at the Waldorf Astoria pool which Hilton guests are allowed to use. Pool area is more “adult” at the Waldorf and the pool service is definitely better. There is a coffee bar in the Hilton lobby which had great coffee drinks, some sandwiches, wine, beer, and huge delicious salads which were a bargain at $12.00 and big enough for two people. The Italian restaurant in the hotel called La Luce was delicious! Ordered the pappardelle fantasia (pasta with shrimp in a spicy red sauce) was outstanding. They make all the pasta in house. The hotel gym was more than adequate and never really crowded. The yoga mats that are hanging on the wall are worn and definitely need to be replaced. The Hilton is very convenient to the Wyndham Grand which is directly across the street and it was nice to walk around their lake and utilize some of their restaurants. My only complaint about the Hilton Signia was the condition of one of the common areas located behind the lobby bar. It is a very nice patio/lani area with two fire pits, couches, tables, chairs and a beautiful view of the pool. This is a popular area for guests, especially in the evening. The cushions are stained and worn and need to be replaced. There a few floor tiles cracked and there were always crumbs all over the floor. Maintenance should clean this area serval times a day. The staff at this hotel were personable and friendly and texted me several times throughout my stay to ask me if I needed anything. That was a nice touch on their part. I enjoyed my stay very much and look forward to returning to the Hilton Signia!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We booked this Hotel02/19-02/25.We arrived very late and our room(2 queen bed) room was sold to someone else even though we paid for it.They put us king bad and roll up so we are 4 people my wife and my 2 kids slept ok but i need to sleep on the floor. They promised us for next nite they were going to fix it. But we went to studios and came back around 10pm room was not available so they left me in the same room and slept on the floor again. I hate this hotel and people worked there they were so nasty and not helpful. I will never stay there again and not stop complaining.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Excellent hotel. Staff are friendly and helpful The lazy river is perfect for kids. There is enough space to be adults too. Having the option use the Waldorf facilities is wonderful. They have a spa which is lovely. A little pricey but well worth it. Restaurants are plentiful hoping that the Italian one will be open tonight It’s been a tough time for hotels recently and you can tell the staff are busy but they’re handling everything really well

I had a great experience. The team at check in was so sweet and helpful and was able to help me with all of my questions. They were also able to save the day by setting up a very last minute taxi for me since I had trouble securing an uber. Danny Holden and Ryan were also great at the bar and super friendly and accommodating. Even at closing they didn’t rush anyone and were a true pleasure to meet. I would definitely recommend them and the property

Danny and Gabe at check in were absolutely amazing! We were greeted as soon as we walked in and they brought up our reservation quickly and gave us each a water. The room was so perfect and clean. Thank you for amazing service and the stay was awesome! Thank you Tim & Mitzy

The Castle Hotel features a grand scheme of décor and uniquely designed amenities. The staff were exceedingly friendly and helpful. We had a very pleasant one night stay during the busy Christmas season and would love to come back one day. Our only wish was that the breakfast either had more varied options or offered at a more reasonable price for the limited food variety that was provided.

Starting with Joe and ending with Joe at the entrance was a treat. Great conversationalist with excellent recommendations on where to go and how to get there. Thanks Joe! The front desk staff was professional, accommodating and always smiling. Finally, I don't think you can find a more comfortable bed!

Visiting Orlando with my 10hrs son to LEGOLAND and Kennedy Space Center. Check-in: was quick and requested upgrade given my status with Bonvoy. I was upgraded to their Executive suite. Room: spacious and functional. Separate sitting area with swiveling tv between bedroom and sitting area. One thing lacks is the amount of light. I’m used to bright lights when I enter the room. Here however, it’s a bit dim. Not the end of the world! ;) Bathroom: clean and fair size. Did expect a tub with an executive suite. However, I’m staying one day so something I can easily overlook and not use. Hotel lobby: nice ambiance overall. Haven’t checked the facilities but definitely expect we’ll maintained. Couple of points I like to address: breakfast was not included and hoped that it would be a standard offer. Parking fees a bit high ($20) for Orlando/Florida. I would understand paying such fees when close to a large city but I did not expect here. Overall: I would stay again with the price I paid per night and room/facilities available to me. However, would be a steal if breakfast and parking included.

Danny & Gabe were awesome, professional, and quick to help! & the hotel is beautiful!!! They price matched our room and we so wonderful to interact with. We made a last minute change of hotels to Castle Hotel! I’ve never felt clean sleeping in hotel bed but the room was very clean & the sheets smelled fresh!

I absolutely love the staff, environment, restaurant, bar energies and vibe of the Castle! We came back to celebrate our anniversary since we always enjoyed staying here! The Castle never disappoints. We even walked into a special surprise that was gifted to us by the staff. Thank you

Desde que llegue al hotel siempre recibí una buena atención con alegría y cordialidad, el joven Gabriel fue muy amable me explico todas las amenidades del hotel y se mantuvo pendiente de mi bienestar haciéndome sentir en casa.

The hotel is a little gem! Staff is helpful and attentive, in every area. The room was spacious and quiet, and the bed comfortable. I had dinner in the restaurant and it was perfectly cooked and delicious. Check in and check out was easy, and the front desk staff very friendly! Price was reasonable and would definitely recommend!

Danny and Gabe at the front desk were terrific!!! They greeted my mom and I with great kindness and professionalism. Once we finished registering they both made sure we had everything we needed for our 4 day stay. They didn’t miss a beat! Gabe and Danny made such a positive experience that my mom was very impressed. I will highly consider staying at the Castle Hotel every time I visit Orlando.

Todo excelente en el hotel la atención espectacular la habitación modernas y muy limpias la ubicación en una zona hermosa cerca de todo y el personal muy amable y hablan español que nos sirvió mucho volvería

Was super excited to stay here to celebrate my birthday and they didn’t disappoint. We arrived to our room and the fabulous front desk had balloons and a card waiting for me. Such a perfect start. We had some drinks are the inside bar and they sure know how to make some amazing drinks. A quick walk to all the fun things to do on IDrive. Even saw fireworks on the roof top. Thank you Castle team for making my birthday memorable.

All I can say about this place is it was really nice, love the room. The pillows are comfortable the sheets are clean. Houskeeping say good morning I love the front desk, so friendly. I love the nearby restaurants. Everything you need in a Castle to feel like the king.

Castle Autograph Hotel was a very clean hotel, and all of their staff were helpful and friendly especially Danny he was the besttt with his service he made it easy for our volleyball team and made us feel comfortable. Totally recommend this HOTEL to anyone and we definitely will return to this hotel if we shal visit Florida again. Mahalo nui from Hawaii!

Love this hotel! Staff is friendly and hotel is conveniently located near attractions. Hotel is just a block off International Drive so you have a lot of options for dining within walking distance. Lots of shopping close by.

We stayed for a weekend and it was a great time! Looks to be newly renovated, the staff was amazing, pool was great! We will be back sooner than later. Overall +++! We have had some bad experiences over the years at multiple different hotels this stay was on of our best experiences.

My friends and I had such an amazing experience at the Castle Hotel! It’s such a beautiful hotel with newly renovated rooms and a great location! The staff was such a pleasure to be around and accommodated all our requests!

Amazing fully renovated hotel with the absolute best staff. We stayed for two days and had an amazing time. Pool area was a great way to relax after a long day. Our room was very clean and spacious. Service was absolutely flawless with everyone being very helpful.

Great hotel close to a lot of attractions and restaurants within walking distance. It was a pleasant surprise seeing an employee from Hawaii…what a small world! Good parking lot and food and laundry on site.

We stayed at the Castle Hotel during a volleyball tournament and this hotel is beautiful!! They room was nice and clean as was the rest of the hotel. The staff was very friendly and welcoming, especially Danny!! We all enjoyed talking with him about our beautiful home of Hawaii and volleyball. The girls loved the pool and it was so close to the convention center, WalMart and even a Chik fil A. It was even closer to Icon Park which had so much to do!! I would definitely recommend The Castle Hotel if you are visiting Florida.

Hotel rooms were very clean and spacious, we were accommodated very well by front desk staff, and the location can't be beat with multiple restaurants within the lobby area (chicken Marsala at the bar was amazing!) and the mall right there as well! 10/10 would stay here again in a heartbeat

The pillows were comfy. Love that the tv had google chrome cast. I could use the tv remote on my phone through an app. Love that they had a crew room filled with toiletry supplies that you could restock on. Also enjoyed crickets restaurant. Sad I didn't have time to enjoy the gym or pool. Definitely will next time.

This is an excellent hotel property. We really enjoyed our visit. The location is central with an attached mall that has so many stores to choose from and also excellent restaurants and a food court. Room as well maintained and decorated The arrival staff was very helpful. Our bellman quickly took all of or luggage to our room. He was so helpful.

I've attended many conferences at this hotel but usually stayed with family locally. This time I stayed onsite and I am glad I did! The hotel's price point is exceedingly reasonable for its amenities. The gym was incredible - maybe needs a couple heavier free weights for body builders but had everything I needed. Rooms are large and immaculate. I was delighted to have housekeeping available daily - unusual as many hotels have downgraded housekeeping availability but not the Florida Hotel. Staff were most gracious and attempted to accommodate.

Very friendly staff, nothing is too much trouble. Natalia is always very helpful ❤️ The rooms are very clean and beds are super comfy! The location is great, being attached to the mall. Starbucks on-site and a food court not far away. Crickets provides great priced food and drink and the offering at breakfast makes a great start to the day.

Great hotel attached to a mall! Restaurant was fabulous with some of the friendliest employees you could ever meet. The conference room was perfect for our meeting. The gym was clean, had adequate equipment including a Pelaton! Hope to be back next year.

The entire stay was amazing. My friend and I stay here twice a year and every time we enjoy it a little more. Management, front desk staff, restaurant staff (Cricket's)-they are all amazing. Sebastian (Manager) and Luisa (server @ Cricket's) took amazing care of us. We will continue to frequent this hotel time and time again.

Had the pleasure of staying in this fabulous hotel for the last two nights of our vacation. We were met by Jean and Clim in reception who gave a fabulous greeting, and were so very helpful with our luggage. They are a credit to you. Our room on the 8th floor was immaculately clean and comfortable and our room attendants Eva and Elizabeth met our every request. Crickets bar still has a fabulous atmosphere and Matthew, Ted and Luisa took very good care of us. The only thing missing is my dear friend Cricket, who is sadly missed, but never forgotten. We were also able to pay for a late check out which was most beneficial before our long journey back to the UK. All in all we will most definitely use this spectacular hotel as your standards and staff are exemplary. Please pass on my thanks to all the staff I have mentioned, as they are an absolute credit to you. Thank you, Tracey & Andy - UK.

I visit the Florida Mall almost every month whilst working. I absolutely love this hotel . From arrival to leaving the staff are exceptional , friendly and happy to help you in any way. The rooms are nice and big, clean and have all that you need. It has all the onsite facilities you would require. Nice large pool with plenty seating areas, on-site restaurant with amazing efficient staff . I highly recommend the Buffett for breakfast. It has everything you would desire and the freshly made omelettes were delicious. One of my favourites about the Florida mall is the large gym which is nice and big with a separate cardio sections with a great variety of cardio equipment, a free weights section and a great selection of resistance machines. And if you love shopping the mall is on the doorstep and you don’t have to leave the hotel as it’s all linked together. I am always happy on my trips to this hotel from the minute I enter those doors. I look forward to my return 😊

What lovely attentive staff. This is my second year hosting and event at this hotel and I will keep coming back because of the great staff and attentiveness. Every request I had they were on it. It’s also nice that the hotel is located in the mall.

Great attention from the ladies at front desk. A hotel with great price/quality relation. I go everytime before going to the airport, it is a very confortable place, with lot of thigs to do without having to drive.

The best hotel for those who’s seeking good location, impeccable facilities, great food service and a very friendly staff. Been adjacent to the Florida Mall is also very handful, and for those who won’t drive there’s many bus lines going downtown or even to the parks

Very Clean Rooms, Staff is super friendly and helpful. Towels are very soft beds are comfortable and they make sure you are taken care of. Pool area is always clean and so is the pool. Strongly rec staying here

I have stayed in this property 3 times already for my company meetings and its always a good experience. Rooms seem clean and neat, decor is nice. One of best things about this hotel is the location, its right in the mall, the back door to the hotel goes literally inside the mall. There's lots of shopping and dining options inside the mall and around it. There's also a Starbucks, Chick Fi, a bar/bistro restaurant and a breakfast buffet all in the lobby area of the hotel. Parking is right across the entrance. Also if you are flying in Orlando International, this is about a 18-20 minute drive from the airport.

Staff at check-in desk were very friendly and accommodating. This was an emergency overnight stay and my husband and I did not have our luggage with us. Staff provided dispensable toothbrush and single-use toothpaste for us. That small gesture made all the difference. Free Starbucks coffee in the morning was an added bonus.

Staff are excellent nothing was too much trouble, always very helpful. Rooms very clean and comfortable. Hotel bar serve well priced delicious food and drinks. Chickfila in lobby was excellent and the cvs vending machine was very useful too.

Hotel cleanliness was excellent. Staff was excellent. Easy process for check in and check out. Excellent location for entertainment since the hotel is attached to the mall. Great Italian Restaurant in walking distance. Will definitely recommend and stay again.

We arrive late due to aurkine delay, howver, our room was nice, spacious, quiet, clean, and comfortable. We had a nice and good night rest. Excellent customer service and check in. Nice location with plenty of parking.

Very satisfied with the services received during my stay and also with the event we held at the hotel. Meeting spaces are spacious, clean, and well located. The staff is always on hand to provide support.

The room is exceptionally comfortable. The bed sheets oh so soft. Everything is exquisitely clean. Very responsive air con. Drenching fresh shower and delicious in room coffee to wake you up. The view out the window is breathtaking. Thank you for the experience.

This was our first time staying at Cabana Bay and I would highly recommend it to anyone planning a trip to Universal. We had a quick check in process, easy access to our prepaid park tickets, friendly staff everywhere we went, and not a complaint about our room. The beds were comfy and the room was well kept. When we needed extra coffee pods or etc it was dropped off to our room in no more than 20 min. The pool area was fantastic! W loved our pool area so much that we didn’t even venture over to the other pool. The hottub was big enough even on the busiest nights. The lazy river was icing on the cake! It was relaxing and very enjoyable. Lifeguards we saw doing training every morning which was reassuring. The food options were also great. Many meals were made right there on the spot which meant you may wait a few minutes but I would rather have it made fresh. The only downside we encountered was that some of the food in the cooler areas were outdated and did alert the person nearest and they said they would let the chef know. The gift shop had great necessities along with cute souvenirs. We definitely utilized the refillable drink mugs on the stay.
Wanted something modern clean and close to Universal - as we visit Volcano Bay a lot this was a great location, plenty for children onsite and lazy river a huge plus

El hotel me pareció hermoso!! Le cambiaría algo que allá es común y es que te hacen limpieza día de por medio. En Argentina eso no es habitual pero nos pasó igual en el hotel de Disney. En mi caso no estuvimos en todo el día y hubiera sido espectacular volver y tener la habitación ordenada . Agregaría el desayuno incluido en la tarifa, algo simple. Lo demás todo excelente e impecable.

We went on a family trip to Universal Studios and stayed at this resort for two nights. The rooms were extremely clean, I liked it that they provide shampoo and conditioner in dispensers. The bed was very comfortable. My favorite was that they give you a number to call if you need extra towels, coffee, pillows, etc. The pool and lazy river are heated and very comfortable for swimming in January. They sell floats but will also inflate the ones you bring from home. The restaurant was fun, we ate breakfast and dinner there. Not great food, but good and not too expensive for a resort. The repetitive 60's commercials they show in the lobby are fun the first day, after that you wish they had some variety. The Malt Shoppe is very good. There is a fire pit and you can purchase s'mores kits, or bring your own. The bars make very good, but very expensive drinks. There were a few glitches. My son's card never worked for the gates, my husbands was hit and miss. There is no way to call the lobby to ask a question which necessitated an unnecessary trip to the lobby only to find out that the desk we needed was closed. There is a retro phone and clock in the room, but they are for show only. Neither one worked although they tell you that you can order pizza from the phone? We ran out of time and did not go to the bowling alley. I would suggest staying an extra day just to enjoy the resort as the park will keep you busy all day.

We enjoyed our stay at Cabana Bay Beach Resort. The hotel delivers exactly what you see in the photos — the rooms aren’t very large, but they are comfortable, practical, and very clean. The location is fantastic, especially if you are planning to visit Volcano Bay. If you stay in one of the two newer towers at the back, you’re just a few steps away from a dedicated guest entrance to Volcano Bay. It’s not the main entrance that everyone uses, which makes access quick and convenient. From these towers, you can also see the volcano lit up at night, which creates a wonderful atmosphere. Dining options are varied, with multiple restaurants and food stations that stay open late. Breakfast choices are plentiful, and the refillable cups are a great deal since you can also use them in the parks. The pool area is fun, with a waterslide, and the fire pits lit at night add a cozy touch to the overall experience. The staff is friendly and helpful, and the amenities are solid. I tried the gym, which is well-equipped, and there is also a bowling alley (advance reservations required). The hotel also offers shuttles to the parks and early admission, which is a big advantage — we used this to make the most of Epic Universe. The only downside is the noise level in the dining and common areas. Because of the large number of guests (in our case, many were visiting for Halloween Horror Nights), the food court and communal spaces can feel very crowded, busy, and loud. For those looking for a calmer atmosphere, this might be frustrating. Overall, Cabana Bay is a fun, family-oriented hotel with great access to Volcano Bay and Universal, lots of amenities, and a lively atmosphere.

I have stayed at Universal hotels prior to this but the visit encountered a very passive aggressive receptionist. I emailed Universal as I was shocked that this was now the standard of their staff and having just stayed a night at Disney where the staff could not have been nicer the comparison was like night and day. I received an email from the deputy manager which ended with him asking me to reach out to him which I did and have had no reply since, so I guess this is the standard of their current staffing. Needless to say I will take my money elsewhere where in future as there are plenty of hotels in Orlando where staff welcome guests and are genuine in their approach

Please do yourself a favor and don’t spend your vacation here. The halls and rooms smell moldy and are in dire need of deep cleaning and a refresh. The walls and furniture had spills on them that hadn’t been cleaned. My sheets were stained, as well as other parts of the room and bathroom. The carpets smell awful and need to be shampooed or replaced entirely. Like other reviewers mentioned, there are literal tears and holes in the bed covers/sheets. The mattresses were sagging and uncomfortable. If you have any kind of back, shoulder, or hip issues you will wake up in pain from the sagging mattresses. The rooms can get loud at night as well due to noise from the halls. Every time someone opens/closes the doors it will wake you. This hotel is clearly understaffed as well. The tables in the dining area were routinely dirty - no one cleaned them regularly. The pool area was messy as well - used towels left everywhere along with dirty tables with old food/sticky spills. The only way to get a hold of someone when there’s a problem is via text message. The messages are generic and it felt like I was talking to a robot until I was finally transferred to someone else. If you need any services downstairs be prepared to wait in long lines. Check in took about 40 minutes as there were only two people working the busy counters. Luggage services had only one person at the counter and took so long we missed breakfast waiting in line. Getting a package took nearly 30 minutes as well due to the lines. While the theming in the main area is cool - this hotel needs to be cleaned up, repaired, refreshed, and properly staffed. I’ve stayed in several Universal resorts and this was the worst experience I’ve had. Not once during my stay did I feel rested or recovered from long days in the park.

Good stay but wish they would renovate the rooms. Asked for a paid upgrade to a suite upon arrival they gave it for free as it was the slowest time of the year. This is my go to hotel. Love the lazy river and pool vibe. Hate the extra walking but comes with the territory, Things were falling apart in the shower and kitchen area. Was a little disappointed for sure. The elevator broke down and we were on the third floor. Was painful after a long day in the park. Great stay and love the vibe just wish the rooms would get some tender loving care. I’m not huge on luxury I’m good as long as it is clean but the rooms are very tired at this point. Or at least mine was. I would stay there again in a year or two but beyond that it might not be the best.

We stayed for a week in a family suit. The rooms were large with a fab kitchen. The hotel was great, friendly staff lovely pools, good cocktails and my kids loved the refill mugs as there is an icee station. Buses are fast and and we did not wait longer than 10 mins. Would recommend!

Stayed here for a week with my 12 n 13 year olds and my Mum. We were in the Americana building and loved it. The pool and lazy river were great. The lazy river is a decent length and nice n warm. The hot tub is super hot! The food court offers a good choice and also coke freestyle machines. The resort mug def worth buying. Staying here and getting early entry is really good. Its extremely close to Volcano Bay. The rooms are clean and big enough. My only moan would be our shower was cold and we had no toiletries. I did report it and it did go warm but then went back to being cold. The beds are super comfy 😁. The reception always has a huge queue that moves very slowly so reporting things is not easy and check in was a long process. The character meet n greats in reception are good. The resort gift shop has a good choice. The resort is a 15 min walk from the parks which is good 1st thing or at night but not in the middle of the day due to the heat! We loved it here and would return. Especially miss the lazy river 😊

All of the throw back 60’s and 70’s vibes. Exquisite recreation of a boomers (my) childhood. The resort is beautifully themed. From the upscale “rat pack” feel of Swizzles to the drive-in feel of the shake shop, the bowling alley, and the cavernous themed lobby along with the appropriately designed pools and slides the place hits you hard remembering childhood vacations with the family station wagon. A wonderful introduction to this era for those beyond boomers. The terrazzo floors are fabulous, as are the rooms. Service was tremendous. But, the cherry on top of the chocolate Sunday that is Cabana Bay is the quick serve restaurant with the generational tv commercials!! Awesome. Price point is outstanding. Value is tremendous. I’m a huge fan of Disney and have stayed all over the WDW property. Likewise, we’ve stayed at most of the Universal resorts. CB is one of my favorites in either property. Can’t recommend it highly enough.

Hemos pasado una semana en el hotel. Es un hotel enorme, si tienes la mala suerte de que te toque en alguno de los extremos te tocará darte enorme paseos cada vez que salgas de la habitación, incluso si vas a por agua, ya que solo tienen agua en la zona de comida ( y el agua del grifo sin filtrar dudo mucho que sea saludable). Por otra parte está muy descuidado, Las habitaciones llenas de desperfectos y manchas, la limpieza no es muy eficiente, puedes volver a las 18:00/19:00 de la tarde y que tú habitación no esté echa. En la zona de comidas tienen una tienda y zona de restauración, pero hay que tener suerte para encontrar mesas limpias, ya que una vez que se usan, el personal no se esmera mucho en limpiarlas. No esperes gel en la ducha, solo hay champú, acondicionador y una pastilla de jabón para el cuerpo. Las toallas hubo dos días que no las cambiaron, un día las cogimos de la piscina y otro tuvimos que pedirlas a recepción. La zona de piscina está bien, tiene dos, más un río lento pequeño. Al personal se le ve muy desganado, hubo tormenta, y como es lógico nos echaron de la piscina, pero el personal cerró todas las puertas de acceso a está antes de que saliéramos, dejando solo abierta la del hall de la zona de restauración obligando a todo el mundo a dar tremenda vuelta. Al ser un hotel de Universal resort está muy bien conectado con los parques por autobús, cualquier otro desplazamiento que quieras hacer lo tendrás que hacer en Uber. A parte de la zona de restauración, tiene una bolera, un Starbucks, dos bares de piscina, un recreativo y una tienda. El precio por los vasos rellenables es abusivo. Si sois familia compartidlo y ahorras dinero, que el agua se puede coger en cualquier botella.

Huge shout-out to Adia and Tony at reception! I booked a two-bedroom suite for two weeks, and the entire process with Tony was seamless—he was so helpful throughout. Because we had a late-night flight home, I booked an extra room for my kids so they could relax until our departure in the evening. I explained the situation, and Adia kindly helped us get a room that was available. I truly appreciate this—thank you! All of the staff we encountered were absolutely superb and helpful, from reception to the canteen diner bowling alley and arcade. I couldn’t fault a single member of staff! The location is excellent for Volcano Bay (walking distance), which was exactly what we wanted. Epic Universe and Studios also had frequent direct buses that were simple to use—such a help for a mom traveling alone with her boys. The only real issue we had was with the two-bedroom suite we booked for 12 nights (Volcano Bay view in Beachside). Unfortunately, the room wasn’t very clean when we checked in—there were visible stains on the floor, walls, fridge, sofa bed and the shower was full of body hair. Neither of the bathroom showers worked properly—the water pressure was more like a small hose (we ended up booking a few nights at another hotel so we could have showers) and in the main bathroom, the shower fixture was actually hanging off the wall. The walls and furniture also looked quite marked and worn. You did however get a great amount of space with two bedrooms, living room + kitchen area - a kettle would be a good addition for hot water. The view of Volcano Bay from your room is incredible, however.

A poor excuse for a hotel. Long lines to check in or handle any business at the front desk. Relationship with Universal is arm's length when there is a ticket problem or a reservation problem if it wasn't booked with Loew's, the hotel owner. Rooms are minimalist. Service is abysmal. Parking is extra ($26/day) and $50+ if a visitor. They failed to load the parking onto our hotel key making exiting the parking lot a challenge. Getting a refund meant standing in another interminable line. Vending machines on the hotel floors poorly stocked but charge you anyway when an item isn't in stock. Again, getting a refund requires standing in the same daily long line. Not a well run property. A call to management meets with flowery words and zero action.

There's no better location for Universal with an easy walk into Volcano Bay and a 20min walk (or bus/boat) to City Walk. We stayed in Beachside Tower level 10, and it was quite and had a good view of the volcano and water park. I would encourage choosing the tower if you can as it's a bit quieter and feels more modern . The rest of the hotel, and lower level blocks were very much like a holiday camp with corridors of rubbish, and incredibly noisy. The dining area reminded me of a school canteen and was chaos. The ice cream shop Shakes was very nice however and I'd recommend. Not sure I would return but it served it's purpose so I can't complain too much

La segunda vez que tengo la suerte de ir a este hotel y volvería siempre. El lugar, su pileta, el ambiente, todo está correcto y bien puesto. Al ser de Universal, contás con entrada anticipada a los parques. Esta vez me tocó ir con un hijo pequeño y se disfrutó mucho más aún.

It's a wonderful stay. Everything is close to walk to. We had an interior room. While nothing special, it was a very nice room. Clean and comfortable beds. Easy shuttle service to City Walk. Bowling allies for some additional fun. Lots of food options in their main dining hall though wasn't the best quality at times. Staff were friendly and helpful. Will be 100% staying again. Keep in mind that the free refill cups only work at the resorts and not the parks. What you get for the price is easily worth every penny if not more.

The rooms were smaller than you expected, not worth the price. The bathrooms were quite small and outdated, with tiles on floors and walls needing replacement. Additionally, the property was easily accessible to anyone on site. I was not comfortable in my suite at all. The toilet seats had things on them that could not be removed and the tub had old stains. The noise levels in the suite were also quite disruptive, with sounds from neighboring rooms and the hallway easily heard. This made it difficult to relax or get a good night's sleep. The thin walls and lack of soundproofing contributed significantly to the overall discomfort during the stay. To enhance the room conditions, I recommend updating the bathroom fixtures and replacing the tiles to create a more modern and clean appearance. Implementing better soundproofing measures, such as installing thicker walls or soundproof panels, would greatly reduce noise disturbances. Additionally, ensuring that all surfaces, including toilet seats and tubs, are thoroughly cleaned and maintained would improve guest comfort significantly.

2200 rooms and very spread out. It has everything you need to have a good time. Price was reasonable. Plan on walking if your room is at the end of the property. Plenty of pools, sand, food and beverages. It has shuttle to and from the parks, which is very nice. Park and not having to drive around has its perks. We will stay here again.

Had an amazing 29th birthday here! My partner and I are FL Resident AP holders, and I decided to book 2 nights at Cabana Bay about a month out in advance. This is my 2nd time staying here, and this time was in the Bayliner Tower, which I was excited about. The walk can be lengthy to get to the lobby and Garden Walk to the parks, but that is okay! If you are doing Volcano Bay, 10000% recommend staying in one of the towers, as you have your own private entrance to the park. Madison at check-in provided world-class service. She even gave me a free birthday ice cream voucher and was all around a delight. The room was spacious, and had a view of Velocicoaster. The theming at this resort is top-notch (very charming) and it carries over well into the room. Beds were comfy. Lots of TV channels, as well. We didn’t make use of the lazy river and/or pool(s), but Universal did a great job with the design and amenities. The Bayliner Diner is decent for a meal or a quick bite. The quality of the food is not stellar by any means, but it gets the job done (for a price). Really love walking to the parks or hopping on the water taxi at Sapphire Falls. The only (minimal) critiques I have are that some wear-and-tear is showing in spots - a lot of signage could be cleaned and updated around the resort, and there is still some trash on the pathways leftover that I noticed from the previous day. Overall - great! Would stay here again.

Amy Gilbert from the Scratch Market is a gem! She took extra special care of me every morning. Turns out she is coming to visit my area in the Winter. Small world!!! She was helpful, courteous and kind. Everything you would want to start off the day

The stay was great! Special thanks to Abdul at the front desk/reception, He helped us during check in and check out, went above and beyond to make sure we had rooms as requested and reminded me about the little perks that my Diamond Hilton Honors status gave me. Thank you))

Property is really nice and updated. After I arrived Abdul assisted me at the front desk. Recognized my Diamond Status and looked at an upgrade option. He was able to get me into a suite. Check in was quick and appreciated the service. 5⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ for Abdul

Great bed. Nice room. Even better concierge service. Kept asking questions and making requests and they continued to provide perfect solutions and answers. Really enjoyed that part. Not having to look for answers who knows where. Just texting on your phone and getting what you need.

Just wanted to thank you all the stuff, especially Mia Danny guest service agent she was outstanding helping our family for everything that we need for us. We stay three nights I extend one more night that’s how happy we was and my kids was extremely happy my wife and I so yes, I will strongly recommend everyone that I know to come to your property at Hilton Orlando. Keep up the great work can’t wait to come back to Hilton Orlando again much appreciated and thank you for all you’ve done for us. ❤️❤️❤️❤️😄😄😄😄😆😆😆😆

Cherline cashier every time I go to get coffee she’s always smiling and talking to my kids and my family. She is outstanding people like her make my stay better and better. I want to be here just a few days, but I end up extending my stay because of her and all the stuff, the outstanding service Front Desk , and everyone else was outstanding thx a lot for making my stay extremely fabulous I mehdi sejdija with my family strongly. Recommend people to come to this property. Thank you again and have a wonderful day. Can’t wait to come back again. 👍🤠🥰🥰

Ashley and Andrew in the hotel pool side provide great service and they were very attentive. Thank you for your service. Ashley checked on us several times during our visit and refilled our water and drinks with eagerness. We truly appreciate her and her dedication.

Christiane, guest ambassador was excellent. She explained my options very well, was patient and very respectful. I appreciated her a lot. Her warm and sincere approach made my trip memorable. In terms of the room, the mattress and the pillows were okay. Coffee and the breakfast restaurant were very good. The hostess in the restaurant Paula Bigger was phenomenal. As a solo traveler I appreciated her warm and caring approach.

I stayed here during hurricane Helene. All the staff was great and the rooms were so clean. However, I was very impressed by the dedication and attention given by the members of the catering staff, especially Carlos and Terrance. Terrance remembered my name after the first night and asked how my day was every time i saw him. He asked with genuine concern about the safety of my loved ones after the storm. He made me feel like I was at home talking to an old friend while still being attentive to his job. Carlos was funny and energetic and gave some good recommendations for local things to do. I looked forward to talking with both gentlemen at each of my meals. They made a boring work trip less boring. These guys make me hope for another work trip here. Thx guys 💓

Mario was a pleasure to meet. He explained everything very well and he was also very helpful. He asked pertinent questions about our travel history and made good suggestions about future stays at Hilton locations. We look forward to future stays.

Beautiful Hotel! Wonderful Staff at the pool Bar -Restaurant Especially Gina! Also the front desk Staff everyone there was very helpful! And The Fast Break restaurant and staff were so nice and Delicious food at the pool and also at Fast Break!

This was a case of expectations vs. reality. In point form; Pros - Food options were exceptional. We visited both Todovos and Fastbreak multiple times. Food was fantastic each time. Prices were very fair as well - Location is wonderful for anything on I-Drive. Rideshare was about $8 to any place on the strip. - Pools and lazy river were great. - Beds are very comfy Cons - Property is definitely showing its age, for a supposed 4 star resort the rooms are worn and dated. - There wasn't a single USB port in the room. When I asked to borrow a "brick" from the front desk to charge my phone they told me to walk across the street to Walgreens and buy one. - Water in the room had to run for 3-4 min before it was hot - in room TVs do not have casting or streaming ability. - Resort fee says it includes a 15% discount at the onsite restaurants, however every time we ate and said we are charging it to the room, they gave us a check with no discount. We ate on site 6 times. All 6 times we had to ASK for the discount. - Our rate included a $50 resort credit per day, when checking in we were not informed of exactly how it was going to be applied. This caused confusion upon checkout and we ended up with $100 of unused credit. While the location was great, we will wait until a full renovation is complete at this property until we visit again. In the meantime Rosen Shingle Creek and Omni Championsgate are better options for less cost.

Mario was a great Hilton ambassador and sold us on a great experience to come back to Orlando in the future. The amenities and Spa at this location are amazing and we had a wonderful time. The pool bar poured really delicious cocktails, hospitality is great here.

Stayed at the Hilton Orlando during a recent convention. It was a great stay. Walking distance to hotel and convenient to I-drive and downtown. Hotel was clean and offered many amenitie. Highly recommend staying here if visiting the downtown area!

Couples massage Groupon was amazing. We signed up for Hilton Honors prior to and got an amazing deal with Leah Guest Services on ANOTHER vacation! The resort is gorgeous. The pictures online don’t do it justice. We can’t wait to be local frequent flyers at Hilton Orlando! Pro tip: we kept our son in daycare during the day so we could get away as husband and wife! What a lovely experience!

Beautiful compound, spa was delightful, Leah our guest ambassador made us feel like royalty! Abdul at the front desk was super friendly and funny! The valet and bellhop servers were quick, informative, and efficient. 10 out of 10 experience! My wife and I will definitely be back.

Excelente hotel para pasar en familia y con amigos una atención excelente y piscina para que los niños disfruten tobogán y piscina con balsas lo recomiendo la mejor experiencia de unas de mis vacaciones con mi familia es un hotel grande y con mucha limpieza

Terrible, muy malo muy lleno mal servicio , my decepcionada, mal servicio mal trato,no nos gustó, no regresaremos . My familia quedó muy decepcionada no esperábamos tan mal trato . No se prepararon para este fin de tantas personas .Terrible Terrible

Precioso hotel ! Muy lindo, me encantó que la app te da un check in con llave, que te hace poder entrar y salir de la habitación, y hacer check out sin filas ! Buen gimnasio, y enormes espacios Nuestra única queja fue que el día del check out era a las 11 hrs, y la persona de aseo pasó tocándonos la puerta a las 10.50 hrs recordándonos que debíamos salir, nos pareció innecesario y de mal gusto, pero fuera de eso; todo estuvo muy bien

Our family of 6 booked a cabana day pass here because we had a lot of time to kill between an early morning cruise departure from Port Canaveral to our flight home out of Orlando. It was nicer than we expected. After booking online through a 3rd party, think it was resortpass.com, we just showed up, self parked our rental and the hotel took us from there. All of the hotel staff were courteous, the food and drink service at cabana was prompt and delicious! The hotel grounds were clean and offered a lot of amenities! Many areas to either be loud and party or relax in quiet. Nice lazy river, basketball courts, volley ball, many different hot tubs and fire pits. Was almost sad we couldn’t stay the night and try out the cute outside restaurant and fire pit areas! Everyone looked like they were enjoying themselves! Looked like a nice spot for families with older kids (that are over the Disney themes, to launch to Disney or Universal!

I love this hotel. Has everything in it. Clean and neat. My wife love the mall where you can find everything. We are from Aruba. We have recommended family and friends to stay at this hotel. Looking forward for our next stay.

Excellent staff who were attentive to our needs. Food was what you should expect at any conference. The food was served hot and service personnel were attentive without being intrusive. Rooms were well kept and maintained.

This hotel is lovely. We pleasantly surprised by our room. It was very nice, bed comfortable, everything very clean. Major issue that we worry about: it was very quiet!! We know there were a lot of people in the hotel because we were there for a conference.

Always great staff nice rooms Excellent gym and pool Location is excellent food court is an added bonus and staff are exceptional Bed and pillows always ensures a great night sleep Breakfast in restaurant is really great value

Look no further and book your event with them. Erika held my hand through the process and details of how my daughters quince would be a success. And for the day of the event Myle was extremely supportive and available for my every need. The location was out of my price range, however it was worth it to make my daughters quince a success. The service was perfect, the food was finger licking good and my daughter & family had a night to remember. The venue is great to work with, the location is convenient And honestly I would do it all over again. Thank you!

My Wife and I have stayed at this property many times. This has been our first trip back since the pandemic. This is always our go to hotel in Orlando. The convenience of being attached to the Florida mall is a great perk. The real reason we keep returning here are the staff at all levels are so friendly and accommodating. You get the feeling that they genuinely appreciate having you as a guest. We spent 3 nights and had all our breakfast at Marcellos and dinner with cocktails at Crickets. All meals were great without any complaints. We enjoy evening cocktails and Crickets bar just off the Lobby makes some great Martini's. Daniel in Crickets looked after us every evening with superb service. We will be back sooner rather than later this time. Robert. Trinidad.

Overall the hotel is amazing, unfortunately my trip was for business and not pleasure, but I will definitely come back with my family to enjoy the locations in Orlando. Thank you very much for the attention from all the staff involved.

My husband and I stayed at The Florida Hotel for 5 nights. This hotel is so pretty and attached to the mall which was a plus. We were in town for a bowling tournament. I love the do not disturb and make-up room lights by the door. We were given coffee, tea, and two bottles of water daily. On the last day, everything was done in our room but the bed wasn't made, I guess the person got distracted but it was not a big deal. The pool was perfectly heated as well as the sauna. We had a broken lamp and I called the front desk who sent engineering up to the room to take care of it within 10 minutes. Our room view was on the 11th floor looking over the parking lot and the circus across the street. We will be back I loved it here. We ate at Cricket's Bar I had the wings and they were DELICIOUS!!! My husband had the steak and vegetables and said that the steak was cooked to perfection. Thank you so much for a beautiful hotel and great staff!!

Clean & well equipped rooms….each with a fridge & microwave. All amenities well maintained. Staff are so helpful & friendly. Lively bar just off reception area serving good value food & drinks. Great sized pool & a very well equipped gym

I travel for business and this is my favorite Hotel to come to. The hotel offers a great restaurant/Bar along with a breakfast restaurant, Starbucks and Chick-fil-A. The food and atmosphere are perfect. The Hotel offers a direct entrance to the Mall as well and makes for an enjoyable time. The rooms are very nice very clean and well taken care of. The staff is one of the main reasons I come back, very polite, helpful and happy. This is a must stay.

The staff is always friendly courteous and are always so welcoming. And besides the staff being super awesome the rooms are always clean and they smell clean love the hotel and there's alot around the hotel to shop at.

I have no complaints. The staff was excellent and hosts our yearly event every year always with a smile! The rooms were remodeled, comfy and very clean. I look forward to the return trip in October. Oh yeah…great Bloody Mary’s

We stayed here for 1 night after leaving a really dirty and dodgy hotel. What can I say? The Florida Hotel is simply outstanding! It was so clean, staff very helpful, well lit rooms and very spacious. Beds were very comfortable, sheets and towels spotless and floors super clean. Added bonus is the Florida Mall attached to it 😊 Can be a little expensive but what you’re getting is pure luxury. There’s also a Starbucks in the main lobby. I wish we had had more time to check out the swimming pool and gym but from what we saw, they looked amazing. I wish we’d discovered this hotel sooner as we would’ve spent longer there! Would definitely recommend to everyone and will be back in a few months when we return for our Disney vacation 😁 If you’re staying outside Disney, this little gem of a hotel is simply perfect!

Upon arrival at the florida hotel a week ago. After a very chaotic flight here between airlines and rentals we arrived at the hotel late, exhausted and confused. And expected nothing good to come out of our next experience. But to our surprise as we pulled into the roundabout at the entrance. We were greated with open arms by the kindest gentleman I've ever met. His name was Luis. And as a member of the service industry myself, let me just say he is above standard of who you want to be your first impression for guests. His ability to read our situation, and reassure us things are looking up from here. Turn our nightmare start to and incredible stay at Florida. He took our bags, gave us a brief rundown of operations, elevators etc. Gave us a key to park the car directions to local stores and restaurants... The whole nine. And I should make a point to say his kindess and hospitality was a deciding factor for us to extend our stay not once, but TWICE. as we half jokingly said how can we leave without saying goodbye to him. Well that settles it, push the flight back. Thank you Luis for all of your help and hospitality for our much needed r&r before heading back home to our grind. The Florida hotel should recognize him as a most invaluable asset to there operations.

My room was clean, fresh, comfortable....it was PERFECT! I did not use the mini fridge or coffee maker. The room had a safe, but again, I did not use it. The bed was very comfortable, with clean sheets and pillows. The A/C was very easy to program and worked perfectly. I have NOTHING to complain about. Very enjoyable stay and will gladly stay again if the opportunity arises.

This hotel is an amazing value. I was there for a state conference and the price was very reasonable for Orlando. The staff are always pleasant, courteous, and professional. The room was scrupulously clean, well stocked, and the view on the 4th floor was breathtaking! The breakfast is a hot buffet with made to order omelets. The food on the buffet was hot and plentiful and coffee was refilled by staff quickly. This is not the first year our conference has been here and every year we have a consistently wonderful experience!

What a bargain! Beatiful hotel. Amazing pool and gym!! I have never seen a gym with pelotons. Rooms were clean. Beds comfortable. Luis at the front door was funny and sociable. Nice private keycard parking

My experience at this hotel was spectacular! The staff is very friendly and accommodating. The rooms are clean, and the beds are extremely comfortable....I literally slept like a baby. My stay was related to business, but, I'll definitely be visiting for pleasure in the near future.

Room was clean and well attended to; front desk staff, particularly Kaliq, was super friendly; breakfast buffet had a great variety and friendly staff; convention area was nicely maintained; great to be attached to the mall; easy parking; great overall trip

Excellient hotel . One of the best I have stayed on this Vacation . From the minute you arrive until departure reception staff could not do enough for you . Spotless clean rooms. Pool area fantastic and very relaxing. Location is excellient I wish we had of booked longer here . Great quality for the price . Right in mall also if you like shopping fantastic food available . Thank you to the managment and staff for the brilliant service . We stayed room 410 and my friend connecting room . Thank you for making this a wonderful way to end or vacation . Thakk Nola from Adrienne and Eleanor Ireland .

This is a hotel that is low end charging mid prices. Hotel is in need of a lot of maintenance. Toilet hard to flush. Safe did not work. Closet door off the tracks and on. Housekeeping is hard to come by and staff does not care. Walls paper thin. Would not recommend.

Rubbish German food prices hiked for substandard , sat in restaurants where told and tables saved for the Germans never again would never stay again as this is the worst ever !!!! Absolutely rubbish waste of money what more can I say ??? Please don’t book this awful as it’s just wasting your money

Before I get to the pros and cons, let me start off by warning anyone who wants to book a volcano view. We booked a volcano view and I attached pictures of what we got. Our view was a crumb of the side of the volcano and mostly the back end of the park by the slide area where it looked like staff went to take breaks. The pictures I took were only able to be taken from the right aspect of the room. I had to really get at an angle to take the picture of the volcano. If you truly want to stay at this hotel and see the volcano, maybe call and book (we booked online) to make sure you are actually getting the view of the volcano. To be fair, we called the front desk because of the shock of the view to confirm it was truly a volcano view and they confirmed. They also called us back to see if we wanted to get another room the following day if it was available, but we were going to be in the parks all day and could not fit that into our schedule as we would have to be physically available in the hotel so we declined. They had mentioned the hotel was fully booked and it was crazy busy from a cheerleading/dancer competition going on so it was not a risk we were willing to take. Starting with the positives-the location and theming of the hotel is excellent. The staff was the best part of the stay. They were extremely friendly. The bayline diner and the market were pretty big and had plenty of options for everyone. We stayed at the Beachside tower so it was a little bit of a walk to the lobby but not bad. The walking area was very pretty. I would recommend to ask for a room closer to the lobby if anyone in the family has issues walking. The resort is BIG so it might not be a nice walk for everyone. The cons-As others have mentioned, housekeeping was never seen in the 3 days we were there. However they did come into the room to fix the bed on the second day. They do let you know that housekeeping is done every other day. I did not mind that but the carpets in the hallways were so dirty and smelly! Plenty of stains everywhere. It was kind of crazy. Although this is a value resort, we stayed during a very busy weekend. For the amount of surcharge they added to the room, you would expect them to be on top of the cleaning a little bit more. Where is all the extra money going to if not additional staff to accommodate the amount of people. Also, if you booked close to volcano bay, know that you will absolutely be able to hear the music from the park every morning at 8 am. The walls are very thin so you can also hear every crying baby in your vicinity. Overall, if this hotel fits your budget, cautiously go for it. However, I cannot recommend it.

Spent a week at Cabana Bay. Hotel was only ok average. Not much of an atmosphere very conference centre like. Checked in the first night and got to the room and the shower had suspicious looking hairs in it. Called the front desk to let them know they offered to send someone up to sort it but pointless they shouldn’t have been there in the first place. Towels left short also on one of the housekeeping days. Parking rates extortionate. Hotel in general looks tired and needs some TLC. Sapphire falls across the road looks much nicer.

El hotel es muy bonito pero llegamos a las 5 de volcano bay , mojados y con frío para ducharnos y no habían limpiado el cuarto ,no teníamos toallones limpios Tuve que ir a recepción a quejarme y esperar que me atiendan debido a la cantidad de gente esperando. De todos los hoteles que estuvimos hospedados en Orlando es la primera vez que nos sucede Una vergüenza

Un hotel estupendo, está al lado del parque acuático volcano bay. La habitación era muy buena y además habían muchas piscinas con grandes toboganes, quedaba cerca de los tres parques de Universal (Island of Adventure, Universal Studios y Volcano Bay).

Big Resort is in a quiet area at universal, easy check in, friendly staff,comfy bed in a smaller room overlooking the pool area, but still quiet. Lots to do here but you must walk alot to get about the resort...can be tough on seniors. Food is quite good, but long lines certain times of day getting food can mean cold food when you finally get to your seat to eat. The Starbucks on site is excellent. Pool area is large and clean with several bars and places for snacks and food. Lazy river is long but they charge alot for tubes.

Excelente decisión. Alojarnos dentro de Universal no solo te permite estar cerca de los parques, sino la entrada temprana y traslado en el micro. Está cerca de los parques pero sobretodo es completo. Grande pero bien distribuido, piletas y bares muy lindos. Arriba hay para jugar bowling o juegos electrónicos, de pago aparte y realmente lo usamos y disfrutamos muchos. Tiene un patio de comidas enorme con mucha variedad y buen precio. También un Starbucks dentro. Realmente amamos las vistas a Volcano Bay y todo funcionó a la perfección. Tuvimos la suerte de tener cuartos cerca con mi mamá ya que estábamos separados. En el Lobby suele haber personajes y la atención de todos es excelente. No tengo cosas malas para decir y volvería SIN DUDA.

Un desastre! Contrate la habitación más cara (con cocina) no tiene elementos para cocinar. Solo te dejan platos y cubiertos de plástico. No tiene ni tostadora. Colchón muy malo que te hundis cuando te acostas. Es mi cuarto día acá y nunca vinieron a limpiar la habitación ni cambiar toallas. No vengan ni paguen de más por estar aqui. Lo único bueno son los traslados a los parques.

Very easy going family place. Walking distance to the parks (a bit of a long walk, not right next door). Big pools and facilities, good informal places to eat, right next door to volcano bay. Rooms are spacious if you get the family room. A little more expensive than outside hotels but a lot cheaper than the higher end universal resorts with the proximity to the parks.

Lo que más me gustó es su cercanía con Vulcano Bay ,podrían mejorar un poco más el servicio de limpieza y el aspecto de la piscina Lo más recomendable su horario de traslados en bus a los parques de Universal Su predisposición con la gente con alguna discapacidad física

El hotel no es lo que promete. Las habitaciones familiares son súper chicas. Solo para 4 personas y que sean niños pequeños, no entran 6 personas como promocionan. El sofá cama es inservible. No se puede dormir ahí. Todo lo que ofrecen se paga aparte, el bowling, la sala de juegos. El parque acuático es solo un tobogán. El río lento está en otro edificio. No volvería a elegirlo nunca más.

I had a Universal pass and we wanted to go to Volcano Bay. That required a one night stay. We chose Cabana Bay because it was a walking path into the park an hour early. The room was clean and comfortable. If you're going to Volcano Bay, this is definitely the place you want to stay.

Stayed here for 2 weeks and I was really pleased with everything Room everything you need is there and nice and clean perfect reception for WiFi Staff very friendly and polite Pools absolutely amazing not to crowded Buses to parks every 10 minutes I will definitely be back

The main resort building is very cute in its retro theme. There are dining options and entertainment (arcade, bowling, work out space etc) the pools are also enjoyable. But don’t eat the mozzarella sticks (late night) or the “grilled cheese”/cheese quesadilla @ the atomic bar. However, the rooms. Oof did I get a doozy of a room. I was booked in the castaway section rm 1111 it comes with a kitchenette, 2 beds, a fold out sofa, closet and ample bathroom space. To get to this room you play mental gymnastics with yourself. Yes, the numbers did go from 1110 to 1112 no, you’re not hallucinating. You must “exit” the resort area into the parking lot to find your room. Once in your room you get to enjoy the delightful ambiance of a busy parking lot and several dozens of guests loudly walking by your room daily. But don’t worry, you can also hear all the movements and conversations of the adjoining room as well. Did they just open a muffin container? Yup. Did they just open a plastic bag? Yup. Want to learn a new language? Cabana bay has got you. Just ask to be booked next to someone who speaks another language. You’ll pick it up. Prepare to sleep in arctic conditions, and if you’re lucky like me you’ll be blessed with sleeping on the pull out sofa. Formerly used as a torture device in gulags you too can now enjoy sleeping on the hardest substance known to man. TL;DR: Stay here bc it’s on park property and it’s cute. Bring ear plugs, bring or buy sweats to stay warm, and got the love of all things good, DO NOT SLEEP ON THE PULL OUT SOFA.

We stayed at cabana Bay for two nights both mornings no hot water. I alerted the staff was told that Maintenance would come down and check on it. We never seen anybody come to the room for it, but I took for granite that the situation was under control seeing that the hotel was not all that busy or overbooked. I didn’t understand why there was not hot water at the most. It was piss warm, but was told it would be fixed by Maintenance after our not so great shower we headed towards the parking lot where they were cleaning the hotel although you could not tell they were going to get ready to power wash here comes the water all over our hair and clothes, bleach water! Destroying our clothes so we had to go back and take another cool shower. Next morning woke up to the same piss warm water. I alerted the staff through text. I wasn’t asking for any discounts or anything and I made that clear but she needed to address the water issue in the building we were staying at Will never stay here again. I suggest finding a different hotel.

nice holiday but had late checkout with virgin holidays that housekeeping didnt know about so were rushed out of room leaving behind 2 tshirts hat and sunglasses contacted lost and found but nothing handed in would not recomend this hotel poor customer service once you have paid

Where to begin. This hotel was part of a package through Maximum for my daughter's World's for cheer. Pros: Cabana Bay is pretty epic. A lot to do, from bowling to swimming. We really liked the place in general. The room was clean, the grounds were clean, and we felt safe the entire time. Food was decent. They have laundry machines that'll take card or quarters. Being next to Volcano Bay, with it's own entrance, was wonderful. Cons: Food was expensive. The place was packed, probably sold out, so swimming was a nightmare. Even though there are 2 pools, your shoulder to shoulder with everyone from about 4 to 10 pm. Forget finding a chair. Rooms are small. The path to get across the street to get to the water taxi is dumb. It'd be easier to just cross the street. Even though Orlando doesn't want to make it a crosswalk... They need to suck it up and do it. No one wants to walk an extra mile to cross the street. We'll stay here again in 2025, because the only other option are the 2 not connected to the property, but I can already tell you that in 2024, with the package, 6 nights (which was max allowed) at Cabana Bay for the cheer World's, for 3 people, was $2862. Prices are already out for 2025, and the same package, but now only allow 5 nights, at Cabana Bay will cost $3256. So you lose a night and increase $400. That's Bidenomics for you.

Stayed for 11 nights and was pleasantly surprised how amazing the place was! Having stayed at the Hard Rock and Portofino hotels on site previously, I was worried that this would be a bit of a step down but I was so wrong! In fact, it was better! So many facilities including the wonderful lazy river, plenty of places to eat, pool open really late. We had a volcano view room in the Bayside tower and it was brilliant. View was outstanding. Only possible negative which is the same every place I stay - never enough hangers in the wardrobe! How on earth they think you can get away with just 5 for 2 people is beyond me. I asked them to send 20 more to the room but they refused saying we could only have 10. Was a bit disappointed because it was still not enough but we just had to get on with it. Other than that, perfect!

This hotel may be good for families with kids however it is extremely noisy and busy. The pool side rooms are exposed to loud music until 11 pm. Kids were running up and down the halls. There is no sit down restaurant. There is a large food court however the GF pizza was raw and the prices are more in line with a better hotel. We were also surprised to find that tubes for the lazy had to be purchased ($17 for a large tube). The staff was very nice, it just wasn’t enough to make the stay enjoyable.

The family and I planned to visit Universal Studios/Islands of Adventures for the long President's weekend (February 19-21, 2022). Prior to our trip, we researched and booked the Castle Hotel due to its reviews and close location to the parks. The bonus part was all the restaurants within walking distance. I had the pleasure of speaking with the Director of Front Office, Mr. Carlos Rosario prior to our arrival. I first want to start off by saying that the customer service is top notch at the hotel. It starts with Carlos being very helpful with my reservation and needs. He and his team went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect, and it sure was! The President's weekend was packed with visitors due to the long weekend and several sport activities going on in the area. Once we arrived in Orlando, we went straight to the parks, I connected with Carlos to advise him we would be a late check-in, he assured us no problem. We arrived at the hotel around 10pm, i walked up to the front desk and was assisted by a wonderful agent who was very welcoming. I provided my name and right next to her was Mr. Carlos Rosario who welcomed me as well with a great smile!! Although he was very busy due to the traffic within the lobby, he took the time to welcome me and my family and assisted me with my room keys and explanation of the hotel. This type of service goes a long way. He mentioned he would be at the front desk all weekend and If I needed anything to just let him know. We went up to our room, opened the door and it was perfect! Clean and spacious. Beds were comfy and so was the pullout sofa. The following day we took off to the parks again, (great location to the parks as I mentioned). We arrived back to the hotel around 6pm and I had the pleasure of meeting the front desk agent, Ariel. She was so friendly and helpful with a few requests I needed. Even the morning that we were checking out, I stopped by the restaurant to get Starbucks and the staff there were friendly and always smiling. You truly sense the above and beyond feel at this hotel. I plan on returning and recommending this hotel to friends and families. What a great experience staying at this hotel. Kudos to Carlos and his Rockstar Team!

I stayed in Jan 2022, I sent an email to management about my concerns but no one wrote me back. I wasn’t expecting much but at least a reply. Not sure if I want to stay here again if their management doesn’t even have the courtesy to reply to an email from their customer. Titanium member.

During January I stayed weekly at this property. For the most part it was a great stay and each visit. However on my fourth visit to the property after being upgraded by no choice for an extra $36 a night to still a double bedroom but they said it was the corner see if the pay more. That aside I don’t care. What I cared about was on my fourth day I requested a freshen up of linens and replenishment of bath amenities. After working a 12 hour shift at the airport I returned back to the room to find none of that stuff taken care of. I requested that in the morning their housekeeping on the app and it was confirmed. When I texted the front desk via the app they said they would address it. Nothing ever happened. So I’m not staying at another property elsewhere. I am in a elite member With Marriott. I travel 4 to 5 days a week staying in Marriott hotels. Then you’re charge $20 a day for parking and good luck trying to find a spot. I had to park and Jason hotel next-door and worry about being towed.

I have to give this hotel a great review. Starting with checkin, the agent was wonderful and made sure I had what I needed, including a glass of wine! I greatly appreciated this, and I also like that they recognize your status with Marriott. It is becasue of Marriott that I booked here. The room was super clean, the bed comfortable, and the bathroom spotless. Greatly appreciated. What I appreciated even more was that in January, the pool was heated to a very warm, comfortable temperature. I hate when hotels say the pool is heated, and they consider heated to be 75. This pool was well over 80. The bar was also enjoyable. I had a drink and dinner there one night, and the bar tender was very friendly and the food was excellent. I wouldn't mind returning! Thank you for having great service during these ever lingering covid times. My only complaint was that my room wasn't made up, and I didn't realize you had to ask. I think that should be clear at check in. Good job, Castle Hotel. See you again in March.

This is a wonderful hotel in the middle of international drive, which is the perfect location for Orlando! There are unlimited restaurants and actives to do within waking distance. The rooms are spacious and clean. The bartender David, is friendly and nice. It was a perfect stay!

This newly renovated boutique hotel is a joy to stay at - a refined Orlando experience. Lovely staff, nice pool with mellow music. Currently a very good buffet breakfast ($16 adults, $10 children) is the only food offered but there is bar service in the antler lounge (with happy hour specials) starting at 5 pm. Many good restaurants within walking distance. Complimentary coffee is available in the morning and hot chocolate in the evening. Two small recommendations to improve the guest experience - adding a soap dish to the shower and another hook to hang up towels and swimsuits. Thank you for a beautiful vacation!

Stayed here last year while visiting family. The hotel is worn out, dirty. Even though I’m Marriott Bonvoy Platinum, there was no water in the room. You had to collect it at the checkin counter. In general, I’d never stay here again. Waste of money for what it is.

Second stay at this hotel having previously loved it. As others have mentioned it’s currently under renovation and probably would be better to be closed until they’re finished. Although appreciate the effort they have gone to negate the disruption. It should have been made more clear at the time of booking that renovations were taking place. Will probably return when its completed

Hotel is in deep renovation, so it is noisy and not clean. Elevators are use for constructions activities. Rooms are not fully ready, due to shipment delays. The Hotel charge for Parking night customers.

Nice room came while they was doing renovations good scenery but the water pressure is horrible although it's hot the pressure is horrible... Here for Pop Warner Little League football game hoping to have a great time... Llllll00l00lllllllllll0lll000lllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllllll0ll00000llll

We stayed for 2 nights on a short trip to the area which we know well We were aware that it was being renovated on certain floors when we booked it Checkin was excellent and we were given a renovated room but told that the new furniture hadn’t arrived due to the pandemic The room was very spacious and the bed extremely comfortable, the furniture was fine We were not bothered by noise but were aware that work was going on during working hours A comfortable stay and professional staff When all the work has been finished it was be an excellent venue to stay but don’t be put off visiting now A good location for bars and restaurants

All wonderful! All staff are polite, especially Christina, she is wonderful! All accommodations are perfect, from the entrance, pool to the bedrooms, perfect bed, it feels like you're sleeping in the clouds, bathroom with shower, everything new. I stayed before the remodel and now after the remodel, it's fabulous!

Very disappointed to check into a hotel that is currently under construction with limited services and nothing on their website alerting their guest. Over priced dated garden apartment type hotel under Autograph... Reserved a King received double bedded room. I would never have booked myself into a hotel under construction for a week had I known....

I stayed there for a work trip. The hotel is under massive renovation so there is a lot of dust and construction noise and the construction workers are using the elevators so it took me over 10 minutes to get to the lobby. The rooms are nothing special. My room was never cleaned during my stay. They charged me $16 per night for parking but there is no sign or anything telling you there is a charge and all other hotels nearby have free parking. The food options in the hotel are a joke. There is no chance I would ever stay at this hotel again!

We stayed at the Castle Hotel for a wedding and this was one of the finest experiences I’ve had at a hotel. The grounds are beautiful with trendy rooms that trump your standard hotel room. Cool downstairs bar/lounge with friendly bartenders that are great conversation, such as David. Joe was also a fantastic doorman with great recommendations for the area. Furthermore, I left a gold watch with both monetary and sentimental value as it was a family heirloom. Lisa at the front desk provided me rockstar service as she was phenomenal in helping me get this watch that means so much to me back in my hands all the way in North Carolina. Overall, this was a splendid stay and I highly recommend making this your temporary home while visiting the great city of Orlando. As a cherry on top, the location is supreme with convenient bars/restaurants less than a mile away and merely minutes from Universal Studios. Downtown Orlando is not too far away either. Perfect hotel experience!!

Over the last year, I have stayed at this hotel three times. The first two times before the room renovations reached the Concierge level. The hotel is going to be nice when renovations are finished, but I would not recommend it now. Stayed here the third time on November 4, 2021. While the room appeared clean and bright, construction dust permeated the air while we slept. I would recommend the hotel change the air filters in each room regularly during renovations.

This is a solid hotel located just off international Drive. Though it is not on International Drive it appears it is walkable. The hotel itself is clean, attractive, with a great Hospitality staff to greet you. I did not sample the facilities at all so I can’t comment on that. The only negative is the excess charging for parking. $15 a night would make me think twice about booking there again.

Great stay for a weekend! Staff was wonderful, accommodating and so friendly! We were here to celebrate our anniversary and had never stayed before since we usually stay on disney property. So glad we stayed! The room was fantastic… beds were comfy, rooom was quiet, clean and overlooked the pool area.

Es lindo, diferente y tiene detalles únicos. Esta muy bien ubicado, detrás de International Drive donde hay muy buena opción de restaurantes y entretención. Es un hotel muy básico, esta bien para quien no va de plan de parques con niños,no tiene restaurante. El aseo en las habitaciones es regular y el tapete de los corredores “muy morado”.

Esta es una buena opción si buscan un lugar céntrico en la zona turística de Orlando (IDrive). Se ubica cerca de restaurantes y centros comerciales. Así como a unos 30 minutos de Disney World. El cuarto es cómodo, aunque nada extraordinario. Posee amenidades superiores como tina y cama king size. Mantienen cuidado de los protocolos de Covid 19 con zona de desinfección a la entrada del hotel así como desinfectante en áreas comunes. No obstante, el servicio nos pareció prácticamente inexistente... el día que llegamos fue con lluvias torrenciales y no tuvimos otra opción que bajar las maletas del auto con lluvia y luego reubicarnos, sin ningún paraguas o algo por el estilo, ni nadie que nos ayudara.

Beautiful Hotel close to many Orlando attractions. Came here for a business trip. Enjoyed the hotel amenities for a mini-vacay too! Fitness center, pool, room, and restaurants were clean and the staff were friendly! Thanks Hilton Orlando!

Yaneristo Soto bartender at tropics pool bar made our stay very special . He was patient, kind , and attended to all our needs . We were celebrating my sons 10th birthday and he wanted a special smoothie Yaneristo went out of his way to make our son feel special and was giving him different options and joking with him and my son said it was the best smoothie he ever tasted.
