A simple act of kindness made my son’s birthday truly special . You have a star employee in Yaneristo out at the bar who truly embodies great customer service and can tell he takes pride and truly loves what he does .

Hotel was great, but what truly made the experience was Terry “Terry YAKI” our server at the pool. Friendly, great service and a joy to talk with. The hotel itself has comfortable beds and the check in and out with the Hilton app made things nice and simple.

We had the most amazing time by the pool! It was so much fun! They have a pool for kids with a slide and a quieter one for adults. They also have 2 hot tubs and a lazy river. We had the most amazing server, Erika! She was very attentive and made my daughters birthday feel special! Can’t wait to come back again!

Overall our stay was very good. When we arrived, for Dance Nationals, most of the group was told that we had rooms with a king bed. This was not ideal, but we made the best of it. Also the girls rooms were all messed up, but the front desk associate, Andrew made it right. He spent the time correcting the glitch. The food was great in every location we ate at the hotel.

Our recent stay at the Hilton for a business conference was quite pleasant. We opted for the one-bedroom suite, which was spacious and comfortable, and the check-in process was a breeze. The pool area was well-maintained and provided a nice spot to relax after long conference sessions. However, we were disappointed to discover that the lazy river was out of order during our stay, which was not communicated to us beforehand. On the bright side, the restaurant on-site served good quality food, enhancing our overall dining experience. Despite the minor inconvenience with the lazy river, we enjoyed our stay and found the Hilton to be a convenient and comfortable choice for our business trip.

Maria and Anna, bartenders at the Fastbreak sports bar, were fantastic. Incredible service, great conversation. They made our group feel welcome and were attentive to every detail. They made sure we had fun and enjoyed our stay at the Hilton Orlando. Thanks Maria and Anna!

Absolutely awful. Hotel was full and they did not have enough staff to support the hotel crowd. Room was beyond dirty. Duvet had mold and was stained throughout, carpet was ripped, cobwebs were in corners of the room, walls were all scuffed, housekeeping took towels and never left any. Never had Shampoo, conditioner and soap. Ice machine room was flooded with water a half inch deep and the smell was horrendous. Pool was nice, staff was nice. Don’t stay here. The Hyatt is an 8 minute walk away from this hotel and only a few minutes from the convention center. We have stayed there before and wished we stayed there this time. Rooms were so small and it felt worse than a motel.

We were here for a dance competition and we went to Tropics bar by the pool. Gaylon was an awesome server. He made sure all of our wants were met. His personality was awesome. He made everyone feel at home. We need more people like Garlon in this world.

💯 recomendado, la atención es estupenda , habitación limpia , y el hotel hermoso , el desayuno estaba muy rico y la atención del personal es muy buena , la zona de la picina es muy bonito , lastima el clima no se presta mucho para disfrutar la picina

GAYLON IS AMAZING AT THE POOL BAR! GO SEE HIM AND ONLY HIM! WE LOVE YOU GAYLON! We came for the day for a bridal party and he took amazing care of us, checking in and going the extra mile for us to have a great time
Great service from Terriaki (Terry)). Friendly! Quick! On top of everything and making sure my daughter had the best 40th birthday. He ensured the cabana was stocked and kept on everything. Wonderful

Lidianna was the Guest Ambassador for the Hilton Orlando. She greets us every time we visit. She offers many amazing packages and the best part is she does not put pressure on you to make a purchase. She represents Hilton as a true professional!
Phil at Fast Break was great. One of the best servers we have ever had. Made sure everything was right. He was right about the hot sauce. Very good. Ask for Phil the next time you are at Fast Break

I was there for 5 nights and have zero complaints about my stay. The bed was so comfortable, and the room got so dark with the blackout curtains, so it was a real bummer for me that I had to get up early every day for a conference instead of sleeping in. There was a lounger chair in the room that was also super comfortable. The shower was fantastic. The cleaners did a really great job. I only had time to go to the pool one day, but it was delightful, and the pool-side drink service was really prompt and friendly.

I had an absolutely excellent experience during my stay at this hotel. From the moment I checked in until the day I checked out, every encounter with the hotel’s employees was exceptional. The staff’s professionalism, friendliness, and willingness to assist made my stay truly memorable. I was greeted with warm smiles at the front desk and clear instructions of amenities, the housekeeping team kept my room immaculate, and the restaurant staff provided top-notch service - Everyone was so great and smiling. It’s evident that the hotel values its employees, as their commitment to guest satisfaction shines through. I can’t wait to return to this hotel for another outstanding stay. My brother’s weekend celebration with the family was awesome. We had a great time. Thank You!

Perfect stay-cation for a day out for a Bachelorette. And Andrew was our server and he was amazing! He needs a raise for sure. Service was excellent! He brought us drinks wherever we were at the resort!

Stayed her for 5 nights and loved it. its right next to the convention center which is what i came here for. this made it very convenient. The front desk service was fast and efficient. My room was clean, smelled good and the bed was very comfortable. The restaurant in the hotel has a "limited menu" but the food was very good so i can't complain about that. I ate dinner for three nights in it. The pool area was wonderful. I did not have any children but you can tell the pool area caters to them. There is an adult pool, a spa, a kiddie pool and a lazy river which is not very deep. Also they have a water slide and a nice food/bar area. The place is not cheap but its right next to the convention center and it is a beautiful hotel. I don't know how far it is to the Disney Parks because that's not what i came for. With the resort fee you do get a discount in the restaurant. I did not have a car so I'm not familiar with the parking. Would stay there again

Idager Guest ambassadors was awesome and got a package from her the hotel is excellent and the service too! Can’t wait to come back and stay again with my package. Awesome property and experience highly recommended

We had a day pass with a cabana every one was very nice from the front desk personnel to Wait Staff and the cabana coordinator I would like to say thank you to Terry Yaki and Shawn they went above and beyond made use feel special it was my son Giovanni Birthday and they came out to sing to him. The Resort grounds was beautiful the lazy river was fun and clean plenty of room to sit. Food was great and drinks were tasty. We will be back for sure.

Lindo hotel con bella decoracion. Ubicado en una zona muy centrica y cerca a muchos restaurantes,lugares d entretenimientos y tiendas. Muy recomendado. Personal muy amable. Habitaciones comodas y precio modico.

Entrance to the hotel garbage was always overflowing. Dirty, room was not clean upon check-in. We wiped everything down upon arrival. Plate found behind the refrigerator. Cork stew opener found next to refrigerator. Headboards were dusty, looked liked nothing had been cleaned in awhile. I won’t be staying at a Marriott, let alone this one ever.

I needed to travel during Covid and needed to stay in Orlando for one night. This hotel was perfect. I was able to relax by the pool that evening and the room was very clean and comfortable. The staff was great. Both girls behind the desk were friendly and helpful. I would definitely recommend this hotel for a nice quiet getaway solo or as a couple.

My husband and I stayed here New Years Eve then came back at the end of June. Great little hotel. We love the decor and ambiance. Staff are very nice and helpful. Although the bar and restaurant are closed due to Covid-19 now-we loved them in December- the front desk will be happy to sell you drinks (both alcoholic and nonalcoholic) as well as snacks and amenities. That was very convenient. We had a great time twice and highly recommend. Something I almost forgot to mention- the Castle is very close to Universal Studios and surrounded by hotels meant for kids and families. This Hotel provides a really nice break from all the chaos and is peaceful and best suited for adults. (We love kids-but after spending the day at Universal with then- we appreciated the quietness of the hotel).

I'm a travel agent so I stay at plenty of hotels and I was on vacation a couple weeks ago with my boyfriend for the weekend. I love that the hotel is close to icon Park Orlando. Front desk was very friendly, the bar was closed unfortunately due to covid-19. hotel room seemed very clean we got there around 5 so we wanted to go out for the night so we went out right away to icon Park didn't arrive back to the hotel until around midnight. When my boyfriend laid on the bed there was a car toy right behind his pillow! I called the front desk immediately informing them that the we found a kid's toy underneath our pillow and we obviously don't have children and lucky the front desk representative moved us to a different room right away. it's still shocking that we found a kid's toy in our bed! Obviously the bed was not properly clean by the housekeeper's. when I checked out I figured they would give us some kind of discount but they charged full price. I didn't bother to ask for a manager because I was in a rush to head back home because my boyfriend had to work that evening . I have been to many hotels in my life and never have had this happen. Just make sure to check your bed when staying here!

Very cool hotel with fun ambiance, comfortable rooms, and a great location that is walking distance or short drive to many activities and restaurants. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Nice restaurant including free water, coffee, and tea in lobby. Reasonable fitness center with cardio equipment, free weights, and benches. Take note there's no concierge lounge.

Stayed at this hotel recently. Beautiful and artsy on the inside. Grounds were nice to walk through. The restaurant downstairs was equally artsy and had great drinks and food. Staff was very helpful and very nice. Would definitely stay again.

My brother and I decided we wanted to have a little family vacation to Disneyworld for a few nights. We stayed at the Castle Hotel and immediately when I entered the lobby I was "fan girling" over everything. Everything was so pleasant to look it- this hotel paid so much attention to detail and it was noticeable. It really created the perfect vibe for our Disneyworld Vacation. The pool was also beautiful.

Beautiful property, clean rooms, friendly staff. We had a quick stay and the staff accommodated us coming in earlier than expected. Resort like property. The theme of the hotel was really nice, enchanted and fairy tale like. Many placed to take beautiful photos. Also great location.

Each year that I attend the Global Pet Expo, I look forward to staying at the Castle Hotel. Great style: furniture & artwork, super nice staff and really good food/drinks on the premises. The view from the roof is epic.

I visited this hotel at the last minute with my dog. I have never traveled with my pets and was worried about the difficulty of doing this. The staff was wonderful and so very accommodating! I could not recommend the staff or the hotel more highly!

Always enjoy this hotel and it’s unique design. Generally quiet and relaxing compared to other I-Drive hotels. Front desk and manager very helpful and accommodating. Nice pool and restaurant areas, friendly staff. Only quibbles are parking fees are charged when every other area hotel is free. Also, shower pressure is feeble. Overall still enjoyable and most certainly will return.

I had the opportunity to stay here as a result of evacuating from Hurricane Dorian with my pets. From the reservation, the check-in, the bellmen, the hospitality staff, the maids and of course the front desk team—- everyone could have been trained at Ritz Carlton given their attention to details of guests needs and professional care during my stay. I LOVE THIS HOTEL BECAUSE THEY LOVE PEOPLE WITH PETS. If anyone entered the hotel lobby, they would never guess that pets are permitted—- it was spotless, fresh, and well designed for all guests those with pets and others.

Visited the Castle Hotel 8/1 and chose it because of the decor I saw online. It looked as if its designed for "Girl Trip" weekends. The lobby is beautiful and the staff was very pleasant. Housekeeping was prompt. Although the common areas are nice, the rooms could use some updating. I was disappointed with the $15 a day fee for self parking and $100 a day for incidentals.(this isn't Vegas!) The brunch at the onsite restaurant was great. It was pleasant experience for my friends and I but I'm pretty sure this will be my only visit

The Castle Hotel is beautiful and unique compared to others in this area or period. It is themed and looks like an actual castle all the down to the staffs’ attire. The staff is friendly and helpful. I only had one night to enjot the hotel but I’ll likely return. It’s very luxurious all the way from the pool area, to the rooms, to the exterior and lobby areas. Even the bathroom amenities are unique. The property also sits in an area close to several attractions and restaurants, making it very easy to walk around for a night out. There are several hotels in the International Drive area with similar prices and not nearly as many amenities. Might as well stay here if only for a night. I highly recommend doing so!

I owe a huge THANK YOU to the staff of the Castle! While out for a run, I tripped and hit my chin on the sidewalk. There was quite a bit of blood, and I went to the nearest hotel, the Castle, and just hoped to clean up the cut and grab some paper towels. Jeison immediately asked if I needed help, and showed us to the family restroom so my husband could come with me. Jeison met us with a bag of ice, which I'm sure helped reduce swelling. When we came back to the lobby, I needed to sit down because I was shaking. Karen and Christina at the front desk brought me a compress and alcohol wipes. Wonderful, caring treatment for someone who wasn't even a guest.I left a message for General Manager, Tammy Bateman, to let her know how well I was treated. She kindly called me back, and asked how I was. The Castle can be very proud of the staff and management. The lobby and courtyard were lovely, by the way. I so appreciated the help, and you all gave us a great impression of the people of Orlando!

The hokey location is in walking distance from I-drive, the staff is amazing, my room was available before my check-in time, and I was allowed to check early w/o any issues. Overhaul great experience.

Not sure who is giving positive reviews, however this hotel is an absolute fraud, does not measure up to Marriott or Autograph standards and Marriott should be ashamed for having this in their portfolio, I would stay at any Courtyard or even Fairfield vs being tortured staying at this mismanaged property that is nothing more than a Crown Plaza with chrome lights, neon spotlights and very dated carpets and furniture, it is dirty, its doors or plumbing have never been updated and to top it all off rooms have low, dirty popcorn ceiling that makes you feel like you are in Motel 46 at best. I have checked in too late to change but I would not be staying there ever again, shame on you Marriott!!!

I read some reviews about this hotel but was pleasantly surprised. The only reason I gave a "4" was that the furniture in the rooms should be updated. But the bed and bedding and TV are updated. And the customer service from everyone from the front desk to the restaurant was exceptional!! Rarely do you see this type of service, much less in a Marriott property. Marriott should use this hotel's service as a benchmark for their other properties! Thank you for an enjoyable stay!

Independetly operated boutique. Definitely not up to Marriott standards or most autograph hotel standards. still lots to love. quaint with lots of personality, comfortable beds and linens, close to universal and attached to a great restaurant tutu tango. front desk staff is super friendly but doesn't make up for general dinginess of property.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Had a great stay here in December. I’ve been several times before. Only criticisms are there is almost no storage in the rooms, which isn’t great for a 2 week holiday, and the Harvest Bistro not being open for dinner is not good. This leaves little choice for families, and we ended up going out to eat everyday (after trying the bar food and being very unimpressed). Pool is great, and plenty of sun beds and umbrellas.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We always stay here when in Orlando! It is always clean and friendly. I had a bit of a issue checking in this stay but all and all amazing as usual! Thanks Signia for the amazing hospitality and stay.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: The hotel is beautiful, clean and convenient to Disney park locations. The rooms are spacious and the staff were very friendly and helpful!. They have their own shuttle bus to take you to all the parks. The hotel has a beautiful pool and food and beverage service at the pool. I would highly recommend this hotel .

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: The resort is beautiful, VERY clean & well maintained, and the service was impeccable! I am one to easily get hotel heebie-jeebies and this resort left me with a sense of calm & clean surroundings. We stayed 5 nights on a high floor with a pool view. We loved it & could also see Epcot fireworks at night. It’s perfect for Disney travel. It’s centrally located. Within minutes you could make it to any of the 4 parks or Disney Springs. The shuttles are very comfortable, ran on time & were never overly crowded. We also opted to Lyft a couple of times, and the cost was low due to location. We very much enjoyed our stay & look forward to visiting again soon!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We stayed at the Signia while attending the Workers’ Compensation Institute at the Convention Center. Although not within walking distance, the Center was a short bus ride away. Our room was spacious and clean and the beds were comfortable. The breakfast buffet was excellent. The pool side grill provided good food in a pleasant environment. The entertainment kept everyone occupied. The pool with innertubes and a current provided relaxing hours. The weekend pool-side movie brought Disney Magic to our stay. Signia guests have access to the entertainment at the adjacent Waldorf Astoria that is a short distance away. Its miniature golf course added to our enjoyment. There is a hotel adjacent to the Convention Center. While it might be preferable to those only interested in a convention, we enjoyed the quiet and lack of crowds at the Signia. We would return.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: My family of four stayed here for three nights mid Feb. Used Hilton points for the stay, which helped us avoid the resort charge but we still had to pay $30 a nt for self park. As a Diamond, got $30 per night for Food and Bvg credit, which we used at both the in house sundries store and also the breakfast restaurant and poolside restaurant. We found the restaurants in particular were very expensive so the credit didn't go to too far. Room itself was fine though on a couple of occasions the toilet tank overflowed. We alerted the front desk of this at check out. Pool area very nice with it's lazy river. Water was reasonably warm as well. Both hot tubs had issues though...one had no working jets, and the other was only lukewarm. Did find that the hotel answered concerns via text very quickly, which was nice. All in all pretty decent stay at a well located hotel for doing the Disney parks.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: From the moment we arrived, the valet service, desk, lobby, room, food, tubing and river ride...and shuttle to the park. The hotel was spotless, the staff wonderful and totally attentive...cannot say enough about the experience. So relaxing after the parks...thank you. You forget about all the congestion of all of the parks.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I can not say enough about the over the top excellent customer service. We got daily texts following up with us to see how our stay is, if we need anything, and how our day is going. The hotel is very nice and clean. They provide a shuttle to and from the Disney Parks. The pool and amenities are very nice. We will definitely stay here again soon!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This place is fantastic. Instant hot water. I never knew I needed this. Everything is super clean. Text the front desk with any needs, and they take care of it immediately. Very responsive. Bus service to the parks included in resort fee, as well as half hour early park entry. We picked our room when checking in on the app. We choose a room at the end of the hallway to be away from the elevators. It was a very long walk. It’s much bigger than it looks on the diagram. This will be my number one choice for a Disney visit.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: As new branding evolves, customers so to evolve as to enjoying that new preference or not. After staying 5 days, I have no idea what a Signia branding is or where it belongs in the Hilton portfolio. Most amenities and food services are far below most Hiltons we visit. The beds are not even close to a Westin Heavenly....so they don't fit in that class. Yet, they want a higher price tags on very ordinary rooms......... see no comparable value here at all. I love Hyatt Centrics...... top quality everything...... Signia is closer to a Hyatt Place ( except smaller rooms and higher prices). If you are going to be a FULL service hotel.....have your FULL services open to your customers ALL the time.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I loved staying at the Signia Hotel! Very pretty on the outside and inside of the property. Very comfortable beds! Everything was clean and room service was everyday. Having restaurants inside the hotel was great addition to an awesome stay! I also enjoyed the 24 hour gym! I would definitely stay here again! :)

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Es un hotel donde encuentras todo. Pero no sorprende, la atención no la sientes como huésped al menos que vallas a los restaurantes. Todo muy Cerca de los parques temáticos y buena conexiones. Excelente la piscina.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Strong property for many reasons. Super friendly and helpful staff. Amazing Italian restaurant on site, La Luce. The pool, pool bar and lazy river is top notch and a great way to decompress. It is in the heart on Disney. Literally minutes to Epcot & Hollywood Studios. Tried the Waldorf first (which is next door) but didn’t have a great experience.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I’ve visited so many hotels in Orlando over the past 8 years. This hotel is the best and has something for kids of all ages.. check out BJ at the pool area she’s amazing, Gretchen at the front desk is amazing and will work with you if you have a group and Kim she works in the lobby store super cool person very friendly, the entire staff is awesome really , rooms are extremely clean, the room hallways are so clean that they look like you can’t eat of the floor (not recommended).

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I’ve been staying here regularly for business since June 2020. They take Covid cleanings very serious here. I literally have watched the staff wipe down each and every single lounge chair by the pool on a regular basis. They have wipes all over the hotel & hand sanitizing stations. As far as food is concerned Monday through Thursday it is limited however Friday through Sunday lots of food choices. The lazy river is rocksolid

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: A great hotel. I stayed for 12 nights. The room was nice and clean and large with great views. Modern bathroom with fan! Staff extremely friendly. Parking convenient. Big pool connected with a lazy river. Great Italian Restaurant, La Luce. Grab-n-go had good selection and very friendly staff. Bar in hotel was good and offered good food. I will return after covid to experience two other restaurants that are currently closed.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We have been to this Resort/Hotel over 40 times. And there are too many reasons we keep on coming back! I will list just a few: Service, Cleanliness, Food, Value, Location, Amenities, and the Staff is amazing! We have been to many similar hotels, none can match this Staff and how organize and courteous they are. The food is always great! We call it our second home! We look forward to come as often as possible and are sad when we can’t come as often we would like to! We strongly recommend this Hotel and we know you will be amazed!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I been here a few times. COVID or not, the place has so much room to move around. The grounds are beautiful. The pool is heated with a lazy River. Staff is great. Room have a sticker on them to indicate that they are clean and no one has been in, but if you need something, a concierge texts you! Emma was very helpful. Everyone was. Food in the cafe is generous for a hotel. The Disney store is official so you can get your pass holder discount. Beds are super. Pillows are great. Parking has free EV chargers. The pool has a pool side bar and restaurant. There a baby pool, hot tub, zero entry, lazy River, private areas... really has it all.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Had a wonderful family vacation to the resort, everyone was focused to make sure our stay was memorable, safe and comfortable. The food was fantastic, the hotel is exceptionally clean and very fun. The pools and lazy river provided great enjoyment.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: As per the norm, the service across the board was exceptional and our server at the pool was terrific. Room was clean and comfortable! I’ve spent a considerably amount of time in upstate NY (Buffalo, Rochester, Binghamton) and I know my chicken wings. The Bull & Bear wings are the best I’ve ever had. I would drive from home to pick those up for football Sundays every week - they were so good. Footnote: Bull & Bear at the Waldorf is one of the finest restaurants in the US and one of our favorites!

I don't think we will be back. We have come to this hotel every year since our honeymoon and have always enjoyed our stay. This year was terrible in so many ways. The 'adult pool' was so over crowded with teenagers it was hard to find a place to sit. No staff does anything about this. You could not find someone to bring you anything at the pool areas. Yes, it was busy but they would look at you and walk by pretending not to notice you trying to get their attention. The fire pit near the adult pool was not lit. When asked, a staff person said it didn't work. When the dest was called they sent over two 'engineers' who pulled a button and said it would light in a few minutes. After 5 minutes we were almost overcome with smell of propane and quickly shut it off. (The engineers had left). The next night someone walked over with a torch and lit it. So it did work and the 'engineers' put people in danger. The lobby is a full bar that would step off the elevator into. The new restaurant downstairs has terrible service. You never know who your server is and they have very little food for those of us trying to eat healthy. On the day we went to the park I asked the at the door of the all you can eat buffet if i could please have an oatmeal and fruit cup to go and was denied and told to go to the scratch kitchen (I would have paid the price for the buffet). The lazy river was full of children playing football (the adult were right there watching) and they did not move when you tried to float by. They even would run into you and ignore it. The hotel was so full of people paying for the day ($20) that the guest had no service. Pure greed. One night we ate upstairs and had a buffet. The service was terrible. They never even really did anything for us then tagged an 18 percent tip. Do not by the packages that they come around to sell. They all lie.

The staff at this location go above and beyond. Everyone is very friendly and want to make your stay top notch. Mekayla went out of her way to bring a delivery directly to my room when I wasn’t able to come down to the lobby and I really appreciate it! Thank you so much!

We landed in Orlando at 7:00 am and we were exhausted. We arrived at the front desk of the hotel and met Joseph Mateo, one of the front desk agents. During our stay, he was very informative, patient, understanding, kind, accommodating and was a great help, which was the ray of sunshine☀️ that we needed for our trip. If looked up customer service in the dictionary, you would find his picture under it. He actually said I was the greatest guest that he’s ever dealt with 🥹. We were able to get the next available just as he said to rest our tired eyed. Thanks a million Agent Joseph Mateo and Hilton Orlando.

wilson at David’s was excellent. He was training new staff and had a smile on his face and was patient with them as he was teaching them everything. In today’s day and age when people are rushed and frustrated - his patience level was amazing and really wonderful to see. His smile lit up the room. you have a real gem there.

We stayed here only for 1 night just to return to another hotel because they’re fully booked on the day. Everything is awesome, the hotel is amazing, especially the pool and the service. Naufal helped me with the check in process, the most pleasant front desk staff that I’ve ever met, with the biggest smile! He explained every facility clearly and even arrange our family room to be close to each other. Definitely would find him again on my next stay!

Love the variety of pillows in the bed, staff was great and food and beverage options are really great! Excited to see all the upcoming reservations when I return later this year! Conveniently between airport and Disney.

Great family vacation. The hotel was beautiful and the staff was so friendly and helpful. We rented pool cabana #21 our last full day at the hotel to have a relaxing day, with Erica as our server. She was AMAZING! She worked her trail off to make sure we were taken care of every second...and we were!

Durning NCAA tournament we went to Spencers steak house food was great and Salina was a joy! Lovely bartender! Would recommend, steaks were very good and the pasta was excellent!. Friendly service and very accommodating.

This gorgeous hotel has so many fun activities on property for our teenage boys whether it’s cold or hot. The boys had a blast playing basketball and sitting by the fire pit. The 24hour Scratch Kitchen was a lifesaver for busy our baseball schedule in Orlando. We have stayed here for years, and they keep making it better and better. We can’t wait to book our next visit.

We had our flight cancelled last minute by West Jet and we’re given vouchers to stay over night for the next flight. We selected Hilton Orlando and we’re not disappointed, the staff were very courteous to our situation, gave us a nice room and sorted out the payments and meal charges all part of the bill to the airline. The hotel has good facilities, in house dining and bars. The lobby is very spacious. This is a solid hotel with pleasant staff. We didn’t get chance to sample the pool area and lazy river as not there long enough but looked great. Thanks again Hilton Orlando, a decent hotel in the International Drive area.

Es mi segunda vez visitando este hotel, a mi familia y a mi nos encanto, es un hotel muy grande amplio , con un área de piscina muy amplia, tiene rio Manzo y togobane. Las habitaciones muy limpia y bien equipadas. Siempre tenemos en cuenta cuando planificamos unas vacaciones a Orlando es visitar este hotel.

Hilton Orlando was a good hotel. The food choices vary and are convenient and tasty. My only complaint is the cleaness of the room. The carpet was so dirty my eyes became red and blurry when I was in-room. Someone came and vacuumed. The whole staff are kind and helpful.

Super kind staff and willing to go above and beyond in any area. Including texting me to see if I needed anything, changing rooms, directing me to various places as I am not familiar with this area at all.

Had the great opportunity to spend the weekend with Family and Friends. The quality of the food was off the charts as was the service. The Best was the lazy river and very convenient and hard working staff!! i very strongly recommend this hotel to anybody looking for a famiy spot! Shout Outs to: Erika Daysia Tara Shaniah Briana Chanelle Skyler

I really enjoyed this hotel stay. I was here for business so I cannot speak to any of the resort-style amenities like the spa. The hotel was very nice and large. Room was clean and serviced daily which is a nice departure from other hotels that service upon request. There was a 40 dollar per night resort charge which seems high considering I don’t know what would be added cost. Parking was so abundant that I found a spot in seconds upon arriving. the pool area looked amazing although I did it get a chance to use it. Parking decks very secure and attended at the entry and exit points. Very convenient to international drive and close to the convention center. Lobby bar and lounge very nice size and comfortable. One thing I noticed was the lack of USB chargers in the room which was a miss. However, I think this is a great vacation hotel for those who want to check out for a little while and enjoy Orlando. For business stays, unless you have some down time you won’t be able to take advantage of the amenities.

Stayed here for one night. Loved the pools. Many to choose from plus lazy river. The restaurants are very expensive and not really worth it. I bought a diet coke in the little store. It was $4.73. If i had of pulled one from the vending machine it would be $3.75 - no tax! I would stay here again - just plan on eating dinner off site.

I went there for a business conference, was pleasantly surprised on the good quality of food that was served! Stayed extra day and had my grandchildren join me at the outstanding huge pool recreation area. WOW! lazy river, 3 pools open until 11PM, even a quiet pool if I wanted to escape (as no one under 18 in allowed in that pool area). Hilton deinitely is much better than that other hotel chain that starts with M. Esp being a Hilton Honors Member, I get so much more!

I would like to acknowledge all the pool servers and the team around the pool. It is amazing to chill here with what might be best pina colada in the world .. the food and drink orders come within minutes! Love the smiles and great sunshine vibes .. special thanks to Terry from Oli and Kai .. thank you for looking after us. A suggestion - why not build a bridge over the main family pool? It will help the team to be even more efficient as it will shorten response time and will save everyone energy to go around the huge area. Thank you ! Will be back soon again

Stunning property, so much to do on and near the property, refreshing pools with a lazy river, comfortable rooms with a great view of SeaWorld, and plentiful, delicious dining options with outstanding service from people who genuinely care. From Ryan Tomm, Director of Front Office, to the Universal desk staff, the Valets, the hosts and waitstaff, EVERYONE made our stay positive beyond words. Come to Hilton Orlando and see for yourself. You deserve to experience an amazing vacation! And: We’ve been gone a day, and we are dying for the pool and a Southern Hot fried chicken sandwich from David's Club Bar & Grill inside the hotel. Our entire party ate that sandwich multiple times during the trip. Delicious!! The breakfast buffet was also great. Already counting down the days until we can return again!

We left our bag on the hotel bench when we took the taxi to the airport. We immediately called the hotel from the airport, ready to pay for a taxi to bring it to us (laptop and personal belongings).The reception didn't even bother to check the bench, nor the surveillance camera footage, they just blew us off the line. Our plane took off at 2 pm and we could not return to the hotel.On the first day, my pajamas disappeared from the hotel room and were not returned in 5 days.We asked the maid to look, but no reaction.When we wrote an email in which we wrote all this ,on the same day after our return, no reply arrived.For the price of the room, I expected more...much more ...

Overall, our stay was broadly okay and I would stay here again, but there are some points worth knowing if you’re booking as a family. We booked for four people and expected a standard American-style room (normally two queens), but instead were given one king bed and a sofa bed. The sofa bed wasn’t made up on arrival, and we had to do it ourselves. Housekeeping only comes every other day, and although the bathroom is designed for larger refillable amenities, we were only given very small, single-use bottles of shampoo and conditioner. With long-haired family members, these weren’t really sufficient, and they weren’t automatically replaced. I’m sure we could have asked reception for more, but it felt a little inconvenient. We also had to request extra pillows given the number of people in the room. We realised from the room assignment text that we were on a low floor. When we asked about moving, we were told the hotel was overbooked but reassured we would have a “lovely park view” from the second floor (first floor by UK standards) and that our kids would enjoy it. In reality, the view was over the canopy above the entrance and into the tops of nearby trees — you couldn’t see the parks at all. Had we known the room would be this small and low down, we would have asked our travel agent to book a larger room category. It wasn’t quite what we expected from an American hotel. On the positive side, the hotel has some very convenient features. There’s a handy Starbucks in the lobby, you can grab a pizza in the evening, and the transport links to the parks are excellent. Volcano Bay is right next door, which was perfect on our arrival day, and we often made use of the little ferry from the neighbouring hotel for easy access to CityWalk and the parks. In summary, while the room setup and view were disappointing for a family of four, the location and transport options are fantastic. With clearer expectations about room types, I’d be happy to stay here again.
Destiny from your security team could not have been more helpful, and she even helped us on her day off. She was worth these five stars alone!
Great place to stay. Spacious, clean rooms. Beautiful pool. Lovely common areas. The staff was amazing--kind, respectful and always helpful. Would not hesitate to stay there again.

After three years without a vacation (since our last Disney trip), my partner and I decided to try something new—Universal Studios and Epic Universe in Orlando. Our expectations were high, especially with the hotel, but unfortunately, our stay at Aventura Hotel fell far short. First Impressions: The lobby was clean, spacious, and refreshing, and the front desk staff were professional. However, our room wasn’t ready upon arrival. There was no mobile check in. Everything was card based. The staff member we had doodled over our whole resort map and we were still more confused. We were offered luggage services but expected our bags to be delivered directly to our room. Instead, we had to pick them up ourselves with a ticket—definitely not what we hoped for. The Room: The rooms were surprisingly small. The bathroom had a tub with a shower curtain, which felt outdated and unpleasant. There was a black spot on the curtain, mold starting to form around the tub rim, and a pink discoloration on the hanging rod that looked like mold or dye—definitely concerning. We tried cleaning it ourselves with wipes just to feel comfortable. Adding to this, the toilet was in the bathroom without any ventilation, so the only way to air it out was by keeping the bathroom door open. Not ideal at all. The TV was tiny—more suited for kids—and the desk was too small for one person to eat comfortably, forcing one of us to eat on the bed or stand. There really was no movie channels - you had to literally log into your own Hulu but not Netflix no other services just plain tv and … Hulu We had a double queen bed room which wasn’t needed for two guest (I wish they would’ve accommodated us to a single king room instead) The hair dryer was old and you can tell a lot of guest may have dropped it. Bars of soap … no thank you. I wish they had pump bottles, but they don’t. For a resort that’s nomore than 5 years or 6 years old - I expected better. Rooftop Bar: We tried to enjoy the rooftop bar on our first night, but getting a check for three drinks took 54 minutes. We ordered three beers and a Shirley Temple-esque drink. On top of that, there seemed to be roach-like bugs coming through the rooftop drains, especially when it rained. Also, the pool and rooftop close with even slight rain or thunder within a 10mile radius, which was frustrating. But I understand safety is important but I mean come on now even when it wasn’t thundering they closed the roof top over just rain …. “ROOFTOP” Food & Beverage: Food was a major letdown. I’d recommend doing a Walmart or Target run instead because the hotel food was overpriced and underwhelming. For instance, coffee was $5 a cup, despite free unlimited coffee available at stations (though creamer wasn’t readily available). The souvenir refillable mugs were outrageously priced—Disney does it better. The pizza we ordered (15 inches) had slices so small they looked like they were made for a kids’ classroom, making Domino’s pizza seem gourmet by comparison. Transportation & Amenities: The walk to Volcano Bay was long, as no shuttle buses came our way. We took the boat from the neighboring resort instead, to citywalk and to get to the parks which was much faster than waiting for our resort bus. Beers at the hotel cost about $11 each, while we paid $20 for two cases of 12 cans of blue moon and 12 cans of fat tire at Target. The microwave in the food area was filthy, and the gym was more impressive than the arcade, which had only three machines and a ping pong table. Overall: Epic Universe was fun, but CityWalk felt run-down, and many rides were more motion simulation than thrilling experiences. I regret not sticking with Disney for this vacation, and I definitely won’t be staying here again anytime soon. If you’re thinking of booking Aventura Hotel, temper your expectations and prepare accordingly. Good luck and happy vacation hunting!

Spent a week. Had two rooms. One was decent size, the other was pretty small. Room cleaning every two days, not a problem for us. Small cafeteria type eatery. Food was ok. Pool was pretty nice and well life guarded. Staff was very nice. Only drawback was that the elevators were pretty bad. Usually had to wait several minutes for one to arrive. Bigger problem when we were in the lobby with a crowd trying to get back to their rooms, too. No complaints about bus service to parks. Would definitely stay here again.

Would recommended this place for a chilled out escape to the theme parks. Our Deluxe Resort View room had a stunning view of Volcano Bay and you could see Epic Universe in the background. Room is a little odd layout, the bathroom and toliet is a bit awkward but we traded that for a little more space in the main room. Great tablet to change temp and order things for the room. Great views from the roof top bar. The lobby pantry is a little underwhelming but plenty of food options elsewhere. Starbucks ok for a quick coffee. Was super easy to walk to Sapphire Falls and get the boat to Citywalk, or a bus that took 15 mins from outside. Swimming Pool was refreshingly cold and not always that busy. Would return.

Stayed in April 2024 prior to a cruise. Hotel was clean, lots of facilities to enjoy including pool, food, shop. Really neat to universal could walk there or use river boat from sapphire falls. Rooms were spacious and modern with IPad to control your room. One issue was we were locked out twice due to locking mechanism on the door latch. Was dealt with quickly by maintenance staff to gain entry. Otherwise fantastic stay!

Really enjoyed my stay. Bed was quite comfortable. A little firm. Room was lovely. Had a king bed with couch. The view from the window were fab. I had a standard room. Facilities in room were good. Not many places to store your suitcase. The hotel was very much aimed at adults which I really liked. Nice pool and loved its private entrance to volcano bay. It was a little noisy. Had loud air conditioning unit outside which sometimes wok me up at night. Really enjoyed my stay and would consider staying again in the future.

I stayed here for one day and here is my impression we tried to get an early check in and was told to wait. I never had any problem on value resorts so we couldn’t check in until after our parks day. The hotel is clean and modern if you are not into technology, this may be a negative for you since a lot of Room works off of an iPad. Overall, the rooms are not too big but comfortable for two. The rooftop bar is awesome. We had breakfast at the pantry. The problem is that you can’t read the menu pricing it’s very light so until you walk up to the counter, the pricing is competitive, but I like that they make the food to Order Overall this is a solid hotel for young professionals and older people. I would not recommend it for a family with children as the theme is very modern and geared towards an adult.

I usually do not write reviews. But I had to write to say how amazing Yarelys at the front desk is. She was so nice and helpful every single day. If we ever had a situation, she fixed it ASAP. And not very many people remember your name anymore, so I was very impressed. She made a good hotel a great hotel! Carlos Flores

Booked this hotel through Universal website direct and I was not disappointed. I am giving them a 5 star based on what we paid versus the overall experience. Since we got such a great price (versus what is listed), I was completely satisfied. Clean, bright, and beautiful rooms with enough storage for the week were there. Was able to keep the room fresh looking. Attendants and all personnel were spot on. Knowledgeable, quick, friendly and efficient. My only complaint is that, as a Canadian, I found the onsite costs for parking (insane), coffee and food (outrageous), and drinks were not good. Offerings were either very, very expensive with the exchange rate, or unattainable. They charge $32 USD per night for parking which is about $48CDN. That is RIDICULOUS. To Canadians I would recommend this hotel, but go to Costco before going there and get some groceries beforehand, otherwise your daily costs will exceed the actual cost of the hotel room itself. Super convenient, right next door you can catch the water taxi to Universal, or any other hotel. Loved this.

The Aventura Hotel serves the needs of hotel within walking distance to Universal Studios. There are also shuttles every 20 minutes and boat rides from the Sapphire Falls resort. The hotel has a Starbucks and the resort own cafeteria. We feel the Starbucks to be cheaper than the cafeteria. The hotel also has an Universal Studios shop. We didn't use it, but the hotel also has an Avis car rental. We can't speak too much more about this hotel. We mostly just slept at the hotel - not using the other amenities it has to offer. The hotel was quiet if you're a sensitive sleeper. The hotel does have a person that can help you with the Universal Studios tickets.

was visiting my ld boyfriend (now fiancé) for a trip to Orlando. we stayed here and visited the parks and it was a week to remember. beautiful hotel with such a beautiful view (especially at night) from the 16th floor where my fiancé proposed. i won’t ever stop talking about it but i love the view we had. you could see the downtown Orlando skyline and it felt very romantic. it’s so clean and there’s a lot you could do. has a Starbucks inside so it was very convenient to get matcha for the fiancé. we will definitely be coming back for the summer since we came in December and it was cold :,-)

We were a family of seven (with teenage children) travelling from Scotland staying at the Aventura for a two week stay and loved every minute! Such a lovely relaxed hotel. Check in was excellent, staff were very helpful, especially those who worked in the restaurant area and Starbucks, always joyful and polite! There is a good variety of food options, the noodle bar was excellent as were the pizzas and breakfast. We had skyline rooms which were fantastic, so spacious and immaculately clean and the beds were really comfortable. Being December, the hotel was decorated beautifully for Christmas. The pool area was great too and loved by the teenagers in the evening with it being open late. We are returning in December 2025 and decided to take the water taxi down to the Hard Rock Hotel to consider options for next time but all of us agreed we are definitely coming back to the Aventura, without question and we cannot wait to walk through those doors! Thanks for having us.

Seamless check-in, perfect room with an amazing view of the park. Staff were friendly and food available was pretty good from the dining options. Beds were very comfortable and room very spacious for my best friend and I. We loved the availability of the shuttle service to and from the parks each day and also the fact that we were next door to a hotel that offered water taxis as well which we had access to. It made for a very convenient commute especially on very long park days when we were tired. I would definitely recommend this resort and would stay here again and again once we were in the area for a Universal trip.

Thank you Yarelys!! I walked to the front desk to get directions to a drug store. When I asked for directions, she asked whether it was for medications? When I said I needed distilled water, she confirmed it was for a CPAP machine and said ‘I have some for you.’ ❤️ I couldn’t believe it. Saved me a trip and gave me more time to enjoy the parks. Thanks Universal for being so considerate and thanks Yarelys for being you!! That’s memorable!👏🏾👏🏾

To whom it may concern: We booked a king size suite at your hotel for 01-18-25 - 01-20-25 When we arrived we were informed that the king suite we booked is not available and we had been demoted to a queen room with two beds. We specifically booked the king bed and did not get what we received. When we arrived to our room immediately we noticed several things broken and not working. The TV would keep shutting off on us and freezing while watching it. For the duration of our stay the TV never worked properly. The phone was also not working in the room. And the shower door was making a horrible Noise when using it (please see attached video of the shower door noise). We called The front desk they apologized and said they would send engineering. Engineering tried to switch out our TV which they actually did 4 Times. All the TVS still never worked at all. The manager at the front desk Monique was not able to fully fix the issue which made our stay feel very disappointing. We have been coming to Universal resorts for years every year we enjoy coming to the parks and staying at one of the nice resorts Universal has to offer. Our stay at Aventura Hotel was the worst stay we have ever had in Universal and we will not be coming back ever or recommending this resort to any of our friends who frequent the Universal parks with their children and us. I would like a manager to reach out to me and please address these concerns I have attached for you a video of your broken shower door in room 1107 along with my invoice.

Muy amables en el tratro desde que hicimos la reserva, desde luego siempre te quieren vender mas cosas en todo momento pero no son abusivos, la habitación tenía una gran vista y era muy cómoda para 4 personas, te incluye bus a los parques y cuenta con varios restaurantes y una piscina.

Nice hotel, in the perfect location for visiting Universal Studios. There is a shuttle bus which takes you to Universal and we never waited more than 5 mins for it on either side - it was usually already waiting! This hotel is also located a short walk to Volcano Bay. The pool was great and a lovely temperature. Apart from the tablet gadget in the room, the room/bathroom felt very basic. A personal choice but I found it odd we didn’t have duvets (even thin ones). The bedding is almost just like 3 sheets on top of each other. We liked visiting the Urban Pantry for food, it was nice to go and eat away from the busy parks and felt like a chilled atmosphere. Would definitely recommend.

We easily booked our stay for a mother daughter trip to Universal Studios Florida. The hotel was modern and well equipped. There was a nice pool and rooftop bar. There were adequate dining options. The beds could have been more comfortable. The mattresses were a bit hard and lumpy, in my opinion. The problem I had came when my adult daughter got sick in the park. We were seen in the first aid department and security helped us back to the bus stop in a wheelchair stating that he would contact the hotel to meet us at the stop with another wheel chair to help us to the room. On arrival, there was no chair. Other passengers wondered where the chair was and went inside to ask. It didn't arrive. I texted the front desk because they initiated a text stream on check in and someone replied they would be right out. Another bus came for pickup as my daughter was lying across the bench, and still no chair. I finally had to leave my daughter at the bus stop to go in and ask about the wheelchair and after I asked, the wheelchair was on it's way out. We made it back to the room. I believe my daughter's glasses were left during her evaluation in the first aid tent. We didn't realize until the next day as she spent the rest of the first day and most of the next sleeping. I contacted the front desk to ask how to contact the first aid station and was given a link to Universal Studios.... I ended up figuring out how to get to their lost and found website and filling out a claim form, but this was a really unhelpful move. I wanted to make sure we didn't need to make a detour back to first aid if they didn't still have them. It wouldn't have been hard to figure out who they belong to since we completed paperwork and were the only ones there before they would have needed to clean up. Anyway, as long as you don't need anything outside of your room key, it's a great place to stay.

Estuvimos 6 días, al segundo día del hotel llegamos al hotel después de haber ido a los outlet a las 2 pm y no nos habían realizado el aseo, avisé, luego volvimos después de los parques en la noche y tampoco me lo habían realizado, al otro día no me hicieron la limpieza del baño… igual es súper mal que no te hagan la limpieza siendo que nosotros llegamos a dormir después de un día súper cansador.- lo otro no hay loza de cocina, te dejan todo de plásticos, no hay hervidor de agua, solo microondas y un refrigerador pequeño y si no te hacen la limpieza no te dejan nada de útiles de cocina, tampoco hay para lavar vasos, etc…

Muy lindo Hotel, con buenas actividades como la piscina y cancha de bowling, para disfrutar del Hotel . Muy buena la comida en el restaurant . También cuenta con un Starbucks . Para los que quieran visitar en Volcano Bay en ingreso de hace a pie desde el hotel y a los parques de Universal con el bus. Lo negativo ..te cobran estacionamiento en el hotel....

I was so disappointed in one of my favorite hotels. I haven’t stayed here in years because of cost but because I was carrying my grands, so I took a leap. This was my first error and many followed. The rooms are in need of repair and painting. The outside is not as appealing as it once was. Our keys did not work, went to get more, didn’t work, called maintenance, no one came for 20 min, after 20 minutes of waiting outside our room sitting on concrete floor…. Someone arrived. I ask if he was coming to let us in and he said no he was on his way to another problem. 11:15 at night and luckily he’s felt sorry for two adults and two children so he helped. Hotel said they would refund 23.00 for our car for inconvenience. 🤬! The room was very small for a suite. We tried to charge something to our room since we had change privileges , didn’t work. We couldn’t get out of the parking lot because our keys didn’t work again. This once was the IT place for me but not anymore!

Pésima experiencia! No lo recomiendo, no me pasó nunca nada igual en hoteles más económicos inclusive. Revisaron mis valijas en el cuarto, al hacer el reclamo lo que obtuve fué que no limpiaron mi cuarto completamente por dos días de los 4 que me hospede. Al hacer el reclamo dijeron que iban a reintegrarme el costo del estacionamiento y que tendría un late check out a las 14 hs., el costo del estacionamiento nunca me lo devolvieron y cuando llegué a la habitación a las 12.30 el día del late check out mi tarjeta estaba bloqueada y con mis cosas adentro. Vale también mencionar que los colchones ya necesitan recambio y ni hablar el cubre cama que parecía sucio de lo viejo que estaba. Sólo pagás la marca del hotel, hay por menor valor hoteles en la zona de mejor categoría y con mayores beneficios. No le pongo una estrella por el chico que me ayudó con el check in que fué sumamente amable y servicial conmigo.

Wow, con eso comienzo Fui con mi familia a celebrar mi cumpleaños a Orlando, y para esta visita pues obvio había que ir a los parques de atracciones, en la planeación del viaje decidimos hacer uso de dos hoteles diferentes, uno de ellos fue el Cabana Beach Resort, y la verdad quedamos facinados con todo. Desde su diseño y distribución, sus amenidades y el personal todo resultó de nuestro agrado. Tanto así que queremos volver en cuanto nos sea posible. Las habitaciones son espaciosas y sus camas son de las más cómodas en la que hemos dormido, el aire acondicionado de todo el hotel es muy bueno, nos mantuvo frescos pese a que fuimos en temporada caliente, además el área de comidas tiene buena variedad y su personal es muy agradable, y tienen el plus del transporte que te lleva y trae a los parques de Universal y Isla de la aventura. La verdad lo recomiendo mucho y espero volver para cuando se inaugure Epic Universe. Nos vemos

EL hotel es espectacular. Las dos areas de piscina muy entretenidas y diferentes. Lo único negativo es que no alquilan el gomon, solo podes comprarlo y llevártelo cuando te vas es un lío. El tobogán es simpático y entretenido para las familias. Esta perfectamente ubicado, el servicio de transfer a los parques es excelente. El restaurante? Con las comidas mas variadas que he visto, y Jose (uno de los chef que es de venezuela) fue muy amable y servicial: logro que yo tuviera la cena deseada. La variedad de bebidas es buena, el cafe de cortesía también, y mucha gente nos asistió en español. La aparición de personajes sorpresa le da el toque que falta para que todo sea especial. La limpieza excelente y pedimos mas frazadas y la solucion fue inmediata.

El hotel es un desastre!!! Nada que ver a lo que te venden en las fotos (que no los engañen ) nos dieron una habitación para 6 donde había 5 almohadas, no hay acolchados para todos, la limpieza de los cuartos es mala, pedimos con buena voluntad si podían pasarnos a dos habitaciones más chiquitas pero que tengan dos baños, ya que 6 adultos en un cuarto con un baño es imposible tanto para bañarse como para ir al baño y nos respondió una gerente del hotel “ustedes son de Argentina de Latinoamérica ?” Por no decirnos sudacas, traigan todo lo q necesiten porq no es como en otros hoteles q te ponen shampoo crema enjuague pasta dental, nada que ver a los hoteles de Disney que nos hospedamos otros años donde solo se acercan con buena voluntad para ayudarte, acá todo es plata, para todo hay que pagar más, para familias no se los recomiendo… salvo que quieran hacer una vida peor que la de un hostel de Europa (que seguramente son mejores que este hotel ) una vergüenza

We had a really nice time and enjoyed our stay at Cabana Bay. We had a family suite and the room was very comfortable. The resort overall was terrific, and every person we encountered was friendly and helpful. We arrived early (about noon) and our check in was smooth and the person who checked us in Kayla could not have been friendlier or more welcoming. Before our trip we saw some confusion in other messages about checking in on line. We booked our trip directly through universal and we never received an email (even checked the spam folder for it) giving us the option to check in online so for those wondering; I don’t know if online checkin is still an option. Regardless in our experience we checked in with Kayla in person and she got us situated , answered our questions and started us off on a really enjoyable stay. The vacation desk folks from where we picked up our pre purchased park tickets were also very professional helpful and friendly. There really was something for everyone at this resort and no matter what time we wanted to go over to the parks or return there was always a shuttle there for us. It was continuous one leaves another is there behind it and it’s just a 5 minute ride but all the drivers were also very friendly and welcoming. Although this resort has a lot of rooms it’s big enough so that we never felt crowded at any time. Overall we really enjoyed staying at Cabana Bay.

We visited from 31st October to 5th November 2023 as a family of 5 (3 adults and 2 children). We had an exterior entry family suite - in the Castaway block - which suited us well for our short stay. There were two decent sized beds in the bedroom (along with clothes/luggage storage and the toilet & Bathroom). The living area had a small kitchenette and a sofa bed. The room was plenty big enough for the 5 of us and it was nice to turn the sofa bed back into sofa during the day to use as seating. The kitchenette was simple but the fridge was big enough for our needs. Our only grip was that the sofa bed was a little uncomfortable (your ankles were higher than your head when you laid on it). However, we do appreciate that a sofa bed is never going to be a comfortable as a regular bed. The staff were amazing. The check in was smooth and the lady who served us was very informative. We collected our Universal tickets from the Ticket desk in a matter of minutes. The reception is very large with generous seating, along with the bar. Left off of reception is where you get to the Universal Store, Starbucks and food hall. There were various food options, meeting the needs of many a fussy eater. The prices were higher than I’d like but to be expected for a theme park resort. We got a resort mug, which did us well, especially when the kids realised you could put Icees in them. There’s plenty of seating available in the food hall. The two pool areas were fab, especially for little ones. Having a lazy river at the resort was mind blowing for our kids. However, we preferred the other pool just because the water slide and splash area was more entertaining for our little ones. A big highlight was the early access to the theme parks along with the dedicated entrance to Volcano Bay (which you could walk to easily from the resort). The buses to the parks were very regular and I don’t recall ever really having to wait long at either end for a bus. We did walk one day to Lowes Royal Pacific and take the water taxi to City walk. The walk between Cabana Bay and Royal Pacific was very pleasant and didn’t take more than 15 minutes (and that was with two people with very little legs). We loved our stay at Cabana Bay and will definitely be back.

I got a room here last minute because we drove down to Florida faster than expected so I was grateful they had space before we switched to the Loews Pacific Resort for the rest of the week. I knew this was lower-end, but I didn't expect it to be so outdated and dirty. The staff wasn't unpleasant but they weren't friendly. The room was gross and dated as was the elevator. I was so glad we only stayed one night and I will never go back. If you can afford it, stay at Loews. It was absolutely amazing.

Great resort! Huge! We went for 1 night post cruise, our room was ready right away! Spent the day swimming and enjoying the lazy river. You can bring your own floats or purchase on site. Great free shuttle to Universal walk where we spent our last evening in Orlando

The hotel is very quiet, but I didn't like the cleanliness of the beds, the maintenance people are very rude, there was no one to help me, they never fixed my bed when I went outside, it was a complete mess. And apart from that the food is bad in the restaurant everything is far away and there is absolutely no one who thanks you with a smile.

I knew going in it was a value resort. I picked it for the location nearest Volcano bay. It is a retro themed hotel from the 50s as expected. Our room has two queen beds in it. It was just two of us - my daughter and I. i tried to sleep in one of the beds but it was HORRIBLE. my daughter and i had to sleep in one queen together, not optimal but i slept much better. I read a previous review about the pillows and i am so glad i brought two pillows from home. Yep an entire suitcase for two pillows. The pillows were super small (see pic) and only 2 per bed. The gates at the pool never worked with your hotel key card. Always had to bug someone inside of the pool to let us inside of the pool area. One day we lost water. Toilet wouldn't flush and nothing coming out of sink. So that was fun. Not worth it. Won't go back.

My wife and three kids were so excited to plan a trip to Universal and Volcano Bay for spring break. We were excited to stay at an authentic themed hotel that was on Universal property and conveniently within walking distance to Volcano Bay. However during our stay we were extremely let down over numerous occurrences. Upon checking into our suite we found the parking lot was extremely full and we were unable to park anywhere near our suite, and this was a reoccurring issue throughout our stay,we saw the bar stools in the suite were extremely worn down and our beds were extremely uncomfortable,the couch that pulls out into a bed was even more uncomfortable that we had to use the couch cushion on top of the mattress just so our teenage son could sleep. We had a very hard time accessing the pool because our key cards didn’t work half the time and after a long day at the parks we wanted to relax by the fire pit and the staff rudely told everyone that everything was closing and we needed to leave in 5 minutes (the pool area and bar was still very full upon being told this) this was also frustrating on another note because of the unpredictable weather we were not able to use a lot of the amenities earlier in the day. My wife had to call each night for more towels because no one serviced our room in the 3 nights we were there. We booked a bowling session while we were there and the staff was short and rude and made us feel like we were being rushed. On the way to the lobby my son fell on an uneven part of the walkway. I had asked for a late checkout until 1 and was told we would be charged a 100 dollars if we wanted to stay until 1. We paid a higher price to stay here given the peak season and that is understandable but we were expecting to get more out of what we paid given this a universal resort property that offers a lot of amenities. Room 3130 Kip Perry

Took forever to check in as they had our name wrong in the computer. After around 30 mins finally was checked in. Our reservation was for a ground floor room for 6 people. We showed the staff member and he said "rooms are not guaranteed ", so why put hat on our reservation. Diner had dirty tables and walls an rails at the side of the tables. Staff in diner area seemed lifeless and wandered around aimlessly doing nothing. Room was OK. But definitely showing it's age. Noisy neighbors can be heard.

Everything about staying here was great. The key cards are personalised and you get to keep them which is a nice touch. The rooms are a great size for a family of five or even 6! There is a proper storage area for your luggage and plenty of space to move around. The kitchen facilities are good but we didn’t use them much. There is a fridge and a microwave. The laundry facilities were great $3 per cycle and you can pay by card. Wish I’d bought detergent earlier in the holiday though. Again to buy on site is $3 per wash as they come in individual sachets so not expensive but my son needed a sensitive skin detergent which was easily available at Walmart. I left behind the excess for others to use. I would have packed less if I’d known how good the washing facilities were before going. The pools attached to the hotel were lovely and the kids enjoyed the lazy river and the pool with the slide. Volcano bay is a very short walk away from the internal family rooms in the continental building. Parking was easy, there was always a space. I really loved staying here and would love to return.

Habitaciones espaciosas y bien equipadas para alojarse en familia. Muy bonito el camino para ir desde el hotel a los parques de Universal y al City Walk. Las opciones de comida en el resort son muy variadas. El complejo también cuenta con buenas instalaciones como piscina, ping pong y un bowling. No agrego fotos porque las del hotel reflejan la realidad tal cual es.

It is a reasonably priced hotel with excellent facilities, with a retro atmosphere that makes you travel to the past, my stay was comfortable, the transportation system for the parks is very efficient, I recommend it

habitacion chica, vieja y con colchones pesimos listos para cambiar sillon cama duro como una piedra alfombra vieja y sucia no tenia placard para guardar ropa no tenia elementos de limpieza minimos poca luz en la habitacion

Es un hotel muy lindo. Excelente poder ir a los parques más temprano con el "early admition". Muy cumplido el sistema de transporte. Hay muchas opciones de comida (pagada - no incluye desayuno. No hay cerca nada más para comprar.

This is our 3rd stay at a universal hotel and overall, we enjoyed our stay with some minor concerns. The hotel has a quieter, more relaxed atmosphere than others, which was perfect for what we wanted. The staff were excellent and always helpful. Had an issue with the a/c on our first night, and after discussing with reception, it was promtly fixed and no other issues for our stay. It is a modern hotel so maybe less fun than the other resorts. The hotel is very clean however since our last visit to universal I notice some of the hotel areas look tired and in need of attention for example the tables and chairs in the sitting areas on the rooftop and pool bar require replacing and were damanged or stained. The major plus for this hotel is its promimity to Volcano Bay, such a short walk. As with all universal properties, it is very easy to get to the parks by bus, boat (at saphire) or walking. The food area in the hotel is very convenient and we enjoyed everything we ate there. We also felt the portions were generous. We felt it was very overpriced initially, but realised quickly everywhere seemed quite a bit more expensive for food and drinks. We rarely drank in the hotel as the soft drinks and alcoholic drinks were overpriced. There was a small fridge in the room that was helpful for stocking up on drinks. The rooftop bar is nice with lovely views. Overall, it is a good base for visiting the parks at a reasonable price. Just a note regarding rooms as I had noticed comments previously about sound. We had guests on either side and did not hear anything, we were also 2 doors from the elevators and it did not bother us however, the ice machine was outside the door and was very noisy. I considered requesting a room change as there were guests using it at 3am. I would recommend requesting a room at the end of the corridor if you are a light sleeper.

We moved to the Aventura after staying at the Hard Rock, and as it’s a more moderate hotel our expectations were not high. However we were wrong, this was a great hotel. The theming was great and very clean and modern, the lobby had lots of places to eat and drink and we had the pizza for lunch one day which was great and good value. The rooms were decent, and had everything you would have needed. There were no glasses but plastic disposable cups to use, but as I said it’s a cheaper hotel. Toiletries were good and plenty of towels to use. The room has an iPad as its control hub where you can do everything from control the TV, light and heating to order food or chat to the hotel - very cool! The pool is nice, not huge but good. However you are 2 minutes away from volcano bay so could just chill at the park (see my separate review) it is about a 20-25 minute walk to city walk and the main parks however if you walk to the hotel next door (about 7-10 minutes) you can grab the boat. The hotel also has the rooftop bar 17 (see my separate review) which also adds to its appeal Will definitely stay here on out return

Went out to the universals parks for the day came back to room and cleaning staff had smashed tablet that controls tv .lights and that .reported it straight away to kyle in management .filled out report to say we were at park which they checked on cctv that cleaners were last in room after us .got told we would not get charged for the damage and on check out they charged me over $200 for a new tablet which we didnt break so will never stop at aventura again i advise taking video or pics when leaving room and when returning very very dissapointed with this hotel avoid find some where else that treats you better

Jamás volveré a este Hotel, te cobran por todo, sales una noche antes, teniendo las noches pagadas y aun así te penalizan con 180€, sin avisar. Nadie habla español en recepción en ningún turno, y la habitación es tan sofisticada que se hace incomoda. Mejor elegir otra opción.

Hotel in a great location especially for Volcano Bay which is a short walk across the resort pool. Reception staff really nice especially Danii who has a lovely friendly yet professional manner. Be careful that you take all your belongings when checking out. I left some heated hair appliance in the bathroom and when I returned later on in the evening they had not been handed in to lost property. Spoke to the manager who was really nice he escorted us to the room which still wasn’t occupied and there was no sign of my appliance. They had either been thrown away or taken as the room was not occupied by new guests. Poor show and no compensation either so make sure you remember to take everything from your room.

Jamas volveria a este Hotel, nadie sabe Español y me cobraron 170$ por salir una noche antes. Una verguenza. Todo va por una tablet lo que hace la estancia super incomoda, apagar la TV, encender luces etc… NO LO RECOMIENDO. Hay opciones mas económicas y mejores.

Stayed here for a couple of nights at the end of a long holiday which started at Loews Sapphire Falls across the road and in comparison, the room was nicer, more modern, the breakfast way better, the rooftop bar better and pretty decent in every way at this price point. The downside was a small and basic pool which was adequate.

Un hotel excepcional. La habitación muy amplia y con bonitas vistas ¡Hasta se veía Hogwarts! La piscina genial y el jacuzzi, pese a que el segundo día estaba cerrado por cuestiones técnicas, amplio y cómodo. La zona de comidas con bastante variedad y el personal amable y varios nos atendieron en español. A 5 minutos del parque con la lanzadera gratuita. Muy contentos

Stayed for 3 nights and 4 days at this wonderful property. Booked a Standard 2 Queen room and was upgraded upon arrival to a skyline view by the lovely Yarelys, for my husband’s birthday. Such a gorgeous view of the parks and the water over at Sapphire Falls. We were able to check in prior to the 4pm check in time. Yarelys was friendly, smiling and very helpful- answered all of our questions and provided excellent and efficient service. Room spacious, bed comfortable, everything in working order, fantastic water pressure. The cleanliness upon arrival could have been improved- some kind of dust/debris lined the floors and surfaces of desk and bathroom vanity area. Not a deal breaker. Public areas were clean and well maintained. Pool and hot tub area was clean, plenty of fresh towels available at all times of day and night. Gym on site as well. Pool was a refreshing temperature. Life guards available at all times. Starbucks on site in the lobby was handy for early mornings. While we did not use the on site restaurants we did browse the menus and the area- looked clean, well stocked and had multiple menu choices available until 11pm daily. Roof top and Lobby bar were excellent for a late night drink, although slightly expensive. But this is to be expected. 2 smoking sections on site which were clean, convenient and well located. Loved that the hotel was in close proximity to Sapphire Falls to utilize the water taxi to Universal City Walk and the parks. Early admission to Islands of Adventure was very helpful in maximizing park time. Hotel location was excellent in terms of getting around to off site restaurants, entertainment, IDrive and highway access to Celebration/Kissimmee. Felt very safe to walk and drive any time of day. Parking garage easy to navigate and opens with room key. All lighting and room temp controls are done via a tablet in the room.
