This was initially a weird concept, but we ended up really enjoying the technology. Elevators feature large touch screens which was excellent (especially for my spouse who is visually impaired) parking is $23 per day. Check out done via cell phone which was a huge plus. This hotel was recommended for myself as a place to go without children. There were far less children here than the other larger hotels, which was a great choice for us as a travelling couple. Would highly recommend if you’re looking for a mid range, family and couples friendly hotel with easy access to Universal Parks. One piece of feedback would be for the hotel to equip their Guest Services With correct information. I emailed the hotel a few weeks out asking about the toiletries provided. I was given a long general list. Upon arrival, we found there was only shampoo conditioner and bar soap. There was no body wash, lotion or amenity kit, as they advertised. It was not orderable from the front desk either. As we travelled via air with carry on, I did not pack some items based on their communication, and wished we did….just note that in room amenities are limited and to bring your own if you absolutely need something, or be prepared to pay for it. We thoroughly enjoyed our first time at Universal and wouldn’t hesitate to visit again. We found it to be of good value, having great on site choices of food and beverage, and loved that we could use the amenities at the other Premium Hotels for no added cost.

Less of a theme park hotel more of a standard hotel. Nice rooms, decent quick service food but no real restaurant. Bar 17 does serve food with a great view but not much of a selection. Sapphire falls very nearby has Amatista restaurant. A quiet pool as it appears most people go to the nearby Volcano Bay. A bit of an oasis from the Universal theme parks.

We arrived full of Disney magic and soon wish we hadn’t left Disneyworld. We had asked for a Deluxe King for our family of three. When we arrived in the room the sofa bed was not made for our daughter and it was wet through on the arm, possibly from the air conditioning unit. We promptly complained and were told it was a budget hotel, budget hotel or not you expect the beds to be made when you’re on holiday. They gave us a deluxe queen with both beds made. The corridors were dirty, even though hoovered daily I don’t think they realised you don’t just go down the middle you need to hoover the edges as well. Food was ok for breakfast and snacks and bus transfers were good. We never recovered from our arrival and would never go back.

El hotel está ubicado cerca del parque acuático volcano, desde sus instalaciones puedes entrar sin necesidad de los autobuses del parque, y también está muy cerca con el autobús de los otros parques. Las personas de recepción son muy agradables, simpáticas y te explican todo sin problema. La habitación es grande, todo domotizado desde una tablet. Las camas son cómodas y la limpieza perfecta. La única pega que no están bien insonorizadas, y puedes escuchar a tus vecinos, nosotros tuvimos la mala suerte de tocarnos unos vecinos que les gustaba discutir todas las noches. Para disfrutar un descanso tras una larga jornada de parques universal, es una buena elección.

Wonderful modern hotel close to all the attractions. I enjoyed the fact that hotel was more compact that the other universal hotels. Room to lobby time is quick. In room tech is great (although sometimes would have just preferred to use a tv remote!). Loved that there was free hot water and milk / sugar - handy for me bringing my Yorkshire tea bags! 😂 so bring your tea bags and a reusable cup! Also great to use the cola freestyle machines for ice and water if you don’t want to buy the refillable cups. We brought our own insulated bottles to use at the parks so it was great to fill up before we left. Handy to be able to Collect our park tickets at the desk and to be able to keep our luggage at the lobby so we could explore on our last morning. We had a couple of meals in the urban pantry - particularly loved the pizzas and the noddle bar. Whilst it is more a self serve eatery than table service the quality was great. Handy for walking to volcano bay - literally minutes. Great free shuttle bus to take you to city walk although we preferred to walk over to the water taxi at sapphire falls which takes you right in to city walk Exceptionally clean hotel and well maintained grounds. Highly recommended.

The hotel facilities overall were wonderful, we were extremely happy with them. Most of the staffing were great as well. We had some problems with our stay however, hence lower marks. When we booked, we got a Skyline room which the website description made it sound as if we'd be on the top few floors with big views of the parks. When we arrived, we requested a side for Volcano Bay view. We were very happy they could do so, very kind of the front desk, but it ended up being the 10th floor, which out of 17 total floors, is not what we expected. Our view consisted of the top of the volcano and the back of another hotel's parking garage. We could see some outskirts of Orlando, which was neat, just not what we expected. Apparently Cabana Bay towers have the full view of the waterpark. We had a short stay, so one night wanted to take advantage of the rooftop, but a private party was booked there. Not only could we not not be up there, but the party had loud club music playing until midnight, which we could hear thumping even down in our room keeping us awake. Something that particularly upset us was when we called the front desk about the noise, they simply asked us if we brought earplugs. That's not addressing the situation. I guess it's fine the hotel allows that, but those parties should be listed on the website to make guests aware of the situation so we can plan accordingly. Beyond that, we were looking forward to using the hot tub, but it was unheated the first day and closed the rest of our trip. I know it's a small detail, but overall we felt like like we'd bought a room at a higher price at Aventura for it's amenities, but didn't get to use the ones we really wanted, outside of the early park admission. Honestly we should be offered a credit of some sort. We wished we chose another hotel. Our vacation time is precious, it was our anniversary trip, and expected more. When we filled out the post trip survey with these comments, we simply got a generic reply email saying they were sorry for the problems. Yet again, not directly addressing our issues or offering a way to rectify.

Fantastic stay even tho I got sick and had to leave early. Staff was super nice and helpful. This is the hotel that gives you the bang for your buck! Clean, nice lay out, friendly staff, loved the food area. Loved everything about it. Wish Saffire next door would take some notes. Will definitely be back as we are local and have passes to Universal.

Mi hija y yo disfrutamos de una fabulosa estadía en el Hotel Universal's Aventura. El personal, especialmente Francisca, fue atento y amable, haciendo que nuestra experiencia fuera impecable. Las instalaciones son modernas, cómodas y limpias. La ubicación es ideal, a pocos pasos de los parques temáticos. La piscina, el gimnasio y los restaurantes son excelentes. Punto a mejorar, la habitación era un poco ruidosa. Lo mejor es elegir los pisos más altos.

We just arrived home! Our stay at Aventura was very good. Geena at the lobby bar was super nice and helpful, we enjoyed hanging out there and chatting with her. She was also super sweet to our kids. The food in the hotel was decent, we ate several times in the food court area. The pizza was really yummy, they had Gelato and there was a grill and asian food. Asian food was really good! Lots of snack options there. We were sad that there weren't any treats like cake pops/cupcakes, but realized we could get that nearby at Sapphire Falls. On the 17th floor there's a bar/restaurant where you can watch the Disney fireworks, which was so exciting for us! The room was clean and kept up well, housekeeping was great. Beds were a little firm, but fine. We could see the volcano at the waterpark from our room which was fun. Pool was okay, we only used it once. We found out that you can use pools at Cabana Bay and Sapphire Falls (both in walking distance) and we used the Sapphire Falls pool more, as they had sand and we liked the environment better. Staff was friendly and helpful throughout the hotel. They had movies in the evening by the food court. Parking was close by. City Walk and Universal theme parks are so close. The bus system was very good, and we could also use the boat that went to Sapphire Falls. Overall, I'd recommend this hotel.

This hotel is pretty amazing! The hotel is beautiful and clean, the rooms are comfortable, and the location cannot be beat. You can either take the shuttle bus or the ferry next door at the sister hotel, which is about a 5-10 min. walk. Even my local Orlando friends were amazed at how great the hotel was when they visited. I would definitely stay here again given the location, the cost, and the quality of the hotel.

We stayed here celebrating my wife’s birthday at Universal Studios. Clean rooms, friendly and knowledgeable staff. Quick shuttle options to the parks. There’s a walking pathway to the parks but take my advice….save those steps and take the shuttle. Your feet will thank you at the end of the day. We really enjoyed our stay and the bar/restaurant on the 17th floor was excellent. Highly recommended for couples looking for the park convenience but don’t necessarily need a theme park hotel vibe. We will definitely visit again.

Excellent stay at Aventura Hotel. Rooms: clean room and bathroom. Lots of windows which (mostly) makes up for dim lighting . Clean and minimalist. Mattresses were comfortable. iPad controls the tv, thermostat, and (most) lights. Room includes iron/ironing board, safe, mini fridge (no freezer), and hair dryer. Bathroom provides shampoo, soap, and conditioner - no lotion. Pool was nice, as we were there in Feb. it was not too crowded but by late afternoon it was warm enough to sit by the pool and even the water was a nice temperature. If possible, skip on the food options in the lobby unless in a pinch. They're overpriced, which you should assume but you won't know that for sure as no price tags are displayed. (On principle I don't shop in stores that do this.) Location relative to the parks/City Walk is ideal. You can walk there via the garden path in about 20 minutes, you can take the boat (6 minute ride, and generally a very short wait), or you can take a shuttle but (10-ish minutes but a longer wait and an inconvenient drop-off location unless you are only going to City Walk. I would definitely stay here again, were I to return.

When you are in a tourist area you expect tourist style service and accommodations. This was not the case for this property. It was located close to the convention center and the tunnels and connections were fine. The mattress was excellent, as so often they are not. Everything was fantastic and i would welcome staying there again. A great convenient store is right across the street, and a McDonald's when you don't want hotel fare.

Una pésima experiencia, la luz el hall no funciona, el secador tampoco, la Tv tampoco. Haces el check in y no te informan de que las habitaciones no las hacen todos los dias y eso cobrando más de 300 euros noche. Avisas de que vas a llegar tarde y te encuentras que la habitacion que habias pedido te la han cancelado y te tienes que conformar con otra. Lo único destacable, el personal de recepción y el GYM, si voy otra vez a Orlando no volveré a este Hotel no está al nivel de lo que se paga, Por protestar me dieron un voucher de 50 usd, algo es algo pero poco para una estancia de 6 días en esas condiciones.

Pésima actitud de todo el personal que labora en este hotel, mal servicio en restaurantes, muy mala actitud de la gente de recepción. Servicio mal de internet y no hay nadie que resuelva, No parece un HILTON !

My friend and I chose this hotel based on good reviews and amenities for a long, relaxing weekend. The staff is super, the hotel is fantastic, and the pool/resort area is out of this world!! Rooms are clean and I was on the top (19th floor) so it was very quiet up there. (sleep is vital to me) I loved getting up and taking a morning walk on the grounds. There are several pools (ONE IS AN ADULT ONLY POOL! CAN I GET AN AMEN?!) Wait staff comes to you poolside for orders. Those people work so hard but are stellar at their job. All friendly and helpful. The steak house is expensive, but good. Loved The Bistro in the morning for breakfast, David's is a great choice and the market is super for snacks and sandwiches. Although my visit was short, my friend and I will DEFINITELY be back for another girls' getaway. This is the first time I have ever come home from a vacation feeling totally rested and relaxed. There isn't even a reason to leave this resort! I think I'd live there if I could. Can't wait to go back!!

I love this hotel. It has a great location if you are doing multiple parks and such. Right off the highway, It is super convenient. Convention Center is next door. Super close to SeaWorld, Universal and Disney. Parking is easy. Parking deck out back is connected to the hotel. No super long walk in the Florida sun. The front desk staff where great and super pleasant. Room was comfortable and clean. The room service by phone worked well. Must compliment the delivery staff. You can tell he had years of hospitality service. And then there was the guy at the grab and go. On the plus side most of the staff was great here. The Selection is good as well. You ever been standing at the cash register waiting to check out and have someone call the next guy waiting behind you ? WTF ? You can’t miss me. Of course he said he did not see me. Yeah. I would suggest some customer service training for the grab n go employees. Maybe the guy from room service can teach them some of his skills. The rest of the stay was wonderful. Would I stay here again ! Probably since the rest of the experience outweighed this one bad note

I pre paid for room but upon checking out I was charge double for a resort fee and then a 264.00 charge that they say was pre authorized. by who noone knows. I only agreed to 75.00. not 75.00+264.00. Trying to figure this out and they send me in circles from hotel to Advance Purchase to hotel. What a crappy exp. Wont be staying here anymore if the accounting dept cant get their crap together.

Huge shout out to KEVIN!! I spent my birthday weekend with my girlfriends, at the Hilton, and Kevin made sure we had everything we needed in our cabana. Prompt, accurate, and always with a smile. Sure did help me relax and enjoy my birthday. Thank you Kevin!! You helped create memories I'll cherish for many years.

My family enjoyed staying at the Hilton Orlando. The staff were all so friendly and personable. The pool area was my grandsons favorite. It has a large pool, lazy River, slide, hot tub and little water park for toddlers. Eric and Paige texted me and made sure I had everything I needed. The food was delicious and a great variety to chose from. The shuttle to Universal is good but you have to remember to book it 24 hours ahead.

Don’t waste your money. It’s not worth the money. The staff is lazy. They don’t have microwaves. No coffee. They don’t have house keeping til the 3rd day of your stay. You get 1 roll of toilet paper and 1 day of shampoos and conditioners. I wish I had booked a condo. I will NEVER go to a Hilton owned hotel in ORLANDO again. I love hotels. But this one is a joke. I’m not sure what your paying for. It damn sure ain’t worth $750 a night. We stay in about 50/100 hotels a year. We travel all over the US for business/pleasure. My husband and I are here on both business and pleasure. My husband booked a king suite because our anniversary is today, (Saturday February 19th) and he want es to spoil me a little while we here on business. We checked in Thursday 17th. The price for a suite was $750 a night. Our total Bill so far is $2780 plus $150 for parking. When you pay that kind of money, you would expect a little nicer hotel and accommodations. We get in the room and only 1 Of the 2 super small refrigerators work. No microwave. Only 1 roll of toilet paper. Which you could wet sand a car with, and no blankets for bed. Just a single thin duvet blanket. Cable channels are the worse than staying at a budget hotel. Only 2 HBO channels and 13 regular channels and that includes infomercials. They do not offer free coffee or breakfast for guest. A bottle is f water is 6 bucks. Coffee is $6. Honestly I wish we had went to a home 2 or a holiday inn express, or a Hampton Inn. I could have gotten the same exact room with better amenities for a third of the price. Another thing is you order delivery, you have to walk down 18 floors and outside to get food. Valet is unorganized but the valet help is very kind. We got back this afternoon from our business meeting to find the room not cleaned. No fresh towels. No toilet paper. No shampoo. We called front desk and they said they don’t clean rooms til 3rd day of your stay to help with covid exposure. WTF??? Are we supposed to pay $750 a night and bring our own towels and toilet paper and take out the trash??? This is by far the worst hotel experience in my 2500 plus stays across the country. On a positive note, the apparently have a lazy River for guest but we haven’t been. We here on business. Really sad. I love Hilton’s but this one SUCKS balls. Trust me when I say, go to the home 2 across the street. I promise you will have a much better stay.

The hotel is conveniently located to the convention center. It offers shuttles which were convenient. The room was at the very end of the long hallway so it was pleasantly quiet the entire stay. Everything was comfortable but nothing to write home about. Disappointed in the store for food and drinks in the main lobby. The furniture in the room felt a little outdated but the pool grounds and lobby was nice.

They gave away my room even though I asked to hold it for a late arrival, and because they were overbooked when I arrived I ended up sleeping on the couch in a conference room. With no bedding, no pillow, no nothing. And instead of a reduced rate or a refund they gave me ........ a resort credit. For an amount that was 1/3 of what I paid for the room when I made the reservation.That I could only use while at the property. In the five minutes I had left before I needed to leave for my meeting. Incredibly insulting, really. It's one thing if this was a rando hotel in the middle of the Gobi Desert, but this is a Hilton .... in Orlando. AND I'm Hilton Honors member.

I stayed at this hotel for a business trip for 6 nights. I have to say, this is the best Hilton experience I have ever had. The hotel is super clean, the staffs are very friendly, professional, helpful and I formative. Every hotel staff is trying his/her best to provide the excellent service for the customers. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to visit Orlando, especially if you need to attend trade show/meetings in Orlando. The hotel is connected to the south hall of the convention center.

The Hilton manager suggested we would be happier at the Rosen center , I ask what he suggests we should do about the 45 minute trip the conference center , He suggested walk , take a taxis,Uber ,lift or go to the Rosen center a hotel much closer. So the next day I checked out of the Hilton and into the Rosen .Never see any info on the Rosen but it’s just as nice as the Hilton. Buy the way it’s half the Price.

No es posible que uno pague $350 en un hotel y no le limpien la habitacion a diario. Si lo hubieran advertido en la pagina web del Hilton, donde hice la reserva, hubiera estado advertido pero en ninguna parte decía.Ademas la atención del gerente encargado fue lamentable. No me trato como debe tratar a un cliente HHonors gold que por mas de 30 años llevo frecuentando Hilton Hotels. Lamentable

Pase unos días divinos en ese hotel, fui a Orlando por los parques por mis niñas, pero ellas cada vez que regresábamos de los parques querían disfrutar de la piscina. Nos encanto.En esta ocasión fuimos con amigos y familia y fue muy rico compartir allí, muy amables todos los trabajadores. Mil gracias por su grata atención.

El parqueo es caro, 27 por noche El wifi bueno te lo cobran por noche como a $15 El precio del hotel es alto, podría incluir desayuno. Las instalaciones magníficas, las piscinas súper, el hotel en general. Solo mejoraría lo mencionado arriba

Excelente, buena higiene, muy acogedor, una piscina increíble para todos los gustos y con bastante espacio para grandes y chicos actividades y demás solo dos puntos a destacar el servicio del bar de la piscina es extremadamente lento, y tampoco sentí que a los gold nos dieran algo especial como se acostumbra en hilton, pero por lo demás super

This place was pretty nice and we enjoyed our stay. They had hand sanitizer near the elevator and only 4 people were allowed on the elevator per COVID-19 guidelines. The room was clean and nice but it never was freshened up during our stay. If we wanted towels or soaps we had to request them and put the trash outside the door. The highlight of this place was the lazy river, pool area, and the food/drink right outside the pool area. The hotdogs and drinks were always great on the weekends (only time they had them) and the men working them were awesome. This place is located within a mile of many activities and restaurants including topgolf, bars, and SeaWorld.

Great place to take family, there's a lazy river and many activities for the kids. Pool side service drinks and eats is a MAJOR plus. They also plan events for the kids throughout the day which was fantastic! Overall great experience. Rooms are fine nothing spectacular but you won't spend much time in them just to sleep really. I gave it an excellent because when you are just wanting to get away for a weekend with friends and family this is perfect.

Well, we were thrilled to see that our favorite hotel in the Orlando area was available to visit again after the Covid-19 nightmare. I booked two nights online for next week to provide the family with a much needed getaway. This would be a great way to reward our high school graduate who has been screwed out of all his year end activities. A cabana by the pool is a must so I called to make the reservation. I was told that cabanas were not available during weekdays. Ok, we can roll without a cabana this trip. Next, I asked to have a cake made for our graduate that we would have during lunch by the pool. I was told that no food would be available from any of the hotel's outlets but that the grab and go market would be open. Say what? I don't remember seeing any of this explained on the website where I just made my reservation. Well, I said to the person on the phone, certainly the pool bar must be open. Nope, no bar available either. You'll have to leave the "resort" for any food and beverage needs outside of what is available from the grab and go market, she said. After a long and uncomfortable pause, I told her that we would need to cancel our reservation but thank you for being candid with us unlike your website. Ok, so the hotel is struggling to bring services back after being shut down for a couple of months. I get that and realize that this just isn't the right time for a getaway to this property. What is inexcusable, however, is the fact that this property is charging hefty room rates ($185/night) for a room at a "resort" that isn't really open. Worse, they are intentionally not informing you of this fact in an attempt to draw you there under false pretense. That is just plain slimy and not worthy of the Hilton brand. But, worst of all, they have the gall to add $35 a night to our room as a "resort charge" to pay for facilities and services that don't exist at this time. It's unfortunate management never learned guest service 101 or the old adage that honesty is the best policy. If I hadn't called to reserve a cabana, we would have shown up there only to learn at check in that the resort isn't. We were lucky to avoid that but I wonder how many families do show up only to be faced with massive disappointment and a $35 per night resort fee. Management should be ashamed of themselves for perpetrating this fraud. Finally, don't be trapped by this hotel's cancellation policy that is different from the corporate policy. Hotel policy states that any cancellations must be made three days in advance. Corporate policy states that all reservations can be cancelled 24 hours from arrival through August 31. Why the hotel and Hilton corporate can't be on the same page serves as additional evidence that management at this hotel has lost sight of its purpose.

Si bien en general funciono todo normal, hay cosas como el no tener agua embotellada en las habitaciones lo encontré incomodo. Falta de personal que hable español Poca amabilidad del personal y entrega de informaciòn erronea

Excelente hotel, de los mejores que visitamos en los ultimos tiempos. Habitación amplia, siempre limpia, con una gran vista a Volcano Bay. Piletas limpias y seguras, Universal Express, justo al lado de Volcano, ademas de varias opciones de comidas hacen que este sea un excelente hotel para visitar Universal sin dudas!

Es un hotel bellísimo, muy cómodo, limpio, las habitaciones impecables, espaciosas y con toda la tecnología necesaria. Nos toco una habitación con vista a Volcano Bay, es realmente un sueño observarlo desde el hotel, fundamentalmente de noche con las luces que lo decoran.

El hotel cumple con todo lo que uno espera, lo que hace la diferencia con otros hoteles, es la cercanía a los parques Universal, transporte a los parques Universal , y la entrada mas temprana para algunos parques. Se recomienda.

Experiencia muy agusto. La pasamos super en nuestro segundo viaje familiar y primero en Orlando. Total mente recomendado . Para mayor eficiencia y poder aprovechar al máximo su tiempo recomiendo la app de universal orlando Florida. Ya que teda los tiempos reales en la atracciones.

Hotel en la zona de los Universal Studios con un bus que te lleva gratuitamente. Es un hotel grande con muchas instalaciones: zona de comidas, piscinas, bolera, tiendas... Las habitaciones son correctas, los baños un poco antiguos.

Muy buen hotel , excelentes instalaciones , la comida se debe comprar, hay que pagar parqueadero , gran servicio de transporte , no necesitas toallas en ninguna instalación, debes comprar tus bollas no esta incluido

El hotel esta muy bien preparado para familias con niños de todas las edades. Las habitaciones son muy cómodas y espaciosas incluso para una 5 personas. En las zonas comunes el hotel cuenta con un espacio con todo el tipo de comida para cenas y desayunos. lo único que nos fue mal fue la conexión de internet en la habitación. Muy recomendable.

Estuve con mis hijas de vacaciones durante 10 días en este hotel, dado que había escuchado que era un buen lugar en la zona de Universal. Sin embargo mi experiencia no fue la mejor. En la tarde la piscina estaba llena de personas ebrias sin ningún control, los baños de la piscina absolutamente sucios. Las habitaciones están bien, la limpieza bien, la comida es de buena calidad. Las habitaciones con vista a volcano bay son un engaño ya que hay un muro que impide disfrutar de la vista. El precio puede ser llamativo, pero hay mejores hoteles por ese precio similares.

Es un buen hotel, ofrece muchas cosas. Comenzaré por la habitación. Pedimos una suite familiar, dos camas queen bastante cómoda y un televisor en la habitación. Tiene una sala de estar anexa, con otro televisor que al ser de la misma marca del otro, al accionar el control remoto hacía cambios en los dos. Existe un sofa cama para alvergar hasta 6 personas en la suite. El baño me gustó bastante. El excusado independiente de la tina y en medio una zona de lavado de manos, lo que permite optimizar tiempos si el grupo familiar es grande. Donde no quedé conforme es con la cocina. Pequeña, justa, con un microondas pequeño que en nuestro caso no daba vueltas. Una exvelente estantería, una mesa con solo dos sillas, dos comían en la mesa y el resto a comer en los sillones. Carece de encimera o estufa eléctrica, lo que limita las posibilidades de cocinar. La única opción si quieres algo caliente es cocinar en el microondas. Lejos lo mas decepcionante es el refrigerador, aparte de pequeño lo peor es que no tenía freezer. Habíamos comprado helados luego de nuestra estadía en un hotel de Disney que sí tenía un buen refrigerador, pero no fue posible mantenerlos al momento de llegar a este hotel de Universal. En resumen se perdieron los dichosos helados. En cuanto a las instalaciones del hotel me gustó la cantidad de piscinas, la proximidad con Vulcano Bay. Lugar al que se va caminando. Tiene varios restaurantes de comida rápida. Un lugar para jugar bolos que se debe reservar. No me gustó que nos cobraran por el estacionamiento, lo que parece ser la tónica en los hoteles de por acá. Tampoco me gustó que cobrasen sumas elevadas por ver una película estreno reciente que estan gratis en el avión o incluso un monto por escuchar música en la habitación por medio del televisor. Aunque eso se suple con el celular. El internet ha andado bien, de manera que no me quejo, pese a que si quieres mayor velocidad debes pagqr adicional. En fin, un buen hotel, habitación amplia, pero una cocina decepcionante, esparaba algo mejor, falta un mejor refrigerador y una encimera. Otro dato, te dejan platos y cubiertos de plástico. Todo plástico. Hay una cafetera que sirve para calentar agua

Espectacular recepción de Amika en el check in donde pudimos tener una impresión gral de todo. Hotel muy cómodo, practico y limpio. Súper recomendable el 3 park-5 day. Early park admisión es genial para evitar filas tempranas.

Hotel acogedor, completo y muy bien distribuido con diversión para nuestras pequeñas, comida variada en su food court, habitaciones con buena vista y comedor espacioso. Nos toco una habitación con vista ala piscina lo que hizo que el sol fuera esplendoroso para nosotros al levantar.

Es un hotel muy lindo, amplio, con varios negocios en su interior de comida y merchandaising.. con buses gratuitos a los parques y al lado de volcano bay pudiendo ir caminando… Las habitaciones son muy espaciosas y luminosas.. todo muy lindo!!

Sinceramente, excelente.. Cada detalle del hotel, pensado para el confort, para el deleite, y la experiencia única de estar en Orlando, Florida. Incluso un huracán azotó el estado de Florida, produciendo el cierre de los parques de diversiones, cancelación de vuelos..y el hotel, parecía una burbuja protectora.. El personal atento, la limpieza, todo pulcro, durante nuestra estadía pintaron paredes, y entiendo que es algo que realizan constantemente. El parque acuático privado, una maravilla.. a pasos del parque Volcano.. Muy recomendable..el precio es compatible con lo que se recibe.. MUY AGRADECIDO!!

Muy buen hotel , servicio, accesibilidad a los parques y personal atento, recomendable para las familias que tienen niños y buscan tranquilidad y comodidad al viajar con su familia. Piscina exelentemente

Muy malo Pésima la limpieza en los cuartos en general Una noche Llegamos cansados de los parques a la noche y una de las dos suites que tomamos estaba limpia y la otra con las camas sin hacer y Lis baños sin limpiar. Por parte de la gente del hotel no hubo ninguna intención de resolver el problema y encima nos trataron mal . Esperamos una Mucama que hiciera el cuarto por mas de una hora . Con todas las opciones de hoteles que hay en Orlando esta fue sin duda una pésima elección .

Hola Arrendamos por un total de 6 días, en donde se presenta un hotel maravilloso en fotos y el cual es especial para estar en familia. Detallo cada uno de los acontecimiento que pasamos, que sin duda nos amargaron el viaje. 1. Llegamos tipo 10 p.m., en donde nos cobraron el estacionamiento(todo bien) no tuvimos problema en pagarlo, pensando en que nos daría un numero para poder estar durante nuestra estadía. Nadie nos oriento para poder llegar a nuestra habitación y no teníamos lugar para estacionar. Quedamos super lejos de nuestra habitación y fue terrible llevar nuestras maletas, voy a que si te cobran por algo mínimo debían tener en cuenta sobre la ubicación. Todos los días fue un caos encontrar lugar para estacionarte, incluso un día tuvimos que irnos y llegar después para ver si había algún lugar. 2. El primer día que llegamos nos entregaron una clave de WIFI, la cual no existía en nuestra habitación, tratamos de llamar por su "teléfono" el cual es del año de la prehistoria, nunca contestaron de recepción y terminando hablando con alguien del restaurante.. no nos quiso derivar a recepción y nos señalo que no había personal para atendernos, ya que, solo estaban tres personas trabajando?¿¿¿ en un hotel que presenta una recepción las 24 horas.. con miles de personas las cuales pueden necesitar ayuda. 3. para el sillón cama no había frazadas, pedí la hora que llegamos el mismo día nos entregaron sabanas para poder taparme, termine con una resfrió y medicamentos por todo el tiempo que estuve pasándome de frio. ( la ropa de cama llego a las 4 AM) EN DONDE NOS TOCARON LA PUERTA DE FORMA INSISTENTE. 4. Encontramos un pañal con excremento entre medio del sillón cama, lo cual fue asquerozo. 5. Había basura tirada por los pasillo, y el aseo dentro de la habitación dejaba mucho que desear. 6. Exigimos hablar con algún encargado, el cual se nos negó la posibilidad.. aparte no tenían a nadie quien hablara español, algo que nos parece inédito.. siendo que llegan personas de diferentes nacionalidades. Nos cansamos en pedir alguna solución, solo no le recomiendo este hotel, por ningún motivo. Enviamos un correo entregado por el hotel con las pruebas de lo cual estoy hablando y hasta hoy no existe respuesta. Nos sentimos decepcionada, aparte por el dinero desembolsado, pero también por ilusión que entrega el hotel de tener una buena estadía.

La limpieza de la habitación pésima , no nos cambiaron las toalla ningún días, nos dimos cuenta porque las toallas olían pésimo , y hoy día llegamos muy cansados de los parques y la habitación estaba sin la limpieza que contrate, fui al lobby y solo me ofrecieron dejar toallas y retirar la basura , ninguna disculpa o minimo una compensación o reubicarnos a una habitación limpia como corresponde una verdadera. Falta de respeto nos sentimos discriminándos por ser latinos , no lo recomiendo para latinos , te entregan muy poca información y tienes que adivinar sobre los beneficios del hotel , pero lo peor es llegar a tu habitación y que esté todo sucio , sobretodo un día cansador como el de hoy , nunca fueron a retirar la basura una burla y falta de respeto poca calidad de atención al cliente

Habitaciòn còmoda, buen baño. Desgraciadamente cuando fuimos una de las piscinas (la màs grande) estaba en renovaciòn. La ubicaciòn es inmejorable para ir a los parques Universal. Desde el hotel en una caminata de unos cinco minutos por un sendero rodeado de plantas se llega al parque acuatico Volcano Bay. Los buses a los restantes parques (muy cercanos) tienen mucha frecuencia y en horarios pico ponen varios buses a la vez.Ventaja de entrada mas temprana a parque Adverture que permite disminuir dràsticamente el acceso a atracciòn Harry Potter , tanto al tren que une con el otro parque como a la nueva montaña rusa (que vale la pena, pero las colas durante el dìa son muy largas) Cuenta con un patio de comidas amplio, donde hay tostadoras y microondas disponibles. Personal muy amable. No es un hotel barato, pero ninguno (tanto de disney como de Universal) lo son. Hay outlet cercano. En nuestro caso ni siquiera nos molestamos en alquilar auto, Uber es una opciòn màs econòmica y funciona bien tanto para transportarte hacia o desde aeropuerto como para ir a los outlets, yendo a los parques al contar con buses si alquilas un automovil queda estacionado (y el estacionamiento si mal no recuerdo es pago, pero como ahora disney ha dispuesto volver a dejar gratis el estacionamiento en sus hoteles por ahi cambia.

Es un hotel MUY GRANDE ambientado en los años 70! En sus tarifas no incluyen desayunos y tampoco estacionamiento. Es muy céntrico y tiene dmfacilidades para quienes van a los Parques de Universal. Me recuerda a los Hoteles de la Vegas todo es masificado. Las habitaciones fueron limpias y agradables para dormir. En realidad descansamos. Es un poco costoso pero están bien. Tiene una buena piscina si no desean salir del hotel.

We changed hotels last minute while in Orlando, and chose Aventura because of a planned day at Universal Studios. This hotel did not disappoint us. It was convenient to take the bus to Universal Studios. The food options were great, and the close proximity was convenient for dinner at Saphire Falls one night. The room had everything we needed and we loved the room controls on the IPad. We’ll be back to stay here again.

Our family of four stayed at Aventura resort in February 2024. We had two bedrooms one with a king and one with two queens in the deluxe category. The amenities were fantastic in the whole resort including the pool area, the food court and the lobby. The Starbucks in the lobby proved to be very much needed each morning as we made our way to the parks. Our king bedroom was very much lacking in light. The only light that we had was from the main hallway and the bathroom. All of the other light sources had either been removed or were not functioning. The windows in the room did provide a lot of light during the day, but at night time it was very hard to see around our room. Our queen bedroom was for our children and it was perfect for them. If I had to stay there again, I would choose two queens as I felt like the king size room had a lot of unused space where the sofa bed was. We enjoyed the rooftop bar and had a great meal. My husband and I enjoyed cocktails on the roof with the view of Orlando and our daughters enjoyed the pool which is heated and found that there was very few people utilizing the pool area during our stay, which was very nice. The lifeguard staff were very friendly All of the staff that we encountered during our stay were very helpful, friendly and went out of their way to make sure that our stay was wonderful. We went to Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure for three days and we used the boat next-door at Sapphire Falls on two occasions and also used the walking path and shuttle. The boat at Sapphire Falls was very easy to find and a very quick walk from the resort. We also use the shuttle and it arrived every 10 to 15 minutes and was a very quick ride over to the park the walking path from the resort to the parks is a quick 15 minute walk. The walking path is lined with trees and pretty scenery, and also provided many signs along the way telling you where to go once you arrive at the park entrance. The walking path brings you right up to Margaritaville where there is a security line and we never waited. The next time that we stay at Universal Studios on property. We will definitely stay at Aventura hotel as we found it to be reasonably priced with great amenities and friendly staff .

We booked the Aventura as it was our first time in Orlando, and the trip was centred around Universal & Disney - we were very happy with our selection! The Aventura was excellent for young couples, with less stress than the family packed hotels! The staff were excellent and couldn't be more helpful! The shuttle buses were efficient/quick, and were less than 5 minutes to City Walk. The room was large and comfortable, especially as we were based there for the 7+ days! The fitness centre had everything we needed, and the on-site Starbucks was a life saver! The only thing that could've improved our stay would be some more food options, and an area for drying wet clothes in the room! Small things that didn't negatively impact our stay! 5 out of 5! Looking forward to our next visit!

Hotel adecuado, esperaba más leyendo las opiniones acá en realidad. Puntos a favor: - Buena distribución del hotel, llegas rápidamente del lobby a tu habitación dado el tamaño, a diferencia de los otro hoteles de Universal. - Buena atención de recepción; tuvimos un problema de aseo al llegar y lo solucionaron rápidamente. - Habitación cómoda Puntos en contra: - Cuando llegamos, la habitación no había sido bien limpiada, y el refrigerador de la habitación estaba manchado y sucio con restos de comida del huesped anterior. - Habitación ruidosa. Se sentía ruido de motores constante durante las noches - Todo se maneja desde una tablet, pero el streaming que hace a la tv es de calidad regular. - Poca variedad para comer y cara; terminamos cruzando la calle hacia Cabana Bay para encontrar mucha más variedad y cantidad de comida. En resumen, experiencia regular en el hotel, probablemente no me volvería a quedar acá.

I liked the proximity of the hotel to the Universal theme parks, and the hotel itself was very nice. The food in the food courts was delicious and provided a nice variety. Overall we enjoyed our stay at The Aventura.

Pretty good had a good time, great time of year the wit times were minimal and the days were an OKAY temperature. We did volcano bay and it was colder than we would’ve liked but that’s circumstantial. The other days were perfect weather

Very sleek and modern hotel. I had a standard 2 queen room. Not a huge room but it was pristine. Rooftop bar was great. Very friendly customer service everywhere. The pool chairs could use updating and the Bluetooth speaker in the room had such horrible sound quality they might as well get rid of them. Other than that my stay was perfect and the price is very reasonable. I love that it’s a short walk to Sapphire falls to catch the water taxi to the parks. I will definitely be staying here again!

Never again money hustlers. Had room reserves for months showed up at midnight was told we no longer had a king bed for our getaway. Was told we were given a upgrade but it wasn’t my wife and I had to sleep in separate beds

My husband and I really enjoyed this hotel. The food was excellent at the Urban Pantry. We loved the rooftop bar. Great views! The technology in the room was fun to use, but there was a learning curve to it. The room is pretty small. I can't imagine trying to fit a family of 4 in one room.

Nice modern hotel, clean and tidy, reception staff were great, very helpful with tips and ideas about the area. With just a five minute walk, this hotel is pretty much the closest you can get to Volcano bay and allows you to get in 1 hour early which is why we stayed there. Also great location for the other Universal parks. It had a nice pool area and a roof top bar with great views. The room was a little small, and the ipad style technology to use the TV was a bit confusing, but otherwise a great stay.

From the moment you arrive, this hotel has the wow factor. Check-in was quick, and staff were very friendly, we were given a room on the 16th floor, and the view overlooked Universal Islands of Adventure. There is a bar restaurant on the 17th floor. Room, (we did pay via Tui for a skyline room, well worth it) There were two double beds which are the most comfortable beds we have slept in, only wish we could of brought them home with us. Shower room with toilet and separate area with sink and mirror. Hair dryer provided. Maid service every day with fresh towels and bed sheets changed on a regular basis. Bars, there are 3 bars, one by the pool, one in the lobby, and the other on the roof. Expensive thou $19 for two 16oz glass (plastic) of Stella. Staff at bar friendly chatting to customers, the bar on the roof not so friendly they just wanted your money. Food is available in the bar on the 17th floor. Whilst we did not try it, it looked appetising. Please note that they only serve 1 beer per ID, so if there's 2 of you, you both need to order at the same time. Restaurant, lower floor on the same level as the lobby, there is a Starbucks and a few cooking stations offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The meals are repetitive, freshly cooked Pizza's, Wok station, and area offering Burgers or Chicken, prices are in line with the area. Food was bland and not always warm. Drinks, you can purchase a refillable cup for around 19 dollars PLUS tax, this allows you to get a variety of cold drinks for your whole stay, coffee (a brown liquid) was also available. Location, Ideal for Universal IOA and Studios also City walk where there are many restaurants and bars available. You can get to these via the free transport which stopped outside the front of the hotel. You can walk across (5 minutes) to Sapphire Falls hotels and catch the water taxi, which run regularly. You can also clear security there. Staff, very friendly on reception, made you feel welcome. There's a ticket counter to get your park tickets if required. Getting to other parks (Disney etc) we used Uber, the most we paid was $23 for 4 people and they picked you up at the front of the hotel. Summary, WOW, this hotel is ideal location, staff go above and beyond to help you. We did have an issue with some items of nightware going missing, it was reported but not found.

The Hotel is nice in itself and the shuttle buses are great. The location is fab too. The biggest let down is the rooftop bar! We were given a room on the 16th floor, again great views but be prepared for the DJ they have at the weekends playing stupidly insane loud music, where you can literally hear the song lyrics and name the song! I contacted guest services to complain at 10pm to say we were woken by the music and was told they would ask them to turn it down and then 20mins later they had the absolute cheek to send someone to our room with earplugs! The music did not get turned down at all and there was no offer to be moved to accommodate us being able to choose when we wanted to sleep rather than being kept awake so they could have a DJ playing instead. Appalling customer service and no warning of this whatsoever when booking. I would avoid this hotel at all costs at the weekend if you plan on sleeping before midnight! After this experience I certainly wouldn’t return on this basis and recommend it to anyone, even on a week day purely based on the customer service we received from this complaint! We overslept the next day and missed out on the early entry hours to the park that you get with staying on a Universal property. We were kept awake again the following night until midnight because of the DJ when we asked to move we were told there was nothing that could be done due to the hotel being at full capacity! Note to the hotel don’t bother replying to this review asking us to contact you so you can discuss our concerns etc.! We tried that whilst staying with you to which you did nothing but actually insult us with earplugs and not actually asking anyone to turn anything down as the music stayed the same the whole night and kept us awake till gone midnight for two nights in row!

La mejor experiencia de lujo que puede tener, el mejor y rápido transporte del hotel a los parque, desayunos y cenas muy buenos, piscina muy entretenida con muchas tumbonas y toallas ambiente familiar

Para nosotras estuvo todo excelente, la atención, el bus para los parques, el servicio del cuarto, las piscina, el Starbucks. Lo único que no nos gustó mucho fue la comida que era muy costosa para lo que era, pero comíamos en los parques. Nos encantó que es un hotel tranquilo y pudimos descansar cuando llegábamos agotadas de los parques

excelente servicio y areas super bien distribuidas que generan un ambiente agradable, los precios de la comida son apropiados y el camino que entrelaza los otros hoteles y la city walk es genial, volveremos

Room was clean but service was horrible. Housekeeping discarded/took the clothing we accidentally left behind in the closet instead of reporting it to the lost and found department. Very dishonest. Having come from the hospitality industry, I know that housekeeping should have reported the items left behind in the room and guests should be informed. However, that was not the case here at Aventura. Hotel provided no explanation when asked about the clothing except that they could not locate the clothing which has sentimental value to me. Strange, as the clothing were IN THE CLOSET when we did a rushed room swap due to miscommunication by the front desk. We were asked to vacate the room halfway through our stay (when we were out) because we had a separate booking for an additional night made in advance. This was not mentioned to us when we spoke to clarify with front desk the night before. Front desk shared that we just needed to have a room key change and not a room change. This resulted in us cutting short our plans and rushing back to the hotel to quickly vacate the room -- forgetting to remove our clothes in the closet in the process. We informed the front desk about the lost items in less than 12 hours and they barely did anything. Just kept saying they could not locate the items. We asked them to check with housekeeping too, but nobody replied. Nobody was interested to help us so we had to message the staff asking repeatedly about the location of our clothing. All they did was brush us off saying they could not locate until I asked if our clothes were discarded. Only then they offered a compensation of 50USD for a pair of pants and a set of new pajamas. Terrible and in the end they issued a refund of 100USD. This is terrible service -- and dishonest etiquette from the housekeeping dept and the housekeeping staff who either discarded our clothing or took it. WILL NOT be staying or recommending this hotel to anyone. You can get a better hotel at a similar price point.

Un hotel excelente. Súper moderno e impecable, hasta había un robot por el lobby al que le podías pedir room service. Pileta climatizada, jacuzzi, películas en la pileta a las 8PM, gimnasio, varios bares, uno en el piso 17 con una vista espectacular, traslado gratuito a los parques de Universal, habitación grande, linda y con camas súper cómodas. Y lo más importante, todo el personal muy muy amable.

This review is for the "One King Bed" room. TL:DNR - Due to location and great service, I'd stay here again if the price was right. But, Cabana Bay is better, and only about a 5 minute walk farther to get to Garden Walk to the boat docks. The hotel itself is sleek and high tech. There is an iPad in the room that can be used to control the lights, order room service, etc. You can chat with the front desk via the tablet, or via text messages. There are robots (named "Relay") that can run things up to your room (not food/drinks, though :). You will catch Relay hanging out in the lobby and you can push buttons on its screen to learn more about it, or have it pose with you for a selfie. Fun stuff. But, the room itself, even with the great 14th floor view (actually 13th, there is no floor 13 in this hotel, so Bar 17 is really the 16th floor), is lacking. While the room itself is fresh and nice, and the towels are so much better than at, say, the Disney World Swan, the setup of the room left a lot to be desired. First, the king size bed is right up against the wall, meaning you have to crawl over from the other side (not an option if someone is sleeping there) or up from the bottom of the bed. Why!? In the bathroom, the toilet paper holder is vertical, so paper is usually just dropping down to the floor. AND, you have to reach back and behind you to get to it. Why!? There is NO towel rack in the sink area. Just leave your hand towel on the counter, I guess. Why!? Little things like this really seem to indicate they went for looks over functionality, which is odd considering this is a very sparse looking hotel (the theme would be "sleek and sparse"). Service was GREAT! Mobile check in, text to ask questions, SUPER friendly and helpful luggage staff -- outstanding interactions with everyone. There is a food court that is fancier than most (sushi, rice and noodle bowls), which is a step up above the cheaper hotels like Surfside/Dockside/Cabana Bay. There is a pool bar, a downstairs bar (usually closed unless weather is bad), and an upstairs Bar 17. Bar 17 has a great view all around, but on Friday/Saturday night it's SUPER LOUD with a DJ. You can sit on the other side if your ears can't handle the volume (it was loud enough that the watch sound alert was going off warning that extended exposure can cause hearing damage). The night we visited, it was SUPER WINDY, but still -- what a view! And some very interesting bar foods. The nitpicks here are minor, but they are the things one usually always depends on at a hotel - getting in to bed, using the restroom, using the sink. All of these are super easy for the hotel to fix, so maybe we'll see improvement in a future remodel. I'd stay here again, easily, unless the deal at Cabana Bay was significantly better.

Staying at the Universal's Aventura Hotel provides one of the greatest Universal benefits, a direct path straight to Volcano Bay. This makes it easy to come and go from the hotel to Volcano Bay as needed. A great benefit for families with younger children. The other compiling reason to use the Aventura is their great staff.

The Aventura Hotel is the epitome of modern. A tablet is provided to you to order room service, control lights and temp in your room, contact the front desk, etc. There's a rooftop bar and DJ Saturday nights, a beautiful pool downstairs, with a firepit and (surprisingly) fresh and tasty foods at the quick service dining in the lobby, including fire-grilled pizza and a hand-scooped ice cream bar! It's also about a 25 minute walk or 15 minute shuttle ride to the park. One thing they do not offer, however, are rollaway beds, so if you have larger children, you may be sleeping a little on the tight side on queens (which was the case for us with our 16 year old).

My husband and I were in town with a a group of teens for a Bible quizzing competition. The rooms were clean and comfortable. Each room had a small fridge with a tiny freezer space (we put our ice packs in them), a microwave, an electric kettle, and a coffee maker with pods. The coffee maker had apparently been used to heat milk at some point, which was soured and smelled nasty inside. The staff was very quick to replace the dirty appliance with a clean one. Although the hotel was quite full, the rooms were kept supplied with clean towels. The rooms were quiet with little to no noise from nearby rooms. The hotel is connected to a mall, which was rather nice. We enjoyed walking around and window shopping while there. There was a good variety of restaurants in the mall and surrounding area, including a food truck park. We had lunch in the mall one day and visited the food truck park one night. The burgers were so delicious!! Overall, this was a great place to stay and we would not hesitate to return!

Convenient place to stay, great location, great staff, rooms are comfy, clean and the WiFi is always fast. Gym is one of the better ones you will find in a US hotel. I travel all over the world, and have stayed in pretty much every city in USA, this place is up there with the best for business travel. Always get a good nights rest, great bar in the lobby and Starbucks on a morning for a coffee. If you want height of luxury and opulence go elsewhere but if you want somewhere to stay while visiting the area or are in business you won’t go wrong staying here.

This is a great spot for conferences as there is something to do for everyone. Convenient location and friendly people, plus my personal favorite part was a Starbucks at the end of the lobby. All that and the price was right too. Give it a try.

I loved my experience at the Florida Hotel. The rooms were great, and the workers were so kind. The one I wanted to really point out was one of the bell men that went above and beyond for me. I wish I could remember his name, but I filled out a form to give him a good review while I was there. The Florida Hotel is the only place I want to stay when I am in the Orlando area. I love Orlando and I can’t wait to go back. I will always be loyal to staying at this place Thanks again!

I have stayed at this hotel a couple of times and never had any issues with my stay. I have even left good reviews on TripAdvisor for my previous stays. The staff was always friendly and attentive to our needs. It seems that everything now has gone terribly downhill. When we checked in on this occasion, the staff was not very welcoming and did not provide us with any information pertaining to our stay at the hotel. The lady just asked us for our ID and credit card and gave us our room key without telling us important information regarding their housekeeping policy, wifi connection, pool hours, etc. On our 2nd day there, we stopped by the front desk to let them know that we would like to have our room serviced by housekeeping however, the man at the front desk informed us that we needed to request that at least 24 hours in advance to have the room towels changed and housekeeping service done. In addition to that, he informed us that in order to receive housekeeping, we had to stay longer than 2 nights at the hotel. I informed him that we were never told about this rule or policy when we checked in to the hotel however he appeared that he didn't care and directed us to a sign posted at the front desk which is very vague and does not mention anything about a notice of 24 hours in advance to have towels changed or housekeeping services (see pictures attached). I decided to speak to a manager since I felt that this was wrong on their end and we were never advised as a guest about this policy changes from the hotel. I spoke to the Front Office Manager CASEY CLEVENGER about my concern and how I felt. I asked to give us at least a one time courtesy since this was not expressed to us at check in and she denied our request and informed us that since we are staying for 2 nights that she can not accommodate us with such a request. I told her that we had stayed numerous times at their hotel and never had a bad experience like this one. All we wanted was a one time courtesy accommodation request to have our room cleaned but she seemed like it wasn't important to her and didn't care about our needs. I felt like my request was reasonable especially since they failed to informed us from the beginning. I asked to speak to someone else in management and she said no one else was available. I was very disappointed with our stay and will consider other hotels in the future when traveling back to Orlando.

Fun hotel- being located in a mall- steps from lots of shopping and a decent food court. Up to date exercise room with towels , pelaton bikes , water and ear plugs for use. Room was on the 11th (top) floor. Great beds, towels and large room. Funky room phone- looks like a stapler and hard to hang up! Called down twice for soap but never received. Went down to front desk next morning but they only had toiletries. Coffee maker and pods in room (with condiments). Cold fridge and safe also. Starbucks in lobby with a friendly staff. Buffet for breakfast was OK- long line for omelet station.

El hotel está muy bien ubicado, tiene unas excelentes instalaciones. La habitación es amplia y bien dotada. Recomendaría que el desayuno estuviera incluido en la tarifa. El personal es muy amable Felicitaciones

Great staff and great experience , great location near to the airport and near to shopping and near to golf courses . Secure rooms ! Great foods ! Clean rooms , flexible staff , came through every time I called !

Brilliant service by all in the hotel, really friendly and welcoming service, the bell guy Louis is fantastic always friends and takes his time to welcome you back every time he sees you. The hotel rooms are really clean and modern and comfortable

Excelente hotel. Todo muy limpio, bien ubicado dentro del mall con las mejores tiendas y feria de comida, el personal muy amable y las habitaciones en excelente estado. Sin duda cuando volvamos a Orlando volveremos a este hotel.

We had a great stay.. Jeniffer one of the managers went above and beyond to accommodate us. All the staff was extremely great..we requested extra water at 11:30 pm and it was brought up. I really enjoyed my stay here and will definitely return!!

Staff is incredibly attentive and knowledgeable.. The restaurant is great, though limited with this virus stuff.. Rooms are bright and clean. Great gym! Love staying here. Access to the mall is a definite bonus...

The place was very clean, and all of the staff was welcoming and friendly. The room was awesome as was the workout facility. The Starbucks staff was great. Great parking too. The ajoining mall was a great location because it gave you opportunities to shop all you wanted too.

The front desk reception was so welcoming and always acknowledged me even when I was in line waiting. The food I ordered was so delicious and the waiter was very knowledgeable and friendly. I feel the staff took extra time to make sure everything was clean and sanitized to prevent the spread as best they could from Covid. Would definitely recommend this hotel!

Hotel Staff very friendly had helpful. Rooms clean and very comfortable. Have stayed here before. Highly recommend this hotel. Having mall on property is very helpful for family traveling with me. We will be staying here again in the future. look forward to future trips there.

Stayed 2 nights in a very clean, quiet, & comfortable room. Nice amenities. Not a lot to choose from on the local TV, but great if you have other entertainment accounts like HULU, Amazon, etc. Meeting rooms were nice also. Front desk staff seemed happy to see me there and were more than willing to assist. Friendly. We will stay again in July and August 2020!

Florida Hotel and Conference Center it's just the Inn in Orlando, they have Florida Mall just next door so you can go and hangout there easy, the hotel have some good perks like a bar and gym,it have the best rooms in my opinion 5 stars in Orlando, the price it's just right, I've paid almost 2x the price in other hotels that doesn't even get close the quality of everything they have, Florida Hotel it's just unbeatable, you won't regret staying in this hotel trust me.

The Florida Hotel is an outstanding property with great amenities and very friendly staff. It is also in a great location nearby to many restaurants and stores. I would definitely recommend staying there.

During these difficult unprecedented times, especially around the hospitality hotel industry, it's hard to find a place that really has it together!!!! Thank you, "The Florida Hotel", for keeping things extremely clean, security safe and remaining to stay very friendly and making me feel like home!!!! The staff has been outstanding and the security team, lately has made me extremely comfortable!!

I was at your property 3 times in May and cannot say enough about the property. Even though the scope of that was limited due to the pandemic I will say that staff is top notch. They were pleasant and helpful. The food was excellent even with a limited menu. As well the property and rooms were very clean.

We just completed a four-day stay at the Hilton Orlando. From check in to check out we had an amazing experience. Special hats off to Charis and Sztella for their hospitality. The food by the pool was incredible all served up by the amazingly talented chef Timothy. The drinks by the pool were cool and tasty and served up by Chuck who always had a great smile. These are unprecedented times, and the entire Hilton family did a great job to make our stay comfortable, fun, clean, yummy, and overall a great time.

Weve been here a few times and it never disappoints. Cabana by the pool is reasonably priced and it’s a great poolside venue with good service. Would recommend for a staycation or anyone on vacation as wel.

I’ve been booking small getaways when possible during this Covid 19 situation. Mainly for a mental health break. Recently I booked an overnight stay at the Hilton believing that they were taking measures to keep staff and customers safe. Unfortunately what I saw and experienced was anything but! Upon arrival the front desk did not have a shield to protect the staff or arriving guests. Staff were not even wearing masks. There was a hand sanitizer in the lobby which ended up being the only visible sanitizer in the entire property. When we went to the pool area we had to open doors and gates and could not find a hand sanitizer. I did inquire with the pool staff where one staff member said there wasn’t any and another one said there was. There was no sanitizer in the pool area for lounge chairs or tables. There was no staff to oversee social distancing either. We did our best to social distance and in fact had to move 3 times to meet CDC guideline. The only pool staff available was to oversee that guests took only 1 towel per guest because they were short staffed. I think they should’ve taken this opportunity to reiterate safety and social distancing. This could’ve been done either verbally or by walking guests to available areas. This is something that I’ve experienced at other hotels. While at scratch market we couldn’t find any sanitizer either and none of the staff members in the entire hotel wore staff. The staff member here was on her cellphone while we were standing there waiting for her to assist us. We gave her a moment to finish on her phone to look up but when this didn’t happen we interrupted so we could be serviced. The lack of service throughout the hotel except at the front desk was noticeable. All of the restaurants were closed including the pool area. They did have a makeshift grill area where they were offering burgers, hotdogs and limited drinks. The problem here was the limited space where people could social distance. Again no hand sanitizers. I’ve read about Hilton’s commitment to safety but at this property this was anything but. We had considered staying an additional night but decided against it. We simply didn’t feel that the hotel made safety a priority during this Covid pandemic.

I get it that some things are changed due to the virus. But several of the amenities are closed, the on site restaurants are closed, and they do not provide any breakfast that is supposed to be included with the stay. BUT, they still charge full resort fee on top of the room rate and $28 for parking. The front desk said there were no upgrades available for diamond members but there are still many options available for purchase. This was our first visit here and will surely be our last.

I love coming to this hotel! The staff was very friendly, Nikki at the front desk was very kind and quick! Room was ready early and the pool / lazy river as always made me feel like I was in a retreat and not in the heart of I Drive! Can't wait to come back!

Buena ubicación Tiene wifi que funciona bien en algunas zonas del hotel . Habitaciones amplias, limpias, ordenadas, closet pequeño si vas a compartir habitación, cómoda no es suficiente para 4 personas en una misma habitación. Camas y almohadas muy buenas. Aire acondicionado funciona bien. Baño amplio y bien el aseo. Reponen insumos básicos y toallas sin pedirlo. Desayuno insuficiente para este tipo de hotel.

Fui a fines de nov 2019, el baño no tenia etiqueta de desinfección, el papel higiénico estaba apunto de acabar (recién entraba al cuarto), el personal no saludaba cuando t los cruzabas por los pasillos, si bien no cambiaban las sabanas en mi estadía solo la estiraban , no lo sacudian,ya q encontré medias dentro de las sabanas, me cobraron 25$ por noche por el estacionamiento, estuve 4 noches, no lo recomiendo hay hoteles de menos estrellas que se esmeran mas.

El establecimiento cuenta con todo lo que un hotel de primer mundo debe contar, menos con una atención excelente, resultó que mi reservación no incluía las botellas de agua en la habitación, lo cual inmediatamente no te hace sentir bienvenido. Desde mi check in hasta mi check out nadie se acercó a ayudarme con mi equipaje y vaya que llevabamos bastante.

Hotel mal cuidado. Me dieron una habitación sucia y mal oliente. Al reclamar me ofrecieron otra que estaba peor (tuve que volver a la original pese a todo). Hablé con dos gerentes del hotel en tres días y ninguno fue capaz de reaccionar a tiempo. Ofrecieron llamarme para solucionar pero jamás cumplieron. Al insistir me dieron otra habitación que no habían limpiado (encontré ropa sucia en el suelo y hasta le enseñé la foto de eso al gerente, y su respuesta fue ofrecerme una noche gratis en algún Hilton, cosa que rechacé de plano). No lo recomiendo para nada.

Make sure your name is on the reservation! My husband was meeting me here after a flight in from Europe and they were not going to let me have the room! He even paid for early check in! Luckily an hour waiting for his flight to land, he finally called. They could not find the aeroplan rewards note adding me to the room. What stress and a waste of my time. We were in room 1236. No hot water all weekend for showers later in the day/evenings, only lukewarm. Luckily there was hot water in the morning. Great pool area and good food. We enjoyed our days around the pool.

Excelente lugar, muy bonito y bien conservado, piezas muy cómodas espaciosas y con todo lo necesario, buena vista y muy cómodas, muy buen desayuno, áreas comunes bien mantenidas, con lugares de entretencion tanto para adultos como niños

El hotel es súper limpio, camas cómodas, el área de la piscina es increíble. Todo el personal es muy amable. Excelente vista hacia la ciudad y la piscina. El área del gimnasio es fabulosa tienes todo para ejercitar.

Great hotel for families, business trips and all things in between. The environment was very peaceful and relaxed. The staff was super helpful and polite. The hotel receptionist Ben was amazing. He always had a smile on his face and made me feel welcome. He also helped me numerous times when I needed assistance. I was so grateful for him. I would recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Orlando.

Had a great stay with three extra days for vacation. Perfect location with many amenities. No need for a rental car with trolley and restaurants in walking distance. Easy access to all usual attractions

Recién llegué al hotel y me empecé a sentir muy mal, al grado que la segunda noche estuve terrible por una infección estomacal severa. Al comunicarme a Room Service y pedir algo acorde a la situacion, en automatico me mandaron lo pedido, junto con una tarjeta de bienestar y no me lo cobraron. En la siguiente ocasion que solicité este mismo servicio sucedió exactamente lo mismo. Felicidades a IRIS de Room Service por este detalle. Tambien a la hora de registrarme, Eric en Front Desk hizo un servicio extraordinario.

Fuimos a cenar la noche del sábado en familia. Un lugar increíble con la vista a la piscina y ciudad. Una cena encantadora, de excelente calidad, atendidos por Omar Bermúdez que su labor fue inmejorable nos recomendó platos excelentes desde las entradas hasta el postre. Los cortes de carnes son exquisitos. Súper recomendable

Excelente hotel, con muy buena ubicación, tanto del centro de convenciones como de parque de atracciones. Habitaciones amplias y cómodas. El desayuno es algo tardado si se pide a la carta pero si de muy buena calidad, esta la opción de buffet que es mas rápido y prácticamente lo mismo.

Si se trata de un viaje de negocios, tiene todo lo que se puede esperar de un Hilton, Centro de Conversaciones propio, Parking, Cafés, Restaurantes y además está a un paso del Orlando Convention Center y del International Drive. Las habitaciones son amplias y cómodas. El servicio es bueno, pero impersonal y no lo recomiendo para quienes van con chicos. Como todos los hoteles de esta clase, es un poco caro.
El hotel es excelente, los servicios el personal todo de 10.Las únicas contra el alto precio del estacionamiento y del resort fee, siendo que en Orlando casi no se cobra.Todos lo demás es estupendo.

De principio al fin el servicio fue estupendo. Me canto la vista de la piscina y el bar fue donde pase el mayor tiempo. Y ay una persona en particular que se destaco. Este muchacho me serbio muy bien alado de la piscina. Quiero que cualquiera que lea esto y si vas estar ir llégate para conocer lo. Believe me great service! Thank you Zack!

Never saw such Incompetence by the most Arrogant, Unprofessional “Hotel Manager”. Mr Torres thought I should have been grateful for the new door lock they put in on my first and only day there. He thought that my spending 31/2 hours stuck in my room was fine as they had to change the entire locking mechanism. Believe he was waiting for me to Thank him as we lost a large restaurant reservation for my husband’s sixtieth Birthday. How Dare anyone dismiss a Guest who checked into a room only to be unable to open the door. I Truly hope, Mr. Harris Rosen Handles this, Personally.

The pillows are the lumpiest I've ever felt. The super small beds had dips in them from over use. On property construction noisy. Toilets in room are the small toilets that allow bathroom door to open but not for guest to to comfortably use the toilet Complaint department is closed at this location. You will be introduced to security here if you don't accept front desk clerks Smiling nice approach of don't know what to tell you buddy. It's new paint,old furnishings,no insulation in walls. Type place it's really not that cheap compared to newer built hotels in area. 2star all the way for sure on this one! P.s they sat us out ! After 2nd complaint.. just letting you all know.. What customer service. They do smile and talk happy but its not real..it's do what they say or leave.

Dated hotel in a decent location. Room was a bit old but satisfavtory considering our budget limitations. Multiple pools on the property, of wich only one was heated. We found the heated pool on our last day if our stay. Eould reccomend testing each pool on your first day there. Okay stay

En general es un buen hotel para quienes sólo quieren pasar la noche ya que durante el día aprovecha los parques. Buena relación precio/calidad. El gran problema que tuve con este hotel es que me cambiaron el alojamiento. Inicialmente mi reserva fue para el Rosen Inn Lake Buena Vista, pero como estaba sobre vendido, me trasladaron a este. Todos los días tuve que pelear con las personas del comedor para que me reconocieran mi desayuno que estaba incluido. Fue bastante desagradable esta situación diaria. Sumado a que ya no me encontraba tan cerca de los parques como originalmente había coordinado, ya que este hotel queda más lejos.

Fue una muy buena experiencia. El Hotel tiene una gran localizacion ya que tiene restaurantes, farmacia y atracciones cerca. Puedes llegar caminando. El staff del hitel fue muy amable. El hotel tiene una tienda de memorabilia con cafe de starbucks. Tiene desayuno y cena buffet aunque no esta incluido en el precio. Lo unico que mejoraria seria la limpieza, y conn una limpieza adicional que hubiera hecho el staff todo hubiera estado en orden. Recomendaria una limpieza profunda a las alfombras ya que tienen mucho polvo y me provocaron alergia. Por lo demas en cuestion de precio obtienes muchisimo valor por tu dinero. Un hotel con todo lo que necesitas para descansar y continuar con tus planes en orlando.

Good budget hotel rooms are spacious but a bit dated well equipped with coffee making facilities in room safe microwave and iron and ironing board food let’s them down not many using the restaurant in the evening not hard to see why a lot of mashed potato what’s wrong with jacket or red skin potatoes kids don’t want mashed potato with Hot Dogs what’s wrong with fries you do them for the bar did have jacket potatoe on a couple of times during the 3 weeks we were there but only one choice at a time been going for more than 20 years hasn’t changed also a lot of chicken chicken noodle soup very salty breakfast was typically the same rasher’s of bacon rock hard salty potatoes they need to sort it out chicken tenders and fries in bar also salty lot of food was wasted on tables i noticed the queues in the bar were ridiculous on some evenings with the queue passing mark on the karaoke counted 15 in queue and 2 staff on one evening 3 staff kept running out of Bud light bud beer had none on draft for 3 days dearer in bottles and bottles not included in Happy Hour who does the ordering this when on for the whole of the holiday mark on the karaoke is very good and always has time for a chat best thing about the bar room was kept spotless by the maid no complaints there we enjoyed our stay but not the food could do better or not bother at all

I just got off the phone with Reservations Specialist Alania. She was wonderful and went "above and beyond" making the Reservation process stress-free. Alania was very informative of all the possible booking scenarios and was able to lock the best rate for my stay. Thanks again Alania for all your help and kindness.

This hotel and friendly helpful cheery staff, never fail to make our stay a great one, even after staying here for 23years!! Rooms are clean, have coffee making, an iron and hair dryer, comp!momentary shampoo and condtioner food in the dining room is excelkent. A great choice every night, coffee shop and lifeboats good also. Our only disappointment this visit was that the shuttles to Disney parks are no longer available from this hotel, it really put scamper on our stay. Shuttle to universal available, local bus and trolley regular cheap service to shops , seaworld, aquatic a. Please Rosen lets see a change to getting your customers to Disney parks.

Nice clean hotel really good pool areas for the blocks of hotel we stayed in block F was quiet rooms were cleaned daily and was all that was needed for staying on I drive close to restaurants bars and the amenities in hotel were really good 24hr mini market a coffee shops bar restaurant free shuttles to universal and only $20-$24 dollars to do do Disney parks in Uber and no resort fee would definitely stay here again if staying on I drive.

Checked in to our room (10pm) to realise we wern't the only guests in our room, we were sharing with a pile of a few hundred maggots. Reception staff seemed unbothered but gave us a new room (11pm) By 3am we were all wide awake from the noises coming from the ac unit, and also the freeway that the hotel backs on too. At 7am we asked to be moved again to the opposite side of the hotel away from the freeway, staff again seemed unsympathetic,but did give us a new room on the other side. Now to the room it's self, very basic, very dark and dingey, very out dated. Tiny kitchen space with only ONE sink, which is also the bathroom sink (not very hygienic) Also the two small double beds are not enough for a family of 4 with a sixteen year old, So back to reception, who said we could have a roll away bed, at a charge of over 20 dollars per night plus taxes (we had 20 nights left) begrudgingly we paid for the bed, which then left us with no space in the room what so ever. We will NEVER stay in this hotel again.
