Our 4th visit to this hotel, it isn't missing anything that we can think of, we just used it as a base between going to the theme parks but there's a cinema opposite and a very nice restaurant called Maggiano's. Plenty of parking and a car rental office a 10min walk away, i-ride bus stops right outside plus free bus transfer to Universal. If it was lacking anything we wouldn't have gone four times.

This was our second visit to the Rosen Inn at Pointe Orlando and it didn’t disappoint. Our room was on the 3rd floor of Block D. Very clean and adequate for our needs. The house keeping team were very polite and courteous and ensured our room was cleaned, beds made with fresh towels daily. My only gripe would be when it’s known a flight has arrived and there will be a number of guests checking in, to have more than 2 members of staff on the reception. Other than that (and it’s a very minor issue which wouldn’t knock anything off the rating given) our stay was fantastic. The pools are clean, tidy with plenty of sunbeds for everyone. Perfect location to walk to restaurants and bars and also for driving to the parks. Ample car parking spaces too. Every staff member made us feel welcome and greeted us with a smile. Keep up the good work!

We returned last week after a last minute booking. What a bargain wr got! We loved the hotel, breakfast buffet was brilliant value for money. Our children couldn't get enough of the pools! Rooms a little dated but for what we paid we were happy. Location was amazing, perfect for IDrive and shops etc. Hopefully see you next year. One thing that did drive us potty was the amount of people smoking in stairwells.

We booked the Rosen Inn at Pointe Orlando in a last minute deal which was just too good to turn down. We visit Florida regularly and this was our first stay here and will be our last. ROOM - Was was probably the best part of the trip, a little dated and double beds are not not very wide. Air Con quite noisy too. But overall the room was clean, bathroom was fine, TV had sufficient channels to keep little ones entertained. LOBBY AREA - Didnt eat in the restaurant, much better looking options out on international drive. On site shops had a good selection of food, drinks and other essentials. Gifts were similar to what you might find the gift shops of I-drive, a bit tatty and cheap. Zebras sports bar was very dated, decor was very dark and brown everywhere, drinks selection ok. Caught a bit of karaoke before heading out and felt like stepped back into the 80's. POOL - We used the main central pool, was busy quite often and this means the pool fills up quite quickly so not a lot of room when like this. The pool temperature was not very refreshing, felt more like a bath. LAUNDRY - First expereince of this area was awful, was like being in jail. There was stuff everywhere, not just detergent, but left over drinks and food rubbish, clothing left everywhere. LOCATION - This is the most appealing aspect of this hotel, smack bang in the middle of I-drive with so many great food and entertainment options nearby. Universal / Seaworld parks are just a few minutes in either direction.

I was pleasantly surprised. From the outside, it's obvious that this hotel is older but the rooms were very clean, did not have an odor, and were well taken care of. The staff were all friendly. Anything you needed extra was able to be found in the convenience store on site. I will definitely be back to this hotel.

It's so easy to stay at this location. Made my reservations direct, and now you join some club, and I guess I have a 15% credit for my next stay. I'll be back anyway, but I will take Mr. Rosen's money thank you! Finally figured out which pool is heated, which was a plus. I love the no parking fees, and easy in and out access. I know there isn't daliy maid service (as of mid-November), but three of us in the room required some effort. I gave the maid a $20 as we checked in, and we had towels all week and empty trash. I was good with that. We only slept there. Beds are comfy, wifi works fast, and staff is friendly. They were decorating for Christmas, which added a nice touch. Can't want to return. I wish they had a larger suite but this will do. Also bonus....dined twice this time at the breakfast buffet. Perfect start for theme park families.

Many times I think we've all asked ourselves what's the point of this thing called life. We work a lot and when we go on vacation why not go to Orlando where there is something for everyone. I have stayed at 4 of the Rosen Hotels. The Pointe is right on International Drive amid multiple restaurants and shoppes. The rooms are very clean and well appointed. The best thing ? No fee for parking and NO RESORT FEES. A $50 deposit for either direct or 3rd party booking (Priceline, etc). Excellent value. A 24/7 store and a nice restaurant on site. CVS and Walgreens are also steps from the property. I would definitely suggest Rosen Pointe Orlando. Safe, secure and lower priced than most.

I’ve always been a huge advocate of the Rosen properties especially Rosen point Orlando! But I feel I now have to share my continued disappointment over the last few visits (I stay at least three times a month) since the pandemic what happened To clean rooms and fitted sheets? I felt like in my previous stays before Covid the rooms were much cleaner than they are now which seems kind of ironic as everyone is claiming to have extra precautions in place to make sure that things are clean? Why are we No longer using fitted sheets? Why does the air conditioner no longer run on continuous fan? When the air conditioner runs on a continuous fan it drowns out all the noise of the highway and the idiots that run around making Rakas all night so those of us that actually have a job can sleep!!!

Well run large hotel complex. Multiple older hotels combined into one complex. Everything was clean Staff were nice and helpful Close to convention center Shuttle bus stops out front Free parking Safe, clean and reasonable

Bit of a double edged saw. So we arrived at the hotel my girlfriends cards had been blocked her bank (issue that was fixed the following morning), and we met Lainie at the desk. Who couldn't do less to help us. We had paid for the hotel in full up front, and when she asked for 70dollars on our card for incidentals, it didn't work. Her response was, I can't do anything. We offered cash as we had taken all our money as cash with us she said no. We had been travelling for 20 hours from Ireland, our transfers hadn't turned up and now our hotel was refusing to allow us to check in. We tried to move money onto different cards but again due to the bank holding the cards(as we were abroad), we tried again, and again and again. He attitude was just to stand and stare at the floor, not hp us or offer any solutions to a stay we had already paid upfront. Eventually after the stage where my girlfriend was visibly upset and Tired another staff member stepped in and showed common sense. Offering the room for the night and we would sort the card with the bank in the morning as it was 4 am Irish time and we couldn't call them. Which we did the following morning and sorted everything. He attitude and responses of i can't help you was shocking. Zero customer service and that was say 1 of our trip. Now, to balance this out. We met Rose, i think, ldy with blonde hair who served us at breakfast. Every morning she had a smile, a heartfelt good morning and made you feel very welcome. Herself and Caolán were both lovely and welcoming, sadly the first person we met wasn't wither of these two ladies. We rang to ask one morning was breakfast in and were told no, when we went down to head out, breakfast was being served. Annoying. Hotel was fine though. Beds clean, room clean and walking distance to Universal and close to stores and diners. Plenty of options around for drinks or food.

Excelente Hotel... ubicación, comodidad, pero por sobre todo en el personal y la calidad de atención al cliente. Un 10!!!!. Hicieron de nuestras vacaciones que sean únicas gracias a su hospitalidad. Volveremos seguro!

This boutique hotel is on of kind,offering a great service and food delicious The lobby is designed with a great taste,very Parisian boutique look Will come back again soon....no competition in Orlando area.

We stumbled across this property 5 years ago and have been back 10 or more times. Great location on I Drive, extremely friendly staff, and a unique decor is what keeps us coming back. Our highlight of every trip is drinks and dinner in the lobby bar. Michael goes out of his way to make sure we are more than satisfied with our entire experience. He is quick with great suggestions on hidden local gems to visit or tips on events that may be going on during our stay. We look forward to our next visit.

Had a surprisingly wonderful stay. Staff were excellent, attentive, and helpful. Decor/ambiance was playful and chic. Rooms were a good size and clean. Nice lounges area to relax or work in. One note would be the older windows which water condensed on and obscures the view. Looks like they are doing some renovations though. Will happily come back.

Although the hotel is kids friendly to us it was more of a romantic getaway place for couples. I love the castle theme of the hotel. I felt like a real Queen especially that I was there celebrating my 50th bday. The rooftop at night is wonderful and so romantic. We enjoyed it with a bottle of wine. The staff were great too. Very friendly and helpful. We received so many coupons we were able to do an entire night bar hopping.

I loved this hotel's aesthetic, my mom did not. It's dark with interesting art in the hallways and a fun lobby. We were given cookies at check in. It is on International Drive so prepare for traffic in the evenings. You can walk to most of the attractions close by and you're very close to Universal and Seaworld. I would stay there again. Comfortable beds.

Very trendy hotel with great decor, but the room was terrible. Bed was sunken in. Curtains let in all the sun in the am. Noises coming from everywhere....hallways, exhaust fans, etc. Pool was small. Hotel was under construction by the pool. Spa was closed permanently... just didn’t seem like a Marriot property. We did order room service, which was tasty (the waffles were amazing), staff was friendly. Self Parking is $15 per night. It is a very convenient location, but anemities are sub par.

...but i was really lucky to have found this hotel. it was a very nice hotel, the decoration was interesting,great location and awesome staff. Wish i had more time to enjoy the hotel facilities but it served my business needs.

Myself and two friends stayed at the Castle Hotel for a weekend getaway. From the second we stepped up to the front doors we were happy. The lobby was beautiful (great place to take pictures). The staff at the front desk were great- they gave us ideas on fun things to do around the hotel. Our room was nice, not super modern, but that was not a concern as it was very clean and the beds were very comfortable. The pool was great, they have little cabanas around the pool and a fountain in the middle. The dining area for breakfast was SO CUTE and the food was delicious (waiting staff also very friendly). The pool bar was great (bruschetta was delicious), and staff even brought the food poolside. There are a variety of restaurants, stores, and even a ferris wheel within walking distance of the hotel. Although we had no children with us, we saw a family check in they gave the two little girls princess crowns, which I though was really cute to go along with the Castle theme. All-in-all I cannot wait to visit Orlando again and I will definitely be staying in this hotel when I do.

The staff was very friendly and helpful in getting me a last minute room when the Air conditioner broke in my room at another hotel and they were unable to move me to another room. Very thankful for the castle hotel as I had a business convention the next morning and all the hotels were booked. Castle was also very clean and stylish. Will be staying with them again in the future.

Stayed here for 15 nights on my last trip to Orlando & plan on staying here again for our next trip in 2023! This is the perfect location with an iRide stop just outside & Uber drivers being nearby also. The room was a little dated but it was spotlessly clean & had everything we could have needed. We did have issues with the safe, we couldn't open it the first time we closed & locked it but we called down to reception & it was sorted within 10 minutes. On check in we were given vouchers to use for breakfast, dinner & something else that I can't remember. We only used the 2 breakfast vouchers & didn't use the rest as we had too many other places to visit - but this is definitely a nice touch & I'm sure a lot of people get good use of them! I know there are many hotels on International Drive & the only places I have experience in staying are a private villa & Rosen Inn at Point - but I would much rather stay here than a private villa again.

Excellent two week stay had lots of facilities for the kids and had 2 pools. The rooms had lots of space to move around and was very clean. I would definitely stay here again. I do reccomend this to anyone who is looking for a place to stay in orlando

We stayed here for a week - the rooms are dated but clean and have everything you need. We had breakfast there one day as we got 2 free breakfasts with our booking and unfortunately everything was cold so didn’t go back. The pool area looked nice although we didn’t actually use the pool. There was plenty of parking. The location is great with so many restaurants in walking distance. Room tip - try and get a room not facing the pool as ours was very noisy with a very busy road just steps away.

I stayed at the resort 1.22.22 and when i checked out i Forgot medication in the refrigerator. I call and spoke to security Office name start with P. He was so helpful and retrieved the medication left it in fridge until i was able to come back 4 hours later to pick up. He was very friendly and willing to help. Thank you

The staff is very friendly. They make you feel at home with friends. The rooms are comfortable. I forgot my keys in the room and it did not even take 5 minutes to get help from them. Foods are of good quality.

The location of this hotel was wonderful. It was convenient to restaurants and attractions. The hotel itself was clean and the staff friendly and helpful. The hotel has a restaurant, bar and convenience store. I would definitely stay here again when in Orlando.

Great location off of International Drive and the staff was very friendly. Housekeeping was available everyday and the room rates are very reasonable! I will definitely be back for future stays! Keep up the great work!

Have stayed here so many times now I’ve lost count. It’s our home from home in Orlando! Fantastic location. So many restaurants within walking distance -good for a rest from driving. Rooms have everything you need & beds very comfy. Room service every day. Yes you do get the odd noisy guest talking too loudly, late, as they pass your room but that’s a problem you get at some point in every hotel. It’s called inconsiderate people!! I have stayed at many hotels in Orlando & around the world & have encountered this everywhere. Spotlessly clean. Deli great for late night snack or early morning coffee. Lovely outside seating area, peaceful & relaxing. Grounds well kept. Great base. Just booked another stay for April.

We stayed in November for 3 weeks, The check in was great with no lines, Our room was cleaned and restocked daily. The rooms are very clean with everything you need. The housekeeping staff were lovely. Reading some of the reviews I never smelt or witnessed any 'weed' smokers' but I did agree with the staffing of the Zebra bar, we only used it a couple of times due to this issue but just went over the road to Millers, felt sorry for the barman .. trying to take orders, serve food and clear tables all by himself. Had no issues parking (even over thanksgiving weekend) and felt safe at this end of I drive. We never used the Restaurant so cannot comment on that the hotel was well maintained both inside and out. I never leave money out in my room unless it's a tip for the housekeeper but nothing else was ever amiss. This hotel is my go to on I drive. looking forward to my next stay

This was our tenth stay at this hotel, there won’t be an eleventh. It has gone completely downhill. Had to swap rooms twice in 24 hours due to the overpowering smell of weed in the room, you come back from a day in the parks only to be met with enough weed smoke to make your eyes water. Security were worse than useless and management claimed they had no way of finding out who was smoking weed in the rooms

We stay at this hotel 3 times a year and never have we had money stolen from the room until this stay. My husband leaves a cup next to the tv with quarters in to use the pool table , the cleaner had been in the room in the morning and we left and returned to the room around 4pm to find a very sheepish cleaner back in the room saying she was leaving towels which she had already done that morning. My son had figures next to the cup and they were knocked over and when my husband checked there was around $10 missing from the cup. We went and speak to the manager who was Eli who was absolutely useless. He advised they were using some contact cleaners so we said we didn’t want anymore housekeeping as they can’t be trusted to enter the room. The cleaner in question was still working on the same floor when we left. Also if you are going to charge full price to stay at the hotel please make sure all facilities are up and running. Restaurant shut in the evenings, restaurant only open some mornings for breakfast and a very under staffed Zebras bar. We felt so sorry for Cyrl & Ricardo as they are doing the work of what was 4 bartenders. Security had to be called at 2.30am as people outside the room shouting, jumping around and smoking weed. Think we will definitely think twice about returning which is very sad for us. Please also bring back Mark Good he is very much missed.

Above all being so awesome, the absolute best part about it was the two wonderful ladies at the front desk... Nerly and Marie ! They are the most helpful gals that I've ever met ! They both deserve a nice raise of some kind... PLEASE ???!!!

I just want to say that I enjoyed my stay at the hotel! Everyone was extremely nice, the rooms were clean, the property was well kept and the kids enjoyed the pool and the buffet breakfast! Thank you!

I got a last-minute deal on this hotel ($56) and almost canceled my reservation after seeing some of the recent reviews that made it sound like the vibe was creepy. I’m glad I ended up keeping the reservation, because in my experience it wasn’t bad at all. Head's up: I'm a travel writer who is used to writing in-depth hotel descriptions all day every day, so we're about to get pretty detailed here. Hopefully it's helpful. Expect your arrival to be hectic. There were a few kind employees out front directing cars into check-in parking, which was crowded and tight. I discovered why once I got inside - there was a line of about 30-40 people waiting for the front desk. This was at about 9 p.m., which is traditionally a pretty slow check-in time at most hotels, but the front desk clerk told me that one night they had a line up until 5 a.m., so it sounds common here. Given that they have over 1,000 rooms, adding a few more front desk staff would definitely cut down wait times, but I know finding good employees is tough right now. Despite the line, I only waited about 20 minutes for check-in. I heard a couple of people requesting room changes during my wait, but I didn't overhear the specifics of why. My only request was an upper floor room, since those tend to be quieter, but that plan didn't quite work out. Despite being on the 9th floor, my room was about as close to I-4 as you can get without being right on top of it, so I had interstate noise all night. While the traffic was basically white noise, the sound of suitcases rolling along the walkway outside my room and one very loud car stereo at 3 am were harder to ignore. If you're a light sleeper, bring earplugs. I felt totally safe exploring the grounds at around 11 p.m. As a former Orlando resident, I'm used to keeping my guard up but I-Drive is decent in terms of safety and you needed a parking pass from the front desk to even get into the parking lot, which helps. The buildings are fairly spread out (think Disney value resort layout, if that helps), but it was only a five-minute walk from the lobby to my building, which was one of the farthest away, and you can park close to your building. After being away from Florida for several years (Thanks, pandemic) I loved being surrounded by the lush tropical foliage and palm trees that line the pathways. There are three outdoor pools, which are all pretty much the same size. Since other reviews have mentioned it - I did definitely catch the scent of weed at one point while I was out exploring, but only by one building. There's a treehouse-style outdoor playground for kids and a small gym with a couple of treadmills, an exercise bike, an elliptical, a tricep pull-down machine, and some free weights. The gym was basically just like the hotel: Not fancy, but it gets the job done. One definite perk: They have a 24-hour convenience store. After arriving fairly late, I was not in the mood to get out in traffic for food, so being able to grab snacks and bottled water was a big plus. They also offered some basic souvenirs, Disney and Harry Potter t-shirts, a few frozen meals, and a decent selection of beer, wine, and hard ciders and seltzers. Prices were basically what you'd expect from a hotel gift shop in a tourist town: Way more expensive than you'd like, but also way better than the trouble of traveling somewhere else. On to the room, which was basically your standard upper-budget level room: Beds, desk, mini-fridge, microwave, and not much else. It was a little humid, but this is a motel in Florida - more often than not, that's what you're going to get. It's never really bothered me, but if you tend to be bothered by it, spend a few extra dollars to stay somewhere with indoor hallways and you'll be much happier. Other than the AC being a little loud (it's one of those units that sits below the window rather than central AC), I didn't really have any complaints. Overall, I wound up being pleasantly surprised. I'd stay here again if I found a similar deal - cheap hotels that aren't in terrible areas can be hard to find in this city. You're right across the street from Pointe Orlando and Wonderworks, and there's a complimentary shuttle to the theme parks at set times. As long as you can deal with the long check-in line, no-frills style accommodations, and possible noise, it's not bad at all. I'd stay here again if I found a similar deal, but I definitely wouldn't pay $100+, which was the standard rate for the night I stayed.

I have stayed in this hotel many times and i have seen it slowly going down hill each time i stay, i made a online order because it had free delivery i decided to get it delivered instead of picking it up myself and when it got delivered to the hotel i went to the front desk and they tried to charge me $10 handling fee, i refused the package out of a matter of principle and told them to send it back. Also the cleaners have gotten very lazy they knock on your door about 8am knowing your still in the room and when you say come back later they dont bother untill the next day. The staff at the front desk used to be nice and welcoming now when you ask them a question its like your disturbing them. I can honestly say its the last time i will ever stay at a rosen hotel thankfully we move to the doubletree at seaworld on sunday.

The check in location was nice, but it was like we were at a different location once we headed to our room. It was absolutely disgusting and creepy. There were people outside smoking weed, so that’s all we could smell in the room. The beds were uncomfortable and our bedding felt damp. Never again!

Stayed here a lot of years ago when it was Quality Inn & have been coming to Florida nearly every year mostly staying in villas or large resort/condos such as Orange Lake, Liki Tiki & Mystic Dunes Golf Resort. This year was a last minute trip for 2 instead of all the family so needed smaller accommodation. Having read the reviews i was very cautious about staying here & even tried to book into the Plaza next door but missed out so in the end settled for Rosen Inn Pointe seen as there was only 2 of us thought it was adequate. Just coming towards the end of a 10 day stay and can safely say i’m glad i saved the £140 pp to stay here than the Plaza. Firstly there is no resort fees or parking fees, which is a major bonus !The only minor annoyance here was the wifi disconnected after 24 hours & you had to sign back in, other than that everything has been great ! The staff at the front desk were more than helpful letting us look round rooms first so we could get the best location & settled for Block F Floor 6 & it offers fantastic views day & night of I Drive, but its also very peaceful. Block G is pretty quiet but you do hear I4 traffic very faintly if you are a light sleeper ! But Block G is bang on the money. The pool up at this block was very quiet & relaxing. The water was heated which was nice during cooler evenings of November. Only downside to this pool was it only got partial sun till around 1pm when the sun moved. I got the impression the blocks closer to reception was more livelier especially with young kids. The whole complex was immaculate & well kept. Had a couple of drinks in the bar which was very welcoming & not bad priced. The on site shop has most things you’ll need but a tad expensive. I enjoyed sitting out by the shop on a morning with a coffee it was very quiet. Rooms were more than comfortable with no issues at all. Beds were very comfy, large flat screen tv with all the channels. There was a coffee maker which can also do tea, so no need to hire a kettle ! Iron & board. And a rather large fridge with plenty of room for a few days, microwave & hair dryer Maids came by daily & were pleasant but they do come early some days knocking on the door at 9am. Location is FANTASTIC you are centre of everything. I usually stay up at Kissimmee & its a bit of a drive to get places. But here you can nip out to the outlets/mall & be back in a couple hours. I’d say its the most perfectly placed accommodation on the whole of I Drive ! All in all i wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again, and i am glad i chose this place because its a bargain compared to other hotels. If you’re looking for a resort for more than 2 weeks, you’ve got all the kids with you & your going to spend time at the hotel & wanting on site activities this isn’t for you. If you’re planning an action packed holiday where your out every day & want a few hours in the day/night by the pool you won’t get a better.. value for money room than here. I can’t speak for what its like during the rest of the year. But i stayed here over the thanksgiving week from the UK and thoroughly enjoyed our stay !

Went to eat Thanksgiving dinner on night of 25th starting at 5:00pm. We were not planning to eat out as we are from the area locally; however our kitchen was being worked on so we had nowhere to cook. We had 12 people and we did the special buffet. I want to stress how wonderful a welcome we all received and just the best service from our staff and all those working around the buffet as well as cleaning the tables. We also had a very special birthday and our waitress took all the time to present the cake and make the night so special. Everyone was so kind and just full of smiles and we could see that spread into the faces of the other guests. Please pass on our thankfulness to these folks, we were there from 5:00pm till 7:30pm at the Thanksgiving buffet sitting just in front of the icecream machine. Thank you! James Alter from Orlando

Excellent service and Helpful staff. Downside is they dont have a proper restaurant. They have a deli and a cocktail bar to get some burgers. I wanted to het breakfast and had to go to IHOP. Hotel is not so far from theme parks ($14 Uber). I will definitely come back

My 4-night stay at the Rosen Inn at Shingle Creek was very pleasant. Check in was easy and fast (one person in front of me). The room was clean and well appointed. There was a fridge, coffee service, and an iron and ironing board. The bathroom was fine and the mattress was exceptional. At all times I felt safe. It was convenient that there were 5-6 excellent restaurants at Pointe Orlando not more than 300 yards away. After traveling for business for over 45 years I can honestly say this might be the best "under $100/night room" that I have ever stayed in. Contrary to other reviews, I had NO challenges with parking any of my four days. On a side note, I was in a hurry leaving and I left some very expensive clothing hanging in the closet. When I got home, my call was directed to Lost and Found, and four days later all my clothing showed up at my door in pristine condition.

Un lugar que te sorprende constantemente con su ambientacón de fines de los 50. Pegado a Volcano Bay, por lo que aprovechamos al máximo el pase de dos parques Universal + Volcano en 4 días. la entrada a Volcano es desde el mismo hotel. un día de descanso en Volcano, dos días de parques universal y un cuarto partiendo en Volcano y en la tarde cerrando en los parques

Es muy bonito, limpio, con gente muy amable al servicio de los clientes. La conexión con los parques a través de buses esta muy buena. Venden vasos de bebidas que son recargables por el tiempo que lo compres y son de gran utilidad, especialmente para niños. Es un lugar para compartir en familia. Totalmente lo recomendamos.

El hotel es inmenso, tenes pileta, laundry pago, restaurantes, starbucks, local con mercaderia de universal, bowling, etc Los empleados super amables, las habitaciones enormes y comodas. Posee una mini cocina la cual te ayuda por la heladera, cafetera, cubiertos , etc. El wifi funciona perfecto, estas a pasos de los parques universal podes ir caminando o tomarte el micro en el hotel que te lleva a los parques.

Excelente opción, cerca de parques, buena comida, camas cómodas despuesde un día cansado de parque y buen servicio de transporte. Eso sí en el checkin nos atendió una chica poco amable y accesible para aclarar nuestras dudas

El hotel es muy agradable y esta muy bien mantenido. Nos toco una habitación con una vista increíble al parque de VOLCANO BAY. Habitación cómoda y acogedora. Nos gustó mucho mas que la estadia en hotel POP CENTURY de Disney.

Me ha encantado el hotel en general, sus instalaciones, la hermosa vista de la habitación a Volcano Bay, su variedad y calidad de comidas, una tienda con mercancía a la mano de Universal y su facilidad y servicio de transporte de buses a los parques de Universal. Volvería sin duda.

This stay was an excellent experience at the cabana bay beach resort. The hotel’s cleanliness and convenience to Universal Studios with their bus service was great. The dining experience was very enjoyable everyone was able to select their meals

We have stayed at Cabana Bay four times in seven years and until this trip, we loved it. This time we had major issues on four of our eight nights with nearby rooms blowing weed smoke into vents that connect to both of our adjoining family suites. They did this every few hours, around the clock. Security refused to look into it, even though smoking in rooms is not allowed. The fourth day we complained we were told a manager would come to our room to experience the severity of the odor. That was 8pm on 12/22 and when we checked out 13 hours later, the manager had still never shown up. We’ll never stay on a Universal property again.

El hotel está buenísimo. Muy lindas y cómodas instalaciones. Las dos piletas son entretenidas y muy buenas para pasar el día en familia. La limpieza y comodidad de las habitaciones y zonas del lobby son excelentes. Cómodo y amplio el estacionamiento. El acceso a volcano bay caminado es muy bueno! Y para el resto de los parques hay bus que te dejan en 5 minutos. La amabilidad del personal de los restaurantes es mala. Cierran los sectores para comer mucho antes del horario de cierre. Deben mejorar eso!

Lo más bajo que tiene el hotel es: -> admisión:personal frío y poco cortés -> Aseo de las habitaciones: es muy superficial y no tienen horario. Pueden llegar desde las 9 hasta una vez a las 12. -> Baños de las habitaciones: jabón y shampoo de regular calidad (para el precio que uno paga). -> no incluye desayuno. -> Un bowling hermoso pero tremendamente caro. Lo mejor: -> Una piscina exquisita. -> ambientación. -> cercanía a los parques. -> buses de traslado permanente.

A nivel de servicios, el hotel está genial, tiene bolera, tienda, salón recreativo, dos piscinas geniales, restaurantes……. Pero la habitación podría mejorar en limpieza y los colchones muy blandos. Aún así, el hotel está genial.y lo recomiendo totalmente.

Es un hotel excelente, buenas habitaciones, buen trato, excelente limpieza. Una piscina hermosa con lindos lugares para disfrutar de momentos hermosos. Las habitaciones en las torres con vistas al Volcano Bay son espectaculares de día y de noche. El patio de comidas es excelente. Un hotel muy grande, con mucha gente pero totalmente preparado para recibirla. Una buena experiencia.

Visitamos el hotel en julio de 2022 en familia (tres hijos adolescentes). Nos hospedamos en el edificio Starlignt, con vistas a la piscina. La habitación contaba con dos camas de 1.50m y un sofá cama también doble. Un baño. Para los 5 nos ha quedado un poco justa de espacio, pero teniendo en cuenta que solo hemos estado allí para dormir, pues nos hemos arreglado muy bien. El restaurante no es buffet, sino que hay 4-5 posibles puntos para elegir la comida que más te interese y luego pagas en caja. Hay un puesto para ensaladas que está muy muy bien. Dentro del propio hotel hay un Starbucks donde comprábamos el desayuno y así por la mañana no perdiamos apenas tiempo. Esta muy cerca del parque Universal, se podría ir andando, pero con el calor y la humedad, lo mejor son los autobuses (salen constantemente de la puerta del hotel ). Limpieza diaria de las habitaciones (genial). El personal muy atento. Las instalaciones de la piscina están fenomenal (nosotros no nos bañamos), muy amplia, toboganes... Muy buena relación calidad - precio!! Puedes acceder a los parques con antelación al alojarte en el hotel (muy recomendable sobre todo en estos meses con tanta gente). En resumen, hotel correcto, sin grandes lujos, pero perfecto por su proximidad, limpieza y trato

older hotel nice pool area items in my room were not working had to wait on room change which caused the day that I paid for park ticket to be missed had reservations for dinner was supposed to be a 2 day relaxing trip was nightmare with room change out we lost clothing because we were rushing to get to the park because we paid for the day. the elevator was not working as well. will not be back

This is our second year and this was even better then last year. Our son always ask to go back. Next year he’ll be old enough to really enjoy some of the theme parks. We look forward to coming next summer.

The House keepers were disturbing and not psychologically stable! We found a dirty towel hanging by the sink with the dirty side folded under so we wouldn't notice. I tossed it on the floor on top of a pile of wet towels that got wet because it rained while we were at the pool. I expected that the towel would be taken and laundered with all the other dirty towels. Nope! When we returned we found the same dirty towel hanging back up on the towel rack. I took the towel and put it on the bedside table with a note asking them to please replace the towel. When we returned to the room the towel was still on the table with the note turned upside down and no new towel on the towel rack. I complained to the manager who responded in a positive way. He had new towels sent to the room immediately and promised that the housekeeper would be addressed about the situation. We also received vouchers for one meal for each person. This wasn't enough compensation for our trouble because the vouchers didn't even cover the cost of breakfast per person and I'm not counting tax and gratuity that the voucher didn't include. We continued to find more disturbing issues in the room when we looked a little closer. A pillow case had the same stain on it as the towel as well as the drapes and the bathroom door jamb. I decided to check the bathtub and I ran a tissue over the surface and it was filthy. I took pictures of the empty towel rack, the tissue, the pillow case, and the drapes. It looks like they just left the dirty linens from the last guests in the room. We found crumbs and a whole Dorito on the floor as well. We were upset and afraid of what the housekeepers would do next so we kept the do not disturb sign up for the rest of our stay. We really loved this hotel but we could not tolerate the housekeepers' creepy behavior. I have never experienced anything like this before. What kind of person leaves dirty towels and linens in a room, picks them up off the floor to hang them up for us to use and refuses to replace them. I've heard of recycling but this was ridiculous. AND...We were leaving them a daily tip for their service.

El camino de Pensylvania a Florida fue un trayecto algo alejado pero a válido la pena ya que fue una experiencia diferente a todos los años pasados. Nos gusta visitar diferentes sitios y espacios para hacer de los recuerdos.... memorias inolvidables

La ubicacion del hotel es excelente . Camas comodas. Limpio. Buen servicio. Tienen un bus que te lleva a los parques de Universal gratuitamente, el Volcano Bay esta ala par. La picina limpia y super su tamaño. Adentro del hotel tienen buenas opciones para comer. Lo recomiendo ante todo por la comodidad y la ubicacion.

La mejor habitación con vista a VOLCANO BAY ! Inmejorable todo ! La gente del hotel La recepción Todos ! Y sigo escribiendo xq acá me lo piden Y no sé cómo explicar que estuvo todo de maravillas!!!!!!!

El Hotel es bueno en general. Yo me hospedé en la habitación #1489. PROS Lindo lobby Conexión directa con el centro de convenciones. Buenas camas. Servicio amable. Buena limpieza. Express check out. TV Led grande. CONS WIFI malo. No tiene buen ancho de banda. Encontré bichos en el baño en 2 oportunidades.

Superó mis expectativas. Personal muy amable, buenas y cómodas instalaciones. Rico buffet del desayuno. Bien ubicado. Faltó quizás q pongan pantuflas en las habitaciones y reponer jabón en los baños. Tuve q pedir pues ya los jabones eran muy chiquitos y me los alcanzaron de inmediato. Muy cerca al centro de convenciones.

Realmente un hotel 5 estrellas. Tiene una pileta espectacular, donde los niños pueden divertirse en el tobogán o río lento, los adultos disfrutar de la piscina, el bar. Las habitaciones nuevas muy bien equipadas, amplias y excelente limpieza. Muchas opciones gastronómicas dentro del hotel. Cerca de todo. En el punto medio entre Disney y universal

Excellent staff and beautiful place with lots of amenities. Affordable rates and very comfortable rooms! The Convention center was equally as impressive too! After a long walk thru the Convention center the Lazy River was therapeutic!

We were in town for a large convention at the Orange County Convention Center and the Hilton staff from start to finish rocked our world! The Bistro, David’s Club,Spencer’s and the Marjey place were great as well. Thanks!

The room was not vacuumed when I arrived. There are no free amenities. Very poor choices to dine. The pizza I order was burned, and very expensive. As was everything. I’ve had better service at a days inn.

The Orlando Hilton has clean and comfortable rooms, pleasant staff,a beautiful setting that's conveniently located, reasonable rates, a gorgeous pool, and many other amenities make this a great place to stay.

We stayed at the Hilton Orlando, which is right next to the Convention Center in Orlando, Florida. Big, old, cold and staffed by interns. Very disappointing for a Hilton. Arrived late; the valet attendant was alone, pre-occupied with other matters, and laughed about everything, very strange. The desk person had trouble finding our reservation, and finding a room, and communicating. And the buffet breakfast, at $18.95, was about the same level as you would get for free at a Hampton or Springhill. In short, think about one of the other big brand name hotels if you are going to Orlando.

Being a former Diamond member I relived why I left this chain and went to SPG and Marriott. Upon check in the valet offered to keep the car close for $. Checking in we were offered an upgraded room for $100 per night extra and when we declined they said we could check in now for a $25 charge or wait 15 minutes. Finally getting to our 1st room walked in to a room that smelled like there was a pot party. 2nd room was musty apparently not used in quite awhile. Now, all this happened the 1st 30 minutes. We addressed this to management who could have cared less. Only reason for a 2 rating was the pool was great. NEVER going to another Hilton!

recently visited and honestly didnt want to leave the pool area, probably because of Zach and his steller recommendations. If you visit be sure to grab a Strawberry Gin Fresca or the Baja Tacos, both are amazing!

This hotel is great for a tight budget. It’s clean and the staff are knowledgeable and friendly. It’s perfect for getting some theme park perks while you have a nice place to stay. Our children enjoyed the hotel’s robot, Relay, the fire pit for making s’mores, and the splash zone/pool. There is not much else for kids to enjoy unfortunately. It’s a very simple hotel that is not much fun to look at and doesn’t have fun activities. However, the service was wonderful. There was an iPad in the room that controlled your TV, the internet, lights, and AC. You could also use the iPad to request whatever you needed for the room and to ask any questions to the front desk. We used it to order pizza as well. That was convenient. This hotel is also perfect for people that cannot walk much. Everything is in close proximity: the bus, the pool, the lobby, and the cafeteria. So that is another upside to this small hotel.

Resort pricing was double what the normal rate is based on the time of when we were booked. Parking is a separate charge that we were not aware of until we were there. Other than that it was a great place to stay.

They even text u during ur stay to make sure I r comfortable rooms smell very clean food is great front desk are really helpful made phone calls for me during my arrival gym is nice u can’t go wrong with choosing this hotel

Buen hotel, buenas habitaciones, cerca al parque, transporte incluido. El hotel tiene parking de pago diario. Deben implementar desayuno bufette y en los restaurantes opciones para cenar comer algo despues de las 8 pm.

Bien hotel en general , cerca parques y con un bus que facilita mucho todo en la puerta del hotel de 8 a 24h connmucha frecuencia Hotel bueno piscina buena . faltan algunas amenities en la habitacion como body lotion o cepillo dental . Debería tener un buen restaurante ( tiene opciones pero son fast food)

Nuestra estadía fue muy buena, la gente muy amable, el hotel muy bonito y limpio, está cerca de los parques de universal. Fueron unas vacaciones mágicas. Tiene una piscina amplia y bonita donde se puede pasar las tardes tranquilamente. Las habitaciones son cómodas.

Desde el servicio, los empleados, la habitación y todos los extras la transportación y el personal todo estuvo excelente. Ya van más de 4 veces que me quedo en el hotel y siempre el servicio es mejor. Gracias

My husband and I have been staying at Aventura every year for a few years now for our anniversary (started on our honeymoon). We love it! We stay in a deluxe room, and the view is like nothing else!! The staff is friendly and helpful, the delivery robot is adorable, and the transportation is super helpful.

Clean and modern Hotel. If you prefer just a good „bed“ and small room, because you just want to visit the parks, than it’s perfect. Very good value, good choice of food in the hotel lobby. Pool area is ok, but not more.

We are frequent Universal visitors and we loved this hotel!! Bars, food, pool, and room were awesome!! I traveled with 5 kids ages 15-18 and our visit was so great!! Highly recommend. Bryan at Barventure was top notch

Very nice place , food was good, coffee sucked haha , staff was awesome, very clean, pool is nice but hot. Bus ride to park was great. Room was big and clean. The roof top bar was awesome. The food court was nice. we had an Asian noodle bowl that was awesome! We will be back for sure

Great hotel with a good location and facilities. Staff were very helpful. I would not advise staying near the top floor as the Bistro area is loud and will keep you awake until 1am at weekends. The free bus service and water taxi to the city walk was very good and there was always one available when we needed it. Early access to the parks was an added bonus, we also went to the horror night at universal but I would advise fast passes for this as we would have been waiting 1+ hours to access each walkthrough.

Clean and modern hotel With really good and helpful team members. Perfect room and amenities. Would stay again. Very easy to get to the parks via bus or walkway, especially volcano bay! we loved it here!

Everything about the hotel Aventura is so good. Food, drink, pool, rooms, staff, housekeeping, cleanliness, couldn’t fault any of it. Easy access to the parks by bus or water taxi at the hotel next door. Would definitely stay again, thank you so much Aventura for a fantastic stay, it made our holiday so special.

Aventura is a great value hotel with all the necessary facilities and benefits to the theme parks. You get to take bus that stops around citywalk area, or u can take a 5 mins walk to sapphire falls resort and take the water taxi there. For me, going to the theme park i would choose to take water taxi and when back, i would take the bus. We get to enjoy early admission to the theme parks as well. They even had self service laundry/dryer at level 4, 8 and 12 which was great! The rooms were clean, quiet and comfy. Starbucks is at ground floor too.. Truely enjoyed my stay there. Highly recommend!

Great hotel, the room was clean and fresh, the staff were helpful and friendly, could not fault our 16 night stay. Will definitely be staying again. There weren't many children at the hotel and it's poetically heated more for couples or families with older children

Dentro del complejo Universal Orlando, este hotel bastante nuevo tiene aspectos buenos y otros no tanto. Quizás sea más para millennials o centennials que para huéspedes de mayor edad. Intenta ser algo lujoso, pero no tiene ni un solo restaurante, solamente una suerte de patio de comidas. Sí, un hermoso rooftop en la terraza, ideal para disfrutar de un buen trago al atardecer. Las habitaciones son completas y todo se maneja desde una tablet. No hay room service. Tampoco botones para ayudar con el manejo de equipaje. En general, muy poco personal. A mi criterio, se queda a mitad de camino.

Cuartos amplios y con limpieza diaria excelente opción para disfrutar de los espacios y las entradas temprano. Comunicado al volcano bay por si gustas una exceltente aventura familiar. Es bueno en costo y calidad

Este hotel tiene un estilo moderno y tecnología en la habitación que habilitan una gran experiencia. Una de las gran ventajas de adquirir estadía y acceso a los parques en el mismo paquete es el ingreso mas temprano a los parques, las facilidades de transporte a través de buses o water taxi. Siempre utilizamos el water taxi ya que el chequeo de seguridad es mas rápido que por el acceso de los buses que esta mas congestionado. Para tomar el water taxi, simplemente se pasa caminando a Sapphire Falls, una caminata de menos de 5 minutos, igualmente para acceder a Volcano Bay se puede hacer caminando. Adicionalmente tener la app de Universal facilita ordenar comida en los parques o City Walk sin tener que hacer filas, ver los tiempos de espera en las atracciones, pagar con codigo QR sin tener que llevar la tarjeta de crédito. Un hotel excelente para vivir una gran experiencia en los parques de Universal.

maravilloso hotel y esta cerca del los parques. Los empleados muy amables. la limpieza excelente. un hotel muy tranquilo para ir con tus ninos. Puedes ir caminando a volcano bay. tiene transportacion para los parques.

We visited Universal Orlando for the first time March 31-April 2 2022 and stayed at Aventura. We loved this hotel. We had 4 adults and 4 kids ages 15, 13, 10 and 4 and we had 2 rooms. It was so close to Volcano Bay. The water taxi at the hotel across the street was so convenient, relaxing and made security a breeze to get through. The food at the hotel had good variety and was reasonably priced. The maid service we had was amazing. She even folded my kids blankets differently each day. Amenities were great and I took home my small shampoo bottles, unlike Disney that doesn't do that anymore. The robots were fun and the room tablets were so useful. We would definitely stay again. **we also stayed on Disney property during this trip and would 100% stay at Universal again before staying at Disney a second time.

This was our first time at Aventura and we loved it. We got a room with the view of the park. It was so surreal. The rooms were pretty large. We had a queen bed which was perfect for us. Hotel was very modern and clean. There are multiple elevators so you never had to wait. There is a Starbucks in the lobby which was great!! There was also a great choice of foods to pick from. The pool area was also nice. We tried transportation via the bus and the boat from sapphire falls and prefer the boat. It's much quicker and less walking. Bus took 10 min then you had to walk through city walk. Boat took 5 min and you are closer to the entrance of universal. I would def go back.

Staff was very friendly and helpful 24/7. You could text requests and they respond right away. Rooms were very clean and spacious. The rooftop bar/restaurant is too notch and the scenery is breathtaking day and night. Pool and Hot tub were very relaxing

Not our first trip to Universal/Disney World however, each time is better than the last. There are usually 11 of us when vacationing, but this time there was only 7, leaving 4 behind for school, work & other obligations. We stayed at Universal's Adventura Hotel and had a blast! Park transportation & water trolley is a life-saver. We only moved our vehicle 1 time during our 5 day stay. This hotel has a Starbucks located in the lobby and it stayed busy, no matter the time of day. There are other food options in the Urban Pantry along with a roof-top bar and a pool-side bar. Lots to choose from. My only wish is that there was a microwave in the rooms to accommodate the small fridge. Otherwise, this is an affordable hotel located on Universal property surrounded by other Universal hotels and conveniently located to Universal parks.

The hotel is OK for kids, I suppose. I came for a conference. The room smelled disgusting. No amenities for adults. Overall, it's no better than a cheap Best Western room in Baltimore. Never, ever again.

Brand new hotel, very clean, close to parks. Our family had a great experience and would stay again. The food was decent and the shuttle was clean and easy to take back and forth from the parks. Would def stay again on our next trip!

It is an amazing hotel, nice, quiet, clean and not over crowded. The room are a bit small to our taste but it was quiet and clean although we can hear neighbors toilet flushing. All the team members are very professional, friendly and courteous compare Disney team members. The hotel is closed to all of the Universal Theme Park and shuttle bus are running smoothly. Even it is advertised as walking distance but we do not suggest to do so since you will be doing a lot of walking during the park visit. The free Wifi is only up to5 devices unless you pay for premium and it is the only downside for me. Overall, we are satisfied with the stay and will stay there in the future since we visit Orlando once a year.

Bistro 17 has the best service I’ve ever experienced. Very clean establishment. Everyone at the hotel was nice and accommodating. Pool area was awesome. Everything was convenient and easy which is the way it should be on vacation.

Loved just about everything with my stay. Requested more towels on the iPad and received them as expected. Requested it before leaving for the park so not sure how long it took but it was nice to see when arriving back 'home'. IPad was wonderful in general. Felt futuristic to control lights and thermostat from it, could access lots of info as well. Shuttles to the park were wonderful. Never had to wait more than 10 minutes to or from the park. And having a scheduled time for the superstar shuttle was nice instead of guessing and waiting when it would come. Only problems I really have a nitpicks. The tvs didn't have access (or easy access from what I could see) to a spare hdmi port. Would've been a little nice to hook up my Nintendo switch or my laptop with something I couldn't cast to the chromecast. Wasn't huge but I'm sure some family's kids would like to play Mario, even on vacation. Secondly, ordering breakfast and/or Starbucks on the iPad would be lovely. We were never in any rush during our stay but I'm sure some families would be if they have limited time at the parks. Ordering mom and dads coffee or a breakfast before they hit the road on the iPad would speed things up for them to hit the road as soon as possible. And lastly, checking out from the iPad. I went through the quick process of checking out from it twice and it didn't seem like it did anything. The it was just a confirmation box with no real indication that I did check out. The home screen wasn't any different, it wasn't very confirming to me. I checked out at the lobby just to be safe, I didn't want to mess anything up.but overall a wonderful experience. Really enjoyed my time would definitely recommend to friends and family and would definitely see myself staying again in the future.

First and last time staying here. For some unknown reason, there is absolutely no cell phone service when at the hotel. To make matters worse, the Wi-Fi doesn’t work. There is only one network called “Lowes” and it literally doesn’t work. We tried calling on the room phone for help and after we were transferred to the internet support team and gave all our information, they hung up on us. So, you’re completely cutoff from the outside world when staying here. The hotel does not put any bottles of water in your room - zero! There is no body wash or lotion provided - I’ve never seen that before, including at much cheaper hotels. There is no exhaust fan in the bathroom, and the shower has plastic walls with a cheap shower curtain that doesn’t even reach the floor, so each time you shower, the floor gets drenched. The parking garage is a mess too as the entry and exit machines don’t work properly…everyone struggles with them, causing a wait to get out as there is only one lane to enter and one to exit. We are staying here right now and leaving tomorrow and will definitely not return.

I've done a lot of travelling throughout the USA. Mostly business. But I mean, a lot. And I can't tell you how amazing this whole property was!!! It was clean, it was updated, the rooms were large, the bathroom area large. The staff was kind, informative and friendly. They had a lot of restaurant options PLUS you were either a bus ride or a riverboat ride away from City Walk which had a done of restaurants and fun places to spend the evening. The hotel's pool was also very spacious and nice. They were probably heating it -- being from Michigan, they could have saved money on the heat!!! These places were so close! Universal’s Volcano Bay 5 min walk Universal’s Islands of Adventure 14 min walk Universal Studios Florida 15 min walk Orlando, FL (MCO-Orlando Intl.) 20 min drive So take my word for it -- book your stay here and enjoy your time. If you go there on business -- take the family!!!! They'll love you for it!!!

This is a very nice hotel. We have previously stayed at Universal Orlando but this is the best hotel to date. The lobby was very nice, check in was very smooth. We had a great room on the 20th floor with a nice very. The room was very clean. The bed was super comfortable. We used the bus to the parks and had very little wait time. In addition you are very close to Sapphire Falls so we took advantage of of eating there a few nights. We also checked out the rooftop bar one night. Very nice! I would definitely stay here again!

I rarely leave reviews but rely on them heavily in making decisions - especially for hotels. Our family booked Adventura for our first Universal trip. The hotel was super clean, quiet and closely located to the park. Shuttles ran consistently, the employees were excellent, the pool was large and warm (a must for me) and they had a really great rooftop bar/restaurant. Best of all, a stay at Adventura allowed early access to Harry Potter Wizarding world which was worth a 6 am wake up call and 6:45 am shuttle bus ride. We were able to get on our favorite rides with less of a crowd. I highly recommend Adventura!

Aventura hotel was an excellent hotel with all the amenities location and good service! It was a great experience staying in this hotel. Aventura hotel has clean and quiet place to stay with the family. Highly recommended!

We stayed at the Aventura for one night. The room was clean, getting our park tickets in the morning was easy and transportation to the Islands of Adventure was breeze. Overall the hotel was great and we would stay there again.

Being two adults seeking relaxation and thrill rides, the Aventura was the ideal hotel! With three bars, smart hotel rooms run on tablets, vegan friendly dining, and a pool that was luxurious it was the perfect way to unwind. Universal is an incredible park that is wonderful for families but if you don't have kids and are adult friends, a couple, parent / adult child adventures - the aventura is the place for you! Starbucks opens early and the modern design makes it upper class and cozy! Can not wait to return!

Very clean, very convenient on-site hotel at the Universal Orlando resort. I’ve stayed at most hotels on property and this is tied for our favorite. Calm atmosphere compared to other resorts (good for adults and older kids), quiet rooms, fun use of technology with an iPad to control the room. Food options are somewhat limited but excellent quality, we especially loved the wok station. Will definitely be our go to resort for future trips!

Loved this hotel! First I love how all Universal Resorts communicate by text! Always easy to get in touch with someone, no matter your need! Second, Aventura has Relay!! Relay is a robot that will deliver some items to your room! I did not know about this prior to arriving! Third, if you leave anything behind (unfortunately I did 😩) they are so helpful! They do not disappoint! As an added plus, the technology used in the room was pretty awesome!

It was her 13th birthday trip and we had a wonderful time. The room was very nice and clean. We definitely enjoyed the free transportation between the hotel and the theme parks. Overly we would absolutely stay here again on our next trip to Universal Studios.

My family and I just returned from a four night stay at Universal Studios Adventura Hotel. The hotel is in a great location as it is beautiful walk to the parks along the river, a wonderful way the relax after a busy day at the parks. We can’t say enough about the staff at the hotel, they were personable and professional. The hotel is clean and high tech which was great but the staff were exceptional, everyone made us feel welcome. From the time we checked till the time we checked out staff were helpful, fun and honestly made us feel special. The parks and City Walk were clean, maintained and well staffed. We found both patrons and workers in good spirits and kind. We would highly recommend Universal Studios and staying at the Adventura!

We have gone to the Rosen 9000 every year since 2011, including 2020 but we had to cut our visit short when the pandamic hit. We are hoping to go back in 2022...I can never understand why some ppl complain about this hotel. We have always gotten excellent service the staff are friendly and helpful and the rooms are amazingly clean. In fact the person who cleans the rooms has another person who comes around and checks them to make sure they are done up to standards. There are alot of nice restaurants near by as well as very good entertainment, great shopping and alot of things to do. And yes there are lineups, for checkin, we found that if you come before 4pm or after 8 or 9 they are not so long. This is what our group saw while we were surveying the lobby :) Which was our meeting place in the evenings while we waited for everyone before going into the Zebra for a few drinks and some great karoke.

Where do I even begin with this? When I booked the room their website said that check-in wasn't until 4 PM, which is kind of late in the day. I had tickets for that night to go to Universal's Halloween Horror Nights with early entry, so I had to be there by the event start which meant getting into the hotel by 3 PM. When I called the hotel, I was told I "might" be able to check in early, space permitting, but with a $30 early check in fee added on. Wait. What? When I got there there was only a few people in line so I thought I'd ask about early check-in. Sure, no problem. OK, then. So I check in, and go to the room. Only the magnet key card doesn't want to work on the first try, or second. Finally on the third try in I go. Leave and enjoy my time at Universal and come back at 11 pm only to find NO, as in ZERO, parking spaces in the lot. The security guard at the gate told me to keep going around until I found one. Seriously? The lot is one way traffic, so I had to keep driving around the hotel until I eventually found one at the opposite end of the property from where my room was. I went to the front desk to ask about this and I see this HUGE line of people trying to check in and heard someone there complaining about what I just went through with parking and another at the front saying they have been in line for over an hour waiting to check in with 8 windows and three people working. Now at this point I'm hungry and thirsty, so I thought I'd check out the store on property. Bad idea. Prices are higher than a 7-11 here with a small Lunchable costing $5.99, the same ones I can get at Walmart for $1 each. A bottle of soda was $4. So I left, wnet across the street to a CVS drugstore and paid half this. Next day - Same kind of story with parking coming back to the hotel and the line at check-in when I walked by. Now the room was fine. The bed was good, the room clean, amenities at the property were even good. But my God, the parking situation here and the check-in process / time are definitely enough to make you leave to find another hotel, and they seriously need to get this figured out and quick. Until they do, I can't rate this hotel any higher than what I did.

Check in was a complete nightmare. We get inside and see the checkout line is wrapped around, down the hallway, and out the back door. Great. Takes over an hour to finally get up to check in (not exaggerating) and are “reservation hasn’t gone through yet” what? I’ve never had this happen before. Then I see there’s a line for people like us where they can’t find reservations and we have to go stand with them to start over again. I call to my hotel booking site to cancel, he calls the hotel and they won’t allow it because MAGICALLY they have my reservation. I’m upset. My partner is online looking for a new hotel just due to the principal. I say no we’ll stay let’s have a positive attitude. That’s where the 2 stars vs 1 comes. Although we didn’t get in our room for over 2 hours now at this point and the staff could really care less, the room was actually clean. The pools-although it’s getting dark at this point- were very nice. Parking is a huge issue I read in other reviews but we just parked early enough and walked everywhere-hotels in a great location. For me due to the check in I scored low and would never stay. For you, if you have no problems at check in you will more than likely enjoy your stay. I don’t know why they don’t have online check in or self serve kiosks like Vegas. It was CRAZY

Avoid this place at all cost. Registration queue was over an hour. Left for a group dinner meet and discovered an even longer queue. It's 2021, no reason not to have automated check-in / digital room keys like at Hampton hotels. Immediately cancelled and found a hotel 15 mins away.

We tried checking in around 4:30…the line to check in was at least an hour long. We went and did our plans, thinking if we came back at 2 am it would be better. No, still waited an hour to just check in. So we only ended up having the room for 8 hours…we would have better off just driving the hour back home. And after all that, it was impossible to find a parking spot. Not worth the hassle to save a few bucks.

We have to wait a lot just to check in, we came at 5pm and the lines where so long and didn’t move, we left to the parks and came again at 2am and lines where still long! It was horrible the check in people is so slow!! I would have prefere paying a little more than staying here… not ever again. Must say worst hotel I have ever stayed

Arrived on-site checked in and left, arrived back approximately 10:50 to shower and go to bed and could not relax or rest due to noise from the neighbors and smoking weed in front of the door. Road noise was ridiculous and when complained Ivonne as well as mgmt stated we would be charged for the night that we should of checked out immediately! We would have had we been there and aware of the noise letter! I would NEVER BOOK THERE AGAIN ROOM 1515 sucked along with the staff!!!! Angry patron!!!

We woke up to worms on the floor, walls, on the bed and in the bathroom. The floor by the front door was soaking wet and when we called the front desk all my husband got was attitude and the manager wasn’t much better. Instead of making a bad situation better, he made it worse blaming Expedia. We were not given our money back or put at ease in any way. I’ve worked in the hotel and restaurant business all my life and never ever have I witnessed how today was handled. Today is my 45th birthday and I couldn’t be more upset …. The customer service and cleanliness is far from an 8.3. Natalie & Chuck Sharpe 10/16/2021 room 2160E

The hotel was $56 a night and worse than a motel 6. The restaurants, bars were all closed. If you bought something in the market you had to take it to the front reception to have it rang up. So it was rather annoying when no one was available to ring you up.

La habitación huele demasiado a humedad, me pareció muy desagradable ver frente a las puertas de los cuartos las toallas sucias botadas en el piso en plena pandemia, piden un deposito de dinero al ingresar pero no responden cuando hacen la devolución del mismo.

Estuve por un par de noches en el hotel. Si vas solo a llegar a dormir puede que el hotel te convenga, pero si es para estar usando las habitaciones no tanto. La limpieza es regular, incluso la primera noche fumigamos las sábanas en Lysol. El olor a Marihuana está presente en todo el hotel.

Viaje con mi hermana, nos gustó el hotel por su ubicación en el Intl Drive cerca del Premium Outlet, Walmart super center y muchos otros locales interesantes. Las habitaciones son amplias, el aire acondicionado funciona bien, tv por cable, mesa de planchar y plancha, al igual que secador de pelo. Lo único que no nos gustó era que en ocasiones el ascensor olía mucho a cigarrillo y que la habitación tenía alfombra. Pero por todo lo demás es muy recomendable. Tiene estacionamiento gratis. El desayuno no lo probamos pues preferimos desayunar fuera.

Bad hotel, there are much better ones at the same price, not clean, old, AC didn’t work well, in the middle of the night the alarm was on 4 times, we didn’t sleep at all, not recommend , staff are ok but not more than that

Stayed here for my yearly week long visit to Orlando! Had a great stay! I always try and stay on Rosen properties when I visit! I have not had a single bad experience with them! Check in and check out was great! Fantastic staff! Room felt clean and safe! I will be back!

Review a bit late but better late than never :) I thought I had left my 2nd review but I can’t see it so here it goes The first I want to is give praise to the helpful staff who work at the hotel from the front desk being quick and efficient on the first day as After a long flight I just want to get in my room to relax. To the ticket desk as they were always helpful, when it comes to booking tickets/travel or just help in general of the area. Then there is the dining servers always have a smile of their face and very friendly. Never had a moment of bad service while dining there. And last but not least is the cleaners there everyday to clean and the room amazing each time. Even the lazy days we had but didn’t leave the “Do not disturb” sign on the door they were always happy to just swap the towels for that day. The hotel is in a great spot on International Drive where a lot of great restaurants, local shops and if you do have a lazy day in the hotel you have a 24 hour convenience store in the hotel as well as a gift shop where again the staff are always helpful. There are 3 pools to hop in that are always clean and have a lot of towels by the side of the pools. My only downer I have at the moment is that I couldn’t go back this year. Hopefully I get the see the hotel next year as I’ve rebooked.

If we had stayed at this hotel under better circumstances, the review might have a better rating. We booked at room at Clarion Inn Lake Buena Vista on Palm Parkway close to Disney Springs. I'm the type of person that I read reviews on hotels before I book there to make sure it is clean and safe. We picked the Clarion because it had good reviews, a good price and the location we were looking for. After a long, very hot day at Magic Kingdom we headed to the hotel. We pulled up to a security gate and noticed the hotel looked oddly dark. It didn't click why until right away, we told the security guard that we had a reservation. She didn't seem surprised that we were there, she just told us the hotel is closed and that we were at the wrong place. She handed us a small flier and let us know we were actually booked at the Rosen Inn, International Drive. We were very confused since we booked a room at Clarion Inn Lake Buena Vista. Even our email confirmation said it was for Clarion Inn Lake Buena Vista. Not having much choice, we headed to the Rosen Inn. When we got to the front desk we told them our name and sure enough we had a reservation at a hotel we knew nothing about. I will say, it looked fine, so I wasn't too concerned. We let the lady that was checking us in know what had happened. Again she didn't seem surprised and really wasn't apologetic to the situation we had been put in. She just proceeded to ask for a credit card that she could put a $100 hold on for incidentals. While we were checking in we noticed a man standing at the end of the counter where you have to walk by him once you are ready to go to your room. He is there to stop you from going to your room right away and to direct you to the desk where they sell you tickets and other things. He didn't stop us, probably because he had just seen us get upset with the desk clerk due to the bait and switch we feel had been done to us. Now a review of the actual property. The room was clean and looked updated. Overall the room was quiet, my issue was the noise outside, this hotel is located on a very busy street. I could hear the cars and sirens that went by like they were right outside the window. The hotel also seemed safe, which is one of the two things we always look for. We were only there one night, so I can't say a lot more about the hotel. The pool looked really nice, although we didn't use it. The location is desirable to some, but for us we usually look for one on not such a busy road. When we checked out, we asked for a receipt to show that we do not owe anything. The lady, the same one that checked us in the night before, asked us why we needed a receipt. She seems hesitant to give us one, which seemed odd to us. She did provide us with one though.

I stay there for 3 nights the location is good but my only issue was that for the 3 nights nobody from housekeeping went to do cleaning or to bring towels. I had to called them and they said that they only provide room cleaning on the fourth day of stay that doesn’t make any sense to me and at least they should explained those things to everybody when you check in but overall is convenient in a nice location

First check in ONE person at desk ...on a Saturday evening . It took a hour to check in...get to room reeks of pot...and the people standing out side look like people you might buy weed from (being serious). Also the room is HOT...non stop helicopters behind room...ever the Serlargo is better than this (not often you can say that!) Very disappointed...one person at desk I know it’s a pandemic but customer service is not a priority here!

So this is my second time at this resort and was again a great holiday. Stay in March just before the virus hit. The room was a perfect size and has everything you need, maybe tho I would prefer a small table and chairs to sit and have food at then the armchair but you have loads of space to eat around the pool and beside the shop so again not a major deal. You have a fridge, microwave and coffee machine, if you are a tea drinker like me you can just heat up he water and use that. The room was always cleaned and tidied everyday, they do come early so if you like a sleep in don't forget to put the 'Do not disturb' sigh out the night before. We stay in block B facing the pool, I emailed the hotel before I travel to ask for this block beside it was closed to reception, pool, restaurant , and they were more they helpful to help. The pool is great for the kids always loads of sunbeds nobody is allowed down to early to reserve beds because the gates do be lock . Towels are provided with is great because not everyone brings towels. There is a small amusement area for the kids all machines are $1 so bring change. Only a handful of machines so don't worry might not cost you too much for the kids. The laundry room was in this block also so is was great to get a few bits done while the kids are in the pool, by you own washing powder in Walgreens across the road, there is a machine there to buy washing powder but its $3 for one load and if you need to done my there that it can add up, can get busy sometimes so get there early in the day The hotel was has free transfer to parks with save my a ton of money, just make sure you book the night before ! At night the bar is quite and nice just for when you come back from the parks and just want a quick meal and a few drinks at the bar, before you head to bed, they have a happy hour so drinks do be quite cheap. So this hotel is perfect for families and couples of all ages there is things to do for everyone around. I booking this hotel again for next year hopefully when the virus calms down.

Went to Rosen for our First time & omg what an awful experience ,when we got our room & it was hot,smelly & the refrigerator wasnt working neither,we had to wait over 45 mins - 1 hour till they switched us to another room & it gets worse, the next day, my fiance coming from the parking lot from the store,walking to our room down the hall and a big brown dog came out of room #1110 ran out- tried to bite my fiance jumped on her just about a few feet to our door ,she was trying to open our room door- screamingg gggg ,fell to the floor right to the entrance of our room to her knees ,I got up from the bed- yelled & the dog took off running and I saw the owner ( lady ) from the pool running- grabbing her dog by the back of the neck carrying it to her room #1110 - then she was telling me it's a puppy when the dog looks like a full grown adult dog & still barking aggressively in her room ,I yelled to her your dog went after and tried to bite my fiance, she's crying,shaking and in shock ,I had to call the front desk till security showed up Wrote up a report, no managers,gms or front office came and till today we haven't gotten a call an apology or anything from Rosen , to see if my fiance is well or ok ,we will never ever go back to Rosen again & make sure we let our family and friends know what we experienced at Rosen,it was horrible 👎

Me encanto todo. Super recomendado. Excelente servicio. Volveré pronto! Fui con mi familia y todos la pasamos super bien. Incluyendo mi bebé, papá y yo pudimos disfrutar de todas las amenidades sin preocupaciones. También cuentan con child swap para que ambos padres se puedan montar en las machinas lo que es conveniente para aquel que quiera venir con bebes

El hotel se encuentra muy descuidado en sus aspectos técnicos, en la habitación habían varias cosas que estaban en mal estado como por ejemplo muebles con su sistema de cinta corredera en mal estada con las taps desencajadas lo cual lo hacia peligroso para niños pequeños, el sensor de incendios de la habitación estaba colgando, en el baño la tina tenia un ruido muy fuerte como de crujidos en el piso y ademas tenia algunos embellecedores en mal estado de los tomadores para personas con discapacidad, hicimos el reclamo correspondiente en recepción pero las soluciones fueron enviar a alguien a reparar o cambio de habitación, ambas situaciones generaban un estrés por lo que decidimos continuar en la habitación ya que teníamos muchas maletas y andábamos con una persona con movilidad reducida. También mencionar que las camas son muy incómodas. Lo que si destaco es la piscinas que es muy grande y con agua temperada.

La experiencia fue excelente.. el único detalle es que nos quedamos en la torre de beachside y para ir al lobby ahí que caminar bastante.. pero todo lo demás encantada en servicio, la limpieza, la comida lo mejor de ella te la preparan al momento… en fin todo súper excelente!!

En nuestra visita a Orlando nos quedamos en varios hoteles y este fue nuestro favorito. La decoración, la piscina, la vista, la habitación con máquina de café y todo. El area para comer donde hay microondas, platos, etc y el restaurant que vende comida un poco más a lo que estamos acostumbrados los latinos, frijoles, carne, pollo al horno hasta plátanos. La primera noche al llegar recién de viaje, era tarde y no teníamos agua, el recepcionista amablemente, nos regaló varias botellas de agua pequeña. De verdad le agradezco mucho ese gesto
