Excelente ubicación para poder ir a las atracciones de Universal, entrega beneficio para los parques, cuenta con zona amplia de estacionamientos, las instalaciones están bien mantenidas a pesar de tener varios años. La atención de la gente es buena, cuenta con amplia piscina. El check in y check out son muy fáciles de realizar.

Muy buena experiencia desde el recibimiento y trato en la mesa de servicio hasta el personal de mantenimiento. Habitaciones limpias y bien arregladas, modernas y con buen olor. Las facilidades están en buen estado. En él área de compra de alimentos todo es parecido a los parques ya que tienes diferentes opciones de alimentos en el mismo lugar. Área de piscina limpia recogida y con seguridad. Área de estacionamiento amplía y habitaciones accesibles. Definitivamente es recomendable este lugar.

💯 Recomendado , desde el check in, cuartos, áreas recreativas, limpieza, transporte, personal todo muy bien organizado, es un lugar seguro y muy bueno para celebridades y pasar un tiempo hermoso en familia.

Compramos un paquete promocional en la pg de universal. Después de calcular todo esta fue nuestra mejor opción teniendo en cuenta que no íbamos a Disney. La opción del transporte nos ahorró lo de la renta del carro y los parqueaderos. A lo demás nos movilizamos en uber, outlets, ross, seaword, etc, Teniendo en cuenta esto nos fue muy rentable (en los deals de universal). El hotel tiene cosas para hacer internas por lo que disfrutar unos días en él es una buena opción. Falta variedad en las comidas.

No puedo entender que este hotel tenga una calificación decente. Hemos pasado allí dos noches y la experiencia ha sido de las peores que he tenido en un hotel. Y no es precisamente barato. Era una habitación para 6 personas, en la planta baja. La habitación estaba tremendamente sucia, asquerosa. Al llegar, la puerta y el pasillo tenían una salpicadura oscura que siguió allí cuando nos fuimos. La zona de la bañera, con un olor raro, descubrimos que tenía moho (mucho) en una de las esquinas de la pared. La cortina de la ducha se estaba deshaciendo. En la moqueta encontramos semillas de manzana al llegar. Sábanas de una de las camas, con agujeros. La ducha suelta. Lo más desagradable fue encontrar un trozo de caca pegado en el marco de la puerta del water. Polvo visible en todas partes... Vomitivo. Pedimos que repasaran la limpieza y, pese a decirnos que lo harían, mandaron a una persona que rascó el moho sin siquiera mojar la ballesta (que, por cierto, se dejó allí en el lavabo y tuve que tirar a la basura). Una vergüenza y, en época de COVID, es especialmente grave esta falta de higiene. Por cierto, 600 € por dos noches. Una auténtica estafa.

Hermoso pasanos en familia resibiendo El ano nuevo.todo fue sensational. Lo unico negativo Los guess no usan mascara. Son muy pocos los que acatan Las ordenes del hotel. Despues de eso le doy 5. Strellas

La cercanía a Volcano Bay y la decoración retro lo hace un lugar hermoso para descansar y relajarse sin embargo depende de la torre en que se encuentre la habitación puede resultar un largo camino desde el lobby. La facilidad para llegar a los parques de Universal lo hace una muy buena opción para quedarse, es un hotel diferente muy pintoresco en especial para adolescentes y adultos

El hotel es bastante grande, luego encontrarás filas para comer. Los menús no cambian, será lo mismo todos los días. Las porciones varían depende de quien las sirva... podrá ser mucho un día y poco otro día. Las comidas son bastante caras.

Es una buena opción si eres fan de los parques de Universal por la posibilidad de entrar una hora antes a uno de los parques (Island of Adventure). Las habitaciones no incluyen el desayuno en la tarifa y es algo que tienes que presupuestar aparte. La piscina y las áreas comunes son muy buenas y el personal es muy atento. Tal vez esperaba alguna experiencia en el hotel con los personajes de Universal y algo así pero no pasó.

Nos encantó la habitación. El hotel es tipico resort con mucha gente, pero contabamos con eso. Al estar en un hotel de Universal teniamos acceso temprano a los parques y transporte en bus. Comas comodas, sabanas de calidad y toallas en abundancia. No te hacen la habitación a diario, sólo cambian sábanas. Tampoco estabamos en la habitacion mas que para dormir y desayunar, así que no se ensuciaba. No esperes las medidas COVID de europa u otros paises... en las zonas comunes (aire libre o cerrada) no hace falta uso mascarilla y no se guarda dustancia de seguridad, ni otros huespedes ni los empleados del hotel, incluidos los de los restaurantes que no llevan la mascarilla homologada colocada correctamente sobre nariz y boca.

Realmente un muy buen hotel con excelentes instalaciones e ideal para ir en familia. La family room muy espaciosa y cómoda, realmente recomendado. No pudimos aprovechar al máximo todas las instalaciones ni piscinas por tiempo, pero realmente hay un montón de alternativas y todas se veían incríbles. Nos encantó y lo recomendamos a ciegas

El hotel necesita ser remodelado, las habitaciones están un poco viajas, para el monto que se paga por ellas… la única ventaja que tiene es que puedes entrar a los parques antes de que se abra al público en general, pero está con todo para las condiciones del hotel.

En general es un sitio Maravillo para tus vacaciones recomendado buen servicio es serca de los parques tienen transporte hacia los parques, excelente limpieza Restaurantes y diversiones dentro el resort.

Exelente experiencia con mi familia que sobrepaso las expectativas de nuestras vacaciones la pasamos super bien ,cada experiencia fue expectacular y muy relajante muy buen servicio y las instalaciones de lo mejor

Si bien es cierto los hoteles en Orlando son basicamente para descansar lñuego de un dia ajetreado por los parques, este hotel, ambientado en los años 50, tiene lo necesario para que lo cumplas. Tiene unas excelentes piscinas, comida variada, Starbucks, bowling y demas servicios, tienen lavanderias en los pisos 3 y 6 de cada edificio, te cuestan 3 dolares la lavadora y 3 dolares la secadora, tienes maquina para que compres tu detergente. Te sugiero tambien tengas monedas aunque puedes pagar con tarjeta. Las habitaciones muy comodas , la que reserve mo tiene microondas, se que otras tienen pero cuentan mas. Te dan servicio de buses para los parques de Universal pero lo mejor es que a Vulcano Bay puedes ir a pie, ya que colinda con el hotel!!

La pasamos super bien. Camion del hotel a universal y de regreso cada 5min. Las habitaciones super limpias, amenidades sencillas pero en abundancia, café, etc. Entrada directa al Volcáno Bay. Los estacionamientos suficientes. El restaurante en precio de Orlando. Definitivamente regresaremos.

We stayed in a deluxe queen room on the 4th floor for a week in February 2022. We arrived at 11am, knowing we may not be able to get to our rooms until check-in time at 3pm. The staff were really friendly and helpful, and we arranged to have our luggage stored until we could get into our room. We decided to get coffee and go off to the parks for the day, but by the time we had ordered our coffee we got a text to say the room was ready! Awesome! The room was clean, we liked the layout. The view of the pool was nice and we loved the iPad controls and the huge shower. The whole week we were impressed with the daily cleaning and provision of new towels. The bed was comfy and there was a big safe for laptops etc. To get to the parks we just walked two minutes across the road to Sapphire Falls and caught the boat every time which was so convenient, we never used the shuttle bus! It was a little loud in our room sometimes but it was never too late or kept us awake - most of the time we noticed it was the pool area or louder neighbours - the walls are a bit thin! We really liked the food court as it was convenient for us to order pizza after a long day at the porks, or grab a quick lunch before an afternoon out - however, most of the time we had fun finding restaurants at City Walk and around Orlando - which is one of our favourite things to do on vacation. Bar 17 was a blast and the food was amazing there, we loved the views and watching the Disney fireworks in the distance! We also made use of the guest laundry which was a great amenity! Two things that need to be addressed was the coffee machine in the room - absolutely undrinkable! I would pay a little more to have the convenience of a Nespresso machine in the room so I don't have to go down to the lobby first thing and buy coffee. Maybe Lowes could provide a couple of pods per day and give an option to buy more pods if we want them. The other thing was that the in-room fridge wasn't very cold. Otherwise we had a great stay and we would definitely book again.

Puntos a favor: 1. Excelente ubicación a los parques de Universal. 2. Transporte incluido cada 30 minutos para recorrer el complejo y que te lleve al citywalk. 3. Está a tan solo dos minutos de Volcano Bay. Excelente!! 4. Las vistas desde la habitación, buenas. 5. Puedes hacer uso de las instalaciones de otros hoteles cercanos. 6. La tecnología utilizada en la habitación, para el control de la misma a través de un Ipad. 7. Facilidad de ingreso y salida con el check-in mobil y el check-out express. 8. Ofrece entrada 1 hora antes a Volcano Bay En contra o por mejorar 1. A 15-20 minutos de los parques de Disney (Depende de tu interés de viaje) 2. No cuenta con Desayuno incluido. 3. La piscina es grande pero de tan solo 1 M de profundidad. Es importante recalcar que en el primer piso cuenta con tienda oficial de Universal, 3 restaurantes y un Starbucks. Puedes encontrar platos desde los USD$12 con una buena porción. Además, tiene una oficina de AVIS para reserva de vehículos. Recomendado!!

Me encanto ya quiero regresar 🥰 el hotel súper moderno las habitaciones muy cómodas … la vista espectaculares… todo fue muy bueno solo fue una noche pero ya voy a reservar para regresar …. El desayuno muy bueno

Uno de los mejores hoteles a un precio modico para ir con la familia y amistades el servicio es muy bueno y la fachada de el hotel supera los estándares la vista en las habitaciones excelente y el personal muy amable.

Estuvimos ocho días, fui con mi hijo de 13, una amiga y su hija y fue nuestra mejor decisión, a la hora de escoger hotel. El servicio excelente, es un hotel moderno y tecnológico. Las habitaciones limpias y muy cómodas. Puedes tener el acceso al parque una hora antes de abrir y puedes moverte entre los parques en un solo día, siempre y cuando compres la oferta. La transportación al parque y al aeropuerto fue excelente. Los concesionarios de comida buenos. La terraza en el piso 17 tiene una vista espectacular. Lo escogeria en una próxima ocasión.

Todo excelente, la experiencia fue muy buena, el ingresar antes a los parques es un hit. Excelente ubicación y todo.el.personal muy amable. Lo pasamos super bien en familia. Tiene un parking con costo pero muy confortable.

Las experiencias vividas en el viaje no cumplieron con las expectativas, la atención en el hotel fue mala, no cumplen con normas sanitarias para prevenir el covid, las mesas del restaurante del hotel sucias, no realizaron aseo a nuestras habitaciones durante la estadia (7 dias), en los parques se encontraban muchas aglomeraciones sn distanciamiento social, los restaurantes sucios, pocas opciones de comida.

Geared towards adults. Fair value. Good if looking to avoid huge resorts. Just nothing too special about this place. Nothing stands outs to make me wanna come back or try again. Rooms were a bit tight with odd shape compared to standard rectangular room. But you could do a lot worse. Pay for location but wonder if other options nearby off property or other Universal Resorts would be better I wouldn't bother recommending or return. I'd prefer to try something else upon next return. Though not a bad experience, nothing exceptional or memorable either. Stayed for holidays end of Dec 2019 and into Jan 2020 past New Years. NYE was loud as expected but rest of stay was peaceful. Pros: Really easy walk to Volcano Bay View of Volcano Bay Universal Shuttle at least 3 times per hour. Short ride to parks. Modern, newer hotel so appears clean and not much wear and tear at the time. Cons: Food service seemed pretty slow and not in hurry despite very few customers. I can't imagine how long one must wait if it was actually busy. Selection and prices were not so great either. Food court was probably most disappointing aspect of hotel. Via hotel can schedule and reserve shuttle service to Sea World area parks from Universal bus lot. Got left at water park and never picked up .

I had the best experience wit savana she was really sweet and everything she made the pizza wit a smile face and it turn out so good. She made me and my man very happy. She was very sweet, and funny..

For us this was a no return stay hotel. We will stick with the three original resorts and Sapphire Falls. This hotel is definitely geared towards young adults. The iPad in the room with cameras was very off-putting to us. We kept it so that there was no way a camera was pointed at us. Everything we watched on the TV paused at almost the same exact time when watching. It was also very sporadic for pausing while watching any of the shows we watched. We did not check with the hotel since this happened on all channels we watched and figured it was their internet speed affecting streaming. The room was on the small side and very played down. Like I said this hotel is geared towards younger people not older more demanding guests. There is no full service dining at this property so you will have to go elsewhere for that. Everything is grab-and-go or quick order. There really was nothing wrong with this hotel other than it is a lower service/amenity hotel with everything designed for younger people. If you are older and used to traveling a certain way, you will completely understand what I mean. A major plus was that the staff was great!!

The hotel was pretty empty at the end of June because of COVID-19. They implement all the safety and health protocols. The room could’ve been a little bit cleaner to reflect that they take this as seriously as they say. The hotel is very conveniently located to quickly access By shuttle Universal Studios and Islands of adventures. It’s a five minute walk to volcano bay. It offers good dining options with a Starbucks and a cafeteria style restaurant called urban pantry. The rooms are very well designed and comfortable. Communication with the staff via text messages from the tablets in the room is fun and efficient.

Except for a frustrating billing issue (the reason the review did not get top marks), we had a great experience, will return, and will recommend to others. Basically, the hotel/reservation site clearly made an error of charging us a no-show for a night when we were not reserved. This was recognized at check-in but not immediately corrected and required follow-up after the stay. While it was corrected in the end, the time and effort spent to make sure it was correct was frustrating and it should not have happened. Just make sure you are diligent in checking your billing statements.

The weather was nice as was the view from the hotel. The front desk employees was pretty nice but SEVERAL OF THE STAFF, pool area, security, ect...was rude and ruined our trip . Boys couldn't even play Marco Polo , throw a beach ball or race in the pool and no one else was even in the pool. The were HATEFUL. Security targeted my little brother due to the way he dressed, treated him as if he didn't belong or as if he was an outcast. To the point they stopped him and held the elevator so he couldn't come up to our room and asked him several unprofessional questions, it was terrible and management didn't do squat to make it right.

Excellent location. Walkway to Volcano Bay, bus to parks and Citywalk. Also possible to walk to neighboring resorts Cabana Bay (via Volcano Bay walkway is best) and down sidewalk to Sapphire Falls. Both of those resorts offer additional entertainment and restaurant options. Small rooms, best for adults and teens. Design of hotel is great for mature adults or those with difficulty walking long distances since every room is only a short walk to elevators. Parking fee is a little steep, about $20, even if you are a passholder.

My husband and I first stayed at this resort in September 2019 and then again in November for our Anniversary and February for a casual visit. Each time we have enjoyed our stay. I was impressed by the staffs friendly demeanor and the resorts amenities. The roof top bar is a great place to hang out. I really like the food court area, especially the design your own bowl for breakfast. I highly recommend this resort for couples and singles.

The one thing this hotel has going for it is the excellent walking distance to Volcano Bay, which is literally a 5 minute walk. Other than that, I couldn’t find one other reason to stay here. The entire hotel is completely sterile. There is absolutely no theming anywhere. The rooms are so minimalist and boring. The pool is completely uninviting. I have stayed at the Endless Summer Resort (which is cheaper) and thought it was much better. Only stay here if you want a super quick walk to Volcano Bay and you don’t mind sterile everywhere.

Had plans as far back as March but due to pandemic the reservations kept getting canceled. Finally after each month of rebooking and getting canceled again, the plans for June 3rd weekend paned out. Took the entire family up to Aventura again this time knowing that things would be much different, as expected. Soon as we walked in we were greeted with temperature checks and asked to wear our mask within the public spaces. They had sanitizer stations throughout the lobby and at each entry / exit. The elevators were signs that pointed out only 1 family at a time for safe distancing. The hotel overall was not busy at all, if anything there was only a small percentage of folks staying that weekend. As everywhere we went it was empty, including the parking garage - which is normally packed and can never find a spot in the 1st or 2nd floor. Due to the curfew also while there it limited our capacity to visit city walk during dinner times. It also meant we had less choices on what we can get, as most external places were closing early. So we had to resort to the hotel choices which were actually pretty good. This was only for the first night or two as we later planned accordingly and scheduled dinner based on curfew times. My only remark is with letting those who check in know that the room servicing is not to be expected. Some will not read the FAQ and a simple reminder that if they want towels refreshed that they need to call for new ones to be dropped off. Also, the hallways from the elevator to the room was very stuffy and warm - this is probably due to low amount of folks staying and preserving resources but it was really warm when arriving to and leaving room. Overall the stay with everything going on at the moment was great. At times you feel a bit as though you didn't get everything you should have, but again these days how thing are now are challenging. Glad to be able and take a road trip, spend time with family outside of the home, feel safe and comfortable the same time.

So we have all stayed home.Time to start venturing out. We decided to spend the weekend in Orlando. We were curious to see how hotels are adapting to our new way of living with Covid . We parked our car in the garage. t At the elevator there was hand sanitizer.At the entrance in the lobby an Associate checked our temp with one of the touchless thermometers.We got a wrist band that would let us in and out for the day. Everyday a new temp check and wristband. Masks are required, Check in was easy with proper distancing, Lots of signs.lots of places to sanitize your hands. Hand sanitizers everywhere We felt comfortable.Had drinks and dinner at bar17. It was great,We felt safe and pleased that the Hotel has taken great pains to ensure we stay safe.All staff wore masks and were friendly, helpful and careful Had fun.Did not go to Universal Studios- lots of rain but did notice it was open Will visit again.

The property personnel were above and beyond their duties. All aspects of sanitation were always at hands length. Room service and condiments were top notch. When I would take my mask off in my room immediately there was a smell of mildew. I purchased some Lysol spray at a convience store and sprayed the room vents and the shower drain and sink,then I put a wash cloth over sink and shower drains. This seem to help a little but it was overbearing sometimes. Also I love to heat up leftovers when I get hungry again. No microwave was in room. Also late at night I wanted a cold, room service was closed but I was told that floors 4,8,12 had vending machines. I went to every floor and all machines were sold out. The part that I was worried about is the wife has an immunity problem (breast cancer survivor), so the mildew smell kind of worried me.

Excelente habitación. Muy amplia, moderna, cómoda e impecable. Para los niños fue maravilloso que las luces, televisión, despertador, etc, se controlan desde una Tablet. el sistema de islas tipo fast food para comer muy practicas y buena comida. La piscina de muy buen tamaño y bonita.

Stayed March 20, as theme parks closed Minus Noisy in rear rooms due to freeway Quite poor air quality due to traffic, but this is all across Orlando Rooms a bit dingy Air con noisy and no windows can open Restaurant is cheap but low end buffet fare Can be noisy if your neighbours fancy a party Plus Location good and easy to walk out for eats and drinks Parking secure and close to rooms Bar is friendly 3 pools which spreads the volume of users Handy onsite shop Cheap

We had our first Orlando holiday here the hotel is really nice very well kept grounds and pools spotless rooms great location.only lil thing was the aircon unit in the room is very loud at night hopefully they will be upgraded.well be back Easter 2021 can't wait

I spent one night here with my girl friend based on a stay I had several years ago and was not sorry. The parking is a little dicey but the physical plant is still solidly three stars or a little better. Based on my last stay I requested a third story room to avoid noise and was really happy that I did. All in all a good stay with plenty of room for both of us to move around and get ready in the morning.

Been here now a few times, central place to stay so you can get around everywhere. Rooms are everything you need, pools are good and quiet, staff are really helpful and friendly. free car parking and a very short walking distance to food places.

We chose the Rosen Inn as we visited Orlando without a car. The location was excellent. On International Drive with a trolley stop right outside & free transfers to Universal theme park. We love to walk and found a Wal-Mart 40 mins away. This was great as International Drive & the little on-site supermarket were an absolute rip off. We also used the Lynx buses a lot to get to Florida Mall & further afield. The on-site restaurant was Ok but i certanly wouldn't have used it if i wasnt staying there. We had breakfast a few times, but always felt as if we had outstayed our welcome, The Staff made us feel very uncomfortable, especially if you went back up for seconds, even though it was a buffet!! Our room was very dark & unwelcoming and we thought the carpet felt damp. However, the room was cool and we didn't need to use the Aircon too much (which was good because it sounded like an aircraft!!) but a lick of white paint and some light furniture would transform the rooms completely. The housekeeping staff were excellent & although we live clean anyway, our room was always cleaned to a high standard. The room was large with a separate bathroom. The fridge & microwave were invaluable to us as we didn't want to eat out all of the time. it was too cold for us to use the pools while we were there but they looked nice enough. The transfers to Universal were great for us with a seperate desk for booking a space, as well as other tourist information and the staff were always very helpful.

The hotel is in a good location and the room was adequate but if you are expecting a conventional hotel atmosphere, you are in for a nasty surprise. After checking in, I was searching for the elevators and was surprised to know that I had to walk down a whole township before reaching my block. Finding my elevator and finally the room was another surprise. I did not have the strength or inclination to go down even for dinner since the place looked eerie without a soul in sight. It would be great if the guest is made to feel at least safe. Probably it is different for a family or friends.

I wish I could come down again as I love this hotel but........... the mattress in your rooms are way to soft for my poor old back. March 2019 I had to sleep the chair by the bed cause if I use your bed I barely managed to get out. I need a stiffer mattress but since all of yours are soft I can't return......... it sucks getting older and I have to look out for my back since Rosen will not invest in a few harder mattress

Estuvimos en enero en familia, la ubicacion es buena el hotel es cómodo y útil para ir a los parques...las instalaciones están cuidadas pero no en todos los horarios hay personal que hable español. La limpieza es buena, cuenta con lo esencial para mantener y guardar comida para llevar a los parques

Excellent location especially if you are meeting at Orange County Convention Center! 1) easy Uber ride from airport. 2) I could walk to convention center in 10-12 min. 3) no need for a car or Uber. Tons of great restaurants within a 5 min walk. Like Del Friscos, Capitol Grill, Maggiano’s, and so much more. Room was ok. I was on the top floor near elevator. Very quiet. Not much traffic noise from people walking by. 1) bed comfort was just “ok” 2) my tv did not work at all, wouldn’t even turn on. I didn’t report issue b/c I wasn’t in Orlando to watch tv. 3) workout room easy to get to and had the basics anyone needs for their workout. Free weights/mirrored wall/treadmill/bike/stair master/universal weight machine. Small but good equipment, gets the job done. 4) the small 24 hour food mart near lobby has anything you need. Food, beverage, chargers, travel size stuff. But there is a CVS right across street too. 5) small fridge/microwave in room. 6) iron and ironing board in room. 7) AC and heat in room worked just fine. Basic amenities were solid. So, I recommend this place b/c of location, price and amenities. But if comfort of your bed is super important you may want to consider another place.

We've being to international drive 4 times now and always stay at the Rosen inn at pointe orlando because it's fantastic The location is perfect within walking distance to everything idrive. The rooms are super comfortable maybe a bit dated but perfect comfortable bed chair etc TV has lots of channels. The pool areas are always spotless and we'll stocked. We don't eat there as for me there are much better options around but for families I'm sure it's very convenient Staff are always really nice and friendly I would note they point you to a time share person for a free gift and this person is annoying!!! I'd stay again In an instant Give it a try

Hotel moderno y nuevo, habitación amplia y confortable. Silenciosa. Muy buena atención de todo el personal, buena limpieza. Muy buenos desayunos y comidas. Ideal para relajarse luego de una jornada agotadora de parques. Muy conforme con este hotel

Un buen Hotel, ideal para estar en esa área. Su personal atento, tiene un excelente hotel en su terraza. Ofrece diversos menús en su área de restaurante. El transporte del hotel muy bueno e inclusive puedes ir caminando hacia las atracciones de Universal. Sus habitaciones, piscina y las vistas son muy buenas.

Maravilloso hotel! todos los comandos de la habitacion se realizan con un i-pad( luces, aire acondicionado) Tiene cafetera y frigobar en la habitacion.La atencion del personal es excelente, lastima que solo hablan en ingles.En el piso 17 tiene un bar en la terraza con una vista maravillosa a los parques de Universal.La piscina es climatizada y lo que me encanto es que tienen una silla especial que se introduce en la piscina para que las personas con discapacidad puedan bañarse.Me gusto todo y destaco la atencion de una señora que trabaja en el patio de comida de unos 55 años aprox (que no recuerdo su nombre) que hablaba español y se preocupaba todo el tiempo por atender y ayudar a los huespedes.

The hotel looks good from the outside. And I think it’s only around 2 years old, so I expected it to be good. But it’s not. There is noise in the room all night from cars passing (we were on 11th floor). At 2:38am they was a very loud noise that woke us both up. No idea what that was. The pillows are so thick that my neck was hurting. The bedsheets are too thin unless you want to use the bed cover as a sheet. There is a lot of light coming in from outside ALL NIGHT. At least at night there shouldn’t be light coming in. I personally don’t like the sink is not inside the bathroom, if you want to wash your hands (or turn on the light) at night then you wake up whoever else is in the room. This hotel is in no way worth the money we spent. We would never go back there again. It’s not recommended. The only good thing about it is the overall look from the outside (which is what fooled us).

Fui con mi novia, estuvimos 9 noches la pasamos de 10!!!. Las instalaciones son super modernas y el ambiente es muy tranquilo. La cama es muy cómoda, la vista desde la habitación que nos toco era increible, se veía Volcano iluminado en la noche. El baño y accesorios también 10 puntos. El patio de comidas cuenta con diferentes islas donde uno puede pedir desde Pizza y hamburguesas hasta sushi. (probamos pizza y hamburguesas todo muy rico y abundante) El servicio de Buses hacia los parques realmente cómodo y eficiente, desde que uno sale del hotel a unos pocos metros están las paradas de los buses. Para los que no hablan ingles, el personal del hotel cuenta con team members bilingues. Absolutamente recomendable, volvería siempre.

Excelente hotel. El servicio, atención y la habitación fueron excelentes. El bar de la terraza y la comida super recomendable. La ubicación estrategica para ir a los parques de Universal. Nunca tuve que esperar el bus que te lleva a los parques.

todo mejor de lo que esperabamos, el unico inconveniente que tuvimos fue el idioma en la recepcion del hotel que fue el unico lugar donde no hablaban español y nos dificulto la comunicacion un poco pero todo se pudo resolver

Todo estuvo genial Lo referente al acceso temprano al parque es una super ventaja que te permite disfrutar aun mas los parques. La vista en especial de este hotel es magnifica pues ves todo el parque completo.

Me encantó este hotel. Las zonas comunes son muy amplias y luminosas. Las habitaciones super modernas, luminosas, grandes y bien acondicionadas. Posee un patio de comidas dentro con muchas opciones. Desayunar dentro del hotel en starbucks fue lo mas!! No usamos la pileta porque fuimos a los parques, se veía muy bien. En bus podes ir a Universal en 5 minutos y caminando a Volcano Bay. El check in y out súper ágil. Es un hotel inteligente!!

Pasamos una semana estupenda en este hotel. Aunque alquilamos auto, la idea era pasar el mayor tiempo en las facilidades de Universal, inclusive para las comidas, piscina y parque de agua con salidas mínimas a los alrededores. Si visitamos una cadena de supermercados grande localizada a 5 millas para adquisicion de productos y frutas. Volveré a visitarlos. Hay personal que habla español

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We have visited this hotel many times and they are always consistent in accommodations and service. The hotel was very empty and food choices very limited. I think my only major criticism was lack of enforcement of guests wearing masks. Having stayed at several hotels during the last few months this was by far the worst with guests walking around with no masks in sight. There seemed to be little security and on a few occasions I had to point out to staff members that people weren’t wearing masks, which I was surprised and disappointed about. Still a great choice.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We stayed for my husband's birthday on Friday & Saturday night, and the first night was ok.. the room was clean, the bed was average comfort level and the hotel decor was nice. It wasn't until we came back from the pool that we realized the tiny bottle of shampoo (which was more like scented water) was not enough to actually wash an adult's hair after swimming in the pool.. so after everyone had there makeshift shower we went to bed. The next day we left for the park and were told the shuttle to return to the hotel would pick us up at Hollywood Studios at 6:15 so we were at the pick up location from 5:45-6:45 waiting on a bus that never came, we were then forced to call an uber, because were already running late for our 6:45 birthday dinner reservations, afterward we hit the pool for the evening, when we returned from the pool we realized that the housekeeping never visited our room to refill our watered down toiletries or our towels, much less to make up the beds. That was the last straw for me. In my opinion/experience the level of customer service we would expect and what we actually recieved from a hotel of this category and price point was very subpar. I would be very hesitant to ever stay here again.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I have stayed at the Hilton Bonnet Creek several times over the years and have always loved this resort. Fantastic amenities, beautiful pool with lazy river and great restaurants. I was concerned it wouldn't be the same with not all of the restaurants and amenities open, but we had a fantastic time. This resort was super conscious about social distancing, having floor markings and place markers of where to stand in elevators and enforcing face coverings while walking throughout the resort. The rooms are clean and spacious. The Waldorf side of the resort was closed for a private event which was a bit of a bummer as that side of the resort is beautiful as well. The highlight of the stay was dinner at La Luce. I have reviewed that restaurant separately, but it is fantastic. The food, the service, the atmosphere, the staff - all impeccable. I will definitely continue to choose Bonnet Creek as one of my Disney adjacent go-to resorts and I highly recommend it. Prices are considerably more reasonable than the official Disney Resorts and Bonnet Creek offers bus transportation to all of the parks!!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Stayed here in 2019 and I have to say it is a the best hotel we have stayed in in Orlando. In a really nice location with Golf Courses all around. Rooms are luxurious and there is several restaurants to choose from.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Absolutely 5 star service every time at Hilton Bonnet Creek. They made our 45th anniversary stay and my grandson's Under Armour golf weekend a perfect weekend stay. Absolutely exceeded our expectations. The GM, Glen, and his staff are first class.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I stayed on the 18th floor and my experience was good overall ( August 7-9), they were a few things my girlfriend and I did not enjoyed and one was the AC, since it was centralized I had to put it at the lowest temperature and still ti wouldn't go lower than 65 degrees and it would feel like 75, despite the lazy river at the pool was good the tallest part was just 3 feet, basically no free swimming to enjoy, again the staff was amazing and the room was beautiful, but those things were a disappointment.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Great hotel and location for families visiting the Orlando area. We stayed from July 19th-23rd of this year. Being a Hilton Honors member did not need to check in, being we had a Digital Key. We stopped by the Concierge Desk to ask about the Complimentary Shuttle Service to the Disney Parks. Very friendly informed us that they were not running the buses during the week. We could take a Taxi, Uber or Lyft and we would be reimbursed for our rides to the Disney parks. Just needed to show the Front Desk copies of our receipts. Stopped by the Front Desk to get physical keys for our 2 Rooms. Sheila, helped us with our Physical keys and was very Friendly and Informative about our stay. Our connecting rooms were on the 15th Floor facing towards Disney Springs. Nice sized rooms and amenities included in the Rooms. We liked the idea that Hilton is using the Clean Seals for the doors. Hilton is definitely taking the necessary precautions during the Pandemic. We felt very safe on our trip. Grabbing a quick bite each morning was a snap from Muse in the lobby area. Staff was very friendly each morning we got something and quick to help us. Great way to start each day before a long day at the Parks. Unfortunately some other food options were not available during our stay but we were fully aware of this and it did not distract from our stay. Pool is a must stop for Couples or Families. Our family enjoyed the Lazy River and Ample seating. Did not get a chance to eat or drink at the Pool area. Will be definitely back for the other Restaurants, Great Value and Wonderful Service. My only complaint is exiting the Parking Garage with the Digital Key, had a few issues trying to exit the gate a few times. Staff quickly answered the call button and was able to get us out. Love being so close to Disney and having things on site for our family.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We have stayed at a lot of Hilton Brands around the world, and we have stayed many times in the Orlando area for Disney and Universal. The Majority of our experiences have been relatively pleasant. This stay however definitely ranks at the top, from the moment we walked in, we were treated very warmly with greetings and smiles (Yes even though masks were worn, you can see the smile in the eyes!) Being a Gold Honors member, we asked if there were any complimentary upgrades available, and they informed us there weren't at this time, but would continually check for us through out the day, which they did and they would let us know the status via text message (Which was very convenient). When we came back that evening from Epcot, we stopped by the front counter and was warmly greeted again, and we asked if anything had came available and they said unfortunately not for the duration of our stay, but they said we do have another option for a nominal upgrade fee, they showed us the executive suite. They explained the normal/standard nightly rate for this suite, but would allow us to upgrade for a fraction of that rate, we accepted and upgraded. Best decision we made! What a wonderful suite, very spacious! We also loved the pool/lazy river, and jacuzzi! During this time with a lot of confusion and uncertainty in all directions, it was very nice to get away, and this Hilton resort went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable, relaxed, and safe. Thank you very much for everything!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We just wrapped up an awesome weekend getaway at the HBC! The staff, who are always friendly” had their “A” game on. Pool: Sherri at the pool continues to wow us with name recognition and continually checking on us and many other guests. She is awesome Le Luce: We had our birthday dinner here and everyone was very attentive. Justin and Yari from the management team were kind enough to check on us often. Joe our server, who has been at the restaurant since it opened, had great knowledge of the menu and provided some excellent suggestions. Thank you for making a birthday to remember Hope return soon.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Beautiful property, extremely clean, great service, good food .They clean and spray all the areas that people use. Personal with mask all the time. complementary tubes and towel. There are shopping areas 3 miles away.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I stayed at the Hilton Bonnet Creek near Walt Disney World recently. The resort is very nice. The pool area is spacious with a lazy river and a restaurant. The room was beautiful with high quality finishes. The resort was well maintained and very clean. The staff were helpful and friendly. They had taken many precautions to reduce the spread of Covid including requiring face coverings and cleaning and sanitizing the rooms and surfaces around the resort. I recommend the Hilton at Bonnet Creek.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: I had such an amazing stay at the Hilton Bonnet Creek resort. The property was beautiful & every staff member way beyond welcoming. Big thanks to Kristyn, Emma, Alisha, Veronica, Jonny, & Greta for their quick replies on the messaging system. I will definitely be back!!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: When our Hilton Disney Springs reservation was cancelled due to COVID 19 they offered the Bonnet Creek property for the same rate. Since it was close to Disney Springs we accepted. It has been a five star experience! They have gone all out to create a safe and clean atmosphere ...we opted out of housekeeping but whatever we needed was delivered to our room immediately and hung on the door. The decor is fabulous with many places just to sit in the lobby. Or outside. The lazy river is a real treat...hubby even agreed to experience it! The staff has been amazing. Because of COVID we are spending a lot of time in our room, plus we are both working remotely, but it is spacious and tastefully decorated. This is our new getaway for sure!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We had the best family vacation here at the Hilton Bonnet Creek. We were really nervous about traveling but the measures taken at the resort made us feel really safe. Everything was sanitized often and properly. The front desk especially Alisha made us feel at home. As far as food, We ate at La Luce one night- the food was fantastic. We also loved the food at the pool bar. Disney springs is a quick ride away and lots of food options open there. Our favorite part of the hotel was going out to the pool late night with the kids as the pool is open until 10. Overall we loved our trip and will definitely be back!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This hotel was very clean, the staff was very friendly and helpful. To minimize the contact between staff and guess, housekeeping only comes to you’re room upon request. All the staff are wearing masks all day, they are wiping doors, tables, pool chairs and the bar. This is probably the cleanest hotel I ever stayed in. Usually the normal spots to find dust or dirt like under the sink and bathroom was absolutely cleaned perfect. The hotel is only at half capacity, some of the restaurants are closed but overall my family enjoyed the lazy river. Special thanks to the front office team for making our stay enjoyable, Jenn , Greta, Emma and Veronica. Thank you!

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: The primary reason of my "poor" review was we started feeling unsafe by managements policy to not enforce mask wearing and than disrespected by the form letter response by the front office manager when I addressed it with Hilton Honors. I must travel for my profession (Diamond Honors); even during the pandemic. This was my 4th visit to a full service hotel in the past 8 weeks. Other hotels I've been a guest of were actively ensuring mask wearing... Signage posted at Bonnet Creek states face masks are required in all interior public areas. Constantly witnessed quests in the lobby and public areas not wearing masks and being in direct sight by staff. Once we counted 12+ guests in the lobby not wearing masks; addressed it with two staff members on two different days. Their response was they will remind guests to wear masks and provide masks if they don't have one. However management will not enforce the wearing of masks. I emailed Hilton Honors about this issue and stated their response will dictate how I proceed. The response from the properties front office manager was a form email not addressing face masks or any of my concerns.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We stayed at the Hilton Bonnet Creek from July 8-10, 2020, which is about a week after the hotel reopened after shutting down for COVID. It was incredible. Extremely clean. Exceptional service (shout out to our pool side server Ryan, who was kind, helpful and took great care of us while lounging poolside). The safety protocols were top notch. My entire family felt very safe and taken care of. While not all amenities have returned yet, for example, daily housekeeping is by request only, we never felt like we were missing anything. I’d like to thank the entire Hilton Bonnet Creek staff for their hard work and commitment to safety, cleanliness and care. It was truly felt during this stay, and we are so thankful to have had an opportunity for a mini vacation during such uncertain and challenging times. Highly recommend a stay here.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We checked in only one day after they reopened post covid19 shutdown. It was clear they were making many adjustments to make guests feel safety measures were in place. They were operating at only 30% capacity which made for a very nice float down the lazy river with little contact with others. There were plenty of places at the pool to relax in the sun and always a spot at the pool bar for a cool drink. A few things they need to do better are increase the options for meals. The only option for breakfast unless you chose to leave the resort were pre-made oven warmed breakfast sandwiches or bagels/croissants. The lunch/dinner options were very limited as no matter where you chose to sit and order from all the food was coming from one or two kitchens. Made for very limited menu choices and slow service. Every staff member we encountered was extremely nice, helpful and seemed genuinely pleased to be back at work.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Decided to come down in the off-season to visit family and friends and stop by a park or two. Hilton Orlando is in a great location with good amenities. Especially enjoyed the lobby bar Myth and the semi-enclosed area with the gas firepit. The pool is great as well with the lazy river.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: This location is attached to the convention center facility, golf course and Waldorf Astoria. With the lazy river and proximity to Disney Springs you cannot go wrong with a family style stay. Restaurants on the property serve good quality food as well.

Great hospitality all staff I have encountered have been very friendly . Glad to know the pool and gym are available to be used for the crew the cree coffee and breakfast sándwiches are a plus to us thank you

This was my first time at this hotel. The customer service was amazing, which included the shuttle driver from the airport, the front desk associate and the bartender. The food was delicious and the rooms were clean. Thank you for an wonderful stay.

The property was very clean and the staff was extremely friendly. They did everything in their power to ensure my stay was to my satisfaction. The property is attached to a large mall which is fantastic if you have to make any last minute purchases or you’d just like to go for a casual stroll.

The staff at this hotel is amazing. They are genuinely friendly. I left an item at the hotel that I have had for 43 years. They called me back within an hour saying it was not in the room. My heart was broken. The next morning I received a call saying they had located it. She went and checked the linen chute. I will be forever grateful for this act of kindness.

This hotel has the absolute most amazing staff. I stood at the hotel for 2 nights and 3 days and to be quite honest I didn’t want to leave. The hospitality that each and every staff provided simply made me feel better than being at home. Every staff literally would go above and beyond regardless of my needs. I personally forgot I was working and felt like I was on vacation the whole entire time.

THE STAFF WAS BEYOND ACCOMMODATING. The rooms were so comfy, clean, and cool. I would recommend to stay here again. The gym is available for use & is an extremely nice gyms. The pool is under maintenance. However, the staff brought out lounge chairs to a private courtyard for sun bathing. It was an extremely pleasant & comfortable stay.

Great staff and amenities! Awesome to have a Peleton bike in the gym to do a spin class. Super convenient because hotel is attached to the Florida mall. Also there is a Starbucks in the lobby which is a plu!

Great hotel, super clean, staff is super welcoming great location!!! Stayed here for work I hope my business keeps putting us here because out of all the hotels in Orlando I’ve stayed at this is by far my favorite.

Stayed at the Florida Hotel by the Mall many times for business. The hotel is always warm and welcoming and I feel like I’m at home with family. Nothing is ever too much trouble and the staff are more than happy to help with anything. I truly hope to see you all again soon ❤️ Best regards to you all in these tough times. Andrew

The location has all the conveniences. The gym is superb, with towers and Pelotons, the rooms were very nice and the staff friendly. I’m not sure I would have picked this hotel to goto had I not been sent there for work, but I most certainly will be back.

Our go to hotel every time we visit Orlando. Friendly staff ,spotless rooms I couldn’t recommend this hotel enough. You will not be disappointed.For those of you who may not know this hotel, it is situated within easy reach of Orlando airport. Boasts a lovely pool area and shopping is literally on the doorstep.what more could you ask for take my advice and stay here you will have a lovely stay

The staff was extremely friendly. Because of the COVID19 situation, it is an extremely hard time for hotel staffs, everyone I saw followed the guidelines and was extremely gracious. The rooms were extremely clean as was everything else I saw.

Lovely rooms well equipped with all your needs. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. Front desk ladies were very welcoming. Don’t forget to try the cookies😉 there is a shopping mall attached to the hotel so easy access for all your shopping needs. A must stay hotel.

The rooms are very modern and clean, the gym is top notch with smith machine and Peloton bikes, plenty of sanitizing wipes and spray bottles. Nice pool area and very convenient location inside the Florida Mall. Plenty of restaurants within walking distance of the hotel

Very friendly staff. We stay at this hotel exclusively for work. Under normal circumstances the mall is lively and a great way to spend a day. Unfortunately during the pandemic it was closed as most of the restaurants surrounding the hotel. The hotel went out of its way to make sure we were comfortable.

We stayed 3 night in the beginning of march at this hotel. It is a huge hotel situated in the florida mall. We requested in advance for a room on an upper floor. The hotel management answered that they did their best but couldn't promise it. We can understand that so that was no problem for us. At check in we got a room on the highest floor, so we were very pleased with this and we were pleased by the good management. The check in was also very smooth. The room was spacious and clean with a wonderful view over the city. The only problem we had was that the water in the bathtub did not drain properly. The hotel itself looks great and the communal areas are beautiful and clean. We had a tight schedule in Orlando so we did not have time to use the facilities in the hotel, but they all looked great. There is more than enough parking around the hotel. You can use valet parking or free parking, there is also safe free parking behind a barrier (you can use your room key to park your car). We read in advance on tripadvisor that breakfast and dinner at the hotel were pretty expensive so we didn't use this, due the lack of time we could not check this, so we don't know if this is true. In the vicinity of the hotel and all around orlando there are a lot of facilities to have breakfast and dinner, so you don't starve. We can recommend this hotel to anybody.

El lugar está modernizado y muy cómodo. Es perfecto para hacer shopping ya que está al lado del shopping Florida mall Además tiene lugares para comer y un target y un bed bath and beyond cerca del hotel

Un muy buen hotel, con buena ubicación y estupenda oportunidad para compras. Un punto negativo es su restaurante Marcelo´s , en donde aparte de que su oferta gastronómica es mala y limitada, el servicio de su personal es francamente malo. Recomiendo no comer ahí, caro, malo y con mal servicio.

For the past four years I have been traveling from The Bahamas to Orlando during December with my family and we always stay at Florida Hotel. The recently renovated rooms, the friendly staff especially Joey and Darron on the front desk made my last visit quite fun. From suggestions for fun places to take my girls and good restaurants, they know how to make your stay memorable. Looking forward to my visit in 2020. J.Beneby

I have traveled all over the world and the hospitality I received at the Florida Hotel was beyond all expectations. Every single employee was extraordinarily helpful and nice. I will definitely be visiting again!

It is great, because the Florida Mall is next to the Hotel and I love shopping.. The room has a microwave, refrigerator and all the amenities. Starbucks is next to the Hotel. People at the Reception Desk is very kind. I recommend this hotel.

I visit this property regularly on business. The location is excellent and the staff are outstanding. The hotel is attached to great shopping mall so very easy to shop, eat and drink there. The gym is very well equipped and the pool has many beds and towels left for guests. The staff are all outstanding, especially Maria on the Skydesk and bellman Joey is very helpful, friendly and knowledgeable. In summary, a very comfortable, friendly and well located hotel perfect for rest, shopping or socialising.

Fantastic hotel and very friendly staff!! Rooms are very clean,amazing shower and gym . Would highly recommend to anyone travelling to Orlando . Bonus - Hotel is also connected to an amazing mall with great shopping . Looking forward to staying again . Five Stars

excelente, muy bueno y lindo todo, el trato de los trabajadores fue maravilloso desde el servicio de maletas, Frontdesk y housekeeping (Francisca) recomendamos este Hotel,,, gracias !!! Feliz día de thanksgiving

El hotel se encuentra muy bien ubicado para pasear y hacer compras ya que esta prácticamente dentro de un mall. El personal de recepción es muy atento y amable. Los botones muy amables en todo momento.

This was my first time at The Florida Hotel and Conference Center. I was there for a country western dance festival. The hotel staff, on all levels, was so accommodating - from check-in through check-out, including my naive questions in between.

I stayed for 3 nights for a conference. My family joined me and we had a great time both at the hotel and at the mall. The room was clean and the staff was incredibly friendly. We weren't able to partake of the pool, but it looked inviting.

The remodeled rooms hit the mark. Attached to a mall, what other amenities could your ask for. On two days, I received text messages asking if I needed anything. I like that! The breakfast buffet was excellent and well below the cost of what I would expect to pay for comparable offerings.

We use this hotel because of its convenience to the Mall. It is a good hotel - the reception people are very helpful. I can register and if a room is not ready I can roam the Mall until I get a text message that the room is ready. The bed is comfortable. The room taxes are atrocious but that is common throughout Orlando. I do not hesitate to recommend this hotel -

I've stayed at the hotel several times for business... always a great experience. A shout out for the staff for this particular trip. I was running late for my outbound flight and as I was getting off the elevator going to my room, I dropped my room key envelope (which also had my credit card in it). It managed to fall down the elevator shaft through the crack between the elevator door and the floor. I didn't have time to look for it, but Christian Castro said he would take care of it. The staff expedited getting me a new room key on a side computer, despite a long line of customers who had just arrived to check in. When I came downstairs, Christian was there with the envelope with my key and credit card in it. My phone died as I was trying to get an Uber, but the two guys working the desk outside got me a cab (nice SUV) which was there inside of 2 minutes. Made my flight. Can't thank the staff enough for making it happen.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Visité el hotel Hilton en Florida. Fue agradable estar al lado de Disney World pero el hotel era horrible. Las habitaciones estaban muy sucias, el baño era pequeño, la televisión no funcionaba y solo había una cama. No recomiendo este hotel a nadie

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: If I had been staying on a corporate expense account like many guests at this hotel, I probably would have given it a higher review. $72+ for a family of four for breakfast, $37 for parking a night and $45 Resort fee. This was expensive and everything was extra. The shuttle does not get you to Disney parks early enough for magic hours, or ROTR sign up, so paid for Uber a few mornings too. The kids loved the lazy river, but pool side service very slow and under staffed. All and all not bad, but there are enough options in the area that I would shop around more next time with attention to what's included.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Our time spent at the Hilton Orlando Bonnet Creek was one of the best experiences we've had at a hotel. We were celebrating a special birthday and the staff got wind of it - this filtered up all the way to the hotel's leadership team and they did everything possible to ensure this birthday celebration and vacation was perfect. We couldn't believe all the staff seemed to know our names and of the birthday celebration, stopping us throughout our stay through the halls to ensure we were enjoying our stay. Starting with Michelle, the executive assistant to the general manager, she truly went above and beyond from the very beginning of our stay. She had great recommendations, took us on a tour of the hotel upon arrival, and even had birthday balloons, beverages and more in the room for us waiting as a surprise. It was incredible. Michelle ensured we were set up with everything we needed during our entire stay and made us feel like this hotel was home. She truly embodied what it means to be hospitable throughout our stay and we can't thank her enough for her kindness and accommodations. On another note the hotel restaurants we ate at were delicious. And throughout our experiences at the hotel restaurants, Justin, the manager, was fantastic. He checked up on us periodically during our dining experiences - giving us great recommendations, insights and great conversation. We cannot thank the staff enough for this incredible birthday experience at one of the most beautiful hotel properties we've been to... I highly recommend the Hilton Bonnet Creek to anyone looking looking for first-class service and a an amazing stay, guaranteed.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Nothing bad to mention. Positive experience. Staff very attentive and friendly. Would go back again. Was there for a large meeting and the staff handled all the people efficiently with great service. Very nice meeting rooms also

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: It was a great stay. Everything went smooth and everything was very clean. All the restaurants were amazing as well. No complaints at all. I will say they did upgrades me for a being a diamond member. Disappointed it wasn't a suite, it was just a different view. Lastly the shuttle is great, just has long run times. You stop at multiple parks which takes a while to get to the parks. All in all 4 our of 5. I will be back.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Nos alojamos en este hotel con ocasión de un viaje para llevar a nuestro hijo a Walt Disney World y sinceramente creo que fue un grave error. Para empezar, si eres español y no tienes un buen nivel de inglés, tendrás problemas para ser atendido por el personal, tanto de recepción como de conserjería, algo que no comparto desde la perspectiva de atención al turismo y que entiendo es una deficiencia importante, por lo menos si lo comparamos con la forma de atender en España a los turistas. Tuvimos un problema con la cisterna del baño, que se descargaba sola y volvía a cargarse cada 5 minutos, algo que por la noche resultaba claramente molesto y que, en un principio, achacábamos a alguna habitación colindante, hasta que descubrí la verdadera causa del ruido, por lo que tuve que estar casi una semana teniendo que acordarme de cerrar la llave del agua antes de acostarnos y ello pese a haber tratado de comunicar el problema tanto en recepción como en consejería, cuyos empleados parecía que habían entendido lo que pasaba, pero sin que hubiera solución real alguna, hasta que lo comenté con un empleado que trabajaba en los pisos y ese mismo día se solventó el problema. En cuanto al transporte a los parques temáticos, los tiempos de transporte oscilan entre 15 y 40 minutos, las frecuencias son cada hora y en algún caso no tienes transporte hasta la tarde, por lo que la única solución que tienes es irte a Magic Kingdom y a partir de ahí utilizar el transporte interno de Disney. Por otra parte, nosotros habíamos hecho la reserva a través de Nautalia y en el presupuesto que nos pasaron nadie nos informó que en este hotel, si o si, tienes que abonar 45 dólares por día, más las tasas, lo que nos produjo la sorpresa y el gasto añadido de 650 dólares más, algo que de haberlo sabido hubiera supuesto que no iríamos a este hotel. Ese pago obligatorio y adicional cubre el transporte a los parques y el Wi-fi en la habitación, una cena gratis para el niño siempre que cene también, al menos, un adulto, y algunas cosas más de similar efecto y que te pueden suponer hacer gastos que no deseas tener. En cuanto al wi-fi el funcionamiento en la habitación es bastante deficiente, si bien mejora en la zona de recepción. La habitación bien en general, aunque si quieres gel de ducha tienes que pedirlo, porque lo que encuentras son pastillas de jabón para que te duches a la antigua usanza. En resumen, si quieres ir a los parques temáticos, te recomiendo que te alojes en cualquiera de los hoteles del complejo, ya que entre lo que te cuesta un hotel como este y el cargo complementario, seguramente podrás igualar la cifra de gasto y ganarás en comodidad. En mi opinión es un hotel para americanos, bien en general, pero que no dispone de habitaciones de cortesía si tienes el vuelo de regreso tarde, toda vez que has de abandonar la habitación a las 11 y si permaneces más tiempo has de pagar 25 dólares por hora. De ahi que el lobby se convierta en una especie de campamento en el que permanecen los clientes que han de salir tarde y que toman algo o comen ne las mesas y zonas de descanso que tienen. Por lo que se refiere a los restaurantes, el mejor es el Asia, tanto por horarios como por comida y precios. Por último, si quieres un vasito de leche para tu hijo también te lo cobran en la tienda que tienen en el Lobby, donde sólo puede utilizar la tostadora, el microondas y disponer de vasitos de plástico, azucar y similares. Por todo ello, para españoles que no dominen el inglés no es un hotel a tener en cuenta, por más que pertenezca a una cadena del prestigio de la Hilton. Es de suponer que la oferta de transporte incluido tenga características similares en el resto de hoteles que no están dentro del complejo de Disney.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Excelente ubicación, atención, servicio e instalaciones. El único pero es que los baños están algo pequeños y viejos, fuera de eso todo estuvo muy bien. El desayuno buffete con mucha variedad y de buena calidad.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Buen hotel en general. No se esperaría menos de la cadena Hilton. Sin embargo a mi juicio excesivamente caro. Supongo que al estar en Disney todo influye. En general la gente del hotel muy agradable y muy servicial. Las habitaciones grandes y limpias. El wifi bastante bien aunque a veces fallaba un poco (cosa que entiendo por que el Hotel es muy grande y supongo que habría mucha gente conectada) El transporte a los parques de Disney muy bien. En general buena experiencia.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: We chose this hotel because it was close to Disney Springs and the lazy river. We wanted a relaxing final day of our vacation before we left for home from our cruise. I will definitely choose this hotel if I stay in Orlando again or travel to Disney World.

hotel_name: Signia By Hilton Orlando - An Official Walt Disney WorldR Hotel
review_text: Really enjoyed our stay here after a couple of teething problems. First night in our room we had a lot of noise from the restaurant below (scraping chairs on the floor etc), this was resolved quickly and we were moved to another room. The new room was a lot better, however there were a couple of nights on which we had noise issues with a family with young children next door (our room was joint by an interconnecting door so you could hear everything). We rang down to the staff and made them aware of this and they did eventually resolve this problem for us. Aside from those issues, this hotel was lovely and clean, in a great location and has a great pool and bar area. Good regular shuttles to the parks too!

Me encanto.. la experiencia fue única. La comida exquisita y fresca… eso si tiene un costo adicional.. La limpieza de los cuarto fue diaria .. al menos que en la puerta estuviera el no molestar.. ellas no entraban a limpiar.. El servicio del lobby al llegar todos muy cordiales.. lo único malo es que si te toca en el área de Bayside tienes que estar preparad@ para caminar hacia el área del lobby y dinner.. lo demás me encanto si volvería a ir.. Lo Elegiría otra vez los 10 días 😊

Es un hotel muy lindo para ir en familia. Solo una piscina estaba habilitada pero era grande. Habitación cómoda y muy bien equipada. Lo único es quedaba lejos el lobby, pero lo recomiendo. Podes lavar ropa pero las secadoras no funcionaban.

Necesita mejorar el servicio de limpieza en los cuartos, llegaban un dia si uno no, pero no limpiaban bien, tuvimos que ir detras de la señora de servicio para pedir papel higienico. La piscina durante la semana que estuve hospedad se mantuvo cerrada de lunes a jueves , la que tiene el tobogan y por ende la que quieren usar los niños, no fue muy satisfactorio y no habia excusa porque no la abrieron.

Es la tercera vez que nos hospedamos en este hotel. Realmente no quedamos satisfechos, tuvimos una estancia de 9 noches de las cuales nos limpiaron la habitación en 3 oportunidades y por encima. Teníamos que dejar la basura en la puerta para que la retiraran al igual que las toallas usadas, luego te dejaban en una bolsa colgada de la puerta las limpias. No había sanitizante en ninguno de los aparatos que están junto a los ascensores. Lo único positivo es la hora antes que puedes ingresar al parque sirve para entrar en Universal y Volcano Bay, se aprovecha. Pero no volvería más. La relación calidad precio no es buena.

Mal servicio, tuvimos solo un dia de limpieza de los 7 contratados. La recepcion fue tardia y no tienen forma de avisar y con pocas ganas de intentar hacerlo ameno. La gente de recepcion esta sobrepasada, y el interes del personal en atender los comentarios o quejas es cero.

Lugar limpio y amplio el área del restaurante y áreas comunes. Los cuartos limpios y servicio al cliente bueno. Los edificios están numerados por números. Estos se utilizan para identificar el lugar del cuarto. Sin embargo, no están debidamente rotulados. Cada edificio tiene una rotulacion pero casi no se ve. El edificio debe tener más rotulacion. El desayuno bien variado y buen estacionamiento.

Una experiencia muy excelente , él hotel muy limpio, todo staff que interactúe fue servicial y amable en todo momento. La comida, el arcade, la piscina, todo increíblemente bueno. Lo recomiendo 100%.😍

Un hotel entretenido y comodo para ir con ninos, varias piscinas, rio lento y tobogan (este ultimo solo abierto los fines de semana), facilidad para comer y desayunar, con muy buenas opciones de comida tanto de niños como adultos a precio adecuado, ademas de entretenimientos para la familia como juegos electronicos y bowling. Habitacion con microhondas y refrigerador (no encimera), ducha y wc separados, buen espacio de walk in closet. No te hacen limpieza de habitacion. Para mi la vista de la habitacion es fundamental asi que elegi acceso interior con vista a piscina, y creo es la mejor opcion.

El parqueo fatal no había puesto en las noches . En la habitación todo se escucha no se descansa si tocas con un mal vecino. La comida estuvo bien .Pienso que el precio no va con el valor del hospedaje.

Encontramos cucarachas en la habitación y solo nos ofrecieron un insecticida en aerosol para que yo lo aplicara. Pedí cambio de cuarto, por que tengo una bebe y accedieron pero jamás se disculparon por lo sucedido.
